title: Global Transaction Banking Summer Internship Programme 2027 Dublin
description:
Job Description 
 
 
 Purpose of the role 
 To participate in the day-to-day activities of the Transaction Banking division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.
 
 Accountabilities 
 Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for transaction banking, participating in the development of payment solutions for global companies as well as end-to-end product management with risk controls.
 Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.
 Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
 Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for transaction banking.
 Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions.
 
 Analyst Expectations 
 To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
 Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
 Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
 They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
 OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
 Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
 Partner with other functions and business areas.
 Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
 Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
 Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
 Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
 Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisation's products, services and processes within the function.
 Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
 Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
 Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
 Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
 Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.
 
 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
 
 
 Summer Internship Programme Overview 
 Join us as a summer intern and discover the world of finance and technology. Dive into our culture, engaging in real projects that offer a comprehensive business overview. Select your desired business area for an in-depth introduction, taking on immediate responsibility guided by a mentor and line manager. Forge connections, explore new horizons, and unlock growth opportunities in this 10 week journey. Join us during the summer of your penultimate year of university to build skills, expand knowledge, and embark on an impactful path towards a promising career.
 
 Why the Global Transaction Banking Summer Internship Programme? 
 The Global Transaction Banking summer intern programme imparts understanding of payment products' importance in our Corporate Banking offering. You will begin to understand how we innovate payment solutions for global companies, mastering end-to-end product management with risk controls. This internship will help you gain a good understanding of corporate product knowledge for a potential Corporate Banking career. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with key stakeholders, including tech and service partners, offering insights into the bank.
 
 Global Transaction Banking at Barclays 
 Global Transaction Banking serves a diverse range of clients, including mid-sized corporates, large corporates, financial institutions, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). These clients are organised based on their specific needs: mid-sized corporates are typically owner-managed and single-banked; large corporates are multi-banked and aligned by industry sectors; financial institutions include banks, payment service providers, and alternative finance companies; and SMEs range from small businesses to more sophisticated financial institution clients.
 
 We provide tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of each client segment, ensuring they receive the appropriate level of service and support.
 
 Barclays Global Transaction Banking is a perfect place to begin, and build, a long, varied and successful career in finance. You’ll be exposed to an unrivalled depth and breadth of experience. You’ll learn skills and gain product knowledge that prepare you for any role in our organisation.
 
 We are a wide ranging and diverse team of people across the UK, Europe, AsiaPac and the US. We have the strategy, leadership, and investment in place to grow our team significantly, upgrade our digital capabilities and drive global expansion. That’s because we are seen by the business as one of Barclays’ key opportunities for growth.  With all this growth, there’s also the opportunity to bring a truly global perspective to your career. That could mean managing a global team from your current location, creating products that are adapted for use around the world, or making an exciting international career move.
 
 The work we do touches every aspect of corporate and commercial banking. You’ll also get a unique perspective on global commerce, seeing how financial solutions and working capital support every stage of the corporate value chain.
 
 You’ll be interacting with, and learning from, colleagues from Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, sales, operations, technology, relationship management, compliance and legal teams. You’ll be working closely with Transaction Banking experts who have years of experience and knowledge to share. You’ll be understanding the needs of every size and type of client, across every industry. The relationships and networks you build with colleagues, clients and other financial institutions will be priceless.
 
 Throughout, you’ll be growing our business and forging new ground, with the support of one of the world’s leading corporate and investment banks. So, you’ll enjoy more exposure, access and influence, at an earlier stage, than most established Transaction Banking teams can offer. 
 
 There are a whole range of roles to explore, and our commitment to growth means that you’ll have opportunities to innovate, be an entrepreneur and develop your career on a global stage. There are always new products, sectors, markets and regulatory environments to explore.
 
 Who we're looking for 
 To be considered for this programme, you must be in your penultimate year of your degree, in any discipline.
 
 Ideally, you'll have a keen interest in finance and business. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.
 
 The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are accepted into our graduate programme, your base location will be the same as it was during your internship.
 
 Barclays Europe 
We’ve had a presence in Europe almost as long as there’s been a Barclays. So, we’re building on solid foundations, leveraging our embedded talent, in 10 locations across the region allowing us to draw on a wealth of local and regional insight.

 Working in Dublin 
You will be based in our new flagship office, One Molesworth Street, which is in the heart of Dublin city centre. We are currently expanding which drives a culture of change and hard work ethic, nonetheless the company maintains an open, friendly atmosphere.  This is enhanced through our unique on-boarding programs and a number of committees which all employees are eligible to join.
 
 Entry Salary: €30,000
Upper Salary: €30,000 
 
 The entry and upper salary information above includes only annual full-time equivalent base salary and represents the typical range of pay for the role. The actual pay rate will reflect the responsibility level of the role and experience level of the individual. The entry and upper salary information does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available. 
 
 Barclays employees are also eligible for a suite of competitive country-specific benefits.

title: Data Analytics Graduate Programme
description:
About Allianz: 

We are proud to be one of the world’s most trusted insurance companies, and Ireland’s #1 Property & Casualty Insurer serving over 900,000 customers across Ireland, for over 100 years. Our success is driven by the incredible people we employ, with over 800 people in Allianz Ireland, we are committed to supporting our employees' individual needs and aspirations. 

 

This role is officially based in Elm Park, Dublin 4, but we embrace a hybrid working model that offers you the flexibility and support you need to excel in your role. 

 

We are incredibly proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work having won the Super Large Category in 2025 & 2026, as well as being named one of Ireland’s Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces for Health & Wellbeing. We are also the proud winners of the Gradireland Best Graduate Recruiter within the Insurance industry 2022 – 2025.  

 

At Allianz, we believe the graduates of today will become the leaders, innovators and experts of tomorrow. If you're ready to take the next step in your career, apply now and become part of the team! 

 

The Data Analytics Graduate Programme: 

The Data Analytics Graduate Programme is a three-year programme where graduates will have the opportunity to build technical expertise, commercial awareness and leadership capability through a structured development journey. 

 

You will gain hands-on experience across some of Allianz's most innovative teams, helping to solve real business problems through data, analytics and technology. Throughout the programme, you will complete four rotations tailored to your strengths, interests and development goals, typically across teams including Data Insights, Transformation, Actuarial, Underwriting, Pricing and other key business areas. 

 

As part of the programme, you'll complete a six-month international assignment within the Allianz Group, giving you exposure to global best practice, different cultures and international career opportunities.  

 

In parallel, you will receive support to achieve your APA (Accredited Product Adviser) professional insurance qualification, benefit from structured learning and development opportunities, and build a strong professional network across Allianz Ireland and the wider Allianz Group. 

 

For more information download our Graduate Programme Brochure 

 

Closing date for applications:  11th October 2026 

 

What we are looking for: 

We're seeking curious, ambitious graduates who are passionate about using data, technology and innovation to solve complex challenges. You may be a strong fit if you:  

  • Enjoy analysing data to uncover insights and support decision making.  

  • Are data driven with an analytical mindset 

  • Have an interest in emerging technologies including Artificial Intelligence and automation  

  • Are naturally curious and enjoy solving problems.  

  • Can communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively 

  • Thrive working collaboratively in cross-functional teams.  

  • Are results oriented & solutions focused 

  • Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. 

 

 

Minimum requirements: 

  • Achieved or expected 2:1 degree in the following areas:  in Actuarial Studies, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Insurance, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. 

  • Full authorisation to work in Ireland or a valid work permit for minimum of 36-month period covering the duration of the programme.  

  • Demonstrated work experience through internships, placements, part-time employment, volunteering, academic projects or extracurricular activities.  

 

 

Rewards & Benefits: 

  • Competitive graduate salary 

  • Six-month International Assignment 

  • Further Educational Support & Additional Study Leave 

  • 22 Annual Leave Days plus 2 company days and volunteer days  

  • Excellent Health & Pension Benefits 

  • Staff Affinity Insurance Scheme 

  • Hybrid Working Arrangements 

  • Free Lunch 

  • Onsite Gym 

  • Holiday Saving Scheme & Travel Subsidies 

  • Employee Assistance Programme 

  • Active Social Club & Events 

  • Charity and community initiatives   

  • Mentorship Programme 

  • Compressive Learning & Development Support 

 

Allianz plc. is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland. 

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. 

 

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust. 

 

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. 

 

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Audit Associate Galway 2027
description:
At Forvis Mazars, we’re not just one of the leading professional services firms in Ireland — we’re a launchpad for ambitious graduates ready to make an impact. With over 1,000 professionals across Dublin, Cork, Galway, and Limerick, and a global network spanning 100+ countries, we offer the scale, support, and opportunities to help you thrive.   
  
 Why join us  
 Our next-generation graduate programme is built around you. We understand that no two people are the same, so we tailor your training, mentoring, and career development to match your strengths, interests, and goals.   
   
 Here, you’ll be more than just a number. You’ll be empowered to lead, innovate, and grow — personally and professionally. If you're looking for a career where your voice matters and your work makes a difference, this is the place for you.  
 
 The Position    
   
 Auditors have the responsibility of determining how honest and accurate a business’s financial records are while also suggesting ways to reduce cost, enhance revenue and increase profits. As an Audit Associate with Forvis Mazars, you will gain a wide range of experience across a wide variety of clients including privately owned businesses, large corporates, and multinational organisations.  
   
 Forvis Mazars Audit & Assurance teams are split into specific areas; Public Interest Entities (PIE), Privately Owned Business (POB) and Financial Services (FS). Each area offers graduates the opportunity to pursue either ACA or ACCA professional qualification.  
   
 From the outset, you will experience auditing some of the lower risk audit areas and as you progress you will become responsible for the most complex and high-risk sections on an audit file and be pivotal to managing our client relationships and service delivery. The level of your responsibilities will be driven by your capability, your on-the-job performance and your motivation to succeed.
We’re looking for bright, motivated individuals from a wide range of backgrounds—whether that’s engineering, business, law, science, or a related field. What matters most is your eagerness to learn, collaborate, and apply your skills effectively. We’ll equip you with the technical and business know-how you need—but your energy, curiosity, and attitude are what will set you apart.  
   
 What we’re looking for  
 You’re working towards or have recently completed an honours degree in any discipline. 

 You act with integrity and always strive to do the right thing. 

 You’re a strong communicator who enjoys meeting people and exploring new ideas. 

 You value respect, inclusivity, and supporting those around you. 

 You thrive in team environments and enjoy working with others. 

 You’re organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage your time effectively. 

 You’re comfortable with technology and have solid computer skills. 

 You think critically and enjoy solving problems with logic and creativity. 

 You have excellent organisational skills, computer literacy and attention to detail

At Forvis Mazars, we’re not just one of the leading professional services firms in Ireland — we’re a launchpad for ambitious graduates ready to make an impact. With over 1,000 professionals across Dublin, Cork, Galway, and Limerick, and a global network spanning 100+ countries, we offer the scale, support, and opportunities to help you thrive.    
   
 Why join us?   
   
 Our next-generation graduate programme is built around you. We understand that no two people are the same, so we tailor your training, mentoring, and career development to match your strengths, interests, and goals.   
   
 Here, you’ll be more than just a number. You’ll be empowered to lead, innovate, and grow — personally and professionally. If you're looking for a career where your voice matters and your work makes a difference, this is the place for you 
 
 The Position   
  
 Our IT and security audit training programme provides you with the opportunity to develop your knowledge and audit skills in areas such as IT general controls, AI, IT governance, risk management, cyber security, data privacy, network security, digital forensics and incident response, amongst others.  
  
 Associates are also provided the opportunity and support to successfully obtain internationally recognised industry certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) as well as becoming familiar with a variety of other industry standards. 
  
 Successful candidates will be offered a three-year graduate training programme which will provide them with a wealth of opportunity to conduct audit work across a range of IT, security and audit disciplines including external audit, internal audit, security, cyber, risk, investigations, SOC and the emerging discipline of digital trust and AI audit.  
  
 The new IT and security audit associates will join a growing team of strong technical audit professionals working on a range of prestigious Irish and international clients. Over the 3 years of the programme, you will develop both your technical IT/security skills and your audit skills, leaving you with a range of exciting career options on completion of your contract, including the option to stay within the Forvis Mazars Group. 
  
 You will receive comprehensive training over the course of your training contract including at the Forvis Mazars University, ongoing soft and technical skills training. In year 1 you will pursue the Certified Information System Auditor (CISA) programme, in year 2 the Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) and in year 3 you can elect to pursue one of a series of options ranging from CRISC, CGEIT, CISSP, Cyber Security Foundation Professional Certificate (CSFPC) or similar.
About you   
   
 We’re looking for bright, motivated individuals from a wide range of backgrounds—whether that’s engineering, business, law, science, or a related field. What matters most is your eagerness to learn, collaborate, and apply your skills effectively. We’ll equip you with the technical and business know-how you need—but your energy, curiosity, and attitude are what will set you apart.  
   
 What we’re looking for   
 You’re working towards or have recently completed an honours degree in any discipline.  

 You act with integrity and always strive to do the right thing.  

 You’re a strong communicator who enjoys meeting people and exploring new ideas.  

 You value respect, inclusivity, and supporting those around you.  

 You thrive in team environments and enjoy working with others.  

 You’re organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage your time effectively.  

 You’re comfortable with technology and have solid computer skills.  

 You think critically and enjoy solving problems with logic and creativity.  

 You have excellent organisational skills, computer literacy and attention to detail

 The Position    
   
 We have an exciting opportunity for a graduate to join our leading international firm and specifically our award-winning Financial Accounting and Outsourcing Services Division.  Our Financial Accounting and Outsourcing team work to support our clients to better run their finance functions, understand their financial position and performance, and to ensure they are compliant with changing accounting and tax legislation. The successful candidate will work with a diverse range of clients across various industries, assisting with all aspects of their accounting lifecycle. This ambitious individual will have the opportunity to complete ACA/ACCA exams while receiving full financial and exam support from Forvis Mazars.   
   
 Responsibilities    
   
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:  
 
 Maintenance of financial information for a broad range of international clients using various accounting software packages including Xero and Sage 50  

 Preparation of monthly accounting reporting packs including bank reconciliations, creditors reconciliations, VAT reconciliations and debtors’ statements  

 Creating and updating financial statements using accounts production software  

 Preparation of statutory financial statements  

 Preparation and filing of VAT, VIES and Intrastat returns  

 Interim secondments to clients across a range of industries  

 Liaising with various external stakeholders providing support as required including external auditors as part of the year end audit process  

 Building strong relationships with client representatives

 The Position    
 In providing tailored solutions to the individual needs of our clients, Forvis Mazars tax examine and offer a comprehensive range of tax services to national and international clients with a particular emphasis on helping them to structure their businesses and financial affairs tax efficiently.  
   
 Forvis Mazars has one of the largest teams of tax specialists in Ireland and provides a full range of tax services to small and medium sized enterprises, private and publicly quoted companies and individuals. Our approach entails coming forward with ideas and solutions that bring added value to clients, based on a comprehensive understanding of each client’s particular business. We are part of the International Forvis Mazars organisation, Europe’s largest independent firm of accountants and advisors, and as such are ideally placed to provide advice on cross border transactions and international tax issues.  
   
 As a Tax Associate, you will be trained and developed in the following areas:  
   
 Preparation of tax computations, personal tax returns and corporation tax returns for our income tax and corporation tax clients  

 Research, review and interpretation of tax legislation, Revenue guidance and published papers  

 Assisting in the preparation of tax consultancy reports and responding to client queries  

 Working with international clients on global tax issues e.g. setting up new companies in foreign countries   

 Reviewing tax issues around potential succession planning e.g. passing on a business to the next generation and the tax implications that should be considered  

 Communicating with clients and Revenue on an ongoing basis  

 Attending client meetings along with more senior staff members to obtain one-to-one client interaction skills  

 Working alongside our experienced tax team, gaining training across all tax heads.  

 Identifying tax planning opportunities for clients

title: Tax Associate Limerick 2027
description:
At Forvis Mazars, we’re not just one of the leading professional services firms in Ireland — we’re a launchpad for ambitious graduates ready to make an impact. With over 1,000 professionals across Dublin, Cork, Galway, and Limerick, and a global network spanning 100+ countries, we offer the scale, support, and opportunities to help you thrive.   
  
 Why join us  
 Our next-generation graduate programme is built around you. We understand that no two people are the same, so we tailor your training, mentoring, and career development to match your strengths, interests, and goals.   
   
 Here, you’ll be more than just a number. You’ll be empowered to lead, innovate, and grow — personally and professionally. If you're looking for a career where your voice matters and your work makes a difference, this is the place for you.  
 
 The Position    
 In providing tailored solutions to the individual needs of our clients, Forvis Mazars tax examine and offer a comprehensive range of tax services to national and international clients with a particular emphasis on helping them to structure their businesses and financial affairs tax efficiently.  
   
 Forvis Mazars has one of the largest teams of tax specialists in Ireland and provides a full range of tax services to small and medium sized enterprises, private and publicly quoted companies and individuals. Our approach entails coming forward with ideas and solutions that bring added value to clients, based on a comprehensive understanding of each client’s particular business. We are part of the International Forvis Mazars organisation, Europe’s largest independent firm of accountants and advisors, and as such are ideally placed to provide advice on cross border transactions and international tax issues.  
   
 As a Tax Associate, you will be trained and developed in the following areas:  
   
 Preparation of tax computations, personal tax returns and corporation tax returns for our income tax and corporation tax clients  

 Research, review and interpretation of tax legislation, Revenue guidance and published papers  

 Assisting in the preparation of tax consultancy reports and responding to client queries  

 Working with international clients on global tax issues e.g. setting up new companies in foreign countries   

 Reviewing tax issues around potential succession planning e.g. passing on a business to the next generation and the tax implications that should be considered  

 Communicating with clients and Revenue on an ongoing basis  

 Attending client meetings along with more senior staff members to obtain one-to-one client interaction skills  

 Working alongside our experienced tax team, gaining training across all tax heads.  

 Identifying tax planning opportunities for clients
About you   
 We’re looking for bright, motivated individuals from a wide range of backgrounds—whether that’s engineering, business, law, science, or a related field. What matters most is your eagerness to learn, collaborate, and apply your skills effectively. We’ll equip you with the technical and business know-how you need—but your energy, curiosity, and attitude are what will set you apart.  
   
 What we’re looking for   
 You’re working towards or have recently completed an honours degree in any discipline.  

 You act with integrity and always strive to do the right thing.  

 You’re a strong communicator who enjoys meeting people and exploring new ideas.  

 You value respect, inclusivity, and supporting those around you.  

 You thrive in team environments and enjoy working with others.  

 You’re organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage your time effectively.  

 You’re comfortable with technology and have solid computer skills.  

 You think critically and enjoy solving problems with logic and creativity.  

 You have excellent organisational skills, computer literacy and attention to detail

title: Technology Financial Operations Data Analytics & BI Engineer
description:
Summary: This role builds and supports the data models, dashboards, pipelines, and reports the Technology Financial Operations Office uses to manage technology cost, Cloud FinOps, TCO, portfolio, demand, and productivity information. The work is to move recurring reporting off manual spreadsheets and one-off files and onto governed analytics products with reliable refreshes, consistent definitions, and clear ownership. Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric are the corporate platforms for this work; strong comparable enterprise BI experience will also be considered. The test of success is whether leadership uses the reporting as delivered, without rebuilding it in a spreadsheet first and without the numbers falling apart when someone checks them.
 Who We Are Looking For The Technology Financial Operations Office is looking for a hands-on Data Analytics & BI Engineer to be based in Dublin. The broader team is distributed, with several senior stakeholders and complementary roles based in other offices, so this role will need to partner effectively across locations. This is a build-and-support role: the successful candidate does the BI engineering and data modeling directly, works with the stakeholders who use the output, and stays with those products once they are in production. The work runs the full path from a loosely defined reporting request through discovery, data preparation, modeling, build, validation, release, and ongoing support. It suits someone comfortable with both technical partners and non-technical business users, who can explain what a number means as readily as they can build the model behind it. The role is judged on what reaches production and gets used, not on the volume of reports produced.
 Why This Role Is Important to Us The Technology Financial Operations Office is moving recurring reporting off manually maintained spreadsheets and one-off files and onto BI products that can be reused across functions. Source data is fragmented across finance, cloud, procurement, portfolio, and service management systems, and the questions leadership asks keep changing as the cost agenda matures. This role makes the answers reliable enough to act on without side calculations or manual reconciliation.
 Near-term work includes reporting for IT Total Cost of Ownership and showback, Cloud FinOps spend and optimization tracking, productivity and demand reporting, and the retirement of high-effort manual reports. These are starting points rather than the boundary of the role; the same discipline will be applied to further cost and financial analytics products as the Business Office defines them.
 What You Will Be Responsible For Build and maintain data pipelines, transformations, semantic models, dashboards, and refreshable reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related analytics tools.
 Modernize spreadsheet-based reporting by converting recurring, manually maintained reports into governed, reusable BI products with defined owners and a support model.
 Develop reporting that supports technology financial management, IT Total Cost of Ownership, Cloud FinOps, portfolio, demand, and headcount processes, including showback views and optimization tracking.
 Prepare, reconcile, and model data from finance, cloud, procurement, portfolio, headcount, and service management systems, including the transformation logic and refresh processes that keep those sources aligned.
 Build reusable datasets, semantic models, and measures, together with the validation checks and exception reporting that surface data quality issues before they reach a report.
 Design dashboards and reports that Business Office teams, finance partners, and senior technology leaders can read and act on without a walkthrough.
 Work directly with business stakeholders to capture requirements, agree definitions, and validate results, translating loosely defined questions into something the available data can answer.
 Apply controlled release, change, and access practices so reporting stays secure, traceable, and safe to change once it is in production.
 Document sources, definitions, assumptions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, and known limitations.
 Support delivered products after launch, including issue intake, triage, resolution, and continuous improvement.
 What We Value The following skills and qualities matter most in this role:
 Ownership of a vague reporting request from discovery through build, validation, release, and ongoing support, including the unglamorous parts, without needing to be chased.
 Comfort working with imperfect source data, and the discipline to reconcile differences, document assumptions, and state plainly what the data will and will not support.
 A clear line between actuals, forecasts, estimates, and advisory analysis, held consistently and without turning every number into a caveat.
 The ability to explain a number, its limitations, and the tradeoffs behind it to a finance partner, a technical peer, or a senior executive.
 Comfort working across functions where definitions, source data, and ownership are still maturing, and the patience to build alignment rather than wait for it.
 A product mindset that treats reporting as a supported capability with an owner, a backlog, and a roadmap rather than a series of one-off builds.
 Exacting standards for documentation, data quality, governance, and auditability, because these reports are relied on every month and are expected to hold up to review.
 Education & Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
 Hands-on experience building BI solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric preferred, including Power Query, DAX, semantic models, dashboards, dataflows, lakehouse or warehouse patterns, and SQL; strong comparable enterprise BI experience will also be considered.
 Demonstrated experience building data models, measures, reconciliations, and refresh processes that span multiple source systems and survive routine change in those sources.
 Familiarity with financial, portfolio, procurement, cloud, and headcount data, and with IT cost transparency concepts such as Total Cost of Ownership, showback, and Cloud FinOps, preferred.
 Experience documenting data lineage, definitions, calculations, and controls in a governed or regulated enterprise environment preferred.
 Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to capture requirements, agree definitions, and validate results before release preferred.
 Additional Requirements This is a matrixed role. The work spans finance, FinOps, portfolio, procurement, and technology teams, with requirements that shift as the cost agenda matures and source data that rarely arrives clean. Comfort operating with that level of ambiguity, and the persistence to resolve it rather than route around it, matters as much as technical skill.
 Work Requirements Full-time role based in Dublin, Ireland.
 Expected to follow applicable State Street office attendance requirements for the role and location.
 Standard business hours, with flexibility as needed to support stakeholders across time zones; limited travel may be required.
 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

 Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

title: Global Transaction Banking Graduate Programme 2027 Dublin
description:
Job Description 
 
 
 Purpose of the role 
 To participate in the day-to-day activities of the Transaction Banking division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.
 
 Accountabilities 
 Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for transaction banking, participating in the development of payment solutions for global companies as well as end-to-end product management with risk controls.
 Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.
 Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
 Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for transaction banking.
 Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions.
 
 Analyst Expectations 
 To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
 Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
 Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
 They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
 OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
 Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
 Partner with other functions and business areas.
 Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
 Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
 Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
 Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
 Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisation's products, services and processes within the function.
 Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
 Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
 Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
 Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
 Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.
 
 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
 
 
 Graduate Programme Overview 
 If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success, and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.
 
 Why the Global Transaction Banking Graduate Programme? 
 The Global Transaction Banking graduate programme imparts understanding of payment products' importance in our Corporate Banking offering. You will innovate payment solutions for global companies, mastering end-to-end product management with risk controls. Completing the programme will equip you with solid corporate product knowledge for a Corporate Banking career.
 
 There are a huge variety of roles, opportunities and career paths to explore at Transaction Banking. Our teams include people of all levels and experience. We have teams focusing on Technology, Digital, Customer Experience, Data, Specialist Sales, Liquidity, Coverage, Trade, Cash Management, FX, Structuring, Operations and Control, supported by Business Management.  Our roles range across the product lifecycle from deep technical specialists to client-facing relationship managers and experts in data, risk and operational rigour. Our Product Managers act like entrepreneurs running their own small business from beginning to end.
 
 This variety gives our people the agility, deep product knowledge and broad commercial understanding to develop their careers in any number of ways. We’re committed to helping our people update and upgrade their skills as they grow with us.
 
 Global Transaction Banking at Barclays 
 Global Transaction Banking serves a diverse range of clients, including mid-sized corporates, large corporates, financial institutions, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). These clients are organised based on their specific needs: mid-sized corporates are typically owner-managed and single-banked; large corporates are multi-banked and aligned by industry sectors; financial institutions include banks, payment service providers, and alternative finance companies; and SMEs range from small businesses to more sophisticated financial institution clients.
 
 We provide tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of each client segment, ensuring they receive the appropriate level of service and support.
 
 Barclays Global Transaction Banking is a perfect place to begin, and build, a long, varied and successful career in finance. You’ll be exposed to an unrivalled depth and breadth of experience. You’ll learn skills and gain product knowledge that prepare you for any role in our organisation.
 
 We are a wide ranging and diverse team of people across the UK, Europe, AsiaPac and the US. We have the strategy, leadership, and investment in place to grow our team significantly, upgrade our digital capabilities and drive global expansion. That’s because we are seen by the business as one of Barclays’ key opportunities for growth.  With all this growth, there’s also the opportunity to bring a truly global perspective to your career. That could mean managing a global team from your current location, creating products that are adapted for use around the world, or making an exciting international career move.
 
 The work we do touches every aspect of corporate and commercial banking. You’ll also get a unique perspective on global commerce, seeing how financial solutions and working capital support every stage of the corporate value chain.
 
 You’ll be interacting with, and learning from, colleagues from Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, sales, operations, technology, relationship management, compliance and legal teams. You’ll be working closely with Transaction Banking experts who have years of experience and knowledge to share. You’ll be understanding the needs of every size and type of client, across every industry. The relationships and networks you build with colleagues, clients and other financial institutions will be priceless.
 
 Throughout, you’ll be growing our business and forging new ground, with the support of one of the world’s leading corporate and investment banks. So, you’ll enjoy more exposure, access and influence, at an earlier stage, than most established Transaction Banking teams can offer. 
 
 There are a whole range of roles to explore, and our commitment to growth means that you’ll have opportunities to innovate, be an entrepreneur and develop your career on a global stage. There are always new products, sectors, markets and regulatory environments to explore.
 
 Who we're looking for 
To be considered for this programme, you must be motivated and curious with a degree or expected degree, in any area.
 
 Ideally, you'll have a can-do attitude and have analytical skills. You'll have some experience translating data and be a good communicator. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.
 
 Barclays Europe 
We’ve had a presence in Europe almost as long as there’s been a Barclays. So, we’re building on solid foundations, leveraging our embedded talent, in 10 locations across the region allowing us to draw on a wealth of local and regional insight.
 
 Working in Dublin 
You will be based in our new flagship office, One Molesworth Street, which is in the heart of Dublin city centre. We are currently expanding which drives a culture of change and hard work ethic, nonetheless the company maintains an open, friendly atmosphere. This is enhanced through our unique on-boarding programs and a number of committees which all employees are eligible to join.
 
 Entry Salary: €40,000
Upper Salary: €40,000
 
 The entry and upper salary information above includes only annual full-time equivalent base salary and represents the typical range of pay for the role. The actual pay rate will reflect the responsibility level of the role and experience level of the individual. The entry and upper salary information does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.
 
Barclays employees are also eligible for a suite of competitive country-specific benefits.
 
 This position is eligible for an incentive award.

 Reporting to an Officer/AVP, the Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring the net asset value of the clients’ portfolios are accurately calculated and disseminated in a timely manner. Ensure prompt follow upon exception situations and facilitate timely issue resolution to mitigate risk to the corporation and deliver excellent service to clients. This position gives the opportunity to demonstrate leadership, communication and technical expertise.  The Individual will be responsible for implementing company policy, overseeing client deliverables and contributing to the development of the team and organization.

 Why this role is important to us 
 The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

 What you will be responsible for 
 As Fund Accounting  Specialist-Senior Associate you will 
  Responsible for delivery of the highest quality of client services and maintain understanding of client  SLA provisions and relevant KPIs
 Prior experience in Fund accounting / NAV  is required
  Responsible for NAV oversight and timely NAV dissemination
 Develop and build up a strong relationship with the clients
 Assume oversight responsibility for operational aspects of the client’s funds.
 Anticipate the client’s future requirements & ensure that these can be met.
  Manage and plan resources ensuring delivery of outcomes are consistent, timely and accurate
 Represent team on local, regional or global working group, projects or committees as required
 Ensure sufficient trained staff is available to service the client and deliver quality service.
 Drive and assume responsibility for the implementation of client specific projects
  Ensure senior management is adequately updated on a regular basis regarding all aspects of the clients, highlighting all potential risks with possible solutions in a timely manner.
 
 Leadership and Management 
 Set and maintain standards of personal and professional performance/behavior; ensuring staff accountability and adherence to company policies and procedures.
 Provide coaching, guidance and support to team on technical, professional and client issues.
 Monitor and appraise the performance of team in conjunction with your manager - providing regular formal and informal feedback.
  Manage resources and take responsibility for the on boarding of new staff.
 
 What we value 
 Core Competencies 
  Self-motivated and enthusiastic with proactive attitude
  Exercise sound judgment
 Flexible attitude to solving issues
 Leverage knowledge and technology to ensure optimal results
 Communicate effectively at all levels within the organisation
 Display organisational insight, proven ability to improve workflows and team structures in line with Business  objectives
 Foster collaboration & team work
 
 Education & Preferred Qualifications 
 Qualifications 
 Primary Degree or a Professional or Accounting qualification or equivalent
 Significant experience working in the provision of fund administration service
 
 About State Street 
 What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

 Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

 Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility. We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.
 State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: General Insurance Graduate Programme
description:
About Allianz:

We are proud to be one of the world’s most trusted insurance companies, and Ireland’s #1 Property & Casualty Insurer serving over 900,000 customers across Ireland, for over 100 years. Our success is driven by the incredible people we employ, with over 800 people in Allianz Ireland, we are committed to supporting our employees' individual needs and aspirations. 

 

This role is officially based in Elm Park, Dublin 4, but we embrace a hybrid working model that offers you the flexibility and support you need to excel in your role. 

 

We are incredibly proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work having won the Super Large Category in 2025 & 2026, as well as being named one of Ireland’s Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces for Health & Wellbeing. We are also the proud winners of the Gradireland Best Graduate Recruiter within the Insurance industry 2022 – 2025.   

 

At Allianz, we believe the graduates of today will become the leaders, innovators and experts of tomorrow. If you're ready to take the next step in your career, apply now and become part of the team! 

 

The General Insurance Graduate Programme:

The General Insurance Graduate Programme is a three-year programme designed to build commercial awareness, business expertise and leadership capability through a structured learning journey. 

 

You will gain hands-on experience across a range of business functions, helping to shape the future of insurance through customer-focused solutions, business transformation and innovation. Throughout the programme, you will complete four rotations tailored to your strengths, interests and development goals, typically across teams including Transformation, Operations, Underwriting, Marketing, Claims, Product and other key business areas. 

 

As part of the programme, you'll complete a six-month international assignment within the Allianz Group, giving you exposure to global best practice, different cultures and international career opportunities. 

 

In parallel, you will receive support to achieve your APA (Accredited Product Adviser) professional insurance qualification, benefit from structured learning and development opportunities, and build a strong professional network across Allianz Ireland and the wider Allianz Group. 

 

For more information download our Graduate Programme Brochure 

 

Closing date for applications: 11th October 2026 

 

What we are looking for: 

We're seeking curious, ambitious graduates who are passionate about building a career in a dynamic, innovative customer-focused business. You may be a strong fit if you: 

  • Enjoy working collaboratively and building strong relationships with others. 

  • Demonstrate commercial awareness and an interest in understanding customer needs and emerging market and business trends. 

  • Have an interest in innovation, emerging technologies and continuous improvement. 

  • Are results oriented & solutions focused 

  • Have strong communication and interpersonal skills. 

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and can adapt to change. 

  • Take ownership, show initiative and are self-motivated. 

  • Are naturally curious and eager to learn. 

 

 

Minimum requirements: 

  • Achieved or expected 2:1 degree in the following areas: Insurance, Business, Law, Commerce, Marketing, Communications, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.  

  • Full authorisation to work in Ireland or a valid work permit for minimum of 36-month period covering the duration of the programme.  

  • Demonstrated work experience through internships, placements, part-time employment, volunteering, academic projects or extracurricular activities.  

 

Rewards & Benefits: 

  • Competitive graduate salary 

  • Six-month International Assignment 

  • Further Educational Support & Additional Study Leave 

  • 22 Annual Leave Days plus 2 company days and volunteer days  

  • Excellent Health & Pension Benefits 

  • Staff Affinity Insurance Scheme 

  • Hybrid Working Arrangements 

  • Free Lunch 

  • Onsite Gym 

  • Holiday Saving Scheme & Travel Subsidies 

  • Employee Assistance Programme 

  • Active Social Club & Events 

  • Charity and community initiatives   

  • Mentorship Programme 

  • Compressive Learning & Development Support 

 

 

Allianz plc. is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland. 

 

Regulatory Notice:  

Appointment to this role will be subject to the requirements provided for by the Central Bank of Ireland. Please refer to the Central Bank of Ireland’s Guidance on Minimum Competency Code: Minimum Competency | Central Bank of Ireland as well as F&P Standards and the Corporate Governance Requirements: Fitness & Probity | Central Bank of Ireland. This includes the requirements provided for by the Central Bank Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. The successful candidate will be provided with the relevant Conduct Standards (including Additional Conduct Standards) training, where required. Full details are available via the Central Bank website: Individual Accountability Framework  | Central Bank of Ireland. 

 

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. 

 

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust. 

 

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. 

 

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

description:
Graduate Programme 2027 – Audit 
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.
 About Grant Thornton 
 Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth. 
 Audit 
 About the Team 
 Grant Thornton's Audit practice provides independent assurance services to organisations across a wide range of industries, helping stakeholders make informed business decisions with confidence. Our professionals combine technical expertise, commercial understanding and industry knowledge to deliver high-quality audits that go beyond compliance.
 The Audit practice comprises Corporate Audit, Financial Services (FS) Audit and Global Statutory Audit teams, providing graduates with exposure to a diverse range of industries, organisations and audit environments.
 Corporate Audit works with clients ranging from large multinational corporations and listed entities to privately owned businesses and rapidly growing entrepreneurial companies.
 Financial Services (FS) Audit supports a broad range of regulated entities, including investment funds, asset managers, aircraft leasing companies, banking institutions and insurance businesses.
 Global Statutory Audit works with multinational organisations to coordinate statutory audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions, collaborating with Grant Thornton member firms around the world to deliver seamless and consistent audit services.
 Our professionals support clients across a variety of sectors, including:
 Technology
 Financial Services
 Aviation and Leasing
 Manufacturing
 Healthcare and Life Sciences
 Retail and Consumer Business
 Real Estate and Construction
 Energy and Infrastructure
  
 As an Audit Graduate, you'll gain hands-on experience from day one, working with a diverse portfolio of clients and developing a deep understanding of how businesses operate. You'll have the opportunity to build strong technical accounting and auditing knowledge while gaining valuable insight into the financial and operational drivers behind business performance.
 Whether working with large multinational organisations, indigenous Irish businesses, high-growth companies or public interest entities, you'll contribute to engagements that help build trust and confidence in financial reporting.
 What You Will Do 
 As a Graduate Trainee within Audit, you'll work closely with experienced auditors and client teams on a variety of audit and assurance engagements across Corporate Audit, FS Audit and Global Statutory Audit.
 You may have the opportunity to:
 Assist in planning and executing financial statement audits.
 Review financial records, business processes and internal controls.
 Analyse financial data and assess audit risks.
 Prepare audit working papers and supporting documentation.
 Perform substantive testing across key financial statement areas.
 Participate in stock counts and other audit procedures.
 Support the identification and assessment of control weaknesses and business risks.
 Work directly with clients to gather information and understand their operations.
 Prepare reports, presentations and client deliverables.
 Collaborate with colleagues across Audit, Tax and Advisory teams.
  
 The Experience You Will Gain 
  
 You'll gain practical experience working with businesses of varying sizes and complexities while developing a strong understanding of accounting standards, regulatory requirements and audit methodology.
 How We Will Support Your Development 
 At Grant Thornton, we are committed to helping our people realise their potential.
 As an Audit Graduate, you'll benefit from:
 Structured learning and development programmes.
 Professional qualification support through ACA training.
 Dedicated mentoring and coaching.
 Technical accounting and audit training.
 Study leave and exam support.
 Opportunities to work directly with senior stakeholders and client management teams.
 Access to The Academy training programme.
 Clear pathways for long-term career progression and leadership development.
  
 Our culture encourages curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement, giving graduates the support and opportunities needed to build successful careers in professional services.
 Who We're Looking For 
 We welcome applications from graduates across a broad range of disciplines who are interested in business, finance and professional services.
 Successful candidates will demonstrate:
 Strong IT, analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 Attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
 Curiosity about how businesses operate.
 A proactive and collaborative mindset.
 Strong organisational and time management skills.
 The ability to analyse information critically and think commercially.
 A minimum 2.1 degree, or expected equivalent, in any discipline. 
  
 It would also be helpful if you have 
 Experience gained through an internship, part-time role, volunteering, university society or team-based project. 
 An interest in how organisations change, improve services or make better use of technology 
  
 Join Us 
 Join Grant Thornton's Audit team and gain exposure to some of Ireland's most dynamic organisations across Corporate Audit, Financial Services Audit and Global Statutory Audit. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial insight and professional skills while helping businesses maintain transparency, accountability and trust.
 Location and working arrangement:  Dublin office, primarily office-based. 
 Application and selection process:  Apply through link - complete our application form and upload your current CV. Closing date Thursday 22 October 2026. Selection process early November 2026. Start date Autumn 2027.   
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.

title: Motor Claims Handler
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Motor Claims Handler 
 
 Job Location: Ireland – Home working Job Type: Permanent Remuneration : Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications  
 Join our Motor Division as a Claims Handler, managing a portfolio of motor damage claims for key clients. 
 As a Motor Claims Handler, you'll take ownership of a portfolio of motor files. You will be required to assess both liability and quantum, determine coverage and manage your assigned claims in an expedient, compliant and customer-focused way.
 
 We're looking for someone with  experience in managing  motor claims, ideally gained in a similar motor claims environment. We are looking for someone to join this fast growing team who is looking for opportunities to develop personally and is able to contribute to improving the overall performance of the team.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply: 
 Claims Portfolio Management – Essential experience managing motor claims in accordance with SLAs and KPIs.
 Insurance Qualifications – APA qualification is a minimum requirement, ideally the candidate will have CIP and progressing with further qualifications.
 Technical Claims Knowledge – The ideal candidate will have knowledge of how to assess both liability and quantum, the investigations to be undertaken and a good understanding of motor coverages generally. .
 Investigation & Decision Making – Confident carrying out desktop liability investigations, reviewing evidence, determining liability and making accurate, well-reasoned decisions.
 Customer, Client & Complaint Handling – Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-focused approach, confidence liaising with clients and colleagues, and complaint handling experience considered advantageous.
 Negotiation & Claims Resolution – Strong negotiating, influencing and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and settle claims in a timely, compliant and commercially aware manner.
 Attention to Detail & Accuracy – High levels of accuracy and attention to detail when reviewing documentation, assessing claims and maintaining records.
 Adaptability & Resilience – Able to thrive in a dynamic and target-driven environment, managing deadlines, changing priorities and business needs with a positive and flexible approach.
 
 What we’ll give you for this role: 
 Bonus/incentive scheme
 20 days' annual leave entitlement
 Bike to Work Scheme
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme 
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4)
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4)
 EAP – Employee Assistance Programme
 Life Cover
 PHI – Permanent Health Insurance
 Exams & Professional Membership Fees
 Professional and personal development opportunities
 
 This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry 
 At Sedgwick, you'll help people and businesses recover when the unexpected happens, working alongside some of the most trusted names in insurance.
 From day one, you'll have access to learning and development opportunities, including professional qualifications through our partnership with the Insurance Institute, helping you grow your skills and build a rewarding long-term career.
 You'll join a team that's passionate about making a difference, where every role contributes to our shared purpose of caring for people and helping businesses recover.
 
 Next steps for you: 
 Think we'd be a great match? We'd love to hear from you – apply today. 
 
 If you're unsure whether you meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Sedgwick is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and does not tolerate discrimination of any kind. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. Following the closing date, applications will be reviewed and shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, either virtually or in person.
 
 Sedgwick Ireland is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). This role is subject to the Minimum Competency Code (MCC) as set out by the CBI. This code sets out the minimum professional standard for any person providing certain financial services, in particular when dealing with consumers. This role is classified as a Controlled function (CF5) and is subject to Fitness and Probity Standards, including the requirements outlined in the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. Successful candidates will receive training in relation to all regulatory requirements applicable to them.   #LI-REMOTE

title: Fuel ETRP Rotational Graduate Program 2027
description:
Career Category Manufacturing Job Description Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do.
 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
 Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 Fuel ETRP Rotational Program – Dun Laoghaire 
 What you will do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We’re looking for potential future leaders who are self-motivated, with strong analytical and decision-making skills, and leadership aspirations, seeking to join a World-Class Biotechnology Company.
 In this vital role you will: 
 Complete complex rotation assignments and tasks
 Dive into new topics, work areas and functions, ramp up your knowledge quickly to contribute meaningfully, and meet expectations and milestones
 Demonstrate agility and flexibility while transitioning through 3 rotations
 Understand the wider business context and how your own work contributes to Amgen's strategies and goals
 Use data and insights to drive business performance
 
 What we expect of you 
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The collaborative individual we seek is a leader with these qualifications:

 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Engineering or other relevant disciplines obtained from an accredited college or university by the time program kicks-off in July 2027

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Proven leadership skills, demonstrated through extra-curricular or work experience activities
 Previous Amgen or relevant industry experience in biopharma, manufacturing, or engineering environment
 Minimum GPA of 3.20 preferred
 Strong technical and analytical skills
 Ability to work effectively and collaboratively across teams and levels of management
 Excellent time and project management skills
 Ability to demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a dedicated approach to achieving success
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Basic understanding of current Good Manufacturing Practices and Good Laboratory Practices
 Global mentality: willingness to relocate to other Operations Sites for future career opportunities
 Willingness to work shifts including weekends
 
 What you can expect of us In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, work/life balance, and long-term career growth. Comprehensive employee benefits package, including health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, retirement and savings plan with generous company contributions, group medical, life and disability insurance. Discretionary annual bonus program. Exceptional learning, development, and career advancement opportunities, empowering employees to grow and build long-term careers. At Amgen, we are committed to nurturing talent and providing meaningful pathways for professional development.
 Amgen is an equal opportunity employer. 

 Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team. careers.amgen.com 
 Application deadline Amgen anticipates accepting applications until October 4th, 2026; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.
