description:
Graduate Programme 2027 – Audit 
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.
 About Grant Thornton 
 Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth. 
 Audit 
 About the Team 
 Grant Thornton's Audit practice provides independent assurance services to organisations across a wide range of industries, helping stakeholders make informed business decisions with confidence. Our professionals combine technical expertise, commercial understanding and industry knowledge to deliver high-quality audits that go beyond compliance.
 The Audit practice comprises Corporate Audit, Financial Services (FS) Audit and Global Statutory Audit teams, providing graduates with exposure to a diverse range of industries, organisations and audit environments.
 Corporate Audit works with clients ranging from large multinational corporations and listed entities to privately owned businesses and rapidly growing entrepreneurial companies.
 Financial Services (FS) Audit supports a broad range of regulated entities, including investment funds, asset managers, aircraft leasing companies, banking institutions and insurance businesses.
 Global Statutory Audit works with multinational organisations to coordinate statutory audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions, collaborating with Grant Thornton member firms around the world to deliver seamless and consistent audit services.
 Our professionals support clients across a variety of sectors, including:
 Technology

 Aviation and Leasing
 Manufacturing
 Healthcare and Life Sciences
 Retail and Consumer Business
 Real Estate and Construction
 Energy and Infrastructure
 As an Audit Graduate, you'll gain hands-on experience from day one, working with a diverse portfolio of clients and developing a deep understanding of how businesses operate. You'll have the opportunity to build strong technical accounting and auditing knowledge while gaining valuable insight into the financial and operational drivers behind business performance.
 Whether working with large multinational organisations, indigenous Irish businesses, high-growth companies or public interest entities, you'll contribute to engagements that help build trust and confidence in financial reporting.
 What You Will Do 
 As a Graduate Trainee within Audit, you'll work closely with experienced auditors and client teams on a variety of audit and assurance engagements across Corporate Audit, FS Audit and Global Statutory Audit.
 You may have the opportunity to:
 Assist in planning and executing financial statement audits.
 Review financial records, business processes and internal controls.
 Analyse financial data and assess audit risks.
 Prepare audit working papers and supporting documentation.
 Perform substantive testing across key financial statement areas.

 The Experience You Will Gain 
  
 You'll gain practical experience working with businesses of varying sizes and complexities while developing a strong understanding of accounting standards, regulatory requirements and audit methodology.

 Technical accounting and audit training.

 Opportunities to work directly with senior stakeholders and client management teams.

 Our culture encourages curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement, giving graduates the support and opportunities needed to build successful careers in professional services.
 Who We're Looking For

 Successful candidates will demonstrate:
 Strong IT, analytical and problem-solving skills.

 Attention to detail and a commitment to quality.

 A proactive and collaborative mindset.

 Experience gained through an internship, part-time role, volunteering, university society or team-based project.

 Join Us

You'll develop technical expertise, commercial insight and professional skills while helping businesses maintain transparency, accountability and trust.

description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Claims Handler 
 
 Job Location: Dublin
 Job Type: Permanent Role
 Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications 
 We have a fantastic opportunity for a Claims Handler in Dublin. 
 Are you looking for an opportunity to build a rewarding career in claims handling while making a real difference to customers when they need support most? As a Claims Handler, you will play a key role in delivering an exceptional claims service on behalf of leading insurers, managing claims from first notification through to settlement. You will be responsible for providing a high-quality customer experience, ensuring every claim is handled efficiently, accurately and professionally while meeting service level agreements and quality standards.
 
 Working within a collaborative and supportive team, you will take ownership of a portfolio of claims, using your knowledge and judgement to assess information, provide guidance on policy cover and progress claims to a fair and timely resolution. You will communicate directly with customers, insurer representatives and other stakeholders, ensuring all interactions are handled with empathy, professionalism and a focus on achieving positive outcomes.
 
 This role offers the opportunity to develop strong technical and customer service skills while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance. You will be encouraged to maintain your professional development, work towards recognised insurance qualifications and support the achievement of team goals. In addition, you will provide assistance to the Team Leader when required, making this an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership, building expertise and contributing to a high-performing team environment.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply: 
 APA Qualification – APA qualified with a commitment to ongoing professional development.

 Claims Knowledge – Strong understanding of claims handling and insurance processes.

 Communication Skills – Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

 Organisation – Strong planning, prioritisation and time management skills.

 Decision-Making – Confident in making sound, informed decisions.

 Problem Solving – Able to identify issues and implement effective solutions.

 Continuous Improvement – Focused on improving processes and efficiencies.

 Regulatory Awareness – Knowledge of CPC and Central Bank of Ireland requirements.

 
 What we’ll give you for this role: 
 Remuneration & More 
 Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications.

 Pension Scheme.

 Holiday allowance.

 Tax Saver Travel Scheme.

 Opportunities for training and development.

 
 Health & Support 
 Employee Assistance Programme.

 Life Cover.

 Permanent Health Insurance (PHI).

 Bike to Work Scheme.

 
 Other Benefits 
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4).

 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4).

 Professional and personal development opportunities.

 Support for professional memberships and examinations where applicable.

 
 This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry 
 At Sedgwick, not only will you be working behind the scenes for some of the UK's most trusted insurance brands helping to resolve millions of claims every year, you'll also be an architect of tomorrow's insurance landscape with Sedgwick University. Our proprietary offering is the most comprehensive training and development program in the industry with more than 15,000 courses on demand, training specific to roles, and opportunities to continue your formal education – all available to you starting from your very first day.  
 
 You'll join a community passionate about making a difference, where every role contributes to a larger mission; protecting people and businesses. This isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of insurance.  
 
 Next steps for you:   
 Think we'd be a great match? Apply now – we want to hear from you.   
 
 If you’re unsure whether you have all the skills needed then do apply – we are looking for all backgrounds from seasoned professionals to those returning to the workforce, and everyone in-between.   
 
 Not only that, we are proud to have a zero tolerance policy towards discrimination of any kind regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital/ family status, race, religion, sex or sexual orientation.   
 
 After the closing date we will review all applications and may select some applicants for an interview (which may be virtual, or in-person). 
 
 Sedgwick Ireland is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). This role is subject to the Minimum Competency Code (MCC) as set out by the CBI. This code sets out the minimum professional standard for any person providing certain financial services, in particular when dealing with consumers. This role is classified as a Controlled function ( CF3 CF4 & CF7 ) and is subject to Fitness and Probity Standards, including the requirements outlined in the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. Successful candidates will receive training in relation to all regulatory requirements applicable to them.

description:
Technology is changing the world faster than ever before – and at the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team. 

Every day around the world, we work with exceptional people, the latest and greatest tech and leading companies across industries. You'll learn, grow and advance in a diverse culture of shared success, where we’ll empower you to bring your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work. 

 Join us and do extraordinary things.  

Through our Business & Technology Graduate Programme, you’ll work at the intersection of business, technology and innovation, helping clients solve complex challenges and create lasting value. You’ll explore how organisations can reinvent the way they operate, grow, and serve their customers by combining strategic thinking, data-driven insight, AI-powered transformation and practical technology solutions. 

 This streamlined programme brings together opportunities across business and technology consulting into one pathway. Through a single application, we’ll consider your skills, interests and potential, then guide you into the work that best fits you, whether that leans towards business and management consulting, hands-on technology delivery, or a blend of both. You don’t need to have it all figured out on day one; you need to be curious about where you could go. 

 What You'll Do 

From day one, you’ll work as part of collaborative project teams, building trusted relationships with clients and colleagues while developing your consulting, analytical and technology skills. The work is varied, fast-paced and practical, and no two projects are the same. You’ll build breadth by working across different technologies, industries and client challenges rather than being boxed into a single specialism. 

 In your first year, you might find yourself: 
 Supporting the adoption of emerging technologies and helping teams put AI to work on real client problems 
 Working within a project team to help a client deliver a large-scale digital transformation programme 
 Using analytics and data to identify opportunities and shape recommendations for a client 
 Designing, refining, building, testing & deploying technology solutions as part of a delivery team

 There are many directions your career can take from here, across areas such as technology strategy and transformation, AI-powered customer experience, talent & change management, operating model & business process design, data and analytics, testing, project and programme management, and cloud. Some of our graduates build broad consulting careers; others develop deep specialist and technical expertise. The programme is designed to give you the exposure to work out which path is yours, and the support to pursue it.

title: Kepak Commercial Graduate Programme 2027 - Ireland
description:
Kepak Commercial Graduate Programme 2027 - Ireland Role Purpose 
 The Graduate programme is designed to equip participants with the essential skills, knowledge, and experience needed to succeed in the meat processing industry, specifically within our sales and commercial teams. Graduates will start by gaining hands-on experience on the factory floor, providing a solid foundation in operations before progressing into sales and account management roles. The aim is to develop well-rounded professionals who understand the full product lifecycle, from production to customer delivery, and who can drive sales while ensuring product and price alignment.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 •Customer Engagement: Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers by understanding their specific needs and delivering bespoke solutions tailored to their requirements.
 •Sales & Negotiation: Lead and manage sales activities, from prospecting to closing deals, ensuring both revenue and margin targets are met.
 •Market Analysis: Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and market conditions to adapt sales strategies accordingly.
 •Project Management: Oversee the implementation of sales and marketing plans, ensuring timely execution and alignment with company goals.
 •Brand Ambassador: Represent the company at various industry events, maintaining a strong professional presence and promoting our brand values.
 •Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements, both in sales and operations, to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
 
 Key Competencies 
 •Customer Orientation: Ability to understand and respond to customer needs with bespoke solutions.
 •Commercial Acumen: Understanding of market drivers, profitability, and competitive forces within the livestock industry.
 •Negotiation Skills: Capable of closing deals that are beneficial for both the customer and the company.
 •Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyse data and market conditions to make informed decisions.
 •Resilience: Handle a heavy workload and frequent travel with a positive attitude, learning from failures and continuously improving.
 •Project Management: Effective in planning, executing, and overseeing projects to successful completion.
 
 Other Role Information 
 •Travel: This role requires travel to various customer sites and company locations, offering a dynamic and varied work environment.
 •Work Environment: Initial placement on the factory floor followed by office-based and client-facing roles.
 •Career Path: Graduates are expected to progress into more senior commercial roles, with opportunities to advance to management within five years, based on performance. 
 Our Graduate programme allows dynamic, motivated, hardworking, and passionate Graduates an opportunity start their career with one of Ireland & UKs leading meat businesses. The programme lasts 2 years.
 
 You can expect: 
 To be fully immersed into our Culture from day 1, working alongside key industry experts and Kepak leaders
 An opportunity to work in various departments across the business with a rotation plan tailored to your development, the rotations plan will vary by site
 Gain an in depth understanding of our brands and products, and our relationships with customers and consumers
 To learn key aspects of our business, whilst you develop your skills and knowledge
 The opportunity to develop personally and professionally through exposure to key projects, tasks and development activities that challenge you, all supported by a detailed learner journey and training plan
 A dedicated mentor and development program to support you both on the programme and into a role that best fits your skills
 Start date: September 6th 2027
 Starting Salary - €33,500 with an up to €1,500 increase at the start of Year 2 to €35,000
 Read more about our programme and hear from some of our Graduates : https://www.kepak.com/careers/graduates/ 
 Requirements 
 Who are we looking for? 
 We are looking for hardworking and ambitious Graduates, who want to learn and grow in a challenging and fast paced environment, by performing real roles as part of your rotations. 
 You must be mobile and willing to travel throughout the programme to undertake development activities at any of our sites in the UK and Ireland.
 We will consider undergraduates from all disciplines and backgrounds.
 
 Knowledge, Skills, and Experience 
 •Industry Experience: Prior experience in food service, FMCG, or a related industry is beneficial, but not essential. General sales experience is less applicable unless accompanied by a strong understanding of our industry.
 •Skills: Strong abilities in channel and customer strategy, account management, joint business planning, and commercial analysis.
 •Business Acumen: Demonstrated understanding of the sales process within the food industry, including pricing, margins, and costings.
 
 Personal Attributes 
 •Team Player: Collaborative approach to working with colleagues across various departments.
 •Self-Motivation: Driven to succeed and comfortable working independently.
 •Confidence & Assertiveness: Able to communicate assertively and stand their ground when addressing quality issues while maintaining amicable relationships with colleagues 
 •Adaptability: Flexible and able to adjust to different roles, challenges, and environments.
 
 We will be looking for alignment with our Core Values:
 Responsibility – Ability to work on your own initiative and take accountability for your actions
 Ambition – You will have the willingness and confidence to challenge yourself to be the best you can be and be driven to succeed
 Passion for Food – this is at the heart of everything we do, you must be passionate about every aspect of our industry
 Teamwork – ability to build positive relationships quickly with people from all cultures and career stages is pivotal

More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
 
 Job Description 
 
 Claims Administrator – Life & Pensions Operations
 Locations: 
 Dublin | Hybrid
 Business: SS&C Financial Services International Limited
 Role Type: Permanent
 Get To Know Us: 
 SS&C is seeking a Claims Administrator to join our Life & Pensions Operations team in Dublin. The role will be responsible for the accurate and timely administration of claims across a range of life, protection and pension products within a regulated outsourced environment.
 Working as part of a client-focused operational team, the successful candidate will manage claims through the end-to-end lifecycle, ensuring customers and beneficiaries receive an efficient, accurate and empathetic service. The role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to work within defined regulatory, contractual and operational controls.
 SS&C is leading the way. We continue to look for todays and tomorrow’s brightest talent, those that embody a spirit to improve not only their lives, but those around them. From college students to seasoned and experienced professionals, we encourage you to apply. SS&C prides itself on hiring diverse, honest, dynamic individuals, who value collaboration, accountability, and innovation to name a few.
 Why You Will Love It Here! 
 Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model
 Your Future: Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS&C University
 Work/Life Balance: Competitive holiday scheme
 Your Wellbeing: Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
 Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
 Training: Hands-On, Team-Customised throughout your career
 What You Will Get To Do: 
 Manage life, protection and pension claims from initial notification through to assessment, settlement and closure.
 Review claim documentation and policy information to establish eligibility and ensure all required evidence has been received.
 Liaise professionally and sensitively with customers, beneficiaries, advisers, trustees and other relevant parties throughout the claims process.
 Obtain and review supporting documentation, escalating complex or unusual cases to appropriate technical specialists where required.
 Accurately calculate and process claim benefits in accordance with policy terms, procedures and delegated authorities.
 Maintain accurate and complete customer and policy records across relevant administration and workflow systems.
 Ensure claims are progressed within agreed SLAs, quality standards and client requirements, proactively managing outstanding information and potential delays.
 Complete appropriate quality and control checks and ensure a clear audit trail is maintained for all decisions and transactions.
 Identify and escalate potential customer detriment, complaints, financial crime concerns, data protection issues or other operational risks.
 Apply appropriate consideration to vulnerable customers and Consumer Duty requirements, supporting the delivery of good customer outcomes.
 Work collaboratively with colleagues across Operations, Finance, Actuarial, Client Services and other specialist teams to resolve complex cases.
 Support reconciliation, reporting and MI requirements associated with claims processing.
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls and improve customer experience.
 Support cross-training and knowledge sharing to build capability and resilience across the wider Operations team.
 What You Will Bring: 
 Essential 
 Strong administration experience with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
 Ability to manage multiple cases and priorities within a deadline-driven operational environment.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate sensitively and professionally with customers and other stakeholders.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify when issues require escalation.
 Comfortable working within defined procedures, controls and regulatory requirements.
 Strong Microsoft Office skills.
 Ability to work collaboratively as part of a wider operational team.
 Desirable 
 Previous experience in Life & Pensions, insurance, protection, investments or wider financial services.
 Previous claims administration or claims-handling experience would be particularly advantageous.
 Knowledge of life assurance, pensions or protection products.
 Experience working within an FCA-regulated environment or outsourced/BPO operation.
 Understanding of Consumer Duty, vulnerable customer requirements and the importance of good customer outcomes.
 Experience using policy administration, workflow or case-management systems.
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are looking for someone who combines strong operational discipline with a customer-focused mindset. Claims frequently arise at significant or difficult points in a customer's life, so accuracy, empathy and ownership are equally important.
 The successful candidate will be comfortable taking responsibility for cases, following them through to resolution and escalating issues appropriately, while maintaining the high standards of quality, control and customer service expected within SS&C's Life & Pensions business.
 We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense. 
 Thank you for your interest in SS&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website @ www.ssctech.com/careers .

title: 2027 Tax Graduate Programme - Dublin
description:
Graduate Programme 2027 – Tax 
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme. 
 About Grant Thornton 
 Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth. 
 About the Team 
 Grant Thornton's Tax team works across the entire spectrum of tax services, providing innovative and practical solutions to clients operating locally and globally. Our professionals combine technical expertise with commercial insight to help clients manage tax risk, remain compliant and achieve their strategic objectives. 
 Our Tax team supports organisations of all sizes across a wide range of industries including technology, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, aviation, real estate and the public sector. 
 Our team advises clients across several specialist areas, including: 
 Corporate Tax 

 Financial Services 

 International Tax 

 VAT & Indirect Tax 

 Private Client & Wealth Management 

 Employer Solutions and Payroll 

 This breadth of expertise provides graduates with exposure to a diverse range of tax matters, industries and client challenges. 
 As a Tax Graduate, you'll gain hands-on experience from day one, working with a diverse portfolio of clients and developing solutions to complex tax challenges. You'll have the opportunity to build strong technical knowledge while understanding the wider business and commercial considerations that influence client decision-making. 
 Whether advising on corporate tax matters, supporting international businesses or helping individuals plan for the future, you'll contribute to projects that have a real impact on our clients. 
 What You Will Do 
 As a Graduate Trainee within Tax, you'll work closely with experienced professionals on a variety of client engagements. 
 You may have the opportunity to: 
 Support clients with tax compliance and reporting obligations. 

 Assist in the preparation of tax returns and related filings. 

 Research tax legislation and analyse technical tax matters. 

 Support advisory projects across a range of tax disciplines. 

 Work with multinational organisations on international tax matters. 

 Assist with transaction and restructuring-related tax projects. 

 Participate in client meetings and technical discussions. 

 Analyse financial information and identify tax implications. 

 Prepare reports, presentations and client deliverables. 

 Collaborate with colleagues across Tax, Audit and Advisory teams. 

 The Experience You Will Gain 
  You'll gain exposure to both compliance and advisory work, allowing you to build a strong foundation across multiple areas of tax. 
 How We Will Support Your Development 
 At Grant Thornton, we are committed to helping our people realise their potential. 
 As a Tax Graduate, you'll benefit from: 
 Structured learning and development programmes. 

 Professional qualification support. 

 Dedicated mentoring and coaching. 

 Technical tax and legislative training. 

 Study leave and exam support. 

 Opportunities to work directly with senior stakeholders. 

 Access to The Academy training programme. 

 Clear pathways for long-term career development. Our culture encourages curiosity, collaboration and continuous learning, providing graduates with the support needed to succeed. 

 Who We're Looking For 
 We welcome applications from graduates across a broad range of disciplines who are interested in business, problem-solving and advisory services. 
 Successful candidates will demonstrate: 
 Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. 

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 

 Attention to detail and a commitment to quality. 

 Curiosity for tax and business. 

 A proactive and collaborative mindset. 

 Strong organisational and time management skills. 

 The ability to solve complex problems and think commercially. 

 A minimum 2.1 degree, or expected equivalent, in any discipline. 

 It would also be helpful if you have 

 Experience gained through an internship, part-time role, volunteering, university society or team-based project. 

 An interest in how organisations change, improve services or make better use of technology. 

 Join Us 
 Join Grant Thornton's Tax team and help clients navigate an increasingly complex tax landscape. You’ll gain practical experience, develop specialist expertise and build the skills needed to become a trusted advisor while supporting organisations across Ireland and beyond. 
 Location and working arrangement: Dublin office, primarily office-based. 
 Application and selection process: Apply through link - complete our application form and upload your current CV. Closing date Thursday 22 October 2026. Selection process early November 2026. Start date Autumn 2027. 
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.

title: Tirlán Graduate Programme
description:
Skip to main content
Tirlán Graduate Programme
We’re looking for new talent.
We’re connecting the work of Irish farming families with the global market, producing pure nutrition, while safeguarding the land for future generations.
We care about life in perfect balance, and want your help.
Do you want a career where you can truly make a difference?
View graduate opportunities
We’re looking for ambitious graduates across a range of disciplines to join us, as we work to create a global community celebrating wholesome nutrition from the land we live and love. Recruitment for our Tirlán Graduate Programme takes place each year in autumn with the graduates starting in September
Our Programme is designed to take you through a series of real-world learning experiences, helping you build confidence in your abilities, and to flourish in your careers.
We’re recruiting across a range of disciplines, including Agribusiness, Commercial, Corporate Affairs, Engineering & Operations, HR, IT (Business Analysis & MES), Marketing, Quality & Compliance, R&D and Strategy/Project Management, Accounting & Finance.
If you’re currently completing your bachelor’s or master’s degree with an expected 2.2 and above in a related field, now is the time to apply.
View our brochure
Research & Development
Agri
Engineering
Human Resources
Digital
Finance
Alexander Nulty – Agribusiness Associate
I’ve learnt so much since I’ve started - in everything from customer service to farm advice, to animal nutrition. The opportunities are endless and they are there to be grasped. You get to meet people here who will help you throughout your life.
Kyeesha Glenn-Davi - Research and Development – Associate
What stood out most for me was how kind and supportive everyone is at Tirlán. They’re happy to share their knowledge. The collaborative culture here means you get broad business exposure. While I now work on the Advanced Analytical Team within R&D, we also work very closely with Quality and Commercial and have had interactions with customers, the Executive Leadership team and farmer representatives. It all gives you a wider view of the business, you can see where you fit in and add value.
Ciara Ryan – Agribusiness Associate
There are lots of opportunities to develop and I’ve found the work-life balance great. Tirlán is a vibrant and exciting place to work.
Why Tirlán?
Our approach is different. We give you the opportunity to do real work. We want you to take control.
You’ll be a valued member of the team
On this programme, you will not be a spectator. You’ll be exposed to significant learning opportunities and will get to know the many aspects of our business.
Tirlán is bigger than the sum of its parts, yet small enough to allow for agility and cross functional collaboration.
You’ll enjoy structured development
We hire graduates for their potential, and do not expect you to know everything. Structured learning is a huge aspect of our programme.
We love to see you develop and strive to provide endless opportunities, through bespoke programmes, on demand learning, summits, mentors, and projects.
We’ll give you a personalised career plan
We provide all the structure you need to grow fast, with a minimum of two job rotations, brand and business exposure, personalised development planning and access to career coaching.
We will support you to achieve the success you want, satisfying your appetite for a meaningful career experience.
You will make a real difference
As Tirlán, we’re setting out to tackle some ambitious new goals. Your impact will truly be felt from the very beginning and will help us shape the future of our business.
This is a new phase for our ambitious cooperative, building on our roots in the past and reaching ambitiously into the future. You will be working with an organisation that invests in farming families all across Ireland and brings world-class nutrition to the global market.
You’ll find a truly human environment
There’s something very different about working at Tirlán. We are community focused and caring. Many say it’s like joining a very large family.
We humbly believe that we are like no other organisation. We care about creating a space where you can be your true self at work, and strive to include everyone.
You will enjoy a real sense of balance
Our new hybrid workplace is designed to encourage work in a way that suits your professional, personal, and social life.
These state-of-the-art facilities support better wellbeing and better outcomes for everyone. We want you to have fun and build connections that last a lifetime; creating social moments as well as working opportunities.
Training & development
We take great pride in our training programmes. By providing personalised training, we empower our graduates to develop the confidence, skills and expertise to excel in their careers.
All grads receive the following training:
Two different rotations during your tenure to deliver different learning and exposure opportunities
Brand exposure experience to develop important business and customer understanding
Ongoing, structured coaching by manager
Career coaching and development planning
Comprehensive development programmes
Individual wellness planning
Reverse mentoring – we want to learn from you too!
We follow the 70:20:10 development model. This includes 70% on-the-job training, 20% networking, coaching and mentoring opportunities and 10% formal training. We have built this model to ensure you develop your potential and thrive at Tirlán. Learn more about our development model in our brochure.
Rewards & benefits
In addition to a competitive starting salary, you will get the following benefits package:
Hybrid working
Structured social events, team building and away days
Spotlighting events with senior leadership
Annual Tirlán Graduate Summit

title: Personal Accident Claims Handler
description:
About Allianz 

We are proud to be one of the world’s most trusted insurance companies, and Ireland’s #1 Property & Casualty Insurer serving over 900,000 customers across Ireland, for over 100 years. Our success is driven by the incredible people we employ, with over 800 people in Allianz Ireland, we are committed to supporting our employees' individual needs and aspirations. 

This role is officially based in Elm Park, Dublin 4, but we embrace a hybrid working model that offers you the flexibility and support you need to excel in your role. 

We are incredibly proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work having won the Super Large Category in 2025 & 2026, as well as being named one of Ireland’s Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces for Health & Wellbeing. If you're ready to take the next step in your career, apply now and become part of the team!  

 

The Opportunity 

As a Personal Accident Claims Handler you will be responsible for managing and processing claims related to personal accidents. The role requires a keen eye for detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to work efficiently under pressure. The PA Claims Handler will ensure that all claims are handled in accordance with company policies and legal guidelines. 

 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Deliver excellent standards of customer service through high quality and efficient handling of policyholders claims. 

  • Registration, handling and settlement of personal accident claims for a key Allianz account 

  • Accurate and comprehensive recording of all transactions and decisions 

  • Compliance with company quality standards 

  • Compliance with financial services authority requirements for claims handling 

  • Achievement of agreed targets in relation to settlement rate, calls answered and completions 

  • Liaising with others to obtain and deliver information that is critical to service and control of claims costs 

  • Be aware of fraud indicators to identify potential fraud cases and escalate them to the relevant personnel in our Fraud Investigation Unit (FIU) 

 

Key Requirements / Skills & Experience 

Essential: 

  • Minimum 1-2 years’ experience in Insurance Claims handling or Underwriting  

  • APA Qualified or studying towards an APA, CIP or a relevant insurance qualification to meet MCC requirements* 

  • Skilled communicator & negotiator, with ability to work on initiative and manage own time effectively 

Desirable: 

  • Relevant third level qualification 

  • Experience in Claims handling

title: Treasury ALM Portfolio Analyst
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive.   We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
 As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.
  
 We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.
 
 We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.
 
 
 
 Job Description The successful candidate will be an integral part of a Treasury team responsible for all Treasury functions within the bank. This role will have a key focus on the management, analysis and reporting of the bank’s investment securities portfolio – including fixed income bonds, High-Quality Liquid Assets (HQLA) and Collateralised Loan Obligations (CLOs) – while continuing to support core Asset and Liability Management activities and day-to-day risk management and reporting.
 
 Key Accountabilities: 
 
 Portfolio Management 
 Support the day-to-day management, monitoring and reporting of the bank’s investment securities portfolio, including composition, performance, and adherence to approved limits.

 Assist in the analysis and reporting of fixed income bond holdings, including valuation, yield, duration, and credit quality.

 Support the build-out and ongoing monitoring of the HQLA securities portfolio.

 Support CLO investment onboarding, monitoring and reporting – including tranche performance, collateral quality and exposure limits.

 Contribute to portfolio construction and investment decision support through data-driven analysis.

 
 Asset & Liability Management / Treasury 
 Provide support and back up to all treasury Asset and Liability Management activities.

 Balance Sheet FX management including the execution of FX trades.

 Support ad-hoc regulatory requests pertaining to treasury and portfolio activity.

 Process improvement with development and review of procedures in a control related environment.

 Contribute to the preparation of content for the monthly Asset Liability Management Committee pack.

 
 Knowledge and Experience: 
 
 Experience/Qualifications 
 Minimum three years treasury, investment or portfolio management experience.

 Experience across fixed income / bond portfolios and an understanding of structured credit (e.g. CLOs).

 Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

 
 Skills/Disposition 
 Strong (internal) customer focus.

 Strong MS Excel skills required.

 Strong MS PowerPoint skills, with attention to detail over final output.

 Ability to effectively manage and prioritize multiple activities with competing deadlines.

 Ability to deal effectively and tactfully with customers, other banks.

 
 Beneficial Skills 
 Knowledge of CLO structures and structured credit instruments.

 Data analytics and financial modelling capability (e.g. Python, advanced Excel, VBA) .

 Interest Rate Swap (IRS) and broader derivative experience.

 Familiarity with portfolio analytics / risk systems (e.g. Intex, Bloomberg).

 
 Additional information: 
 
 The role offers a hybrid / flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.
  
 This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. 
 
 
 Accessibility 
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support. 
 
 Total Rewards 
 U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.
  
 We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:
 Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

 Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

 Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

 Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

 Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

  
 We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.
 
 We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon .
   
 Closing Date 
 Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.
  
 We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Our global portfolio includes best-in-class, iconic brand-name products as well as global key brands; generics, including branded and complex generics; and other offerings across a wide range of therapeutic areas. We are committed to helping create healthier communities worldwide through education, outreach and better access to treatment.
 
 For those driven to live their lives with purpose, Viatris helps employees realise their full potential by creating a collaborative culture that fosters courage and resilience. Viatris is more than just a place to work. This is a place to make a difference in the world.
 
 
 The Role & What You Will Be Doing
 The Global Supply Chain Planning Master Data Analyst is responsible for defining, governing, and maintaining high-quality planning master data across SAP and advanced planning systems in support of global supply chain operations. The role ensures planning data is fit for purpose, supports standardised global processes, and drives effective planning, execution, and reporting — including active involvement in SAP S/4HANA transformation. It requires close collaboration with Planning, IT, Data Quality, and Master Data teams across system deployments, testing, and data migrations.
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Global Supply Chain Planning Master Data Analyst role will make an impact:
 
 Master Data Ownership & Governance
 Serve as global functional expert for supply chain planning master data across SAP and planning platforms

 Define and maintain end-to-end master data processes covering creation, maintenance, validation, and governance

 Develop and continuously improve policies, standards, and procedures with a focus on data quality and scalability

 SAP S/4HANA & Transformation
 Lead SAP S/4HANA data readiness, planning master data harmonisation, and support for new data models

 Support data migration, cutover activities, and post-go-live stabilisation

 Execute test scenarios and scripts across SIT and UAT phases

 Data Quality & Continuous Improvement
 Define and monitor data quality KPIs, dashboards, and scorecards

 Drive continuous improvement initiatives across data, processes, and systems

 Collaborate with stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, IT, and commercial teams to align planning data with business needs

 
 About Your Skills & Experience
 For this role, we’re looking for a candidate who has an effective combination of the following qualifications, skills and experiences:
 
 Strong understanding of master data as a strategic enterprise asset.

 Hands-on functional experience with SAP master data within supply chain processes (MM, PTP, OTC).

 Experience supporting data validation, cleansing, and migration activities.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

 Ability to operate effectively in complex, global, transformation-driven environments.

 Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, engineering, IT, or commercial discipline.

 
 At Viatris, we are dedicated to building a truly diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t fully align with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.
 Benefits at Viatris
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. Some of our benefits include the following on top of a competitive salary:
 
 Excellent career progression opportunities

 Work-life balance initiatives

 Bonus scheme

 Health insurance

 Pension

 
 Diversity & Inclusion at Viatris
 At Viatris, diversity and inclusion are essential to our mission. The diversity we foster in all aspects of our business can be one of our greatest strengths in redefining healthcare not as it is, but as it should be. If you would like to know more about what diversity, equity and inclusion means to us, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/Careers/Diversity-and-Inclusion 
 
 Sustainability at Viatris
 Corporate social responsibility is fundamental to the Viatris mission. We work to advance responsible and sustainable operations and leverage our collective expertise to empower people to live healthier at every stage of life, recognizing that our actions affect the stakeholders and communities we serve. To learn more about our efforts, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/about-us/corporate-responsibility

title: Quality Engineering Graduate Program - September 2027
description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite 
 
 
 Quality Engineer, Graduate Programme - September 2027 
 
 This role is part of the Quality Operations Engineering Development program that provides quality engineering and leadership development across several areas of Stryker’s business. Quality Engineers in this role will have on-site functional rotations between the Quality Operations, Quality Management and New Product Introduction teams, gaining highly valuable experience in key areas of Medical Device Manufacturing Business.
 
 The program is 23 months in duration and begins in September of each year. Core training opportunities in both hard engineering and soft personal skills for example, validation activities in regulated industry, design transfer requirements, GD&T, additive manufacturing, six-sigma greenbelt, presentation skills, finance, and global interactions are integrated into the program. Exposure to Senior Leadership within Stryker and networking opportunities including global interactions across the business are a fundamental part of the program. 
 
 
 What you get out of the program: 
 
 Stryker, a global leader in medical technology takes great pride in their people, and that’s why we’re looking to expand our talent. As a result, we are looking for the best and brightest graduates to strengthen our team and drive our business going forward.
 
 
 A development journey that’s tailored to you! The Quality Operations Engineering Development Program is designed specifically for highly talented individuals who are looking for an accelerated career progression. Participants will benefit from:
 
 Networking with Senior Leadership

 Exposure to cutting edge technology

 Executive mentorship

 Global collaboration & training programs

 
 All resulting in inspiring & fulfilling careers, enduring friendships, and accelerated career progression!
 
 
 Who we want​: 
 Challengers. People who seek out the hard projects and work to find just the right solutions.​

 Teammates. Partners who listen to ideas, share thoughts and work together to move the business forward.​

 Charismatic networkers. Relationship-savvy people who intentionally make connections with both internal partners and external contacts.​

 Strategic thinkers. People who propose innovative ideas and consistently exceed their performance objectives.​

 Customer-oriented achievers. Individuals with an unparalleled work ethic and customer-focused attitude who bring value to their partnerships.​

 Game changers. Persistent individuals who will stop at nothing to live out Stryker’s mission to make healthcare better.

 
 
 Opportunities available: 
 
 As a program participant graduates will be placed in one of the following teams:
 
 Quality Engineering 
 
 Provide quality engineering support in quality assurance, control, and preventative activities with a focus on continuous improvement of internal products and processes. Support supplier quality issues impacting daily operations.  Advocate and lead the execution of initiatives and projects to enhance quality performance within the business and for our customers. Ensure compliance to regulation and standards.
 
 New Product Introduction Engineering 
 
 New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineers play a critical role in Stryker, providing an interface between Advanced Operations activities and manufacturing, translating design requirements into manufacturing and process requirements.  They lead design for manufacture and assembly through technical leadership and direction in quality assurance, quality control and preventative activities. They support the development and introduction of new products, processes, and technologies, with focus on quality systems development, regulatory compliance, and process risk management including pFMEA. They develop and characterize processes that are capable, scalable and produce high yield. They support the design of robust inspection strategies including CQA’s, CTQ’s and MSA’s. Finally, they provide quality engineering support for the execution of quality assurance activities during design transfer phases of new product development.
 
 Quality Management Systems 
 
 The function of the Quality Management System Engineer is to provide subject matter expertise and support to the Quality Operations functions within the relevant manufacturing site while continuing to optimize the operation of the quality management system to ensure compliance in the most efficient and effective manner.
 
 
 What you need: 
 
 Upcoming or recent Graduate (Previous 2 Years) in B. Sc / B. Eng. in a science, engineering or related discipline

 3.0 minimum cumulative GPA (or equivalent)

 Eligibility to work in respective country

 Ability to travel within Ireland

 Self-starter with demonstrated efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills and ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

 The individual should enjoy working in a fast paced, dynamic and results orientated team environment.

 Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively work cross-functionally and externally as required.

 Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, product and process design.

 Basic knowledge of the elements of a Quality Management System and the relevant ISO standards.

 Being able to read and interpret complex engineering drawings and have the ability to understand geometrical dimensioning and tolerancing an advantage.

 Experience in an FDA regulated or regulated industry beneficial.

 High level of PC Skills required.

 Excellent attention to detail.

 
 
 The Company: 
 
 Stryker is one of the world’s leading medical technology companies and together with our customers, we are driven to make healthcare better. The Company offers a diverse array of innovative medical technologies, including orthopaedics, medical and surgical, and neurotechnology & spine products to help people lead more active and more satisfying lives. Stryker products and services are available in over 100 countries around the world.  For more information, please visit our website at  www.stryker.com .

Trainee Programme
Our Trainee Programme has been created to give you an introduction to the fast-paced legal world, while ensuring that your path from law student to fully qualified lawyer is interesting, fulfilling and filled with an opportunity to learn. We offer a world-class training programme which includes secondment and travel opportunities in addition to first-hand experience working across the core areas of our full service, global law firm.
Global Secondments
Jurisdictions
Offices Worldwide
Global Staff
Core Programme
As a Trainee in Dublin, you will complete four rotations through our legal services practice areas which include Corporate, Data, Commercial & Technology, Employment, Finance, Funds & Investment Management, Dispute Resolution & Insolvency, Property, and Tax.
Your first rotation or pre-seat will take place in advance of attending the Professional Practice Course (the PPC) in the Law Society in September of each year. This allows you to kick start your career and get to know the other trainees in your intake prior to starting PPC.
It is important for us that each of our Trainees is involved in shaping their own career path and as such your areas of interest will be taken into account when assigning the various departments that you will gain experience in. These rotations will give you an opportunity to build your knowledge, while discovering where your interests and strengths lie.
Learning & Development
Learning and development is a central part of our Trainee Programme. Our Trainee Programme has been designed to supplement the PPC and includes a wide range of department specific workshops, seminars, and practice group insights. As you progress through your traineeship, you will have the opportunity to showcase your talent and creativity by putting your skills into practice. Presentation, drafting and other core legal and business skills sessions are also delivered throughout your traineeship by both internal and external experts.
Throughout the Trainee Programme, you will have an opportunity to share an office with Partners, offering you the chance to become acquainted with senior professionals where you will experience different working styles while learning the key skills required to become a successful lawyer.
Continued professional development is an important aspect of your career with the Maples Group and feedback is a central part of your of the programme. There is a mix of informal and formal feedback and we actively encourage you to ask questions throughout your traineeship.
Support Network
Our Trainee Partner Committee will provide day-to-day support in each of your rotations. This committee is responsible for working with you to ensure that your professional development progresses during the time spent in each department.
Your Training Partner will play an active role from the beginning of your traineeship with the firm right through to qualifying as an Associate in the firm. The role of the Training Partner is to act as a coach and mentor, providing guidance and support throughout your training programme. You will meet with your Training Partner regularly during your traineeship.
Secondments
As a global organisation which values a culture of collegiality, we are keen to allow our Trainees to experience life in our other offices. Each year, our Dublin Trainee Programme allows successful trainees to complete an overseas rotation in one of overseas offices with potential locations including Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, Jersey, Luxembourg and London offices. Further secondment opportunities, including client secondments, may be offered to selected trainees in each intake, depending on the needs of the firm and our global client base.
Here in the Dublin office of the Maples Group, our Trainee Programme continues to go from strength to strength. We recognise that our trainees are fundamental to the future of our Maples office here in Dublin. During your traineeship, you will have the opportunity to experience a truly international legal environment, working with lawyers across our global offices. You will work with a number of our practice groups throughout your rotations.
The opportunity for secondments to our international offices is something which is an invaluable part of our Training Programme, allowing our trainees to experience first-hand what it means to be part of One Firm.
We offer our trainees a well-rounded training experience to allow you to shape your career and ensure you develop and grow to become excellent, commercial and entrepreneurial legal advisors to our outstanding global clients. title: Risk Analyst
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
 
 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
 
 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
 
 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.
 
 For our business, for clients, and for you
 
 
 Role: Risk Analyst 
 Role Location: Limerick (Ireland)
 Employment Type: Permanent
 Reporting to : Head of Risk

 Role Summary: 
 Reporting to the Head of Risk, the Risk Analyst will be a key member of the Fund Risk team, responsible for delivering robust risk oversight and contributing to the ongoing evolution of the firm's risk management capabilities. The successful candidate will have broad exposure to fund risk activities, engage regularly with senior management and external stakeholders, and play an active role in strategic projects that support the company's growth objectives. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence governance practices, enhance risk frameworks, and develop into a leadership role with responsibility for coaching and mentoring junior colleagues.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 

 Perform ongoing monitoring of investment risks of funds to ensure that each continues to be managed in line with investment objectives, policy and within its investment risk and relevant regulatory restrictions.
 Generate, review, and enhance risk analytics using in-house and third-party risk management tools.
 Assist in the implementation of the internal Fund Risk Management framework as part of new product initiatives and fund launches.
 Assist the Fund Risk team in the preparation of board reports. 
 Respond promptly to material risk issues that arise on funds by escalating to the appropriate authority within the management company.
 Generate both regular and exception-based risk reporting for both fund boards and the management company that enables each to fulfil their governance obligations related to the risk management of investment funds under their management.
 As part of the Fund Risk team, contribute to the onboarding of new clients by drafting the risk related documentation (e.g., Risk Management Process, Risk Appetite Statements, Risk Profiles) and to any other fund due diligence and documentation that requires input from the Fund Risk Team.
 Liaise regularly with key external stakeholders - including: investment managers, administrators, depositaries, law firms, etc.
 
 Skills & Qualifications needed:
 
 A minimum of 2 years’ relevant experience in the UCITS and/or EU Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) frameworks.
 Relevant finance or quantitative degree, with certification or progress towards qualifications such as FRM, PRM, CFA, or CAIA.
 An understanding of the AIFM and UCITS regulatory frameworks, particularly in relation to risk management requirements.
 Excellent communication and reporting skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and convey insights effectively to stakeholders, including portfolio managers, fund directors, and senior management.
 Energetic and solutions-driven team player, willing to support and collaborate with colleagues.
 Self-starter with a detail-oriented and pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
 Adaptable, creative, and capable of addressing diverse client needs effectively.
 
 What you will get in return:
 
 Annual Leave of 25 days + Public holidays
 Hybrid working model.
 Health Care provided
 Life assurance
 Income protection
 Opportunities for professional development.
 Exposure to all aspects of the business and cross-jurisdiction.
 A genuinely unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business + more.
 
 Additional information: 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.

 We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.

 For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)) please visit https://theapexgroup.com/csr-policy/ 
 
 Disclaimer : Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Role/ Department:
 
 Based in Limerick, the successful candidate will report into the Custody Services Manager. The successful individual will focus on resolution of client queries, where expertise is required to problem solve and manage client expectations. The role offers the opportunity to develop skills and knowledge of the firm’s global operating structure. The successful individual will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing the service provided to clients while also having the opportunity to identify and solve service issues.
 Principal responsibilities. 

 The key responsibilities of the role include: 

 To act as the primary point of contact for all custody related queries from the Client.
 Responsible for maintaining and enhancing service provided to the Client.
 Ownership, management and resolution of all Client queries.
 Awareness of transition activity linked to the Client.
 Identifies and manages resolution of service delivery root causes.
 Initiates frequent, proactive communication with the Investment Manager daily contacts to verify perceived levels of satisfaction and demonstrate proactive service.
 Participates in Service Reviews as required.
 Build and maintain strong relationships with all internal partners.
 Maintain and monitor all client data and standing instructions.
 Monitoring and resolution of cash and stock exceptions.
 Ensure day to day funding requirements are in line with client standing instructions.
 Resolves all ASL situations in a timely manner.
 Ensure compliance with all NT risk policies and adherence to ‘Best Practice’ documents.
 

 Skills/Qualifications: 
 The successful candidate will benefit from having:
 
 Excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
 Analytical and problem solving skills are required.
 Ability to facilitate discussions and reach decisions.
 Ability to work under pressure to achieve the multiple daily deadlines for client deliverables, with a mature approach.
 Ability to plan and prioritise their day to day workload to meet client deadlines.
 Ability to review and resolve complex issues.
 Demonstrates an excellent understanding of risk associated with the role.
 
 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

description:
Please note: This Graduate Programme is specifically for candidates available to commence in Autumn 2027. 

BDO’s Business Restructuring Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who wish to build a career in corporate turnaround and restructuring, helping distressed businesses stabilise, preserve value and implement recovery solutions. 

 The role involves supporting delivery of formal insolvency processes such as receiverships, liquidations, examinerships, and SCARPs.   Graduates will get the opportunity to work on restructuring advisory engagements focused on performance improvement, restructuring plans, devising enforcement strategies for lenders, and not solely formal insolvency.

 From the outset, you will be trusted with meaningful responsibilities while receiving the training, mentoring, and support needed to help you grow professionally.  As you progress you will developer strong client relationship skills, gain practical experience delivering on business restructuring engagements and develop commercial judgment, structured problem-solving, attention to detail, resilience, and teamwork skills.  This programme offers an excellent foundation for graduates looking to develop a long-term career in turnaround and restructuring or later move into industry.

 Our dedicated Business Restructuring team works across a diverse range of industries, including Asset Management, Hospitality, Financial Services, Retail, Construction and Real Estate, Aviation, Telecommunications, Media and Technology, Charities, Non-Profit Organisations, and Banking and Insurance.  

 Graduates will also get the opportunity to work on cross boarding restructuring and formal insolvency processes, working with other firms within the BDO International Network.

title: Summer Internship Programme
description:
With fraud cases increasing, it is important to be alert and aware. By staying vigilant you can help protect yourself from being the victim of fraud.
2027 Summer Internship Programme
Inspiring Futures: Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland’s 2027 Summer Internship Programme
Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland’s 10 week Summer Internship Programme offers university students a unique and enriching opportunity to explore the world of finance and professional services. Running annually from late May to the end of August, across both our Dublin and Cork offices this structured programme is designed to inspire, educate, and empower the next generation of professionals
Each summer, a select group of interns joins our team for a hands-on experience that blends practical learning, mentorship, and professional development. Interns are immersed in real-world projects, attend interactive workshops, and gain exposure to various departments across the firm. The programme culminates in a final presentation, where interns showcase their work to Cantor Fitzgerald employees, mentors, and invited guests.
What sets our Summer Internship Programme apart is the personalised support and collaborative environment. Interns are assigned dedicated mentors who provide guidance, feedback, and career insights throughout the summer. This close-knit structure fosters meaningful relationships, peer learning, and a strong sense of community.
Beyond technical skills, interns develop essential competencies such as communication, teamwork, critical thinking, and problem-solving. Many participants leave the programme with a renewed sense of confidence, clarity about their career goals, and a valuable network of professional contacts.
At Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive environment where students are encouraged to challenge themselves, explore new possibilities, and realise their potential—whether in finance or beyond.
2027 Internship Programme Key Dates
Applications Closed
Programme Duration: 10 weeks
Location: Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland Offices
Applications open : 31st August 2026
Applications close: 18th October 2026
Highlights of the programme include
Anti-Money Laundering
The Stock Market
Pensions
Finance for Charities
Market Abuse
Marketing for Finance
2025 Internship Highlights
“During my internship at Cantor, I had the opportunity to gain a well-rounded and immersive experience across multiple departments. A series of insightful talks from the CEO, COO, and employees from various teams provided a deeper understanding of the firm’s operations, culture and general pathway to success. I participated in engaging events, including a meet-and-mingle lunch, a town hall, and a summer party, which fostered a strong sense of community and networking. I attended a training outing at the Bloomberg office and had access to the Bloomberg Terminal, which helped build my technical proficiency and knowledge of markets. A structured rotation through different departments allowed me to broaden my exposure and better understand the firm’s functions. I also had the opportunity to develop and present two project pitches. Within the Corporate Finance department, I took part in high-level industry events such as talks at Mansion House, Dublin Chambers, and Rabobank. I was actively involved in ongoing projects and internal meetings—often treated as a full team member rather than an intern, which was both empowering and motivating. Cantor’s smaller team structure meant that interns were given individual placements and more direct responsibilities, allowing for a more hands-on and involved experience compared to larger firms.”
David Dunne, 2025 Corporate Finance Intern

 Are you passionate about delivering fair customer outcomes and driving continuous improvement? As a Complaints Handler, you will play a key role in investigating and resolving customer complaints in a timely, professional, and compliant manner. Working closely with customers and internal stakeholders, you will conduct detailed investigations, assess evidence, determine outcomes, and provide clear and empathetic communication throughout the complaints process.

Your insights will support operational teams in enhancing processes, reducing future complaints, and improving service delivery. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys problem-solving, attention to detail, and making a meaningful impact on customer outcomes while contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
