Ready to start your career at AIB?
If you're curious, ambitious and looking for a role where you can learn, grow and make a real impact from day one, our Finance Data Analyst   Graduate Programme could be the perfect fit.
At AIB, we know that starting your career is a big step. That's why we've created a graduate programme that gives you meaningful work, plenty of support and opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
Over 3.5 years, you'll rotate across different teams, gain exposure to exciting projects and develop the skills, experience and confidence needed to build a successful career.
No two days will be the same!
Why join our graduate programme?
As part of the programme, you'll get the opportunity to experience different areas across Finance Data, working with a range of teams and colleagues.
You'll learn on the job, contribute to real business initiatives and work alongside experienced professionals who are invested in helping you succeed.
Along the way, you'll also have opportunities to:
Build your professional network
Attend development events
Connect with senior leaders across the organisation
Learn from graduates who have already completed the programme
Explore different career paths within AIB
This is more than just a graduate role. It's an opportunity to discover what you're capable of.
What You’ll Do
We’re made up of small teams where you have the chance to expand your knowledge and be heavily involved in new and ongoing projects. We view inclusion & diversity, wellbeing and continuous learning & development as key enablers that help our business to grow and deliver AIB’s strategic and financial objectives.
As part of the programme, you will gain exposure to some of the following:
Learn the AIB Project Methodology through involvement in numerous projects including how to draft a technical specification
Data visualisation skills development from maintenance of existing dashboards to building dashboards from scratch, learning scripting language, and implementing complex data visualisation solutions.
Complete a journey of SQL competence from basic queries to complex scripts.
Exposure to working with Teradata (Relational Database Management System), other AIB systems and platforms and a knowledge of the development of Financial Data.
Data analysis and cleansing.
Gathering Data Development requirements and documenting technical specifications.
Running Financial Information Management reports.
Monitoring data visualisation batches and fixing issues.
Troubleshooting issues and implementing fixes.
There will be at least 1 rotation, where we will challenge you to ensure your learning and development potential is maximised over the duration of the programme.
Graduates on this programme are given the opportunity to attend online courses in UCD to supplement on the job learning . There you will be able to develop a range of important skills, including practical data manipulation, visualisation, analytics, and machine learning. The programme assessment is project based enabling you to demonstrate your understanding and familiarity of each semester’s content in a work themed, practical way. On completion of the programme, you will receive the following from UCD:
Diploma in Data Analysis without Coding
Diploma in Database Fundamentals
Certificate in Python Programming
Diploma in Data Analytics: Visualisation
Diploma in Data Analytics: Machine Learning
Specialist Certificate in Data Analytics
What's in it for you?
Alongside valuable experience and development opportunities, you'll enjoy:
21 Days annual leave & 2 additional volunteer days
Additional AIB Bank Holidays – Good Friday & the day after St. Stephens Day
Hybrid working, 3 days in office & 2 working from home
Rotations across different teams
Strong emphasis on wellbeing & work-life balance
Structured learning & development programme
Defined Contribution Pension Scheme
Vhi Healthcare scheme
Variable remuneration scheme
We are with you every step of the way
Starting your first professional role can feel daunting, but we'll be with you every step of the way.
Every graduate is assigned a dedicated People Leader who will support your development, help you navigate challenges and encourage you to get the most from your experience.
You'll also become part of a vibrant graduate community, joining fellow Finance Data graduates as well as graduates from previous intakes. Whether it's learning, networking or social events, you'll quickly build relationships that last well beyond the programme.
We also offer access to a wide range of support networks and initiatives, including our Employee Assistance Programme and Mentor Her programme.
Entry Requirements:
Achieved or expected to achieve a minimum 2.1 Honours Degree (or equivalent for universities outside of Ireland) is a prerequisite for those joining the AIB graduate programme.
Candidates must be fully authorised to work in Ireland or hold a valid work permit for the full duration of the contract (September 2027 – March 2031).
If you are not sure about your suitability based on any aspects of the role advertised, we encourage you to please contact our Future Talent Programmes team at Grads@aib.ie for a conversation.
AIB is an equal opportunities employer, and we pride ourselves on being the first bank in Ireland to receive the Investors in Diversity Gold Standard accreditation from the Irish Centre for Diversity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees. Should you have a reasonable accommodation request please email the Talent Acquisition team at  Grads@aib.ie
Apply today and start shaping your future with AIB.
Applications are expected to close on the 26th October 2026  however, we encourage candidates to apply early as the programme may close sooner if demand is high.

Applicants must be resident in the Republic of Ireland and be fully authorised to work, or hold a valid work permit, for the full duration of the programme. Any offer of employment will be conditional upon satisfactory evidence of the right to work in the Republic of Ireland.

title: Sr Consult, Client ServicesGFS (Dublin/Limerick) - Transfer Agency
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Role 
 
 Reporting to the Client Services Team Manager, The Client Service Manager (Senior Consultant) is responsible for the day-to-day delivery and oversight of Transfer Agency services for a portfolio of clients.
 Acting as the primary operational point of contact, the role ensures all client deliverables are met in line with agreed Service Level Documents (SLDs), whilst maintaining strong client relationships, managing service issues, and supporting a consistent, high-quality client experience.
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Day to day delivery of all TA Services to the client.  The CSM should work with Operational Partners in producing daily/weekly/monthly deliverable control checklists and must ensure all targets and deadlines are met.
 Be the face of Northern Trust to our external and internal partners
 Maintain Client Service levels, for dedicated clients, by ensuring timely and accurate delivery of information and work products.
 Provide technical expertise for the development of new TA Products and develop SLD’s with your clients for the take on of these new products and services
 Participates / leads client due diligence visits
 Oversees the timely completion and publication of monthly reporting including calculating KPI levels and review of monthly reporting packs to Consultant / Client     
 Responsibility for vetting all incident reports prior to release to RM's/Clients and ensuring all items are added to the daily client incident log
 To work with internal departments to evaluate and implement changes in proposed new regulations and to ensure that all current requirements are met
 Ensure operating procedures are maintained, with the overall objective of enhancing the client experience to maintain the service quality.

description:
Are you a problem solver looking for a hands-on internship position with a market-leading company that will help develop your career and reward you intellectually and professionally?

 About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

 At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. During your internship, you will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. Collaborating with colleagues in an environment of respect and responsibility, you will create connections that will become a part of your professional network.

 ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. The internship program features various lunch-and-learn topics and social events with other interns and full-time employees.

 At ADI, our goal is to develop our interns so they are the first to be considered for full-time roles.

 Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.

           
 Talent Acquisition Intern, Early Careers 
 Location: Limerick, Ireland

 Internship Type: Undergraduate Placement

 About the Role 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly organised Talent Acquisition Intern to join our Early Careers Talent Acquisition team in Limerick.

 This internship provides an excellent opportunity for an undergraduate student to gain practical experience within a fast-paced, EMEA Talent Acquisition environment. You will support the team in delivering internship and graduate recruitment activity across EMEA, working with recruiters, hiring managers, candidates and other HR partners.

 You will gain hands-on experience across the recruitment lifecycle, from managing applications and recruitment administration through to supporting offers, contracts and hiring activity.

 Key Responsibilities 
 As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you will support the Early Careers team with activities including:
 Supporting internship and graduate recruitment activity across EMEA .
 Using Workday to manage candidate applications and progress candidates through the recruitment process.
 Supporting the preparation and generation of employment contracts and associated recruitment documentation .
 Working with hiring managers across EMEA to support their internship and graduate vacancies .
 Supporting the administration and co-ordination of recruitment processes, including interview activity and candidate communications.
 Maintaining accurate candidate and requisition information within recruitment systems and trackers.
 Supporting the Talent Acquisition team with offer and pre-employment activities.
 Responding to candidate and hiring manager queries in a professional and timely manner.
 Supporting reporting, tracking and general administration associated with Early Careers recruitment.
 Contributing to wider Early Careers initiatives and recruitment projects as required.
 
  
 Qualifications & Experience 
 We are looking for a student who:
 Is currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Human Resource Management , or a Business degree with Human Resources as a major or significant area of study .
 Has a strong interest in developing a career in Human Resources and/or Talent Acquisition .
 Demonstrates excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
 Has excellent written and verbal communication skills .
 Has strong organisational skills and can manage multiple activities and priorities.
 Is proficient in the Microsoft Office suite , particularly Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
 Is comfortable learning and working with HR and recruitment technology.
 Demonstrates a proactive, collaborative and professional approach to work.
 
   
 What You Will Gain 
 This internship offers the opportunity to gain practical experience in:
 End-to-end Talent Acquisition and Early Careers recruitment .
 Working with EMEA wide team and supporting hiring activity across multiple EMEA countries .
 Using Workday and recruitment technology in a corporate environment.
 Candidate application and recruitment process management.
 Offer and contract administration.
 Hiring manager and stakeholder engagement.
 Internship and graduate recruitment programmes.
 Recruitment reporting, tracking and process improvement.
 
  
 You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced Talent Acquisition professionals while developing the practical HR, communication, organisational and stakeholder-management skills that will support a future career in Human Resources.

 Ideal Candidate 
 You are someone who enjoys working with people but is equally comfortable working with systems. You are organised, curious and keen to gain experience in an international organisation.

 You take pride in getting the details right and are enthusiastic about gaining practical experience in Talent Acquisition and Early Careers recruitment .

Reporting to the Claims Manager, you will participate in a customer focused claims handling team, dealing with liability claims from registration to settlement to include settlements up to & including Direct Settlement, Pre litigation, Litigation Damage & Injury team type settlements.
You will ensure that a proactive, innovative and compliant philosophy is adopted in relation to all claim handling activities, which will involve managing a portfolio of Motor Liability, Employer Liability, Public Liability injury/damage and Personal Accident claims , where claimant cases are managed either  directly with the claimant, via a solicitor,  through the Injuries Board or Litigation process.    Your duties are to be carried out in adherence to all regulatory requirements.

Providing first telephone contact for customers in a friendly, courteous and professional manner to ensure a positive customer experience.

Targeting claims where appropriate for settlement direct with the claimant, ensuring that these claims are dealt with in a proactive, fair and compliant manner.
Targeting claims where appropriate for settlement with the claimants’ legal representatives prior to the Injuries Board process.
Managing claims within the Injuries Board process.
Managing claims that have proceeded to Litigation including liaising/instructing Legal Defence Team, Expert witnesses, Service Providers etc.
Ensuring all recovery opportunities and fraud aspects are identified and proactively handled through to conclusion.
Ensuring Customer Service levels are delivered and maintained in accordance with agreed standards.

title: MI & Reporting Data Analyst
description:
About us   
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.  
 At Davy, you are the difference.    
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.  
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.  
 About the role  
 We are seeking a results driven data analyst with a passion for finance and wealth management to join the newly established Data and Analytics Centre of Excellence. 
The purpose of this role is to enable the delivery of exceptional client experience through data driven decisions. You will collaborate with key stakeholders in Wealth Management, Strategy and Marketing to deliver outcomes that improve operational efficiency, client experience, and business performance. You will help shape the backbone of our analytics function as we move into Snowflake and adopt more advanced analytical techniques. This is a high-impact role blending technical skills, business acumen, and forward-thinking curiosity.
This is an excellent opportunity for the right person to join Ireland's leading wealth management business and develop their career in Data and Analytics.
 In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Support the migration of legacy data assets to Snowflake, ensuring fidelity and efficiency.
 Design and execute exploratory and statistical analyses to uncover business insights.
 Partner with business units across Compliance, Risk, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Investments to deliver data products and solutions.
 Prototype and deliver compelling visual analytics via Power BI.
 Contribute to the design and development of data products.
 Champion data literacy across the organization through ad-hoc training or support.
 Document metadata, maintain data lineage, and support data quality frameworks.
 Requirements 
 About you: 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills: 
 2-3 years in a data or analytics role, ideally in financial services or a similarly regulated industry.
 Strong fluency in Excel & SQL and experience working with large datasets.
 Solid understanding of Snowflake or other cloud data platforms.
 Exposure to data modelling best practices and schema design.
 Familiarity with Python, R, or equivalent data science tools is advantageous.
 Demonstrated experience with BI tools like Power BI or Tableau.
 Ability to translate business requirements into data-driven solutions.
 Effective communication and documentation skills with a natural curiosity and drive to learn.
 Benefits 
 What we offer: 
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.   
 Health and Wellbeing   
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.  
 Reward and Recognition   
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.  
 Growth and Development   
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.  
 Positive Workplace   
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.  
 Values and Culture   
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.   
 Important Information  
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

title: CLO Deal Administrator - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive.   We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
 As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.
  
 We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.
 
 We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.
 
 
 
 Job Description CLO Deal Administrator - 12 Month FTC 

We are currently looking to hire a CLO Deal Administrator on a 12 Month Fixed Term Contract basis aligned to our Cherrywood office.

 The CLO division sits within US Bank’s Global Corporate Trust (GCT) division. CLO’s are structured finance vehicles that issue both debt and equity liabilities, with the proceeds being used to buy a portfolio of collateral. Typical types of collateral include syndicated bank loans, corporate bonds & equity.
  
 The CLO Deal Administrator role is a key role within our Corporate Trust Business and offers a good level of individual responsibility and accountability, whilst being part of a dynamic and successful business line with opportunity for future growth and development.
  
 Responsibilities of this role include: oversight and execution of bond/bank loan trade settlements, analysis of Money Market Fund investment requirements, booking cash inflows/outflows to the portfolio, tracking asset attributes such as accrual information, providing cash & asset reporting to the clients on a daily basis, and assisting the Analysts with reporting to the CLO investors. The Deal Administrator ensures 100% accuracy and timeliness of data through the booking and reconciliation of account activity.
  
 Context / Environment for this role 
  
 The role holder will be required to build and maintain effective relationships across the Bank and its parent, as well as with external parties, clients, and stakeholders.
  
 The role holder will be part of a specialist team and will be expected to exhibit teamwork, attention to detail, ability to work to tight deadlines, detailed technical knowledge with the ability to manage a heavy and varied workload.
  
 Principal Accountabilities: 

 Cash & Asset Reconciliation responsibility for a portfolio of CDO/CLO transactions
 Generate accurate Daily Cash Reports that reconcile asset payments and receivables on an Actual vs Expected model basis
 Investigate and resolve any exceptions / discrepancies arising. Ability to resolve transactional and portfolio related issues
 Process Broadly Syndicated Loan trades from trade ticket to settlement/payment request stage
 Analysis and oversight of automated Trade settlement processes
 Daily Review of available cash balances & Money Market Funds to ensure sufficient liquidity to action trade settlements
 Receive Bond/Securities tickets and Loan Trade Documents from Clients, review for accuracy, complete relevant documentation and liaise with internal Operations Team’s to ensure they settle within agreed time scales in the market
 Liaise directly with Clients/Counterparties/Agent Banks and other departments for Bond/Loan & Cash related queries
 Settle Loan and Bond transactions on internal compliance system – CDO Suite
 Reconcile Cash & Asset Balances with our clients to support CDO Analytics in the production of Monthly CDO Investor Report
 
  
 Experience Required:
 
 Typically 2-4 years’ experience within Financial Services with experience of cash recs / settlements / client engagement or in a relatable Operations Analyst role
 Preferably with knowledge of fixed income, debt, loans or derivatives and a passion to enter the CLO market or some previous CLO experience or theoretical knowledge of CLO's be hugely beneficial
 Looking for someone with a good level of numeracy and attention to detail
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a client centric approach
 Ability to work both independently and as a team player
 Strong organizational skills and detail-oriented
 Relationship building across several internal groups & divisions
 Ability to manage a heavy and varied workload while demonstrating strong attention to detail
 Indenture/Credit Agreement interpretation abilities and analytical skills are preferrable
 
 
 Location Expectations   
 in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.  
  
 
 Accessibility 
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support. 
 
 Total Rewards 
 U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.
  
 We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:
 Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

 Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

 Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

 Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

 Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

  
 We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.
 
 We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon .
   
 Closing Date 
 Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.
  
 We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

The Senior Data Quality Analyst plays a key role in advancing AIB’s established data quality and control environment across the organisation.
The role focuses on enhancing how data quality is measured, reported and governed — ensuring data remains reliable, well-controlled and fit for use in decision-making, regulatory reporting and risk management.
Sitting within the Data & Analytics Office, the role operates across technology, data and business teams. You will support the continued embedding of practical, enterprise-wide data quality and data management standards, partnering with stakeholders to strengthen how data is created, moved and used within critical processes.
This is a high-impact role with strong enterprise exposure, offering the opportunity to work with key stakeholders across AIB. You will help address complex data challenges and drive continuous improvement in how data is designed, controlled and used at scale.
This role has specific accountability for:
Data quality and control environment – Implement Data Quality rules, thresholds and monitoring, and work with delivery teams to improve how data is captured, transformed and managed to ensure reliability and end-to-end control
Apply data management practices in delivery – Lead on embedding of data lineage, metadata and master/reference data practices to improve consistency, traceability and reuse across domains
Deliver insight and embed scalable ways of working - Produce high-quality data reporting that highlight risk, support governance and enable informed decision-making
Embed practical data standards and controls - Apply data standards and controls in a pragmatic way, ensuring they are consistently adopted and deliver tangible improvements in data quality

Experience working with data across both business and technology environments is required
Experience working with data in a technical or data-focused role, including understanding how data flows across systems, processes and reporting, with a good understanding of how it supports decision-making, operations and risk
Ability to simplify complex topics and communicate clearly with stakeholders across business and technology

 Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth.

 Grant Thornton's Tax team works across the entire spectrum of tax services, providing innovative and practical solutions to clients operating locally and globally. Our professionals combine technical expertise with commercial insight to help clients manage tax risk, remain compliant and achieve their strategic objectives.

 You may have the opportunity to:

title: Graduate Program Associate - Environmental, Health & Safety
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
 The EH&S Graduate will support the Environmental, Health & Safety team in maintaining a safe, compliant and sustainable pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The role provides broad exposure to occupational safety, environmental compliance, risk management, emergency preparedness, EHS systems and continuous improvement within a GMP-regulated manufacturing setting.

 Key Responsibilitie s

 Health & Safet y
 Support the implementation and continuous improvement of site EH&S policies, procedures and standards.
 Assist with workplace risk assessments, hazard identification and routine safety inspections.
 Participate in incident and near-miss reporting, investigation and corrective action follow-up.
 Support contractor safety management, permit-to-work activities and emergency response exercises.
 Track and trend safety metrics including observations, near misses, incidents and action closure.
 Environmental Compliance
 Assist with environmental monitoring programs, waste management activities and recycling initiatives.
 Support the maintenance of environmental permits, registers and compliance documentation.
 Help track environmental KPIs such as energy, water, waste and emissions data.
 Contribute to sustainability, resource efficiency and carbon reduction projects.

 Regulatory & Management Systems 
 Support compliance with Irish EHS legislation and relevant site standards.
 Assist with ISO 14001 Environmental Management System and ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety Management System activities where applicable.
 Support GMP-aligned documentation, change control inputs and audit readiness activities as required.
 Maintain EHS records, databases and digital EHS management systems such as Cority or equivalent platforms.
 
 
 Training & Safety Cultu re
 Assist with EHS induction training for employees, contractors and visitors.
 Support safety campaigns, toolbox talks and awareness events.
 Participate in Safety Committee meetings and follow up on assigned actions.
 Promote positive safety behaviors and employee engagement across operational areas.

 Qualifications and Experience 
 Essential 
 Desirable 
 Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Chemistry, Biological Sciences or a related scientific discipline.
Strong communication skills, attention to detail and a proactive approach to learning.

Competence in Microsoft Office and ability to manage data accurately.
 Internship or placement experience in pharmaceutical, chemical, manufacturing or regulated industry.

Basic knowledge of Irish safety and environmental legislation.
Awareness of ISO 14001, ISO 45001, GMP principles and EHS management systems.
 
 Core Skills and Competencies 

 Technical 
 Risk assessment, hazard identification, incident investigation support, environmental monitoring, EHS documentation and KPI reporting.
 Communication 
 Ability to engage with colleagues, contractors and cross-functional teams in a clear and professional manner.
 Problem Solving 
 Practical approach to investigating issues, identifying root causes and supporting corrective actions.
 Organisation 
 Strong attention to detail, ability to prioritise tasks and maintain accurate records.
 Mindset 
 Positive safety attitude, curiosity, integrity and commitment to continuous improvement.
 Development Opportunities
 ·         Occupational safety management and risk assessment methodologies.
 ·         Process safety fundamentals and chemical safety awareness.
 ·         Industrial hygiene and exposure monitoring programs.
 ·         Emergency response planning and business continuity support.
 ·         Environmental compliance, waste management and sustainability programs.
 ·         ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and pharmaceutical GMP operating environments.
 ·         Digital EHS systems, data analytics and KPI dashboard development.
 Typical Graduate Projects
 ·         Safety culture improvement initiative or behavioral safety campaign.
 ·         Near-miss and observation trending project with corrective action analysis.
 ·         Waste reduction, recycling or sustainability improvement project.
 ·         Ergonomic assessment program for operational or laboratory work areas.
 ·         Contractor safety documentation review and improvement plan.
 ·         EHS digital system support, including data quality and workflow optimisation.
 This role is suited to a motivated graduate who wants to build a long-term career in Environmental, Health & Safety within a highly regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will receive mentoring, structured development and hands-on experience across both strategic and operational EHS activities.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of data management processes, controls and standards.
Participate in projects and ad hoc tasks as required.

Understanding of data governance principles and metadata management.
Experience querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data validation, reconciliation, trend analysis and deriving actionable insights.

Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

title: Commercial Graduate Program - Sales Path - English Speaking Market
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 
 Job Category 

Sales 
 Job Details 

 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 
 
 
 Fixed-term contract
Duration: 12 months
Start Date: February 2027

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

 Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

 Who are we looking for? You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
 You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
 You are a creative problem-solver
 You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
 You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
 You thrive in a team environment
 You have excellent interpersonal skills
 You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
 You are fluent in English is Essential

 What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? The program is structured as follows: Introduction Month 
 During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

 Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
 Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
 Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
 Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni
 
 Rotations During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
 
 If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.

 Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

 Examples of what you can expect during the rotations 
 Sales Graduate Rotation Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
 Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
 Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation
 
 Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
 Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
 Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view
 
 What’s in it for you? A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
 The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
 Access to our diverse internal employee groups
 A comprehensive benefits package
 Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
 An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model
 
 Map your future for the coming years 
 With the EMEA Graduate Program - Sales Path, you can continue to progress:
 After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change.
 

 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title:
Dublin /Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in office)
Reporting To:

Career Level:
COMPANY BACKGROUND
Ornua is a leading dairy co-operative which sells premium dairy products globally on behalf of its Member Co-operatives, Ireland’s dairy processors and, in turn, Irish dairy farmers.
Ornua has revenues of €3.4 billion and is supported by a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. The Group operates as a commercial organisation across 10 business units, including 12 production facilities located in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
The commercial organisation is responsible for the marketing and sales of Ornua’s consumer brands including Ireland’s most successful food export: Kerrygold. Consumer markets are served by production facilities in Ireland, Germany and the UK and by in-market Sales & Marketing Teams in Asia, Germany, Ireland, MEA, Poland, Spain, rest of Europe and North and Latin America.
It also manages the procurement of Irish and non-Irish dairy products, the sale of dairy ingredients to food manufacturing and foodservice customers globally, and the implementation of de-risking and trading strategies to manage market volatility. These activities are supported by production facilities and in-market teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
WHY THIS ROLE IS VALUABLE
The Commercial Operations Executive is a key member of the Commercial team in Ireland, supporting the team in executing our growth plans with Key Customer Accounts. Reporting to the Senior Account Manager, the role acts as a central point of co-ordination between the Commercial team and colleagues across Supply Chain, Procurement, Marketing and 3rd Party Logistic Providers.
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:
Act as the Commercial team’s lead contact with Customer Service and Supply Chain including product availability, stock management on a daily basis for promotions and ownership of the team’s service-level reporting.
Partner with National Account Managers to deliver accurate forecasts by SKU and by customer, building a consolidated periodic sales plan.
Act as lead contact for aligning commercial plans with the Marketing and Trade Marketing teams on customer activations, including sampling and point-of-sale (POS) planning and requirements.
Serve as lead contact for Field Sales Representatives, managing their reporting and tracking product sample allocations.
Provide ongoing support to the Commercial Director, National Account Managers and Category team, including sales reporting and ad hoc requests.
Gather and analyse customer and competitor information, maintaining market pricing and promotional trackers.
Use customer reporting data to support the Category Management team in developing shared insights that enable value-adding decisions.
Contribute to the preparation of presentations for customer meetings.
Manage sales enquiries and, in conjunction with Marketing, respond to consumer complaints.
Support Marketing brand events where relevant, including co-ordinating customer invitations.
KEY SKILLS/ATTRIBUTES
Ideally a bachelor’s degree in business, Food Business, Food Science or a related discipline.
Previous experience in a commercial support or administrative role, preferably gained working with Retailers.
Proficiency in Power BI, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Excellent numerical, analytical and organisational skills.
A clear, confident communicator with strong persuasion and presentation skills.
Able to quickly master reporting systems and work comfortably with large volumes of data.
A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and is comfortable working with ambiguity.
Committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience and confident engaging
ORNUA COMPETENCIES:
WORKING TOGETHER: Encourages co-operation in own team and support cross functional working.
COMMUNICATIVE: Communicates confidently, adapting style for different situations.
OWNERSHIP: Clarifies accountabilities, overlaps, and gaps, and helps other remain motivated through difficult times.
CUSTOMER FOCUS: Pays attention to customer satisfaction levels and builds good relationships.

title: Graduate Programme 2027 | BDO Ireland LLP Limerick
description:
The BDO Ireland LLP Limerick Graduate Programme 2027 is seeking applications across our Audit, Tax and Corporate Governance Departments. 

 AUDIT JOB DESCRIPTION
 

 The BDO Audit Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are eager to build a career in accountancy and gain hands-on experience working with a broad range of clients. 

 As part of the Audit team, you will work alongside experienced professionals while supporting our clients. You will be involved in assisting in the preparation of financial statements, analysing financial information, and helping clients meet their reporting and compliance obligations. The role will give you exposure to different clients, business models, and financial challenges, allowing you to develop both your technical knowledge and commercial awareness. 

 From the outset, you will be trusted with meaningful responsibilities while receiving the training, mentoring, and support needed to help you grow professionally. As you progress, you will develop strong client relationship skills, gain practical experience in financial reporting and assurance, and work towards your recognised professional qualification (ACA or ACCA). 

 This programme offers an excellent foundation for graduates looking to develop a long-term career in audit and professional services or later move into industry. As part of the programme, graduates will be assigned to one of BDO's specialist audit teams, providing the opportunity to develop sector-specific expertise and build strong client relationships.  

 Our audit teams serve a diverse range of industries, including Financial Services, Manufacturing and Distribution, Telecommunications, Media and Technology; Charities, Non-Profit Organisations; Construction and Real Estate.  

 Working within a dedicated team, graduates will gain valuable hands-on experience, develop strong technical and commercial skills, and contribute to the delivery of high-quality audit and assurance services to clients. 
 
TAX JOB DESCRIPTION 
 

 The BDO Tax Graduate Programme offers graduates the opportunity to develop a career in a fast-paced and dynamic area of professional services. Working as part of our Tax Department, you will help clients meet their compliance obligations while supporting them in understanding and managing the tax implications of their business and personal affairs. 

 Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to a broad range of tax matters, work with clients across different industries, and develop a practical understanding of Irish tax legislation. You will be involved in both compliance and advisory work, giving you the opportunity to build strong technical skills while developing commercial awareness and client relationship experience. 
 
With support from experienced colleagues, structured training, and assistance towards completing a professional qualification, including the Irish Tax Institute (ITI) Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA) programme, this graduate programme provides an excellent foundation for graduates looking to build a long-term career in tax. 

 CORPORATE GOVERNANCE JOB DESCRIPTION

 The BDO Ireland LLP Corporate Governance Graduate Programme offers graduates the opportunity to develop a career at the heart of how organisations are governed and managed. 

 As part of the Corporate Governance team, you will work closely with clients to help them meet their regulatory and statutory obligations while supporting effective governance practices. You will gain exposure to a range of company secretarial and compliance activities, working with organisations of various sizes and across different sectors. 

 The role provides valuable insight into corporate structures, board operations, regulatory requirements, and governance frameworks. You will work alongside experienced professionals, developing your technical knowledge, attention to detail, and client relationship skills while gaining a strong understanding of the governance environment in which organisations operate. 

 With structured training, mentoring, and ongoing professional development support, this programme provides an excellent foundation for graduates looking to build a long-term career in corporate governance and professional services.

Internship Programme
The Maples Group’s Internship Programme provides interns with the opportunity to see what it is really like to work in a global law firm. During their time with us, interns will be involved in legal work, including meetings, drafting and research. They will also have the chance to meet trainees, solicitors and partners across all practice areas. We are committed to making sure that interns receive excellent training and develop their skills. Of course, they also get to enjoy the social side of life, with many events and activities which allow them to connect with other interns and the entire firm.
The programme runs for four weeks during the month of June each year. You will primarily be based in our Dublin office, however, you will be involved with international transactions, clients and advice. The programme includes a mix of training; department, committee and global talks; various workshops, Q&A sessions and a number of social activities to ensure a holistic experience for all our interns.
Our Internship Programme is the foundation of our Traineeship Programme as it allows us to identify our future Trainees. The Internship Programme is the first step in your career with the Maples Group and gives you the opportunity to experience life here with us. We are committed to developing the future generation of lawyers. If shaping the future of law is something that you would like to be a part of, apply for our programme today!

title: Marketing & Customer Insight Analyst
description:
Contact Claims Help
Marketing & Customer Insight Analyst
Marketing Team
Sandyford Dublin 18 Ravenscourt Office Park
2022-09-29 15:50:18
Full-time
Chill Insurance are currently on the lookout for a Marketing and Customer Insight Analyst to join our team.
About the Company
Chill Insurance Limited (“Chill”) is a multi-channel insurance intermediary regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland. Founded in 2007, Chill has scaled to become one of Ireland’s leading insurance intermediaries. Chill Insurance is backed by Private Equity house Livingbridge and having invested significantly in the infrastructure and operational teams in the business we are now in a position to take advantage of a number of opportunities (both organic and acquisitive) which should lead to a more than doubling in the size of the business in the coming few years.
Chill’s sister companies include Quote Devil Insurance, an insurance intermediary, and Ivernia Insurance Ltd, an MGA insurer . The customer insight team support all three businesses and this role will provide support across the full group.
Purpose
Own and embed TRG’s behavioural segmentation and customer decisioning frameworks, ensuring they translate into clear, commercially impactful CRM strategies. This role acts as the internal authority on how customer behaviour is defined, segmented, and activated—driving the shift towards data-led personalisation, next-best-action (NBA), and propensity-driven marketing across the customer lifecycle.
Operating as a senior individual contributor, the role provides analytical leadership and decisioning frameworks that directly shape CRM performance and commercial outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Behavioural Segmentation Ownership
Act as the internal SME and owner of TRG's behavioural segmentation model.
Validate, challenge, and approve segmentation methodology, outputs, and ongoing evolution.
Translate segments into clear commercial strategies across acquisition, conversion, retention, and cross-sell.
Ensure segmentation is consistently and effectively applied across CRM and marketing activity.
Decisioning, NBA & Personalisation
Define and evolve next-best-action (NBA) frameworks and decisioning logic.
Establish how behavioural data, segmentation, and context drive: Targeting; Timing; Message and proposition
Develop scalable personalisation approaches that move beyond static campaigns to behaviour-led journeys.
Ensure decisioning logic is embedded within CRM execution.
Propensity Modelling & Activation
Identify and prioritise key propensity use cases (e.g. conversion, churn, cross-sell).
Translate model outputs into actionable CRM rules, triggers, and journey design.
Ensure propensity-led strategies are measurable and continuously optimised.
Insight-Led Optimisation & Testing
Define and lead the test-and-learn roadmap, ensuring strong hypotheses and statistical rigour.
Analyse customer journeys to identify drop-offs, triggers, and optimisation opportunities.
Provide clear recommendations to improve enquiry generation, conversion, and retention.
Performance & Commercial Insight
Develop performance frameworks linking segments, decisioning, and campaigns to commercial outcomes.
Produce clear, actionable insight on what is driving performance and where to focus next.
Evaluate effectiveness of segmentation, NBA, and propensity approaches.
Data & Martech Enablement
Define requirements for data and Martech to support segmentation, decisioning, and personalisation.
Ensure data structures enable accurate targeting, measurement, and optimisation.
Partner with technical teams to embed decisioning into CRM workflows.
Cross-Functional Influence
Act as the go-to expert on behavioural insight and customer decisioning.
Influence CRM, Data, and Marketing teams to adopt segmentation-led and test-and-learn approaches.
Support the successful activation of segmentation within day-to-day CRM delivery.
Core Skills
Strong analytical capability - confident with SQL and data visualisation.
Working knowledge of Python or similar tools to explore data, validate outputs, and interrogate model performance (not required to build models from scratch).
Strong understanding of propensity modelling, predictive analytics, and AI-driven decisioning concepts (e.g. classification models, uplift modelling, next-best-action frameworks).
Familiarity with AI-enabled marketing approaches (e.g. real-time decisioning, recommendation engines, automated content optimisation).
Ability to interpret, challenge, and refine model outputs and ensure they translate into practical marketing applications.
Experience translating segmentation, behavioural data, and model outputs into CRM strategies and journeys.
Understanding of personalisation and decisioning systems, including how rules and models interact in execution.
Strong commercial mindset - able to prioritise activity based on value impact.
Excellent communicator - able to simplify complex analytics into clear business actions.
Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
If you would like to join our team, or would like to find out more about the role, please send an email to careers@chill.ie . Before applying, please take a look at our job applicant privacy policy .
Please Note: We do not require the assistance of recruitment agencies or consultancies.

supporting the Solvency II and IFRS17 quarterly process.  This includes supporting the:
calculation of the Solvency II Technical Provisions and Non-Life Underwriting Risk SCR
calculation of IFRS17 Liabilities and Profit & Loss Statement
quarterly reporting to relevant committees and Group
annual opinions on Solvency II Technical Provisions, Underwriting, Retrocession/Reinsurance and the ORSA
internal and external audit activities
maintenance of documentation of key processes, procedures and results
development and maintenance of the models, analysis files and dashboards, using programs such as Excel, Power BI and Python
Last but not least, you will support the team in its work for ad hoc projects, such as responding to requests from the regulator.

Robert Matthews
Read other stories from our veterans
What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.
How do you connect with other members of the Armed Forces Community at Expleo?
I participate in careers  transition workshops supporting recruiters. When Ex-Forces  are looking for a new career, I attend the workshops chatting  to the Armed Forces community sharing my experience and  what I have learned.
What advice would you give to other members of the Armed Forces Community who are planning to join Expleo?
Expleo has many different opportunities, whether it be leadership management, various jobs in engineering, project management etc. Don’t think that you don’t have the skill set to join Expleo. It is within you; you do have those skills and Expleo can bring out these skills in people.

title: Client Services Administrator Coordinator
description:
Business Development & Client Services Coordinator 
 About Your New Employer Join an established, specialist financial services organisation with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality pension administration and client support.
 Work in a collaborative and growing team where you will have the opportunity to shape processes, improve ways of working and take ownership of an evolving role.
 Become part of a modern organisation that values professionalism, client service, operational excellence and continuous development.
 
 About Your New Job As the Business Development & Client Services Coordinator, you will provide essential administrative and operational support to the Business Development and Pension Consultancy teams.
 You will be responsible for coordinating activity throughout the client lifecycle, from initial business development enquiries and proposal preparation through to employer implementation, member onboarding and ongoing client engagement.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Supporting Business Development and Pension Consultants with proposals, quotations, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-up actions.
 Taking ownership of the new client implementation process, including coordinating documentation, tracking requirements and monitoring implementation timelines.
 Liaising with employers and internal teams to ensure all required information is received and new clients are onboarded efficiently.
 Maintaining accurate prospect, client and engagement information on MS Dynamics CRM.
 Preparing reports, meeting packs, campaign information and supporting documentation for client meetings.
 Coordinating follow-up actions arising from meetings, consultations and client engagement activity.
 Supporting CRM campaigns, employer outreach and member engagement initiatives.
 Tracking outstanding actions, identifying potential delays and escalating issues where appropriate.
 Coordinating the administrative elements of new member onboarding and supporting bulk member installations.
 Working closely with Business Development, Pension Administration, Marketing and other internal teams to ensure processes are followed and continuously improved.
 Making practical suggestions to improve workflows, controls and the overall client experience.
 This is an operationally focused role. You will not be providing financial or pension advice; instead, you will ensure that processes are implemented effectively, records are accurate and client commitments are followed through.
 
 What Skills You Need At least five years’ experience in administration, client services, financial services, pensions, insurance or another regulated environment.
 Strong experience coordinating multiple workflows, stakeholders and deadlines.
 A highly organised, process-driven approach with excellent attention to detail.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including a professional telephone manner.
 Previous experience using a CRM or workflow-management system. Experience with MS Dynamics is advantageous.
 Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
 The ability to take ownership, challenge inefficient processes and suggest practical improvements.
 Confidence working with internal teams, employers and other external stakeholders.
 A strong understanding of the importance of accurate record keeping and compliance in a regulated environment.
 Experience supporting a business development, client relationship or consultancy team would be beneficial. A QFA qualification, or a willingness to complete relevant QFA or APA modules in the future, is also desirable.
 
 What's on Offer Salary of €50,000–€60,000, depending on experience.
 Hybrid working model, standard hours of 9:00am–5:00pm and 23 days’ annual leave.
 Competitive pension contribution, income protection and death-in-service benefit.
 Modern offices in Dublin 14 with free parking, refreshments, snacks and lunch options available on site.
 Weekly lunch provided on Wednesdays, weekly Pilates classes and an active sports and social club.
 The opportunity to shape a newly enhanced role, influence processes and develop your career within a specialist financial services environment.

title: Trainee Accountant
description:
At Flipdish, we’re turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple-to-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that’s anything but.

About the role

You’ll join the Finance team at Flipdish, supporting a fast-moving, multi-entity environment where accurate financial information, strong controls, and clear reporting help the business make better decisions. This is a hands-on trainee role with exposure across accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end support, audit preparation, and reporting.

You’ll work closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, building the foundations for a successful ACA / ACCA / CIMA training path while taking on more responsibility as you develop. This role follows our hub model, with a healthy blend of hub and home working: 2 days per week from our Sandyford office.

What you’ll own

  • Support core AP and AR processes, including invoice processing, supplier and customer queries, payment support, reconciliations, and maintaining accurate finance records across multiple entities.
  • Assist with month-end close, audit, tax, and statutory reporting requests by preparing journals, schedules, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and clear supporting documentation.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciling items, unusual balances, and transaction queries; work with Finance and wider business stakeholders to improve financial information and recurring processes.
  • Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility — prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.

What success looks like

  • You understand Flipdish’s finance processes, systems, month-end timetable, and key stakeholders.
  • You are confidently supporting core AP and AR tasks with good accuracy, attention to detail, and clear supporting documentation.
  • You are preparing basic reconciliations and month-end schedules with improving independence.
  • You are asking good questions, learning quickly, and escalating issues early when something does not look right.
  • You are identifying small process improvements or ways to make recurring tasks more efficient.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong academic record, ideally with a degree in accounting, finance, business, economics, or a related discipline.
  • Are eager to commence, or have recently commenced, ACA / ACCA / CIMA.
  • Have strong numerical ability, attention to detail, and pride in producing accurate, well-supported work.
  • Are highly organised, dependable, and able to follow through on tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and are willing to ask questions.
  • Have good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets, with a willingness to keep improving quickly.
  • Take ownership of your work: you do not wait to be told what to do when you can spot the next useful step.

The following would help you stand out:

  • Some finance, accounting, bookkeeping, internship, or office experience.
  • Exposure to accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end, or financial reporting.
  • Experience working with finance systems, spreadsheets, or structured data.

What you get

We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!

  • Hub model (hybrid): a healthy blend of hub + home working (2 days per week from our Sandyford office)
  • Time off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays + company days (e.g. Summer Fridays, seasonal)
  • Private healthcare: IE cover (provided through Laya Healthcare)
  • Pension: Retirement savings support (IE)
  • Team connection: regular team meet-ups and company events
  • Commuter supports: TaxSaver / travel schemes (where available)

Here’s what you can expect throughout the interview process.

  1. Recruiter screening call (15 minutes)
  2. Hiring manager interview (60 minutes)
  3. Competency / technical stage (60 minutes)
  4. Reference checks

Our Culture

At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.

Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.

Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, and create the space for people to grow (with balance, not burnout). We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.

If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

title: Admin and Financial Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland   Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo. 

 About Abbott  
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. 

 *Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company. 

 About the Role 
 We are seeking a highly organized and analytical Admin & Finance Operations Analyst to support our Global Contract Manufacturing organization. This role combines financial analysis, business reporting and administrative coordination while providing exposure to operations, finance, and senior leadership.

 Key Responsibilities Support budgeting, forecasting, expense tracking, and financial reporting.
 Manage purchase orders, invoices, supplier payments, and procurement activities.
 Maintain financial, operational, and contract management trackers.
 Develop business performance reports, dashboards, and presentations.
 Coordinate governance meetings, business reviews, and action tracking. Support contract administration and vendor management processes.
 Provide administrative support including meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and calendar management.
 Support Workday, SAP, Ariba and related business systems.
 Drive process improvements and ensure compliance with company policies and controls.
 
 Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business, Accounting preferred.
 2+ years’ experience in finance or administration preferred, not essential.
 Strong Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis skills.
 Experience with SAP, Ariba or similar ERP systems preferred.
  Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 
 What You Will Bring Strong analytical and financial acumen.
 Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
 Problem-solving mindset and continuous improvement focus.
 Ability to work independently and collaborate across global teams.
 Professionalism when handling confidential business information.

 Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:   Abbott in Ireland | Benefits  

 Connect with us at  www.abbott.com or https://www.ie.abbott/ , on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/ , on Facebook at  www.facebook.com/Abbott  and on Twitter @AbbottNews .

      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

 ADDITIONAL LOCATIONS:      
 WORK SHIFT: Ie - Ansl39S5 (Ireland)      
 TRAVEL: No      
 MEDICAL SURVEILLANCE: Yes      
 SIGNIFICANT WORK ACTIVITIES: Not Applicable
