title: Middle Office, Associate 1
description:
Who we are looking for: 

 Someone who can provide supervision of the teams responsible for trade processing and confirmation of client’s trades, error reporting and resolution.

 Why this role is important to us: 

 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
 Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

 What you will be responsible for: 

 As a Middle Office, Associate 1 you will:

 Monitor Trade File Processing: 
 Ensuring all trade files transmitted by the Fund daily on trade-date are processed by the team.

 Trade Confirmation and Trade Reporting: 
 Monitor and assist in the confirmation of complex OTC trades executed via MTM and DTCC platforms for EMEA, US and APAC markets. This will involve working closely with clients and brokers to resolve intraday trade alleges and breaks in proactive and timely manner on trade date.

 Trade Exports/Settlement Instructions: 
 Ensure the onward transmission of trade details received from the Fund.  Resolve, report and escalate any trade export problems.

 Reconciliations: 
 Overview of daily reconciliation breaks and ensure all breaks are followed up in the hub locations (Poland) and escalated to Ireland team/client if necessary for your resolution assistance.

 Pricing: 
 Ensure pricing for portfolio securities daily from third party pricing sources approved by the Fund.

 Reporting to Ireland Office: 
 Ensure daily checklist is complete and verify end of day process is completed.
 Highlight, escalate and report all issues to the client.

 During the course of normal day to day operation, responsible for identifying any unusual or potentially suspicious transaction activity and must report and/or escalate in accordance with corporate policy and guidelines detailed in relevant operating procedures.

 What we value: 

 These skills will help you succeed in this role:
 Strong critical thinking
 Problem solving, and decision-making skills
 Strong analytical skills
 Strong verbal and written communication skills
 Highly numerate
 Ability to perform effectively within strict client deadlines
 In depth knowledge of some/all of the following products:
      Equity, Futures, Options, Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives (IRS, CDS, TRS, etc)

 Education & Preferred Qualifications: 

 Degree in Accounting or Finance or Business-related area (minimum 2.2 honors degree
 IT Literate  
 

 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

 Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

title: Regulatory Reporting Officer
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
 
 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
 
 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
 
 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.
 
 For our business, for clients, and for you
 
 
 Role:   Regulatory Reporting Officer   

 Department:   Regulatory Reporting   

 Reports to:   Regulatory   & Investor Reporting Manager   

 Apex Risk Technologies (ART) is a leading fintech firm and a critical part of the Apex Group, a global financial services provider. ART clients include alternative investment funds, banks, and fund management companies (ManCo’s).   At ART, we have a passion for finance and technology with a strong commitment to research and development to continuously innovate and improve client solutions within an open and collegiate environment. ART’s core solution is RiskMonitor®, which provides an independent appraisal of investment risk compliance and financial risk exposures. RiskMonitor® produces customisable risk reporting suitable for boards, risk committees and investors as well as risk data required for regulatory submissions.     

 
 ART is a fast-growing business and we are looking for a   Regulatory Reporting Officer   to join our team in   Limerick, Ireland . In this role, you will liaise with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers and Investment Analysts to onboard their funds in RiskMonitor®,   produce regulatory reports in accordance with UCITS and AIFMD directives   and be involved in the daily maintenance of their accounts. In addition, you will closely work with the quantitative development team in Barcelona and Apex technology management colleagues globally to ensure the successful evolution of the ART business unit within Apex. Lastly, you will collaborate with business partners, technology vendors, client counterparties, and colleagues within the Apex Group. This role would suit someone who’s seeking a career in finance and technology with a keen and demonstrable interest in   regulatory reporting .     

 In this role, you will be responsible for:   

 Draft , c oordinate   and review of   UCITS   and PRIIP   Key Investor Information documentation , including risk indicator, monthly performance scenarios.   

 
 Prepare, r eview   of   quarterly/annual AIF,   AIFMD   returns   under ESMA /FCA   requirements . (Annex IV reporting)   

 
   

 Set up and p repare   investor   M onthly   F actsheets for   I nvestment   F unds.   

 
 Prepare, coordinate and review of European PRIIP (EPT) and European MIFID Templates (EMT)   

 
 Prepare, coordinate and review of European ESG templates (EET) in accordance with SFDR and SFDR 2.0   requirements.   

 
 Prepare/review other re porting   required by   the regulators in Luxembourg (CSSF) ,   Ireland (CBI) and United Kingdom (FCA).   

 
 Follow-up with clients and service providers regarding any issues raised until resolution .   

 
 Collaborate with Promoters of each   ART   client to ensure compliance with UCITS V I,   MIFID, KIID , AIFMD   2.0   and overall corporate governance .   

 
 Keep up to date with new regulations.   Support in inter pretation of new regulations on   how the fund/investors will be affected .   

 
 Actively participate in quarterly, monthly service review meetings   

 
 Assist with any ad hoc queries received from clients .   

 
 Ensure supporting procedures are accurate and kept up to date .   

 

 The ideal candidate will possess:   

 Strong academic background including a MSC in   Accounting /Finance/Economics /IT   or related field;   

 
 Proven in-depth knowledge   of European Regulated In vestment Products, UCITS, AIFMD and Fund regulatory requirements .   

 
 Proven experience in   Regulator y   Reporting, Financial Reporting   or Audit   environment   

 
 Excellent communication, analytic al and critical thinking skills   

 
 Ability to work under own initiative   

 
 Ability multi-task and work under pressure   and to deadlines   

 
 Fluent English (written and spoken).   

 
   

 
 Disclaimer : Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

title: Client Service Executive
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future. 
 At Davy, you are the difference.  
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors. 
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity has opened up for a Client Service Executive to join Davy. In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Provide general administrative support to a team of Directors, Associate Directors and Senior Private Client Advisers.
 Act as the first point of contact to clients; dealing promptly and efficiently with client’s queries.
 Prepare investment presentations and collation of documentation for client meetings; auditing customer relationship management system to ensure records and supporting documents are accurate & compliant in preparation of client meetings.
 Manage follow up activities from client meetings; completion of minutes of meetings and monitoring completion of tasks.
 Update and monitor the CRM system on an ongoing basis; preparing documentation to comply with legislative requirements in data management for our clients
 Facilitate client requests by liaising with internal departments to ensure operational procedures and compliance obligations are met executing tasks; acting as the primary point of contact with all internal departments.
 Manage reporting and operation of tasks in conjunction with other team members; implementing and communicating company practice in carrying out tasks.
 Liaise with Tax Advisers, Solicitors, Brokers and Life Offices on behalf of servicing our clients.
 Assist with administrative tasks involved with planning and preparation of various client events and conferences; provide on-site support and hospitality at such events. Occasional out of office hours.
 Participate in interdepartmental projects to identify best practice to enhance servicing our clients; facilitate deployment and communication of new applications to the team.
 Work with the team on the completion and follow up of Investor Policy Statement.
 Contribute in company campaign workshops.
 Comply with the Risk and Compliance frameworks, policies and procedures associated with the role
 Requirements 
 About you 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills;
 Degree in Business/Finance related area
 A strong and proven administration background with the below qualities
 High level of proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint
 A flexible, positive attitude towards work
 Excellent attention to detail
 An ability to work effectively as part of a team
 A professional telephone manner
 Excellent organisational skills
 An ability to prioritise own workload
 Benefits 
 What we offer 
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.  
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection. 
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most. 
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy. 
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy. 
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.  
 Important Information 
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements. 
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

title: 2027 Risk Consulting Graduate Programme | Sales
description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.
 
 The Risk Consulting Graduate Programme launches in the period June -September 2027 dependant on the availability of the successful candidate. 

 As a Broker in training you will be responsible for building, maintaining and servicing a book of commercial lines insurances in line with our prospecting strategy. You will learn the craft whilst developing strong relationships with clients, teammates and insurers.

 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Apply our sales methodology i.e. the three-meeting process to all aspects of the role, including team selling.
 Source prospects/leads as per team/leadership discussions.
 Analyse prospects/leads needs and current insurance programs and find opportunities to strengthen their insurance programs.
 Liaise and negotiate with insurance companies to ensure the best possible outcome for clients.
 Ensure timely collection of all premiums, in line with our credit terms.
 Upload and update all prospects and secured clients on internal systems,  Microsoft Dynamics, Relay or equivalents.  
 At all times maintain a professional image and provide an excellent service experience to our clients.
 Take personal responsibility for delivering accurate, high-quality, right first-time outputs.
 Provide support to service / marketing teams as required.  
 Actively seek and avail of personal development opportunities, in team projects, teammate mentoring, assisting with large renewals and new business prospects.
 In all aspects of the role ensure compliance with all legal requirements, Central Bank codes and O’Leary Insurances procedures and business ethics.
 Continuously strive to build strong relationships both internally and externally. Attend internal sales, client/prospect and insurer meetings, in person as required. Avail of networking opportunities as they arise.
 ‘Learn your craft’ – via CPD, insurer training, policy wording reviews and stay up to date on Commercial insurance products/rates and general competitor activity in the market.
 Any ad-hoc tasks that may arise.
 
 OUTCOMES 
 What the role has to deliver 
 Agreed financial objectives
 Acquire new profitable business
 Retain existing Commercial lines business
 Build and maintain strong customer relationships
 Maintain files and documentation
 Meet all compliance and regulatory requirements
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Income and new business figures
 Existing business and retention of figures
 Margin, conversion and retention rates
 Credit control and aged debt analysis
 Compliance audits
 SYSTEMS AND CONTROLS Relay
 MS Office 
 MS Dynamics
 Workday
 Insurer quote and bind systems 
 

 SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE / EXPERIENCE Ability to work as part of a team and on own initiative
 Positive attitude towards change
 Sales acumen including professional presentation
 Strong desire to develop and actively seek line manager feedback
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills
 Negotiation skills
 Ability to multitask and prioritise
 Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with all key stakeholders.
 Strong attention to detail
 Problem solving ability.
 Quantitative skills; ability to understand the relationship of numbers.
 Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality
 
 This job description is not meant to be an all inclusive statement of the duties of the position listed above.  Other appropriate duties may be required from time to time. 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We take pride in the diversity of our team and seek diversity in our applicants.

title: Financial Accountant, Insurance
description:
Financial Accountant About Your New Employer Our client is an international insurance group specialising in the design, structuring and distribution of unit-linked life insurance products for high-net-worth individuals and their families.
 With headquarters in Europe and operations across several international markets, the Group is recognised for providing innovative financial solutions and comprehensive professional support to its clients and business partners.
 You will join:
 A passionate and ambitious international team of insurance and finance professionals.
 An innovative organisation operating across multiple European markets.
 A collaborative, multicultural environment where your expertise and ideas are valued.
 About Your New Job As a Qualified Financial Accountant, you will play a key role within the Finance Team in Dublin. You will take ownership of core financial accounting activities and support the CFO and Group Financial Controller across reporting, audit, tax and finance projects.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Owning the monthly financial close process and producing financial accounts for management review.
 Preparing and reviewing monthly reconciliations, with particular responsibility for balance sheet reconciliations and the timely resolution of reconciling items.
 Reviewing balance sheet positions and provisions, challenging assumptions where appropriate and ensuring the completeness and accuracy of financial information.
 Preparing quarterly departmental performance reports for functional heads.
 Preparing annual statutory financial statements in line with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
 Coordinating year-end financial reporting activities and audit deliverables, while liaising with external and internal auditors.
 Supporting cash flow forecasting, liquidity management and effective banking controls.
 Assisting with corporation tax, VAT and other regulatory tax returns, working with external tax advisors to meet local compliance obligations.
 Ensuring finance processes and controls are properly documented, followed and continuously improved.
 Supporting annual budgeting, regulatory reporting and the assessment of changes to accounting standards.
 Researching technical accounting matters and providing guidance to management.
 Contributing to ad-hoc finance projects and providing support to senior finance leadership.
 What Skills You Need A professional accounting qualification from a recognised accounting body, supported by strong academic performance and relevant experience.
 Strong financial accounting, technical accounting and numerical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
 Experience preparing financial accounts, reconciliations, statutory reporting and audit deliverables.
 Strong knowledge of FRS 102 and FRS 103. Knowledge of IFRS 17 would be advantageous.
 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Experience with Power BI would be beneficial.
 The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues from varied nationalities and cultural backgrounds.
 A proactive, self-motivated and resourceful approach, with the confidence to challenge existing processes and solve problems independently.
 What's on Offer A permanent position within an innovative, internationally focused insurance group.
 The opportunity to work across financial accounting, regulatory reporting, tax, audit and continuous improvement projects.
 A collaborative and multicultural working environment with exposure to experienced professionals across the insurance and financial services sectors.
 What's Next Apply now to take the next step in your career with this international insurance group. If this opportunity is not quite right for you but you are looking for a similar role in financial accounting, insurance or financial services, please get in touch.

title: Consultant, Transfer Agency - Investor Experience, Quality & Continuous Improvement  |  Limerick
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 TRANSFORMATION CONSULTANT
 
 Investor Experience, Quality & Continuous Improvement  |  Limerick  |  Hybrid 
 
 ROLE PURPOSE  Drive structured, measurable change that improves operational performance, efficiency and the investor experience, using data, emerging tools and technology to turn opportunities into sustainable outcomes.
 Working Model
 
 Hybrid. We have a balanced hybrid working model to provide flexibility, with the successful candidate spending time between the office and working from home.
 Role / Department 
 The Transformation Consultant will be a key member of the Investor Experience, Quality & Continuous Improvement team. The role will add structure, discipline and momentum to change across Investor Services, taking opportunities from initial insight through assessment, prioritisation, delivery and benefits realisation.
 Working across operational teams and enabling functions, the Consultant will translate business challenges into well-defined change initiatives, establish clear ownership and governance, and use data, emerging tools and approved technology to enhance performance, efficiency, control and experience.
 This is an opportunity for a practical transformation professional who combines strong change delivery capability with curiosity, sound judgement and a focus on measurable impact.
 Key Responsibilities Change Intake, Governance & Prioritisation Co-own and strengthen the Central Change Channel as the structured route for capturing, assessing, prioritising and progressing Investor Services change opportunities.
 Define clear problem statements, scope, desired outcomes, owners, dependencies, risks, resource needs and success measures before initiatives progress.
 Maintain a transparent change portfolio and delivery cadence, enabling informed prioritisation against business strategy, client impact, operational risk, capacity and expected benefit.
 Prepare and facilitate governance forums, clearly communicating decisions, actions, risks, dependencies and escalations.
 Transformation Delivery & Benefits Realisation Lead selected change initiatives from opportunity identification through implementation, operational readiness, adoption and post-implementation review.
 Translate operational pain points, quality insights, complaints, escalations, failures and partner feedback into practical improvement actions.
 Apply appropriate root-cause analysis, process mapping and continuous improvement techniques to address underlying issues rather than symptoms.
 Establish outcome-based measures for each initiative, tracking timeliness, adoption and realised impact on efficiency, quality, risk, client or partner experience.
 Ensure changes are embedded through clear ownership, procedures, controls, training, communications and handover into business-as-usual operations.
 Data, Technology & Innovation Identify and assess opportunities to use approved emerging tools, automation, self-service, AI and platform capabilities to reduce manual effort and improve performance and experience.
 Partner with Technology, Data, Privacy, Risk and operational stakeholders to shape viable solutions and progress required approvals.
 Use operational, quality and knowledge data to identify trends, target interventions and support evidence-based decision-making.
 Promote responsible adoption by ensuring technology-enabled change is designed with appropriate controls, privacy safeguards, user readiness and measurable value.
 Support experimentation and piloting within agreed governance, capturing learning and scaling solutions where benefits are demonstrated.
 Operational Performance, Quality & Risk Use insights from Quality Assurance, Quality Control, sampling, service levels and operational performance to identify and deliver improvement opportunities.
 Challenge existing processes constructively, simplifying activity, removing non-value-added work and strengthening end-to-end accountability.
 Embed a risk-management mindset throughout change delivery, including impact assessment, control design, testing, implementation readiness and issue escalation.
 Maintain and improve relevant procedures, checklists and governance artefacts to support consistency, compliance and sustainable execution.
 Stakeholder Engagement & Change Adoption Build trusted relationships across Investor Services and cross-functional teams, influencing progress without reliance on direct reporting lines.
 Create clear, concise updates for senior stakeholders that explain the problem, proposed action, delivery status, decisions required and measurable impact.
 Act as an advocate for enablement and a champion of change, helping teams understand the purpose of change and their role in successful adoption.
 Share tools, methods and learning that strengthen change capability and encourage teams to identify and act on improvement opportunities.
 Success Measures Success in the role will be evidenced through a balanced set of delivery and outcome measures, including:
 Quality and clarity of opportunities entering the change process.
 Throughput, timeliness and predictability of initiatives progressed through the Central Change Channel.
 Measurable benefits realised across efficiency, productivity, quality, risk, client experience and partner experience.
 Adoption and sustainable embedding of new processes, tools and technology.
 Transparency of reporting, decision-making, ownership, risk and dependencies.
 Stakeholder confidence in the structure, pace and impact of change delivery.
 Skills / Qualifications The successful candidate will benefit from having:
 Proven experience delivering change, transformation, continuous improvement or operational excellence within financial services or another regulated environment.
 Demonstrated ability to move initiatives from insight and problem definition through delivery, adoption and benefits realisation.
 Practical knowledge of change governance, project delivery, process improvement, root-cause analysis and risk management techniques.
 Strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret operational and quality data and translate insight into focused action.
 Experience assessing or implementing workflow, automation, self-service, AI or other technology-enabled improvements.
 An understanding of responsible technology adoption, including privacy, control, risk and operational-readiness considerations.
 Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and communication skills, including the ability to influence across functions and levels.
 Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and maintain delivery discipline.
 A results-oriented, curious and pragmatic approach, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the judgement to escalate appropriately.
 Experience in Investor Services, Transfer Agency, fund administration, quality or client servicing is an advantage.
 Working with Us As a Northern Trust partner, greater achievements await. You will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture in an organization where financial strength and stability embolden us to explore new ideas. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to assisting the communities we serve. Join a workplace with a greater purpose.
 Role Profile at a Glance 
 Primary mandate 
 Turn strategic and operational opportunities into structured, measurable and sustainable change.
 
 Core delivery channel 
 Central Change Channel and associated change governance.
 
 Key outcomes 
 Improved performance, efficiency, quality, control and experience.
 
 Ways of working 
 Data-led, cross-functional, risk-aware, technology-enabled and accountable.
 
 Candidate profile 
 A hands-on transformation professional who can create structure and deliver impact.

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. DAM Business Analyst
Glanbia Enterprise Solutions
Role Overview
The DAM (Digital Asset Management) Business Analyst acts as a key bridge between the Business and IT by translating Business needs into detailed requirements and technology-enabled use cases. They develop a deep understanding of the opportunities, risks, and issues facing the Business, and advise on how technology solutions can be used to achieve / resolve them.
This permanent opportunity reports to the Foundation Tech Product Manager.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Alignment & Business Engagement
Collaborate with the Product Manager to define and execute the DAM strategy aligned with business objectives.
Act as the subject matter expert for the DAM ecosystem, promoting best practices and driving adoption across global teams.
Advise stakeholders on the impact of business process decisions on technology, cost, and complexity to enable informed decision-making.
Requirements Gathering & Backlog Management
Elicit, document, and manage detailed business requirements (features, user stories) and translate them into actionable technology solutions.
Prioritize and manage the product backlog in partnership with the Scrum Master, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
Conduct workshops with business teams to validate requirements and identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.
System Design, Configuration & AI Enablement
Document current and future state processes, identifying areas for improvement and automation.
Configure and maintain multiple workflows within the DAM application to support business needs.
Leverage the DAM applications AI capabilities to automate metadata tagging, asset classification, and other repetitive tasks.
Technical Delivery & Quality Assurance
Support development and testing teams by clarifying requirements and expected system behaviour.
Perform functional testing for new features, integrations, and upgrades to ensure solutions meet business needs.
Governance & Compliance
Ensure data governance standards are applied within DAM, including security and compliance considerations for sensitive assets.
Establish and maintain Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity plans for the DAM ecosystem.
Training & Adoption
Develop user guides and training materials; deliver training sessions for key users and support teams.
Monitor and report on application usage and adoption to ensure ROI realization.
Continuous Improvement
Identify and implement automation opportunities within DAM and related processes.
Support & Escalation
Act as the point of escalation for complex issues raised by the Application Support team.
Provide expert guidance on troubleshooting and resolution.
The skills you will bring to the team
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
Career experience in Food & Beverage or other related industry highly desirable.
Proven experience in eliciting and managing detailed business requirements.
Good business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (e.g., IT, Finance, R&D), and how the opportunities, risks, and issues in these domains can be addressed by technology.
Experience in analysing business challenges using structured frameworks and methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for developing technology-enabled use cases and analysing Business needs.
Experience in modelling system processes; knowledge of common notational standards is beneficial (e.g., BPMN).
Able to design and execute functional tests, with experience managing bugs / defects through to remediation.
Basic knowledge of software engineering, information risk, security standards, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
Hands-on experience in Agile methodologies and practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban) is beneficial.
Good communication skills with an ability to build rapport with a wide range of different Business and IS stakeholders.
Where and how you will work
The opportunity will be based in Vauxhall, London with   hybrid working arrangements available which offer you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance.
What we would like to offer you!
The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package including staff discounts, generous family leave policy, competitive salary.
About Glanbia
Glanbia is a better nutrition company with three divisions: Performance Nutrition, Health & Nutrition and Dairy Nutrition. Collectively and with our partners we offer an incredible breadth of expertise in nutrition. We employ a team of 5800 people, work with global food and beverage companies, and sell our award-winning and market-leading brands and ingredients in more than 100 countries worldwide
At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a variety of candidates, we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
At Glanbia, our culture celebrates individuality, knowing that together we are more.

title: Client Service Executive
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future. 
 At Davy, you are the difference.  
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors. 
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity has opened up for a Client Service Executive to join Davy. In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Provide general administrative support to a team of Directors, Associate Directors and Senior Private Client Advisers.
 Act as the first point of contact to clients; dealing promptly and efficiently with client’s queries.
 Prepare investment presentations and collation of documentation for client meetings; auditing customer relationship management system to ensure records and supporting documents are accurate & compliant in preparation of client meetings.
 Manage follow up activities from client meetings; completion of minutes of meetings and monitoring completion of tasks.
 Update and monitor the CRM system on an ongoing basis; preparing documentation to comply with legislative requirements in data management for our clients
 Facilitate client requests by liaising with internal departments to ensure operational procedures and compliance obligations are met executing tasks; acting as the primary point of contact with all internal departments.
 Manage reporting and operation of tasks in conjunction with other team members; implementing and communicating company practice in carrying out tasks.
 Liaise with Tax Advisers, Solicitors, Brokers and Life Offices on behalf of servicing our clients.
 Assist with administrative tasks involved with planning and preparation of various client events and conferences; provide on-site support and hospitality at such events. Occasional out of office hours.
 Participate in interdepartmental projects to identify best practice to enhance servicing our clients; facilitate deployment and communication of new applications to the team.
 Work with the team on the completion and follow up of Investor Policy Statement.
 Contribute in company campaign workshops.
 Comply with the Risk and Compliance frameworks, policies and procedures associated with the role
 Requirements 
 About you 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills;
 A strong and proven administration background with the below qualities
 High level of proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint
 A flexible, positive attitude towards work
 Excellent attention to detail
 An ability to work effectively as part of a team
 A professional telephone manner
 Excellent organisational skills
 An ability to prioritise own workload
 Degree in Business/Finance related area
 Benefits 
 What we offer 
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.  
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection. 
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most. 
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy. 
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy. 
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.  
 Important Information 
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements. 
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

description:
About us 
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.  
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.  
 But we don’t stop there.  
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.   
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.  
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.  
 Job Overview:  
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join our Enterprise Transformation Team. This role focuses on improving Sales & Marketing operations through process analysis, system configuration, and automation. We value foundations in systems integration or large programme delivery, followed by hands-on BA work inside a product or enterprise setting. This is not a pure admin position; core BA skills are required to analyse problems, design future-state processes, and drive change. 
 You will work with Salesforce, Marketo, Gong, and other tools —partnering with Sales & Marketing, analytics, and digital transformation teams to deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality, and user experience. 
 Key Responsibilities:  
 Analyse, map, and redesign Sales & Marketing processes using lean principles to drive operational efficiency. 
 Identify and implement process improvement opportunities across systems, workflows, and teams. 
 Act as the business lead on system enhancements and new feature implementations across Salesforce, Marketo, Gong and related tools. 
 Gather business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for system configuration or automation. 
 Lead tool rationalisation initiatives, identifying overlaps and proposing streamlined, cost-effective solutions. 
 Collaborate closely with Sales & Marketing, operations, and digital transformation teams to deliver integrated solutions. 
 Facilitate cross-functional workshops to identify pain points and design future-state processes and systems. 
 Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for systems, processes, and standard operating procedures. 
 Lead user training, onboarding, and change management activities to drive adoption and effective usage of tools. 
 Monitor system performance and user feedback to identify enhancement opportunities. 
 Stay current on trends in Sales & Marketing systems, process automation, and CRM innovation, bringing new ideas into the team. 
 Requirements 
 Qualifications:  
 Bachelor's degree in business Information Systems, or related field. 
 Experience working with CRM and marketing related systems (e.g. Marketo, Salesforce and Gong. 
 Proven experience leading or contributing to process improvement or transformation initiatives. 
 Strong understanding of finance processes and their interdependencies with systems. 
 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills. 
 Strong communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma or other process mapping tools/methodologies is a strong plus. 
 Benefits 
 Our promise to you   
 We are striving to become global leaders across all of the categories we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross functionally to accommodate our client’s needs.   
 Collaboration: Working together to achieve our best 
 Outcomes: Drive Success in every engagement  
 Respect: A collective feeling of inclusion and belonging 
 Excellence: Continuously raising the bar 
 
 What's in it for you? 
 
 Health insurance 
 Annual leave plus, 3 company days
 Work From Home set-up allowance
 Exposure to our local wide partner community 
 Opportunity to work with clients and colleagues on a global scale for a world leader in Client Lifecycle Management
 Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work-from-home policy, sports and social committee and much more
 Extensive training programs, through ‘Fenergo University' where you will be certified in all of the Fenergo products 
 Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest tools and technologies harnessing AI
 Defined training and role tracking to allow you to see and assess your own career development and progress

 
 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity

 Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
 
 Recruitment Safety  
 For information on our recruitment process and how to verify communications from Fenergo, please visit our Careers page.

 Stryker are delighted to be hiring talented Software Engineers for our “R&D Graduate Programme” – to begin in September 2027.  
 
 Applications close: Friday 24th October 2026.  
 Please ensure your CV includes your academic results or current trending results (if final results are not yet available). 
 
 The “R&D Graduate Programme” is a 24-month structured graduate development programme in the R&D function. The programme rotates on a 6-month rotating assignment basis in order to learn and develop the basic knowledge and skills in the various engineering areas of expertise. The position rotates on a 6 monthly assignment basis:  
 Design   

 Advanced Operations / Research and Technology Development  

 Advanced Quality Engineering   

 Engineering Services (CAD/Prototype/Test Lab)  

 
 What Are We Looking For?  
 Dedicated achievers : People who thrive in a fast-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations.  

 Curious learners . People who seek out cutting-edge research and information to expand and enhance their ability to develop new ideas into reality.  

 Collaborative partners . People who build and leverage cross-functional relationships to bring together ideas, information, use cases, and industry analyses to develop best practices.  

 
 During each rotational assignment participants will be responsible for: 

 Software: 
 Translating user needs to design inputs/specifications and producing component and sub-system level designs.

 Owning the design, implementation, and testing of software modules, and performing associated software development tasks (configuration management, issue/bug tracking, and risk management).

 Using version control to keep an easily traceable and documented history of development.

 Using standard software methodologies to ensure code is readable, understandable and maintainable.

 Investigation, design, development and implementation of new manufacturing processes and technology.   

 Handover of new processes from development to production.  

 Debugging and correcting design issues using independent judgment.

 Independently balancing design trade-offs while designing a component of the system.

 
 What You Need?  
 Candidates must have already attained or be on course to attain a 2.1 result in a Level 8 or above Software/ Computer Engineering Engineering course or related discipline.  

 Candidates must have/will have attained the above between June 2025 and Sept 2027 .  

 Self-starter with demonstrated efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills, and ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.  

 The individual should enjoy working in a fast paced, dynamic and results orientated team environment.  

 Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively work cross-functionally and with global teams.  

 
 Benefits of Working in Stryker:   

   

 Secure a place on our Graduate Programme and you’ll enjoy a remuneration package that is unsurpassed, including:    

 Permanent Contract .   

 Annual Target Bonus .   

 Share Option Scheme .   

 Pension Scheme .   

 Health Care .   

 E xcellent opportunity for Progression and Development.

Job Description
Job Title: Business Analyst
Function: Technology
Reports to: Senior Project Manager
Location: Dublin
Career Level: P2 – Specialist Professional
_____________________________________________________________________
Ornua is a leading dairy co-operative which sells premium dairy products globally on behalf of its Member Co-operatives, Ireland’s dairy processors and, in turn, Irish dairy farmers.
Ornua has revenues of €3.4 billion and is supported by a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. The Group operates as a commercial organisation across 10 business units, including 12 production facilities located in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
The commercial organisation is responsible for the marketing and sales of Ornua’s consumer brands including Ireland’s most successful food export: Kerrygold. Consumer markets are served by production facilities in Ireland, Germany and the UK and by in-market Sales & Marketing Teams in Asia, Germany, Ireland, MEA, Poland, Spain, rest of Europe and North and Latin America.
It also manages the procurement of Irish and non-Irish dairy products, the sale of dairy ingredients to food manufacturing and foodservice customers globally, and the implementation of de-risking and trading strategies to manage market volatility. These activities are supported by production facilities and in-market teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
WHY THIS ROLE IS VALUABLE:
Working closely with Project Managers, programme teams, business stakeholders and IT, the Business Analyst will play a key role in ensuring business problems, opportunities and desired outcomes are clearly understood before solutions are defined. The role will provide structured business analysis, process and data expertise, and evidence-based insight to shape requirements, support decision-making and ensure projects and enhancements deliver measurable business value.
The successful candidate will bring strong business analysis skills combined with experience working within a PMO, programme or project delivery environment. They will be comfortable working across multiple projects and business functions, challenging existing ways of working and translating complex business needs into clear, practical and value-driven solutions.
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:
1. Business Analysis and Discovery
Work with stakeholders to understand business needs, problems and desired outcomes.
Gather, analyse and validate business requirements through meetings, workshops and interviews.
Support structured problem-solving to understand underlying issues and identify risks, gaps, assumptions and dependencies.
2. Process and Data Requirements
Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for improvement, simplification and automation.
Develop clear current-state and future-state process maps and supporting documentation.
Translate business needs into clear business and functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Identify relevant data, reporting and information requirements to support proposed solutions.
3. Project and Programme Delivery
Provide Business Analysis support across projects and enhancements, working closely with Project Managers, business teams and IT.
Support project discovery, scoping, planning and delivery activities.
Maintain clear documentation of requirements, decisions, risks, issues and dependencies.
Manage competing priorities across assigned projects and workstreams.
4. Insight, Options and Decision Support
Analyse business and project information to identify issues, trends and opportunities for improvement.
Use data and evidence to support problem-solving and decision-making.
Support the assessment of potential process or solution options, considering business needs, risks and operational impact.
Present analysis and findings clearly to support stakeholder decision-making.
5. Stakeholder Engagement and Change Impact
Build effective working relationships across the business and act as a link between business, project and IT teams.
Facilitate meetings and workshops, ensuring requirements, decisions and actions are clearly captured.
Communicate business, process and data requirements clearly and appropriately for different audiences.
Support the assessment of change impacts across people, processes, data, technology and ways of working.
6. Testing, Implementation and Benefits Realisation
Support the development of acceptance criteria, test scenarios and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Work with business and IT teams to validate that solutions meet agreed requirements.
Assist with implementation, process documentation and transition to business-as-usual.
Contribute to post-implementation reviews and assessment of business outcomes and lessons learned.
7. PMO and Business Analysis Capability
Contribute to consistent Business Analysis practices, templates and ways of working across the PMO.
Share knowledge, lessons learned and good practice across projects and programme teams.
Support continuous improvement of PMO and Business Analysis processes and practices.
Undertake other relevant activities in support of PMO priorities and business objectives.
KEY REQUIREMENTS:
5+ years’ relevant Business Analysis experience, ideally within IT-enabled transformation, technology delivery or complex business change environments.
Proven experience supporting complex, cross-functional projects or programmes, working effectively across business, project/programme and IT teams.
Strong capability in business discovery and requirements analysis, including eliciting, analysing, documenting and validating requirements and translating business needs into clear, actionable outcomes.
Strong business process analysis and improvement skills, including process mapping, root cause and gap analysis, and current-state/future-state process design.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, evaluate options and use data and evidence to support recommendations and decision-making.
Excellent stakeholder engagement, facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and levels of seniority and navigate differing or competing requirements.
Good understanding of project delivery and change, including Agile and waterfall methodologies, governance, scope/change control, testing/UAT, implementation and benefits realisation.
Highly organised and comfortable operating across multiple concurrent projects and priorities in a structured PMO or programme environment.
Some travel to other Ornua locations may be required.
Closing Date for applications : 30th October 2026

title: QA/QC Administrator
description:
Winthrop Technologies is a dedicated data centre delivery partner providing turnkey solutions to our clients, headquartered in Dublin and delivering throughout Europe.
 Winthrop specialises in providing turnkey data centre solutions, providing services from design through to construction across the full range of civil, structural, architectural, mechanical and electrical services, as well as commissioning.
 Winthrop has grown to become a leading and trusted company in our sector and is a dedicated Data Centre delivery partner in Europe. We are currently constructing multiple turnkey data centre projects across 7 different European countries, equating to over 430 MW of IT load in flight.
 We are pleased to announce that we are currently seeking a QA/QC Administrator to join our team in Dublin, Ireland. 
 The QA/QC Administrator will provide administrative and coordination support to the Quality Assurance/Quality Control Department and project teams. The role will support the effective implementation and maintenance of project quality systems, document control processes, quality records, inspections, audits and reporting.
 The successful candidate will be highly organised, detail-oriented and comfortable working within a fast-paced construction environment. Strong communication, IT and organisational skills are essential, together with the ability to work collaboratively with project teams and multiple stakeholders.
  
 Responsibilities 
 Provide day-to-day administrative and coordination support to the QA/QC team and project management teams.
 Maintain and process QA/QC records, ensuring documentation is complete, accurate, appropriately filed and readily accessible.
 Assist with the administration and maintenance of project Quality Management Systems.
 Manage and maintain quality documentation, including Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Inspection & Test Records (ITRs), check sheets, quality forms, reports and supporting documentation.
 Assist with document control and revision management of project quality documentation, procedures, plans and manuals.
 Support the preparation, issue, tracking and close-out of quality-related documentation and records.
 Maintain quality registers and trackers, ensuring actions, inspections, observations and outstanding items are monitored and updated.
 Coordinate internal quality action plans, including monitoring completion dates, liaising with action owners and reporting progress.
 Assist with the administration and tracking of Non-Conformances (NCRs), observations, defects and corrective/preventive actions.
 Support the QA/QC team with the preparation of quality reports, dashboards, presentations and project updates.
 Assist with the coordination and administration of internal and external audits.
 Assist with the preparation of audit documentation and tracking of audit findings through to close-out.
 Assist in ensuring project teams are working to current approved procedures, forms and quality documentation.
 Support the implementation and communication of new company quality policies, procedures and processes.
 Support the continuous improvement and modernisation of company QA/QC processes and systems.
 Ensure all QA/QC activities are carried out in accordance with company procedures, project requirements and applicable standards.
 Carry out other duties and responsibilities as required by the QA/QC Manager or Project Management Team.
 Requirements 
 Minimum 3 years' general office, administration or project administration experience , preferably within the construction, engineering or data centre industry.
 Previous experience in a QA/QC, Quality Administration, Document Control or Construction Administration role is desirable.
 Relevant 3rd level qualification is preferable.
 Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook .
 Strong IT skills and confidence working with document management and project management systems.
 Experience with Fexillon, NEXUS and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC/Forma) would be a distinct advantage.
 Experience with document control, revision control and maintaining structured document registers.
 Knowledge of QA/QC processes, quality documentation and construction project requirements is desirable.
 Knowledge/use of VBA and Macros would be highly desirable.
 Excellent organisational and time-management skills with strong attention to detail.
 Benefits 
 Opportunity to work with a market leader in the Data Centre industry.
 Supportive career development and training opportunities.
 Competitive salary package.
 Collaborative and professional team environment.
 Opportunity to work on large-scale, technically complex European data centre projects.
 Strong pipeline of project growth and long-term career opportunities.
 
 Winthrop Technologies Ltd is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Us People Organization Graduate Program
description:
Shape the future of work while building a career that makes a meaningful impact. As a P&O Graduate, you’ll explore how talent, culture, employee experience, and HR operations help people and the business thrive. Build the perspective, relationships, and leadership foundation needed to help shape the future of P&O.
To view the job posting and apply, click here.
Applications close 30 October 2026
The US P&O Graduate Track is a two year rotational program designed to develop future people leaders who can help shape how Novo attracts, develops, engages, and retains talent. Through three rotations, including at least one international experience, graduates gain exposure to areas such as Talent Management, Employee Experience, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, DEI&B, and other people focused disciplines. Each rotation is designed to build organizational perspective, strengthen partnership with the business, and show how P&O enables an engaging employee experience and a high performing organization.
Example of a US P&O Graduate's Journey
A US P&O Graduate will begin in US operations, most likely supporting work, like in Talent Management, to strengthen onboarding, development, succession, and talent programming. From the start, they would help create experiences that enable employees to thrive and build the capabilities our business needs for the future. Their international rotation could focus on Talent Acquisition, workforce planning, or global people priorities, offering insight into how P&O partners across markets and adapts to different organizational needs. In a final rotation, they may join Employee Experience or HR Operations, leading projects that improve how employees connect, perform, and navigate key moments in their careers. Along the way, graduates build a strong P&O network, gain exposure to senior leaders, and see how a career in people leadership can directly support our purpose of improving the lives of patients.
Explore multiple areas of P&O and discover where your strengths and interests align.
Build relationships with HR and business leaders who influence talent, culture, and organizational growth.
Develop a global people perspective through international exposure and partnership across markets.
Receive structured development, mentoring, and learning opportunities that support your growth as a future P&O leader.
Contribute to meaningful initiatives that improve the employee experience and help the business deliver on its priorities.
Accelerate your career in a program designed to prepare you for broad, purpose driven opportunities in P&O.
We are looking for curious, driven, and collaborative individuals who are passionate about people and organizational success. Candidates should have:
A recent Master's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business, or a related field.
Strong academic performance and leadership potential.
International experience through studying, working, or volunteering abroad.
Excellent communication and relationship building skills.
Adaptability, learning agility, and a willingness to step outside their comfort zone.
Fluency in English and a willingness to be globally mobile throughout the program
Given the competitive nature of the programme, we ask that you only apply to one track. We recommend you carefully consider which track you would like to apply for and your motivation for doing so to ensure it is most applicable to your background and interests.
Be yourself and share why Novo is the company you want to work for. What motivates you and why do you think being a graduate could be amazing. We would like to know who YOU are.
No, our corporate language is English, so speaking Danish is definitely not a requirement. There may be local language requirements for some International Operations (IO) tracks.
Yes, as long as you plan to graduate before the start of the Graduate programme. It is also accepted if you have not received your official graduate diploma before starting in the Graduate Programme, as long as you have finished your studies and are just waiting for the official papers.
This position is designed as an entry-level role, and while many graduates join the program directly after their studies, we also consider candidates with up to one year of post-graduate experience.
Previous pharmaceutical work experience is not a requirement to apply for the programme.
For the Global tracks you will be employed by our HQ organisation and most of the positions will start in Denmark, except for Global Tax, where you will commence your rotations in either Denmark, US or in one of our International Operations locations globally.
For the International Operations tracks you will be employed in one of our specified hiring countries for 2027, where you will undertake your first rotation.
Upon successful completion of the programme, you will be offered a position in Novo, therefore full mobility and flexibility is required as the location is not pre-determined.

Job Title: Senior Business Analyst

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support implementation of its Data Strategy by engaging with business and functional areas to identify, analyse and document requirements for internal systems, business processes, data flows, reports and dashboards. The role will the client move towards an authoritative single source of truth, clearer data ownership, improved data quality, reduced duplication, better system integration, stronger governance and more reliable operational, management and stakeholder reporting.
The Business Analyst will engage employees and managers to document current processes, identify related data, clarify ownership and stewardship, and translate improvement opportunities into prioritised requirements for systems, user interfaces, integration’s, reports and dashboards.

Strong ability to engage business users and translate operational needs into clear, structured and testable requirements.
Experience documenting business processes, data flows, user journeys, business rules, system requirements and reporting requirements.
Understanding of data management principles, including ownership, stewardship, quality, metadata, governance, lifecycle management, reporting and information asset management.
Experience supporting data audits, catalogues, information asset registers or similar data discovery activities would be advantageous.
Experience with internal business systems, databases, reporting tools, workflow systems, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Power BI and SQL-based systems.
Ability to bridge operational requirements, data governance and technical delivery for both business and technical stakeholders.
Strong facilitation, interviewing, analytical, documentation and communication skills.
Experience in a public sector, semi-state, local authority, regulatory, maritime, infrastructure or operationally complex environment, and knowledge of change management, benefits realisation, user adoption, training and knowledge transfer, would be desirable.

An opportunity has arisen for a  S/4 HANA Senior Finance Business Analyst  within Glanbia Enterprise Solutions. Procure-to-Pay (P2P): vendor accounting, invoice processing, payments, withholding taxes, approvals integration.

Experience in addressing key business issues with IT solutions

Commercially focused, high levels of enthusiasm and energy.

 Working in a professional and collaborative health policy environment, you will gain practical experience within the External Affairs team at our Red Oak Campus in Dublin. title: Specialist, Supply Chain Operations Associate
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

 The Role 

 BMS External Manufacturing is looking to recruit a 12 month fixed -term Specialist, Supply Chain Operations. This role can based in Dublin or Shannon. 

 Job Function
 Provide a key link in Supply Chain between Customers and Intercompany and third party supply sites and markets. Order processing and invoicing.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities: 

 Manage Operations 
 Liaise with Principal’s Purchasing, Finance Departments and Fiscal Reps to perform Supply Chain Operations activities on their behalf
 Provide a key link in Supply Chain between intercompany and third-party supply sites and markets
 Ensure that customer and supply sites comply with Business and Tolling Rules
 Resolve discrepancies in quantity and timing of market orders
 Receipt and entry of market orders as per business rules
 Receipt and process supplier invoices and follow up on price discrepancies, and payment queries
 Accurate receipt and process Tolling Fee invoices
 Perform all activities in accordance to Good Distribution Procedure
 Issue invoices to markets
 Issue required shipping documents, certify with local Chamber of Commerce and legalise with relevant Embassies as required
 Liaise with Freight Forwarder/ Logistics for outbound shipments and update Freight Tracker/ Register if applicable
 Approval or sign off of Redeployment/ Rework on behalf of Principal
 Co-ordinate Redeployments/ Reworks and ensure that the costs are back-charged to the appropriate party
 Liaise with QC for testing, release and generation of CoAs for API if applicable
 Liaise with QC for QP inspection and release of Drug Products
 
 Manage Information 
 Assist and support Master Data related to customers, contracts and BOMs
 Use reports to monitor and ensure data integrity if applicable
 Receive and forward Customer Complaints as per established procedures
 Follow up and expedite for prompt resolution(s)
 
 Manage Financial Activities/ Compile Financial Reports 
 Perform all SAP transactions in compliant manner
 Meet Finance deadline for month-end and year-end sales reporting
 Provide supporting documentation for Financial Audits as requested
 
 Team work 
 Work with External Manufacturing organisation to support implementation of new supply models
 Assist in any ad hoc functions as required and/ or any tasks assigned by the Line Supervisor or Line Manager the tasks associated with these functions should be specified. The statement is too vague.
 
 Qualifications, Knowledge and Skills Required: 

 Three years’ experience in a Multinational Supply Chain Environment, preferably in an Export department
 Exhibit a strong ability to use computer systems efficiently, workable knowledge of ERP system, ideally SAP
 Supply Chain or Business qualification – Diploma standard
 Knowledge of Supply Chain Operations standards
 Knowledge of order processing and invoicing activities; demonstrate efficiency in Supply Chain administration, accuracy and timeliness of order processing
 Deliver results on time in a pressurised environment while maintaining accuracy and a high level of productivity
 Must be flexible and be able to deal with changing priorities; ability to prioritise, organise and manage multiple tasks to tight deadlines
 Follow through commitments to Customers without detriment to the team or company
 Exhibit strong interpersonal and communication skills when dealing with colleagues and external customers; create and maintain strong working relationships within the BMS organisation and externally with trade customers and suppliers
 Understand BMS Supply Chain, products and markets
 Adapt quickly to the demands of the job and show the ability to learn quickly
 Adhere with all Regulatory/ Finance/ EHS/ Security compliance procedure
 
 Why you should apply 

 You will help patients in their fight against serious diseases
 You will be part of a company that encourages excellence and innovation, respects diversity, develops leaders and values its employees.
 You’ll get a competitive salary and a great benefits package including, but not only, an annual bonus, pension contribution, family health insurance, 27 days of annual leave and life assurance
 
 #LI-Hybrid 

 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities.
