title: Supply Planner
description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid 
 
 Initial 12 Month FTC 
 
 Supply Planner - Limerick 
 Hybrid or Onsite (3 day onsite requirement)
 
 Who we want 
 • Detail-oriented process improvers . Critical thinkers who naturally see opportunities to develop and optimize work processes – finding ways to simplify, standardize and automate.
 • Collaborative partners. People who build and leverage cross-functional relationships to bring together ideas, data and insights to drive continuous improvement in functions.
 • Strategic thinkers . People who enjoy analyzing data or trends for the purposes of planning, forecasting, advising, budgeting, reporting, or sales opportunities.
 
 Role Summary 
 The role will interface with production scheduling, procurement, and customer service to ensure an integrated approach to supply planning within the franchise and take the lead in responding to the demand requirements from the business and ensuring that there is supply plan in place to communicate what needs to be produced and purchased to the manufacturing and supply base within the franchise.
 
 Main Duties & Responsibilities 
 Support the creation of a Master Resource Plan based on the latest demand signal to cover what needs to be produced or purchased as a finished product and to ensure that within the process there is sufficient raw materials and components to support the required supply plan up to a 24-month time horizon

 Support the creation of capacity plans based on the latest demand signal to identify where there are potential bottlenecks or risks to supply and to develop and recommend appropriate proposals to mitigate and to ensure that the plant or 3rd party can meet the future demand. Also identify where there is significant underutilization which could impact the costs of supply.

 Responsibility will be initially scoped to limited number of products /segments of the portfolio and during development phase the individual would be closely monitored and coached into supply planning

 Work under the supervision of the Supply Planning manager in Setting of the correct levels of inventory (safety stocks) within the supply plan by understanding the demand volatility and supply chain lead times

 Tracking of the execution of the supply plan with production scheduling and buying ensuring that the plan is fully operationalized and tracked for performance deviation including mitigation on back orders and pro-active communication of future supply risks.

 Ensuring within the supply plan that products are being phased in and planned correctly as well as ensuring communication and timing of exiting products within the plant or 3rd party. Communicating with the business in regard to the status of the product portfolio from a supply planning perspective.

 Support the Supply Planning Manager in providing effective communication and confirmation back from supply planning to the demand plan in confirming capability to meet the requirements via the daily and weekly execution process but also via a robust monthly executive supply process.

 All Supply Planning system core master-data is maintained to enable focus on real supply issues

 KPIs for the role will be Supply Plan Attainment, Safety Stock Health, Capacity Utilization, Back order and Lead time

 Responsible for root causing performance issues and providing recommendation to Supply Planning Manager /leader on how to mitigate and sustain.

 
 Education & Skills Required 
 Level 8 Degree in Business/Engineering/Supply Chain management

 Minimum of 2 years in either a production, supply or demand planning role where knowledge is demonstrated and experience gained in planning 

 Excellent knowledge of MS Excel

 Strong attention to detail, able to analyze and make sense of large amounts of data that can be presented back to operations.

 Experience in a manufacturing environment would be beneficial

 
   
  
 Ireland Pay Ranges: Ireland : €47,000 - €77,000 EUR Annual
 
   
  
 At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.
  
 If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.

 UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner

 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK 
 Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW

 We are seeking an experienced Data Specialist to support the delivery, enhancement and ongoing development of enterprise data and analytics solutions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines, data models and data warehouse solutions.

Role Review: Financial Accountant
Mason Alexander • July 19, 2019
​What is a Financial Accountant?
The traditional role of a Financial Accountant is to record, summarise and report on the myriad of transactions resulting from business operations over a period of time. Ultimately, these transactions are summarised in the preparation of financial statements, including the balance sheet, income statement and cash flow statement, the records of the company’s financial performance over a specified period. But in reality, the role of a Financial Accountant can be broad and varied depending on the industry in which you work in. A Financial Accountant in an SME can have many different responsibilities to that of a peer in a large company or PLC.
How to secure a Financial Accountant role:
Practice Route
In order to become a Financial Accountant, you can complete a training contract with a recognised training accounting firm. These range from the “Big 4” firms to mid-tier and right down to small, local firms. In Ireland, this typically results in a training contract to complete the exams of Chartered Accountants Ireland and to become an ACA. Training in practice as an ACCA is also widely available though the firms that offer this tend to be smaller in size.
Industry
An alternative option to the practice route is training in Industry. ACCA are the market leaders when it comes to training in industry but Chartered Accountants offer their Flexible Route option which get you the same qualification as going the practice route and there is also CPA. Traditionally you will start as an accounts assistant while studying towards your qualification. You will then graduate to a financial accountant role once your qualifications have been gained. It can sometimes take a little longer to qualified within industry as the opportunity for study leave is limited as you balance fulltime work and study but the opportunity to break down the exams into smaller, more manageable segments is a key benefit of this route.
The experience gained from training in industry will equip you with the hands on skills to confidently transition into a financial accountant role and the steep learning curve of those transitioning from practice to industry is not experienced.
Future career prospects with this experience:
There a few professions that are as global and universally recognised as accountancy, the world is your oyster! Upon gaining experience as a financial accountant there are many opportunities to progress your career. If the finance side is where you see your strengths and attributes flourishing, you can progress to Senior Accountant, Finance Business Partner, Finance Manager, Financial Controller, Director right through to C-Suite (CFO/CEO).
This experience can also allow you to move internally to the commercial side of the business such as business partnering, financial planning and analysis and commercial analyst roles. With this, you will be responsible for providing senior management and executives with analysis and information to make key operational, financial and strategic decisions. These moves allow for more commercial exposure and open up a wider range of potential future roles.
Salary Range
﻿ €45,000 – €60,000 DOE

Hons Bachelor Degree (Level 8) in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, or a related discipline is essential.
Graduated within the past two years or currently in the final year of university.

Desire to learn within a regulated engineering environment.

title: Customer Account Specialist
description:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
           
 Job Description Summary  
 
At Analog Devices, Inc. we know it’s our great people who make us a great company, and our Customer Operations team is no exception. We are a group of positive, hard-working, customer-centric employees who represent our company in a positive light when working on the front line with our customers. Want to join a fun team with smart people who make a difference every day? If so, you’ve found the right organization! 
 
 This entry level role (Customer Account Specialist) partners with the Sales Team adding value to the FSE mission and enhancing the customer experience. The CSS will drive ADI’s go-to-market strategy focused on enabling customer success on ADI’s most strategic accounts. The CAS will proactively manage all aspects of assigned customer's demand stream with ADI. This includes sales support, customer interface, pricing and contracts, sales forecasting, supply and demand optimization, and project management. The CAS will also work with Planning, Manufacturing, Business Units, and the Global Supply Partners to communicate requirements and expectations for assigned accounts. This role is fast paced, exciting, and challenging. The perfect candidate will be professional, agile, and able to make an impact out of the gate.
 
 Additional role specifics: 
 
 The CAS continually monitors revenue, backlog, forecasts, and performance to plan. This person understands customer programs that drive revenue and ensures all backend systems are aligned to support anticipated demand. The CAS collaborates closely with Global Ops, Planning, and the Sales Team on a day-to-day basis and is a point of escalation for both the internal and external customers.
 
 The CAS should function as an advisor to the team adding input to help resolve problems and/or achieve goals. The CAS works pro-actively to be in front of situations and notify appropriate teams ahead of issues as well as providing solutions to problems. The CAS should have excellent presentation skills being able to lead customer meetings via phone, virtually, and in person.
 The CAS manages all pricing needs of the customers providing quotations, managing pricing contracts, and coordinating worldwide. This includes being a focal point for contract negotiations coordinating with the contract center, providing input, and participating in negotiations. The CAS will also manage Forecasting Revenue, Unit Forecasting (CFIT), Split / DAR Management, MSD/PRT+, Sampling, Demand Monitoring (QlikView / Drop off reports, etc.)
 You’ll also have the opportunity to collaborate with internal partners to support ADI’s customer base. Internal partners include: 
 Sales - track new design opportunities and project ramps 

 Business Units - review end customer product life cycles to understand business environments 

 Demand Planning – share and consult on customer forecast data 

 Quality Assurance - coordinate product changes and applications support 

 Social & Environmental Management Teams - align customer requirements with ADI policies 

 Supply Chain Management - analyze and understand supply position at each stage of production 

 Legal - review and negotiate customer supply agreements 

 
 Minimum Qualifications:  
 Service-oriented individual with a four-year Bachelor's degree 

 Highly organized and detail-oriented with outstanding follow-through skills 

 Must have outstanding written and oral communication skills and presentation skills 

 Ability to work collaboratively as well as independently 

 Ability to perform with poise under tight deadlines and shifting priorities, as well as ability to understand independently what those priorities should be 

 Excellent MS Office skills, especially Excel 

 Self-motivated and disciplined, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to execute tasks with minimal supervision 

 Excellent time management capability 

 Strong problem-solving and critical thinking capability 

 Quick learner and willing to take on challenges 

 Potential travel (10%)

 IND1

title: Maintenance Fitter
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

 Abbott Ireland Nutrition Division Cootehill Cavan 
 Abbott Nutrition produces a range of infant formulae in all pack sizes under the brand name “Similac”. To complement the range of “Similac” infant formulae, the facility also manufactures a range of follow-on formulae under the brand name of “Gain”. The essential ingredient is liquid skim-milk and this is combined with carbohydrate, vegetable oils, vitamins and minerals. The product is blended, pasteurised, dried and packaged at the site and once packaged, is distributed to Europe, South East Asia, the Middle East, Latin America and Canada.

 Established in 1975, Abbott Nutrition in Ireland is the largest powder manufacturing facility for the production of infant formulae within the Abbott Corporation worldwide.  Approximately 1,000 dairy farms in Ireland and Northern Ireland supply quality milk to the Cootehill facility which processes 500,000 litres per day. This secure supply together with Ireland’s reputation as a green, clean environment is of significant strategic importance to Abbott Nutrition.

 *Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company. 
  
  
 Primary Function / Goals / Objectives To maintain Plant and Equipment at Optimum performance and provide utilities to Manufacturing Department and General Plant to achieve yearly plan.
 Follow all Health and Safety Rules and Regulations in the plant.
 Report any current or potential hazards to your immediate supervisor/dept. manager immediately.
 The correct Personal Protective Equipment (P.P.E.) must be worn at all times.  Consult the appropriate SOP where required.
 The Fitter is responsible for consulting any SOP’s for any job task he/she may carry out and ensure they fully understand and adhere to the SOP.
 Housekeeping is a critical function of all jobs and the Fitter is expected to ensure all housekeeping activities are observed and carried out appropriately.  It is important that the Fitter is in adherence to the Housekeeping SOP.
 It is important that cGMP is a main priority in any operation carried out in this job function.
 Carry out maintenance and trouble shooting on plant and equipment.
 Carry out installation and commissioning of plant and equipment.
 Use diagnostic tools for condition monitoring of Plant and Equipment.
 Carry out engineering work orders in a timely and safe manner while maintaining adherence to cGMP and full compliance with procedures.
 Complete all work order forms in full.
 Carry out plant preventative maintenance programme as scheduled.
 Fully complete all P.M’s plant forms.
 Follow correct procedure when carrying out hotwork & confined space entry ensuring work permits are fully complete and in compliance with SOP’s.
 When working on equipment ensure the correct lockout – tagout procedure is adhered to.
 Ensure adherence to Working from Heights Code of Practice is followed.
 Develop in-depth working knowledge of all plant equipment.
 Maintain equipment in utilities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations.
 Assist in the development and training of apprentices.
 Perform a detailed hand over of work to colleagues when shift completed.
 This Job function will change where update procedures to cGMP, EHS, Technical / New Equipment, Quality Procedures & SOP’s are made.
 To complete training and review of SOPs on compliancewire.
 To support plant on all business excellence activities.
 Print forms from Teamcenter as required.
 This list of responsibilities may change depending on plant needs and employees are expected to be adaptable and flexible where this need arises.
 
 Major Responsibilities Minimise downtime in production and utility areas.
 To install, inspect, adjust, lubricate, troubleshoot and repair all plant and equipment.  To perform routine PM checks on equipment and maintain plant at optimum performance. 
 Independently creates work plans and is able to complete work with little to no supervision
 Independently carry out low complexity electrical or mechanical works
 Routinely update or create training aids for operators and/or craft
 Routinely update or create PM’s based on analysis of DM’s or other line failures
 Support other areas across plant if additional help is needed
 
 Supervisory/Management Responsibilities Not Applicable
   
 Education Required Have a recognized mechanical apprenticeship.
 Senior or junior trades certificates in mechanical craft.
  
 Knowledge Proven track record or demonstrated ability in mechanical field.
 An ability to read diagrams and troubleshoot equipment.
 Six months on the job experience.
 Ability to work on platforms, scaffolding & ladders.
 Good mental ability to logically follow a line of though for problem solving.
 Basic Computer Skills
  
 Accountability / Scope Incur downtime and inability to produce product.  If they do not adhere to cGMP we could have product recall or in worst situation market recall.  Environmental control problems.
  
 Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:  Abbott in Ireland | Benefits 

 Connect with us at  www.abbott.com or https://www.ie.abbott/ , on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/ , on Facebook at  www.facebook.com/Abbott  and on Twitter @AbbottNews .
      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A/hour In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

 DIVISION: ANSC Nutrition Supply Chain         
 LOCATION: Ireland > Cootehill : Dromore West

 WORK SHIFT: Ie - Chensw44 (Ireland)      
 TRAVEL: No      
 MEDICAL SURVEILLANCE: Yes      
 SIGNIFICANT WORK ACTIVITIES: Not Applicable

description:
As an Account Administrator the purpose of your role is to support the Personal Lines team to generate income, build relationships with existing and potential customers and provide excellent customer service.

This role is the perfect opportunity for someone looking to pursue a career in Insurance.

Location: Based in our Waterford office and is a Full-Time Role.

Responsibilities

Activity Management:

Support the team to achieve its income and sales targets by managing assigned renewal lists and mid-term adjustments.

  • Provide support to the Personal Lines team and clients.

  • Manage renewals paperwork within required timelines.

  • Ensure agreed processes are followed in all matters.

  • Manage aged debt and premium collection.

  • Comply with all management audit requirements.

  • Handle Inbound & outbound calls.

Relationship Management:

  • Deliver the agreed standards of customer service in all your dealings with external and internal customers.

  • Take personal responsibility for delivering the highest level of accuracy and quality in your work.

  • Demonstrate promptness, dependability and commitment in dealing with colleagues and clients.

Customer Service:

  • Deliver the agreed standards of customer service in all your dealings with external and internal customers.

  • Portray a professional image to meet or exceed customer service standards.

  • Take personal responsibility for delivering the highest level of accuracy and quality in your work.

Team Collaboration:

  • Contribute to the team by aiming to meet and exceed monthly/yearly targets.

  • Build good working relationships.

  • Proactively take on different roles according to the needs of the team.

Compliance:

  • Meet all compliance and regulatory requirements applicable to your role.

  • Ensure that all accounts are handled in line with compliance requirements.

  • Administer accounts in line with agreed policies and procedures.

Requirements:

  • Candidate must demonstrate the ability to work in a team environment.

  • Strong communication skills are essential.

  • Possess a positive, can-do attitude with the ability to adapt to and embrace change

  • Attention to detail.

  • Possess the ability to manage deadlines & prioritise workload.

  • The ability to prioritise workloads and adapt to unforeseen events.

  • A good degree of personal organisation and a structured approach to time and resource management.

  • Previous Customer Service Experience is preferable.

Arachas is Ireland’s largest nationwide insurance broker, employing over 700 professionals across 14 offices. We provide a comprehensive range of insurance products and services for both commercial and personal clients, leveraging our extensive relationships and deep market knowledge.

Arachas is committed to innovation, offering unique sector-specific solutions for complex insurance needs while fostering an inclusive workplace. We actively engage in community initiatives, including partnerships with charities and voluntary organisations.

When you join Arachas, you join a team of problem solvers, who collaborate well together and go the extra mile to get the best cover for their customers.

Arachas is part of the Ardonagh Group, one of the world’s largest independent insurance distribution platforms and a top 20 global broker with a combined workforce of 12,000 colleagues and a network spanning 250+ locations in more than 30 countries.

title: Kickstart Your Career Journey with Azets
description:
Skip to main content Kickstart Your Career Journey with Azets
At Azets, we celebrate everyone’s individual story, home lives, hobbies and ambitions and we have a place for them all. We believe that diversity and flexibility is essential to creating a modern, vibrant and successful culture – one where being yourself and doing the best work of your life goes hand in hand.
Kickstart your career journey with Azets
If you're a graduate just starting out, eager to learn, grow, and make an impact, this is the perfect place to begin your journey. We know that launching your career can be both exciting and challenging, but here, you'll be supported every step of the way. You'll gain hands-on experience, develop valuable skills, and be part of a team that values your contributions. You might love numbers, but you will never be just a number.
Hear what our Associates have to say
The Azets Academy
Azets Ireland are excited to announce the launch of our new Azets Academy. As a graduate, the Academy will offer you a state of the art, 3 ½ year training programme to learn, grow and develop. Our graduates have first-hand access to our partners and senior management, backing your ambition on your journey to becoming a fully qualified accountant. The Academy will also offer  international travel , granting you access to develop and network around our different offices across Europe.
Incoming graduates in Azets Ireland work collaboratively in a three and half year programme in our business. Backed by supportive and experienced colleagues, graduates work with our clients from the very beginning, giving them the opportunity to build strong relationships.
For the new graduate, our culture and values permeate through everything we do, ensuring a supportive learning environment as you progress. Our people are key to the firm’s success. We put people first, resulting in a workforce that prides itself on going the extra mile for our clients.
Azets
At Azets people are at the core of what we do, with trainees being the first important building block in our success. We are extremely proud of and value the expertise and technical know-how within our business, but we equally understand the importance of enhancing and sharing this knowledge to continuously develop our future workforce.
With the everchanging economic landscape and advances in technology, there has never been a more exciting time to start a career in accountancy. Whether a school/college leaver, a graduate or simply looking for a career change, why not start your journey here at Azets?
We are committed to offering development opportunities to all of our staff, from Entry Level Trainee through to Senior Partner. As a trainee, all of our roles will provide a professional qualification specific to the business area you will be working in.
The role
As part of your role as an Associate Graduate Trainee, you will be working with as part of a knowledgeable and experienced team to learn everything possible in the world of accounting. You will be supported in your development and will be encouraged to expand your experience as much as possible.
Key Requirements
To get the job that you’ll love you will:
Have the right to work in Ireland from your start date
Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting or related discipline
Be on track to achieve or have already achieved a minimum 2:1 in your undergraduate degree
Azets - Our Development Programme
We have created a first-class training and development programme and, by starting your career at Azets, in addition to the comprehensive on the job training, you will also be given all the support you need to complete a professional qualification, including college and/or study days, mentoring and a designated buddy.
We offer a range of different qualification pathways at Azets which are determined by the role you are applying for.
For us, the personal attributes of each of our employees are what makes us authentic in the marketplace. We look for people who can collaborate with peers and can also bring their own voice to the table. We want people who are dynamic in their approach and respectful of other people’s opinions. We are looking for someone who wants to be more than just a team member, rather someone who wants to join a family of like minded individuals.
Compliance assurance
Reduce risk of errors and penalties with accurate, timely submissions.
Flexible solutions
Whether you are an SME or a large employer, we tailor our services to your workforce and payroll complexity.
We are ready to help
With over 300 colleagues and 4 offices in Dublin, Sandyford, Enniscorthy and Belfast, Azets is part of a team of 9,000 talented, smart people across our international office network. Offering a personal, local approach to supporting Irish businesses, if you’re looking for peace of mind, expert advice and more time, we’re ready to help.

title: 2027 Graduate Instrument Planner - Orthopedics
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
Supply Chain Planning 
 
 Job Sub Function: 
Supply Network Planning 
 
 Job Category: 
Professional 
 
 All Job Posting Locations: 
Cork, Cork, Ireland, Ringaskiddy, Cork, Ireland 
 
 Job Description: 
 
 
 ROLE TITLE: Graduate Instrument Planner
 START DATE: September 2027
 LOCATION: Cork, Ireland
 
 Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes 
 
 DePuy Synthes, Companies of Johnson & Johnson , is the largest, most comprehensive orthopedic and neurological business in the world, built upon the strong legacies of two great companies. 
 
 DePuy Synthes offer an unparalleled breadth and depth of technology, devices, services and programs in the areas of joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports medicine, neurological, cranio-maxillofacial, power tools and biomaterials. 
 
 Our broad array of inspired, innovative and high-quality offerings helps advance the health and well-being of people around the world. 
 DePuy Synthes, who employ over 1000 people in Cork established its manufacturing facility in Cork in 1997 where it manufactures orthopedic knees and hips. In 2014, DePuy Synthes in Cork won the Shingo Prize for Operational Excellence.
 
 
 POSITION SUMMARY: 
 The Graduate Planner within the Instruments Deployment Group is a key supply chain role, we provide a world class service to our Direct and Affiliate Global markets for the Joints Business Group. The team is also responsible for instrument set planning and governance for OUS markets.
 
 
 ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 
 Customer Orders/Requests: 
 Receive and respond to customer orders/requests.

 Will enter orders into the relevant ERP system.

 Research, resolve, and follow through with customer issues/complaints, deal with adverse situations, make effective decisions promptly and inform key partners appropriately.

 Will respond to questions relating to delivery information, credit authorization, pricing, and product specific service-related questions.

 Will liaise with supply partners to obtain and communicate delivery information, sharing information on priorities.

 
 Deliver Effective and Efficient Planning: 
 Ensure planned kit requirements and supplemental order processes are completed accurately and in line with global planning 

 Work with warehouse to manage stock queries, expedite outbound/inbound deliveries and coordinate activity between markets 

 Investigate and root-cause critical supply issues and communicate updates on resolution dates 

 Inventory management in line with agreed GSC targets and processes – taking actions to minimize excess inventory, including managing inventory repatriation, and approving in market returns 

 Drive for continuous improvement to enhance service and implement lean process improvements.

 Coordinate the implementation of New Product Introductions/ Rationalization plans with OUS Markets in line with commercial and project teams.

 
 Market Service Review & Performance Analysis: 
 Represent market supply needs and challenges within the Sales & Operations Planning process.

 Will support ongoing improvements to supply chain efficiency by working closely with markets and monitoring market behaviour with a focus to enhance overall “end customer” service. 

 Proactively manage KPI’s, including OTIF, back-order metrics and ad-hoc process improvement metrics.

 Develop and strengthen team relationships with external and internal customers in accordance with our Instrument Deployment Group, GSC, and Depuy goals and objectives. 

 Initiate & maintain reports and support projects as required.

 Will support the development of Team members through training & coaching

 
 
 EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 
 Essential: 
 Minimum Bachelors degree in   Business, Supply Chain, Logistics  or similar   degree

 Recent Graduate ( 2026  or due to graduate in  2027 )

 Continuous Improvement / Lean Manufacturing systems concept knowledge

 The ability to work well individually and remotely.

 The ability to adapt to change and develop skills to meet these changes.

 High capability with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.)

 Interest in developing skills, abilities, and career.

 Pro-active, can-do attitude. High level of personal initiative, ability to function autonomously and self-confidence.

 Self-starter with ability to create and develop new relationships quickly, and   influence/collaborate   to get to desired results.

 Results Orientation/Sense of Urgency – ability to drive to tight timelines.

 Data mining / reporting skills.

 Exposure to Project Management Methodology would be an advantage

 Interested in Manufacturing processes.

 
 
 
 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
   
  
 The anticipated base pay range for this position is: 
€34,800.00 - €55,775.00  
  
 Benefits: 
 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers. 
  
 *This is for informative purposes only. Amounts and actual benefits may vary by location and are subject to change.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Operating since 1946, Abbott serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products. We employ around 6,000 people across ten sites in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford, and Sligo.
 
 Abbott Diabetes Care Division Donegal 
 The Abbott Diabetes Care division based in Donegal Town manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre system.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company
 
 Overview 
 Reporting to the Operational Excellence Manager, the Learning & Development Specialist will lead and coordinate the site's Learning & Development agenda, supporting the delivery of ADC Donegal's Learning & Development Strategy, workforce capability initiatives, talent development programmes, and Operational Excellence learning activities.
 
 The successful candidate will work closely with Site Leadership, HR, managers and employees across all functions to build a future-ready workforce through structured learning, leadership development, continuous improvement and career development initiatives.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support the execution of the ADC Donegal Learning & Development Strategy, aligning capability-building initiatives with workforce planning, business priorities and the site's 2028 vision.

 Promote a culture of continuous learning through engaging communications, site-wide development initiatives and effective use of AD Connect and other communication channels.

 Manage the end-to-end delivery of learning and development programmes, including planning, stakeholder engagement, communications, certification, reporting and continuous improvement.

 Coordinate and support talent, leadership and early career development programmes to strengthen organisational capability and succession pipelines.

 Lead the coordination and continuous improvement of the Lean Six Sigma Academy, including Yellow Belt, Green Belt and Operational Excellence development programmes.

 Conduct capability assessments and learning needs analyses, partnering with stakeholders to identify development priorities, performance gaps and targeted learning solutions.

 Support the development of capability frameworks, learning pathways and future skills strategies that enable employee growth and organisational effectiveness.

 Build and maintain relationships with training providers, educational institutions and industry partners to enhance workforce development opportunities.

 Coordinate external funding initiatives, including IDA-funded training programmes, ensuring effective administration, compliance, reporting and audit readiness.

 Manage learning systems, programme metrics and evaluation processes, using data and learner feedback to measure effectiveness, demonstrate value and drive continuous improvement.

 
 Education & Experience 
 Third-level qualification in Learning & Development, Human Resources, Business, Organisational Development or a related discipline is desirable.

 Minimum of 6 years' experience working within a Learning & Development, Human Resources, Organisational Development or business environment with a strong Learning & Development focus.

 Experience facilitating workshops, development programmes or training interventions.

 Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management abilities, Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills.

 Ability to manage multiple priorities and programmes simultaneously.

 Experience with Microsoft Forms, SharePoint, Power BI and learning technologies.

_____________________________________________________________________
Ornua is a leading dairy co-operative which sells premium dairy products globally on behalf of its Member Co-operatives, Ireland’s dairy processors and, in turn, Irish dairy farmers.
Ornua has revenues of €3.4 billion and is supported by a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. The Group operates as a commercial organisation across 10 business units, including 12 production facilities located in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
The commercial organisation is responsible for the marketing and sales of Ornua’s consumer brands including Ireland’s most successful food export: Kerrygold. Consumer markets are served by production facilities in Ireland, Germany and the UK and by in-market Sales & Marketing Teams in Asia, Germany, Ireland, MEA, Poland, Spain, rest of Europe and North and Latin America.
It also manages the procurement of Irish and non-Irish dairy products, the sale of dairy ingredients to food manufacturing and foodservice customers globally, and the implementation of de-risking and trading strategies to manage market volatility. These activities are supported by production facilities and in-market teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
WHY THIS ROLE IS VALUABLE
The Commercial Finance Analyst will be based in Dublin, and will report directly to the Finance Manager, Ornua Foods Europe. The ideal candidate for this role would have strong commercial experience and a good understanding of how a P&L works and the key levers that will affect and improve profitability. They would have a proven track record with pricing and optimizing trade expenditure.
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:
Commercial Analyst
Pricing and commercial support
Work closely with Finance manager Foods Europe & team on projects requiring finance support
Enable decision making through evaluation of new business opportunities including new product and market launches
Analyse and advise upon trade investment decisions to help guide the commercial team.
Financial Performance Management
Deliver monthly analysis of results and suggest corrective actions to be taken to deliver EBITA targets.
Prepare periodic (weekly, monthly, quarterly as appropriate) reporting on performance by market, region, product category, customer etc. and provide financial insights
Provide strong balance sheet and working capital management by tracking spend, monitoring Accounts Receivable, highlighting slow moving inventory and tracking accruals and reserves
Perform variance analysis to Budget and provide commercial narrative on causes of variance
Budgeting and Forecasting
Coordinate annual budget process for Foods Europe, delivering a clearly articulated and initiative driven business plan
Lead preparation of detailed quarterly forecast (3+9, 6+6 and 9+3) throughout the year
Lead preparation of 5/6 Year strategic plans
Prepare monthly Flash forecasts
Other
Support for project and other ad hoc task as required
KEY REQUIREMENTS:
Qualified Accountant (CIMA/ACCA/ACA)
Experience operating in a commercial finance role, working closely with non-Finance functions
Demonstratable influencing skills
Ability to oversee and drive change
Good team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Commercial experience with astute well-developed analytical skills
Ornua Core Competencies
Customer Focus: Advocates for the customer, balances customer and business needs, and spots opportunities for growth.
Forward-Looking: Helps others to accept change, implements change, and looks ahead to anticipate change.
Curious: Open to asking questions and willing to learn and continuously improve.
Working Together: Encourages co-operation in own team and supports cross-functional working.

description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 
 Job Category 

Finance 
 Job Details 

 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 
 
 
 About Finance Pathways: 
As part of our continued investment in early-career talent, our Finance Early Graduate Rotation Program develops future leaders in Finance by giving you structured exposure across multiple functional areas, hands-on project experience, and meaningful mentorship. You will be a member of a small cohort, participating in four six-month rotations in key Finance disciplines, working with senior leaders, and helping to shape how this program continues to grow and evolve.

This 23-month programme combines full-time paid employment with academic study, leading to a nationally recognised Higher Certificate in Manufacturing Engineering (Level 6, NFQ) .   

 
 No prior semiconductor or manufacturing experience is required . We welcome applications from school leavers and those seeking a career change.   

   

 What You Will Do   

 Working alongside experienced engineers and technicians, you will:   

 Develop practical technical skills within a high-tech semiconductor manufacturing environment   

 
 Support equipment troubleshooting, maintenance and optimisation activities   

 
 Assist with process improvement and problem-solving initiatives   

 
 Learn about automation, robotics and advanced manufacturing technologies   

 
 Work with engineering documentation, procedures and technical drawings   

 
 Collaborate across manufacturing, engineering, quality and operations teams   

 
 Meet all academic and workplace learning requirements throughout the programme   

 
   

 What You Will Gain   

 Competitive salary throughout the programme

 Hands-on industry experience from day one

 Exposure to advanced manufacturing and automation technologies   

 
 Potential long-term career opportunities at Intel Ireland upon successful completion

 We believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds . This traineeship is open to three distinct groups of applicants:   
 

 🎓 School Leavers

 Relevant QQI/FET Level 5 or Level 6 qualification   

 
 Leaving Certificate Mathematics requirement applies

 Genuine interest in engineering, manufacturing or technology   

 
 Strong problem-solving ability and attention to detail   

 
 Effective communication and teamwork skills   

 
 Positive, proactive attitude with a willingness to learn   

 
 Basic computer literacy

title: Data Analyst
description:
Locations- Dublin, London (Bishopsgate), Munich

 

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Analyst to join our dynamic Underwriting Technical Transformation team within the Health Insurance Line of business. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of driving innovation and data-driven decision-making in underwriting and pricing.

 

As a Data Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our centralized data analytics function, which supports technical areas such as underwriting, pricing, and commercial. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including Data Science, Data Program, Portfolio Monitoring, Pricing and Underwriting, to design, build and implement robust data pipelines in order to deliver actionable insights that enhance business performance and customer outcomes.

 

What you will do

 

  • Support and participate in the build and delivery of a clear roadmap for the creation and modernization of a robust data environment aimed at ensuring commercial and strategic success for the business
  • Technically support the design, construction and maintenance of data for the business
  • Understand and implement database and data engineering concepts and terminology, design principles and elements in order to deliver data and analytics
  • Build and maintain production-grade data pipelines in order to automate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes
  • Coordination of data projects with different levels of complexity depending on existing methods, processes and tools
  • Collaborate and engage with Data Program and Data Science teams to support the creation, maintenance and enhancement of reports, tools, datasets and dashboards to facilitate analysis and ongoing review of KPIs, e.g. leveraging Power BI
  • Understand the data relationships that exist between the business processes and systems. In turn apply this knowledge when interpreting the information requirements from the business
  • Perform in-depth data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for optimization in pricing & underwriting processes.
  • Deliver data outputs into a format for presentation to senior management
  • Gather, interpret, identify gaps and translate business MI and reporting requirements into solutions
  • Manages and coordinates stakeholders and builds a robust communication structure for data-related projects
  • Advises stakeholders and actively clarifies their expectations and requirements
  • Ability to assume responsibility for change, communication, quality and risk management
  • AI Readiness  Work effectively in an environment shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, data, analytics and cloud-based tools, using insights responsibly with our standards of data governance, security and ethical use.

 

What you will need

 

  • Bachelor or above in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Mathematics, Computer Science) from top tier university
  • Proven relevant experience (min. 3 years) in data analysis, preferably within the insurance or healthcare sector.
  • Hands-on experience in writing maintainable and testable production-grade Python in a collaborative approach
  • Strong proficiency with direct exposure to SQL/ SQL optimization, Git version control, CI/CD practices as well as data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI). VBA would be useful
  • Excellent analytical skills (capable of understanding complex data structures, organize and structure data extracts) with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Works with little guidance and direction and performs majority of tasks independently.
  • High attention to detail including a commitment to accuracy of work.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complicated processes and concepts to non-experts and to work effectively with diverse cross-functional stakeholders.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for driving change and innovation through data.

 

Why join us

This is more than just a data analytics role – it’s an opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of health insurance underwriting. You’ll be part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, all while working in a fast-paced and evolving industry.

If you’re ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role where your expertise in data analytics can truly make a difference, we’d love to hear from you!

 

How We Hire 

Allianz Partners does not accept unsolicited CV’s or approaches from agencies. We only work with partners on our approved supplier lists, under contract. Any unsolicited submission will not be considered.

Listings Executive - Banking
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Listings Executive to join our Listings team within the Banking Department of our Dublin office. This is an excellent opportunity for an established listings professional with significant experience advising on debt securities listings and regulatory submissions. The successful candidate will work closely with the Head of Listings, Banking Partners and fee earners across the Structured Finance and DCM team, managing a broad range of Irish and international listing transactions from inception through to admission.
A Senior Listings Executive acts as an approved intermediary with the Central Bank of Ireland ( CBI ) and/or Euronext Dublin ( Euronext ), coordinating the listing process between issuers, arrangers, legal advisers and regulatory authorities. The role requires strong technical knowledge, exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple complex transactions in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the efficient execution of listings while maintaining the highest standards of client service and regulatory compliance.
Main duties and responsibilities
Manage and oversee debt securities listing transactions on Euronext and other applicable exchanges.
Review and annotate prospectuses against the relevant Prospectus Regulation annexes for submission to the CBI.
Review and annotate listing particulars against the applicable Global Exchange Market and Euronext rules.
Coordinate regulatory approval processes and manage transaction timelines through to successful admission to listing and trading.
Review and analyse comments received from the CBI, Euronext and other regulatory bodies and coordinate responses.
Liaise directly with issuers, arrangers, trustees, corporate service providers, legal advisers and regulatory authorities throughout the listing process.
Prepare and review all supporting documentation required for regulatory submissions and final admission applications.
Monitor developments in listing regulations, market practice and applicable regulatory requirements.
Provide guidance and technical support to junior team members and assist with training and onboarding activities.
Contribute to the development and enhancement of internal procedures, templates and best practice processes.
Maintain strong client relationships and consistently deliver a high standard of service across all transactions.
Support business development initiatives and contribute to the continued growth of the Listings practice.
Work closely with the Structured Finance and DCM team, with visibility into structuring, documentation and client strategy that informs and enhances the listings workstream.
Experience and attributes
Minimum 5 years' experience in debt listings, capital markets, legal services or a related regulatory environment.
Strong knowledge of the Prospectus Regulation, Euronext listing requirements and applicable regulatory frameworks.
Proven ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously and deliver against tight deadlines.
Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Commercially minded with a client-focused approach.
Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
Experience mentoring or supporting junior team members would be advantageous.
Preferred skill set (but not required):
Legal background or qualification.
Experience acting on listed debt programmes and debt capital market transactions.
Experience interacting directly with the CBI, Euronext, or other stock exchanges.
What we offer
At A&L Goodbody ( ALG ) we pride ourselves on the high calibre of our employees. We place strong emphasis on career development and enabling our people to excel in their careers. Our work environment is friendly, professional and collaborative. In addition to working with a highly regarded team we offer:
A competitive remuneration package
Access to the firm’s marquee training and development programmes, delivered through the ALG School of Business and Law
Discretionary performance bonus
Pension and health insurance contributions, wellbeing contribution, life assurance, subsidised gym, restaurant and coffee shop.
Hybrid working policy
The Firm
ALG is a leading Irish law firm with five international offices in Dublin, Belfast, London, New York and San Francisco. ALG is a full-service, independent, corporate law firm with over 1,000 employees, and a client base spanning across the strong international and domestic business community in Ireland.
ALG has a reputation for leading the way in continuously developing its service to clients and internally to its business. This is delivered through the use of new processes, ways of working, innovative use of technology and marketing-leading business service teams.
Learn more about us  here  or see a sample of our recent  notable awards .
Accessibility
If you require any accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact us and we will work with you to ensure the best possible candidate experience.
We value a diverse and inclusive workforce and are an equal opportunities employer.

Keyridge ESG Analyst
Location:
Dublin, IE
Company:
Keyridge Asset Management Limited
Full Time  Permanent  position
Hybrid role based in our City Centre offices
What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here  Benefits (life-careers.com)
At Irish Life, our purpose is to help people build better futures. Our company values shape everything we do and underpin our vision of being the driving force behind Ireland’s financial, physical, and mental well-being.
We believe in doing the right thing —acting with integrity and making fair, responsible decisions. We aim high , setting ambitious goals and constantly f ind better ways to innovate and improve. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do , and we are dedicated to understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.  We believe that as a team we work best together , in a supportive, collaborative environment where every idea and contribution is valued.
The Role
Keyridge is seeking an ESG analyst to join its institutionally rated Responsible Investment team. The team develops and implements Keyridge’s responsible investment strategy, supporting all investment teams in integrating ESG factors, undertaking sustainability research and delivering effective stewardship across asset classes and strategies.
The ESG analyst will play a key role in advancing Keyridge’s stewardship activities, sustainability research, data capabilities and regulatory insight.
Key Responsibilities
Stewardship and Proxy Voting
• Oversee stewardship activities and deepen analysis to improve company level voting and engagement decisions.
• Enhance systems and processes to monitor voting and engagement alignment with Keyridge’s proxy voting guidelines and stewardship priorities.
• Produce thematic research to support the design and execution of theme-based stewardship campaigns.
• Develop company level analysis and case studies to inform investment strategies across asset classes.
ESG Research and Analysis
• Assist in the customisation of presentation materials, thought leadership pieces, white papers and original ESG research for clients and internal stakeholders.
• Conduct research on sustainable investing trends, material ESG topics and the latest academic and industry research.
• Prepare background research on ESG topics for position papers, investment proposals, reports and responses to internal and external queries.
• Contribute to the development of Keyridge’s ESG integration methodologies and frameworks.
Regulation and Best Practice
• Keep abreast of responsible investing regulations and market standards (e.g. EU Taxonomy, SFDR, CSRD) and promote best practice across relevant investment teams.
• Support Keyridge’s responses to evolving regulatory requirements and industry initiatives relating to ESG and sustainable investing.
The ideal candidate should have the following knowledge, experience and skills:
• Strong passion and understanding of sustainable and thematic investing.
• Strong analyst skills with ESG research analysis/writing experience.
• High level of communication skills, written and oral.
• Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint & Excel,.
• Knowledge of investment analytical tools such as Bloomberg and FactSet an advantage.
About us
The company reserves the right to draw up a shortlist as part of the selection process.  Where Agency assistance is required the Irish Life Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to Irish Life by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role.
Irish Life is proud to be an Equal Opportunities employer. We have created an environment of inclusion and growth to help people achieve their potential, to ensure they can bring their whole selves to work and to feel valued.  We celebrate diversity of thought and perspective and want all of our employees to feel valued, respected and supported.
We have built a culture that promotes equality and inclusion for all of our current and future employees and strive to ensure that our behaviours, processes and practices are aligned to this culture.
If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process please contact lifecareers@irishlife.ie and we will be delighted to ensure you are fully supported to be your best.
Keyridge Asset Management Limited , trading as Irish Life Investment Managers and trading as Setanta Asset Management, supports Equal Opportunity and is authorised and regulated as an investment firm by the Central Bank of Ireland.

title: Site Portfolio Intern
description:
Location: Waterford, Ireland 
 Start date: January 2027 
 Duration: 6 to 8 months 
 Work Model: full time, onsite 
 
   
 About the job 
 As a Site Portfolio Intern , you will join the Site Portfolio team and support the coordination and delivery of projects across manufacturing and supply operations. You will gain hands-on experience in project planning, reporting, stakeholder engagement, and portfolio management while working alongside experienced Project Managers and Portfolio Leads. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to develop practical project management skills within a fast-paced pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 
   
 About Sanofi   
 We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. 
   
 Main responsibilities: 
 Support the coordination of project activities and collaborate with team members to track progress against key milestones.
 Assist with maintaining project schedules, budgets, and project management tools to ensure accurate and up-to-date project information.
 Help monitor project risks, actions, and changes, ensuring documentation is maintained and follow-up activities are tracked.
 Support the preparation of project reports, dashboards, and presentations for stakeholders and governance meetings.
 Assist with maintaining project documentation and ensuring information is organized and readily available.
 Coordinate meetings, record actions, and help facilitate communication across project teams and business functions.
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support the Portfolio Management team with day-to-day project activities.
   
 About you  
 To excel in this role you will need: 
 To be studying towards a Bachelor's or Master's degree and returning to your studies after the internship. 
 A basic understanding of project management principles gained through academic studies or project work. 
 Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail. 
 Ability to analyze information and present data clearly. 
 Good written and verbal communication skills. 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. 
 Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team. 
   
   
 Why choose us? 
 Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you. 
 Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare. 
 Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve. 
 Explore more with personalized development plans, short-term gigs, and internal mobility across functions and countries. 
 Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives. 
 Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being. 
 Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
   
 We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications. 
   
 #LI-EUR #LI-Onsite
 
 
 Pursue progress , discover extraordinary Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.
 
 At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ability or gender identity.
 
 Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com !

Actuary - Actuarial Reporting
Location:
Dublin, IE
Company:
Canada Life Group Services
Description:
Full Time  Permanent  Contract position
Hybrid role based in our City Centre offices
What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here Benefits ( life-careers.com )
Role Overview
After a very successful period of growth over recent years CL Re has developed a significant and diverse portfolio of reinsurance transactions. The Actuarial Reporting team is responsible for delivering the Dublin actuarial reporting outputs, including actuarial liabilities, earnings analysis, capital and ALM reporting, business planning and financial condition testing.
A bright, talented and motivated actuary is sought to fill a role on the Actuarial Reporting - Transaction Reporting team. This role would suit a curious, ambitious, and innovative actuary who:
Is keen to work in a fast paced and dynamic environment.
Relishes the opportunity to work with complex and bespoke reinsurance transactions and the associated actuarial methodologies.
Enjoys working closely with a variety of stakeholders across the Actuarial, Finance, Operations, and Business Development functions.
Specific responsibilities will include
The breadth and depth of responsibility of the role will be tailored to suit the skills and experience of the successful candidate who will:
Produce the financial and capital reporting deliverables for CL Re’s significant portfolio of transactions. This includes:
The quarterly liabilities, earnings, and capital reporting deliverables.
The annual business plan and the annual Financial Condition Testing (FCT) of that business plan.
Work closely with the wider Dublin functions (Business Development, Operations, Finance) to implement new transactions and to ultimately deliver high standard reporting output.
Analyse transaction performance to provide a detailed breakdown of the liability movements, earnings and capital impacts arising from experience and share key insights with the Business.
Draft accurate, clear, and concise documentation and effectively communicate key insights and results to all stakeholders.
Assist in the design and implementation of improvements to transaction reporting models and processes (including governance and controls) to optimise existing reporting, accelerate reporting timelines and enhance the controls environment.
Support the design, development, planning and implementation of relevant CL Re projects, Lifeco Group projects and various strategic initiatives.
Keep up to date with emerging experience and best practice through engagement with colleagues across Lifeco, the relevant professional bodies and individual research.
What you will need to be successful in the role
The ideal candidate will have:
Completed the actuarial examinations with at least three years relevant experience in either a life insurance or life reinsurance environment.
Some experience of financial reporting, cash flow modelling or data management.
Proficiency in the use of MS Excel, MS Word and ideally MS PowerPoint.
Experience working with actuarial modelling (e.g., Excel, Prophet).
An enthusiastic approach to work with a strong work ethic, a keen appetite to learn and develop and a willingness to work to a flexible schedule.
An assertive and self-motivated personality with the capacity to work autonomously, as part of a team and across teams.
An ability to plan work, manage time effectively and deal with changing requirements to ensure timely completion of all deliverables.
The capacity to effectively and efficiently to solve problems and make decisions to ensure successful completion of deliverables.
Well-developed verbal and written communication skills.
About us
Canada Life Reinsurance (CL Re) is a division of Great-West Lifeco Inc. (Lifeco) and a leading provider of client focused reinsurance solutions in the United States, Europe and Asia. CL Re offers a range of innovative risk and capital management solutions covering mortality, longevity, health, lapse, investment, non-life and P&C risk for insurers, reinsurers, and pension funds. CL Re is continuing to expand the solutions it offers to new and existing clients in many global markets.
CL Re has offices in Dublin, Toronto, Philadelphia, Bermuda, Barbados, and Regina. The Dublin office is the base for CL Re’s European and Asian operations as well as the Irish reinsurance entity, Canada Life Re Ireland dac (CLReI). It comprises approximately 180 reinsurance professionals, including 120 actuaries and trainee actuaries. It is a proactive, inspiring, and friendly environment where talent and hard work are recognised and rewarded.
Lifeco is a Canadian headquarter, international financial services holding company with interests in life insurance, health insurance, retirement and investment services, asset management, and reinsurance businesses. Lifeco and its companies have approximately 33,000 employees, $3.3 trillion in consolidated assets under administration and a capital ratio (LICAT) of 128% (as at 31/12/2025).
As a Company we are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where employees can thrive and reach their full potential.
The company reserves the right to draw up a shortlist as part of the selection process.  Where Agency assistance is required the Canada Life Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to Canada Life Reinsurance by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role.
Canada Life Group Services is proud to be an Equal Opportunities employer. We have created an environment of inclusion and growth to help people achieve their potential, to ensure they can bring their whole selves to work and to feel valued. We celebrate diversity of thought and perspective and want all of our employees to feel valued, respected and supported.  We have built a culture that promotes equality and inclusion for all of our current and future employees and strive to ensure that our behaviours, processes and practices are aligned to this culture.
If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process please contact Lifecareers@irishlife.ie and we will be delighted to ensure you are fully supported to be your best.
CLGS supports Equal Opportunity and is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland.

title: Fast Track To Consulting
description:
Skip to content
Fast Track To Consulting
Kick-start your finance consulting career through Capgemini’s Fast Track To Consulting program
Are you looking to embark on an exciting journey of dynamic and challenging projects? Would you like to help craft innovative solutions that drive business success for the world’s largest companies? Do you want to elevate your career through a continuous journey of personal and professional development? Then Capgemini’s Fast Track to Consulting (FTTC) program might be for you.
Make it real
Discover our Fast Track to Consulting program
About the program
Our FTTC program functions as your entry point into the dynamic world of Finance and Accounting (F&A), giving you practical consulting experience that has a real impact for individuals, businesses, and wider society.
As a member of our Intelligent Finance and Accounting (IFAO) team, the FTTC program will enable you to gain transferable skills that will help you to grow into an experienced junior IFAO consultant in just 12 months.
The program also gives you the chance to fuel your own growth through a continuous journey of personal and professional development, empowering you to take on diverse roles and engage with clients according to your preferences and strengths.
It does this through providing ongoing coaching and regular reviews from a dedicated buddy, mentor, and manager who support and guide you through the dynamic and diverse environment of Capgemini’s business world. This will ensure you continue to elevate your career and further enrich your experience at Capgemini long after the program has ended.
Registration opening soon
How it works
Capgemini’s FTTC program gives you the opportunity to work with the very best people and technology on the market, enabling you to rotate across multiple projects, roles, and clients, and giving you exposure to diverse disciplines, including:
Consulting
Project management
Technology consulting
Change management
Transition management
Together our IFAO team members will help you improve your skills in areas such as:
Research and analytics
Processes optimization and continues improvement
Project and team management
Tools and platforms implementation
Solution shaping
Problem-solving
Project tracking
Latest market trends awareness including technology (AI, agentic AI)
Process modeling
Presentation preparation and content management
Business analytics
Commercial awareness
What our graduates say
Here is what past FTTC graduates have to say about how our program
“For me, the program created space to make real use of my strengths while trying myself in different types of work, from project management to technical business analysis. It showed me where I add the most value and how my skills carry across consulting work.” – Zuzanna Piwowarczyk
“The program is a fantastic start to a career in consulting. It provides a wide range of foundations to multiple concepts, a clear learning and development structure, and a great network of colleagues. There is plenty of room for specialisation and a clear progression path both during in after the program.” – Joshua Stephens
“The program has helped me enhance my communication, presentation, project management, and time management skills, while continuously pushing me to stay up to date with emerging technologies. It has also encouraged me to step outside my comfort zone, understand my capabilities, and adapt to the ever-changing consulting landscape.” – Marjorie Santiago
Who we are looking for
We invite you to apply if you:
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with the capacity to understand, interpret, and translate data into clear insights.
A strong interest in finance transformation and digital solutions, with the motivation to contribute to business process improvements.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence to speak up, ask the right questions, and clearly articulate ideas to both clients and internal stakeholders.
Exceptional organisational skills, the capacity to work autonomously and an ability to understand a client’s requests and business requirements.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build the close, trusting relationships that are key to delivering the seamless and efficient transitions that Clients expect from Capgemini.
Proactive attitude and behaviour that result in outstanding delivery and quality.
Very good practical knowledge and skills of MS Office package (Power Point, Excel, Word).
Experience / proficiency in building / formatting presentations.
Very good English both spoken and written. Additional languages would be a plus.
Critical thinking and problem-solving mindset with effective decision-making skills
Appreciation of cross-functional and cross-border collaboration
Strong commercial awareness, with an interest in understanding business drivers and client value.
Adaptable and resilient/flexible to change
Openness to global travel and variable working hours, as required by project needsst
How you can apply
The application procedure is as follows:
1- Submit your application
2- If retained, you will be invited for a phone interview with our recruitment team.
Please note : You may also be asked to provide a short video answering three simple questions related to the role you are applying for * .
3- You will then be invited to an assessment center which will include:
An online group task
