title: Electrical Engineering Co-Op Student
description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite 
 
 Who we want: 
 Dedicated Achievers. Relentless about quality, people who thrive in a fast-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations
 Motivated product launchers. Engineers who bring strategic direction and drive for execution to ensure products are developed and launched with precision
 Goal-oriented developers. Keeping the customer and requirements squarely in focus, people who deliver safe and robust solutions.
 User-focused creators . People who imagine with the user in mind, developing technology that helps change patients’ lives.
 Curious learners . People who seek out cutting-edge research and information to expand and enhance their ability to develop new ideas into reality.
 
 What you will do: 
 
 As an R&D Co-Op Student, you will perform a wide variety of technical work in planning and design of medical devices for Orthopedic Surgeons to allow them to plan and perform their procedures.  This role will support the R&D New Product Development Teams as they bring new medical devices products to market. 
 
 Technical Competencies:   Under supervision, you will assist in the following areas to support the design, development, and verification of electrical components for medical devices: 
 
 Schematic, Netlist, Layout Generation & Review: Assist in developing and reviewing electrical schematics, generating netlists, and performing layout reviews. 

 BOM Management: Support the generation, scrubbing, and review of Bills of Materials (BOM). 

 Prototype Design & Evaluation: Contribute to designing prototypes and evaluating their performance through systematic testing.

 Bench Testing: Perform hands-on bench testing to verify electrical designs and assess device performance.

 Electrical Stack-Ups: Participate in stack-up analysis, including:

 Component de-rating analysis 

 Worst case/Monte Carlo analysis 

 LTspice simulations 

 Design for Excellence (DFX): Assist in Design for Manufacturing (DFMA), Design for Fabrication (DFF), and Design for Testability (DFT) reviews.

 
    Additional Responsibilities :
 Support problem-solving and root cause analysis to identify and evaluate potential solutions against defined requirements.

 Conduct research and studies to support innovative product design..

 
 
   Business Responsibilities: 
 Understand the product’s intended use and clinical procedures. 

 
 Med Device Compliance: 
 Learn fundamental industry standards, design requirements and test strategies which align with regulatory requirements.

 With supervision, create or refine engineering documentation, such as the Design History file per company design control procedures.

 Learn R&D procedures like design controls and risk management, per the Quality Management System.

 
 General Responsibilities: 
 With supervision, work with R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing and Project Management to ensure project success.

 Learn procedures, policies, processes, systems, and technology required.

 Work on problems in limited scope; purposefully learn while gaining experience.

 Demonstrate ownership and integrity of work .

 Build stable relationships. 

 Contribute to the project as a team member.

 
 Educational Requirements 
 Studying / completed a Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Electrical, Electronic Engineering, or related discipline. 

 
 Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles, including circuit design and analysis.

 Familiarity with electrical design tools and practices within a structured or regulated environment (e.g., team projects, internships, coursework).

 
 Design Tools: 
 Exposure to eCAD tools for schematic capture and basic layout design (e.g. , Altium Designer or similar tools). 

 Awareness of circuit simulation tools (e.g., LTspice, Multisim) through coursework or personal projects.

 
 Analysis Skills: 
 Ability to perform basic analysis tasks, including:

 Understanding of tolerances and their impact on design. 

 Simple statistical methods for data evaluation. 

 
 Manufacturing & Materials: 
 Introductory knowledge of PCB design and manufacturing processes (e.g., stack-ups, component selection).

 Awareness of Design for Excellence (DFX) concepts (basic understanding is sufficient).

 
 Documentation: 
 Ability to interpret basic electrical drawings and schematics. 

 Exposure to preparing or understanding engineering reports and documentation through class assignments or internships.

 
 Preferred Skills / Engineering Tools: 
 Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for documentation and analysis.

 Familiarity with eCAD tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or similar tools used in coursework).

 Exposure to bench-testing equipment (e.g., multimeters, oscilloscopes) during labs or projects.

 Willingness to learn PCB/PCBA print generation and review processes.

 What we can offer: 
 Attractive salary & vacation entitlement

 Experience our inclusive, people-first culture . You will be paired with mentors and have access to leaders who support your growth, give constructive feedback, and help build confidence. 

 Flexible working hours

 Sports & Social clubs and DE&I Employee Resource Groups and the opportunity to connect with other co-ops 

 The opportunity to contribute to real-world projects that make a difference in improving healthcare and patients’ lives. In Stryker, you will be given responsibilities that truly matter.

 
 Next steps: 
 Once you have applied to one of our co-op opportunities, our dedicated University Recruiting Business Partners will take some time to look through your application and ensure you meet the criteria in relation to the specific position.

 Should all requirements be met, and you are happy to proceed, in September, successful candidates will be invited to a final round business interview with the hiring team.

 If successful through the final round business interview, you will receive your offer shortly after

 Please note, individual recruitment timelines may vary – please keep in contact with your University Recruiting Business Partner and your university placement coordinator for specific timelines and updates.

   
  
 Ireland Pay Ranges: 
 Ireland : €30,000 EUR Annual
 
   
  
 If you’d like to learn more about the compensation associated with this opportunity, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.
  
   
Travel Percentage: None

description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Finance 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 Role Description: 
We are looking for a dynamic, proactive Tax Analyst to join our in-house EMEA tax team that is responsible for all
direct tax matters in the EMEA region. The Tax Analyst will report to the Senior EMEA Direct Tax Manager and will
be based in Dublin, Ireland.

 Department Description: 
EMEA Tax team is based in Dublin, Ireland and is led by the VP of EMEA. EMEA Tax team works closely with the
wider tax team based in San Francisco and Hyderabad as well as with internal teams based in EMEA.

 Your Impact: 
The focus of this position is to ensure direct tax compliance across the EMEA territories in which the company
operates, to assist in tax planning initiatives and to work with EMEA business teams in achieving their goals while
managing tax risk for the group.

The Tax Analyst will be specifically responsible for ensuring accurate and timely
submission of tax returns and payments, calculations of periodic tax provisions and assisting in areas such as tax
audits, acquisition integrations and transfer pricing. The individual will drive trust, efficiency and the
communication of information within the EMEA Tax team, as well as to the Controllership organization and
business partners in order to facilitate collaboration.

The successful candidate will have previous experience in tax compliance and business partnership/collaboration.
They will be a self-starter, flexible and able to adapt to a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 Tax compliance / Tax Reporting: 
● Assist the Senior EMEA Tax Manager and broader tax team in meeting tax compliance deadlines for
payments and assisting in preparing and reviewing tax return work-papers and tax returns.
● Assist the EMEA and US tax team in the preparation of quarterly and yearly tax reporting under US-GAAP
(FAS109), including true-ups;
● Review of EMEA quarterly and year-end tax packages and FIN48 positions;
● Develop professional relationships with personnel in the Controllership organization and the global tax
team;
● Liaise with external advisors;

 Transfer Pricing: 
● Assist the Senior EMEA Tax Manager and US based Transfer Pricing group in analyzing transactions and

 Job Description: 
 
 ROLE TITLE: Graduate Process Engineer
 START DATE: September 2027
 LOCATION: Cork, Ireland
 
 Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes
 
 DePuy Synthes, Companies of Johnson & Johnson , is the largest, most comprehensive orthopedic and neurological business in the world, built upon the strong legacies of two great companies. 
 
 DePuy Synthes offer an unparalleled breadth and depth of technology, devices, services and programs in the areas of joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports medicine, neurological, cranio-maxillofacial, power tools and biomaterials. 
 
 Our broad array of inspired, innovative and high-quality offerings helps advance the health and well-being of people around the world. 
 DePuy Synthes, who employ over 1000 people in Cork established its manufacturing facility in Cork in 1997 where it manufactures orthopedic knees and hips. In 2014, DePuy Synthes in Cork won the Shingo Prize for Operational Excellence.
 
 Job Purpose: 
 We are seeking a motivated Graduate Process Engineer with a strong interest in materials engineering and advanced manufacturing. The successful candidate will join the Process Engineering team and develop technical expertise in Foundry Manufacturing, including investment casting. 
 
 Working alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional partners, you will support day-to-day manufacturing, process improvement, technical investigations, validation activities and the introduction of new materials, equipment and technologies in a regulated medical device environment. 
 
 
 Key Responsibilities Process Support & Continuous Improvement Support day-to-day manufacturing by monitoring process performance, reviewing data and assisting with the resolution of technical issues. 

 Participate in investigations relating to process variation, scrap, yield loss, rework, deviations and non-conformances. 

 Use structured problem-solving methods and hands-on process observation to help identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions. 

 Support Lean, process excellence and continuous improvement projects focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost and process capability. 

 Help create and maintain process documentation, work instructions, technical reports, response plans and training materials. 

 ​ 
 Materials Engineering & Process Development 
 
 Practical experience across the following manufacturing pathways: 
 
 Foundry / Investment Casting 
 Wax pattern manufacture and assembly 

 Ceramic shell preparation and environmental control 

 Metal melting, pouring and solidification 

 Casting finishing and porous coating interfaces 

 Metallurgical defect analysis and non-destructive inspection 

 
 Technical Analysis, Validation & Collaboration 
 Collect, analyse and interpret manufacturing, material and quality data using appropriate statistical tools.

 Support process characterisation, capability studies, control charting and Design of Experiments under guidance.

 Assist with equipment qualification, process validation, material evaluation and implementation of approved process changes.

 Contribute technical evidence to non-conformance investigations, corrective and preventive actions, risk assessments and audit actions.

 Work closely with Operations, Quality, Validation, Asset Reliability, Project Engineering, Manufacturing Innovation and supplier teams.

 Communicate findings clearly through technical reports, presentations and cross-functional project updates.

 
 What We Offer Structured graduate development with mentoring and support from experienced engineers and technical specialists.

 Hands-on experience in advanced metallic manufacturing within a highly regulated, patient-focused environment.

 Exposure to Materials Engineering, Foundry and Additive Manufacturing disciplines.

 Opportunities to contribute to real process improvement, validation and technology development projects.

 Professional development and career progression within a global medical device organisation.

 
 
 Qualifications Essential 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Metallurgical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

 Recent graduate ( 2026   or due to graduate in   2027 )

 Strong academic foundation and interest in materials behaviour, metallurgy, manufacturing processes or advanced manufacturing technologies. 

 Analytical and structured problem-solving capability.

 Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work well in a team.

 Curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn in a hands-on manufacturing environment.

 Desirable 
 Relevant internship, placement, laboratory, research or final-year project experience in engineering or manufacturing.

 Exposure to metallurgy, casting, metal additive manufacturing, heat treatment, materials characterisation or failure analysis.

 Experience with data analysis, statistical software, Design of Experiments or process capability tools.

 Awareness of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement or regulated manufacturing principles.

 Skills & Capabilities 
 Ability to connect engineering fundamentals with practical observations on the manufacturing floor.

 An evidence-based approach to analysing data, identifying trends and supporting decisions.

 Interest in the relationship between material properties, manufacturing parameters and product performance.

 Organised approach to documentation, task management and follow-through.

 Ability to collaborate effectively and seek guidance while progressively building technical independence.

 Commitment to safety, quality, compliance and patient-focused manufacturing.

€34,800.00 - €55,775.00

 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. About the role
We are looking for a skilled and motivated individual to join our Portfolio Management Office (PMO), supporting construction and property-related programmes. This role will focus on aligning existing governance frameworks, templates and processes with portfolio reporting requirements, ensuring that project and programme information can be reported consistently, accurately and at the right level. The successful candidate will act as a close link between PMO, finance and delivery teams, helping to strengthen financial processes, improve forecast and cost reporting discipline, and support better financial control across the portfolio. The role requires strong analytical capability, confidence working with project data and a practical understanding of governance, reporting and financial control in a delivery environment.
What you’ll be doing
Governance Alignment & Portfolio Reporting
Review and align existing PMO governance frameworks, reporting templates and processes to meet portfolio-level reporting requirements.
Support the development of consistent standards for project and programme data, ensuring information can be consolidated and reported clearly at portfolio level.
Financial Control & Process Improvement
Work closely with finance and delivery teams to strengthen cost reporting, forecasting, accruals, purchase order and financial governance processes.
Identify opportunities to improve financial controls, data quality and process discipline, helping teams understand and apply standard ways of working.
Reporting & Analytics
Support the preparation, assurance and improvement of portfolio reports, dashboards and packs, using consistent data definitions and reporting standards.
Use Excel, Power BI and other Microsoft tools to analyse project, programme and financial data, highlighting trends, risks, exceptions and areas requiring action.
Resource & Financial Management
Support portfolio-level budget tracking, forecasting, accruals and cost reporting activities by helping ensure data is complete, timely and aligned to agreed processes.
Build strong working relationships with finance, commercial and delivery colleagues to improve shared understanding of financial processes and controls.
Stakeholder Engagement
Coordinate communication between project teams, programme sponsors, finance and supply chain partners.
Facilitate meetings, workshops, and governance reviews.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to enhance PMO processes and tools.
Support training and onboarding for project managers and team members.
Risk & Issue Management
Monitor project and programme risks and issues, ensuring timely escalation and resolution.
Essential Skills / Experience
Experience working in a PMO, project controls, project reporting, finance support or business operations environment.
Understanding of project management methodologies, governance frameworks or portfolio management approaches.
Power BI experience, including dashboard use, reporting outputs or supporting report development.
Strong understanding of governance, reporting, financial control and process management in a project or programme delivery environment.
Solid understanding of Microsoft Office, with strong Excel skills and confidence working with data, reports, trackers and dashboards.
High attention to detail and a proactive, process-oriented mindset.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent organisational, analytical, and communication skills.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Commercial or cost control experience, particularly in a construction, property, infrastructure or project delivery environment.
Knowledge of Power Automate, SharePoint Lists, Power Apps or other workflow automation tools.
Experience supporting process improvement, data quality or reporting maturity initiatives.
Relevant certifications (e.g., APM, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are desirable.

title: Network Dev Engineer II, ONE Access Engineering (LAN)
description:
The OpsTech Networking Core team builds and operates the LAN infrastructure that powers Amazon's global fulfillment centers, transportation sites, and grocery operations. The team manages campus network architecture, LAN switching, network segmentation, and large-scale network automation across thousands of sites worldwide, supporting hundreds of thousands of LAN devices at massive scale.

We are seeking a Network Development Engineer II to design and implement next-generation LAN architecture. You will work on initiatives that improve network reliability through self-healing automation that detects and remediates LAN infrastructure incidents autonomously, eliminate proprietary switching dependencies to enable maintenance-free operations, and modernize network designs by replacing legacy vendor-locked architectures with scalable, vendor-agnostic solutions using commodity hardware and open protocols. Your work will directly impact network uptime, operational efficiency, and the ability to launch and support new sites across Amazon's global operations.

Key job responsibilities
As an NDE II on the Core team, you will solve complex technical problems involving enterprise LAN switching and routing, campus network design, network segmentation architecture, and large-scale configuration automation. You will design solutions that are scalable, testable, maintainable, and efficient. You will work with technologies including EVPN, LISP, BGP, OSPF, VRF segmentation, and commodity networking hardware running Software Defined Infrastructure. Information security and network reliability are fundamental to your approach. You will work autonomously on major portions of LAN technology implementation, applying best practices while making pragmatic trade-offs that consider both short-term operational needs and long-term business requirements.

A day in the life
You will operate the largest fulfillment network in the world, working with technologies including enterprise switching platforms, overlay network protocols, zone-based network segmentation, industrial networking for robotics and material handling equipment, and large-scale configuration orchestration across hundreds of thousands of devices. You will leverage AI and ML-powered tools to enhance network operations, including automated incident detection and remediation, pattern recognition for proactive fault management, and agentic AWS AI tools for diagnostics and operational efficiency. You will collaborate with customers and stakeholders to develop project ideas into project plans, participate actively in design reviews and operational reviews, and mentor team members. Network reliability is essential to Amazon Operations, and your responsibilities include driving root cause resolution of network events most impactful to the business.
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application, or experience from a technical internship
- Experience transforming raw thoughts into clear technical documentation and/or direction.
- * Three or more years of experience with major routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF (CCNP/CCIE level of knowledge)
- * Three or more years of experience with routing and switching hardware from major vendors including Cisco and Juniper
- * Network automation experience (Python)
- * Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and operate network solutions that are secure, stable, testable, and maintainable
- * Experience building or enhancing tools, developing best practices, refining operational procedures, and thinking proactively with innovation
- * Ability to work effectively on diverse teams with diverse co-workers
- *Master's degree, or a Bachelor's degree and experience working in a large-scale networking environment
- * CCIE Routing & Switching or equivalent
- * Experience with LAN overlay technologies such as EVPN, VXLAN, LISP, and Layer-3 fabric architectures
- * Experience with network segmentation architectures including VRF design, zone-based security models, and firewall integration
- * Experience with Software Defined Infrastructure (SDI) or commodity networking hardware and open network operating systems
- * Experience with large-scale configuration management and orchestration across tens of thousands of network devices
- * Experience with AI and ML-powered tools for network automation, incident detection, and operational efficiency, including agentic AWS AI tools such as Kiro
- * Experience in automating network administration using Python or other programming languages
- * Development and delivery of large-scale LAN designs in campus or fulfillment center environments
- * Experience with IPv6 design and implementations
- * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to collaborate across organizations
- * Experience with network automation, CI/CD pipelines, and zero-touch provisioning for network devices
- * Experience with industrial networking environments including operational technology (OT), industrial Ethernet switches, and control system networks
- * Understanding of information security principles for network infrastructure
- * Experience with firmware lifecycle management and compliance across large device fleets
- * Experience with traffic shifting, non-disruptive upgrade methodologies, and high-availability LAN architectures

description:
Location: Waterford
 Start date: January 2027
 Duration: 6-8 months
 Work Model: Hybrid – onsite requirements may vary depending on team activities
  
 About the job  
 As a Quality Systems Intern, you’ll have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience within a Quality environment while supporting projects connected with third-party and supplier quality management.
 You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues to understand how quality information is managed across different systems, help identify opportunities to improve data quality and processes, and build confidence working with both internal teams and external partners. From learning new digital systems to turning information into clear and useful data, this internship will give you practical exposure to how Quality teams operate within a global healthcare organisation. You don’t need to arrive knowing all our systems or processes – you’ll receive support and guidance from the team as you learn.

 Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.
  
 Main responsibilities: 
 Support Quality improvement projects related to the management of third-party and supplier information.
 Review information across different systems and data sources to help identify missing, incomplete or inconsistent data.
 Help maintain and update quality information within internal systems, including QualiPSO.
 Support the review, processing, approval and implementation of third-party change notifications.
 Work with Excel and other digital tools to organise, consolidate and present information in a clear and structured way.
 Connect with internal colleagues and, where required, external suppliers to gather missing information and support accurate record keeping.
 Highlight potential gaps, delays or issues identified during your work and collaborate with the team to help resolve them.
 
 About you   
 To excel in this role you will need to have:
 Be a current university student who will return to university after completing the internship.
 An interest in developing your knowledge and experience within Quality. Relevant areas of study may include Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, Chemistry, Microbiology or another related scientific discipline.
 Good attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with information and data.
 Basic Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word, and confidence learning new digital tools and systems such as QualiPSO.
 The ability to organise your work, take ownership of tasks and work independently when needed.
 Good communication and teamwork skills, with the confidence to ask questions, share observations and raise potential issues.
 A willingness to learn and work collaboratively with colleagues and external partners.

 We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

 Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you. 
 Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare. 
 Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve. 
 Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives. 
 Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being. 
 Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.

title: Manufacturing Sciences Intern
description:
Location: Waterford
 Start date: Mid-January 2027
 Duration: 8 months
 Work Model: on-site
  
 About the job  
 As a Manufacturing Sciences Intern, you will join our Manufacturing Sciences team within the laboratory at Sanofi Waterford, gaining hands-on experience in scientific investigations, laboratory testing and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
 You will work alongside experienced scientists, supporting projects involving complex biologics, including enzyme replacement therapies and monoclonal antibodies. This is an opportunity to explore new techniques, develop your problem-solving skills and contribute to scientific projects that support the development and improvement of manufacturing processes.
 Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

 Main responsibilities: 
 Support day-to-day laboratory operations, including safety checks, chemical inventory management, sample handling and maintaining an organised working environment.
 Gain hands-on experience with laboratory techniques, including lyophilisation (freeze-drying) of biologics and protein characterisation.
 Assist with laboratory testing, scientific investigations and experimental activities under the guidance of experienced scientists.
 Support the planning, execution and documentation of technical studies, helping to analyse findings and explore potential solutions.
 Contribute to projects focused on improving manufacturing processes, introducing new products and supporting existing products throughout their lifecycle.
 Assist with laboratory equipment checks, documentation and maintaining accurate experimental records.
 Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot scientific challenges, share ideas and explore new approaches to laboratory work.
  
 About you   
 To excel in this role you will need to have:
 Currently studying in the second or third year of a university degree in Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biopharmaceutical Sciences or a related scientific discipline.
 A basic understanding of laboratory practices and scientific principles gained through your studies.
 A genuine interest in science, laboratory experimentation and learning new techniques.
 Strong attention to detail, curiosity and a willingness to approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset.
 Good communication and teamwork skills, with the confidence to ask questions, share ideas and seek guidance when needed.
 A proactive approach to learning, openness to feedback and willingness to take initiative as your knowledge develops.
 Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  
 Previous industry experience is not required. We value your enthusiasm, curiosity and willingness to learn, and you will receive training and support throughout your internship.

 About Sanofi  
 We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
  
 Why choose us?  
 Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you. 
 Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare. 
 Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve. 
 Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives. 
 Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being. 
 Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
  
 We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications.

 #LI-EUR #LI-Onsite #LI-Hybrid
 
 
 Pursue progress , discover extraordinary Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

title: Assistant Designer
description:
Because your ideas are our style. Design, our way.
 Design at Primark 
 Our design specialists are at the heart of crafting captivating brand experiences. Immerse yourself in the world of visual storytelling, where your creativity will shape the aesthetics of our brand. Collaborate with a team of skilled designers and bring your artistic talent to a global stage.
 What You’ll Ge t  
 People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle:   
 Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.  

 What You’ll Do as an Assistant Designer 
 We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:
 Trend Research & Forecasting: Identify and interpret emerging fashion, lifestyle and consumer trends through market research, social media, competitor analysis and customer insight. Translate trend intelligence into commercial opportunities and help shape future range direction through innovative thinking and trend storytelling.
 Product Design & Creative Development: Support the creation of trend-led, customer-focused product ranges by developing original design concepts, CADs, technical drawings, prints, graphics and artwork. Bring seasonal trends and design briefs to life while maintaining alignment with customer needs and departmental strategy.
 Range Building & Product Execution: Partner with Design and Buying teams to build balanced, commercially viable ranges that deliver the right mix of trend, newness and value. Manage design developments through the critical path, review samples, and ensure products remain true to the original design vision.
 Technical Design & Product Development: Create and maintain accurate specifications, tech packs and design documentation. Apply your knowledge of garment construction, fabrics, trims, colour and print development to support successful product execution and supplier collaboration.
 Commercial Awareness & Customer Focus: Use sales performance, market trends, customer behaviour and competitor activity to inform design decisions. Develop a strong understanding of the Primark brand, product value and cost considerations to help create commercially successful products.
 Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership: Build strong working relationships with Buying, Merchandising, Technical teams and suppliers to deliver fashion-forward, globally relevant ranges. Share trend insights, communicate design updates clearly and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
 Organisation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain accurate design, trend and product information, ensuring all files, samples and amendments are up to date. Support presentations, range reviews and supplier communications while proactively identifying opportunities to improve products, processes and ways of working.
 

 What You'll Bring 
 At Primark, we focus on assisting you in developing your mindset and skillset to you reach your potential. Here’s a more detailed breakdown of the experience you’ll need:
 Design Expertise & Creativity: A qualification in Fashion Design or equivalent experience, with a passion for creating commercially relevant products and bringing new ideas to life.
 Technical Design Skills: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, with the ability to support the end-to-end design process.
 Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement : Proven ability to build strong relationships and work effectively with Buying, Merchandising and Design teams to deliver great results.
 Communication & Presentation Skills : Confident communicator who can clearly present ideas, adapt style to different audiences and contribute positively in meetings and forums.
 Planning & Organisation : Highly organised with excellent prioritisation skills, able to manage multiple tasks and deliver to deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
 Commercial Awareness & Customer Focus: Strong business acumen and genuine interest in retail, with an understanding of customer needs and market trends.
 Ownership & Problem Solving: Proactive and detail-oriented, taking responsibility for delivering high-quality work, making informed decisions and resolving challenges quickly.
 Experience & Mindset: Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a Trainee or Assistant Designer role, with a positive, flexible and collaborative approach and a commitment to continuous learning and development.
 Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.  

 About Primark  
 At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 19 countries today and growing.
 So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.
 You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.
 If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist.

title: 2027 Summer Intern Process Validation & Technology Transfer (IOPS)

2027 Summer Intern Process Validation & Technology Transfer (IOPS)
Location : Rensselaer
Req ID : R51830
Contract : Full time
Work Pattern : Onsite
The role
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently seeking multiple 2027 Interns in the Process Validation, Process Controls, and Manufacturing Sciences and Technology (MSAT) teams of the Regeneron Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) Process Sciences and Drug Product Engineering (PSDPE) department. This group decides how Regeneron's manufacturing processes are controlled and validated, and moves those processes to new sites and external manufacturing partners.
These positions offer the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
When & where:
Location: Rensselaer / East Greenbush / Troy, NY
Timeframe: Our internship positions are full-time and onsite from May/June-August
Pay : Intern and Co-op pay ranges are determined by level of education (year in school) and degree program. The hourly rate range for these locations is: $17.90-$25.50 per hour.
What you'll do:
Before a manufacturing process can be used for a commercial medicine, it has to be shown to work reliably — and when a process moves to a new site or an outside manufacturing partner, the knowledge behind it has to move too.
Projects here involve developing risk-based approaches to process control and validation (for example, deciding which process parameters to monitor, or when results from past studies can be reused instead of repeating them), compiling and analyzing historical manufacturing data, and writing the technical documents that support technology transfers — including for newer Advanced Therapy programs (such as AAV, siRNA, peptides, and bioconjugates) and external manufacturing partners.
Some projects build data-driven or digital tools — for example, performance metrics that improve knowledge transfer to external partners, or tools that keep product datasets and related documents accurate as products and requirements change.
Some projects also explore how AI tools can help review batch records and technical documents for mismatches or omissions, or help draft and review technical source documents.
These are mostly desk-based technical roles — expect research, data analysis, technical writing, and cross-functional meetings rather than lab work. A few projects are better suited to graduate students.
Relevant majors: Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biology, Chemistry, Statistics/Data Science, Computer Science/Information Technology (for digital-tool projects)

Robert Matthews
Read other stories from our veterans
What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.
How do you connect with other members of the Armed Forces Community at Expleo?
I participate in careers  transition workshops supporting recruiters. When Ex-Forces  are looking for a new career, I attend the workshops chatting  to the Armed Forces community sharing my experience and  what I have learned.
What advice would you give to other members of the Armed Forces Community who are planning to join Expleo?
Expleo has many different opportunities, whether it be leadership management, various jobs in engineering, project management etc. Don’t think that you don’t have the skill set to join Expleo. It is within you; you do have those skills and Expleo can bring out these skills in people.

description:
Job Description : 
 About us 
 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.  

 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.  

 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more 
   
 About the function 
 Sales is where our brands meet the real world. 
 This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter everywhere. 
 It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day. 

 About the role 
 Deliver profitable growth and best-in-class execution across a defined portfolio of On Trade customers and outlets in Ireland. Build trusted customer relationships, translate channel and brand priorities into outlet action, grow distribution and rate of sale, and use CRM and performance insight to prioritise the next best action while protecting quality, compliance and investment return.

 Key Accountabilities: 

 Own customer and outlet delivery: Manage an agreed customer portfolio and call plan, build simple growth actions, complete business reviews and ensure customer and internal commitments are delivered on time.
 Grow portfolio performance in outlet: Win and maintain distribution, availability, menu placement, visibility, serve quality and advocacy across priority beer and spirits brands, targeting white-space and rate-of-sale opportunities.
 Land activation and innovation brilliantly: Execute promotions, launches, outlet activations and customer training with Customer Marketing, Advocacy, Quality and external partners; track standards, outcomes and follow-through.
 Use data, CRM and forecasting to act: Maintain accurate EDGE/CRM records; coordinate forecast inputs with Commercial teams, collect volume and trade investment inputs and update Vision directly; use rate-of-sale, quality and customer data to prioritise action and escalate risks early.
 Resolve issues and protect trust: Lead customer follow-through on supply, delivery, quality, pricing, claims, credit and execution issues, working cross-functionally and ensuring all activity meets Diageo, legal and responsible-retailing standards.
 
 About you 
 Key Competencies: 

 Customer and outlet execution: Builds trusted relationships and converts customer, channel and brand plans into disciplined action that improves availability, visibility, quality and rate of sale.
 Commercial judgement and data-led prioritisation: Uses CRM, rate-of-sale, forecast and customer performance data to focus time and investment on the opportunities that create the most value.
 Ownership and collaboration: Operates with pace, accuracy and resilience, resolving issues through Sales, Customer Marketing, RGM, Supply, Finance, Quality and external partners.
 
 Experience/skills required:   
   
 Relevant FMCG, beverage alcohol, hospitality, field sales, customer operations or account execution experience.
 Strong customer relationship, influencing and negotiation capability, with a practical understanding of On Trade outlet economics and consumer occasions.
 Proven ability to deliver distribution, activation, quality and rate-of-sale improvements across a customer or outlet portfolio.
 Confident using CRM/EDGE, Excel, performance reporting and forecasting tools such as Vision to maintain accurate data and prioritise action.
 High ownership, organisation and judgement, with the ability to work responsibly in a regulated category and resolve issues at pace.
 Full driving licence and flexibility to spend significant time in trade, including occasional evening or event activity.
   
 Working with us 
 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. 

 We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:   
 Contemporary work life balance policies and wellbeing activities
 On site gym or subsidised gym membership
 Contributary pension scheme
 Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
 Annual bonus of circa 20% of your base salary (dependent on performance)
 Share options
  
 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible. 

 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team. 

 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. 
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. 

 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

 Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

title: Quality Compliance - Quality Services Intern
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
 

 Inspire and be inspired. We offer a variety of opportunities for undergraduate and post-graduate students to use your talent, skills, education and passion to help make an impact on patient’s lives – all while growing your career and  
 earning academic credit.  
   
 Our Internship Programme gives you a real opportunity to gain practical ‘hands-on’ experience, training and  shadow the experts of your chosen field. It also provides you with insight into what it’s like to work with us.   
   
 We will place you in a six, nine or twelve month Internship Programme depending on the requirements of your degree course. So, are you ready to embark on a new adventure? We can’t wait to see what you’re made of!  

 The Intern, Quality Compliance, External Manufacturing, will participate in and 
 provide support for a wide range of quality compliance activities within External Manufacturing. This includes contributing to quality compliance, quality services, inspection readiness and risk management efforts, and assisting with general departmental needs as required. The role provides broad exposure to quality practices and supports day-to-day operations in a dynamic, cross functional environment.

 Responsibilities: 
 • Support the compilation, tracking, and follow up of quality and regulatory 
 performance metrics across External Manufacturing. 
 • Where applicable, assist with the compilation of Regulatory Restriction 
 Forms and support regulatory requests received for filing applications. 
 • Work with Virtual Plant Teams to support progression of change controls 
 and other quality system activities, including deviations, CAPAs, product 
 quality complaints, documentation, audits, and inspections. 
 • Support the preparation of regulatory summaries for Annual Product 
 Quality Reports. 
 • Provide quality and regulatory support to Contract Manufacturing 
 Operations within a cross functional team, contributing to the 
 management of CMOs and ensuring alignment with applicable GMP, 
 corporate policies, and regulatory requirements. 
 • Support ongoing quality and regulatory projects, continuous improvement 
 initiatives, and Operational Excellence efforts. 
 • Assist with the progression of GMP and regulatory documents within the 
 Documentation Management System, including review, processing, and 
 authorship of quality or regulatory related procedures. 
 • Support the review and approval of site procedures and associated 
 documents as required. 
 • Engage in Quality Culture initiatives across External Manufacturing. 
 • Provide routine administrative support such as scheduling meetings, 
 preparing presentations, issuing meeting minutes, and maintaining action 
 logs. 
 • Collaborate with relevant departments to support compliance and ensure 
 effective communication across teams. 
 • Perform other ad hoc tasks as assigned by management or relevant 
 quality representatives in support of team and departmental goals.

 Qualifications, Knowledge and Skills Required 
 • Currently undertaking an undergraduate degree in a relevant scientific 
 discipline such as General Science, Biomedical Sciences, Biotechnology, 
 Analytical Science, Pharmaceutical and Biomedical Chemistry, or 
 Pharmaceutical and Industrial Chemistry.
 • Strong time management and organisational skills, with the ability to 
 manage multiple tasks and work independently using initiative.
 • Effective interpersonal, communication, presentation, and teamwork skills.
 • Proficiency in key computer applications including Word, Excel, Access 
 and PowerPoint, with the ability to collect, analyse, interpret and present 
 information clearly.
 • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment, balancing 
 several projects at once.
 • Flexible, motivated, energetic and collaborative, with the ability to meet 
 targets and milestones.
 • Confident public speaking skills and the ability to engage effectively with 
 others.
 • Passion for the pharmaceutical sector and innovation in healthcare.

 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Incident Tooling & Response
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Incident Management Service (IMS) team is building the platform that AWS uses to coordinate response during high-severity incidents. When AWS services are degraded, incident responders use IMS to detect, triage, mitigate, and resolve issues, coordinating across dozens of service teams in real time. We are building the next generation of Incident management tooling - a unified platform that must remain available and performant precisely when AWS infrastructure is unhealthy, deployed across three AWS regions with automated failover. You will own significant portions of the service architecture: the data layer, authorization system, API model, and integrations with incident automation systems. You will design and deliver components across the stack, drive cross-team technical alignment, and mentor other engineers. You need to be a strong software developer with a track record of delivering production services, and also excel in communication and technical leadership. You'll use agentic AI development to move fast from concept to production. This is an opportunity to own architecture on a high-visibility platform that is used during AWS's most critical moments.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement service components for a multi-region, multi-tenant incident management platform. Own subsystems including the data layer, authorization, and API surface. Build integrations with incident automation systems, conference bridge providers, and downstream event consumers. Drive technical design decisions, balancing reliability, performance, and delivery speed. Participate in operational support and ensure the service is resilient during the incidents it is designed to manage. Mentor other engineers and lead technical design reviews. Use agentic AI development practices to move quickly from concept to tested, production-ready code.

About the team
We are a high-performing team building the incident management platform for all of AWS. Our software is used during AWS's worst moments, so reliability is not optional. We operate what we build, and every engineer has direct visibility into how their code performs during real incidents. We value high delivery velocity, pragmatic architecture decisions, and engineers who take ownership beyond their assigned scope. We use agentic AI development practices and invest in tooling that lets engineers and agents validate changes locally before they reach the pipeline.

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
- - Experience using generative AI tools to accelerate engineering workflows
- Experience or certifications in API design, cloud architecture/deployment, service-oriented architecture, mobile development, performance optimization, databases design and related fields
- Experience with authorization systems (IAM, RBAC, or attribute-based access control)
- Experience mentoring other engineers
- Experience writing technical design documents and driving alignment across teams

description:
“Novo invests in its graduates and gives us the opportunities needed to excel in our careers. We are given real tasks, real responsibility, and we build networks across the company both during our rotations, but also via friendships built along the way with fellow graduates or colleagues. As a Global Finance Graduate, we have unmatched potential to gain experiences and be a part of the future of Novo, both because of the structure around the rotational program but also because of the trust and involvement that I have experienced in all of my rotations.”
My transition to a Global Finance Graduate - LinkedIn
“The pharmaceutical industry can feel very opaque – it's hard to understand where you’ll fit best when you haven’t experienced it yet. The graduate programme is a fantastic opportunity to gain broad exposure within your field so you can identify the type of work that matches your skills and interests the best. You can expect to face steep learning curves, build a vast professional network, and be surrounded by like-minded graduates, making the programme incredibly fulfilling, both professionally and personally.”
“The programme gives you three very different views of the company in two years: different teams, different countries, and different problems to solve. What ties them together is the people as everyone is genuinely willing to make time for you when you ask. And you're trusted with work from the start, so each rotation stretches you a little further than the last.”
“As a member of the Graduate Programme, you are given a once in a lifetime opportunity to challenge your own perspectives and gain global experiences, so early in your career. It requires you to be open minded, curious, and willing to learn. Its a programme that uniquely pushes you to be the best version of yourself, both professionally and personally.”
“The Graduate Programme is an excellent opportunity to get to know Novo holistically. Throughout two years, you will experience new cultures and build lasting connections. If you are ready to be challenged, work cross-functionally, and learn from great leaders, the Legal, Ethics & Compliance Graduate Programme is the place to be. You will have the opportunity to be anchored in teams across the world and be professionally shaped by the Novo Way, while contributing to Novo’s purpose: driving change for lasting health.”

Newly Qualified Solicitors
We are seeking ambitious Newly Qualified Solicitors to join A&L Goodbody (ALG) across a range of practice areas. These opportunities are suited to individuals who want to begin their careers in a top-tier law firm, working alongside leading solicitors on complex, high-value and often market-leading matters for major Irish and international clients.
As a Newly Qualified Solicitor at ALG, you will gain broad experience within your chosen practice area and contribute to matters from an early stage. You will receive support and guidance from partners and senior solicitors while developing the technical expertise, commercial judgement and client relationship skills required for a successful legal career. The role offers structured learning, exposure to high-quality work and clear opportunities to take on increasing responsibility as your experience develops.
Responsibilities
Work with partners and senior solicitors on a range of client matters.
Draft, review and negotiate legal documents and correspondence.
Conduct legal research and provide clear, practical and commercially focused advice.
Take ownership of defined workstreams and manage matters through to completion under appropriate supervision.
Participate in client calls and meetings and build effective client relationships.
Manage competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
Keep up to date with relevant legal, regulatory and market developments.
Contribute to knowledge sharing, business development and wider firm initiatives.
Practice groups recruiting
We are currently recruiting Newly Qualified Solicitors across the following practice groups:
Litigation: Disputes & Investigations, Environment & Planning, Technology and Healthcare
Corporate: Funds, Pensions, Insurance and Tax
Banking: Financial Regulation, Structured Finance and Aviation Finance
Property: Real Estate
Requirements
You will be a newly qualified solicitor with:
Strong legal analysis, research and drafting skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Clear written and verbal communication skills.
Good organisational and workload management skills.
A commercial and client-focused approach.
The ability to work collaboratively and use sound judgement.
A commitment to developing your technical expertise and taking on increasing responsibility.
Benefits
At ALG we pride ourselves on the high calibre of our employees. We place strong emphasis on career development and enabling our people to excel in their careers. Our work environment is friendly, professional and collaborative. In addition to working with a highly regarded team we offer:
A competitive remuneration package
Access to the firm’s marquee training and development programmes, delivered through the ALG School of Business and Law
Discretionary performance bonus
Pension and health insurance contribution, wellbeing contribution, life assurance, subsidised gym, restaurant and coffee shop
Hybrid working policy
ALG is a leading Irish law firm with five international offices in Dublin, Belfast, London, New York and San Francisco. There are currently 125 partners and over 1,000 employees. The strong international and domestic business community in Ireland forms a valuable part of the ALG client base. ALG is incredibly proud to be recognised as one of the leading Irish law firms in the Chambers and Partners Europe 2026 Guide. ALG is also ranked as a 'top tier' law firm in The Legal 500 EMEA Guide 2026 and the IFLR1000 Guide 2026. The firm is consistently ranked number one in the Irish market and on a European level.
ALG has a reputation for leading the way in continuously developing its service to clients and internally to its business. This is delivered using new processes, ways of working, innovative use of technology and marketing-leading business service teams.

title: Talent Development & Learning Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has been operating in Ireland since 1946 and serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.
 
 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened  a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems . 
 
 The Purpose of the Talent Development & Learning Specialist is to: 
 Develop and execute Learning & Development strategies, programmes, and systems that build organisational capability, enhance employee performance, and support current and future business objectives. Partner with leaders to identify development needs and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Partner with business and functional leaders to assess current and future capability requirements, conduct learning needs analyses, and develop learning strategies that support business growth and performance.

 Build strong relationships across site, divisional, and corporate functions to leverage enterprise learning solutions and best practices.

 Develop and maintain multi-year Learning & Development roadmaps that support organisational capability building and High-Performance Organisation (HPO) objectives.

 Support talent development initiatives that support succession planning, leadership capability, and workforce development.

 Develop career pathway resources and provide coaching and guidance to managers and employees on learning and development opportunities.

 Serve as site lead for further education initiatives and external audits from a Learning & Development perspective.

 Manage learning systems, curricula, training records, and learning documentation, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.

 Manage relationships with external learning providers, educational institutions, and strategic partners to support education outreach objectives.

 Develop communication and engagement strategies that increase awareness, accessibility, and adoption of Learning & Development programmes.

 Measure learning effectiveness, analyse training data, manage the L&D budget, and use insights to continuously improve learning outcomes and business impact.

 Stay informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative learning practices to ensure programmes remain relevant and effective.

 
 EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE 
 A third‑level qualification in Human Resources, Business, Management, or equivalent experience.
 Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Learning and Development role or equivalent; experience within the manufacturing industry is an advantage.
 Experience developing and implementing Learning & Development strategies aligned to organisational objectives.
 Experience conducting training needs analyses and translating business requirements into effective learning and capability-building solutions.
 Experience partnering with managers and senior leaders to identify capability gaps, talent development priorities, and succession planning needs.
 Experience using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning analytics to support decision-making, compliance, and continuous improvement.
 Exceptional interpersonal, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.
 Strong project management with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results independently.
 Experience managing government training grants is desirable.
 
 Connect with us at www.abbott.com or https://www.ie.abbott/, on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews.
 
 Abbott is an equal opportunities employer.
      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

 WORK SHIFT: Ie - Kkyflx (Ireland)

title: Technical Services Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has been operating in Ireland since 1946 and serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.
 
 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened  a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems.
 
 Purpose of the Role
 We are seeking a motivated and analytical Technical Services Specialist to join our team. This role is responsible for leading technical investigations into product failures, process non-conformities, customer complaints, and system anomalies to identify root causes and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
 
 Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Quality, Control Systems, Global Engineering, Validation, PMO, and the wider technical teams, you will play a key role in driving product quality, process reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement. This is a dynamic and multidisciplinary position that requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Conduct detailed root cause investigations using structured methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

 Analyse technical data, performance metrics, and test results to identify trends, determine underlying causes, and support decision-making.

 Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to gather information, validate findings, and implement solutions.

 Develop, recommend, and support the implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to address issues and reduce future risk.

 Design and execute testing, validation, and simulation activities to replicate issues, confirm root causes, and verify solutions.

 Prepare comprehensive technical reports documenting investigations, findings, risk assessments, and recommended actions.

 Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, systems, and procedures to enhance quality, efficiency, and reliability.

 Ensure all investigations and solutions comply with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal quality systems.

 Support the development and implementation of new processes within the Materials function and ensure effective integration across departments.

 Partner with Operational Excellence teams to develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, trackers, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

 Apply Lean methodologies and continuous improvement principles to drive operational excellence.

 Provide guidance and training on investigation techniques, root cause analysis methodologies, and lessons learned.

 Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to support safety, compliance, quality, and continuous improvement objectives.

 Identify areas of operational risk and improvement and proactively recommend solutions.

 Sunday to Friday (Sunday 23:00-07:00, Monday to Friday 22:45-07:00 to allow for shift handover)

They ensure that all warehouse activities are completed as per approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), in a safe manner and in compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). This role is pivotal in supporting the execution of operational readiness in Alexion’s manufacturing facility. The individual in this position is expected to represent Alexion Pharmaceutical interests, objectives, and policies in a professional and responsible manner.
 
 Accountabilities: Performing day-to-day warehouse activities to meet schedules while maintaining a high level of GMP compliance
 Ensuring all training and safety procedures for equipment, processes, and facility are maintained and up to date at all times

 Performing routine material inspection exercises in accordance with agreed procedures and standards to support material release in line with manufacturing schedule
 Supporting continuous improvement initiatives by identifying areas needing improvement, recommending strategies for improvement, and implementing those strategies once approved

 Providing support to Operations, Validation, Engineering, and Quality where required

 Essential Skills/Experience Proven experience performing warehouse activities in a cGMP commercial manufacturing environment
