JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott Ireland Commercial Liffey Valley Dublin 

Opened in 1946, this operation, based in Liffey Valley Dublin was the first Abbott business unit to be established in Ireland. This business is responsible for the sales, marketing and distribution of a wide range of diabetes, diagnostic, and nutritional products in Ireland. This role will be office based in The Liffey Valley office.

 Position: Abbott Nutrition Dietetic Graduate (14 Months) Abbott Ireland 

The Graduate Dietitian, referred to as a Nutrition Specialist until CORU registration is complete, is a key member of the Abbott Nutrition Ireland team. This role supports the delivery of high‑quality, evidence‑based nutrition services, ensures the accuracy and compliance of nutrition communication, and contributes to regulatory, clinical, and commercial activities across the organisation. The position offers an excellent opportunity for a newly qualified dietitian to apply clinical and scientific knowledge in a commercial healthcare environment while developing professional expertise in medical nutrition.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Review and approve content for Abbott Nutrition marketing materials to ensure accuracy, scientific integrity, and compliance with relevant standards and guidelines.

 Operate a dietetic helpline providing high‑quality nutrition advice to healthcare professionals across Ireland.

 Work closely with line manager to support regulatory submissions and reimbursement applications for Abbott Nutrition products available in Ireland.

 Professionalism, discretion, and the ability to maintain confidentiality at all times.

Kepak is a leading food company with manufacturing sites across Ireland and the UK. The Group operates across three divisions: the Foods Division, Meat Division UK, and Meat Division Ireland. Guided by our values—Responsibility, Ambition, Passion for Food, and Teamwork—we are committed to operating as a successful, sustainable, future-ready business that is a great place to work. We supply fresh and value-added meat based products to retail and foodservice through private label and our own brands, including Rustlers, Big Al's and John Stone. 
  Kepak Meat Division Ireland operates across multiple manufacturing sites, producing a range of quality meat and protein-based food products for retail and foodservice customers across both domestic and export markets. The division is recognised for its operational excellence, strong customer partnerships, and continuous innovation. 
 
 We are seeking a Continuous Improvement Specialist to lead and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across our Retail Manufacturing operations. In this role, you'll identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, increase profitability, and embed a culture of operational excellence throughout the business.
 
 Working closely with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, Engineering, Food Safety & Quality, and Health & Safety teams, you'll lead improvement projects using Lean methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, and Root Cause Analysis.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, eliminate waste, reduce costs, and improve operational performance.
 Implementing and embedding Lean methodologies and tools such as Lean Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, and Kaizen.
 Partnering with site leadership teams to prioritise improvement initiatives and deliver measurable business results.

 Quantifying financial benefits, return on investment (ROI), and cost-saving opportunities from OpEx projects.
 Facilitating workshops and improvement events that engage teams and generate innovative solutions.
 Promoting a culture of continuous learning by designing and delivering training programmes on operational excellence principles and best practices.
 Working closely with project teams to ensure improvement projects are effectively managed from concept through to implementation and sustainability.
 Supporting quality, safety, sustainability, and customer-focused initiatives to strengthen our position as a leading food manufacturer.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree / Level 8 qualification in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management or related field 
 Proven experience in a operations role and/or continuous improvement role in food manufacturing
 Lean Manufacturing Green Belt certification is desirable 
 Other project management qualifications and experience advantageous
 In depth knowledge of Op Ex tools and techniques and practical implementation experience

title: Cloud Support Associate Internship - April 2027 start, Support Engineering
description:
**This is a 6 month internship starting in April 2027**

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.

How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

Would you like to use the latest cloud computing technologies? Do you have an interest in helping customers understand application architectures and integration approaches? Are you familiar with best practices for applications, servers, and networks? Do you want to be part of a customer facing technology team helping to ensure the success of AWS as a leading technology organization? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the market leader and technology forerunner in the cloud business. As a member of the AWS support team you will be at the forefront of this transformational technology, assisting a global list of companies and developers that are taking advantage of a growing set of services and features to run their mission-critical applications. 
As an Amazon intern, you will be interacting with your peers and the AWS global team of full-time professionals as part of our AWS Cloud Support team. You will benefit from the opportunity to gain experience on our cloud services, hands on training, and learning as you go.
If you fit the description, you could be the person we are looking for. We are a group of smart people, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world-class support is critical to customer success. 
Come build the future with us.

Key job responsibilities
Each day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
• Learn and use ground-breaking technologies.
• Complete AWS certifications.
• Work on projects that improve support-related processes with fellow interns in other locations.
• Design, build and deploy tools/applications for AWS Support Engineers.
• Interact with leading engineers around the world.
• Partner with AWS teams.

A day in the life
Why us?
• The Cloud Support Associate Internship Program provides interns with the technical and functional skills training based on Cloud Support Builder standards.
• On a typical day, a Cloud Support Builder will be primarily responsible for solving customer’s cases through customer contact channels (e.g., telephone, email, and web/live chat). They apply troubleshooting techniques to provide solutions for our customers by thoughtfully working with customers to dive deep into the root cause of an issue.
• A Cloud Support Builder may also develop, train, partner with development teams on complex issues or contact deflection initiatives, participate in new hiring, write tools/script to help the team, or work with leadership on process improvement and strategic initiatives.

About the team
If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.

• Competitive pay
• Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
• Networking opportunities with fellow interns
• Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
• Mentorship and career development

The internship is a fixed term program, the start date will be April 2027 for a duration of 6 months.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

description:
Job Description: 
 Job Title: Credit Analyst I 
 Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President 
 Location: Dublin 

 Company Overview 
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

 The Team 

 The Enterprise Credit Subsidiary Lending Group (EC SLG) is responsible for independent administration of a client portfolio facilitating credit for local subsidiaries of multinational clients, managing the local credit process, and providing dedicated support to the Global Subsidiary Banking business. Based in 12 countries across three regions, EC SLG performs the role of the Local R-Credit Specialist, including completion of credit administration functions for a client portfolio, and coordination of local jurisdictional requirements with key stakeholders and local business partners.

 Responsibilities 
 Independent administration of a client portfolio facilitating credit for local subsidiaries of multinational clients.
 Facilitate preparation, negotiation & completion of credit documents & loan agreements
 Direct interface with global credit teams, local subsidiary banking team & external clients
 Drive through completion of credit deals in a timely manner.
 Help manage and adhere to the local Legal Entity approval and booking process, coordinating with Tax, Legal, Finance, Compliance & local Management teams where requires.
 .
 
 Requirements 
 Actively contribute to the development of the Enterprise Credit Subsidiary Lending business.
 Behaves appropriately, professionally and with integrity, demonstrating high-levels of conduct, in all aspects of work.
 Deliver to our Shareholders by helping the Bank grow responsibly.
 Ability to actively manage Risk.
 University graduate or equivalent and/or track record of relevant experience.
 Credit background with knowledge of Corporate Banking products and services.
 Experience with reading / interpreting loan agreements & related documentation.
 Excellent written skills and ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
 Team player, results oriented, shows ability to adapt and is able to work under pressure.
 Demonstrates time management and can prioritise workload.
 Ability to coordinate with multiple points of contact (internal and external).
 
 Benefits of working at Bank of America 
 Ireland 
 Private healthcare for you and your family plus an annual health screen to help you manage your physical wellness with the option to purchase a screen for your partner
 Competitive pension plan, life assurance and group income protection cover if you become unable to work as a result of a disability or health reasons
 20 days of back-up childcare including access to school holiday clubs and 20 days of back-up adult care per annum.
 The ability to change your core benefits as well as the option of selecting a variety of flexible benefits to suit your personal circumstances including access to a wellbeing account, travel insurance, critical illness etc.
 Access to an emotional wellbeing helpline, mental health first aiders and virtual GP services.
 Access to an Employee Assistance Program for confidential support and help for everyday matters
 Ability to donate to charities of your choice directly through payroll and the bank will match your contribution
 Opportunity to access our Arts & Culture corporate membership program and receive discounted entry to some of the UK’s most iconic cultural institutions and exhibitions.
 Opportunity to give back to your community, develop new skills and work with new groups of people by volunteering in your local community.
 

 Bank of America 
 Good conduct and sound judgment is crucial to our long term success. It’s important that all employees in the organisation understand the expected standards of conduct and how we manage conduct risk. Individual accountability and an ownership mind-set are the cornerstones of our Code of Conduct and are at the heart of managing risk well.

 We are an equal opportunities employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of sex, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, socio-economic background, responsibility for dependants or physical or mental disability. The Bank selects candidates for interview based on their skills, qualifications and experience.

 We strive to ensure that our recruitment processes are accessible for all candidates and encourage any candidates to tell us about any adjustment requirements.

Graduate Systems Engineer - Boston Scientific 2027 Graduate Programme, Clonmel
Work mode:
Onsite
Onsite Location(s):
Clonmel, Ireland
Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance
At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.
Advancing possibilities for a brighter tomorrow
Boston Scientific is seeking a highly motivated Graduate Systems Engineer on a defined-term (23months) basis to join our Clonmel team .
Job Purpose:
Start your career where your ideas, curiosity and technical skills can make a meaningful difference. As a Graduate Engineer at Boston Scientific, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, contribute to innovative medical technologies and build hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.
As a Graduate Systems Engineer, you will support the development of complex active implantable medical devices while building your knowledge of systems engineering. Working with experienced Systems Engineers and cross-functional teams, you will contribute to requirements development and traceability, system architecture and integration, risk management, verification and validation, and product development activities. You will learn how user and stakeholder needs are translated into safe, reliable and compliant product solutions.
This is an opportunity to apply what you learned during your studies, develop your technical and problem-solving capabilities and gain valuable experience while contributing to technologies designed to improve patients' lives.
Key Respo nsibilities:
Support the development and maintenance of user needs, system requirements and subsystem requirements under the guidance of experienced engineers.
Assist with maintaining requirements traceability between user needs, design outputs, verification and validation activities.
Participate in system architecture, interface and integration discussions, building an understanding of how system elements work together.
Support risk management activities, including hazard analysis and risk assessments, in accordance with medical device development processes.
Assist with planning, preparation and execution of system-level verification and validation activities.
Support system characterisation, integration and testing activities, including documenting results and helping investigate technical issues.
Help prepare and maintain clear, accurate systems engineering documentation and design records.
Participate in cross-functional design reviews and technical discussions, contributing analysis and ideas with support from the wider team.
Collaborate with Electrical, Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Quality and Regulatory colleagues to support product development activities.
Learn and apply systems engineering methodologies, medical device design controls and product development processes as your experience develops.
Education & Experience:
Hons Bachelor Degree (Level 8) in Systems, Biomedical, Electrical, Mechanical, Software Engineering or a related discipline is essential.
Graduated within the past two years or currently in the final year of university.
Relevant work experience or completion of a co-op program.
Eligibility to work in Ireland.
Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the initiative to contribute in a collaborative environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an interest in understanding how complex systems work.
Understanding of engineering fundamentals and an interest in developing systems thinking concepts.
Strong systems aptitude and an interest in developing technical skills.
Enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.
Interest in medical technology, product development, systems engineering or continuous improvement.
What we can offer you
Competitive Benefits – we offer market leading benefits including performance-related bonus, pension contribution, onsite gym, onsite parking, subsidised canteen, organised social groups and healthcare.
A Career with Meaningful Purpose   – opportunity to transform the lives of patients worldwide.
Our Culture   - our work is guided by core values that define our culture and empower our employees.
Career Development   – our highly engaged leaders will empower you to grow and will invest in your potential. You can also broaden your skills through personal development courses.
Opportunity to Innovate   – we encourage you to fulfil your true creative potential by speaking up with your ideas and solutions to problems that matter.
Work-Life Balance   – we have created a culture that acknowledges, respects and supports your life and work choices.
Corporate Social Responsibility   – we are dedicated to progressing business practices in areas important to our communities. Our onsite charity events have raised over €1.5 million for worthy causes in the past ten years.
Boston Scientific Ireland Graduate Programme cosing date is 22nd November 2026.
As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.
So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!
To search and apply for open positions, visit: https://bostonscientific.eightfold.ai/careers
At Boston Scientific, we recognise that nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace helps us be more innovative. It is essential in advancing science for life and improving patient health. We stand for inclusion, equality, and opportunity for all. By embracing the richness of our unique backgrounds and perspectives, we create a better, more rewarding place for our employees to work and reflect the patients, customers, and communities we serve. Boston Scientific is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.  Boston Scientific is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with a disability. Should you require a reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please email TalentAcquisitionIre@bsci.com

description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Role
 Summary :  As a member of the COO Functional Training Team, the Training Consultant will work collaboratively with team members to deliver training solutions to the assigned business unit.  Under general direction the Training Consultant will assist with defining learning solutions that support the functional requirements.  The Training Consultant role involves designing, developing, and delivering functional training solutions, analysing solutions for continuous improvement, and undertaking appropriate operational and administrative aspects of the training curriculum.
 
  Why Choose this role as a training consultant
 This role is an excellent opportunity for a candidate who is looking to progress a career away from a daily operations/client servicing role.

 This role gives the opportunity to engage with senior leaders and all level of management.      

 This role gives an individual the opportunity to create and own a product which delivers benefits to partners now and in the future. 

 
 Principal Responsibilities
 Work with management, business process consultants and/or subject matter experts to understand desired business outcomes and translate them into learning objectives.

 Work with stakeholders to determine appropriate learning methodologies and functional training solutions.

 Handle all types of analysis.

 Develop project plans including the identification of subject matter experts where appropriate.

 Design, develop, facilitate and deliver learning programs.

 Evaluate training development programs for effectiveness and make recommendations for improvements.

 Maintain an inventory of training development programs/tools and schedules, their use according to management priorities.

 Deliver a work product that requires minimal revision.

 Serve as a key subject matter expert in program design and may mentor more junior staff.

 Acts as a product and marketing manager for training programs

 Responsible for multiple projects of various complexities

 Represent the COO Training team in various meetings.

 
 Area Specific Duties
 
 Design, develop and maintain a training curriculum for the Asset Servicing Custody Servicing function which can be implemented and delivered regardless of geographic location.

 Coordinate/deliver the new hire curriculum within the relevant geographic location.

 Design and deliver training for existing systems and new system roll-outs.

 Ensure that COO Training learning and development interventions are aligned with the Business Unit and/or enterprise-wide needs.

 Consult with Custody Servicing management to provide ongoing support on training needs and business unit initiatives.

 Work collaboratively with other global training teams. Provide backup as necessary.

 
 Skills / Experience
 For this position, we are looking for an individual that fits one of two profiles:
 An experienced funds industry operations professional willing to develop their consulting, writing and presenting skills.
 
 Requirements include: 
 Three to five years of capital markets operations experience, preferably in custody servicing or a similar role in financial services.

 Excellent communication skills.

 Ability to work with all levels of staff.

 Self-starter and team player.

 Attention to detail.

 Willingness and ability to give and receive candid feedback

 
 An experienced training professional willing to quickly learn all aspects of the custody servicing business.
 Requirements include: 
 Three to five years of training consulting experience.

 Excellent communication skills.

 Ability to work with all levels of staff.

 Self-starter and team player.

 Attention to detail.

 Willingness and ability to give and receive feedback

 Can consult with business subject matter experts and translate SME knowledge into step by step exceptions management.

 
 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

 POSITION DESCRIPTION 
 
 Do you love to learn? Do you enjoy problem solving? Do you like to innovate? Then this is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment alongside a diverse group of highly motivated professionals.
 
 In this role, you will gain exposure to trade activity, investment strategies, portfolio construction, and the implementation of regulatory and client investment guidelines. The Trade Compliance team is responsible for reviewing fixed income and equity transactions on both a pre- and post-trade basis to ensure compliance with applicable restrictions and regulations. You will have broad exposure to the Investment Guideline Compliance process and will partner closely with teams across Legal & Compliance, Technology, Account Management, Product Strategy, Operations, and the Trade Floor. 
 
 As the compliance landscape continues to evolve, the team is increasingly focused on leveraging technology, automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen risk monitoring, and support continuous process improvement. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to these initiatives while developing deep expertise in investment compliance.
 
 On a given day, your responsibilities might include: 
 
 Analyzing transactions and portfolio holdings against regulatory, client, and internal guidelines, and calculating relevant risk metrics.

 Researching and responding to investment guideline inquiries from the Trade Floor and other internal and external stakeholders.

 Monitoring compliance alerts and ensuring trade activity is reviewed and compliant by the end of each business day. 

 Preparing and distributing compliance reports and management information to relevant internal stakeholders.

 Partnering with Compliance, Technology, and Operations teams to identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, and reporting.

 Participating in initiatives focused on optimizing, automating, and scaling Trade Compliance processes through technology-enabled solutions.

 Leveraging data analytics, workflow tools, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions where appropriate, to support monitoring, investigation, and reporting activities.

 Contributing to projects that improve data quality, operational efficiency, and the effectiveness of compliance oversight.

 
 You will excel in this role if you: 
 
 Demonstrate a strong sense of integrity and personal accountability. 

 Learn and adapt to new processes, concepts, systems, and technologies quickly.

 Exhibit exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to quality.

 Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills and enjoy collaborating across functions.

 Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach to problem solving.

 Have a continuous improvement mindset and seek opportunities to enhance processes through technology and automation.

 Are comfortable learning and utilizing new tools, including data analytics and AI-enabled solutions, to improve workflows and decision-making.

 Take initiative and contribute meaningfully to the growth and evolution of the department. 

 
 You will need this experience: 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline.

 2+ years of professional experience within Compliance, Asset Management, Financial Services, or a related field.

 Basic knowledge of global fixed income and equity markets, including financial instruments such as bonds, equities, and derivatives.

 Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

 Demonstrated ability to analyze data and identify trends, anomalies, or issues requiring investigation.

 
 Additional qualifications that are helpful, but not required: 
 Experience monitoring transactions within an investment compliance system. 

 Basic familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to apply AI-enabled capabilities to improve efficiency, research, and problem-solving.

 Experience with Bloomberg or similar market data platforms.

 CFA designation or active progress toward the CFA Program.

 Exposure to automation, workflow, reporting, or data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, or similar platforms.

 Familiarity with emerging technologies and AI-enabled tools, and an interest in applying them responsibly within a regulated environment.

 Experience participating in process improvement, digital transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.

 PIMCO recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, national origin, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and expression), age, military or veteran status, disability (physical or mental), any factor prohibited by law, and as such affirms in policy and practice to support and promote the concept of equal employment opportunity and affirmative action, in accordance with all applicable federal, state, provincial and municipal laws. The company also prohibits discrimination on other basis such as medical condition, or marital status under applicable laws. 
 
 Applicants with Disabilities 
 PIMCO is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. If you have any difficulty using our online system due to a disability and you would like to request an accommodation, you may contact us at 949-720-7744 and leave a message. description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

 Abbott Ireland Diagnostic Division – Longford: 
The Longford facility plays a key role in helping Abbott to meet the increasing global demand for diagnostic testing in areas such as infectious disease, cancer, thyroid, and cardiovascular diseases.  Longford is based in the midlands of Ireland surrounded by water with the River Shannon, Lough Ree and the Royal Canal. It has a vibrant collection of communities with a rich historical background. The County has plenty to offer to both visitors and citizens in sport, culture, literature, amenities, festivals, events, retail and dining.

 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company. 

 We have an exciting opportunity as a Quality Professional working in our Quality Department and this role will involve the following

 Primary Function: 
 Conduct quality-related activities to deliver consistent, high quality documents, services, products and processes, which adds value to the business.

   Key Responsibilities: 
 ·        General Area: Contributes to defining and timely achievement of overall project goals. Provides compliant solutions to a variety of problems of moderate scope and complexity.  Interacts constructively with employees, managers and cross-functional peers. May lead a project with a limited scope, but usually a contributor on broader projects. Provides guidance to other Professionals and Technicians. Scope typically limited to one specific QA function.
 ·        Quality System Compliance:  Maintains awareness of standards that regulate our industry. Ensures compliance to site level policies and procedures by promptly reporting non-compliance issues to management within Division and Corporation as appropriate. Maintains vigilance to ensure adherence to Quality Policy and Quality system procedures by promptly reporting noncompliance issues to management.
 ·        Risk Management:  Applies basic Risk Management principles to work.
 ·        Problem Solving:  Receives general direction and exercises considerable discretion to own work detail. Recommends possible solutions.
 Ensures compliant documentation, carrying out tasks related to area of responsibility with management oversight. Decisions may have short and long term impact.
 Depending on Functional Area 
 ·        Operations Quality;  Completes process order/ documentation reviews and approvals. Completes incoming inspection of raw materials/ components per approved receiving documentation
 ·        Risk Management : Participates in the development or modification of Risk management files.
 ·        Complaint Evaluation:  Investigates complex complaints with management oversight. Provides compliant solutions to a variety of complex problems
 Ensures compliant documentation related to area of responsibility.
 ·        Design Control / Documentation & Change Control:  Identifies areas for process improvement. Provides supporting information for change including reasons and justifications. Process changes per appropriate procedure.
 ·        Validation/ Project Support : Coordinates quality decisions between different quality and engineering groups. Participates in the development or modification of validation packages, design plans, and risk management deliverables (e.g. FMEAs). Team member helping and interfacing with suppliers to deliver product meeting our quality requirements.

 Education &  Experience: 
 ·        Apprenticeship or relevant third level qualification in Life Science, Engineering, or closely related discipline is required OR relevant combination of education or experience.
 ·        At least 3 years work experience in Quality or related field experience; Less experience may be appropriate with advanced degree.
 ·        Demonstrates understanding of how their function supports the business.
 ·        Demonstrates technical and business competencies that drive results and continuous improvement.

 Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:  Abbott in Ireland | Benefits

IOB - Professional Banking Practitioner Apprenticeship 2027
Why choose between work and study when you can do both?
Looking for a role that combines real work experience, professional development, and a recognised degree qualification?

Why Join the IOB Apprenticeship Programme?
Earn while you learn
Combine paid work with part-time study over three years, gaining banking experience while completing a UCD BSc in Banking and Financial Services (NFQ Level 8).
How the programme works
Work at AIB, in one of our Retail teams, four days a week and attend IOB/UCD classes on-site or online one day a week, supported by practical experience, mentoring and learning resources.
Career opportunities
The programme is ideal for anyone interested in building a career in banking or finance, including customer service, operations, financial advice and business support.
The programme is scheduled to commence in October 2027.
Successful applicants will be required to become members of the Institute of Banking (IOB). Membership fees will be paid by AIB for the duration of the apprenticeship.
What You’ll Do:
Join AIB's Retail business and gain hands-on experience in a customer-facing banking environment.
Develop practical skills in customer service, operations, problem-solving and relationship building.
Build confidence in understanding customers' financial needs and supporting them with day-to-day banking services.
Participate in learning events, networking opportunities and professional development activities with fellow apprentices.
Progress your knowledge, skills and responsibilities throughout the programme while working towards your UCD degree qualification.
Successfully complete academic modules, workplace assessments and programme milestones over the three-year apprenticeship.
What You Will Bring:
A strong interest in developing a career in financial services.
A commitment to learning and personal development.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
A positive attitude and willingness to work as part of a team.
Applicants must be 18 years of age on or before 31 August 2027 and have the legal right to work in the Republic of Ireland.
Entry Requirements:
Applicants must meet one of the programme entry pathways:
Leaving Certificate entry route.
QQI/FET/PLC Business Studies pathway.
Equivalent international qualification.
Mature applicant route for candidates aged 23+ with relevant work experience.
Applicants may apply while awaiting Leaving Certificate or PLC results.
Please review the full programme entry criteria on the IOB programme webpage before applying.
Where relevant, applicants must also meet the English language proficiency requirements and obtain an NUI exemption. Further details are available on the IOB programme webpage .
What's in it for you?
Alongside valuable experience and development opportunities, you'll enjoy:
A paid role with one of Ireland's leading retail banks.
A fully supported pathway to a UCD Level 8 degree.
Mentoring and coaching from experienced colleagues.
Valuable workplace experience from day one.
Opportunities to develop professional, technical and customer service skills.
IOB membership fees covered by AIB throughout the programme.
Healthcare Scheme
Employee Assistance Programme
Family Leave Options
Two Volunteer Days per Year
Market-leading Pension Scheme
At AIB, our values guide how we work and how we support each other. We're looking for ambitious and motivated individuals who are ready to start their career journey while earning a qualification and gaining valuable workplace experience.
Eligibility and Equal Opportunities:
Applicants must be resident in the Republic of Ireland and be fully authorised to work, or hold a valid work permit, for the full duration of the programme. Any offer of employment will be conditional upon satisfactory evidence of the right to work in the Republic of Ireland.
AIB is an equal opportunities employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process.

title: Process Operator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

 Abbott Ireland Nutrition Division Cootehill Cavan 
 Abbott Nutrition produces a range of infant formulae in all pack sizes under the brand name “Similac”. To complement the range of “Similac” infant formulae, the facility also manufactures a range of follow-on formulae under the brand name of “Gain”. The essential ingredient is liquid skim-milk and this is combined with carbohydrate, vegetable oils, vitamins and minerals. The product is blended, pasteurised, dried and packaged at the site and once packaged, is distributed to Europe, South East Asia, the Middle East, Latin America and Canada.

 Established in 1975, Abbott Nutrition in Ireland is the largest powder manufacturing facility for the production of infant formulae within the Abbott Corporation worldwide.  Approximately 1,000 dairy farms in Ireland and Northern Ireland supply quality milk to the Cootehill facility which processes 500,000 litres per day. This secure supply together with Ireland’s reputation as a green, clean environment is of significant strategic importance to Abbott Nutrition.

 *Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company. 

 We currently have a position of Process Operator on our continental shift, and this role will involve the following:

 Primary Purpose 
 The Process Operator plays a key role in the safe, efficient, and compliant manufacture of Abbott Nutrition products. This role covers operations across milk/oil intake, ingredient preparation, processing, evaporation, and drying, ensuring all products meet Abbott and customer quality standards.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Operational Duties (General) 
 Perform routine preventative maintenance per schedule.
 Monitor environmental and process conditions and respond to spills, alarms, and system faults
 Collaborate effectively with QA and cross‑functional teams.
 Assist with non‑routine tasks and provide knowledge transfer to new operators.
 Use systems such as Teamcenter and MCS for documentation and stock updates
 .
 Area-Specific Responsibilities 

 Milk/Oil Intake 
 Verify milk certificates of analysis and QA release for oils.
 Pump deliveries, monitor tanker conditions, and carry out CIP of tankers.
 Conduct manual cleaning, sampling, and updating MCS records.
 Ensure accurate placement of milk/oil according to schedule.
 Process 
 Set up plant per manufacturing directions and pick lists.
 Process batches, weigh and add ingredients, and verify additions.
 Perform CIP of processing equipment and complete related records.
 Troubleshoot alarms/valves and inspect silo contents.
 Ingredient Preparation 
 Prepare and weigh ingredients per pick lists.
 Operate forklifts and manage stock movements using MCS and barcoding.
 Support bag‑off operations, conduct cleaning and stock checks, and comply with ATEX regulations.
 Evaporator 
 Ensure QA release and correct evaporator setup.
 Monitor CCP1 and report deviations immediately.
 Complete CIP logs, walkdowns, and maintain cGMP in high‑care areas.
 Adjust system faults and maintain filtration stock levels.
 Dryer Operations 
 Follow Change Over Matrix and hopper schedule for product changeovers.
 Conduct Dryer CIP, feed line cleaning, and record CIP details.
 Assist QA with swabbing, monitor drying operations, and sample product.
 Monitor area hygiene compliance and maintain inventory accuracy.
 
 Major Responsibilities 
 Safely and effectively operate all process equipment from intake to drying.
 Produce product in full compliance with Abbott specifications and customer requirements.
 Follow all Abbott policies, local rules, cGMP, hygiene standards, and documentation procedures.
 Maintain attention to detail across all operations.
 
 Education & Experience 
 Leaving Certificate (or equivalent).
 Experience working in the Process Team would be an advantage
 
 Knowledge, Skills & Competencies 
 Ability to interpret technical data (charts, graphs, flow rates, temperature readings).
 Strong problem‑solving and troubleshooting ability.
 Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
 Good communication skills and accountability at shift handover.
 Understanding manufacturing directions, cGMP, hygiene standards, and key plant equipment.
 Good computer literacy.
 
 Hours of Work 
 Continental Shift (4 week rotation 12hrs shifts – alternating between days and nights)
 7.30am – 7.30pm and 7.30pm – 7.30am (Monday – Sunday)

 Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:  Abbott in Ireland | Benefits 

 Connect with us at  www.abbott.com or https://www.ie.abbott/ , on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/ , on Facebook at  www.facebook.com/Abbott  and on Twitter @AbbottNews .
      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A/hour In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

 DIVISION: ANSC Nutrition Supply Chain         
 LOCATION: Ireland > Cootehill : Dromore West

 WORK SHIFT: Ie - Chprw8Pm (Ireland)

About the role
Join BT Business' Contract Management Office as a Contract Specialist supporting the commercial performance and governance of high-profile contracts. This role sits at the intersection of commercial analysis, contract management and regulatory reporting, with a particular focus on Qualifying Defence Contracts (QDCs) and compliance with Single Source Contract Regulations (SSCR).
Working closely with Finance, Programme, Project Controls and customer stakeholders, you'll provide commercial insight, analyse contract performance and ensure contractual reporting obligations are delivered accurately and on time. Whilst contract management experience is valuable, this role is primarily focused on reporting, governance and commercial performance analysis rather than contract negotiation or procurement activities.
You must either hold or be eligible for SC level clearance (at least five years continuous living in the UK) for this role.
What you’ll be doing
- Monitoring contract performance against approved cost baselines and identifying cost and resource variances.
- Producing accurate monthly commercial, financial and performance reports for internal and external stakeholders.
- Analysing forecasts, contract profitability, revenue, gross margin and cost performance trends.
- Supporting compliance with Qualifying Defence Contract (QDC) requirements and UK Single Source Contract Regulations (SSCR).
- Tracking commercial performance, cost recovery and contract margin impacts.Facilitating reviews of contract performance, risks, assumptions and financial forecasts across multiple business functions.
- Providing clear commercial insight and presenting management information to senior leaders and customer representatives.
- Supporting governance activities and ensuring contractual reporting obligations are met.Building strong relationships with Finance, Programme, Project Controls and customer stakeholders to support effective decision-making.
Essential Skills / Experience
- Experience in commercial reporting, financial analysis, contract performance management or commercial governance.
- Analytical skills with proven experience of cost tracking, variance analysis, forecasting and performance reporting.
- Advanced Excel skills with the ability to produce accurate management information and reporting for senior stakeholders.
- Stakeholder management skills and the ability to communicate complex financial and commercial information clearly.
- Knowledge of contract management principles and eligibility to obtain Security Clearance (SC).
Desirable Skills / Experience
- Experience working within the Defence, Aerospace or wider Public Sector environment.Experience supporting Qualifying Defence Contracts (QDCs).
- Knowledge of the UK Single Source Contract Regulations (SSCR).
- Understanding of regulatory reporting requirements associated with Defence contracts.
- Experience working within contract management, commercial management or project controls functions.
- Experience supporting complex customer contracts within highly regulated environments.
- Experience working with geographically dispersed or virtual teams.
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
10% on target annual bonus
Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
Equalized maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
Holiday purchase scheme
Join us at a pivotal moment for BT Business. We are executing a multi-year transformation to restore growth, modernise at scale and unlock new markets beyond connectivity. Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. This is a shift from a legacy connectivity provider to a modern, solutions-led, AI-first business that can truly differentiate in a competitive and fast-moving market.
With execution momentum building and a clear path to growth, the opportunity now is to scale what works, accelerate performance and fully realise our potential. This is about delivering against ambitious financial outcomes while transforming how we operate – creating a business that is simpler, faster, more innovative and easier to do business with.
If you want to be part of the team shaping the turnaround of a multi-billion-pound business – and building a stronger, more competitive BT for the future – this is your moment.

Dołączenie do firmy Vistra jeszcze nigdy nie było tak ekscytujące!
W Vistra naszym celem jest postęp. Wierzymy, że nasi klienci mają moc zmieniania świata i robienia wielkich rzeczy dla globalnego postępu. Istniejemy po to, aby usuwać przeszkody wynikające z zawiłości globalnego biznesu, a także, by pomagać naszym klientom osiągać postęp.
Postęp może wydarzyć się tylko wtedy, gdy ludzie zjednoczą się i podejmą działania. Jesteśmy absolutnie zaangażowani w budowanie kultury, w której nasi pracownicy mogą to robić.
Mamy dla Ciebie świetną propozycję, aby dołączyć do naszego zespołu jako Accounting Assistant, na stałe, w wymiarze pełnego etatu. Praca zlokalizowana jest w Polsce (Warszawa) i daje możliwość przyczynienia się do rozwoju naszego działu  Księgowości .
Zakres obowiązków:
Wsparcie administracyjne zespołu księgowego
Przygotowywanie dokumentów i koordynowanie obiegu korespondencji urzędowej
Dekretowanie i księgowanie wybranych dokumentów księgowych pod okiem przełożonego
Współpraca z innymi działami firmy
Pomoc w przygotowywaniu sprawozdań finansowych i raportów managerskich
Pomoc w przygotowywaniu miesięcznych deklaracji CIT i VAT
Przygotowywanie przelewów bankowych
Wymagania:
Zainteresowanie rozwojem kariery w pełnej księgowości
Studia kierunkowe – Finanse/Rachunkowość/Ekonomia/Zarządzanie
Znajomość języka angielskiego przynajmniej na poziomie B2
Pierwsze doświadczenia zawodowe w księgowości
Kompetencje analityczne
Chęć nauki i rozwoju
Co oferujemy:
Zdrowie pracowników jest dla nas ważne – otrzymasz możliwość dofinansowania do prywatnej opieki medycznej dla Ciebie i Twoich bliskich.
Dbamy o zdrowy tryb życia i aktywność sportową – otrzymasz możliwość dofinansowania do karty Multisport.
Jeżeli tak jak my cenisz sobie work-life balance, to zapewne ucieszy Cię, że umożliwiamy elastyczne godziny pracy.
Ważne jest dla Ciebie bezpieczeństwo? Otrzymasz możliwość wykupienia dodatkowego ubezpieczenia na życie.
Ponieważ chcemy wspierać Twój rozwój, umożliwimy Ci dołączenie na bezpłatne lekcje z języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego.
Gwarantujemy stabilność zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę z firmą działającą globalnie, o ugruntowanej pozycji na rynku.
Ponieważ najważniejszy jest dla nas Twój rozwój zawodowy, zapewnimy szkolenia wewnętrzne, a także dofinansowanie do szkoleń zewnętrznych lub studiów podyplomowych, a także jasną ścieżka kariery Vistra.
Mając na uwadze Twoją wygodę oraz oszczędność czasu, nasze nowoczesne biuro jest zlokalizowane w centrum miasta.
Jesteśmy świadomi ekologicznie: adoptujemy pszczoły, zachęcamy pracowników do przyjeżdżania rowerem (mamy rowerowy parking!), a nasz budynek jest eco-friendly.

title: Insurance Healthcare Trainer
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Insurance Healthcare Trainer 
 
 Job Location: Dublin
 Job Type: Permanent Role
 Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications
 We have a fantastic opportunity for a Health Insurance Trainer in Dublin. 
 Are you passionate about developing people and helping teams perform at their best? We are looking for a dedicated Training and Quality Specialist to drive learning, development and operational excellence across a dynamic, high-performing customer-focused team. This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact by equipping colleagues with the skills, knowledge and confidence they need to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business objectives.
 
 Demonstrate reliability, focus and commitment in driving the success of the account by providing training and development to a dynamic and high performing customer-centric team. Deliver training to new and existing colleagues, maintain training documents, monitor agent development, and advise on service techniques. Main point of contact for training matters with operations management.
 Working closely with Operations Management, you will design and deliver engaging training programmes for both new and existing colleagues, covering products, systems, processes and customer service skills. You will create and maintain interactive training materials, ensure compliance with quality and ISO standards, and monitor colleague development through coaching, assessments and ongoing support.
 
 As the key point of contact for all training-related matters, you will identify development opportunities through quality evaluations, root cause analysis and performance insights. You will deliver training on new systems, products and process updates, while supporting continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance and customer outcomes. In addition, you will take ownership of training administration, compliance documentation and supervision processes, helping to maintain high standards across the team.
 
 This is an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic and motivated professional who enjoys developing others, fostering a culture of continuous learning and working collaboratively to support the success of both colleagues and the wider business.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply:    
 · APA Qualification – APA qualified with a commitment to ongoing professional development.
 · Training & Coaching Expertise – Previous experience delivering training, coaching or mentoring programmes within customer service, sales, claims or similar environments.
 · F acilitation Skills – Ability to effectively demonstrate concepts, engage learners and support colleagues in developing new skills and knowledge.
 · Communication Skills – Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to adapt messages to different audiences.
 · Healthcare Knowledge – Experience within the healthcare sector is highly desirable and would be a distinct advantage.
 · Administrative Excellence – Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate training records and documentation.
 · Microsoft Office Proficiency – Competent in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
 · Insurance Industry Knowledge – Understanding of the insurance sector is highly desirable, particularly within customer service or claims environments.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply: 
 Remuneration & More 
 Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications.
 Pension Scheme.
 Holiday allowance.
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme.
 Opportunities for training and development.
 
 Health & Support 
 Employee Assistance Programme.
 Life Cover.
 Permanent Health Insurance (PHI).
 Bike to Work Scheme.
 
 Other Benefits 
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4).
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4).
 Professional and personal development opportunities.
 Support for professional memberships and examinations where applicable.
 This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry   
 At Sedgwick, not only will you be working behind the scenes for some of the UK's most trusted insurance brands helping to resolve millions of claims every year, you'll also be an architect of tomorrow's insurance landscape with Sedgwick University. Our proprietary offering is the most comprehensive training and development program in the industry with more than 15,000 courses on demand, training specific to roles, and opportunities to continue your formal education – all available to you starting from your very first day.  
 You'll join a community passionate about making a difference, where every role contributes to a larger mission; protecting people and businesses. This isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of insurance.  
 
 Next steps for you:   
 Think we'd be a great match? Apply now – we want to hear from you.   
 If you’re unsure whether you have all the skills needed then do apply – we are looking for all backgrounds from seasoned professionals to those returning to the workforce, and everyone in-between.   
 Not only that, we are proud to have a zero tolerance policy towards discrimination of any kind regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital/ family status, race, religion, sex or sexual orientation.   
 After the closing date we will review all applications and may select some applicants for an interview (which may be virtual, or in-person). 
 
 Sedgwick Ireland is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). This role is subject to the Minimum Competency Code (MCC) as set out by the CBI. This code sets out the minimum professional standard for any person providing certain financial services, in particular when dealing with consumers. This role is classified as a Controlled function ( CF7 ) and is subject to Fitness and Probity Standards, including the requirements outlined in the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. Successful candidates will receive training in relation to all regulatory requirements applicable to them. 
 
 #LI-HYBRID

JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Operating since 1946, Abbott serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products. We employ around 6,000 people across ten sites in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford, and Sligo. Abbott Ireland Diabetes Care Division Donegal: Located in Donegal Town, our Diabetes Care division manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and sensors, including the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite, and FreeStyle Libre systems. 
 
 Abbott Ireland Diabetes Care Division Donegal 
 The Abbott Diabetes Care division based in Donegal Town manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre system.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is   conditional upon the successful completion   of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company 
 
 Job Specification 
 Ability to independently data mine multiple large, complex datasets to answer specific research / investigation questions. Curiosity to dig deeper and access other documentation sources to understand the data.

 Provide real time data analysis support to manufacturing in terms of process adjustments, material performance, investigations, programming and yield analysis.

 The ability to strategically interpret statistical findings into a business significant context.

 Provide consulting on data analysis and statistical tools in support of trend analysis, root cause analysis, failure investigation, risk assessment, data management and data visualization to junior team members and engineers.

 Support technical investigations performed within the manufacturing unit.

 Assist with the introduction of analytical test methods & development trials (analysis of variance, setting acceptance criteria & capability analysis) and support efforts to reduce measurement variability.

 Work with scientists and engineers to introduce new machines, materials and processes, inputting into the design of experiments and analysis of resultant data.

 Independently manages multiple projects working with stakeholders to define business questions, timelines and objectives.

 Highly effective in presenting and communicating statistical results to various levels of personnel is required regularly.

 
 Requirements: 
 Bachelor's Degree or higher in a quantitative field (i.e. Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Statistics, Biostatistics etc.) preferred.

 Minimum of 4 years experience in a similar role.

 Proficient in a programming language such as python, R, SAS, JMP or similar.

 An understanding of probability, statistical process control, hypothesis testing, non-parametric statistics, time series analysis, linear and logistic regression etc.

 Experience with relational databases (for example: Oracle Databases, MySQL, Microsoft Access, etc.).

title: Exports Market Service Owner
description:
Job Description : 
 Job Title: Exports Market Service Owner 
 Location: St James Gate, Dublin 
 Contract: Fixed Term Contract until 30th June 2027 
 Closing Date: 6th October 2026 

 About Us 

 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments - from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

 About the Function 

 Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. 

 With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. 

 It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love. 

 About the role   
     
 We're looking for an Exports Market professional to join our team as an Export Market Service Owner, supporting our customers across global markets.

 This is a varied, cross-functional role that provides the flexibility to focus on the right customers, products and processes at the right time, with end-to-end responsibility for the Beer Order-to-Cash (OTC) process. You'll manage customer requirements from order entry through to delivery, acting as the first point of contact for customer queries while building strong relationships with global markets, production sites and third-party freight providers.

 Working in a fast-paced, process-driven environment, you'll demonstrate strong communication and influencing skills, a collaborative approach and a commitment to delivering excellent customer service. You'll take a logical approach to problem-solving, continuously looking for opportunities to simplify processes, improve ways of working and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

 Purpose of the Role 

 Reporting to the International Customer Service Centre Team Leader, you'll play a key role in delivering the Order-to-Cash process in line with CARM principles, ensuring a seamless customer experience from order placement through to delivery.

 As the voice of the customer within Diageo, you'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to resolve customer queries, support business initiatives and ensure high levels of service across your markets.

 What you'll be doing:
 Manage customer requirements from order entry through to delivery, acting as the first point of contact for all customer queries and service issues.
 Deliver the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process in line with CARM principles.
 Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, market teams, production sites and third-party logistics providers to ensure service levels are consistently achieved.
 Represent the customer within Diageo, supporting initiatives such as product change projects, the Quality Incident Resolution (QIR) process and order prioritisation during periods of supply constraint.
 Develop a strong understanding of market complexities, export processes, products and systems, including OTC, SAP, Customer Master Data, Customs & Excise and pricing.
 Manage and report on customer service KPIs, ensuring excellent service performance across your assigned markets.
 Coordinate the timely resolution of quality issues by working closely with Quality teams and production sites through the QIR process.
 Manage freight processes to ensure the most appropriate services are selected, identifying any special pre-shipment requirements while delivering the best value and supporting on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery.
 Ensure compliance with Diageo policies and standards, including CARM, C-TPAT, Health & Safety and other regulatory requirements.
 
 Experience / Skills Required 
 Educated to Leaving Certificate standard or equivalent. A third-level qualification would be advantageous.
 Alternatively, candidates should experience within a customer service or shipping environment.
 Experience of export processes, freight documentation and shipping terminology.
 Experience building and managing customer, supplier and vendor relationships.
 A high level of proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications, including Word and Excel.
 Knowledge of Customs & Excise (C&E) requirements, market-specific legislation and shipping documentation.
 Knowledge of international trade.
  
 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one
 outstanding team.

 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. 

 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application. 

 Recruitment Scam Warning 
 Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

 St James Gate

title: Systems Engineer, Managed Operations
description:
AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/(opens in a new tab)

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.

Utility Computing (UC)
European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

A day in the life
Embark on a week filled with meaningful contributions to the operation and improvement of significant software systems. You dedicate a substantial portion of your time to carefully review the operational health of services within your team's responsibility. In the process, you diligently identify anomalies and craft actionable bug reports, aspiring to enhance the overall efficiency and performance of your systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, you offer constructive feedback on change management documents and work earnestly to address your team's operational backlog. Through a collaborative effort, you strive to navigate challenges and ensure the seamless functionality of your systems. Additionally, you engage in the development and testing of scripts, hoping to provide practical solutions to enhance your workflows.

Beyond the technical aspects, you assume a role as an educator, sharing insights on the complexities of the European Sovereign Cloud with service teams. It's a humbling experience for you to contribute to the collective knowledge of the team, fostering a culture of mutual understanding.

This week encapsulates your commitment to continuous learning and improvement, acknowledging that every effort, no matter how small, contributes to the collective success of your team and the reliability of your software systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, your position involves 24x7 on-call responsibility. You work as a team to root-cause issues and ensure your systems remain resilient and fault-tolerant, underscoring your commitment to maintaining operational excellence.

Eligibility requirement
-Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
-Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
-Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the EU.
-Employees will participate in an On-Call rota.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
- Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
- Experience in Systems engineering, site reliability engineering, building and operating systems at scale
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state
- Able to lead the creation, revision, and/or improvement of standard operational procedures (SOPs) and driving operational best practices.
- Experience with monitoring frameworks (such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Elastic or similar).
- Experience actively mentoring junior engineers and working cross-organizationally and leading strategic team efforts requiring work from multiple team members
- Experience operating 24x7 high-availability, distributed software applications and performance tuning software applications and optimizing fleet utilization
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, (such as CDK, CloudFormation, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or similar)
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Generative AI technologies, including automated deployment, configuration management, continuous integration workflows, prompt engineering, model deployment, and AI-powered automation tools
