• Knowledge of Cisco products, licensing and associated sales processes.
• Experience working with Cisco CCW.
• Experience dealing with ICT distributors, vendors and suppliers.
• Understanding of ICT hardware, software and licensing.
• Experience supporting B2B customers and complex commercial opportunities.
What Success Looks Like
• Accurate and timely ICT quotations and order processing.
• Strong ownership of requests from initial quote through to completion.
• Clear communication with Sales, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
• Commercial processes and pricing controls are consistently followed.
• Issues relating to pricing, availability, orders or billing are proactively managed.
• Sales teams receive responsive, reliable support that allows them to focus more of their time on customers.

Our purpose is to connect for a better Ireland.
Our ambition is to be the number one choice for telecommunications and technology solutions, delivering for our customers today and into the future.
Our new values and behaviours reflect both who we are and who we strive to become.  They are the way that we bring our purpose to life in eir.

description:

title: Strategic Initiatives Project Specialist
description:
Company: 
 Description: 
 What can you expect: 
 An exciting opportunity to work in Mercer’s largest and most rapidly-growing business area – Investment Solutions. As part of our strategic initiatives Team the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting Mercer’s Investment Solutions strategic change agenda by helping shape plans, coordinating delivery, tracking progress against outcomes, and supporting change adoption. Mercer is one of the fastest growing investment solutions entities globally, and our client base has grown substantially over recent years and we have an ambitious trajectory for future growth.
 
 The candidate will work closely with business sponsors and business owners, internal stakeholders, senior management, external vendors, clients, and wider colleagues to coordinate and deliver on key strategic initiatives including integration activity (including M&A-related workstreams), development of operational solutions for existing and new client segments, and global alignment activities.
 
 The successful candidate will get to work in and experience a dynamic and rapidly growing area of Mercer’s business driven by strong demand across new markets and segments.
 
 We will rely on you to: 
 Support strategic planning for the Investments platform by partnering with senior leadership to translate priorities into clear goals, objectives, and actionable delivery plans.
 Coordinate the execution of strategic projects and initiatives, supporting definition of scope, deliverables, timelines, and interdependencies.
 Organize and coordinate cross-functional teams, working groups, and governance forums to drive alignment and delivery.
 Establish and maintain project plans, dashboards, and RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) to support effective stakeholder communication.
 Monitor and report initiative performance using agreed metrics and KPIs; analyze trends and identify areas for improvement and performance optimization.
 Facilitate effective communication and coordination across the Investments business, ensuring alignment across teams and departments.
 Build and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders (including senior leadership, department heads, functional teams, and external partners where relevant) to secure engagement and timely decisions.
 Support change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and adoption planning to embed new processes and ways of working.
 Identify and help mitigate risks and challenges associated with strategic initiatives; escalate issues appropriately with options and recommendations.
 Ensure delivery documentation is completed to a high standard with messaging tailored to different audiences (for example, steering committee updates, project plans, and status reporting).
 Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize processes, governance, and delivery practices within the strategic initiatives framework.
 
 What you need to have:  
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple parallel workstreams and priorities.
 Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear written updates and facilitate effective working sessions.
 Strong analytical skills to support KPI tracking, performance monitoring, and evidence based decision support.
 A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
 Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify issues early and support practical solutions.
 A strong commitment to delivery discipline and rigor (planning, governance, documentation, and follow-through).
 Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines.
 
 What makes you stand out: 
 Experience supporting strategic initiatives, transformation programs, or PMO delivery in a complex organization.
 Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to project coordination and reporting.
 Demonstrated ability to build trust and maintain effective stakeholder relationships.
 A proactive mindset with a drive to learn, improve processes, and contribute to meaningful change.
 
 
 Why join our team: 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.
 
 #MercerIS
 
 
Mercer is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Mercer, visit mercer.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Description:
Full Time  Permanent position
Hybrid role based in our Dublin City Centre offices
What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.

European Technology sits within Canada Life Group and encompasses the technology community across all European entities, including Irish Life Group, Canada Life UK, Canada Life Europe and Central Technology Services – Europe. European Technology supports the delivery of business strategy through strong collaboration, effective governance and modern, resilient technology platforms across Europe.
European Technology is entering a new phase of transformation, with an expanded mandate covering technology strategy, transformation delivery, sourcing and partnerships, data and information governance, and enterprise-wide change enablement. To support this agenda, we are recruiting an Executive Assistant to support the support to the CITO function.
The primary focus of the Executive Assistant is to provide high-quality administrative and organisational support to the CITO function. The role plays a key part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of executive schedules, meetings and operational activities, enabling leaders to manage their priorities effectively. Working as part of a wider EA network, this role supports coordination across teams and helps maintain efficient and well-organised processes in a fast-paced environment.
What you will help us to achieve
The successful candidate will:
Provide administrative support, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings and supporting effective time management.
Coordinate meetings, including room bookings, materials preparation, minute taking, and logistics to ensure smooth delivery.
Support the organisation of team events such as town halls, leadership meetings and offsites.
Assist with HR administration, including recording leave and maintaining absence records
Work with Executive Assistants across locations and time zones to support coordination of activities.
Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation and transport, ensuring necessary documentation is prepared.
Provide day-to-day office and on-site support where required (e.g. visitor coordination, meeting setup, catering).
Process expenses, invoices and other routine administrative tasks in a timely manner
Act as a key point of contact for administrative queries, responding or directing as appropriate.
Log and track IT requests, following up to ensure timely resolution
Provide administrative support to team activities and initiatives as required.
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with care and professionalism.
What you will need to be successful in the role
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Experience providing administrative or EA support in a busy or fast-paced environment.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
A professional approach and commitment to maintaining confidentiality.
Good attention to detail and a structured approach to work
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Clear written and verbal communication skills.
A collaborative and approachable style, with the ability to work with a range of stakeholders.
Flexibility and reliability, with a willingness to adapt to changing priorities.
Sound judgement to manage tasks effectively and escalate issues where appropriate.

Canada Life Group is the top-level European holding company for Great-West Lifeco’s European insurance, reinsurance, and asset management companies, with business operations in the UK, Ireland, Germany, and the Isle of Man.

European Technology supports the business strategy and collaboration of technology across all European divisions. There are multiple IT units within European Technology, each with its own individual set of technology platforms.

title: Fund Accountant
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
 
 We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.
 
 We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.
 
 Job Description Alternative Investments Associates and Accountants work as part of a team responsible for providing accounting, administration and investor servicing for hedge funds, private equity funds and closed-end registered products.
 
 Key accountabilities: 
 Individuals calculate net asset value(s) and disseminate financial and performance information to the investment advisor and their investors.

 Acting as primary fund accountant on multiple relationships, ensures all fund accounting functions are in completed in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

 Records trade information, income/expense activity and applies valuation of securities in the portfolio accounting system.

 Enters and reconciles all investor contributions and withdrawals in the partnership accounting system.

 Allocates fund level profits to individual investors for preparation and distribution of investor statements.

 Reviews and coordinates fund expense analysis and expense processing.

 Prepares fund financial statements, audit and tax schedules.

 
 Skills & experience required: 
 High school diploma or equivalent

 Basic knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

 Ability to identify and resolve/escalate complex problems with minimal guidance

 Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects and deadlines simultaneously

 Effective interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills

 Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages including Microsoft Office applications

 
 Additional information: 
 The role offers a hybrid / flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.

 
 This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship 
 
 Accessibility 
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support. 
 
 Total Rewards 
 U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.
  
 We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:
 Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

 Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

 Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

 Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

 Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

  
 We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.
 
 We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon .
   
 Closing Date 
 Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.
  
 We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

title: Logistics Specialist ( 18 Months Fixed Term )
description:
Generics [U.K.] Ltd. 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Logistics Specialist will make an impact:
 
 Key responsibilities for this role include:
 
 Provide Serve as the first point of contact and subject matter expert for logistics operations, SAP transaction support, inventory accuracy issues, system-interface failures and 3PL operational escalations.

 Monitor daily operational flows across SAP, WMS, TMS and EDI, including interface exceptions, IDoc or message failures, order updates, inventory postings and master-data related issues.

 Work closely with third-party logistics providers and internal teams to ensure service delivery in line with agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality expectations and escalation timelines.

 Support high levels of SAP inventory accuracy through timely issue investigation, stock reconciliation, transaction review, batch or lot integrity checks, and proactive defect prevention.

 Use operational data, Power BI, advanced Excel and other reporting tools to identify trends, exceptions, root causes and improvement opportunities.

 Lead or support structured root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, process mapping, standard work updates and Lean continuous-improvement initiatives.

 Support GDP and quality-compliant distribution processes, including SOP adherence, deviation support, audit-readiness activities and quality escalation where required.

 Act as a functional expert for distribution processes, WMS/TMS workflows, EDI/interface management, SAP logistics execution and end-to-end issue resolution.

Job Description : 
 Job Role: Digital & OT Cyber Coordinator
 Location:  Nangor Road Dublin, Ireland
 Contract: Permanent
 Work Pattern: Monday – Friday onsite

 About Us 
 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. 

 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. 

 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. 

 Our indulgent blend of aged Irish whiskey and luscious Irish dairy cream, with hints of cocoa and vanilla, is loved the world over and sold in over 160 countries. Produced and bottled exclusively in Ireland, Baileys is enjoyed drizzled over ice cream, swirled into coffee or simply poured over ice.

 The world's supply of Baileys comes from two production sites; Dublin and Belfast. Over 8 million cases of Baileys Original and Baileys Flavours leave the gates of these two sites every year, destined for over 130 countries worldwide.

 About the Role 
 As a Digital & OT Cyber Coordinator you will play a key role in delivering digital, data and operational technology (OT) initiatives across our Baileys sites.
 Acting as a central point of coordination between operations, engineering and digital teams you’ll support the rollout of new technologies, ensure alignment with cybersecurity and compliance standards (including GRMS and NIS2) and help embed digital tools that drive continuous improvement.
 You’ll also support OT cyber activities, manage documentation and governance and ensure risks, incidents and change activities are tracked and escalated appropriately.
 A key part of the role will involve enabling better use of data across the site—supporting the development of dashboards, reporting and visualisations that turn data into meaningful insights and support operational decision making.
 You’ll help identify data gaps, improve data quality and contribute to transformation initiatives while also supporting training, communications and digital capability building to ensure successful adoption of new tools and technologies.
 
 About You 
 The ideal candidate will bring experience from a manufacturing, engineering or production environment with a solid understanding of digital tools and operational technology systems.
 You’ll be confident operating across both technical and site-based teams bringing strong coordination and stakeholder management skills along with exposure to areas such as automation, MES, IoT or analytics tools.
 You have a proactive mindset, are detail-oriented when it comes to governance and documentation and are confident supporting initiatives from concept through to rollout.
 Ideally, you’ll also have experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI and an awareness of IT/OT networks and their convergence.
 Exposure to continuous improvement or transformation programmes would be beneficial.
 Most importantly, you’re someone who can connect the dots between technology and operations—helping translate data into actionable insights, supporting teams to build digital capability, and driving real business impact.

 Rewards & Benefits 
 We offer a competitive salary alongside a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your lifestyle and wellbeing. This includes product allowance, pension scheme, healthcare allowance, share plans as well as a range of discounts across retail and wellness. 

 Working with Us  
 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.

 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible. 
  
 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team. 
  
 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. 
  
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. 
  
 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.  
  
 Recruitment Scam Warning  
 Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 109,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 Abbott serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, medical devices and nutritionals products. In Ireland, Abbott employs over 4,000 people across nine sites. We have six manufacturing facilities located in Clonmel, Cootehill, Donegal, Longford and Sligo and a third-party manufacturing management operation in Sligo. Abbott has commercial, support operations and shared services in Dublin and Galway. We have been operating in Ireland since 1946.

 Abbott Ireland Financial Services Cherrywood Dublin 
 Abbott’s EMEA Finance Shared Services centre commenced operations in Cherrywood, Dublin in October 2015. From this location the Finance Shared Services provides processing and expertise, in local languages, to Abbott divisions and affiliate companies across EMEA. The core services are in Record to Report, Order to Cash, Source to Pay and Master data management. The Financial Shared Services hub is part of Corporate Finance and has regional counterparts in the US and in Singapore.
 

 PURPOSE OF THE JOB The successful candidate will support the planning, implementation, and operation of physical IT infrastructure projects across Abbott sites, while contributing to the reliability and continuous improvement of PI IT infrastructure platforms.

 Assist with the planning, design, and implementation of IT infrastructure solutions, including network cabling, fiber optic systems, power, cooling, security, and other technologies that support computer, phone, and communication networks.
 Support compliance with Abbott Engineering and IT standards, industry-recognized standards, and applicable regulatory requirements, including FDA, OSHA, and corporate policies, procedures, and training requirements.
 Assist in the operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of IT-managed infrastructure systems, including structured cabling, facility technologies, electrical systems, and related platforms.
 Participate in the installation and deployment of network infrastructure components, including structured cabling, wireless access points, and other network hardware.
 Support project implementation activities by collaborating with contractors, vendors, and project teams during infrastructure installations and site construction activities.
 Develop and maintain professional working relationships with customers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to support project and operational objectives.
 Provide technical support and problem-solving assistance for infrastructure projects and operational activities under the guidance of senior team members.
 Create and maintain accurate technical documentation to support implementation, operations, compliance, and quality requirements.
 Collaborate with suppliers, contractors, and technical partners to support project planning, deployment, and operational activities.
 Assist with project status reporting, documentation updates using approved project management tools and processes.
 Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple assignments concurrently while meeting project timelines and deliverables.
 Strong customer-focused mindset with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
 Travel of approximately 25% is required to support project execution and operational activities across domestic and international Abbott locations.
 Ability to perform independently while also contributing effectively to a team-oriented environment to support business needs and project objectives.
 
 EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES REQUIRED 1-3 years IT infrastructure support with multinational enterprises.
 
 EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES PREFERRED Familiarity with the design, installation, and maintenance of Layer 1 physical infrastructure, including structured cabling systems.
 Familiarity with power distribution and supporting infrastructure technologies, including Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), Power Distribution Units (PDUs), Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), and related electrical systems, is preferred.
 Familiarity with IT service management and ticketing platforms, such as ServiceNow, or similar enterprise support systems, is preferred.
 Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and related business applications, including Outlook, Visio, Word, Excel, and collaboration tools used to support project delivery, documentation, and communication.
 Reliable personal transportation, along with valid and current documentation required for vehicle operation, is a requirement of this position.
 Experience working in healthcare, life sciences, or other highly regulated environments is preferred.
 Exposure to network infrastructure initiatives supporting acquisitions, divestitures, or business integration activities is a plus.
 Familiarity with data center environments, including critical power, cooling, and physical infrastructure systems, is advantageous.

title: Software Development Engineer, Network Fabric Engineering
description:
Amazon Web Services is looking for talented software engineers to join us in building the software systems that power the world's largest network. You'll work on distributed systems and AI-driven solutions that transform how networks operate, where software makes intelligent decisions and automation handles the mechanics. In this role, you'll take ownership of meaningful technical challenges while collaborating with a skilled team to shape the future of network infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop software solutions that integrate seamlessly into our distributed system architecture
- Own the complete development lifecycle for assigned features, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support
- Collaborate across teams to understand requirements, share technical insights, and ensure solutions align with broader system goals
- Contribute to team growth by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and supporting the development of other engineers
- Identify and drive technical and process improvements that enhance system reliability, performance, and team productivity

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer, you'll focus on designing and implementing software solutions within our distributed ecosystem. Your day might include architecting components that integrate with our larger system, writing and reviewing code with teammates, and troubleshooting production systems to ensure reliability. You'll participate in design discussions with colleagues, mentor other engineers on the team, and contribute to our technical strategy. Beyond coding, you'll help identify ways to improve our processes and tools, ensuring our team operates efficiently and delivers value to both internal and external customers.

Our team values shared ownership, continuous learning, and supporting one another's growth. We work in small, autonomous teams where your contributions directly impact our customers and the broader organization. Together, we're building the infrastructure that enables intelligent, automated decision-making at scale. We're excited to welcome someone who is ready to grow with us, contribute fresh perspectives, and help us tackle some of the most interesting technical challenges in the industry.

title: Consultant Financial Crimes Investigator x2
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 About The Role:

 The Consultant Financial Crimes Investigator role will be responsible for utilizing analytical skills and innovative strategies to detect, prevent, and report fraudulent activities at Northern Trust. This role will operate within a fast paced and dynamic global fraud team that is instrumental in protecting our clients against financial fraud.  
   
   
   
 Daily activities include, but are not limited to:   
 • Utilize advanced data analysis techniques to detect and prevent fraud within client facing applications. Review comprehensive daily reports to identify anomalous patterns, transactions, or behaviors that may indicate unauthorized activity or fraud.   
 • Review and verify login anomalies and suspicious transactions to identify or prevent policy violations, identity theft, and financial crimes by means of web-based and internal system research, coordinated efforts through cross-functional partnerships, client and internal partner notifications and interviews.   
 • Analyze datasets from various sources and systems to identify and prevent potentially fraudulent activity. Research complex account movements that may involve multiple transaction channels, accounts, or client relationships.   
 • Review and authenticate alerts generated by the Internal Fraud Detection systems. Validate transactions and activities using data from multiple sources. Escalate cases as needed to managers, HR and Fraud Investigations.   
 • Leverage advanced skills and subject matter expertise to work independently, within an established fraud research and mitigation framework, to detect and respond to identity theft, scams and fraud risks appropriately and effectively.   
 • Conduct thorough and well documented analysis, in accordance with policy and procedures. Consult with cross-functional departments to validate or invalidate suspicious transactions, and take appropriate proactive action to protect clients and the bank from additional fraud exposure.   
 • Maintain the integrity of highly sensitive data, analysis, and confidentiality of systems, policies and case details, and ensure that all fraud prevention efforts are executed in compliance with relevant laws and regulations.   
 • Communicate findings, trends, and potential risks to the fraud team and management, to aid in strengthening the bank’s preventative posture and enhancing the fraud program.   
   
   
 Qualifications: 
 • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with complex data.   
 • Knowledge of Actimize Xceed / Guardian Analytics preferred.   
 • Current and historical knowledge of malware variants and common attack vectors.   
 • Experience in phone interviewing for the identification of client impersonators and scams.   
 • Understanding of common industry client Authentication processes, tools and Internet Security.   
 • Ability to identify potential fraudulent or suspicious accounts and activities and take appropriate action to prevent loss. Display good judgement in a fast-paced and results-driven environment.   
 • General understanding of commercial web browsers such as Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome, and Safari.   
 • General understanding of computer networking, including but not limited to; local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), internet service provision (ISP), internet protocol (IP), local machine and group security policies, firewalls, and web proxy/content filtering.   
 • General understanding of end-user operating systems, including Windows and Apple OS.   
 • General understanding of traditional money movement transactions, systems and fintech.   
 • Experience with advanced data analysis tools (i.e. power BI, advanced Excel, link analysis, R / Python, OSINT, etc.)   
 • Several years relevant work experience is preferred. Related Industry qualification (e.g., ACAMS, CFE) or studying towards, is preferred.   

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Data Center Infrastructure Engineer Internship 2027
description:
Join our Field Engineering team and gain hands-on experience supporting the technical infrastructure that powers Amazon Web Services. You'll work alongside experienced engineers to troubleshoot complex systems, contribute to data center optimization projects, and develop expertise in hyper-scale facility operations while learning how cutting-edge technologies keep our data centers running efficiently.

As an intern you will work with leading-edge technologies and equipment and learn how hyper-scale data centers are able to operate efficiently and with minimal downtime. You will work with tenured Field Engineers (FEs), allowing you to learn and experience the day-to-day activities in a fast-paced and high-tech industry. You will support with deep dives into operational events and may also be given your own projects to run, exposing you to internal systems and operational processes. 

Key job responsibilities
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
• Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
• Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
• Interface with internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
• Work on concurrent projects.
• Support new construction projects during design, build, commissioning, and handover.

A day in the life
As a Field Engineering Intern, you'll immerse yourself in the dynamic environment of Amazon data centers, where you'll collaborate with seasoned Field Engineers on real operational challenges. Your day might include investigating equipment failures and documenting root cause analyses, reviewing complex operating procedures with operations teams, or supporting the design and implementation of data center upgrades that enhance capacity and efficiency. You'll participate in concurrent projects ranging from new construction commissioning to facility optimization initiatives, gaining exposure to internal systems and operational processes. Working across multiple technical domains—from electrical and mechanical systems to environmental considerations—you'll develop a comprehensive understanding of how we maintain reliability and performance at scale.

About the team
We are the Field Engineering team, serving as the technical backbone for AWS Data Center Operations across multiple regions. Our mission is to provide electrical and mechanical expertise throughout the complete lifecycle of our data centers—from initial design through ongoing optimization and maintenance. We collaborate closely with design engineering, server hardware, environmental health and safety, and other partner teams to establish standards that ensure consistency and reliability in the services we deliver. title: Maintenance Support Engineer
description:
Career Category Maintenance Job Description Maintenance Support Engineer – Syringe Filling Operations 

 Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients 
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer.  As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

 Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 Position Summary 

 The Maintenance department support Engineer is responsible for day-to-day commercial support within the maintenance department. The role will span numerous areas such as, but not limited too, shutdown coordination, engineering reliability projects, supporting and leading all quality non-conformances and leading maintenance equipment RCA’s, leading and coordinating all training-related activities within the maintenance department of a pharmaceutical syringe filling plant. 

 There will also be a training aspect of this role which ensures that maintenance personnel are effectively onboarded, trained, and continuously developed to support safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing operations. The position also plays a key role in building and sustaining a high-performing training hub aligned with site training academy initiatives.

 Key Responsibilities 

 1. Support Maintenance Reliability and Shutdown Planning 
 The Maintenance support engineer is responsible for improving the reliability, availability, and maintainability of plant equipment and utilities within the ADL manufacturing facility. The role focuses on leading and developing shutdown planning and sustaining a robust reliability framework that ensures right-first-time maintenance execution, minimises unplanned downtime, and optimises asset lifecycle performance in support of safe, compliant, and efficient operations.
 The role partners closely with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, and Quality to analyse equipment performance, identify failure modes, and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies. The Maintenance Reliability Engineer also leads continuous improvement initiatives to reduce non-commercial time, improve equipment uptime, and increase overall plant availability.
 
 2. Hiring & Onboarding Coordination (Maintenance Department) 
 Coordinate all hiring logistics for maintenance technicians in partnership with HR and maintenance leadership.
 Lead onboarding processes, ensuring a structured and compliant induction for all new hires.
 Serve as the primary point of contact for new maintenance employees during onboarding.
 Ensure all onboarding documentation, training assignments, and compliance requirements are completed on time.
 
 3. Training Program Development (Syringe Filling Lines) 
 Design, develop, and implement technical training programs for new and existing syringe filling lines.
 Collaborate with SMEs (Subject Matter Experts), engineering, and operations to ensure training content reflects current equipment, processes, and regulatory requirements.
 Standardize training materials, work instructions, and qualification processes across all syringe lines.
 Incorporate safety, GMP, and operational excellence principles into all training curricula.
 
 4. Maintenance Technician Training & Onboarding Program 
 Develop, implement, and continuously improve a structured onboarding and qualification program for new maintenance technicians.
 Define competency frameworks, training pathways, and certification requirements.
 Monitor trainee progress and provide feedback to supervisors and stakeholders.
 Identify skill gaps and implement targeted development plans for both new and existing technicians.
 
 Qualifications & Experience 

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical or Chemical)
 Manufacturing experience in biopharmaceutical Formulation/Fill/Finish or Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) facilities
 Solid leadership, technical writing, and communication/presentation skills
 Strong understanding of GMP, regulatory requirements, and training compliance standards.
 Proven experience in training program development, technical training, or learning & development.
 Experience working with maintenance teams, equipment, and troubleshooting processes is highly desirable.
 
 Skills & Competencies 

 Excellent strategic planning and demonstrated project management skills
 Strong organizational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
 Instructional design and training delivery expertise.
 Analytical mindset with the ability to track and improve training effectiveness.
 Leadership capability with a focus on coaching and developing others.
 High attention to detail and commitment to quality and compliance.
 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

 Time-to-competency for new maintenance hires
 Training completion and compliance rates
 Effectiveness of training programs (assessment results, performance improvements)
 Reduction in maintenance-related deviations linked to skill gaps
 Continuous improvement of training materials and programs
 
 Reporting Structure 

 Reports to: Maintenance Manager / Site Training Lead (as applicable)
 Key Interfaces: HR, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Training Academy
 
 What you can expect of us 
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. 

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

 Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team. careers.amgen.com 
 As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

 Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

 We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities, consistent with legal requirements. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: International Operations Business
description:
The IO Business Graduate track is designed for internationally minded Master’s graduates with a background in business, marketing, management, innovation or similar, who are curious about how commercial strategy is shaped and executed across markets. Through rotations in affiliates, regional offices and/or IO Strategic Operations HQ, you will develop broad commercial insight, build an international network and contribute to creating impact for patients and the business.
The International Operations Business Graduate Programme is designed to develop the next generation of international leaders. With offices in 80 countries, the programme ensures ample on the job experiences, with the opportunity to bring your business understanding into play in a multicultural network during your international assignments.
Start your career on 1 September 2027. Applications are open here from 16 December 2026 to 5 January 2027. Until then follow Novo on LinkedIn to get a better feeling of who we are.
Please note that we also offer the Global Business Graduate programme. Read more about it here.
Reaching 95% of the world across 195 countries, International Operations is the largest operational unit in Novo. Its scale is as staggering as its impact. About 588 million people are living with diabetes in these countries and an estimated 1.4 billion live with obesity. Every day International Operations delivers care to more than 36.5 million patients.
International Operations (IO) is split into four regions, spread across every continent of the globe, with our head office, IO Strategic Operations, based in Zurich, Switzerland.
As an International Operations Business Graduate, you will build a broad understanding of International Operations through rotations across affiliates, regional offices/business areas, Global functions and/or IO Strategic Operations HQ. You will take on assignments that allow you to contribute directly to patients, create value for the business and learn from talented commercial professionals across the globe.
An example IO Business Graduate journey could look like this, and will include rotations across different commercial functions within International Operations:
1.  Regional Office or Business Area: Develop a regional perspective on commercial strategy and execution across a cluster of countries, while understanding how priorities are shaped, aligned and translated into local market impact.
2.  IO Strategic Operations HQ: Understand IO’s strategic priorities and how they are translated across regions and markets, while building skills in stakeholder management, commercial planning and cross functional collaboration.
3.  Brand Marketing team, local affiliate: Build on your value chain understanding by gaining hands-on experience with existing brands and/or new product launches in an affiliate, while learning how brand strategies are executed locally to create impact for patients and the business.
Working at Novo is your opportunity to embark on a life changing career to accelerate your personal and professional capabilities while delivering exciting results and making a significant difference to patients and society.
Throughout the programme, you will gain hands-on experience with transforming data into business insights, developing recommendations and creating measurable business impact. You will work with senior management and build an international network of colleagues, establishing yourself as one of tomorrow’s key commercial talents at Novo.
During the two years, you will benefit from accelerated personal and professional development through one-on-one sparring with a senior mentor, as well as a tailored learning journey combining training, development activities and peer learning. Furthermore, you will build international experience by working abroad in one of our many affiliates or regional offices, while joining an exclusive graduate community across programmes, with social activities and inspiring colleagues to collaborate with and learn from.
For the positions starting 1 September 2027, we are looking for candidates with:
A recent Master’s degree from 2026 or 2027 in a relevant field, for example within International Business, Marketing, Business Administration, Innovation Management or similar study field
No more than one year of full time work experience between or after completing a Master’s degree
International experience gained through studies abroad, internships or volunteering
Relevant work experience from internships, student jobs, or extra-curricular activities obtained next to your studies
Globally mobile, both during and after the graduate programme
Adaptability, courage to experiment and confidence in decision making

title: Global Tax
description:
We have experienced a very high interest for becoming a graduate at Novo Nordisk starting 1 September 2026. The application period ended 7 December 2026. We are reading applications now and first interviews for selected candidates will take place from 16-23 January 2026. Read more about the  application process.
The Global Tax Graduate Programme is designed to develop the next generation of Tax leaders. With three rotations across our global tax organisation, the programme will provide you with the opportunity to bring your tax, accounting and business understanding into play to make a difference to patients and society.
Start your career 1 September 2027. Apply here from November 2026. Until then  follow Novo Nordisk on LinkedIn  to get a better feeling of who we are. We welcome applications from all over the world.
At Novo Nordisk, our commitment to sustainability is deeply embedded in the way we manage taxes across the global tax organisation. As part of our sustainable ambition, we are dedicated to managing taxes in a business-anchored, responsible, and transparent manner that supports balanced and competitive tax rates. Our responsibilities include proactively managing tax risks, maintaining open and constructive dialogue with tax authorities to reduce uncertainty, and ensuring compliance with international transfer pricing standards and local regulations.
As part of this approach, we also make use of mechanisms available in relevant jurisdictions to secure competitive tax outcomes in a sustainable and compliant way.
About the Global Tax Graduate Programme
Fast-track to success! This full-time position offers you the chance to experience three exciting jobs in just two years. You will work in various functions across our global tax organisation, with the opportunity of a fast-learning track in different areas and geographic locations - ensuring a strong tax toolbox, including knowledge of digital tools, and a holistic understanding of Novo Nordisk and the pharmaceutical industry.
Working at Novo Nordisk provides the opportunity to make a significant difference to patients and society while also delivering exciting results from a tax perspective.
As you’ll be working towards an ambitious career, we will provide you with:
Accelerated personal and professional development through one-on-one sparring with a senior mentor assigned to you from day one and an extensive, custom-built training programme.
International experience by working abroad for at least eight months in one of our affiliates (e.g., USA, Denmark, Zurich etc.).
Broad and international network of colleagues, chance to work with senior stakeholders and exposure to senior management.
A competitive entry level salary.
Throughout the programme you will gain hands-on experience with transforming data into business insights, with major learnings in the following areas:
1.    Tax Compliance in Pharma : Acquire knowledge of international tax, build Tax Technical understanding, exposure to other business functions
2.    Risk mitigation and reporting:   Risk assessment and methodology experience, mitigation and controls implementation, partnering to drive business value
3.    Digital Processes and Capabilities: Acquire and automation of processes, using technology to improve efficiency, communication, culture and branding
For positions starting 1 September 2027, we are looking for candidates with:
A recent Master’s degree from 2026 or 2027, demonstrating above-average academic achievements within tax, law, economics, accounting or similar
No more than 1 year of full-time work experience between or after completing a Master’s degree
International experience, for example from studying abroad, working or volunteering
Relevant work experience from internships, student jobs, or extracurricular activities, with a maximum of 1 year of full-time work experience between or after completing your Master's degree
Fluency in both spoken and written English

description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Excited by the pace of AI and the chance to build something meaningful? Join our growing Innovation team in Dublin and help create next-generation applications using the latest tools, technologies, and ideas. AI is a huge part of what we do — but we’re an innovation team first, applying whatever emerging technology best solves the problem, from LLMs to data, integration, and automation. 
 
 You’ll work alongside experienced and curious colleagues in a collaborative environment that encourages exploration, learning, and shared problem-solving. With strong support from senior leaders and visibility across the business, the team is well placed to develop, test, and scale new solutions. Your work will be visible, valued, and connected to key priorities from day one.   
 
 This is a hybrid position with a requirement of 3 days in the office. 

 
 THE ROLE & YOUR MISSION   
 

 This is an opportunity to grow as an engineer while building, testing, and scaling solutions that make a real difference. As a mid-level member of the team, you’ll take ownership of features and components end to end, turning ideas into practical applications that address real business and client needs — with AI and LLMs the biggest part of the toolkit, alongside data, integration, and automation. Alongside hands-on engineering, you’ll help shape our innovation hub by contributing to hackathons, engaging with the broader tech community, and supporting a culture centered on experimentation, learning, collaboration, and results.   
 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO   
 

 Own medium-scale features and components end to end, from prototyping through to production-ready solutions, with senior guidance available when you need it   

 
 Contribute to design discussions, bringing sound technical reasoning and viable suggestions to the table   

 
 Build practical applications — AI-powered and otherwise — that address real business problems and deliver measurable value   

 
 Work closely with colleagues across our Dublin and international Innovation teams, while taking initiative and contributing your own ideas   

 
 Work in an Agile environment where you can experiment, learn quickly, and see the impact of your work   

 
 Stay hands-on with the latest AI tools, models, and techniques, with ongoing opportunities to learn, test, and evolve   

 
 Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and follow good practice in prompt engineering, experimentation, and solution design   

 
 Create reusable components, tools, and patterns that help the wider team work more effectively and consistently   

 
 Share what you learn, support technical quality, and help junior colleagues grow through code reviews and pairing   

 

 WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT   
 
 This is a chance to accelerate your career in a team that’s growing quickly and working with purpose. You’ll own meaningful work, explore the latest technologies, and develop your craft while helping shape how we build. With strong leadership support, visibility across the business, and access to the resources of a global organization, you’ll have the platform to make a genuine impact while continuing to grow. And you’ll do it from Dublin, one of Europe’s most dynamic and well-connected tech hubs.   

 
 What you need to have: 
 
 Solid software engineering experience (typically 2–5 years), with a track record of delivering features independently   

 
 Experience contributing to production-grade applications   

 
 Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, including a framework such as React, Vue, or Angular   

 

 Backend experience with Node.js, NestJS, or similar technologies   

 
 Experience using Python to build AI-powered workflows, integrations, or applications   

 
 Good understanding of APIs and integrating AI into real-world products and business processes   

 
 Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, tool use, and structured outputs   

 
 Familiarity with RAG, retrieval pipelines, and embeddings   

 
 Exposure to modern agent patterns and multi-step, tool-connected workflows   

 
 Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes, and an interest in how AI applications are deployed and scaled   

 
 Good communication skills, a practical and thoughtful approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work across engineering and business teams   

 

 What makes you stand out:   
 

 Experience taking features from early experimentation through to production use   

 
 Curiosity about emerging standards in the agent ecosystem, including Model Context Protocol (MCP)   

 
 Exposure to vector databases and semantic search   

 
 An eye for the quality, reliability, latency, and cost-efficiency of AI systems   

 
 Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, and guardrails for reliable and responsible AI   

 
 A willingness to support others and contribute to engineering best practices   

 

 We know that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. If you’re excited about the role and believe you could thrive in it, we encourage you to apply.   
 
 Why join our team: 
 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders. 
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities. 
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. 
 
 #MMCIC
 
 

 
 
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs.

title: Recruitment Process FAQ, Experienced Professionals
description:
Skip to main content Recruitment Process FAQ, Experienced Professionals
Explore our Recruitment Process FAQs for answers to common questions and insights into what to expect when you apply to join the Azets team.
Here you'll find answers to common questions about applying to Azets, our hiring process, and what to expect as you move through the different stages. We're here to help you every step of the way as you explore career opportunities with us.
Do you accept applications from overseas candidates?
We are typically unable to consider applications from overseas candidates, only in exceptional circumstances. This is due to the complexities associated with visa sponsorship and relocation.
What should I include in my application?
Your application should include a CV tailored to the position you are applying for. Make sure to highlight your relevant experience, skills, and why you are interested in the position. You can start your application directly on our current opportunities page.
Who can I contact if I have questions about my application?
Any enquiries about a role ahead of applying please contact our recruitment team at recruitment@azets.co.uk
What is the recruitment process like?
We believe that a recruitment process should be clear and straightforward. Here's what you can expect:
Application Submission: Submit your application through our careers page, tailoring your CV and cover letter to the role you are applying for.
Initial Screening: Our Talent Acquisition Team will review your application to see how well your qualifications and experience align with the role’s requirements.
Interviews: Our Talent Acquisition team will invite you to a phone call or video call where they will explore your experience and answer any initial questions about Azets and the role. They will also outline the process for the role that you have applied for. The number of further interview stages will depend on the complexity and seniority of the role you have applied for.
Job Offer: You will receive a verbal offer, followed by formal paperwork delivered digitally which will include an offer letter, contract and information about the benefits available to you upon joining Azets.
Onboarding: Once we receive your signed paperwork back, we will begin your onboarding process. During this time, you will received all the details you need to start your journey at Azets smoothly. Our comprehensive onboarding process ensures you’re well-prepared to join your new team and start contributing from day one.
How can I prepare for an interview?
You will be sent additional interview guidance prior to your interview. We recommend using the STAR method to prepare for interviews. The STAR method helps you structure your answers to behavioral interview questions by focusing on the following components:
Situation : Describe the context within which you performed a task or faced a challenge at work.
Task : Explain the actual task or challenge that was involved.
Action : Detail the specific actions you took to address the task or challenge.
Result : Share the outcomes or results of your actions.
By using the STAR method, you can provide clear and concise answers that highlight your skills and experiences effectively.
Do you offer apprenticeships, internships or graduate programs?
Yes, we offer a range of internship, school leaver, graduate and apprenticeship programs. Full information can be found on our (link to) Early Careers page.
Can I apply for multiple roles at once?
Yes, you can apply for multiple positions that match your skills and interests. However, we recommend tailoring your application to each specific role.
How long does the recruitment process take?
Answer: The recruitment process can vary depending on the position and the number of applicants. On average, it takes about 4-6 weeks from a successful application submission to job offer.
What does the onboarding experience look like?
Pre-boarding : Before your first day, you'll receive a welcome message with practical information about your start date, induction information, contact persons, and an overview of your first day. We'll also prepare your IT equipment to ensure you have everything you need.
First Week : During your first week, you'll meet your colleagues, get introduced to different departments, and receive basic training. This helps you get acclimated to your new role and the company culture.
First Month : You'll continue to receive support and training to help you become more comfortable and productive in your role.

 Reporting to a Senior Private Markets Director, the Investment Specialist will assist the team with private market portfolio construction, manager selection, client engagement, asset class research as well as involvement in ad hoc projects.   You will have the opportunity to collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marsh’s Investments business and have unrivalled access to industry experts across the world.
  
 This role will be based in Dublin, with a requirement to work three days per week in the office.
  
 We will rely on you to: 
   
 Work closely with our Private Market Investment Solutions team to support the delivery of our solutions and advice to clients and prospects across UK & Europe
 Liaise with our asset class teams to track new themes and opportunities in private markets as well as engaging with asset managers for their latest views and portfolio positioning
 Support the communication and delivery of our latest thinking on private market asset classes and portfolio construction activities to clients
 Support our sales and consulting colleagues in the marketing and communication of our Private Markets capabilities
 Prepare client updates including performance reviews, commitment plans as well as informational slides on private market asset classes
   
 What you need to have: 
   
 Minimum two years investment consulting or investment management experience in a client-supporting role OR, be a recent graduate within an actuarial / mathematics / finance related discipline.
 No prior private markets experience required, although need to show a strong desire to build a career in the area

 Private markets investment experience.

 Supply Planner - Onsite Role, Carrigtwohill 

 Position Summary: 

 We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Supply Planner to manage supply planning activities across a designated product portfolio. Reporting to the Supply Planning Manager, this role is responsible for developing executable supply plans, ensuring product availability, optimizing inventory, and supporting key supply chain KPIs. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and problem-solver, with the ability to analyze data, manage complexity, and influence stakeholders across the organization.
 

 What you will do: 

 Develop and maintain mid- to short-term supply plans based on demand forecasts, inventory targets, and capacity constraints.
 Collaborate with procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and demand planning teams to ensure accurate and timely execution of supply plans.
 Monitor supply chain performance metrics such as inventory turns, service level, and supply plan adherence.
 Identify and escalate supply risks or constraints, propose mitigation actions, and support decision-making in cross-functional forums.
 Ensure supply plans are accurately reflected in ERP and planning systems; maintain planning parameters (lead times, MOQ, safety stock, etc.).
 Support the S&OP process with data inputs, plan assumptions, and scenario modeling.
 Take financial accountability for inventory related to assigned portfolio (e.g., target setting, aging analysis, write-off risk, and reporting).
 Work closely with finance and supply planning leadership to balance inventory levels and working capital objectives.
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in supply planning processes, tools, and data accuracy.
 

 What you will need: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Accountancy or related field.
 2-3 years of experience in supply planning, production planning, or related supply chain functions.
 Solid understanding of supply planning principles, inventory management, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kinaxis, OMP).
 Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and planning/reporting tools.
 APICS/CSCP certification or ongoing pursuit is a plus.
 Experience in [industry, if applicable — e.g., manufacturing, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals] is preferred.

title: Investment Analyst
description:
About us   
 At Davy, it's the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team - you are a key player in shaping our future. 
At Davy, you are the difference. 
Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors. 
Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally. 
 
 About the role  
 An exciting opportunity has arisen for the position of Investment Analyst in the Davy Select division of Davy. The Davy Select online investment platform enables investors to manage a wide range of pension and personal investment products within a single, integrated solution. Davy Select provides execution-only services via both online and telephone channels, supporting direct clients as well as clients of intermediary firms. The platform is focused on helping clients achieve their financial objectives through access to a broad selection of competitively priced investments, underpinned by a high standard of service.
  
 Reporting to the Head of Investments, the successful candidate will collaborate closely with the wider Davy Investment Team and senior management within Davy Select. The role will focus on enhancing the delivery of investment solutions and improving the measurement of their impact across both Intermediary and Direct business channels.
 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Assist in operating and overseeing the development of investment solutions across all business channels in Davy Select;
 Work directly with senior management on the launch of new Investment Products from Davy Select;
 Manage complex and critical model management operations for a range of investment solutions within Davy Select;
 Continuously improve the organisation’s ways-of-working around investment selection, portfolio construction and fund lists, establishing strong relationships across all business and operations areas;
 Work with the Davy Investment team on Investment Strategy & Investment Selection initiatives;
 Act as a point of contact for all queries relating to investment issues between the Davy Select Account Managers and Independent Financial Advisers;
 Provide investment analysis on funds and strategies as required;
 Contribute at intermediary and client events, internal investment seminars and client meetings;
 Provide input for and maintain investment content for the Davy Select website;
 Attend investment conferences and seminars as required for either CPD or as part of input to investment reports. 
 Requirements 
 About you   
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills: 
 Degree in a business/finance related discipline
 Minimum 3 years experience in the Investment Industry
 Qualifications – Holder or working towards CFA and QFA qualifications
 Excellent analytical and quantitative skills
 Interest and understanding of investments and financial markets
 Strong communication skills and ability to build stakeholder relationships
 High level of accuracy with strong attention to detail
 Excellent information technology capability, including a high level of competence in Microsoft Office products;
 An ability to prioritise own workload 
 
 Fitness and Probity 
 The position set out above is defined in the Fitness & Probity Standards issued by the Central Bank of Ireland (“Fitness & Probity Standards”) as a “Controlled Function (CF)”, namely CF3, CF4, CF10. Therefore there is a requirement to hold, or be willing to take one of the following exams: APA (Regulation & Investment) or Registered Stockbroker or QFA and since function relates to Pensions: APA (Pensions). In compliance with the Fitness and Probity Standards applicable to your position, any offer of employment is conditional upon you demonstrating that you meet the Fitness & Probity Standards.
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.   
 Health and Wellbeing   
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.  
 Reward and Recognition   
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.  
 Growth and Development   
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.  
 Positive Workplace   
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.  
 Values and Culture   
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.   
 Important Information  
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.
