In this role, you'll work with customers, leadership, and peers to automate and invent new ways of operating the AWS network. You'll build best practices, improve operational procedures, and deliver iterative impact with a proactive mindset. You'll collaborate across AWS to deliver the highest standards of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost. You'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. You'll be responsible for building software services that deploy and scale the Amazon networks supporting AWS, customers, and other business units across multiple global datacenters.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. - Develop tools and processes that collect and rationalize data from multiple sources to reduce workloads

- Partner with Network Engineering teams for fast, smooth software roll-outs
- Identify and troubleshoot recurring platform issues; escalate effectively to senior engineering teams

The broader CFE organization focuses on designing cost-effective CLOS topologies, maximizing port availability, and managing the full platform lifecycle—from hardware qualification through decommissioning. title: Software Development Engineer - Elasticache, AWS ElastiCache
description:
Build the next-generation in-memory database services!

The AWS In-Memory Databases team uses ideas from several facets of computer science – data storage, distributed computing, and more – to help customers build low latency and fast performance NoSQL systems. 

ElastiCache, a fully-managed in-memory data store compatible with Valkey, Redis OSS, and Memcached, enables customers to build data-intensive apps or boost existing database performance by retrieving data from high throughput and low latency in-memory data stores.

MemoryDB, a Valkey and Redis OSS compatible, durable, in-memory database service, delivers ultra-fast performance for modern, micro services applications.

Our high availability and scalable in-memory distributed services are powered by open source and optimized for sub-millisecond latency at scale. We are influencing the direction of NoSQL systems throughout the industry – and we want you to be a part of it.

We are seeking motivated, passionate backend engineers to work with in-memory database technologies including Valkey, Redis and Memcached. You will use your analytical, design, and problem-solving skills to help us build next-generation technologies for fast/high scale in-memory solutions across diverse industry use cases.

Our team understands and values work life balance. Most days, our entire team is co-located in the Dublin office, but support occasional remote work if needed. We generally keep core in-office hours from 10am to 4pm and provide flexibility for people to structure their working hours around them.

The role involves day time on-call responsibilities, typically once every 2-3 months. We don’t like to get paged in the middle of the night or on weekends; so we investigate operational gaps on a weekly basis, proactively root-cause issues and fix them for good.

Our team has a mixture of engineers from diverse backgrounds and tenures. We are dedicated to supporting new team members through on-boarding buddies and mentorship.

We try to assign projects based on each team member’s unique background and provide them opportunities to learn new skills to make them better rounded engineers. We celebrate knowledge sharing and encourage each member to participate and learn through team wide design reviews.

Our team is intentional in building a daily work environment where mutual respect, equity and positive recognition of differences are cultivated. We seek diverse perspectives in our team meetings and respect honest feedback to help us make effective decisions.

Elastic Cache is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

title: Software Development Engineer, Lambda - Experience
description:
AWS Lambda’s goal is nothing less than to simplify and improve the experience of computing in the cloud for every developer on the planet, from startups to the largest Fortune 100 companies. Serverless computing is rapidly changing how every company thinks about building and delivering software solutions, and Lambda is leading this industry wide effort.

Our Team

AWS Lambda is growing in Dublin, Ireland and our goal is to continue to define the Serverless revolution. In the Lambda team you will be joining a team where the entire development of the service occurs in Dublin. You will have the opportunity to impact the service roadmap in a meaningful way as the existing team team has done for recent deliverables like AWS Lambda Runtime Management Controls, AWS Lambda Extensions, AWS Lambda Container Support plus a host of new Language runtimes. You will own and implement specific components, build highly available, secure, scalable, distributed, event-driven systems and help to define the system architecture. This is a full-stack development position on a large distributing computing platform.

What does it take to succeed in this role?

You should be comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. You should be intellectually curious, always looking to learn and be dedicated to turning the software developers that use Lambda to build modern applications into fans of the service. You should be somebody who aspires to make the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future

What you should expect?

If you're excited by defining how modern and future software applications are built and want to help lead from the innovative edge, we guarantee that your work in our team will be ground-breaking and challenging. We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Together, we’ll deliver the next generation of industry-leading compute features and help every business from the smallest startups to the largest enterprises run their code in the cloud without the burden of infrastructure or scale (that’s our job). We’ll shape not just our own products, but contribute to the direction of AWS and the serverless industry.

Come help us change the world!

title: Software Dev Engineer, CloudFront (Routing Dataplane)
description:
Do you wonder what happens in the milliseconds between a user clicking play and content appearing on their screen? Do you want to build the systems that make that possible — at global scale, processing millions of requests per second?

Amazon CloudFront is looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to join our Routing Dataplane team in Dublin,
Ireland. CloudFront is one of the world's largest content delivery networks. Working on systems with global scale is a daily part of the job. We build
reliable, scalable, low-cost systems that serve our ever-growing customer base. We are constantly shipping features that drive innovation in the
CDN market. The environment is fast-paced, collaborative, and full of hard problems worth solving.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and performance engineering. You will work on systems that operate at global scale processing millions of requests per second and delivering content with high availability, low latency, and strong security guarantees. You will build and optimize critical dataplane components including layer 4 packet processing, TCP/IP stack enhancements, DDoS detection and mitigation, and Anycast-based routing systems.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build high-performance networking systems that operate in the CloudFront edge network
- Develop and optimize layer 4 packet processing pipelines for ultra-low latency and high throughput
- Enhance TCP/IP stack behavior for performance, congestion control, and resilience at scale
- Build systems for real-time DDoS detection, mitigation, and traffic shaping
- Design and evolve Anycast routing strategies to improve global traffic distribution and availability
- Own critical dataplane services end-to-end: design, implementation, deployment, and operations
- Analyze large-scale network telemetry to identify performance bottlenecks and failure modes
- Drive operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, and rapid incident response
- Contribute to architectural decisions that influence global traffic engineering strategies

A day in the life
You will work on systems that operate at massive global scale, solving complex problems in networking, distributed systems, and real-time traffic
engineering. You will analyze network telemetry data to find and fix performance bottlenecks, ship improvements to packet processing pipelines,
and collaborate with teams across AWS to influence how content is delivered, secured, and optimized across the internet.

title: 2027 Summer Intern - Trade Support Analyst, EMEA
description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.
 
 Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking.  We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.
 
 
 202 7 Summer Internship – Trade Support Analyst, Dublin   

   

 Internship positions are located in Dublin, Ireland   

   

 You’re eligible to apply if you:    

 Are an undergraduate currently pursuing a degree with an expected graduation date of December 202 7 – June 202 8   

 
 Have a minimum , predicted, 2:1 from an accredited university   

 
 Are business proficient in English   

 
   

 You’ll excel as a Trade Support Analyst if you:   

 Demonstrate advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Excel-based calculations, presenting data in the accurate format, simple macro builds, using Excel functions to analyze data) .   

 
 Have demonstrated curiosity and experience in using new emerging technologies and AI tools in your work or school projects to solve problems and drive better outcomes       

 
 Have proficiency in at least one of the following: Python, SQL , and/or VBA .   

 
 Show a strong interest in the financial markets, macroeconomics, and investment finance .   

 
 Possess outstanding analytical skills with the ability to function efficiently and problem-solve in a fast paced and time-critical environment .   

 
 Show outstanding communication skills which enable you to operate in a complex financial and mathematical environment .       

 
 Show the following traits: ethical, collaborative, organized, flexible, high energy, self-starter, accountable , humble .   

 
 Have undertaken finance, fixed income, and/or capital markets coursework (recommended but not required ) .   

 
   

 Responsibilities of the role include:   

 Ensuring investment objectives are reflected across portfolios in scope .   

 
 Monitoring portfolio positions and products versus client guidelines in concert with Compliance team .   

 
 Coordinating with Portfolio Management on re-balancing of portfolios .   

 
 Utilizing proprietary risk systems for monitoring portfolio exposures .   

 
 Assisting in account transitions and cash flow management .   

 
 Conducting performance and attribution analyses .   

 
 Responding to ad hoc requests from the Portfolio Management team .   

 
   

 See yourself as a Trade Support Analyst:   

   

 You’ll serve in a dynamic role alongside Associates on the team, providing key support across Portfolio Management and Trading desks.    

   

 Trade Support Analysts directly support Associates, Traders, and Portfolio Managers. They build relationships internally with Account Managers, Product Managers, Legal and Compliance counterparts, Operations teams, and other Portfolio Associate teams across the firm’s global offices. On a day-to-day basis, Trade Support Analyst use their mathematical and fixed income training to actively monitor portfolios to assist Portfolio Managers in managing risk and client assets. Trade Support Analysts are routinely encouraged to provide creative solutions and develop key tools and reporting methods to support the Portfolio Management team.   

   

 You’ll develop meaningful partnerships through cross-department training and a collaborative team project . Throughout the course of the summer, you’ll be encouraged to showcase an understanding of advanced fixed income concepts and general portfolio management concepts, while operating in an inspiring environment.   

   

 The PIMCO Internship Experience:    

 The PIMCO Internship is a 10-week program that runs from early June to mid-August, with the expectation that you will be available for the full duration of the program      

 
 During Week 1, you’ll participate in PIMCO Fundamentals Training, providing you with the skills, knowledge, and relationships that will prepare you for success   

 
 Alongside your colleagues, participate in PIMCO's Global Month of Volunteering , developed to heighten the impact of our employees' worldwide volunteer efforts    

 

 Join us for a variety of cross-divisional education, networking & social events!   

 
 Your supervisor, peer mentor, senior leaders and team offer guidance and mentorship throughout the summer   

 
 You will gain hands-on experience with AI-powered tools from day one , with training and resources that help build future ready skills and make an impact from the start   

 
 You’ll receive feedback at mid- and end-of-summer as part of a formal review process to keep you on the path to meeting your summer goals   

 
 Want to learn more? Hear about The PIMCO Internship Experience from past interns   

 
 As a PIMCO intern, you’ll receive competitive compensation, along with a transition bonus to help with relocation to one of our office locations   

 
   

 How you should apply: 
 

 We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply by submitting your resume as soon as you are ready.    

   

 What to expect during the interview process:    

 After we receive your application, we will conduct an initial review of your resume   

 
 If you are selected to move forward, you will be invited to complete a one-way video interview and assessment, giving you the opportunity to showcase your interests, skills, and personality as part of the next stage of the process.   

 
 Once you complete the assessment, you will have a final round of live interviews with us conducted live via video conference. Interviews typically consist of behavioral and technical concepts, as well as an Excel assessment.   

 
   

 Applications for the internship program are reviewed in phases. Candidates are strongly encouraged to apply as early as possible to be considered in the initial review. Later applications received may still be considered; however, due to the high volume of interest, we cannot guarantee that all applications will be reviewed.

title: Software Development Engineer 2 - DynamoDB, DynamoDB
description:
Do you want to work on a product that can do the following?

 - Access petabytes of data in single-digit milliseconds
 - Replicate tables across continents
 - Stream terabytes of data updates per hour continuously
 - Back up hundreds of terabytes of data in seconds
 - Encrypt petabytes of data with no performance degradation
Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second.
 
 As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.
 
 DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further.
 
 DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.
 
 This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

DynamoDB is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

 As a Product Engineering Intern, you will work closely with Product Engineers, R&D teams, and leading semiconductor customers to help develop, validate, and deploy cutting-edge verification solutions. This role provides hands-on exposure to advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies and industry-leading EDA software. 
 Responsibilities Assist in testing and validating Pegasus physical verification flows and new product features. 
 Develop and execute verification test cases to ensure product quality and robustness. 
 Analyse verification results, investigate issues, and help reproduce customer-reported problems. 
 Work with Product Engineering and R&D teams to debug and resolve technical issues. 
 Support the qualification of new semiconductor process technologies and design rules. 
 Create automation scripts and tools to improve engineering productivity and test coverage. 
 Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations summarising findings and recommendations. 
 Collaborate with global teams across Europe, Asia, and North America on customer and technology initiatives. 
 Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Basic Programming or scripting experience (Python, Shell, Perl, or similar) is desirable. 
 Knowledge of semiconductor design, IC layout, or EDA tools . 
 Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments is an advantage. 
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills. 
 Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn new technologies. 
 What You Will Gain Exposure to state-of-the-art semiconductor design and verification technologies. 
 Experience working on real-world projects used by leading semiconductor companies. 
 Mentorship from experienced Product Engineering and R&D professionals. 
 Opportunities to contribute to innovative solutions in advanced process nodes and next-generation chip design. 
 Experience in a collaborative, multicultural engineering environment with global impact. 
 We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
 
 
 The Role : The Knowledge team is a lean, high-impact group dedicated to making information seamless, accurate, and accessible across the entire People and Culture (P&C) organization. As our Knowledge & Content Intern, you will work closely with the team to shape how our global employees find answers, navigate P&C processes, and experience our internal Help Center.

 This role offers direct exposure to every aspect of People and Culture. If you have a passion for clear communication, an aptitude for learning new platforms, and a creative approach to problem-solving, this internship will give you hands-on experience in modern enterprise knowledge management and employee experience design.

 Your Contribution 
 

 Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. 

 What You Will Gain :
 Direct Mentorship: Work directly alongside our Head of Programs and Partnership and the knowledge team in a small, collaborative team environment, where your contributions directly impact the business.
 Broad HR Exposure: Gain rare end-to-end visibility into how an enterprise People and Culture organization operates across Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Talent Management & Development, and Operations.
 Portfolio Development: Experience concrete examples of published knowledge base articles, documentation projects, and process improvement initiatives.
 
 Responsibilities include :
 Content Creation & Maintenance: Write, edit, and publish clear, user-friendly Help Center articles. Collaborate with team members on content for new People and Culture projects, while auditing existing resources to ensure information remains current and accurate.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with teams across the People and Culture organization, including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Operations, Global Programs, People Partners, and Talent Management & Development, to translate complex internal policies and workflows into simple, intuitive guidebooks and FAQs.
 Information Architecture & Optimization: Assist in auditing, tagging, and organizing content structure to improve searchability and user navigation within our internal knowledge portal.
 Process & Systems Learning: Gain hands-on experience using modern knowledge bases, content management systems (CMS), and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira and Confluence).
 Creative Problem-Solving: Identify content gaps, outdated information, or friction points in user feedback, bringing innovative solutions to improve the overall employee self-service experience.
 
 Your Qualifications and Skills : 
 Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Communications, English, Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, Journalism, or a related field.
 Strong Writing & Editing Skills: Ability to break down complex procedures or policy details into clear, concise, and engaging written content.
 Aptitude for Technology & Systems: Quick learner with a curiosity for mastering new tools, content management platforms, and workflows.
 Cross-Functional Communication: Comfortable reaching out to subject matter experts across different departments to gather details and feedback.
 Analytical & Creative Problem Solver: Proactive in spotting errors, fixing broken links or outdated guides, and suggesting creative ways to present information visually or structurally.
 Attention to Detail: Meticulous about grammar, formatting consistency, and maintaining high editorial standards across all published materials.
 
 Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
 
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at +1-510-713-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Us Business Program
description:
Launch your career at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and healthcare.  As a US Business Graduate, you’ll contribute to commercial priorities across areas such as marketing, strategy, finance, operations, and sales execution. Develop the business acumen, cross functional mindset, and global perspective needed to help drive growth and reach more patients.
To view the job posting and apply, click here.
Applications close 30 October 2026.
The Business Graduate Track is a two-year rotational program designed to accelerate the development of future business leaders who can help drive growth, strengthen performance, and expand Novo’s impact for patients. Through three rotations, including at least one international experience, graduates gain exposure to commercial and enterprise priorities across areas such as Marketing, Commercial Operations, Finance, Sales Execution, and Strategy & Executive Office. Each rotation builds strategic thinking, commercial judgment, and the ability to connect market insights, business decisions, and healthcare impact.
Example of a Business Graduate's Journey
A US Business Graduate may begin in a brand or marketing team, contributing to strategies that support growth and respond to evolving patient, customer, and market needs. This could include supporting launch planning, analyzing customer insights, or helping translate strategy into actions that reach and support the people we serve. Their international rotation could provide exposure to global business planning, affiliate operations, or cross market initiatives that broaden their understanding of how Novo competes and creates value across healthcare systems. In a final rotation, they may work in Market Access, Commercial Operations, Finance, or Strategy, leading initiatives that connect business performance with our ambition to reach more patients. Throughout the journey, graduates gain ownership, build a global network, and develop the commercial mindset, analytical skills, and leadership confidence needed to help shape the future of healthcare.
Gain exposure to commercial and enterprise functions that shape how Novo grows and serves patients.
Build a global network through international rotations and collaboration across markets, teams, and business priorities.
Strengthen strategic thinking, analytical capability, and decision-making through real business challenges.
Receive mentoring, coaching, and development opportunities that support your growth as a future business leader.
Explore career paths across commercial, strategy, finance, operations, and market-focused roles.
Contribute to work that advances our business priorities and supports people living with serious chronic diseases and propel the mission of Lasting Health Starts Now.
We're seeking ambitious, curious, and collaborative individuals who are eager to learn and make an impact. Successful candidates typically have:
A recent Master's degree, MBA, PharmD, or other relevant postgraduate degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Commercial Strategy, Health Economics, Analytics, or a related field.
Strong academic achievement and demonstrated leadership potential
International experience through studying, working, volunteering, or living abroad.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and collaboration skills.
Adaptability, learning agility, and a willingness to embrace new challenges.
Fluency in English and a willingness to be globally mobile throughout the program.
Given the competitive nature of the programme, we ask that you only apply to one track. We recommend you carefully consider which track you would like to apply for and your motivation for doing so to ensure it is most applicable to your background and interests.
Be yourself and share why Novo is the company you want to work for. What motivates you and why do you think being a graduate could be amazing. We would like to know who YOU are.
No, our corporate language is English, so speaking Danish is definitely not a requirement. There may be local language requirements for some International Operations (IO) tracks.
Yes, as long as you plan to graduate before the start of the Graduate programme. It is also accepted if you have not received your official graduate diploma before starting in the Graduate Programme, as long as you have finished your studies and are just waiting for the official papers.
This position is designed as an entry-level role, and while many graduates join the program directly after their studies, we also consider candidates with up to one year of post-graduate experience.
Previous pharmaceutical work experience is not a requirement to apply for the programme.
For the Global tracks you will be employed by our HQ organisation and most of the positions will start in Denmark, except for Global Tax, where you will commence your rotations in either Denmark, US or in one of our International Operations locations globally.
For the International Operations tracks you will be employed in one of our specified hiring countries for 2027, where you will undertake your first rotation.
Upon successful completion of the programme, you will be offered a position in Novo, therefore full mobility and flexibility is required as the location is not pre-determined.

Job Title:
Safety & Health Officer
Posting Start Date:
10/1/26
Job Description:
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Safety & Health Officer. Reporting to the Head of Facilities, this full-time and permanent position is based in Mauritius.
Key responsibilities:
Develop, implement, review, and maintain the Company's Health, Safety, and Wellbeing policies, procedures, and management systems.
Ensure compliance with all applicable Occupational Health and Safety legislation, regulations, codes of practice, and company standards.
Conduct routine workplace inspections, risk assessments, and safety audits to identify hazards and recommend corrective and preventive measures.
Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions arising from audits, inspections, incidents, and risk assessments.
Investigate workplace incidents, accidents, injuries, near misses, and unsafe conditions; identify root causes and implement preventive measures.
Maintain accurate health and safety records, reports, permits, inspection registers, training records, incident logs, and other statutory documentation.
Coordinate and facilitate health and safety induction programmes, toolbox talks, awareness campaigns, and refresher training for employees and contractors.
Develop, implement, and regularly test emergency preparedness and response plans, including fire evacuation drills, first aid arrangements, and business continuity measures.
Conduct regular inspections of fire safety equipment, emergency exits, first aid facilities, and other safety-related systems to ensure operational readiness.
Liaise with relevant government authorities, regulatory bodies, external auditors, insurers, and consultants on health and safety matters.
Support the establishment and effective functioning of Health and Safety Committees and promote employee participation in safety initiatives.
Monitor contractor and visitor compliance with health and safety requirements while on Company premises.
Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual Health and Safety performance reports, including key trends, statistics, and recommendations to management.
Advise management and employees on emerging health and safety risks, legislative changes, and industry best practices.
Promote a positive safety culture through employee engagement, awareness programmes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Coordinate occupational health and employee wellbeing programmes where applicable.
Participate in internal and external audits and support the implementation of audit findings and recommendations.
Any other duties as may be reasonably assigned from time to time in support of the Company's Health, Safety, and Wellbeing objectives.
Key requirements:
Well versed with occupational health and safety legislation, regulations, and industry best practices.
Sound knowledge of risk assessment methodologies, incident investigation, emergency preparedness, and workplace safety management systems.
Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
Analytical, well organised, and resourceful.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver training and safety awareness programmes.
Ability to build positive working relationships with employees, contractors, regulatory authorities, and external stakeholders.
Have at least 1 year experience in a Health & Safety role.
Experience conducting safety audits, workplace inspections, and incident investigations.
A degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Health, Risk Management, Engineering, or an equivalent field.
Registered or eligible for registration as a Safety & Health Officer with the Ministry of Labour.
Company Benefits:
At our Vistra Mauritius office, we believe in putting our employees’ well-being first! We offer a flexible hybrid working arrangement and probation leave.
Additionally, we provide a fully sponsored Medical Scheme, Sponsored ACCA and ICSA, Study/Examination Leave, Pension Scheme, Group Personal Accident, Death & Disability Cover and an excellent job exposure and career prospects.
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

title: Portfolio Analyst
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.
 At Davy, you are the difference.
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Portfolio Analyst to join our Private Client division. In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Be responsible for the management of discretionary client portfolios in conjunction with agreed client mandate and Investment Committee guidance;
 Conduct significant client portfolio analysis with a strong focus on asset allocation, performance and risk drift.

 3-5 years of relevant experience

 Excellent information technology capability, including a high level of proficiency in Microsoft Office products (particularly Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint);

 Excellent analytical, problem-solving and quantitative skills;
 Demonstrable interest and understanding of financial markets and main asset classes;
 Strong communication and presentation skills; verbal and written;
 High level of accuracy with strong attention to detail.
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.
 Health and Wellbeing

 Values and Culture

 Important Information

title: Systems Development Engineer
description:
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Our team is looking for a highly motivated Systems Development Engineer in Amazon Security who will raise the security bar by delivering industry-best security services. You should be somebody who enjoys inventing and simplifying around complex security challenges, obsesses over the customer experience, and feels strongly about delivering results. You should be passionate about solving security hurdles in innovative ways. We do not desire to simply produce good software here at Amazon Security... we want to produce disruptive, industry-leading innovations. 

Key job responsibilities
Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers and customers make billions of transactions worldwide on our cloud and the Amazon retail site. The Amazon Security team owns security for all of these services offered by Amazon Security, including EC2, S3, and many others, as well as the security of our global retail sites. This team is an EU-based Operations team, integrated with Software Development teams, supporting Amazon Foundational Security Services, to provide our customers with secure by default security services. We dive deep into security technologies such as new access control design patterns, identity security services, access control, authorization, authentication, and life cycle management to support our customers as Amazon continues to scale and grow. We are looking for software professionals from diverse backgrounds, who are creative problem solvers, and passionate about delivering solutions that improve both user experience and security. We are a global team and have a culture of learning from each other. We don’t expect people to join our team knowing everything. We want people who are excited to learn, to challenge the status quo, and who are energized by building highly scalable and available systems on a global scale. 

The EUSC Operations team runs a 24/7/365 operation, and on-call support will be required as part of this role. You would join the on-call rotation approximately once every 4–6 weeks.
Our team values work-life harmony. Being part of a 24/7/365 on-call rotation is an important aspect of maintaining operational excellence in this role, and we understand that striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. On-call rotations are structured to be manageable — occurring roughly once every 4–6 weeks — so that you can stay engaged and effective without feeling overburdened. We encourage members of the team to use personal time as needed to cultivate this balance and to promote a productive and well-balanced life — both in and outside of work.

A day in the life
Amazon has a fast-paced environment - “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” Our team works with users to design new security features, deploy software through large automated systems, and operationally support security software. You'll look for new approaches to automate fixes for operational issues and use Amazon Security services to solve design problems. Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. A healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. We offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and balanced life—both in and outside of work.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state
- Experience with PowerShell (preferred), Python, Ruby, or Java
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication
- Experience with AWS services
- Experience mentoring an engineering community on complex technical issues
- Experience in deploying identity and access management systems, or experience in web security

We are a global team and have a culture of learning from each other. We don’t expect people to join our team knowing everything. We want people who are excited to learn, to challenge the status quo, and who are energized by building highly scalable and available systems on a global scale. 

The EUSC Operations team runs a 24/7/365 operation, and on-call support will be required as part of this role. You would join the on-call rotation approximately once every 4–6 weeks.
Our team values work-life harmony. Being part of a 24/7/365 on-call rotation is an important aspect of maintaining operational excellence in this role, and we understand that striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. On-call rotations are structured to be manageable — occurring roughly once every 4–6 weeks — so that you can stay engaged and effective without feeling overburdened. We encourage members of the team to use personal time as needed to cultivate this balance and to promote a productive and well-balanced life — both in and outside of work.

This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state
“Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union"

A day in the life
Amazon has a fast-paced environment - “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” Our team works with users to design new security features, deploy software through large automated systems, and operationally support security software. You'll look for new approaches to automate fixes for operational issues and use Amazon Security services to solve design problems. Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. A healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. We offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and balanced life—both in and outside of work.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

In AIB Homes, we believe that our role is to re-imagine how we back more of our customers to have a place that they can call home.  We are looking for outgoing, energetic, and enthusiastic people with a passion for Sales to come and join our vibrant team.

title: Business Development & Client Services Coordinator
description:
Business Development & Client Services Coordinator
About Your New Employer
• Join an established not-for-profit pension administration organisation with over 60 years’ experience.
• Work within a specialist organisation supporting employers and employees across the construction and related industries.
• Develop your career in an evolving role combining business development operations, client onboarding, CRM management and process improvement.
Your new employer is a specialist pension administration and investment organisation dedicated to supporting the construction sector. The organisation works with employers, pension consultants and members to provide pension, life assurance and illness benefit solutions.
Working as part of a growing Business Development and Pension Consultancy function, you will support the delivery of new business, employer implementation and ongoing client engagement.
About Your New Job
As the Business Development & Client Services Coordinator, you will provide administrative and operational support to the Business Development and Pension Consultancy teams.
You will support the full lifecycle of employer engagement, from initial business development activity and proposal preparation through to new employer implementation, member onboarding and ongoing client support.
This is an operations-led role, with a strong focus on process implementation, CRM management, stakeholder engagement and ensuring that agreed actions are followed through. You will work closely with Business Development Managers, Pension Consultants, pension administration teams and employers.
 Your responsibilities will include:
New Business and Business Development Support
• Supporting the Business Development team and Pension Consultants with the administration associated with new business opportunities.
• Preparing quotations, proposals and supporting documentation.
• Maintaining accurate prospect, pipeline and activity records on the CRM system.
• Coordinating follow-up actions arising from prospect and employer meetings.
• Preparing information and documentation for consultants before meetings and presentations.
• Maintaining records of proposals, outstanding information, decisions and next steps.
• Supporting business development campaigns and employer outreach activity.
• Preparing pipeline reports and other business development information.
• Ensuring client and prospect documentation is appropriately recorded and retained.
 New Employer Implementation
• Taking administrative ownership of the new employer implementation process once an employer confirms they are proceeding.
• Issuing and coordinating new employer documentation and requirements.
• Establishing implementation checklists and tracking each employer through the onboarding process.
• Liaising with employers regarding company, payroll and employee information.
• Supporting employers with portal set-up and usage.
• Coordinating internally with pension administration and other relevant teams.
• Monitoring outstanding requirements and proactively following up with employers.
• Maintaining implementation timelines and escalating delays or issues where required.
• Arranging employer implementation meetings where necessary.
• Confirming completion of key implementation stages.
• Updating CRM and internal records following implementation.
• Providing the Business Development and Pension Consultancy teams with visibility of implementation progress.
• Gathering information from relevant registration sources, updating the CRM and issuing welcome communications.
 New Member Onboarding
• Coordinating the administrative elements of new member onboarding.
• Supporting the collection and processing of information required for scheme entry.
• Ensuring appropriate member information and joining documentation is issued.
• Coordinating bulk member onboarding associated with new employer implementations.
• Tracking member onboarding progress and outstanding information.
• Supporting member registration for online services where appropriate.
• Liaising with administration teams regarding onboarding queries and exceptions.

 Employer and Member Engagement
• Preparing meeting packs, reports and supporting information for Pension Consultants.
• Recording meeting outcomes, actions and follow-up requirements on the CRM.
• Supporting employer education and pension engagement initiatives.
• Identifying employers requiring additional follow-up or engagement.
• Coordinating member communications and information campaigns.
• Supporting campaigns relating to AVCs, online registration, investment information and retirement planning.
• Recording and reporting on member engagement activity.
• Supporting consultants with follow-up activity arising from employer and member meetings.
CRM, Data and Reporting
• Maintaining accurate and comprehensive employer, prospect and engagement records on the CRM.
• Recording calls, meetings, correspondence and agreed actions.
• Maintaining implementation and engagement trackers.
• Supporting management reporting and analysis.
• Monitoring data quality and following up on incomplete or inaccurate records.
• Assisting with campaign lists, client segmentation and engagement reporting.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes and workflows.
• Helping to develop and embed new procedures across the Business Development team.
 What Skills You Need
• Previous experience in pensions, financial services, insurance or another regulated environment.
• At least five years’ experience in administration, client services, business support or a similar role.
• Strong organisational and administrative skills.
• A clear process mindset, with the ability to establish, follow and improve structured workflows.
• Experience coordinating multiple activities, deadlines and stakeholders.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• A professional and confident telephone manner.
• The ability to take ownership of tasks and see them through to completion.
• The ability to work with internal and external stakeholders, including employers and clients.
• Strong client-service and relationship management skills.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
• Experience using a CRM or workflow management system.
• The ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a wider team.
• The ability to remain calm, organised and professional in a busy environment.
• An understanding of the importance of accurate record keeping within a regulated financial services environment.
 The following would be advantageous:
• Experience supporting a business development, sales, relationship management or consultancy team.
• Experience coordinating client onboarding or implementation processes.
• Experience using Microsoft Dynamics or a similar CRM system.
• A QFA qualification or relevant QFA/APA modules, particularly in pensions, investments or regulation.
• An interest in completing QFA qualifications in the future.
 What’s on Offer
• The opportunity to join an established organisation with over 60 years’ experience supporting the construction and related industries.
• A varied and evolving role with the opportunity to take ownership of Business Development operations and help shape new processes.
• The opportunity to work closely with Business Development Managers, Pension Consultants, employers and internal operational teams.
• Professional development and the opportunity to build knowledge of pensions, financial services and regulated client onboarding.
• Support and encouragement to pursue relevant QFA qualifications.
• The opportunity to develop your career within a specialist pensions and client services environment.
• Salary and benefits will be discussed with suitable candidates.
What’s Next
Apply now by clicking the “Apply Now” button.
If this role is not quite right but you are looking for a similar opportunity in business development support, client services, pensions administration or financial services operations, please get in touch. We also have a range of permanent, temporary and contract opportunities available.
Why Apply Through Sigmar?
We will help manage your job hunt, strengthen your interview skills and improve your CV.
We will provide you with an overview of the jobs market within your industry and help you tailor your job search.
You will also gain access to exclusive roles that are not advertised elsewhere.

Our award-winning Trainee Solicitor Programme will equip you with the skillset and the knowledge you need to start your career as a lawyer.
As a trainee solicitor at ALG, you can expect to receive excellent training in the practical application of the law from the moment you begin your career with us. We invest in your ongoing development as a lawyer and as a trusted business adviser, because we know how important it is to reach your full potential. We provide a programme of development for each career stage, enabling everyone at ALG to be the best at what they do.
Video
Sep 2026
Our trainees share their experiences of life at ALG, including real responsibility, hands-on experience, professional development and a supportive culture.
Life at ALG
Watch Video
Continuous learning
In each seat, you will participate in training sessions designed specifically for trainee solicitors. These include workshops, practice group insights, core legal development training, commercial awareness, advocacy, and other legal and business skills.
Career progression
Our programme provides a structured path for career progression, with a focus on developing both legal and business skills. Many of our former trainees have advanced to senior roles within the firm, including partner.
Collaborative culture
You will share an office with a partner, giving you invaluable insight and mentorship. In this close, collaborative setting, you'll gain hands-on experience, client exposure and learn from experienced lawyers.
Core programme
You complete four seats in various departments – Disputes & Investigations, Commercial Property, Corporate and M&A, ESG, Finance, Tax, Pensions and Pro Bono. This allows you to learn through practice, discover your areas of interest and your strengths.
Ignite
Ignite is the firm’s three-year development programme for trainee solicitors and marks the first stage of your career journey with ALG. As a trainee solicitor, you are encouraged to take ownership of your development and maximise every opportunity available to you.
We understand that being an excellent lawyer goes beyond legal knowledge alone. That’s why our three-year Ignite programme supports your development across legal, business, people, and communication skills, essential for becoming a successful corporate lawyer. This development takes place across three progressive phases, aligned with each stage of your traineeship. In each phase of your traineeship, you will build and practice your skills in these areas, ensuring a well-rounded and impactful learning experience.
Who can apply
Our Trainee Solicitor Programme is open to graduates from all academic disciplines who are final-year undergraduates, postgraduates, and those who have successfully obtained a third-level degree qualification.
What we look for
Applications for our Dublin Trainee Solicitor Programme will open in in September 2027.

These tips are designed to give you a general direction on the application and assessment process and some general focus for your interview preparation.

FDC Graduate Programmes
Discover endless possibilities with the FDC Graduate Programmes, offering graduates the opportunity to pursue a Master's or Postgraduate degree at premier institutions in Ireland. Following the completition of the programme, successful candidates engage in work experience, allowing them to put their knowledge into actionable practice.
Unlock a World of Opportunities
Join the FDC Graduate Programme, your gateway to a thriving career journey. We offer a unique opportunity for graduates, providing full support for pursuing a postgraduate degree at renowned institutions such as the MAAC in UCC , MSc in Ag Innovation in UCD , Postgraduate Diploma in Business in Accounting ATU Galway , Accounting – MA – TUS Athlone or the Master of Science in Accounting- UL .
Either during or after completing your programme, embrace a three-year work contract with us, ensuring valuable experience and professional accreditation.
FDC Graduate Programme – Masters in Accounting (MACC) UCC
We are offering 1 to 2 places on UCC’s prestigious Masters in Accounting (MACC)
About the MACC:
1 Year Programme – Full Time
Begins September 2027
https://www.ucc.ie/en/ckl26/
Requirements – at least a Second Class Honours Grade I in a primary honours degree (NFQ, Level 8) with a significant accounting specialisation.
FDC Offer:
FDC Group pays Master’s Fees in Full
Successful applicants will sign a 3-year contract with FDC and work as a Trainee Accountant on completion of the Masters​.
3 Year Contract begins September 2028.
The Trainee Accountant will work in FDC office which suits them best. Office locations are listed here.
FDC covers all professional qualification fees.
If the contract is breached, fees will need to be repaid.
How to Apply – Essay Style Competition:
In 500 words please describe why your interests and values in the context of the Finance Sector align with FDC’s business model?
How to Apply – Application Timeline:
Email your completed essay, a copy of your CV, and your Cover Letter stating what College you are enrolling in to careers@fdc.ie by Friday March 12th 2027 .
Those selected to move forward in the application process, will be in April 2027 .
Funding will be awarded to successful student/students by April/May 2027 .
Email Now!
Postgraduate Diploma in Business in Accounting ATU Galway
We are funding 1 to 2 places on ATU Galway’s Postgraduate Diploma in Accounting (PDA).
About the PDA:
1 Year Programme – Full Time​
Accounting – Atlantic Technological University
Requirements – at least a Second Class Honours Grade II in a primary honours degree (NFQ, Level 8) of any denomination.
FDC Offering:
FDC Group pays Diploma’s Fees in Full
Successful applicants will sign a 3-year contract with FDC and work as a Trainee Accountant on completion of the Diploma​.
Email your completed essay, a copy of your CV, and your Cover Letter stating what College you are enrolling in to careers@fdc.ie by Friday May 28th, 2026.
Those selected to move forward in the application process, will be in June 2027.
Funding will be awarded to successful student/students by June/July 2027.
Accounting – MA – TUS Athlone
We are funding 1 to 2 places on TUS Athlone’s Accounting MA.
About the Accounting MA:
Accounting – MA – TUS
Requirements – at least a Second Class Honours Grade II in a primary honours degree (NFQ, Level 8) in a cognate discipline.
Email your completed essay, a copy of your CV, and your Cover Letter stating what College you are enrolling in to careers@fdc.ie by Friday March 12th 2027.
Master of Science in Accounting- UL
We are funding 1 to 2 places on UL Master of Science in Accounting.
Accounting – MSc | University of Limerick
Requirements – Normally applicants will possess a minimum 2:2 honours primary degree (Level 8 – National Qualifications Authority of Ireland) with a significant accounting specialisation, or an honours primary degree with a minimum of three years relevant work experience.
Applicants must also expect to qualify for exemption from the CA Proficiency 1 examinations of Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI).
FDC Group pays Master’s Fees in Full.
Email your completed essay, a copy of your CV, and your Cover Letter stating what College you are enrolling in to   careers@fdc.ie by Friday March 12th 2026.
Get in touch
For all other Trainee/Graduate roles please see our vacant positions or email us at  careers@fdc.ie
These roles may include accounting and tax.

Financial Consultant –  Claremorris
The Role:
The purpose of this role will be to manage an existing portfolio of clients in relation to pension, investment and protection advice. The successful candidate will be responsible for the achievement of performance targets and developing client relationships with new and existing clients.
Responsibilities:
Identify financial planning needs with existing and potential clients
Identify and generate new business opportunities
Provide professional best advice and consultation with respect to clients’ needs
Make recommendations and provide solutions to client’s requirements ensuring adherence to compliance regulations and standards.
Provide on-going service and advice to clients.
Build strong relationships
Achieve or exceed agreed sales targets and meet business compliance standards and requirements
Essential Requirements:
Candidate must be fully QFA and CPD compliant
Proven experience in a similar role
Self-starter, highly competitive with a passion to succeed
The ability to listen and to build strong personal relationships
Self-confident and receptive to coaching with a high standard of personal integrity.
Hard working, goal oriented, and the ability to persevere.
Successful track record in previous/current field of employment
Excellent computer and communication skills
Own transport required
Experience of working in a sales role within a brokerage or similar background would be a distinct advantage to your application.

The role
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently seeking multiple 2027 Interns in IT & Systems teams of Regeneron Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS). This group secures our manufacturing and operations organization against technology threats, keeps IT running reliably and in compliance, and drives digital transformation that delivers new, integrated capabilities.
These positions offer the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
When & Where:
Location: Rensselaer / East Greenbush / Troy, NY
Timeframe: Our internship positions are full-time and onsite from May/June-August
Pay: Intern and Co-op pay ranges are determined by level of education (year in school) and degree program. The hourly rate range for these locations is: $17.90-$25.50 per hour.
What you'll do:
These roles build and support the software and digital tools that keep manufacturing and quality operations running — from internal business applications to dashboards and systems designed for use in a regulated environment.
Projects include developing internal business applications from requirements gathering through testing and rollout, building low-code tools and automation workflows (for example, with the Microsoft Power Platform), creating searchable, database-backed tools for tracking assets and equipment requirements with traceability, prototyping tools that use existing AI models — including AI agents that check reports against standards — and designing dashboards and reporting tools that pull data from multiple systems.
These are applied IT roles in a regulated environment, which means change management and documentation are part of the work.
Programming experience in at least one language is typically expected (such as Python, SQL, or JavaScript); interest in AI tools is a plus. A few projects are better suited to graduate students.
Relevant majors: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics/Mathematics; engineering and supply chain/industrial engineering majors with programming or low-code experience

title: IT Systems Analyst - EMEA Change
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY 

 Regulatory and compliance-driven change is the most demanding type of IT delivery: the obligations are externally fixed, the timelines are non-negotiable, and the legacy systems they must change are often poorly documented and highly interconnected. As a Systems Analyst on the EMEA Change Team, you are the person who makes that tractable — translating regulatory obligations into structured, precise requirements that architects and delivery teams can act on.
 You will own the analysis function across assigned programmes, working with compliance, legal, business, and technical stakeholders to produce requirements that are complete, unambiguous, and traceable back to the obligation that created them. You will navigate multi-country complexity, identify cross-system dependencies, and ensure that nothing falls through the gap between what a regulation requires and what the system delivers.
 
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 Regulatory & Compliance Analysis 
 Analyse regulatory and compliance obligations — interpreting legislation, regulatory guidance, and internal compliance requirements and translating them into structured IT change requirements
 Identify the full scope of impact across the application estate: which systems are affected, which data flows are in scope, which processes must change
 Distinguish between what a regulation mandates and what is an implementation choice — keeping scope bounded to what is required
 Flag newly identified regulatory obligations as high-priority findings and ensure they receive legal or compliance review before scope is finalised
 Maintain a clear register of regulatory obligations, the requirements they drive, and their traceability through delivery
 Requirements & Structured Analysis 
 Lead structured discovery sessions with compliance, legal, business, and technical stakeholders — translating intent into unambiguous functional requirements
 Manage requirements formally — distinguishing confirmed requirements, provisional requirements, and open questions at all times
 Log every decision (verbal, written, or inferred) in a structured decision register; nothing left informal
 Identify and maintain scope boundaries; escalate scope additions rather than absorbing them into delivery
 Author acceptance criteria in a testable format, ensuring requirements are verifiable without interpretation
 Legacy System & Impact Assessment 
 Analyse existing system documentation — runbooks, interface documents, functional specifications, and security controls — to establish current-state baselines for change impact
 Identify integration and dependency risks: changes to one system that have downstream effects on others, including cross-programme dependencies
 Document gaps in existing system documentation as findings in their own right — absence of evidence is evidence of risk
 Assess the impact of regulatory changes across multiple country instances of the same application, identifying where divergence between instances creates additional complexity
 Support migration and decommissioning planning by providing structured analysis of what a system does, what depends on it, and what must be preserved or replaced
 Cross-Country & Multi-Programme Coordination 
 Manage analysis across multiple concurrent regulatory programmes, prioritising and sequencing work with the delivery manager
 Coordinate requirements across EMEA country teams — identifying where a single regulatory obligation has different implementation implications in different jurisdictions
 Maintain awareness of cross-programme dependencies and escalate conflicts or sequencing risks to the delivery manager before they affect delivery
 Produce clear, well-structured documentation suitable for review by non-technical compliance and legal stakeholders as well as delivery teams
 AI-Assisted Analysis 
 Use AI tooling to accelerate document analysis, gap assessments, and specification drafting — applying judgement to review, validate, and correct AI-generated outputs before they are used
 Contribute to the team’s AI-assisted analysis capability — identifying where tooling can reduce manual effort and sharing effective approaches with colleagues
 Collaboration 
 Partner with architects on technical impact assessments and integration design — providing the requirements context they need to make sound architectural decisions
 Collaborate with delivery managers on programme planning — providing effort estimates, dependency maps, and risk flags that inform delivery schedules
 Work with QA and testing teams to ensure requirements are complete enough to produce meaningful test cases, and that acceptance criteria are directly testable
 Engage directly with compliance, legal, and business stakeholders to validate requirements before delivery begins — owning the sign-off cycle
