Acting as a trusted advisor by analysing client warehouse and logistics processes and designing tailored SAP EWM solutions. Ensuring timely delivery, quality, and alignment of solutions with client business objectives. Who is the Hiring Manager? The hiring manager, David McNamee, is a seasoned SAP Consulting leader with extensive expertise in supply chain and warehouse management solutions. He values collaborative leadership, open communication, and continuous learning. His management style encourages pragmatic problem solving, supports professional growth, and fosters a culture where diverse perspectives are respected and leveraged to deliver exceptional client outcomes. Where is this role based? This role is based in Dublin or Cork, with a flexible working model supporting hybrid arrangements combining office presence and remote work. If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process. What we offer Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options. Deloitte is the number one professional services firm in the world, and the leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, sustainability, tax, and related services. We have offices across Ireland in Dublin, Belfast, Cork, Limerick and Galway. Deloitte is proud of the enhanced flexibility that we offer our people through our hybrid working strategy, Deloitte Works. It means we trust our people with the flexibility and control to make the right choices in where, when, and how they work. Deloitte is looking for people that have a leadership mindset, are curious, enjoy solving challenges and are eager to grow their careers.

top
Robert Matthews
Read other stories from our veterans
What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.
How do you connect with other members of the Armed Forces Community at Expleo?
I participate in careers  transition workshops supporting recruiters. When Ex-Forces  are looking for a new career, I attend the workshops chatting  to the Armed Forces community sharing my experience and  what I have learned.
What advice would you give to other members of the Armed Forces Community who are planning to join Expleo?
Expleo has many different opportunities, whether it be leadership management, various jobs in engineering, project management etc. Don’t think that you don’t have the skill set to join Expleo. It is within you; you do have those skills and Expleo can bring out these skills in people.

title: Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) Services, Associate 2
description:

 At State Street, our purpose is to help create better outcomes for the world's investors and the people they serve. We partner with many of the world's leading asset managers, owners, and financial institutions, providing investment servicing, data and analytics, investment research, and trading services.
 Join our exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) servicing team. ETFs are one of the fastest growing segments of the global investment industry, offering exposure to a diverse range of asset classes, investment strategies and markets. You will work in a collaborative, control-focused environment where accuracy, timeliness and continuous improvement are central to the service we provide.
 
 Why this role is important to us: 

 
 Reporting to the Team manager, you will be part of the ETF Servicing Team responsible for the creation, review, and release of order confirmation files to Authorized Participants for all primary market order activity across all Exchange Traded Funds administered by SSIIL as well as the settlement of all primary market orders through both local and international Centralized Securities Depositories in Europe and managing deliverables both internal and external.
 
 What you will be responsible for: 
 As an ETF servicing Associate 2 you will:
 Confirm production for primary market orders received on ETFs

 Instructing and monitoring of settlement for all ETF orders

 Timely and accurate preparation of reporting  

 Investigation and resolution of internal queries

 Manage client queries to ensure the highest level of service  

 Build strong working relationships with clients and internal departments

 Identify any risks with processing and ensure that these are addressed

 Review of overall job process with a view to further efficiencies

 Manage own continued professional development, by engaging in the PPR process and attending relevant training per development pathways

 Engagement on project work within the team

 
 What we value: 
 Excellent attention to detail

 Excellent time management skills

 Strong numerical and problem-solving skills

 Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

 Ability to work as part of a team

 Highly computer literate – good knowledge of MS Office  

 Excellent communication skills

 Organized and deadline-oriented on a day-to-day basis

 Escalation of relevant issues to manager on a timely basis

 Query management skills

 Self-driven and able to work on own initiative

 Positive attitude to change

 
 Experience and Qualifications: 
 Primary Degree or a Professional or Accounting qualification or equivalent

 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

 Explore and pilot emerging technologies and innovative approaches to data engineering.
 
 Requirements 
 Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
 1-3 years of experience in a data-focused or software engineering role.
 Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
 Knowledge of Spark and/or Scala.
 Experience working with ETL tools such as Microsoft Fabric

 Exposure to Microsoft Azure technologies including Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, and Power BI.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

 What can we offer you?

 Subsidized Canteen

 Apply today and become part of Kepak's data transformation journey.

title: Off Trade Account Executive – Retail & Wholesale (12-Month Fixed Term Contract)
description:
Job Description : 
 About Us 
 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. 

 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. 

 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. 

 About the Function 
 Sales is where our brands meet the real world. 

 This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter everywhere. 

 It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day. 

 About the Role 
 We are looking for a 2 highly organised, commercially minded Account Executives - one for the Retail Channel and the other for RTM team ( Wholesale), on a 12-month Fixed term contract . Reporting to a Senior National Account Manager or National Account Manager, you will play a critical role in supporting the delivery of our commercial plans across some of Ireland's largest retail and wholesale customers.

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in Key Account Management, gaining exposure to customer planning, forecasting, commercial analysis, trade investment, and cross-functional leadership within a fast-paced FMCG environment.

 Key Responsibilities: 
 Customer & Commercial Support 
 Partner closely with the Key Account Manager (KAM) to support the day-to-day management of key retail and wholesale customers.
 Assist in delivering Joint Business Plans (JBPs), promotional programmes and customer growth initiatives.
 Prepare customer presentations, business reviews and commercial recommendations using internal and external market data.
 Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of customer plans.
 Sales Reporting & Business Performance 
 Produce accurate and timely sales reporting to support the Business Performance Management (BPM) process.
 Maintain and analyse Daily Deliveries, sales performance and customer trends.
 Support weekly and monthly forecasting processes, ensuring forecasts are submitted accurately and on time.
 Monitor customer performance against targets, highlighting risks and opportunities.
 Forecasting & Planning 
 Support demand forecasting by working closely with Sales, Supply Chain and Customer Service teams.
 Ensure customer forecasts remain accurate and reflect promotional activity, seasonal trends and commercial plans.
 Identify variances and recommend corrective actions where required.
 Commercial Process Excellence 
 Own and maintain CPP Control Files, ensuring all pricing, promotions and commercial agreements are accurate and up to date.
 Ensure Vision investment systems are maintained accurately, supporting strong trade investment governance.
 Monitor promotional performance and support post-promotion evaluation.
 Cross Functional Collaboration 
 Develop strong working relationships with Customer Marketing (CMO), Customer Service (CS), Supply Chain, Finance and Revenue Growth Management teams.
 Ensure product information, launches and customer requirements are communicated accurately across the business.
 Support the successful execution of new product launches and promotional activity.
 Credit & Trade Investment Support 
 Partner with the Credit Control and Trade Investment teams to ensure timely clearance of customer credits and debits.
 Resolve customer queries efficiently while maintaining strong financial controls.
 Support accurate customer account reconciliation.
 Compliance & Governance 
 Lead the compliance agenda within the customer team.
 Ensure all commercial agreements, pricing approvals and investment documentation are fully compliant with company policies.
 Maintain accurate records and evidence to support internal and external audit requirements.
 Drive continuous improvement in ways of working and process compliance.
 
 About you 
 Skills & Experience 
 Essential 
 Previous experience in Sales Support, Commercial Administration, Customer Service or FMCG.
 Strong analytical capability with advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
 Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
 Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
 Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
 Commercial mindset with an interest in developing a career in Key Account Management.
 
 Desirable 
 Experience within FMCG, Retail or Wholesale.
 Knowledge of forecasting, sales reporting or trade investment processes.
 Experience using SAP, Vision or similar commercial systems.
 Degree in Business, Commerce, Finance or related discipline.
 
 What You'll Gain 
 Hands-on experience supporting some of Ireland's leading retail and wholesale customers.
 Exposure to commercial strategy, forecasting, customer negotiations and revenue growth management.
 Opportunity to work alongside experienced National Account Managers and senior commercial leaders.
 A collaborative, high-performing team environment with excellent development opportunities.
 
 If you're highly organised, commercially curious and enjoy working in a fast-paced customer-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you!

 Working with Us 
 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. 

 We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:   
 Contemporary work life balance policies and wellbeing activities
 On site gym or subsidised gym membership
 Contributary pension scheme
 Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
 Annual bonus of circa 20% of your base salary (dependent on performance)
 Share options
  
 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible. 

 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team. 

 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. 
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. 

 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.  

 Recruitment Scam Warning   
 Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

 St James Gate

title: Sr Electronics Hardware Engineer
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life The Physiological Sensing R&D team develops technologies that measure and interpret physiological signals to improve patient outcomes. Our portfolio includes anesthesia and depth-of-sedation monitoring, respiratory monitoring, pulse oximetry, regional oximetry, EEG-based devices, and clinical decision-support solutions. We are seeking a hands-on Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer to develop electronic hardware for medical devices and physiological monitoring products.
You will take technical ownership of complex electronics across the full product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through circuit design, PCB layout, prototype bring-up, verification, manufacturing release, and lifecycle support.
This is an end-to-end hardware development role requiring the ability to personally deliver safe, reliable, testable, and manufacturable PCB assemblies while providing technical leadership within a multidisciplinary team.
 Primary Responsibilities Design analog, digital, power, sensor-interface, and mixed-signal electronics for medical products and physiological monitoring systems.

 Own complete PCB and PCBA development, including requirements, schematic capture, component selection, PCB layout, design review, prototype bring-up, verification, manufacturing release, and lifecycle support.

 Personally perform multilayer PCB stack-up definition, component placement, routing, grounding, shielding, power distribution, electrical isolation, controlled-impedance design, and thermal implementation.

 Perform circuit simulation, tolerance and worst-case analysis, component derating, and design-margin assessment to demonstrate design robustness.

 Apply signal-integrity, power-integrity, EMC, ESD, electrical-safety, DFM, DFA, and DFT principles to achieve reliable, manufacturable, and testable designs.

 Create and verify ECAD libraries, bills of materials, fabrication and assembly drawings, and complete manufacturing-output packages.

 Lead prototype bring-up, electrical characterization, systematic debugging, failure analysis, and root-cause investigation using appropriate laboratory equipment.

 Develop hardware test cases, fixtures, and automated laboratory tests using Python and/or LabVIEW, including instrument control, data acquisition, analysis, and reporting.

 Develop verification protocols, acceptance criteria, and test reports traceable to hardware requirements and risk controls.

 Develop medical-device electronics in accordance with applicable IEC 60601 requirements, particularly IEC 60601-1 for basic safety and essential performance and IEC 60601-1-2 for electromagnetic compatibility.

 Contribute to design controls, requirements traceability, design FMEA, fault analysis, risk-control implementation, and risk-control verification.

 Support prototype builds, manufacturing transfer, production testing, yield improvement, component obsolescence, second-source qualification, and controlled design changes.

 Collaborate with systems, software, algorithms, mechanical, test, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and sourcing teams to resolve complex product-development challenges.

 Lead technical reviews, communicate evidence-based recommendations, drive design improvements, and mentor less-experienced engineers.

 
 Required Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, with typically 5 or more years of relevant product-development experience.

 Strong hands-on experience in analog, digital, power, sensor-interface, and mixed-signal circuit design.

 Proven ability to independently deliver complete PCBAs from requirements and schematic capture through PCB placement, routing, bring-up, verification, and manufacturing release.

 Proficiency with a professional ECAD platform, preferably Altium Designer, including schematic design, PCB layout, library management, design-rule configuration, and manufacturing-output generation.

 Strong practical knowledge of multilayer PCB design, signal integrity, power integrity, grounding, shielding, controlled impedance, EMC, ESD, electrical isolation, creepage, clearance, and thermal design.

 Practical medical-device development experience with IEC 60601-1 and IEC 60601-1-2, including electrical safety, essential performance, EMC, and associated verification activities.

 Hands-on experience with Python and/or LabVIEW for hardware test automation, instrument control, data acquisition, analysis, and reporting.

 Strong laboratory capability in prototype bring-up, electrical characterization, systematic debugging, failure analysis, and root-cause investigation.

 Ability to resolve complex multidisciplinary problems, communicate technical risks and trade-offs, lead hardware work packages, and mentor other engineers.

 Experience with physiological monitoring, pulse oximetry, regional oximetry, EEG-based devices, respiratory monitoring, optical sensing, biopotential acquisition, low-noise analog front ends, photodiode

title: Data Operations Engineer - Python
description:
Overview 

 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. 
  
 We're looking for a Data Operations Engineer to keep our trading and data platforms running seamlessly. You'll be a guardian of the Python data pipelines and the scheduled start- and end-of-day jobs our trading desks depend on, making sure these trading-critical workflows run on time and with precision. In equal measure you'll work hands-on with the data: onboarding new datasets, reconciling and validating them, and tracing anomalies back to their source. When something breaks you'll dive in, diagnose quickly, and make the fix that keeps downstream systems healthy. 
 You'll work across a layered platform: an ingestion layer that decodes incoming feeds into structured data, a data-flow framework that streams and transforms it, configuration-driven feeds and analytical applications built on top, scheduled batch jobs that assemble each day's start- and end-of-day datasets, and a serving layer that delivers it all to trading tools. Across every layer you'll work alongside quantitative researchers, developers, and traders, as well as other reliability engineers on the team and partner teams such as those in reference and market data, to review changes, manage releases, and continually strengthen both the pipelines and the data flowing through them. 
 In this role you will: 
 Engineer - Build and maintain the tooling that brings new data sources onto the platform, turning ad-hoc data handling into dependable, automated workflows in Python. 
 Analyse - Get to know the data inside out, validate and reconcile it against expectations, and help researchers get it into the shape their models need. 
 Investigate -  When a derived dataset looks wrong, chase the discrepancy upstream until you find the root cause, combining detective work, technical analysis, and the right conversations across teams. 
 Support - Provide proactive oversight of trading-critical scheduled jobs and Python pipelines, keeping them on time and within SLA; triage, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents under tight turnaround, validating downstream impact and keeping recovery procedures ready. 
 Release - Own safe delivery to production - review configuration and code changes, enforce safe deployment standards, and coordinate risk-aware releases through GitLab and Octopus Deploy. 
   
 
 What we're looking for 

 2+ years in a data engineering, data science, or production-support role, or a degree in a technical or data discipline. 
 Demonstrated experience with Python (or a comparable language). 
 Experience with at least one SQL variant (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL), and the ability to pick up others as needed. 
 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; detail-oriented, self-motivated, and curious. 
 Willingness to work shifts: the team works an alternating weekday early/late shift rotation, with participation in an on-call rota. 
 Exposure to change-management and incident-management practices. 
 Comfort with technical documentation and handling support cases. 
 Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments. 
 If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com . Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

title: Public Procurement Consultant
description: Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging. Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging. We offer a competitive starting salary of €45,000.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. . Why you'll enjoy this new opportunity: Join Deloitte Technology & Transformation’s growing Supply Chain practice, where you will play a key role in supporting government and public sector organisations to transform their supply chains through innovative procurement and commercial management solutions. This role offers the chance to build your expertise on impactful transformation programmes, develop trusted client relationships, and contribute to meaningful public sector improvements while working alongside a diverse, multi-disciplinary team. Key skills and prior experience that align well with this position: A third-level qualification or equivalent professional certification in Business, Strategy, Supply Chain, Technology, or a related field. Experience in procurement, supply chain, or supplier management, ideally within government or public sector environments. Strong analytical and interpersonal skills, with a commitment to delivering high-quality client service and building effective working relationships. Demonstrated adaptability and creativity in problem-solving, combined with initiative and sound business judgement. What type of work will I be doing? Assisting clients to develop and implement category and procurement strategies tailored to their organisational needs. Providing end-to-end support in procurement and contracting delivery, including optimisation of strategic supplier relationships. Building and nurturing trusted partnerships with existing and new clients. Developing practical, client-focused solutions and methodologies that exceed expectations. Collaborating within Deloitte teams to share knowledge, mentor junior staff, and support professional development. Contributing to business development activities and internal initiatives to grow the Supply Chain consulting practice. Working closely with Irish and global Deloitte teams to adapt government and public sector offerings for the Irish market. Navigating challenges faced by public sector organisations and helping clients address these effectively. Who is the Hiring Manager? The hiring manager is an experienced leader within Deloitte’s Supply Chain practice, known for fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment. They value open communication, professional growth, and innovation, while maintaining a strong focus on client service excellence and integrity. Their leadership style encourages continuous learning and empowers teams to deliver impactful results. Where is this role based? We are open to applications for either our Dublin or Cork location and offer a flexible working model that includes hybrid arrangements between office and client sites. For more details on our working approach, please visit our Deloitte Works webpage. If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process. What we offer Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options. Deloitte is the number one professional services firm in the world, and the leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, sustainability, tax, and related services. We have offices across Ireland in Dublin, Belfast, Cork, Limerick and Galway. Deloitte is proud of the enhanced flexibility that we offer our people through our hybrid working strategy, Deloitte Works. It means we trust our people with the flexibility and control to make the right choices in where, when, and how they work. Deloitte is looking for people that have a leadership mindset, are curious, enjoy solving challenges and are eager to grow their careers.

title: Intern, Engineering
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
 
 
The Role:

Join a cross-functional team designing and developing consumer electronic experiences, such as the Logitech G pro-wireless gaming mouse. You will be an integral member of a global group that defines and develops new consumer devices from concept through production. This position offers a great opportunity to learn about design thinking and user-centered design in a fast-paced environment. 

Your Contribution:

- Work as part of a multidisciplinary team to develop user-centric products.
- Develop concepts, prototype, test, learn, and iterate.
- Model concepts in CAD (Creo).
- Use rapid prototyping equipment to bring concepts into the physical world (3D printing, CNC, laser cutting) and produce functional prototypes.
- Test and evaluate prototypes using our fully equipped test lab.
- Conduct user tests on functional prototypes.
- Analyze data generated from lab testing.
- Contribute to innovation in technology and products.
- Drive to learn and deliver results.
- Have fun and work well as part of our team.

Your Qualifications and Skills:

- Strong physical prototyping skills.
- Basic 3D modeling skills in Creo or similar 3D CAD package.
- Knowledge of materials (plastics and metals).
- Highly skilled in problem-solving.
- ‘Design Thinking’ mindset.
- Proficiency in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite, 3D modeling, and rendering tools such as KeyShot or Blender.
- Passion for sustainability and dedication to designing products that positively impact the environment.
- Creative problem-solving abilities, including exploring and prototyping alternative, sustainable material solutions.
- Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating concepts effectively.
- A proactive learner who stays updated on product design.
- Capable of collaborating with diverse teams and external partners, demonstrating strong teamwork. Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
 
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

title: Quality Assurance Intern - Documentation & Compliance
description:
Location: Waterford
 Start date: January 2027
 Duration: 8 months
 Work Model: Onsite
  
 About the job  
 As a Quality Assurance Intern, you will join our Quality team in Waterford and gain hands-on experience of how quality processes support the manufacture and release of medicines.

 You will support documentation and archiving activities across the QA Specialist teams, help prepare records used during the batch release process, and gain exposure to quality audits, inspections and day-to-day quality operations. You will work with different systems, teams and processes, giving you the opportunity to build practical experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. This internship is ideal for a Life Sciences student who is organised, curious and keen to understand how Quality Assurance works within the pharmaceutical industry.

 Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.
  
 Main responsibilities: 
 Support the preparation, review and archiving of Quality Assurance documentation.
 Upload batch release documentation to internal systems and support the associated archiving activities.
 Help maintain well-organised records and working areas in line with quality and 5S standards.
 Support monthly quality audit walkthroughs and preparation activities for GMP audits and inspections.
 Take part in daily and weekly Quality team meetings, giving you exposure to how day-to-day quality operations are managed.
 Work in line with Good Manufacturing Practice requirements, Standard Operating Procedures and site safety expectations.
 Collaborate with colleagues across Quality and other departments while contributing ideas and supporting continuous improvement activities.
  
 About you   
 To excel in this role you will need to have:
 Be currently studying towards a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences and be returning to university after completing the internship.
 Have an interest in the pharmaceutical industry and in developing your knowledge of Quality Assurance.
 Strong attention to detail and an organised approach to your work.
 Confidence using computers and an ability to learn new systems and digital tools.
 A willingness to learn, ask questions and take initiative as your knowledge develops.
 Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across different teams.
  
 Experience using tools such as Excel, different software platforms or technical/scientific writing as part of your studies would be helpful, but is not essential. Training will be provided on the systems and processes used in the role.
   
 About Sanofi  
 We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
  
 Why choose us?  
 Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you. 
 Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare. 
 Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve. 
 Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives. 
 Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being. 
 Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
  
 We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications.

 #LI-EUR #LI-Onsite
 
 
 Pursue progress , discover extraordinary Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.
 
 At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ability or gender identity.
 
 Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com !

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
   
 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
  
 Abbott Ireland Diagnostic Division – Longford: 
The Longford facility plays a key role in helping Abbott to meet the increasing global demand for diagnostic testing in areas such as infectious disease, cancer, thyroid, and cardiovascular diseases.  Longford is based in the midlands of Ireland surrounded by water with the River Shannon, Lough Ree and the Royal Canal. It has a vibrant collection of communities with a rich historical background. The County has plenty to offer to both visitors and citizens in sport, culture, literature, amenities, festivals, events, retail and dining.
  
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company. 
  
 We have an exciting opportunity as a PQA Specialist and this role will involve the following
  
 Primary Function 
 The PQA Specialist is responsible for ensuring that product complaints, customer communications, risk evaluations, and related quality activities are managed and completed in compliance with Abbott's Quality Management System, applicable international standards (e.g., ISO 13485), regulatory requirements, and relevant medical device regulations.
   
 Key Responsibilities 
 Complaint Handling & Customer Communications 
 ·        Support the effective management, investigation, and timely closure of product complaints.
 ·        Track and monitor the status of all product complaints and external customer communications.
 ·        Perform complaint trending and analysis to identify recurring issues and emerging risks.
 ·        Prepare and maintain complaint documentation associated with distributed product investigations.
 ·        Follow up on complaint investigations and customer communications through to closure.
 ·        Author and review customer communications and Quality Technical Communications as required.
  
 Quality Systems & Compliance 
 ·        Identify and escalate potential product quality risks to Quality Management.
 ·        Support distributed product investigations, non-conformance investigations, and CAPA activities as required.
 ·        Ensure quality records are maintained in accordance with site, divisional, and regulatory requirements.
 ·        Demonstrate a strong understanding of the Quality Policy and apply it consistently in day-to-day activities.
 ·        Promptly report quality system non-compliance issues to management.
  
 Data Analysis & Reporting 
 ·        Compile, analyse, and report complaint and investigation data in a timely manner.
 ·        Monitor complaint trends and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
 ·        Support risk assessments associated with post-market surveillance activities.
  
 Audit & Regulatory Support 
 ·        Support internal, external, customer, and regulatory audits as required.
 ·        Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and quality standards, including ISO 13485 and relevant medical device regulations.
  
 Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) 
 ·        Conduct all activities in a manner that protects human health, safety, and the environment.
 ·        Comply with all applicable EHS legislation, Abbott Global Standards, and Technical Standards.
  
 Accountability 
 ·        Timely closure of complaint investigations and customer communications.
 ·        Accurate administration and maintenance of quality records.
 ·        Timely preparation of analysis, trending reports, and investigation documentation.
 ·        Ensuring compliance with site and divisional quality requirements.
   
 Education & Experience 
 The following qualifications provide the necessary foundation for success in this role:
 ·        Bachelor's degree in Natural Sciences, Biotechnology, Quality Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.  Alternatively, a relevant postgraduate qualification combined with appropriate industry experience.
 ·        Minimum of 1-2 years' experience within the Medical Device, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, or regulated manufacturing industry is preferred.
 ·        Experience supporting complaint handling, post-market surveillance, CAPA, or quality systems activities.
 ·        Familiarity with ISO 13485, FDA Quality System Regulations, MDR/IVDR, or similar regulatory frameworks.
 ·        Experience of participating in internal or external audits.
  
   
 Key Skills 
 ·        Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
 ·        Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 ·        Ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all organisational levels.
 ·        Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate record keeping.
 ·        Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
 ·        Working knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements within a regulated environment.
   
 Reporting Structure

 ·        Works independently with guidance from Quality Management as required.

title: Sr. Specialist, Product Experience Design, Crypto
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Sr. Specialist, Product Experience Design, Crypto 
Overview
The Crypto Solutions team within Mastercard's Financial Crimes organization is driving the next generation of risk, compliance, and security solutions that enable financial institutions to safely participate in the rapidly evolving digital asset ecosystem. As traditional financial infrastructure converges with blockchain-based payment networks, the need for trusted, scalable, and intelligent risk management capabilities has never been greater.
We are seeking a Senior Specialist, Product Experience Design to help shape the future of Mastercard's Crypto Solutions portfolio. This role will be responsible for designing intuitive, customer-centric experiences that simplify complex risk, compliance, and security signals into actionable insights.
You will empathize with our customers to understand their needs and motivations, define user problems, design end-to-end journeys and experiment with these ideas to bring new designs – consistent with Mastercard's design standards – from concept through to development, working closely with Product, PMTs, and Engineers on a regular basis.

Role
• Design end-to-end user experiences for Crypto Solutions products, including onboarding, researching, monitoring, and reporting journeys.
• Apply best-practice UX methods to identify solutions to customer problems, experiment to validate them, and create final deliverables for Engineering partners.
• Work closely and regularly with Product Managers, PMTs, and Engineers to translate product strategy and customer needs into intuitive digital experiences.
• Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, and validate them through user research and usability testing.
• Design communications and decks to pitch new product ideas and concepts to stakeholders.
• Support hands-on product-feature design within initiatives, contributing to timely, quality deliverables that meet stated goals.
• Work as part of a functional team, partnering with senior-level peers to gain experience and grow design skillset over time.

All About You
The ideal candidate for this position should:
• Have hands-on experience in a user experience function, including a tactical skillset in designing and validating solutions that solve user problems.
• Have enterprise software, fintech, payments, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, or comparable industry experience; digital asset or blockchain exposure is a plus.
• Demonstrate the ability to execute tactical design outputs, with support from senior-level peers as needed.
• Develop new designs leveraging Copilot, Figma Make & other generative AI tools.
• Familiarity with design thinking principles
• A passion to be the empathetic advocate for the customer by turning complexity into simple solutions.
• Have proficiency in Figma for UX prototyping and design systems.
• Experience leveraging design systems
• Be proficient in PowerPoint for communicating design concepts and product ideas.
• Be comfortable collaborating across Product, PMT, Engineering, and Data Science in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
Skip to main content
Home > Engineers & Technicians > Join Expleo mechanical design engineering team
CAREERS
Join Expleo mechanical design engineering team
Scroll
From concept to object, in every details
As a mechanical design engineer at Expleo, you will design and develop mechanical components or systems, providing detailed 3D digital mock-ups and 2D drawings for a wide array of industries, including aerospace, automotive, rail, and defence.
Working alongside cross-functional teams in stress analysis, systems installation, and manufacturing, you’ll bring creative solutions from concept to completion, contributing to products that range from car plastic trims to aircraft structure’s critical parts and assemblies.
Does it sound like we’re talking about you?
You’re in the right place.
Search open positions
Expleo’s mechanical design engineering team delivers:
Commercial aircraft’s critical parts in composite
Largest European carmakers’ chassis, BIW and equipment s
Rolling stock’s cabin architecture and equipment
Sport car exterior and interior (from sketch to product)
Next gen space launcher’s thermal shield
Nuclear submarine’s architecture and hull
At Expleo, I value the opportunity to work globally and connect with teams across different engineering fields. From the UK to the US, it’s inspiring to collaborate on challenging projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible.
James
Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at Expleo
A day in the life of an Expleo mechanical design engineer
Morning
Setting up for the day, checking emails and reviewing project updates; aligning with team members on any urgent issues.
Mid-morning
Diving into CAD modelling to refine designs, adjusting specifications as needed based on team and client feedback.
Noon
Working with cross-functional teams to ensure design feasibility, aligning with stress engineers, systems installation engineers and production engineers.
After lunch
Analysing feedback from the factory, suppliers and customer support, to modify the design or the material of the part.
Afternoon
Reviewing the part with internal stakeholders, to release the final design to the production team.
End of day
Assessing progress, setting priorities, and preparing goals for the next day.
Entry-level requirements​
HARD SKILLS
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., CATIA, SolidWorks)
Knowledge of technical drawing basics & standards
Knowledge of mechanical systems and component design
Familiarity with material properties and stress analysis principles
Knowledge of various manufacturing processes
SOFT SKILLS
Strong communication and collaboration abilities
Attention to detail and a proactive approach
Problem-solving mindset and adaptability
Curiosity
What you will be learning with our team
Advanced CAD modelling and simulation techniques
Real-world application of design for manufacturability
Life cycle of an engineering project
Project management essentials and team coordination
Sound exciting? We think so too!
Join our team
Accessibility
top
Robert Matthews
Read other stories from our veterans
What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.
How do you connect with other members of the Armed Forces Community at Expleo?
I participate in careers  transition workshops supporting recruiters. When Ex-Forces  are looking for a new career, I attend the workshops chatting  to the Armed Forces community sharing my experience and  what I have learned.
What advice would you give to other members of the Armed Forces Community who are planning to join Expleo?
Expleo has many different opportunities, whether it be leadership management, various jobs in engineering, project management etc. Don’t think that you don’t have the skill set to join Expleo. It is within you; you do have those skills and Expleo can bring out these skills in people.

title: Motor Claims FNOL Agent
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Motor Claims FNOL Agent 
 
 Job Location: Dublin – Hybrid. Remote working considered.
 Job Type: Permanent Remuneration : Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications  
 Join our team as a Motor Claims FNOL Agent, supporting customers from first notification through to claim registration and triage while delivering an outstanding claims experience. 
 As a Motor Claims FNOL Agent, you will be the first point of contact for customers reporting motor claims, ensuring every notification is handled efficiently, accurately and with a strong focus on customer service. Working within a fast-paced claims environment, you will gather and assess claim information, register claims and ensure they are allocated appropriately for further handling.
 You will play a key role in the triage and assessment of motor claims, capturing accurate information, asking probing questions where required and ensuring high-quality data is recorded from the outset. Your ability to identify customer needs and promote relevant support services will help enhance the overall claims experience.
 
 The role involves liaising with a range of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, brokers, third-party representatives, internal technical experts and aligned service providers. You will ensure that appropriate documentation is issued promptly, instructions are provided to suppliers and all claim records are maintained to the highest standard.
 
 Success in this role requires excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to remain organised and focused while working under pressure. You will enjoy working as part of a collaborative team and will be supported in your ongoing development through mentoring, training and career progression opportunities.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply: 
 Claims or Insurance Experience - Previous experience within insurance, broking, claims handling or a customer-focused environment is advantageous but not essential.

 Insurance Qualifications - APA qualification, or working towards APA, is desirable. Candidates without qualifications who demonstrate a strong aptitude and willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

 Motor Claims Knowledge - Understanding of motor claims processes, policy structures and claims classifications would be beneficial.

 Communication Skills - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with customers, brokers and colleagues.

 Customer Focus - Committed to delivering excellent customer service and creating positive customer outcomes.

 Organisation & Attention to Detail - Highly organised with strong administrative skills and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.

 Problem Solving & Decision Making - Able to assess information, identify appropriate next steps and make informed decisions within agreed processes.

 Technology Skills - Confident using databases and IT systems, with strong data entry and record management capabilities.

 Teamwork & Collaboration - A proactive team player who works effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across the business.

 Adaptability & Resilience - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing competing priorities and maintaining a positive approach under pressure.

 
 What we'll give you for this role: Bike to Work Scheme
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4)
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4)
 EAP – Employee Assistance Programme 
 Life Cover
 PHI – Permanent Health Insurance
 Exams & Professional Membership Fees
 Professional and personal development opportunities
 
 This isn't just a position, it's an opportunity to build a rewarding career in claims. 
 At Sedgwick, you'll help people and businesses recover when the unexpected happens, working alongside some of the most trusted names in insurance. From day one, you'll have access to learning and development opportunities, including support towards professional qualifications and ongoing career development. You'll join a collaborative team that values innovation, customer service and continuous improvement, where every role contributes to our purpose of caring for people and helping businesses recover.
 
 Next steps 
 Think we'd be a great match? We'd love to hear from you - apply today. 
 
 If you're unsure whether you meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences, including those returning to work or looking for a new career opportunity.
 Sedgwick is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and does not tolerate discrimination of any kind. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.
 Following the closing date, applications will be reviewed and shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, either virtually or in person.
 
 Sedgwick Ireland is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). This role is subject to the Minimum Competency Code (MCC) as set out by the CBI. This code sets out the minimum professional standard for any person providing certain financial services, in particular when dealing with consumers. This role is classified as a Controlled function (CF5) and is subject to Fitness and Probity Standards, including the requirements outlined in the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. Successful candidates will receive training in relation to all regulatory requirements applicable to them.
 
 #LI-HYBRID #LI-REMOTE

 This role is a physical role requiring persons to be fit to carry out physical work activities in a highly regulated and safety critical environment.

title: Development Executive - Cyber Specialty Team
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Job Description For Posting

 The Cyber Risk landscape continues to evolve at an accelerated rate, with continued exploitation of 0-day & Edge Devices, as well the use of deepfakes for misinformation and cyber extortion, driven by more sophisticated AI technology. It is widely recognised by Risk Managers as representing one of the most significant threats to the viability and continuity of business operations across the globe.
 
 Marsh’s global Cyber Practice is the World’s Most Trusted and Innovative Cyber Risk Advisor. Servicing clients in 130+ countries, illustrating global reach and local expertise, we pride ourselves on simplifying the complexity of Cyber. Through the application of unique Digital Tooling that is unrivalled within the marketplace, our global proprietary wordings, regional facilities, incident management support, and our global team of Cyber specialists, we provide our Clients with a holistic Cyber service proposition, helping them to Understand, Measure, Manage and Respond to Cyber Risk.  
 
 In a direct response to the increased demand and complexity of Cyber Risk, Marsh Ireland are seeking the appointment of an ambitious, motivated and results-driven Business Development Executive to join our Cyber team.  
 The individual concerned will join an existing team of motivated and enthusiastic technical Cyber specialists that are dedicated in providing Clients with Cyber Risk Service Solutions. Working closely with this team the successful candidate will benefit from comprehensive on the job training and education on Marsh Cyber solutions and services.
 
 This key role will involve maintaining responsibility and accountability for the creation and identification of new business opportunities, building and maintaining existing and prospective client relationships and working in collaboration with colleagues across the wider Marsh business to deliver our Cyber Value Proposition to new and existing clients and to drive new business revenue growth within the Cyber/Specialty practice.
 
 This represents an exciting opportunity for the right candidate with previous insurance experience ( must be CIP qualified ), ideally from a broking background, but not necessarily having significant existing Cyber and/or Financial Lines experience, and who possesses the required growth mindset, to transition themselves into a Trusted Risk and Innovated Cyber Advisor.
 With support from the wider business and the existing Team, the individual will develop strong expertise on Cyber risk, technical Cyber product knowledge and in addition will gain an in-depth understanding of and ability to articulate the Marsh Cyber Ireland Value Proposition.
 
 The role will be based in one of our ROI offices situated in Dublin or Cork or Galway and offers a hybrid working model, with 3 days in the office and 2 days remote. It will require a commitment to travel to colleague, client and prospect meetings.
 The successful candidate will be exclusively focused and dedicated to New & Expanded Cyber/Tech and FINPRO Product and Solution Sales. They will be tasked to support and implement an ambitious growth strategy and to achieve short, medium and long term growth targets.
 
 Main Activities 
 This is a sales function and the individual will be expected to develop and execute a growth strategy and development plan, aligned to our country, region and global value proposition.
 
 What can you expect: 
 To be part of an organisation with a leading global brand, a brilliant and expert team and a positive, vibrant and inclusive culture.
 You will gain the opportunity to excel and further your next career steps through intensive on the job training, interesting & challenging work, further professional development opportunities and supportive leaders.
 A key component of the role will be the Intense Technical Cyber and FINPRO training that will provide unique industry expertise.
 
 We will rely on you to:  
 Gain in-depth knowledge and understanding of Marsh’s CyberTech value proposition and develop technical working knowledge of CyberTech & FINPRO products.

 Actively seek and develop relationships with prospects and client contacts. While maintaining control and oversight of Cyber active client target/prospect list.

 Develop market profile, attend Industry Trade events/shows, compose marketing materials and insights for wider circulation on social media and Company marketing distribution.

 Draft and deliver new business presentations and support colleagues in the creation and development of expanded new business opportunities

 Identify potential growth areas, whitespace opportunities and newly developed cover solutions.

 Review Client Risk Assessments and identify potential opportunities for the provision of additional Marsh Advisory/Consulting and Incident Management services aswell as oversee, manage and coordinate the wider Cyber Advisory and Claims Incident Management services.

 Work with other business stakeholders to create increased Cross-selling opportunities. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve targets and objectives.

 Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities while collaborating with marketing, product, and operations teams to align business development strategies.

 Monitor and report on sales performance metrics and suggest improvements.

 Attend industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote the company and generate leads alongside staying up-to-date with industry developments and best practices.

 
 What you will need to have: 
 CIP qualification

 3 - 5 years minimum general insurance experience

 Full drivers licence and access to own car/private transportation

 Eager to learn and to enhance knowledge and technical skills

 Self-motivated and energised  

 Ability to communicate at all levels with clients & colleagues

 Team player and work with other business stakeholders

 
 What makes you stand out: 
 ACII qualification  

 Proven track record of Sales delivery is desired but not essential

 Professional certifications in sales or business development are advantageous

 
 Why join our team: 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work, and supportive leaders.

 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact for colleagues, clients, and communities.

 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Marsh Risk, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Job Description:
Vistra is a global leader in corporate and fund solutions, with over 9,000 professionals operating across 50+ jurisdictions. We provide expert fund administration, corporate services, and SPV management, helping organisations streamline and integrate business-critical operations across the globe.
About the Role
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Functional Analyst, based in Mauritius. This full-time and permanent position offers regional and international coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact within our Technology team supporting Fund Services operations across multiple jurisdictions.
As a Functional Analyst in our Technology team, you will be playing multiple roles, between key escalation point for Paxus support related integration projects while also being involved in a software implementation for our Management Company (ManCo) activities in Luxembourg.
Key Responsibilities
Paxus  Support  & Functionalities Implementation
Serve as the Level 2 support escalation point for Paxus-related issues, driving timely resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement
Lead functional analysis for new functionality implementations, automation initiatives, and integration projects involving Paxus
Gather, document, analyze, and validate business requirements from stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions
Collaborate closely with development teams on solution design, testing scripts, and end-to-end UAT cycles
Produce clear, concise documentation that effectively bridges business needs and technical solutions
Software Implementation (ManCo – Luxembourg)
Drive key implementation workstreams of PMPlus software supporting ManCo activities in Luxembourg
Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation including functional specifications, process flows, and system configuration
Develop training materials and user guides to accelerate end-user adoption and minimize post-go-live issues
Prepare and coordinate UAT testing — including test scripts, scenarios, and Issue Log tracking
Design and implement Support operating models aligned with PMPlus capabilities
Plan and execute data migration activities into PMPlus, ensuring data integrity and completeness
Supporting various Hedge & ManCo Dev Projects
Keep Jira boards clean, prioritized, and up to date
Maintain and enhance the Project Tracker for visibility across teams
Lead requirements gathering and specifications definition for new initiatives
Key Requirements
Strong understanding of business analysis methodologies (requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, UAT coordination)
3–5 years’ Technology experience in Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency, or ManCo operations
Proven experience in software implementation projects — ideally in a financial services or fund administration context
Experience providing application support (Level 2) and managing automation and system integration projects
Excellent organizational skills, combined with strong interpersonal, communication, and analytical abilities
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with tenacity, confidence, and resilience to deliver high-quality results
Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations on complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
Desirable
Experience in consulting or advisory roles within financial services
Knowledge of IFRS, UCITS, AIFMD, or other regulatory frameworks relevant to fund services
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence)
Exposure to data analytics, BI tools, or reporting platforms
Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or in a global delivery model
Understanding of API integrations, middleware, or ETL processes
Why Vistra
At Vistra, we believe our clients’ businesses and people thrive when we operate sustainably and responsibly. We are committed to making a positive impact through our people, relationships, and operations — and we want team members who share that vision.
As a leading global provider of fund and corporate services, Vistra serves clients across the financial services industry with excellence and integrity. By joining our team, you will be part of a dynamic, inclusive organization with genuine opportunities for career advancement, international mobility, and professional development.
We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, flexible hybrid working arrangements, and the chance to work on meaningful, high-impact projects alongside talented colleagues from around the world. If you are ready to grow your career in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment, we want to hear from you.
