title: Equity Analyst – Fundamental Value Equities - VP1, State Street Investment Management
description:
Equity Analyst – Fundamental Value Equities 
 Location: Dublin, Ireland   
 Team: Active Fundamental Equities  
 Sector: Information Technology & Communication Services
 
 Promoting a Culture of Excellence 

 Our success hinges on attracting the best people. Highly skilled, engaged, and productive teams are our greatest asset — and essential to everything we achieve. We hire talented, diverse professionals who share our commitment to helping clients, and those who rely on them, achieve financial security. We insist on, and reward, performance excellence.
 We are committed to helping you build a fulfilling career. Our aim is to be the employer of choice, offering competitive compensation, meaningful development opportunities, and a work environment that values a diverse range of people, ideas, and skills.
 
 The Company 

 State Street Investment Management is a global leader in institutional asset management, entrusted with more than $6 trillion in assets. We partner with many of the world's largest and most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries, helping them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process spanning both indexing and active disciplines.
 We are passionate about understanding the specific needs of those we serve. By applying deep experience and intellectual rigour across a broad toolkit, we develop and deliver thoughtful, targeted solutions designed to ensure their success — and the success of the millions of people who depend on them.
 
 The Team 

 State Street Investment Management's Dublin-based Fundamental Value Equity Team invests in undervalued equities through bottom-up, value-based stock selection, grounded in rigorous fundamental analysis and a long-term investment horizon. The concentrated nature of our global and regional portfolios ensures that every position is an active, high-conviction investment in what we believe are our most compelling opportunities.
 Role Summary / Purpose

 We are seeking an Equity Analyst to join our Information Technology and Communication Services sector research team. You will be responsible for delivering excess returns through security selection across a global sector, adhering to an investment approach consistent with our long-standing investment philosophy. You will also help advance our research process by thoughtfully integrating AI and other emerging tools to deepen insight, enhance efficiency, and strengthen investment decision-making — while preserving the rigour and independent judgement at the core of our philosophy.
 
 Essential Responsibilities 

 Meet with, analyse, model, and value the equity securities of global publicly listed corporations.

 Collaborate with the global Information Technology and Communication Services sector team to manage the global sector sleeve of our research portfolio.

 Recommend investments for inclusion in our suite of concentrated regional and global strategies.

 Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement across our investment process, models, and tools — including the integration of AI and advanced analytics to enhance research productivity, idea generation, and analytical depth.

 Apply AI-enabled tools to accelerate data gathering, synthesis, and modelling, while rigorously validating outputs to uphold the accuracy and integrity of our research.

 Support client teams and Portfolio Managers with RFPs, presentations, commentaries, and other regular and ad hoc marketing deliverables.

 Partner with the Client Portfolio Manager for Active Fundamental Equity to provide product updates to the EMEA sales teams.

 Become a thoughtful and compelling advocate for our investment approach, both internally and externally.

 
 Basic Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree, preferably in a business-related discipline.

 CFA, MBA, or an accounting qualification would be an advantage.

 
 Desired Characteristics 

 Significant Information Technology or Communication Services sector expertise — most likely gained as an analyst, or in a corporate strategy or strategic consulting role.

 Excellent financial analysis and valuation skills, combining qualitative and quantitative insight into your research.

 Curiosity about, and openness to, integrating AI and emerging technologies into the investment research process — with the judgement to apply them critically and validate their output.

 Capacity for differentiated thinking and the confidence to challenge the status quo to drive optimal investment decisions.

 A strong collaborator with excellent interpersonal and facilitation skills.

 Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation and to develop and nurture external relationships.

 A genuine passion for investing in companies and markets.

 Initiative and independence, with the aptitude to self-direct and set priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 Curiosity, strong organisation, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic.

 Demonstrated personal and professional integrity.

 
 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
 
 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
 
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.
 
 Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

title: Enterprise Operations Engineer II
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Enterprise Operations Engineer II 
- Overview 

• This Job demands L1 Application Support, Alert handling, Monitor application health check and involvement in any Event, Incident and Problem Management Process.
• Deliver world class technical support for MasterCard applications and infrastructures, enabling growth, diversification and new business generation. 
• Provide 24x7x365 support for MasterCard applications; with focus on minimizing impact to Customers and internal users. 
• Monitor the application and infrastructure, and be a key stakeholder in MasterCard Incident and Change Management processes. 
• Regularly perform data analysis to determine MasterCard’s performance and identify areas of improvement. 
• Have you worked in a Production Support Environment? 
• Do you like to triage and drive events to resolution? 
• Do you like to interact with Customers, vendors, and support teams on a global scale? 
 
- Role 

• Perform L1 Application Support services on a 24x7x365 basis. Alert Monitoring - Initial response & triage of alerts using SOP 

• Validation of CRQ’s using Alerts or Dashboards 

• Application Performance and Monitoring using Dashboards 

• Problem Ticket creations & follow-ups for Alerts reductions 

• Alerts/Volumetric reporting (Bi-weekly, Monthly) 

• Participation in TRT/Bridge calls for Critical alert resolution 

• Soft Skills & Situation Management over the phone call 

• Contribution in Knowledge Management - create/update new or existing SOP 

• Assign incidents generated by monitoring tools to corresponding application and support teams using SOPs. 

• Escalate and engage Incident Requests and Change Requests to respective application teams using escalation matrix. 

• Communicate and correlate any events triggered during a change window to corresponding application teams to ensure application availability. 

• Regularly perform data analysis to determine Customer’s program performance and identify areas of improvement 

• Increase quality of work through streamlining of processes, reducing alert counts, innovating wherever/whenever possible, and through various other continuous improvement opportunities. 

• The approved service management tool(s) (e.g., Remedy) will serve all specific incidents, changes and service requests. 

• This job requires working in shifts. So selected Person should be ready to work in Shifts. 

- All about You 
 
• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience. 

• Basic understanding of UNIX scripting 

• Experience on batch scheduling & Monitoring 

• Basic understanding of SQL/Oracle or any other relational database 

• Knowledge on tool monitoring (Splunk, Dynatrace & Omnibus) 

• Effective problem and troubleshooting skills 

• Knowledge of ITSM best practices 

• Effective written and verbal communication skills 

• Effective interpersonal skills. 

- Secondary skills (Good to have) 

• Knowledge of Mainframe skills – JCL, OPC/CA7 (Job Scheduler) 

• Alert Tools – Xmatters , Nagios , Azure Monitor , IPMON, Zabbix, Python 

• Project management fundamentals, including prioritization, ownership, execution, and accountability for delivering results. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Clinical Specialist - Cardiac Rhythm Management
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott Medical 
 From essential vascular devices to next-generation technologies, our products are helping lay the foundation for better health outcomes every day. Minimally invasive treatments help speed recovery and let people get back to their daily activities faster with fewer complications, allowing healthier lives for millions of people worldwide.
 
 We’re dedicated to advancing patient care by transforming the treatment of cardiovascular disease through medical device innovations, investments in research and development, and physician training and education. We have an industry-leading pipeline and comprehensive portfolio of products for cardiac and vascular care. And we’re committed to developing innovative technologies that have the potential to change the way physicians treat vascular disease.
 Abbott Ireland Commercial  Liffey Valley Dublin Opened in 1946, this operation, based in Liffey Valley Dublin was the first Abbott business unit to be established in Ireland. This business is responsible for the sales, marketing and distribution of a wide range of diabetes, diagnostic, and nutritional products in Ireland.
 
 PURPOSE OF THE JOB 
 
 Support Abbott customers to deliver best in class implantation and follow-up of CRM devices including Pacemakers, Cardiac Resynchronisation, Implantable Cardiac Defibrillators and Loop recorders across designated Public and Private hospitals.

 To build strong and professional relationships in various hospital settings, showing flexibility and adaptability to changing needs (e.g. varying hospital schedules, etc.)

 Support regional CRM business strategy, via product implantation cover in accounts as agreed with Regional Business Manager and the local territory manager.

 
 Education & Experience 
 Individuals will B.S degree preferably in Sciences.

 Experience in a Cardiology or Cardiac Medical Devices.

 Knowledge of the Irish healthcare market

 Strong Communication Skills: Verbal and Written.

 Willingness to travel 70% of the time.

 Interpersonal skills

 Willingness to seek coaching and feedback.

 Displays professionalism at all times and is highly ethical

 Ability to collaborate with a wide variety of customers and colleagues.

 Familiarity with catheter lab and operating room procedures and protocol (preferred)

 MS Word, MS Excel, Power Point and Outlook

 
 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Provide primary technical support to Abbott customers during implantation and follow-up of Abbott CRM products.

 Perform Complex device/ EGM troubleshooting independently.

 Assist senior team members in the management and delivery of regional customer education training events. liaise with customers regarding training requirements liaise with education team in the development and delivery of the training

 Develop a clear understanding of regional account objectives and strategy for all accounts within the assigned region. Actively contribute to competitive and market intelligence data collection.

 Administrate territory including case support app is completed on a weekly basis.

 Demonstrate ability to be flexible and adaptable with regards working hours and location of customer support.

 Develop clinical and non-clinical skills as agreed with Regional Business Manager and Senior CRM Device Specialist including quarterly reviews of performance against competency modules.

 Working towards a recognised CRM certification examination, e.g BHRS/IBHRE/EHRA ideally achieving within 12 months of obtaining Grade 13.

 Takes responsibility to understand and comply with all clinical practices and standard operating procedures required by the individual healthcare establishments when attending in support of any medical procedure.

 Adheres to technical, clinical and ethical standards and practices applicable and complies with Abbott quality standards, legal and regulatory requirements and the Code of Business Conduct.

 
 What We Offer 
Attractive compensation package that includes  competitive pay and structure Bonus , as well as benefits such as 
 Private Health Insurance for you and your family 

 Occupational Pension Scheme with an excellence contribution rate 

 Life assurance 

 Career Development 

 Growing business plus access to many more benefits 

 Luas stop right outside the building 

 Underground parking available 

 Onsite canteen 

      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted. 
      
 JOB FAMILY: Support Services      
 DIVISION: CRM Cardiac Rhythm Management         
 LOCATION: Ireland > Dublin : Liffey Valley, Block B      
 ADDITIONAL LOCATIONS:      
 WORK SHIFT: Ie - 37.5Hst0 (Ireland)      
 TRAVEL: Yes, 75 % of the Time      
 MEDICAL SURVEILLANCE: Not Applicable      
 SIGNIFICANT WORK ACTIVITIES: Not Applicable

title: Assoc. Spclst, Quality Control (Microbiology)
description:
Job Description
 
 The Company: 
 Within our Company in Ireland, we work at the forefront of science and technology to advance manufacturing excellence and R&D across our Irish sites and global company network. We’re always looking to make a difference for people, patients, and communities – from our Company in Ireland to the world.
 
 Our Commitment to Ireland: 
 Ireland is one of the Ireland’s leading healthcare companies, having first established here over 50 years ago. We have a dynamic
 team of over 3,000 employees currently working across seven sites in Ballydine, Co Tipperary, Brinny, Co Cork, Dunboyne, Co Meath, Carlow, and Dublin, where, in addition, operate substantial Human Health and Animal Health businesses. Through our long-standing footprint in Ireland and over $6 billion invested across our Irish operations, our Irish sites manufacture many of our Company’s top products, helping save and enhance lives in over 140 countries around the world.
 As a cutting-edge, state-of-the-art vaccines facility spanning over 15,500 square metres across three stories, our Dundalk site will focus on qualification, continued product development and expanding its capabilities within our network. Featuring drug substance manufacturing, drug product manufacturing and quality control labs that will support the global supply of vaccine products - strengthening our ability to make an impact on people and patients worldwide by adding new capabilities to our already industry-leading network
 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a QC Associate Specialist (Microbiology) to play a key role in ensuring continuous, compliant manufacturing support. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead a team, provide technical support, and contribute to our mission of saving and improving lives around the world.
 
 
 Bring energy, knowledge, innovation to carry out the following: 
 Act as the primary operational point of contact and shift lead, providing direct guidance, coordinating daily task allocation, and managing analyst workflows to ensure schedule adherence and on-time sample collection.

 Serve as the first-line contact for weekend technical issues, instrumentation faults, or sampling challenges. Coordinate real-time troubleshooting at the bench and execute timely escalations of critical cGMP or safety issues to QC Management.

 Perform microbiological testing, including Bioburden testing, Bacterial Endotoxin testing (LAL), and Sterility testing. Execute cleanroom Environmental Monitoring (EM) and utility sampling (WFI & clean steam) as required to support manufacturing schedules.

 Conduct timely, first-line reviews of laboratory data, analyst testing worksheets, logbooks, and environmental monitoring logs within LIMS to ensure compliance with GDP and data integrity standards.

 Deliver on-the-floor technical coaching and mentoring to junior analysts, resolving routine assay challenges and ensuring strict adherence to aseptic techniques.

 Assist in identifying on-shift deviations, documenting initial event details, and initiating immediate containment and notification steps.

 Ensure the microbiology laboratory is maintained in an inspection-ready state, adhering strictly to cleanroom behavior and cGMP guidelines.

 
 
 What skills you will need: 
 
 B.Sc. degree in Microbiology, Biological Sciences, or equivalent.

 Minimum of 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology QC laboratory, with direct exposure to environmental monitoring and core microbiological assays.

 Demonstrated capability or strong aptitude to lead, organize, and guide other analysts in a shift-based environment.

 Strong understanding of aseptic techniques, cleanroom behavior, and clean utility operations.

 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively guide the team and handle shift-level escalations.

 Proven troubleshooting and real-time problem-solving skills under manufacturing operational pressures.

 Proficiency in QC data systems (e.g., LIMS equivalent environmental monitoring software).

 Strong knowledge of cGMP, GDocP, and basic regulatory expectation

 
 
 We keep the patient at the very heart of all that we do and strive to find solutions and treatments for some of the world's most challenging healthcare needs.
 
 As an equal opportunity employer, we are proud to be a company that embraces the value of bringing talented, and committed people together.
 
 Please don't hesitate to contact the Talent Acquisition Advisor assigned to this role should you need any support during our recruitment process.
 
 We are committed to flexible working where possible, and this is why our Company has introduced a new hybrid working model for office-based colleagues around the world.
 
 Please feel free to speak to us about what flexibility means to you during your application.
 
 So, if you are ready to: 
 Invent solutions to meet unmet healthcare needs, please apply today. 
 
 
 Required Skills: 
Aseptic Handling, Bioburden, Bioburden Testing, Data Integrity, Deviation Management, Deviation Reporting, Endotoxins, Environmental Monitoring, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Laboratory Analysis, Laboratory Testing 
 Preferred Skills: 
Teamwork

title: Financial Planning Associate
description:
About the role  
 An exciting opportunity has opened up in the Financial Planning team within our transformation project, working on the development of a digital advice platform. The successful candidate will work closely with Financial Planning Specialists, Product Owners, technology teams and Private Client Advisers to help shape how financial advice is delivered across our key client segments. Over time, they will build deep expertise in our advice platform and proposition, providing an excellent foundation for a career in financial planning or as a wealth management adviser.
  
 In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Support the development and continuous enhancement of our digital advice platform.
 Apply core financial planning knowledge to support platform design and development required to deliver a high quality advice proposition.
 Use and interpret cash flow modelling outputs and tools to validate planning assumptions and client outcomes.
 Collaborate with Project teams, Advisers, financial planning team and technology teams to deliver digitally led planning solutions.
 Support testing, quality assurance and implementation of new platform functionality.
 Identify opportunities to improve adviser and client experiences through platform and process improvements and innovation.
 Assist in the creation of planning methodologies, templates, training materials and adviser guidance.
 Contribute to project workstreams and squad initiatives, taking ownership of tasks and deliverables.
 Support the creation of client and adviser-facing content.
 Ensure compliance with all relevant Risk and Compliance frameworks, policies and procedures.
 This role combines financial planning expertise, project delivery and business innovation. 
 We are looking for a self-starter with strong initiative with an understanding of core financial planning concepts and an interest in technological developments. 
 Requirements 
 About you 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills: 
 A degree or master's qualification.
 At least two years’ experience in financial planning, wealth management or financial services with a strong interest in financial planning and wealth management.
 A fundamental understanding of core financial planning concepts and cash flow modelling.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills. Excellent attention to detail.
 The ability to manage priorities and work independently.
 Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
 A proactive, self-motivated approach with a willingness to take initiative.
 High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
 QFA qualification (or willingness to complete).
 CFP qualification (or willingness to complete).
 Desirable 
 Knowledge of pensions, investments and taxation.
 Experience working on business change, transformation or digital projects.
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.    
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.  
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.  
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.  
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.  
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.   
 Important Information 
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

McDermott Laboratories Limited

With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

 Join Viatris' 2026 Graduate Development Programme – Shape the Future of Pharma

 About the Programme: 
 Launching in September 2026, the Viatris Graduate Development Programme is designed to equip high-performing graduates with the skills, knowledge, and experience to thrive in a dynamic global healthcare environment.
 Throughout this two-year programme, you will have the opportunity to rotate across three well-structured departments at one of our cutting-edge pharmaceutical sites in Dublin, Cork, Galway, or our Global office in Dublin. Our locations include the manufacturing sites in Damastown (Dublin 15), Baldoyle (Dublin 13), Inverin (Galway), Little Island (Cork) and the corporate office in Northern Cross (Dublin 17).
 What You Will Be Doing 
 During the 2-year program, participants will participate in 3 structured rotations across various site departments such as (Production, Automation, Engineering, EHS, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and OpEx, etc.).

 Gain exposure to day-to-day operations in a pharmaceutical organisation while being assigned to specific impactful projects.

 Receive continuous mentorship and training from senior colleagues who will guide your growth and development.

 Expand your technical abilities and key business skills in a progressive, innovative environment.

 Graduates will participate in careers fairs, TY & STEM Ireland events.

 In-depth knowledge of Viatris business and operations.

 Practical experience working with cutting-edge pharmaceutical technology.

 A tailored, comprehensive onboarding program that sets you up for success.

 A clear pathway for career progression within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

 Who We Are Looking For: 
 Recent graduates or upcoming graduates with an Honours degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math), 3rd level qualification. A grade of 2.1 or higher is a requirement for the programme.

 Demonstrated success in previous work experience, placement, or extracurricular activities.

 Interest in pursuing a career in the pharmaceutical industry; Production, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain etc.

 High achievers who thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

 Strong communicators with a passion for making a difference in healthcare.

 Ambitious individuals eager to take on challenges and make an impact.

 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
 Join our team! 
 Viatris is more than just a place to work. We are a new kind of healthcare company, one where you can make a difference in the world. If you inspired by our commitment to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, explore our global opportunities and find your team today. Visit Viatris.com/careers.
 Why Viatris? 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. You will also have the opportunity to access excellent career progression opportunities and work-life balance initiatives.
 Diversity & Inclusion at Viatris 
 At Viatris, diversity and inclusion are essential to our mission. The diversity we foster in all aspects of our business can be one of our greatest strengths in redefining healthcare not as it is, but as it should be. If you would like to know more about what diversity, equity and inclusion means to us, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/Careers/Diversity-and-Inclusion 
 Sustainability at Viatris 
 Corporate social responsibility is fundamental to the Viatris mission. We work to advance responsible and sustainable operations and leverage our collective expertise to empower people to live healthier at every stage of life, recognizing that our actions affect the stakeholders and communities we serve. To learn more about our efforts, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/about-us/corporate-responsibility

Sales & Marketing Operations Associate 
 Join IQVIA and play a key role supporting a dedicated healthcare client team in Dublin. 

 Location: Dublin, Ireland
 Working Pattern: Full-time, with reduced hours or a four-day week considered

 The Opportunity IQVIA is seeking a proactive and commercially minded Sales & Marketing Operations Associate to support a dedicated healthcare client team based in Dublin.

 This is a dynamic, business-facing role that combines sales support, marketing coordination, commercial administration and office operations . As part of the team, you'll work closely with leadership, sales and marketing colleagues, helping to drive commercial effectiveness, support marketing initiatives and ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the Dublin office.
 We're looking for someone who enjoys working at the heart of the business, thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering exceptional support that helps teams perform at their best.
 

 What You'll Do Sales & Commercial Support Provide administrative and operational support to sales and leadership teams.
 Prepare sales reports, presentations, dashboards, trackers and customer-facing documentation.
 Support sales planning, pipeline reporting and business performance tracking.
 Assist with proposal preparation, meeting coordination and commercial administration.
 Maintain accurate records, documentation and reporting systems.
 

 Marketing & Events Coordination Support the delivery of marketing campaigns, events, exhibitions and internal communications.
 Coordinate marketing materials, promotional activities and stakeholder communications.
 Assist with event planning, logistics and post-event reporting.
 Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to ensure effective campaign execution and follow-up activities.
 

 Business & Office Operations Manage the day-to-day running of the Dublin office, ensuring a professional and efficient working environment.
 Coordinate facilities, suppliers, workplace services and office administration activities.
 Support onboarding, team meetings, town halls and employee engagement initiatives.
 Manage purchase orders, goods receipting, supplier queries and monthly accrual processes.
 Support health and safety administration, records management, fleet coordination and other operational processes.
 

 What You'll Bring Experience in sales support, marketing support, commercial operations and / or business support role.
 Previous experience supporting sales teams, marketing teams or customer-facing commercial functions.
 Strong reporting, presentation preparation and administrative coordination skills.
 Experience coordinating events, exhibitions, campaigns or business initiatives.
 Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook.
 Experience with purchase orders, procurement or finance administration would be advantageous but is not essential.

 Flexible working options, including consideration of reduced hours or a four-day week for the right candidate.
 
 Ready to Apply? If you're passionate about supporting sales and marketing teams, enjoy coordinating projects and events, and take pride in keeping business operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineer – Test Support , Hardware Engineering - Manufacturing
description:
Amazon Web Services’ Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world’s premier cloud computing platform. We are looking for Manufacturing Test Engineers who are capable of operating in a fast paced, ever changing, multi-platform international manufacturing and production environment. Our Test Engineering team works closely with our ODMs, CMs, internal AWS hardware and software development teams, and with upstream component vendors to ensure right Test Flow, tools and test plans are established and validated for a product to launch and scale up across multiple sites world-wide. This role requires the engineer to be a technical contact and take on full ownership of the manufacturing launch and resolution of Test issues. You will be the driver in getting production scaled across a global network. You will own the Test performance as well as the processes that go with them. You will implement standardized test methods & troubleshooting guides world-wide across multiple ODMs and CMs ensuring consistent usage and processes across sites. 
Amazon Web Services’ Hardware Engineering team is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

 Abbott Ireland Nutrition Division Cootehill Cavan 
 Abbott Nutrition produces a range of infant formulae in all pack sizes under the brand name “Similac”. To complement the range of “Similac” infant formulae, the facility also manufactures a range of follow-on formulae under the brand name of “Gain”. The essential ingredient is liquid skim-milk and this is combined with carbohydrate, vegetable oils, vitamins and minerals. The product is blended, pasteurised, dried and packaged at the site and once packaged, is distributed to Europe, South East Asia, the Middle East, Latin America and Canada.

 Established in 1975, Abbott Nutrition in Ireland is the largest powder manufacturing facility for the production of infant formulae within the Abbott Corporation worldwide.  Approximately 1,000 dairy farms in Ireland and Northern Ireland supply quality milk to the Cootehill facility which processes 500,000 litres per day. This secure supply together with Ireland’s reputation as a green, clean environment is of significant strategic importance to Abbott Nutrition.

title: Platform Engineer II
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
 At Medtronic Patient Care Systems (PCS), we power the digital heartbeat behind life-saving cardiac therapies. We build the connected ecosystem that enables clinicians to monitor, manage, and protect millions of patients living with implantable cardiac devices around the world.

From secure device connectivity and real-time data platforms to intelligent clinical tools and patient-facing experiences, PCS transforms complex cardiac data into clarity, helping physicians make faster decisions, improving outcomes, and giving patients greater confidence in their care.

Every line of code we write supports someone’s parent, spouse, child, or friend. Our work ensures that life-saving therapies are not only delivered safely and reliably, but continuously improved through innovation, insight, and global scale.

If you want to build technology that truly matters, where uptime means peace of mind and innovation means more birthdays, join us. Together, we are shaping the future of connected cardiac care and changing lives every single day
 We support a hybrid work model based out of our Galway offices. Alongside a competitive base salary (outlined below), we provide a comprehensive benefits package including an annual performance bonus, pension contribution, family healthcare coverage, continuous professional development, and more. 
 Come for a job, stay for a career! 

 A Day in the Life of our Platform Engineering Team: 
 As a Platform Engineer II within the PCS organisation, you will help develop and operate the software ecosystem supporting Medtronic implantable cardiac devices. Working across the software development lifecycle, you will build robust, scalable cloud and platform capabilities that support application, network, mobile, connectivity, and embedded-device solutions.
 You will collaborate with global, cross-functional teams to shape technical solutions, improve engineering practices, and deliver reliable experiences for clinicians and patients.
 
 Primary Responsibilities: 
 Develop, operate, and support shared engineering platforms and services.
 Build reusable automation, tools, documentation, and runbooks that improve developer productivity, operational efficiency, and platform reliability.
 Implement, test, deploy, and support defined platform capabilities with general supervision.
 Contribute to technical design discussions and apply sound practices across software development, cloud computing, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
 Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to systems and engineering processes.
 Partner with software engineers, architects, security specialists, data professionals, and infrastructure teams to deliver project milestones and engineering enablement initiatives.
 Provide guidance and assistance to entry-level engineers when appropriate.
 
 Key Skills & Experience 
 
 Must have: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, with at least two years of relevant experience; or an advanced degree.
 Experience creating or maintaining repeatable infrastructure and configuration using Terraform, Helm, or comparable tools.
 Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability-as-code practices using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, or comparable tools.
 Strong ownership, initiative, and the ability to deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.
 A collaborative communication style and commitment to improving patient outcomes through connected health technology.
 
 Nice to have: 
 Cloud platforms and infrastructure services.
 Software development using a modern programming or scripting language.
 Source control, automated testing, and continuous integration or delivery practices.
 Containerisation and modern application platforms.
 Data processing, event streaming, databases, or distributed systems.
 Security, quality, and compliance tooling integrated into engineering workflows.
 Developer productivity, self-service platforms, or engineering enablement solutions.

 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 

 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture Freestyle blood glucose test strips and Freestyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the Freestyle Precision, Freestyle Lite and Freestyle Libre systems.
  
 Main purpose of the role 
 Responsible for coordinating various supply chain projects and managing the flow of material for project, validation and engineering activities, while ensuring timely availability of resources and providing regular updates on project progress.  
 The role involves being an individual contributor that works under limited supervision while applying subject matter knowledge. The Supply Chain Specialist will work closely with cross-functional teams, as well as external vendors & suppliers, to achieve these objectives.

 At Abbott in Kilkenny, you can shape your career as you help shape the future of healthcare.  
  
 Purpose of the role 
  
 The Material Planner will play a key role in ensuring the seamless supply of materials to support our manufacturing operations. This position is critical in maintaining optimal inventory levels, supporting production requirements, and driving overall operational efficiency.
 Working closely with Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and external suppliers, you will be responsible for ensuring materials are available when needed while maintaining effective inventory control and supply continuity.
  
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain material plans and replenishment schedules aligned with production requirements and customer demand.
 Analyse demand forecasts, production schedules, and inventory trends to accurately determine material requirements.
 Manage inventory levels and safety stock policies to ensure continuity of supply while minimising excess inventory and obsolescence risks.
 Monitor supplier order fulfilment, track inbound shipments, and expedite critical materials when required.
 Collaborate with Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and Warehouse teams to ensure timely material availability and efficient inventory flow.
 Coordinate transport and logistics activities to support the timely collection and delivery of materials.

 Issue and manage supplier call-offs for vendor-managed and supplier-held inventory.

 Monitor and evaluate supplier performance against key metrics, driving corrective actions where required.
 Maintain material planning parameters, master data, and replenishment settings within SAP to support accurate planning outputs.
 Prepare and present regular reports on inventory levels, material availability, supplier performance, OTIF delivery, and supply chain risks.
 Identify, lead, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance material planning, inventory management, and supply chain performance.
 Proactively identify potential supply risks and develop mitigation plans to minimise operational disruption.
 Support new product introductions and material transitions by ensuring timely material availability and effective supply planning.
  
 Education & Experience

 Excellent organizational skills with a strong attention to detail.
 Ability to manage priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

title: Associate - Account Solution Engineer
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 
 Job Category 

Sales 
 Job Details 

 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 
 
 
 Job Details 

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
 
 Overview of the role 
As an Account Solution Engineer (also known as a "Presales Consultant" or "Sales Engineer"), you are the visionary who transforms customer experiences. You aren’t just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner to Sales, owning the solutioning throughout the entire sales cycle. You will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, translating complex business objectives into enticing, practical recommendations that drive real change. 
Business Acumen & Strategic Impact Business Transformation Advocate: You are passionate about how technology solves real-world business puzzles. You enjoy digging into a company’s value chain to find where Salesforce can drive the most impact.
 The "Bottom Line" Mentality: You understand that technology is only as good as the business outcome it creates. You are excited by the challenge of connecting high-level business strategy to technical execution.
 
 Strategic Sales Partner: You thrive on the "win." You act as a co-pilot to the sales team, bringing a strategic lens to every deal to ensure we aren't just selling software, but building a long-term partnership.
 
The Ideal Profile: Passion & Mindset Demonstrated Passion for Technology & AI
 The "First to Know": You are a true technophile. You don't just wait for training; you are already experimenting with the latest in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows.
 AI Visionary: You have a clear passion for how AI is transforming the workforce. You are eager to show customers how Agentforce and autonomous agents can augment human productivity.
 Continuous Learner: You have a "Growth Mindset." Whether it’s passing a new Salesforce Certification or exploring a new API, you are driven by a natural curiosity to understand the how and why behind the tech.
 
 Responsibilities Strategic Sales Partnership: Act as the technical "North Star" for the sales team, aligning technical strategy with business outcomes to close complex deals. 
 Solution Innovation: Develop and deliver innovative custom solutions and demos (including Agentforce and Data Cloud) that address unique business challenges and prove tangible value.
 Lead the Cycle: Coordinate and lead the entire solution cycle through close collaboration with other high-performing teams (Product, Marketing, Professional Services).
 Value Communication: Articulate the benefits of Salesforce to audiences at every level—from IT Administrators to C-suite executives—using industry-specific insights.
 Continuous Growth: Maintain expert-level knowledge of Salesforce products and industry trends to remain effective in a performance-driven environment.
 
 Experience & Background 
 We are looking for a diverse range of backgrounds to join our high-performing South team. Whether you are a career SE or looking to pivot your technical and business acumen into a pre-sales career, we want to hear from you.
Core Experience (One or more of the following): Solution Excellence: A proven track record in Solution Engineering (Pre-sales), technical consulting, or professional services delivery within an enterprise software organization.
 SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture.
 Consultative Mindset: A background in Business Consulting, with the ability to perform deep discovery, identify "pain points," and map them to high-value technology roadmaps.

title: L&D Delivery Specialist
description:
L&D Delivery Specialist 
 Because we strive to put people first. Culture, our way. 
 People & Culture at Primark
 What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.
 What You’ll Ge t  
 The work you do shapes the impact we have. We’re focused on providing you with the culture to reach your potential. Your wellbeing is our top priority.   
 Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, Pension and Potential Bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

 What You’ll Do as a L&D Delivery Specialist 
 In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets and departments. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:
 Conduct learning needs analysis and stakeholder discovery to identify development requirements and shape local L&D strategies.
 Design, develop, and deliver learning programmes across onboarding, technical skills, customer experience, career progression, and leadership development.
 Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of multiple learning initiatives, including Apprenticeship Levy programmes and market-specific training solutions.
 Facilitate engaging training sessions, workshops, and learning events while managing associated logistics, communications, and stakeholder coordination.
 Evaluate programme effectiveness through data, reporting, and ROI analysis, making recommendations for continuous improvement and learning innovation.
 Manage learning systems, supplier relationships, learning records, and partner with key stakeholders to ensure effective delivery and tracking of all L&D activities.
 

 What You’ll Bring   
 Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:
 5+ years' experience in Learning & Development, with a strong track record of designing and delivering a broad range of training and development initiatives.
 Strong understanding of corporate and retail learning principles, best practices, and employee development methodologies.
 Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse audiences.
 Proven ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels across the business.
 Demonstrated capability to manage multiple priorities, deliver strategic initiatives in fast-paced environments, and navigate change, complexity, and ambiguity.
 Experience supporting multi-site or geographically dispersed workforces, combined with a genuine passion for people development and continuous learning.
 

 Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.  
 About Primark  
 At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 17 countries today.
 Our Values: Every person impacts the culture at Primark. Our values: Caring (we always strive to put people first), Dynamic (we bravely push the boundaries to stay ahead) and Together (we learn more, laugh more and achieve more as a team) outline how we work with each other, our suppliers, and our partners. We want to continue to create amazing cultures across Primark and need everyone to play their part in making this happen by living our values.

What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 
 Job Category 

Sales 
 Job Details 

 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 
 
 
 We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place. 
 
 Description 
 
 The Sales Development Representative role could be your next big career move. We are currently seeking high-energy, driven professionals with sound business acumen and natural sales instincts. Ideal candidates should be eager to advance through a clearly defined learning and earning path.We offer a fast-paced, innovative environment where you will be provided the tools, resources and outstanding leadership to sell business application solutions and take your career to the next level! 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Identifying and creating new qualified sales opportunities from inbound leads

 Achieving monthly quota of qualified opportunities

 Engaging with customers via telephone and email to analyse their needs

 As this is the first point of contact with the customers, conduct business dealings in a professional, proactive manner

 "Multi-channel" follow-up - help uncover new deals and nurture existing opportunities

 Required Skills/Experience

 Fluency in English language

 1-2 years business experience (software sales a plus)

 Team player and ability to work in a high energy sales environment

 Excellent communication skills - verbal and written

 Highly motivated and ambitious

 Strong desire to work in sales

 
 What's in it for you? 
 Clear and structured career path

 World - Class Training & Development in the areas of professional growth and product knowledge

 Constant learning and knowledge sharing with some of the best complex selling professionals in the industry

 Opportunity to make a massive impact on your customers' business by providing best CRM solutions in the world

 Chance to work in a dynamic, fun and challenging environment where you we will make sure you reach your full potential

 Gym subsidy, Travel Scheme, Education Subsidy, Pension, 7 Volunteering Days a year and free snacks and drinks!

 For candidates who need to relocate to Ireland for this position, Salesforce would assist with relocation support for your move.

 
 Map your Future 
 We provide extensive training and mentoring including Bootcamp

 With our strong coaching culture we aim to develop world-class sales leaders. This is a great opportunity to develop your international experience in an organisation that has transformed the Enterprise Software Market with Cloud Computing

 After a period of continuous target achievement and learning & development you will be offered the opportunity to apply for a number of positions in EMEA as part of your career progression plan

 
 Salesforce in Dublin 
 Our Dublin office is the European Hub for the Corporate Sales Organisation. The office is a heaven of diversity and offers a great opportunity to work with people from all nationalities and backgrounds.

 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 
 
 
 Posting Statement 

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

 An amazing opportunity has arisen for a Quality Control Technician to join our Dundalk team.

 Maintain / sustain QC equipment within their qualified state for GMP readiness.
 Review and approve RAMS / permit to works, liaising with both EHS and vendors.

 Execute sample management tasks using GLIMS and other electronic platforms.
 Support ad hoc tasks where and when required.

 Education 
 Minimum BSc Degree in a science related field.

title: Specialist, Product Management
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Specialist, Product Management 
Overview 
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test & Learn), and data-driven information and risk management services. 

Test & Learn 
As a member of the Business Experimentation & Optimization Product Management team, you will help shape the evolution of Test & Learn, an industry-leading experimentation platform that brings advanced analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. Test & Learn development today spans front-end, analytic, and technical investments; the team is rapidly building new products, improving existing capabilities, and expanding how Test & Learn is delivered to clients. 

Position Responsibilities 
• Product Manager for Mastercard’s Test & Learn product, an analytic platform used by the world's largest organizations to make multi-million-dollar decisions. 

• Develop product strategy derived from user research, market trends, customer pain points, and commercial priorities. 

• Translate a deep understanding of our users into an actionable roadmap. Leverage user research, market research, sales/marketing expertise, and usage data to inform priorities. 

• Own end-to-end feature development. Identify and prioritize problems, define use cases, design solutions, write requirements, support development and testing, and measure impact to inform future decisions. 

• Work as a part of a cross-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Work together with UX designers, engineers, and other product managers to improve our products. 

All About You 
• Can work closely with cross-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales and marketing as well as users. 
• A quick learner with the ability to multi-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor. 
• Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap. Creative problem-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully. 
• Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Description:
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Executive Assistant. Reporting to the EVP, this full-time and permanent position is based in Bogota, Columbia and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our department and its' growth.
Role Summary
The Executive Assistant provides comprehensive, proactive support to the EVP Americas, ensuring the executive's time, travel, communications, and priorities are managed efficiently. The role acts as a key point of coordination between the EVP, regional leadership teams, global stakeholders, and external partners, and plays a central part in planning regional events, preparing executive materials, and resolving day-to-day operational issues.
Key Responsibilities
Calendar and Executive Operations
Manage the EVP's calendar proactively, prioritizing commitments and resolving conflicts across multiple time zones.
Schedule meetings with internal and external stakeholders across the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific, coordinating directly with executives and their assistants worldwide.
Prepare the EVP for upcoming meetings by organizing agendas, briefing materials, and follow-up actions.
Handle ad hoc requests and resolve operational issues quickly and discreetly.
Travel and Expenses
Plan and book domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, and ground transportation, comparing options for cost and convenience.
Build detailed itineraries adjusted to local time zones.
Process and reconcile expense reports accurately and on time, in line with company policy.

title: Customer Marketing Analyst
description:
Job Description : 
 About us 
 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. 

 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. 

 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. 

 About the function 
 Sales is where our brands meet the real world.  
 This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter.  

 It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.  
 About the role 
 The mission of this role is to provide analytical and operational support to Customer Marketing, turning customer, shopper, activation and performance data into simple insights, trackers and actions that improve planning and execution.

 Key Accountabilities 
 Maintain customer marketing trackers: Produce regular views of activation delivery, spend, important metrics, M&E, customer performance and action follow-up across channels. 
 Support planning and cycle readiness: Prepare insight, customer data, sales cycle materials, activation calendars and post-activity analysis for Customer Marketing Managers. 
 Turn data into practical insight: Analyse shopper, customer, market, CRM and campaign data to find opportunities, risks and improvements. 
 Improve data and process quality: Maintain clean inputs, documentation, templates and control logs that make routines repeatable and easy for teams to use. 
 Support cross-functional decisions: Provide clear, simple summaries for Sales, RGM, Category, Shopper and Finance stakeholders to help prioritise action. 
 
 About you 
 Key Competencies 
 Execution excellence: Turns strategy into simple standards, customer actions and field routines that improve availability, visibility, quality and compliance. 
 Data-led prioritisation: Uses insight, CRM and performance data to focus effort on the customers, outlets, occasions and brands that matter most. 
 Collaborator influence: Works across Sales, Customer Marketing, RGM, Supply, Finance and external partners to tackle issues and land plans at pace 
 
 Qualifications & Experience Required 
 Experience in commercial analysis, sales operations, customer marketing, finance, category, RGM or business intelligence roles. 
 Sophisticated Excel and good Power BI or dashboarding capability; experience with NielsenIQ, IRI, Dunnhumby, CRM or customer data is advantageous. 
 Strong attention to detail, data quality approach and ability to translate insight into clear commercial actions. 
 Organised, curious and comfortable working with Sales, Customer Marketing, RGM, Finance and D&T stakeholders through busy commercial cycles. 
 FMCG, retail, hospitality or beverage alcohol experience preferred.
  
 Working with us 
 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. 

 We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:   
 Contemporary work life balance policies and wellbeing activities
 On site gym or subsidised gym membership
 Contributary pension scheme
 Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
 Annual bonus of your base salary (dependent on performance)
 Share options
  
 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible. 

 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team. 

 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. 
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. 

 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.  

 Recruitment Scam Warning   
 Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.
