title: Systems Development Engineer, ESC Managed Operations
description:
AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/ 
 
Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in "on-call" rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours. 
 
The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation. 
 
Utility Computing (UC) 
European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC). 
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. 

Eligibility requirement 
- Fluency in written and spoken English is required. 
- Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud. 
- Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union. 
- Employees will participate in an On-Call rota. 

A day in the life
A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You’ll spend roughly 50% of your time operating production systems and 50% working with your team to make long-term improvements to the reliability, availability, and performance of those software systems. Over the course of a week, you will root cause why some deployments recently failed, and fix those bugs. Later in the week you may execute a highly sensitive time-critical change to production. You can round off the week by participating in design discussions by another team, writing code, and providing actionable feedback to your team’s code. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours. 

About the team
Diverse Experiences 
 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS 
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance 
 We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture 
 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

- Experience developing software code in one or more programming languages (java, python, etc.)
- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state
- Experience in engineering, working with hardware, software, networking, operating systems
- Experience designing systems for performance, simplicity, and scalability, durability, cost, and security.
- Able to lead the creation, revision, and/or improvement of standard operational procedures (SOPs) and driving operational best practices.
- Experience actively mentoring junior engineers and working cross-organizationally and leading strategic team efforts requiring work from multiple team members
- Experience operating 24x7 high-availability, distributed software applications and performance tuning software applications and optimizing fleet utilization
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (such as CDK, CloudFormation, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or similar) and monitoring frameworks (such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Elastic or similar).
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Generative AI technologies, including automated deployment, configuration management, continuous integration workflows, prompt engineering, model deployment, and AI-powered automation tools

title: Software Development Engineer - Lambda, AWS Lambda Control Plane
description:
Software Development Engineer — AWS Lambda Control Plane (Dublin)

When millions of builders ship their Lambda functions, it all just works — in seconds, anywhere in the world. The machinery that makes that possible is the control plane: the systems that validate, orchestrate, and propagate every function's state so the data plane can execute it flawlessly at any scale.

As part of the team you'll design, build, and operate the distributed systems that sit between customers and the Lambda data plane:

You'll own the full path from API request to running function. The APIs you build are the public surface of Lambda — high-throughput, strictly consistent, globally available — serving customers and CloudFormation alike. Behind those APIs, you'll design the asynchronous workflows that orchestrate a function's lifecycle: taking a customer's intent — a new function, a code deploy, a version publish — and propagating it safely to the systems that actually execute functions. That means solving metadata propagation at global scale: ensuring every configuration change reaches the right compute fleet, in the right region, with the right ordering guarantees, even under partial failures.

We operate at the scale of one of the largest services in AWS. Availability is a first-class design constraint, not an afterthought.

What we're looking for

- Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production — the kind where "retry" isn't a strategy, it's a starting point.
- Comfort with ambiguity: you'll own problems end-to-end, from API contract through data-plane handoff.
- Strong fundamentals in at least one of: Java, Python, or TypeScript (our stack spans all three).
- A bias toward simple, operable solutions — systems that are easy to reason about at 3 AM.

About the team
We're a Dublin-based engineering team within AWS Lambda. We invest in growing engineers through meaningful ownership, direct mentorship, and exposure to problems that don't have textbook answers. We value diverse perspectives and hire for collaboration — the best systems here are built by teams, not individuals.
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

A student placement with the Maples Group is a great way to build the foundations of your career path.

  • Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and data flows feeding portfolio management processes

  • Perform data cleaning, validation, and reconciliation, establishing robust checks

  • Assist with the development and refinement of forward-looking KPIs (e.g. price adequacy and risk adjusted rate change) under the guidance of more senior colleagues

  • Manage and maintain rating tools in close collaboration with underwriting colleagues: version control, testing, implementing rate changes, and supporting their digitisation into modern platforms

  • Lead the production of data submission packs and regular portfolio monitoring packs for carrier partners

  • Assist with exposure and mix analyses and with claim frequency and severity investigations

  • Build and maintain dashboards and MI (e.g. Power BI or similar)

  • Document processes, tools, and data definitions as they are built, so the team scales on solid foundations

What We're Looking For

Requirements

  • Part-qualified actuary (IFoA or equivalent) making good progress with exams

  • A high level of numeracy skills and analytical approach to work is essential

  • Strong coding and data skills; advanced Excel and ideally experience with Python/SQL

  • Experience (or strong aptitude) with dashboarding/BI tools such as Power BI

  • Exposure to P&C insurance data; MGA/delegated authority or bordereaux experience is a plus

  • Understanding of, or keen interest in, pricing and portfolio management concepts such as rate change monitoring, technical price models, and ultimate loss ratio projection

Personal Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Enthusiasm for building and further developing robust processes; turning imperfect data into reliable and automated processes

  • Positive, resilient, and adaptable

  • Willing to roll up your sleeves and take ownership of tasks

  • A team player who communicates clearly, and works well with underwriters and other functions

  • Curious and commercially minded

  • At Orvia Underwriting, we believe in connection through expertise. Our pan‑European platform brings together the strongest underwriting talent in the industry. Orvia is a home for specialists who want to push boundaries, learn from one another, and consistently deliver market‑leading results.

  • We connect brokers and insurance capacity through deep underwriting expertise and a culture defined by collaboration and trust. Our success is built on strong relationships and a shared commitment to delivering the right outcomes for our partners.

  • Service is our competitive edge. Fast, reliable and responsive, we are built around the needs of brokers. Powered by deep capacity partnerships, our underwriting combines speed, precision and consistency, strengthening confidence at every interaction.

A destination for exceptional talent. Attracting and developing top underwriting professionals is central to our ambition. We invest in our people, creating opportunities to grow, lead and shape the future of underwriting at Orvia.

Orvia Underwriting is an equal opportunities employer, with a growing and thriving diversity, equity and inclusion strategy; we are committed to a working environment that is free from discrimination, is inclusive, and empowers our people to bring their whole self to work and reach their full potential.

About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Role Overview 
 Private Capital Administration are currently hiring within our Private Equity Accounting team in Limerick, with opportunities available at Accountant, Consultant and Senior Consultant level.
 This is a great opportunity for individuals from accounting,  fund administration, practice, bookkeeping, or broader financial services backgrounds to join a high‑growth, evolving area of the business.
 As part of PCA, you will support the end‑to‑end accounting of Private Equity funds, gaining exposure to financial accounting and reporting, valuations, and client servicing within a collaborative, fast‑paced environment.
 
 Why join Private Equity Accounting (PCA)? 
 A key growth area for Northern Trust Ireland, with continued expansion and investment in the PCA technology platforms
 Opportunity to join a rapidly scaling function with strong long-term career potential

 Experience working across an end‑to‑end service model, including financial, accounting, reporting, valuations, and client servicing
 Strong focus on learning and development, with structured training and support for those new to Private Equity
 Clear progression opportunities from Accountant to Consultant and beyond
 Collaborative environment with a focus on long-term careers, flexibility, and development
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support the delivery of Private Equity fund accounting services, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
 Prepare and review financial statements and investor reporting
 Assist with valuations and Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations
 Reconcile financial information and investigate discrepancies
 Process and monitor expenses, fees, and fund activity
 Build and maintain client relationships, acting as a key point of contact for clients, auditors, and internal stakeholders to resolve queries
 Contribute to meeting regulatory and reporting deadlines
 Support team deliverables and participate in process improvements

 We welcome candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including:
 Accounting, practice, fund accounting, bookkeeping, financial services
 Experience Private Equity in is advantageous but not essential
 
 Key skills:
 Solid understanding of basic accounting principles (debits/credits, reconciliations)
 Strong attention to detail and accuracy
 Ability to work in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
 Good organisational and problem-solving skills
 Strong communication skills and a client-focused mindset

title: 2027 Internship - Software Engineer
description:
Virtu is an industry-leading financial technology firm that operates both proprietary trading and client-facing businesses in the global financial marketplace. Our cutting edge, proprietary technology is core to everything we do. We trade in over 35 countries, across 235 financial exchanges and over 25% of retail order flow in the US is serviced by Virtu.

Our team is a dedicated group of traders, quants and developers that are inspired by the unique and exciting challenges we solve every day. Our culture combines the creativity of a fast paced start up with the stability of a disciplined financial services firm. We are a flat organisation and encourage our people to innovate and lean on their teammates for support and collaboration. We have fun, work hard and strive to be virtuous in all we do.

Developer Internship

Virtu's internship programme offers students an extraordinary opportunity to learn about the firm and the world’s financial markets. We have built a thoughtful and challenging curriculum with projects that introduce students to the many complex and ever-changing problems to solve. Students can expect a company-curated global training week for our interns, real trading and quantitative problems to solve throughout the programme, and engaging social events to get to know our team and culture. 

  • Location: Dublin, Ireland (onsite)
  • Dates: 10 week programme, starting 21 June 2027 - 27 August 2027
  • Training: Ongoing training throughout the summer
  • Projects: Real problems to solve throughout the programme. Interns will work from a list of projects and have several senior mentors throughout the programme.
  • Perks: Daily catered lunches, fully stocked kitchen, on-site gym & workout classes, games room, social events and laundry service.

Our development team is a highly talented group of versatile software engineers. These engineers are responsible for the design, development and optimization of our proprietary, low-latency trading systems as well as our propriety trading algorithms. This team also creates powerful trading tools, which facilitate all trading stages of our high-performance system which is deployed in financial marketplaces around the world.

As an intern, you will complete a variety of challenging development projects. You'll work alongside our senior team to improve scalability, performance and efficiency of our cutting edge trading systems. This is a rare opportunity for students to learn first hand how to design and architect a trading system for scale and to support the massive amounts of data that flow through Virtu's trading systems daily. 

Requirements

Virtu is looking for top performers. Whether you’re a coding whiz or a master of Shakespeare, we would like to meet you!

 

  • Excellent academic background in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field
  • A physicalizer; a person who identifies issues and creates solutions without rigid direction or fanfare
  • Outstanding quantitative problem‐solving skills and mathematical aptitude
  • Highly motivated and tenacious individual, with a proven ability to take initiative and work independently and within a team
  • Team player: authentic, genuine person who is capable of working collective goals.
  • Graduating year of 2028

 

 

THE PROCESS

After applicants pass an initial resume screening, an online programming test will be emailed to you via Hackerrank. Upon review, we will reach out to arrange next steps. We are looking forward to meeting you!

Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
description:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month and growing fast! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Strong programming skills in at least two of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice ( https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page ) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying. 

Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers — from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide. 

Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful — and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us! 

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs. 

Who Should Apply 

We welcome applications from: 
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree (graduating 2027) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career. 

About the Role 

As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges. 

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. 
 
What You Will Do – Are these job responsibilities accurate for the internship?

- Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures 
- Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support 
- Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered 
- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions 

Internship Structure 

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday to Friday. 

Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go. 

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

- Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice. 
- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. 

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for an exceptional senior software development engineer to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 13 quadrillion metric observations per month! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

CloudWatch is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. 

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will lead the design and architecture of highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide and spanning multiple services and teams. You will shape the technical strategy and roadmap for the services you and your team own, making and documenting the key architectural decisions and tradeoffs, and you will stay hands-on — building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will raise the engineering bar across the team through code and design reviews, coding standards, and operational excellence, and help expand our services across all AWS Regions. When issues arise, you will dive deep to understand the root cause and drive fixes that prevent them recurring. Above all, you will mentor and develop the engineers around you, growing the technical capability of the team, and partner with product and other engineering teams to break ambiguous problems down into deliverable workstreams. You will champion the adoption of GenAI and AI-powered development tools across the team, raising engineering productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.

About the team
Our team owns telemetry collection for CloudWatch, building and operating the agents that gather metrics, logs, and traces at AWS scale.

title: Specialist, Talent Acquisition (Technology Recruiter)
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Specialist, Talent Acquisition (Technology Recruiter) 
Overview
Technology is at the heart of everything we do, and our European Tech Hub in Dublin is central to that. We're looking for a Technology Recruiter to join our European Technology Talent Acquisition team. You'll help us hire the engineers, product people and technical specialists who build Mastercard's future.
This isn't a generalist recruiting role. You'll focus on a group of related technology job families and become the go-to talent expert for them. You'll build deep knowledge of the skills, markets and people involved. You'll work with hiring managers across Europe and use a skills-based approach, modern tools and data to deliver great hiring outcomes and a candidate experience people remember for the right reasons.
What you'll do
• Own end-to-end hiring for your job families, from intake to offer, across Dublin and our wider European locations.
• Lead skills-focused kick-off meetings with hiring managers to agree on role requirements, critical skills, level and how candidates will be assessed.
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for your job families that stay open all the time, rather than filling one vacancy at a time.
• Source and engage talent directly through LinkedIn, networking, communities, referrals, events and social media.
• Write clear, inclusive job postings that describe roles in terms of skills.
• Screen and assess candidates against defined skills, using structured interviews, scorecards and technical assessment partners.
• Share market insight with stakeholders on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, competitor activity and emerging skills.
• Track your hiring data, including pipeline health, time-to-fill and diversity, and use it to spot risks and keep hiring moving.
• Keep candidates, hiring managers and your leader informed with clear, timely updates.
• Use AI-enabled recruiting tools and suggest new ways to make our hiring smarter and simpler.
• Take practical, deliberate steps to make our hiring process inclusive and fair.
About you
• Experience recruiting for technology roles from start to finish, whether in-house, in an agency or both.
• Confident sourcing people directly and building talent pipelines for technical roles.
• Good understanding of the Irish and European technology talent market.
• Comfortable talking about technical skills with engineers and hiring managers. You don't need to be technical, just curious.
• Organised and able to manage several open roles at once with pace, accuracy and follow-through.
• Comfortable using data to make decisions and share insights.
• Open to using AI and new technology in your work.
• Experience with Workday or a similar applicant tracking system is helpful but not essential.
Why join us
You'll join a supportive, high-performing team. You'll build real specialist expertise and work on some of the most interesting technology hiring in Europe. You'll also have room to grow your career, whether that means deeper specialism, leading a group of job families, or moving into a broader talent role.
We know great people don't always meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
Senior Software Development Engineer, Amazon DynamoDB
Location: Dublin, Ireland

Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission-critical workloads operating at more than 200 million requests per second? Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest-growing businesses depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB. In this role, you will help lead us on a journey toward a next-generation cloud database that takes advantage of the latest hardware advancements to deliver amazing performance at an attractive price point. You will design and operate reliable, highly scalable distributed systems, set technical direction for complex initiatives, and raise the operational bar for a service with the highest availability and durability requirements. This is a rare opportunity to tackle distributed-systems challenges at a scale and level of impact seen in very few places in the world.

Amazon DynamoDB is part of AWS Utility Computing (UC), which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon's Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement highly available, horizontally scalable distributed systems that store and serve customer data with strict durability and latency guarantees;
Own the technical design of large features and multi-quarter initiatives, decomposing ambiguous problems into deliverable plans for the team;
Solve hard distributed-systems challenges around replication, consistency, partitioning, reliability, security, and performance for a service running at massive scale;
Drive operational excellence for a tier-1 service — define best practices, improve observability, eliminate root causes of operational pain, and participate in the on-call rotation;
Perform data analysis to identify opportunities to optimize our services for performance and cost;
Lead design and code reviews and set technical best practices for the engineering team;
Mentor SDE Is and SDE IIs through code reviews, design guidance, and pair programming;
Maintain current technical knowledge to support rapidly changing technology, and work with the team to bring in new technologies when appropriate.
A day in the life
You might start the day with a design review for a new feature: a next-generation replication path for multi-region tables. You whiteboard trade-offs between consistency guarantees and throughput, debating how to minimize impact during failover. Later, you pair with a teammate to debug a race condition in the storage layer that surfaces only under high concurrency, then dig into operational metrics to pre-empt a scaling bottleneck before it reaches customers. You balance hands-on coding with the technical leadership that keeps a global service running reliably.

About the team
You'll join a team of curious, driven engineers who believe that technical excellence and world-class reliability are not aspirations — they are the baseline our customers deserve. If you want to build something that matters, alongside people who challenge and inspire you, this is the place. This is a rare opportunity to design and operate systems at true cloud scale while developing deep expertise in distributed systems and database technologies.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture. AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

title: FY27 Electronic Engineering Graduate Opportunities
description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.

 ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future. 

 About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
           
 Location: Limerick/Cork/Dublin, Ireland 
 
 Are you looking to work for a company that is Ahead of What’s Possible…. a company where you are empowered to Act with Courage, to Build great teams, to Create the future, and to Drive for Excellence?  If so, then Analog Devices International (ADI) is the place for you. 
 
 Leading Edge Technology; From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there.  Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Our automotive battery monitoring technology is used in the majority of petrol and diesel engine cars with engine start-stop functionality.  This helped prevent 33 million metric tonnes of carbon vehicle emissions last year globally, which is more than half of all the carbon emissions the whole of Ireland produces in a single year. In digital xray imaging our technology enables delivery of increasingly high image fidelity at lower radiation dosages. Because we are dedicated to solving the toughest engineering challenges, Analog Devices is one of the top 10 semiconductor companies in the world. 
 
 We don’t just talk about innovation, we live it ; At ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. A career with ADI means taking part in innovation and being challenged to achieve, and it offers the opportunity to work with other talented people, using state-of-the art processes and equipment. We run an annual Innovation Award for our Co-ops, a Global Early Employee Challenge for recent grads, and Hackathons for our wider community of employees. At ADI we strive to be Ahead of What’s Possible .
 
 Silicon Meets Software; Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between.  Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include; IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure.  As ADI continues to grow its software capability we’re also focussed on building expertise in the area of Machine Learning and AI.  We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real.
 
 One Company, Unlimited Opportunity; The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities. From our Graduate Rotation Program, to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success.
 
 We hire Graduates primarily from Electronics, Software, Computer Science, Physics, Maths Science, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Artificial Intelligence & Robotics and Chemical & Biochemical disciplines . Our grad opportunities work in areas like IC Design, Product Applications, Design Verification, Design Evaluation, Layout, Embedded Software, Software Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Engineering, Failure Analysis, RF Design, Research Science, Technical Marketing, Test Development, Packaging, Quality, Reliability and Supply Chain.
 
 Why Join ADI? 
 
 Competitive Salary, Bonus Scheme, plus relocation assistance 
 Competitive Holiday Allowance
 Graduate Rotation Programme for all new Grads to experience different functions and enhance skills 
 Learning Opportunities/ Access to Cutting Edge Technology
 Variety of Networks and Sports & Social Clubs
 Subsidised Canteen and Free Tea and Coffee Stations
 Onsite Occupational Health Clinic
 Cutting edge facilities in our European Research & Design Centre
 
 We will be recruiting for Graduate positions from September 2026 on a rolling basis until all positions filled.

title: Software Development Engineer, Lambda Runtimes, AWS
description:
AWS Lambda’s goal is nothing less than to simplify and improve the experience of computing in the cloud for every developer on the planet, from start-ups to the largest Fortune 100 companies. Serverless computing is rapidly changing how every company thinks about building and delivering software solutions, and Lambda is leading this industry wide effort.

Our Team

AWS Lambda is growing its initiatives in Dublin, Ireland, with goals of continuing to define the Serverless revolution. Lambda teams in Dublin are part of lambda experience charter with mission to simplify the developer, operator, and administrator tasks in bringing code from desktop-development to a production service. If you’re excited by Serverless computing, programming languages and container/function interaction models, this role is for you. Join us and change how the world computes by enabling new frameworks that enable customers to build better software on top of AWS.

Lambda Experience Runtimes is one of the most customer visible and developer commented upon areas of Lambda. The Language Runtimes team are responsible for the curation, patching and deprecation of all the six Managed Runtimes that Lambda supports such as Python, NodeJS, Java, Ruby, Go, DotNet in addition to the custom runtime plus the associated lambda container images.

An ideal candidate has experience delivering new initiatives and be comfortable working closely with Customers. You should be aware of industry best practices & patterns in all aspects of building, releasing & verifying software. You should also be familiar with industry trends in programming languages, build tooling, and deployment spaces. You will own and help driving exciting new and existing initiatives in Lambda, while being capable of working on massive scale, high availability, and ambiguous performance problems as well as developer experience problems. This role will involve identifying and solving problems in different programming language ecosystems, enabling new customer facing functionality, and new programming paradigms in the Serverless ecosystem.

What does it take to succeed in this role?

A roll-up-your-sleeves type. Comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. Able to think about business opportunities, operational issues, and architectural diagrams in the course of a single conversation. Intellectually curious, always looking to learn, and a dedication to turning developers into fans. Someone who makes the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

What you should expect?

If you’re excited by defining how modern and future software applications are built and want to help lead from the innovative edge, we guarantee that your work in our team will be ground-breaking and challenging. We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Together, we’ll deliver the next generation of industry-leading compute features and help every business from the smallest startups to the largest enterprises run their code in the cloud without the burden of infrastructure or scale (that’s our job). We’ll shape not just our own products, but contribute to the direction of AWS and the serverless industry.

Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Come help us change the world!

Job location is Dublin, Ireland. Relocation assistance available. For more information on Amazon Web Services, please visit http://aws.amazon.com

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Software Development Engineer (open-source), Runtimes
description:
AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that lets customers run code without provisioning or managing servers. As part of the AWS Lambda team in Dublin, you'll work on one of the fastest-growing services in AWS, processing trillions of invocations monthly for millions of customers worldwide.

We're seeking an experienced Software Developer to join our Dublin-based team working on AWS Lambda's Runtimes. The Runtimes team holds a unique position within Lambda, owning implementation, documentation, security updates, and supporting libraries that define how developers write and run code across multiple languages in Lambda. Unlike teams owning discrete services, Runtimes owns software with an extraordinarily large surface area spanning runtime versions across seven languages (Python, NodeJS, Java, .NET, Ruby, Go, Rust), each with its own dependencies, behaviors, and integration patterns with the Lambda platform and broader serverless ecosystem. This is a customer-visible and developer-scrutinized area in Lambda.

An SDE in this domain must possess versatile expertise across multiple programming languages and a nuanced understanding of how customers experience Lambda through its programming models. They actively engage with upstream open-source communities, ensuring Runtimes align with evolving language advancements. They simplify Runtime operations for efficiency and scalability, balancing security patching urgency against customer disruption risk.

This role offers the opportunity to solve complex challenges at scale and deliver best in class serverless customer experience.

As a team, we are dedicated to making new team members feel welcome and included. We strive to grow each other through task assignments, mentorship, and trainings. title: Fiduciary Specialist
description:
The role will report to the Head of UK & Europe Trustee & Fiduciary Account Management working within Citi Depositary Services Ireland DAC. Citi provides Trustee and Depositary related Fiduciary Services to regulated and unregulated investment funds and is a part of the Global Funds Services business. The position will be based in Dublin.

 This Role is a “Controlled Function” Role as defined by the Central Bank of Ireland Reform Act 2010 and Principal Regulations 2011, and amending Regulations 2014, 2015.
  
 Job Description: 
 Work as part of the UK & European Trustee & Fiduciary Account Management team responsible for leading a team of Fiduciary Account Managers, including responsibility for performance reviews and providing direction with team members' career development through training and coaching.
 Act as a senior contact in the delivery of an excellent Depositary service to our clients on all fiduciary matters.
 Responsible for core depositary duties including investment restriction monitoring, periodic NAV reviews, and cash flow monitoring for both UCITS and AIF clients.
 Maintain oversight of Fund Administrators, Managers, and Transfer Agents to ensure that funds for which Citi is the appointed Depositary are managed in accordance with regulatory requirements.
 Work collaboratively with offshored service providers through regular service calls and onsite review meetings to drive operational excellence.
 Ensure a consistent UK & European service and product offering is delivered and, where required, developed for existing and potential fund clients.
 Lead and support the implementation of new business onboarding and fund launches.
 Protect the interests of investors in funds and safeguard Citigroup's franchise, reputation, and fiduciary standing with regulatory bodies and the client base.
  
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Team Leadership & Fiduciary Oversight
 Lead a team of Fiduciary Account Managers; conduct performance reviews, provide ongoing coaching, and guide career development and professional training.
 Supervise and deliver core depositary functions—daily cash flow monitoring, periodic NAV reviews, and investment restriction monitoring across UCITS and AIF fund structures.
 Manage the annual due diligence plans and oversee Fund Administrators, Investment Managers, and Transfer Agents to verify that all fund administration, valuation, and governance processes comply with regulatory standards.
 Partner collaboratively with offshored service delivery teams through weekly and monthly service calls and operational metrics tracking.
 Ensure agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and commitments are monitored, tracked, and fulfilled, ensuring any operational issues are promptly escalated and followed through to complete resolution.
 Lead and support the onboarding and operational implementation of new fund business and mandate expansions.
  
 Client Management & Stakeholder Relations
 Act as a principal point of contact in delivering high-quality Depositary and Trustee services on all fiduciary matters.
 Present periodic fiduciary reports and governance updates at client board meetings and supporting team preparation.
 Liaise with internal support teams, client representatives, and external counterparties to effectively resolve outstanding queries and operational matters.
 Ensure all statutory and fiduciary duties are fully discharged, protecting investor interests and safeguarding Citigroup's market reputation.
  
 Projects & Continuous Improvement
 Participate with other Depositary jurisdictions on projects associated with regulatory change management, process enhancement, and operational standardization.
 Deliver key business initiatives and ad-hoc projects as directed by the Head of UK & Europe TFS Account Management.
  
 Regulatory Governance & General
 Maintain continuous, in-depth regulatory knowledge for self and the team, keeping fully abreast of updates to UCITS, AIFMD, and other relevant European fund regulations.
 Engage in specialized assignments and support leadership as requested by the Head of UK & Europe Fiduciary Account Management.
  
 Knowledge & Experience
 Professional experience in fiduciary, compliance, depositary/trustee, or broader financial services environments.
 In-depth understanding of European fund regulations, specifically UCITS and AIFMD frameworks.
 Strong technical knowledge of financial instruments, asset classes, and investment strategies.
 Experience in fund governance, administrator oversight, and exceptions-based monitoring.
  
 Qualifications
 Bachelor’s / University degree (or equivalent);
 Relevant Funds industry or compliance qualifications are highly desirable.
  
 Skills & Competencies
 Exemplary personal integrity and adherence to strong ethical standards.
 Strong team management and collaborative leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop staff.
 Demonstrated ability to multitask, prioritize high-volume deliverables, and maintain sharp attention to detail.
 Excellent oral and written communication skills with proven confidence in engaging with fund boards, senior client executives, and internal stakeholders at all levels.
 Self-starter mindset with the ability to take initiative, solve complex issues, and manage deliverables from inception to completion.
 
 What we can offer you: 

 By joining Citi Dublin, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed) and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits that support you (and your family) to be well, live well and save well. Discover more here. 

 Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day.  We want the best talent around the world to be energised to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive. 

 Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.

title: Specialist, Implementation
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Specialist, Implementation 
Overview

• The CIS Testing Team tests Mastercard products and services with financial institutions enabling production electronic payments globally.
• CIS ensures financial institutions are systemically synchronized with Mastercard financial messaging.
• The role ensures accurate and precise vetting of customer network interface and systems to process financial payments, and consumer tailored service interactions.
• Provides the ability for customers to test new Mastercard Release code.
• Accommodates testing whenever financial institutions and other organizations make changes on their systems.
• Do you enjoy learning new technology?
• Do you like working with customers toward a common goal?
• Have you ever performed a consultative role?

Role
• Act as central point of contact for customers and/or Mastercard customer representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.
• Provide testing expertise and support to Mastercard customers for all products and services.
• Act as processing implementation advisor, to customers’ processing support staff.
• Provide guidance to execute all necessary processing implementation activities. 
• Handle multiple key customer processing implementation projects in parallel, including key implementations (key customers, key markets, key services / products).
• Define, create, maintain and document standard and non-standard key customer processing implementation processes.
• Provide training to CIS organization, other Mastercard organizations and the customer.

All About You
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Exact Sciences, Business or equivalent work experience.
• Basic experience in Information Technology system knowledge, with strong understanding of network technology, applications, and project management. Basic payment transaction processing and industry business principles knowledge.
• Ability to interact with the customer and Senior management.
• Good verbal and written communication skills with ability to leverage these skills in a teaching environment.
• Ability to support change in a technical work environment. 
• Ability to multi-task covering multiple projects and products.
• Mobile payment background, basic API understanding (API developer skills is a big plus).
• Fluent in English is a must.
• Multilingual is a plus (Russian, French, Spanish). 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

About the role
Here at BT Sourced, we’re redefining procurement from top to bottom. We’re BT owned but operate as a standalone company, with a focus on making procurement simpler, more digital and more sustainable. We’re building a diverse team of brilliant people who want to challenge traditional ways of working and help shape the future of procurement.
As a Digital Analyst within our Procurement Excellence Team in Dublin, you’ll work across Data, Procurement, Digital and Technology to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, value-driven digital solutions. You’ll identify internal capabilities and external suppliers, gather requirements, explore emerging technologies and help take solutions from initial concept through to implementation and adoption.
This role matters because we’re increasingly relying on data-driven intelligence to make faster, better and more strategic decisions. You’ll contribute to complex, cross-functional projects, helping us use technologies such as AI, automation and analytics to improve efficiency, performance and user experience across procurement.
What you’ll be doing
Translate business needs into clear, prioritised and validated requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, enabling internal teams and external suppliers to deliver the right solutions efficiently.
Identify, evaluate and pilot emerging technologies, including AI, automation and analytics, turning suitable opportunities into scalable solutions with measurable business value.
Lead the successful launch and adoption of digital products by preparing business stakeholders, communicating expected benefits and ensuring solutions deliver measurable value by working with cross-functional technical teams or external suppliers.
Shape future business strategy and approach-to-market plans by assessing vendors and products against business needs, strategic fit, cost, scalability and expected value.
Undertake initial data investigation and exploratory data analysis to support procurement business needs.
Support end users by investigating and resolving business data, process and system-related issues, coordinating with relevant teams to achieve timely resolution.
Identify project risks, dependencies and changes, ensuring appropriate intervention and clear communication to stakeholders.
Build effective partnerships between business and technical teams, resolve issues and gather relevant information.
Drive innovation initiatives that deliver measurable business outcomes and improved user experiences.
Essential Skills / Experience
Relevant digital and transformation experience : Experience within Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Digital Transformation, data improvement or Technology Delivery, with experience delivering digital products, platforms or process transformation initiatives.
Business analysis and problem solving : Strong experience gathering and translating business needs into clear requirements and actionable solutions, including the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into measurable requirements and analytical frameworks.
Stakeholder and cross-functional working : Strong communication, stakeholder management, facilitation and influencing skills, with experience working across business, technology, data and operations teams.
Data and digital understanding : Understanding of data sources, structures, reporting approaches and performance measures, alongside an awareness of AI-enabled tools, workflow automation and AI-driven solutions.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Experience driving product roadmaps, backlogs, prioritisation and release planning.
Experience within Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Shared Services or Operations environments.
Experience using Microsoft Copilot Studio or comparable low-code and AI-enabled solutions.
Experience creating wireframes, mock-ups, prototypes or proofs of concept.
Experience using tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, reporting platforms or SQL to support solution development and analysis.
Familiarity with delivery and work-management tools such as DevOps, Jira, Planner or equivalent platforms.
Our Package
10% on target bonus
25 days annual leave + bank holidays and an opportunity to buy up to five more days every year
Hybrid working, with state-of-the-art offices within Canal Plaza
BT Sourced Pension Scheme - 6% BT contributions
Life Assurance from 1st day of employment - 4x salary
We provide healthcare cover and permanent health insurance (income continuance)
Access to excellent training tools, programmes and communities to help you connect, learn and grow.
And we like it when our people do good things so there will be the opportunity to take time off for volunteering and we'll help with your fundraising too.
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good.  Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country.   Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Logistics Specialist, Data Center - 2027 Internship
description:
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying. 

Behind every click, stream, and cloud service is real hardware — and someone needs to make sure it gets where it needs to be. As a Logistics Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help manage the supply chain that keeps our data centers running, from receiving and tracking parts to ensuring the right equipment is in the right place at the right time. 

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Logistics Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs. 

Who Should Apply 

We welcome applications from: 
- Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Supply Chain, Logistics, or a similar discipline who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career. 

About the Role 

You will join a creative, dynamic team of Logistics Specialists dedicated to providing world-class customer service — and you will be part of operating the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure. This hands-on role supports our procurement and supply chain operations. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. 

What You Will Do 
- Monitor inventory levels to ensure proper stock levels are maintained 
- Receive parts, maintain inventory records, and check out parts 
- Load and unload shipments and transport parts between different locations 
- Assemble, address, stamp, and arrange for the shipment of merchandise and materials 
- Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations Unpack incoming shipments and verify contents 
- Maintain precise records of all commodities going in and out of the facility 
- Physical Requirements 
- This role involves physical activity, including: 
- Regularly lifting and moving up to 16 kilograms (approximately 35 pounds) unassisted, and participating in group lifts for heavier items 
- Lifting loads of up to 22 kilograms (approximately 49 pounds) and carrying them for short distances 
- Continuously climbing and descending stairs safely (applies to sites with stairs) 
- Reaching and stretching to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance 
- Pushing or pulling heavy objects into position 
- If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation during the application or hiring process, visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.

Internship Structure 

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday. 

This is a paid internship. 

Please note that a full-time Logistics Specialist position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position. 

Diverse Experiences 

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying. 

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go. 

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help keep the supply chain moving for one of the world's largest cloud infrastructures — making sure the right parts arrive at the right place at the right time so millions of customers stay connected. 
- Impact. Your work keeps data centers stocked and operational. Every shipment you process and every part you track plays a role in keeping AWS running for customers around the world. 
- Action. You will move fast, solve real logistics challenges, and see the results of your work every day. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice. 
- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how a world-class supply chain operates at massive scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon. 
- Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape. 

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. 

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.
- In pursuit of a Technical/Bachelors Degree within a relevant technical field such as Supply Chain, Logistics or similar, graduating in 2027/2028
- English language proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
- Customer service experience
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordinate with your manager

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice ( https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page ) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
