title: Process Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Purpose of the Role: 
 The Process Engineer is responsible for supporting manufacturing operations through the administration and continuous improvement of production equipment maintenance systems, monitoring production performance, and ensuring compliance with quality and operational standards.
 This role plays a key part in maintaining efficient manufacturing processes, supporting non-conformance investigations, and driving a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence.
 This role will be based at our TPM in Fermoy, Cork.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage and administer the day-to-day demand and preventative maintenance system for on-site production equipment.

 Monitor manufacturing performance and support the identification and implementation of process improvements.

 Conduct and support Non-Conformance Assessments within Operations, ensuring appropriate corrective and preventive actions are implemented.

 Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, and quality teams to ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and compliant products.

 Support equipment reliability, uptime, and production efficiency initiatives.

 Ensure adherence to 6S standards and promote a clean, safe, and organized working environment.

 Maintain compliance with all applicable corporate, divisional, quality, and regulatory policies and procedures.

 Contribute to continuous improvement projects that enhance operational performance, product quality, and manufacturing effectiveness.

 Support investigations, root cause analysis, and process troubleshooting activities as required.

 Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 Essential 
 Third-level qualification or trade certification in Engineering, Manufacturing, Science, or a related technical discipline.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional manufacturing environment.

 Good communication and organizational skills.

 
 Preferred 
 Minimum of three years' experience within an engineering or manufacturing environment.

 Experience working in a regulated industry such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, or healthcare manufacturing.

 Knowledge of preventative maintenance systems and manufacturing process controls.

 Familiarity with quality systems, non-conformance management, and continuous improvement methodologies.

 
 Key Competencies 
 Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis

 Process Improvement

 Quality & Compliance Focus

 Equipment Reliability & Maintenance

 Data Analysis & Performance Monitoring

 Team Collaboration

 Communication Skills

 Safety & Environmental Awareness

 Continuous Improvement Mindset

 
 What we Offer 
 Attractive compensation package that includes competitive pay, as well as benefits such as
 Family health insurance,

 Excellent pension scheme

 Life assurance

 Career Development

 Growing business plus access to many more benefits.

 
 Connect with us at www.abbott.com or https://www.ie.abbott/, on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews.
 Abbott is an equal opportunities employer.

      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted. 
      
 JOB FAMILY: Manufacturing      
 DIVISION: ADC Diabetes Care         
 LOCATION: Ireland > Cork : Sanmina Rathealy road      
 ADDITIONAL LOCATIONS:      
 WORK SHIFT: Standard      
 TRAVEL: Yes, 10 % of the Time      
 MEDICAL SURVEILLANCE: Yes      
 SIGNIFICANT WORK ACTIVITIES: Not Applicable

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
About us  
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.  
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.  
 But we don’t stop there.  
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.   
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.  
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.  
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support the bid managers to fulfil the end-to-end Bid Management function by providing central management for global bid opportunity responses, including bid task assignment, tracking, collating, packaging, managing ad-hoc queries / request.
 Coordinate proposal input from a variety of stakeholders, typically involving contributions from Sales, Client Solutions, Engineering, Risk & Privacy, Security teams and more.
 Bring your organisational skills and effectively prioritise work to meet client deadlines.
 Ensure proposal documents follow corporate branding guidelines and quality standards by assisting the bid team in proof reading and formatting of proposal documents.
 Work closely with the Bid Managers to ensure key content is gathered, maintained and continuously updated in bid libraries using AI tools.
 Escalate to the Bid Management Team Lead if there are any risks, issues or dependencies which puts the submission timeline at risk.
 Attend Bid Sign On meetings, collate and distribute minutes / follow up actions.
 Support in managing and responding to the annual Vendor Due Diligence and Security assessments for our existing client base.
 Build strong relationships within the regional Sales teams, and our stakeholders.
  
 Requirements 
 Key Expectations 
 Skills 
 2+ years’ experience in Bid coordination or similar project-based role
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to present written information in a professional and concise format.
 Ability to manage and prioritise workload effectively.
 Willingness to support team with variety of cases simultaneously and ability to handle competing deadlines
 Strong attention to detail.
 Strong computer literacy, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook packages.
 Experience in online proposal tools advantageous
 Demonstrated mindset for continuous learning and knowledge transfer
 Literacy in AI tooling
 Benefits 
 Our promise to you    
 We are striving to become global leaders across all of the categories we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross functionally to accommodate our client’s needs.    
 Collaboration: Working together to achieve our best  
 Outcomes: Drive Success in every engagement   
 Respect: A collective feeling of inclusion and belonging  
 Excellence: Continuously raising the bar  
   What’s in it for you?    
 Healthcare cover through the VHI  
 Company pension contribution   
 Life assurance/ Income protection  
 23 days annual leave  
 3 company closure days  
 Annual bonus opportunity  
 Work From Home set-up allowance  
 Opportunity to work with clients and colleagues on a global scale for a world leader in Client Lifecycle Management  
 Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work from home policy, bike to work scheme, sports and social committee and much more 
 Buddy system for all new starters  
 Collaborative working environment  
 Extensive training programs, classroom and online, through ‘Fenergo University’  
 Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest of tools and technologies  
 Defined training and role tracking to allow you see and assess your own career development and progress.  
 Active sports and social club  
 State of the art offices in the heart of Dublin’s Docklands with great facilities, canteen and games area  
 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity   
 Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.  
   Recruitment Safety  
 For information on our recruitment process and how to verify communications from Fenergo, please visit our Careers page.

title: Accountant (9 month FTC)
description:
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys turning numbers into meaningful business insights? We're looking for an ambitious Accountant to join our team in Clonee, Meath and play a key role in supporting financial performance, driving continuous improvement, and helping the business achieve its strategic goals.
 
 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of financial reporting, analysis, business partnering, and process improvement within a dynamic and collaborative environment.
 
 This is a 9 month fixed term contract. 
 The Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing financial reports, ensuring compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements, and supporting the business in achieving its financial objectives. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to provide timely financial information to support decision-making.
 
 Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management accounts.
 Analyse financial performance and provide commentary on variances and trends.
 Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
 Prepare financial reports for senior management.
 Maintain the general ledger and ensure all transactions are accurately recorded.
 Reconcile bank accounts, balance sheet accounts, and other key financial records.
 Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
 Process journals, accruals, and prepayments.
 Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies.
 Prepare and submit VAT, payroll, and other statutory returns as required.
 Support internal and external audit processes.
 Maintain effective financial controls and identify opportunities for process improvements. 
 Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts.
 Conduct cost and profitability analysis.
 Provide insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
 Assist with business cases and investment appraisals

title: FPRT Lab Technician
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
   
 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
  
 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture Freestyle blood glucose test strips and Freestyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the Freestyle Precision, Freestyle Lite and Freestyle Libre systems.

 Main purpose of the role 
 To perform all set up, preparation and testing of sensors via Portal test system so that testing is performed on time, in full meeting all quality and compliance requirements, and in a cost-effective manner to meet the needs of the business & the customer. The role includes performing laboratory duties such as preparing buffers and performing validity testing using specified equipment. The person within the role will perform verifications of their colleagues’ actions and undertake batch record reviews and approvals, to support product batch release. Perform inspections associated with laboratory investigations and / or technical / quality system investigations and generate associated reports. he person will assist in the scheduling and control of testing to ensure all scheduled testing is performed correctly in a timely manner. The role is individually accountable for the quality and efficiency of their own actions whilst performing sensors testing, and via verifications also responsible for the actions of their colleagues.
  To maintain awareness of new/changed products and processes within the area, and to proactively support projects and drive improvements in terms of quality, cost and efficiency.
 The person undertaking the role will ensure their actions are compliant with Health and Safety regulations and standards by adhering the sites Health and Safety systems and procedures. Being accountable for the health and safety of themselves and others by highlighting where EHS improvements can be made.

 Main responsibilities 
 Operate laboratory equipment following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
 Perform troubleshooting and problem solving online following guidance in SOPs.
 Prepare solutions according to SOP’s, accurately weighing raw materials and performing calculations,
 Perform the associated Inventory Management transactions (i.e. generation of batch numbers and material usage transactions).
 Perform basic engineering functions (i.e. set-up checks and routine maintenance of laboratory equipment) and consistently maintain a high standard of housekeeping.
 Maintain good timekeeping for all tasks and to wear correct working attire and PPE.
 Perform cleaning of glassware and utensils and maintain the laboratory in a clean and fit condition for use
 Ensure sufficient stocks of all laboratory consumables available ready for use.
 Assist in the scheduling and control of testing and making sure all scheduled testing is performed correctly in a timely manner to ensure output targets and schedules are met.
 Perform Out of Specification investigations as per SOP, where applicable.
 Undertake the verification of data and documentation reviews as required.
 To adhere to training policies and procedures; being aware of their, and other Technician training status to ensure it is up to date prior to performing tasks and making sure they remain in compliance within the sites training system.
 Perform training of fellow Technicians.
 To know, understand and adhere to Health and Safety risk assessments applicable to the area.
 Pro-actively prevent/reduce the occurrences of non-conformances within the sensor testing area, and support non-conformance investigations, in addition to any associated corrective and / or preventative actions.
 Support audit readiness for internal and external quality system audits.
 Through role model behaviour, demonstrate full cross functional team support for the department and ancillary functions.
 Communicating details of laboratory activities with line managers and representing workgroup if and when required Ensure that any support functions, such as Engineering Support, or Unit Quality Assurance and Technical Support are notified in a timely manner.
 To always adhere to company policies and procedures and input data accurately into production records.
 To perform any other reasonable request.  Note: This job description describes the principal and main elements of the job. It is a guide to the nature and main duties of the job as they currently exist but is not intended as a wholly comprehensive or permanent representation.
 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 A Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in a relevant science or engineering discipline, or equivalent.
 Experience of working in a laboratory or product test environment and use of a variety of analytical/testing instruments, to provide a general knowledge of laboratory science is preferred.
 Basic computer skills are required to operate Laboratory based computer applications and equipment. 
 Exposure to working in a regulated environment where strict compliance and documentation discipline is preferred.
 Meticulous attention to detail – maintaining accuracy and consistency in high-volume, time-sensitive testing
 Accountability - for both personal actions and verification of colleagues’ work
 Compliance mindset — strict adherence to Quality, GLP & Health & Safety standards
 Proactive risk prevention & Problem solving - spotting potential problems & resolving efficiently
 Effective communicator — able to escalate issues promptly and represent the workgroup when required
 Time Management & Prioritisation-ability to manage schedules and ensure timely completion of testing.
 Health & Safety Awareness - strong commitment to EHS compliance and proactive identification of safety improvements.
  
 What we Offer 
 Attractive compensation package that includes competitive pay, as well as benefits such as
 Family health insurance,
 Excellent pension scheme
 Life assurance
 Career Development
 Fantastic new facility
 Growing business plus access to many more benefits.

title: 2027 Internship - Quantitative Trading
description:
Virtu is an industry-leading financial technology firm that operates both proprietary trading and client-facing businesses in the global financial marketplace. Our cutting edge, proprietary technology is core to everything we do. We trade in over 35 countries, across 235 financial exchanges and over 25% of retail order flow in the US is serviced by Virtu.

Our team is a dedicated group of traders, quants and developers that are inspired by the unique and exciting challenges we solve every day. Our culture combines the creativity of a fast paced start up with the stability of a disciplined financial services firm. We are a flat organisation and encourage our people to innovate and lean on their teammates for support and collaboration. We have fun, work hard and strive to be virtuous in all we do.

Quant Trading Internship

Virtu's internship programme offers students an extraordinary opportunity to learn about the firm and the world’s financial markets. We have built a thoughtful and challenging curriculum with projects that introduce students to the many complex and ever-changing problems to solve. Students can expect a company-curated global training week for our interns, real trading and quantitative problems to solve throughout the programme, and engaging social events to get to know our team and culture. 

  • Location: Dublin, Ireland (onsite)
  • Dates: 10 week programme, starting 21 June 2027 - 27 August 2027
  • Training: Ongoing training throughout the summer
  • Projects: Real problems to solve throughout the programme. Interns will work from a list of projects and have several senior mentors throughout the programme.
  • Perks: Daily catered lunches, fully stocked kitchen, on-site gym & workout classes, games room, social events, and laundry service.

Our Quantitative Traders are responsible for the design, operation, and improvement of high‐performance algorithmic trading strategies deployed on electronic trading venues around the world. They work to improve Virtu's trading algorithms through transforming large data sets into usable trading models. They work closely with our quants and software engineers to enhance and further develop the firm’s trading strategies. Quantitative Traders become experts in Virtu's trading technology and its interaction with the market.

As a Quantitative Trading Intern, you'll work alongside Virtu's senior traders on a variety of exciting and challenging projects that introduce you to all the intricacies of market making. You will know our trading strategies used in Virtu's customer market-making business. Interns in this track will apply their quantitative analysis and research skills to discover patterns that can potentially improve our trading algorithms. We've designed the internship to be very hands-on; interns will spend most of their time solving trading problems as they occur in the markets and working from a menu of projects with the team. Projects can come from a variety of different trading desks such as Foreign Exchange, Fixed Income, Options, ETFs, Energy and more. This is a great opportunity for the right candidate to kick start a career in the financial technology space.

Requirements

Virtu is looking for top performers. Whether you’re a coding whiz or a master of Shakespeare, we would like to meet you!

  • Excellent academic background (all subjects welcome)
  • Outstanding quantitative problem‐solving skills and mathematical aptitude
  • Some programming experience is required (Python, SQL, Java or C++ are a plus)
  • A physicalizer; a person who identifies issues and creates solutions without rigid direction or fanfare
  • Highly motivated and tenacious individual, with a proven ability to take initiative and work independently and within a team
  • Team player: authentic, genuine person who is capable of working collective goals.
  • Graduating year of 2028

THE PROCESS

After applicants pass an initial resume screening, an online programming test will be emailed to you via Hackerrank. Upon review, we will reach out to arrange next steps. We are looking forward to meeting you!

Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

  • Independently utilise support resources and tools to comprehend new and technical information

title: German Customer Support Specialist
description:
As a Customer Support Specialist, you will work directly with HubSpot customers across phone, chat, and web channels to resolve product-related queries as a trusted advisor. You'll deliver a human and proactive support experience, applying creative problem-solving to help customers optimise their use of HubSpot tools and grow their businesses. Collaboration within a dynamic team environment will foster a positive, inclusive culture where continuous learning and feedback are encouraged.

We’re a hybrid team, with this role being open in our Dublin office, with remote and flex options available for anyone based in Ireland

We are looking for people who:

  • Are fluent in English and German
  • Have a minimum of 1 year of experience in a customer support or technical support role, preferably within a software or technology company
  • Have a strong foundation in technical troubleshooting and enjoy delving into complex technical queries
  • Are adept at understanding and using product documentation to resolve customer issues effectively
  • Are self-motivated, always curious, and consistently eager to learn, with a growth mindset
  • Enjoy developing technical skills and acquiring comprehensive knowledge of our product and related technical concepts
  • Demonstrate a strong customer-first mentality and enjoy helping others by adding long-term value
  • Thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment and are comfortable with ambiguity
  • Embody our HEART values and contribute positively to our company culture

In this role, you will:

  • Utilise phone, live chat, and web tickets to partner with customers, effectively resolving issues and adapting to fluctuating inquiry volumes
  • Apply business acumen to customer situations to proactively identify challenges and opportunities
  • Remove technical barriers for customers and guide them through various tools within HubSpot
  • Independently utilise support resources and tools to comprehend new and technical information
  • Implement troubleshooting frameworks to test, replicate, and investigate technical queries, minimising escalations and resolution time
  • Identify and diagnose software issues to enhance the product experience for customers
  • Deliver thoughtful, empathetic, and comprehensive resolutions tailored to each customer, facilitating their business growth
  • Collaborate within HubSpot to deepen customer engagement with our platform and enhance the overall customer experience
  • Serve as a role model and trusted advisor, demonstrating a customer-first mindset and taking ownership of even the most complex and sensitive issues

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. 

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
€32.000—€44.000 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers. 

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore more:

title: AML/KYC Quality Control and Testing Specialist
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Northern Trust is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented AML/KYC Quality Control and Testing Specialist to join the First Line of Defence (1LOD) AML/KYC function.

 This role is responsible for executing quality control reviews and control testing activities across the KYC Center of Excellence (CoE). 

 The successful candidate will provide independent assurance over AML/KYC onboarding, periodic reviews, event-driven reviews, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) activities, helping to ensure consistency, quality, and compliance with regulatory expectations, internal policies, and operational standards. 

 This role supports the ongoing enhancement of the AML/KYC control environment through testing, root cause analysis, reporting, and continuous improvement activities.

 Additional responsibilities include:
 Performing risk-based quality control reviews of AML/KYC files, including onboarding, periodic reviews, event-driven reviews, and Enhanced Due Diligence cases.
 Executing testing of AML/KYC controls to assess compliance with regulatory requirements, internal procedures, and enterprise policies.
 Evaluating the completeness and accuracy of customer due diligence documentation, risk assessments, screening results, approvals, and audit trails maintained within AML/KYC systems.
 Identifying, documenting, and communicating testing findings, control weaknesses, procedural gaps, and quality issues in a clear and evidence-based manner.
 Supporting root cause analysis activities to identify recurring themes and opportunities to strengthen controls and processes.
 Tracking testing findings and remediation actions through to closure, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation where necessary.
 Contributing to governance reporting, including quality metrics, testing outcomes, trend analysis, key risk indicators (KRIs), and management information.
 Assisting in the development and maintenance of testing methodologies, sampling approaches, quality standards, and testing procedures.
 Partnering with KYC Operations, Program Management, and Risk teams to support remediation activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
 
 The ideal candidate should have a fair amount of the following skills & experience:
 University degree and/or relevant professional experience.
 Experience in AML/KYC Operations, Quality Assurance, Testing, Financial Crime Compliance, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
 Strong understanding of AML/KYC regulations and requirements, including Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
 Experience reviewing complex customer structures, high-risk client files, and financial crime controls.
 Understanding of quality assurance principles, control testing methodologies, and issue management processes.
 Strong analytical and investigative skills with excellent attention to detail.
 Experience producing management reporting and presenting testing outcomes clearly and concisely.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
 

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Occupational Health Nurse
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has been operating in Ireland since 1946 and serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.
 
 Abbott Ireland Diabetes Care Division Donegal 
 The Abbott Diabetes Care division based in Donegal Town manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre system.
 
 
 This is how you can make a difference at Abbott: 
 We currently have an opportunity for an Occupational Health Nurse to join Abbott Diabetes Care Donegal site.
 The Occupational Health Nurse (OHN) contributes to employee health and wellbeing through the effective implementation of Occupational Health programmes, delivering exceptional care in an environment where quality, respect, caring, and compassion are central. The OHN works closely with the Environmental, Health & Safety Manager, wider management, and the Occupational Health Physician to establish a first-class Occupational Health service that meets organizational needs.
 
 Main Responsibilities: 
 
 Clinical Services 
 Provide on-site Occupational Health service including employee consultation, first aid and emergency treatment.

 Conduct pre-hire medical assessments to evaluate fitness for work and ensure OH compliance.

 Oversee medical surveillance program in line with Abbott and regulatory requirements.

 Liaise with Occupational Health Physician for internal / external medical assessments as required.

 Manage absenteeism reviews and timely referrals to the Occupational Health Physician, review recommendations with Managers and HR.

 Implement case management plans and interventions to achieve timely outcomes.

 Support occupational illness and injury management, including incident investigations.

 Support the on-site clinical testing by providing a phlebotomy service.

 Conduct Drug and Alcohol testing in accordance with the site procedure.

 Oversee management of medical records in accordance with Abbott and regulatory requirements.

 Co-ordinate the First Aid and AED programme.

 
 Compliance & EHS Program Management 
 Complete gap assessments of the OH program to ensure compliance with Abbott and regulatory requirements.

 Maintain and implement OH procedures and programs aligned with Abbott, OSHA, and HSA standards.

 Lead and support EHS projects using problem-solving tools to ensure legal compliance and business benefits.

 Monitor and manage OH KPIs; define annual objectives and provide periodic status updates.

 Contribute to OH risk assessments such as: ergonomic, biological, reproductive, chemical and make recommendations to control hazards.

 Support and lead internal assessments, audits, and inspections including third-party and corporate reviews.

 
 Employee Wellness & Engagement 
 Advise employees on work-related issues and wellness initiatives.

 Organize and support health awareness programs including flu vaccinations, cancer prevention and mental health campaigns.

 Act as company representative for employee health and well-being initiatives.

 Ensure effective execution and sustainability of employee wellness programs through education and support.

 
 Communication & Leadership 
 Advise senior leaders on strategic Occupational Health priorities, implement improvements that enhance employee wellbeing, and contribute to budget planning and resource allocation.

 Lead the execution of Occupational Health strategy by defining annual goals, implementing targeted initiatives, conducting assessments and driving continuous improvement.

 Collaborate with functional support teams providing advice on all elements of the OH management system.

 Correspond with third parties including corporate teams, contractors, and agencies for reporting and audits.

 Develop and deliver training sessions on topics such as industrial hygiene, ergonomics and biosafety.

 
 This list of responsibilities may evolve based on operational needs, and employees are expected to remain adaptable and flexible as required.
 
 Qualifications 
 Must be a Registered Nurse with up-to-date NMBI registration.

 Recognised Occupational Health qualification.

 At least 2 years’ experience in an Occupational Health setting.

 
 Job-Specific Competencies and Knowledge 
 Familiar with Occupational Health practices, policies, and procedures, return to work, absence management and immunisations.

 Competent in the use of IT programmes and databases.

 Ability to analyse and report.

 Evidence of continuous professional development to maintain registration.

 
 Personal Competencies 
 Must be a strong team worker and work collaboratively.

 Proactive, self-motivated, and assertive.

 Must be able to communicate in an effective manner with all staff levels within the organisation.

 This role requires a level of flexibility to ensure the delivery of an effective and efficient service.

 
 What we offer: 
 Attractive compensation package that includes competitive pay, as well as benefits such as:
 Family health insurance

 Excellent pension scheme

 Life assurance

 Career Development

 Growing business plus access to many more benefits!

 
 
 Connect with us at www.abbott.com or https://www.ie.abbott/ 
 on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/ 
 on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott 
 and on Twitter@AbbottNews.

title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Maintenance Technician About Your New Employer Join an established electronic manufacturing on an ever growing team. 
 Become part of a technically advanced manufacturing environment focused on quality, reliability, continuous improvement and mission-critical technologies.
 Support products and equipment used by SMEs, multinational organisations and innovative start-ups around the world.
 About Your New Job As the Maintenance Technician, reporting to the Maintenance Manager, you will help ensure the reliability, performance and safety of production and facility equipment.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Carrying out planned, predictive and reactive maintenance on a wide range of manufacturing and facility equipment.
 Troubleshooting and repairing AC/DC power systems, PLCs, motor and servo drive systems, pneumatic equipment and compressed air systems.
 Interpreting technical drawings and schematics to diagnose equipment faults efficiently.
 Performing internal equipment calibrations and maintaining accurate maintenance and calibration records.
 Supporting the installation, commissioning, calibration and validation of new and existing equipment, including IQ/OQ/PQ activities.
 Applying Lean Manufacturing principles and contributing to continuous improvement activities.
 Communicating equipment issues effectively during shift handovers, particularly those affecting Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
 Maintaining a safe working environment and complying with all company safety procedures.
 What Skills You Need An NFQ Level 6 qualification, or a recognised trade qualification, in Electrical, Mechanical, Electromechanical or a related Engineering discipline.
 At least three years’ experience in an industrial or manufacturing maintenance environment.
 Practical knowledge of PLCs, motor drives and pneumatic systems.
 Strong electrical and mechanical aptitude, with hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial machinery.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
 What's on Offer The opportunity to work with advanced manufacturing equipment across the medical device, automotive, aviation, IoT and ICT sectors.
 A varied technical role involving maintenance, troubleshooting, equipment commissioning, calibration and continuous improvement.
 The chance to develop your technical expertise while collaborating with Engineering, Quality and Production teams.
 Competitive salary and benefits package, to be confirmed based on experience.
 A structured Monday-to-Friday working schedule with no weekend hours specified.
 What's Next Apply now by clicking the “Apply Now” button. If this role is not quite right for you but you are looking for a similar maintenance or engineering opportunity in Galway, please get in touch to discuss other available positions.

 Manage the end-to-end pension transfer process from a front-office perspective, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance. 
 Prepare and work closely with advisers and CSEs in relation to documentation, tracking transfer requests, and providing management information (MI) to support business decisions.  
 Manage pension transfer-in (FO)  
 On receipt of signed information mandate, gather pension schedule, to include information on fees, bonus, penalties and underlying investments if available. 
 Liaise with advisers to ensure transfer is in best interest of client. 
 Issue transfer paperwork to advisors and collect same for further transmission to external providers. At the same time, query if PAO exists. 
 Chase and provide weekly updates to advisers on status, even if no progression. 
 Once all paperwork and requirements are met, including the setup of receiving pension scheme, pass file to Pension Operations Team. 
 Manage Pension Transfer Out (FO)  
 Review instructions received and if in specie requested, liaise with adviser and IA. 
 Work with IA and advisor if assets need to be liquidated. 
 Ensure pro rata fees are charged on accounts before transferring out. 
 Keep client informed of process, any requirements and potential timeline. 
 Prepare transfer packs and ensure all documentation is complete and compliant.  
 Draft templates for client signatures and coordinate with advisers for timely execution.  
 
 Track & Report:
 Maintain accurate records of all transfer requests and monitor progress to completion.  
 Provide MI to management on 
 Pension transfer Funds Under Management (FUM) in pipeline.  
 Transfer turnaround times and process efficiency.  
 Stakeholder Coordination:
 Liaise with advisers, operations teams, and external providers to resolve queries and ensure smooth transfer execution.  
 Escalate issues promptly and propose solutions to minimize delays.  
  Compliance & Quality Assurance:  
 Ensure all transfers adhere to regulatory requirements and internal policies.  
 Work closely witb pensions technical team and Client suitability team to ensure consistency of advice on pension transfers. 
 Conduct quality checks on documentation and data accuracy.  
 Requirements 
 About you: 
 Strong understanding of pension transfer processes and regulatory requirements.  
 Proactive and commercially minded ensuring timely transfer of assets into Davy and a smooth client experience. 
 Strong communication skills with both clients and internal stakeholders. 
 Excellent organizational and time management skills.  
 Proficiency in MS Office and knowledge of pension administration.  
 QFA or relevant pension qualification preferred.  
 Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance.  
 Ability to improve processes where needed. 
 Strong communication skills for stakeholder engagement.  
 Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.  
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.  
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection. 
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most. 
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy. 
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy. 
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.  
 Important Information  
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland.
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 About the Team 

The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce’s own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.
 
 Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do. 
 Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings. 
 Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent. 
 Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents. 
 Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering. 
 

What it’s like to start here: You’ll join a team that is rebuilding how it works, and you’ll help shape it. You’ll work in real production, on real incidents, with people who will teach you. You’ll start with well-scoped work: triaging cases, investigating failures, following and improving runbooks, and building monitors and automations. As you grow, you’ll own root-cause analysis and a piece of platform reliability. We write down what we learn, and we favor automation over manual effort.

Who thrives here: You’re curious, you like finding out why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people. We’ll teach you the platforms and the operating practices.

As a Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you’ll independently run day-to-day production support and administration for Salesforce’s enterprise data and analytics platforms, working from established runbooks. You’ll own your case backlog, respond quickly and keep requesters informed, escalate with clear context, and help keep our support documentation accurate. You’ll grow toward owning escalations, root-cause analysis, and platform reliability.

 What You'll Actually Be Doing 

 Frontline Case, Alert & Escalation Management 
 
 Working with regional peers and leads , be among the first to respond to key signals and hand-raises from customers, agents, and alerts.
 Start investigations, open issues, and help triage. 
 Be a frontline responder when an incident starts: connect first, gather evidence and impact, and swarm with the team alongside Incident Command. Follow the runbook to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) when needed. SREs own incident resolution. 
 Provide Tier-2 production support: ticket triage, case management, and keeping backlog health. You are measured on the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART). 
 Support case and stakeholder satisfaction (CSAT, NPS) by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and closing the loop on every case. 
 Escalate cleanly on cases, intake, investigations, and gaps in SOPs: hand off to the right team with the evidence, impact, and steps already taken, and follow the escalation paths and time-zone handoffs in the runbooks. Growing toward owning escalations independently. 
 

 Platform Administration & Operations 
 
 Handle user provisioning, role hierarchy, and access management requests. 
 Troubleshoot declarative configuration, validation errors, and data discrepancies. 
 Execute scheduled data updates, bulk data loads and migrations, and basic sandbox maintenance. 
 Deliver moderate declarative solutions (for example Flows and validation rules) and platform enhancements. 
 

 Problem Management & Reliability 
 
 Contribute to RCAs, growing toward owning RCA and resolution for application bugs. 
 Help build and tune monitors, alerts, and automations. Flag technical debt and recommend fixes. 
 

 Process, Documentation & Playbooks 
 
 Follow and improve lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs), using team templates. Flag gaps and stale content, and draft updates from what you learn on cases. 
 Write knowledge articles and process maps so Tier-1/Tier-2 teams can reuse what you learn. 
 Map processes end to end with business partners. 
 Execute support playbooks as an SME and point of contact for development partners.
 

 Security, SOX & Compliance 
 
 Follow security policies and change controls. 
 Execute technology compliance activities, audit reporting, and SOX reporting. 
 Follow the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes. 
 

 Collaboration & Growth 
 
 Communicate clearly with business partners, engineers, and vendors across time zones. 
 Share knowledge and mentor new joiners. 
 Try new tools and practices, including automation and AI. 
 

 Flexibility 
 
 On-call and travel as required, subject to local regulations. Other related duties as required. 
 

 You're Our Person If... 
 
 Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.) 
 1-3 years of hands-on platform or systems support experience in an enterprise IT environment. 
 Ability to perform core support tasks independently from SOPs and runbooks, and to escalate with clear context across teams and time zones. 
 Foundational knowledge of Salesforce native functionality: objects, access management, reports and dashboards, and data model administration. 
 Experience with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules) and data loading (Data Loader, Workbench). 
 Basic knowledge of Service Management practices (incident, problem, change). 
 Strong written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and follow-through. 
 Ability to work with growing independence in a distributed, global team. 
 Certifications (achieved or actively pursuing): Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201), Advanced Administrator (ADM-211), and Platform Developer I. 
 
 Even Better If... 
 
 Certifications: Data 360 and Tableau, plus other specialist or consultant certifications. Platform App Builder. 
 Hands-on experience with Data 360, Agentforce, CRM Analytics, or Tableau. 
 Exposure to major incidents or RCAs. 
 Intro-level coding (Apex, Python, SQL). 
 Experience in SOX-controlled environments. 
 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 
 
 
 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Data Governance Specialist
location: United Kingdom, Dublin, Ireland, Netherlands, Luxembourg
description:
Data Governance Specialist 
 UK 
 U.S.  
 Luxembourg 
 Ireland 
 Netherlands 
 Monday to Friday 
 *U.S. 8:00 am to 5:00 pm 
 * EMEA: 8:30 am to 5:30 pm  
  
 Remote 
  
 The Data Governance Specialist supports the implementation and ongoing maturity of the enterprise data governance program within a federated operating model. The role partners with business data owners, stewards, and technology teams to establish consistent governance practices, strengthen data ownership and accountability, improve metadata and data quality, and support compliance with privacy, retention, and risk requirements. By coordinating governance activities, facilitating stakeholder engagement, monitoring performance, and promoting adoption of enterprise standards and tools, this role helps ensure data is well-managed, trusted, discoverable, and used responsibly across the organization
  
  
 Some of the things you will be doing: 
 Data Governance Program Support 
 Support the implementation and maturation of the enterprise data governance framework. 

 Assist in developing and maintaining data governance policies, standards, procedures, and operating models. 

 Facilitate governance councils, stewardship forums, working groups, and governance-related meetings. 

 Track governance initiatives, decisions, action items, risks, and issue remediation activities. 

 Promote governance awareness and adoption across business and technology teams. 

  
 Data Ownership and Stewardship Enablement 
 Partner with business unit leads to identify and document Data Owners and Business Data Stewards. 

 Facilitate stewardship onboarding and training activities. 

 Clarify governance roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and accountability expectations. 

 Coordinate stewardship activities across data domains and business functions. 

 Escalate unresolved ownership, accountability, and stewardship issues through appropriate governance channels.  

  
 Metadata and Data Catalog Governance 
 Support the development and maintenance of business glossaries, data dictionaries, and governance metadata. 

 Establish metadata standards, governance workflows, and quality expectations. 

 Coordinate metadata collection and validation activities performed by business and technical stakeholders. 

 Monitor metadata completeness and governance compliance. 

 Promote effective use of enterprise data catalog capabilities.  

  
 Data Quality Governance 
 Support implementation of enterprise data quality policies, standards, metrics, and controls. 

 Facilitate identification, prioritization, and escalation of data quality issues. 

 Coordinate remediation efforts with business stewards, system owners, and technology teams. 

 Track data quality trends, root causes, and corrective actions. 

 Report on data quality performance and governance outcomes.  

  
 Policy, Compliance, and Risk Management   
 Support alignment of activities with regulatory, privacy, records retention, and risk management requirements. Support implementation of data classification, retention, and protection requirements. 

 Assist with governance assessments, audits, and compliance reviews. 

 Maintain governance documentation and evidence required for internal and external audits.  

  
 Stakeholder Engagement and Change Management 
 Collaborate with business, technology, analytics, security, privacy, legal, compliance, and risk stakeholders. 

 Communicate governance standards, expectations, and program objectives. 

 Develop training materials, guidance documents, and governance communications. 

 Drive adoption of governance processes and stewardship practices through education and stakeholder engagement.  

  
 Reporting and Metrics 
 Define and track governance KPIs and stewardship performance measures. 

 Produce governance dashboards, management reports, and executive summaries. 

 Monitor governance maturity and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 

 Report governance risks, trends, and and adoption metrics to leadership.   
 

 What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?  
 Bachelor's degree in Information Management ,  Business, Information Systems, Data Management, Analytics, Computer Science, or  related discipline (equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal education). 

 Preferred CDMP or comparable data management certification. 

 3-5 years of practical experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, business analysis, risk management, compliance, records management, or compliance, records management, or a related field. 

 Practical experience applying privacy laws such as GDPR and/or CCPA in a corporate environment. 

 Practical experience with governance and catalog platforms such as Informatica Data Catalog, Informatica CDGC, Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, or similar tools 

 Proficient in SQL to pull, audit and analyze data sets 

 Knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles and governance best practices  

 Familiarity with metadata management, business glossaries, data catalogs, and data lineage concepts. 

 Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. 

 Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills. 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

 Ability to influence without direct authority. 

 Strong organizational and project coordination skills. 

 Ability to document policies, standards, procedures, and governance requirements clearly and consistently.  

 *This role is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (e.g., H ‑ 1B, TN, E ‑ 3) now or in the future. 
  
 #LI-Remote 
  
 **The salary range for this specific role will be € 34,599.76 to € 50,254.62 gross per year. The final salary will be determined based on relevant skills, experience, and role scope, in line with our objective and gender-neutral compensation framework.

Description:
Canada Life Assurance Europe plc (‘CLE’) is a dynamic insurance company with over 700 people across our offices in Germany and Ireland. We have been operating in Germany since 2000 and have established a fast-growing presence in one of the world’s largest and most established markets. We specialise in providing innovative unit-linked pension, savings, and protection solutions and have become a trusted partner for life insurance products distributed through independent brokers. It is our priority to support our customers at every stage of life with the best products and service, tailored to their needs - and we’re doing it all in a culture that promotes equality and inclusion for all of our current and future employees.
Role Overview
Canada Life Europe (CLE) is seeking an experienced Systems Analyst (SAN) to bridge business needs and technology delivery. The role combines structured analysis, systems thinking and practical delivery expertise to shape solutions from early discovery and estimation through design, implementation and transition to service.
The role holder is expected to work with a high degree of ownership, influence stakeholders, manage analysis across complex change, mentor less experienced analysts and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Systems Analysis practice.
This role is part of the I.S. Systems Analysis Team which is predominantly based in Dublin, Ireland. The successful candidate will be expected to work on programmes/projects across Germany and Ireland.
What you will help us to achieve
•    Elicit, analyse and prioritise business, system, data and non-functional requirements, defining outcomes, scope, assumptions, constraints, dependencies and success measures.
•    Facilitate workshops with business, technology, risk and third-party stakeholders, translating needs into clear, testable and traceable requirements and delivery artefacts.
•    Analyse current-state processes, systems, interfaces and data flows; assess end-to-end impacts and help define viable future-state solutions.
•    Ensure solution requirements address architecture, security, privacy, resilience, accessibility, auditability and regulatory obligations.
•    Work across discovery, refinement, estimation, delivery, testing, release readiness and production handover, resolving ambiguity and supporting decisions throughout.
•    Partner with engineering, QA, business SMEs and vendors to align acceptance criteria, implementation and test coverage with business outcomes and material risks.
•    Maintain accurate analysis artefacts, traceability and decision history in Jira and Confluence, and support production issue and root-cause analysis.
•    Mentor less experienced analysts and contribute to practice standards, knowledge sharing, process simplification and cross-team collaboration.
•    Use approved AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve analysis and documentation while retaining human judgement, confidentiality and validation.
•    Contribute to solution options analysis and recommendation, ensuring alignment with business strategy, architecture standards and target operating models.
•    Acts as a senior individual contributor within the Systems Analysis practice.
What you will need to be successful in the role
Essential Skills:
•    Third-level qualification in Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
•    At least five years of relevant business or systems analysis experience, including ownership of complex change in a large enterprise environment.
•    Fluent written and spoken English.
•    Strong practical knowledge of analysis techniques and standards aligned to BABOK or equivalent recognised practice.
•    Demonstrated ability to turn complex and sometimes ambiguous needs into clear, testable and implementation-ready requirements.
•    Experience analysing system behaviour, processes, data, interfaces and end-to-end impacts across multiple applications and teams.
•    Experience working in Agile delivery teams, with a sound understanding of the full software development lifecycle and quality practices.
•    Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, written communication and presentation skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and influence decisions.
•    Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving, prioritisation and risk management.
•    Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and take accountability for analysis outcomes.
Desired Skills:
•    Experience in life insurance, pensions, investment products or another regulated financial services environment.
•    Experience with customer, broker, back-office, workflow automation, integration or data-led change.
•    Practical knowledge of APIs, event or batch integrations, SQL, data mapping and logical data modelling.
•    Experience with enterprise architecture, business capability modelling, service design or product operating models.
•    Knowledge of German or experience working across Irish and German stakeholder groups.
•    Recognised Business Analysis qualification such as IIBA, BCS or equivalent.
Personal Strengths
•    Curious, outcome-focused and comfortable working through ambiguity.
•    Collaborative and able to build trust across business, technology and vendor teams.
•    Pragmatic, evidence-led and willing to challenge assumptions respectfully.
•    Committed to quality, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and professional development.
•    Able to balance pace with the control, documentation and traceability expected in a regulated environment.
Technologies & Tools:
•    Jira and Confluence for backlog, requirements, traceability and delivery documentation.
•    Modelling and diagramming tools such as Visio, Signavio, LeanIX or equivalent.
•    Microsoft 365 tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and approved Copilot capabilities.
•    Exposure to API tools, database query tools, prototyping tools or reporting platforms is advantageous.

title: Market Service Owner
description:
Job Description : 
 Market Service Owner 
 Nangor Road 
 7.5 Month (Fixed Term Contract) 

 About us: With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and setting a higher standard for our brands, our business and each other.
 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more

 About the Function: Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.
 With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.
 It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

 About the role The Market Service Owner will be responsible for order execution for a number of markets. Tasks include
 Coordinating international transport operations and assist production to meet customer demand.
 There will also be a continuous improvement element to the role with expectations on improving key KPI’s and pulling cost out of the business where possible.
 The Service and Supply team: Manage 6,500 orders per year.
 Deal with 400 product codes, 3 plants and 8M cases of product.
 Co-ordinate supply by sea, road, air to over 60 countries and 180 customers worldwide.
 Champions service for market and leads on resolving potential service issues.
 ‘Act like an Owner’. Run allocated region like a business. Accountable for benchmark delivery and cost.
 Great Teammate with ability to motivate and support development of others.
 Maintains awareness aspects of the business that impinge on service.
 Has the drive and commitment to overcome obstacles and get results.
 Has experienced a range of situations and knows how to get things done in an organisation: Dealing with incidents, Major change, necessary contacts.
 Excellent communication skills as will be building relationships with ‘Rest of World’.
 Prioritisation of workload
 Keen to develop and progress within team and ultimately Diageo.
 To manage all aspects of delivery of Baileys products from Ireland to the destination in accordance to Incoterms
 To prepare and collate export documentation relating to orders in line with market requirements
 Manage order dates in line with production planning and despatch requirements.
 Liaise with marine, road, and air carriers to book capacity, secure shipping instructions, confirm shipments and resolve.
 Prepare and collate order documentation, to meet market requirements with emphasis on C&E compliance.
 Liaise with the Regional Hubs to resolve service issues
 Monitor and record reasons for order failure to support benchmark measures, provide ownership for and input into corrective actions for misses.
 2+ years’ experience in a logistics/Supply Chain, ideally export related
 Supply chain systems: SAP, LCT, TMS
 Awareness of Supply chain processes E.g. planning, replenishment, make to order fulfilment, manufacturing, materials and services supply
 Experience of Microsoft Outlook, Excel essential
 Brand Awareness
 C&E Awareness essential
 
 Must exhibit following behaviours: Builds strong networks and relationships to help get things done - customers and partners in the supply chain
 A team worker – demonstrates that team performance matters more than individual contribution.
 Actively aids and contributes to Process Improvement
 Demonstrates commitment to high quality (information, data, documentation, communication)
 Proactively seeks out and deals with the root cause of problems – does not just fire fight.
 Responsiveness – responds quickly to requests and takes personal responsibility
 Takes initiative – is prepared to search out opportunities
 
 Experience/skills required: (TE) 

 Working with Us 
 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
 We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

 Recruitment Scam Warning Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

  
 
 Worker Type : 
 Regular 
 Primary Location: 
 Nangor Road 
 Additional Locations : 
 
 Job Posting Start Date : 
 2026-10-14
