description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 The role is for an Operational Risk Specialist, based in Ireland to act as the Designated Person PCF39B (subject to CBI approval) for Operational Risk Management on behalf of Northern Trust Fund Managers Ireland Limited (NTFMIL), which is authorised as a UCITS Management Company. The individual will work within the global Risk team, focused on supporting the successful EMEA and APAC Asset Management business and reporting to the International Chief Risk Officer.
 The role is suitable for someone with operational risk experience looking to apply that in a regulated role for a UCITS Management Company with over $100bn of AUM. The entity is responsible for both pooled and segregated mandates, which are managed by a combination of portfolio managers within NTFMIL and other NTAM entities.
 The individual will be the expert on all operational risk considerations for the entity, including third party oversight over the investment managers and other key NT service providers. 
 
 Key Duties and Responsibilities:
 Day-to-day oversight of operational risk processes, including business resilience
 Performing the DP for Operational Risk Management role Reporting to Boards and regulators
 Ownership of Risk Management Framework document
 Ownership of Risk Appetite Statement
 Monitoring and assessment of risk appetite
 Delivery of ICAAP risk assessments
 Working with other Designated Persons across the entity
 Support of global non-financial risk processes
 Participation in cross-functional committees supporting ongoing governance and strategic developments
 
 Knowledge and Skills:
 Track record in a risk management capacity at a senior level, with detailed knowledge of asset management businesses, especially EU/UK regulated entities
 Suitable qualifications and experience that directly support the expectations of the PCF39B role (DP for Operational Risk Management)
 Experience with regulatory communication and expectations, as well as knowledge of relevant CBI, ESMA and UCITS regulations
 Compelling written and verbal communicator, with the ability to adjust communication style to audience need when explaining complex situations
 A global outlook with sensitivity and awareness of social and cultural differences
 Significant experience in an asset management risk role, or an operational risk role in a regulated business
 

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

 A recognised professional accounting qualification (preferred), with relevant post‑qualification experience

 A collaborative, team‑focused approach with a clear commitment to shared success

 Why This Team

 Clear opportunities to deepen technical expertise and progress within a growing department

 Reasonable accommodation

title: Academy Professor, French & Portuguese
description:
Role Summary

HubSpot Academy is on a mission to be the place people go to learn how to start and grow a business. We offer a variety of educational and inspirational content — from lessons and full certification courses to live, hands-on workshops — that provides valuable business training to people all over the world. This educational content generates new customers for the business and delights our existing ones in service of achieving their business and career goals.

We're looking for a Professional HubSpot Academy Professor - Coach who is passionate about helping customers confidently use HubSpot tools through live, hands-on small group coaching sessions. This role is ideal for someone who shows growing independence and proficiency in live facilitation and content creation, effectively applying skills to enhance customer outcomes while contributing to HubSpot's educational mission at scale.

As a Professional HubSpot Academy Professor - Coach at HubSpot Academy, you'll be responsible for developing and delivering live, small group coaching sessions focused on specific HubSpot tools and use cases, as well as creating supporting on-demand educational content. You'll design engaging workshop experiences and practical learning resources that solve real customer problems, drive product adoption, and support long-term usage of HubSpot products. The role requires good understanding of adult learning principles, live facilitation skills, content creation abilities, and comprehensive knowledge of HubSpot's product offerings, as well as a passion for crafting hands-on learning experiences that deliver measurable impact at scale.

This role sits on the HubSpot Academy team and reports to the Manager of HubSpot Academy Education. You'll work alongside other Academy Professors and Customer Evangelists to develop comprehensive educational strategies that align with HubSpot's business objectives and support customers at scale.

What you'll do:

Facilitate High-Impact Small Group Coaching Sessions:

  • Lead multiple live, interactive coaching sessions each week for groups of customers focused on specific HubSpot tools, features, or use cases (e.g., Advanced CRM, Marketing Automation, Customer Agent, Loop Marketing plays)
  • Run sessions in alignment with standardized agendas and learning objectives while adapting to the needs and questions of each cohort in real-time
  • Demonstrate growing expertise in facilitating workshops where customers work on their real HubSpot challenges and leave having configured something concrete in their portal
  • Create supportive learning environments where customers feel comfortable asking questions, sharing use cases, and learning from peers

Create Supporting On-Demand Content:

  • Develop short educational videos, workbooks, and guides that complement small group coaching topics and enable customers to review key concepts
  • Create practical resources that customers can reference when implementing what they learned during coaching sessions
  • Design follow-up materials that reinforce session learning and support continued product adoption
  • Collaborate with Instructional Designers and content creators to ensure cohesive learning experiences across live and on-demand formats

Drive Product Adoption and Usage Uplift:

  • Design sessions and supporting content so customers leave with actionable next steps and concrete configurations in their HubSpot portals
  • Partner cross-functionality to understand which specific actions and sessions drive the largest usage movement
  • Refine content and facilitation approaches based on data showing what drives measurable customer outcomes
  • Track how coaching sessions contribute to customer activation, feature adoption, and ongoing product usage

Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

  • Work closely with Academy, Product, Creative, and Marketing teams to align session topics with product launches, spotlight moments, and strategic initiatives (e.g., AI adoption, Loop Marketing, Customer Agent)
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and leadership on what customers are saying and where they're getting stuck
  • Ensure coaching insights inform product roadmap and enablement priorities
  • Participate in cross-functional projects to develop educational strategies aligned with business goals

Maintain Operational Excellence:

  • Ensure accurate logging of sessions and attendance via Bevy and HubSpot systems, partnering with operations teams to resolve data integrity issues
  • Follow established workflows for customer inquiries about registration, scheduling, or follow-up questions
  • Use tools like Asana, AirTable, and Google Suite to coordinate session planning, content development, and track key metrics
  • Monitor registration and attendance patterns to optimize session timing, topics, and promotional approaches

Continuously Improve Content and Experience:

  • Iterate on session content, flow, and activities based on NPS, CSAT, qualitative feedback, and performance metrics (attendance, usage impact, repeat attendance)
  • Collect session feedback to continuously improve both live facilitation and supporting on-demand content
  • Experiment with new formats (e.g., "Build With" sessions, customer guest speakers, region-specific variants)
  • Share insights with the broader team to enhance the small group coaching program and on-demand content library

What you'll bring:

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and Portuguese
  • You have demonstrated experience leading live trainings, workshops, or group sessions (virtual or in-person) where you taught, demoed, and troubleshooted on the fly.
  • You possess exceptional facilitation and communication skills—you can read a room, simplify complex topics, and keep diverse audiences engaged and on track.
  • You have strong product aptitude and quickly learn new features, connecting them to real-world customer use cases across Marketing, Sales, and Service workflows.
  • You effectively communicate and collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to align on coaching objectives and customer needs.
  • You're energized by scale—reaching hundreds or thousands of customers through repeatable experiences—and see group coaching as core to the future of customer education.
  • You're customer-obsessed and empathetic, able to meet customers where they are in their journey, even when they're just beginning with advanced features.
  • You comfortably adjust to changing priorities in a fast-evolving environment where programs, tools, and processes are being optimized, and you actively contribute to improvements.
  • You can craft well-structured written content for workbooks, guides, and supporting materials that enhance learning experiences.
  • You independently explore and suggest innovative approaches to coaching and content creation, experimenting with new facilitation techniques and formats.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working directly with HubSpot (as a user, partner, or prior HubSpotter), especially across multiple Hubs
  • Experience facilitating global customer audiences across time zones
  • Familiarity with event platforms, and/or prior experience in scaled programs or live onboarding
  • Experience creating short-form video content or educational materials

 

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. 

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
€47.100—€64.800 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers. 

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

title: Operations Coordinator (Installations)
description:
Join us, be part of more.   
   
 We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that's energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion, and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently - we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it, and mend it.   
   
 About your team:   
   
 We’re the pride of Ireland. Bord Gáis Energy have been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for almost 40 years. But now, we’re so much more than just gas and electric. Through our unique combination of household heroes and energy assets, we’re at the heart of the energy transition in Ireland, strengthening the country’s energy security and helping customers get ready for a net zero future.
 
 We have an exciting opportunity for an Operations Coordinator (Installations) to join our growing Local Heroes and Net Zero teams. In this pivotal role, you'll act as a key point of contact for both customers and installers, providing first-line support across our installation ecosystem and helping to deliver a seamless end-to-end customer journey.

 Working closely with a wide range of stakeholders, you'll play a vital role in ensuring positive outcomes for customers and installers at every stage of the installation process. From resolving complex queries and complaints to supporting onboarding activities, driving process improvements, monitoring performance, and ensuring quality and compliance standards are met, you'll help shape an outstanding customer and partner experience.

 We're looking for someone who is passionate about building strong relationships, solving problems, and identifying opportunities to improve the way we work. You'll be comfortable analysing information, turning insights into meaningful recommendations, and contributing to projects that support business growth and transformation.

 Location : Based within commuting distance of our Dublin office , you'll be comfortable working on a hybrid basis with at least two days per week spent in the office.

 Key Accountabilities: 

 Provide first-line support to customers and installers, resolving queries, issues, and complaints.
 Coordinate installation schedules, surveys, and communication across customers, installers, and field teams.
 Build strong relationships with installers, surveyors, and trade partners to support business growth.
 Monitor service quality and compliance, ensuring partners meet agreed standards and deliver excellent customer experiences.
 Support the delivery of boiler and EV installations, ensuring a smooth end-to-end journey.
 Analyse operational performance, identify root causes, and help implement improvements.
 Drive initiatives to reduce complaints and enhance customer satisfaction.
 Liaise with suppliers to ensure orders are fulfilled and delivery timelines are met.
 Track and contribute to the achievement of key operational and customer service metrics.
 
 Here’s what we’re looking for: 

 Experience working in Customer Service/Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar analytical role.
 Salesforce experience is preferred (navigation, case management, dashboards & reporting).
 A team-oriented individual who will provide ground support for our sales and operations team.
 Aptitude for identifying gaps and implementing solutions.
 Ability to utilise technology for building solutions.
 Attention to detail while handling multiple, simultaneous projects under deadline pressure.
 Positive attitude with the ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
 Self-motivated and able to drive results independently.
 Experience working with contractors or third parties.
 Demonstratable experience of using data (Business Intelligence) to make informed decisions and influence others.
  
 The ideal candidate will bring experience from a customer operations, sales support, installations, or similar fast-paced environment and possess strong commercial awareness alongside excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. You'll be confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and thrive in a collaborative, dynamic setting.

 Most importantly, you'll have a growth mindset and a genuine desire to make things better. As part of a business operating in a rapidly evolving market, you'll embrace change, demonstrate adaptability, and play an active role in helping us deliver market-leading Net Zero solutions as we energise a greener, fairer future.
  
 
 Why should you apply?    
  
We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.  
  
 https://www.morethanacareer.energy/bordgais  
   
 If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.    
 
 Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
 Are you passionate about neuroscience, patient care, education, and cutting-edge medical technology? Do you thrive in a role where no two days are the same?

 We're looking for a driven and clinically minded Technical Consultant to join our growing Irish Neuromodulation Team, supporting innovative therapies that are transforming the lives of patients living with chronic pain and movement disorders.

 Working alongside an experienced Territory Sales Specialist and Technical Consultant, you'll play a vital role in supporting healthcare professionals and patients across the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland. This is a highly visible, field-based position offering the opportunity to work directly in clinics, operating theatres, and specialist healthcare settings, while partnering with leading clinicians at the forefront of neurological care.

 If you're excited by the opportunity to combine clinical expertise, advanced technology, patient interaction, and education while making a meaningful impact on patient outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

 Primary Responsibilities Provide clinical and technical support for Neuromodulation therapies, including DBS, SCS, and TDD.
 Support patient assessments, clinics, implant procedures, and follow-up appointments.
 Deliver hands-on technical support in theatre and outpatient settings.
 Educate and train healthcare professionals, multidisciplinary teams, and patients.
 Troubleshoot device and therapy-related issues, ensuring optimal therapy outcomes.
 Build strong relationships with clinicians, nurses, physiotherapists, and wider healthcare teams.
 Collaborate with commercial, clinical, and technical colleagues to deliver exceptional customer and patient experiences.
 Travel extensively across the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland.
 
 Required Qualifications Experience in a hospital or clinical environment, ideally within Pain Management, Neurology, Neurosurgery, Neurophysiology, or related specialties
 Experience supporting healthcare professionals and patients in a clinical, technical, or medical device setting
 Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
 Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and excel in a field-based role
 Willingness to travel frequently across Ireland
 
 Preferred Qualifications Degree in Neuroscience, Biomedical Science, Life Sciences, Nursing, Physiotherapy, or a related field
 Experience delivering education, training, or coaching to healthcare professionals
 Knowledge of Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS), Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS), or Targeted Drug Delivery (TDD)
 Passion for healthcare innovation, patient care, and advanced medical technology

title: Risk Trader
description:
Location : Dublin (2 days/hybrid) 
 Type: Permanent 
 
 Your next move 
 If you thrive on pace, enjoy taking initiative and are ready to adapt when things change, you’ll feel at home here. We’re looking for people who bring energy and curiosity, ask the right questions and find a way forward when the answer isn’t obvious. This is your opportunity to bring that approach to the UKI Risk Team, where our traders are the people behind the odds that our customers bet on. We utilise stats, in-house models, industry news and our opinions to solve problems, manage risks and power performance on all types of sporting events. 
 Risk Traders work as part of the UK&I Risk team to monitor Football and Sports customers’ activity in real time and retrospectively, assessing the future value of these customers and adjusting Flutter UK&I’s risk exposure to each customer accordingly. The Risk team also monitor Flutter UK&I’s liabilities across Football and Sports, acting as appropriate to manage Flutter UK&I’s risk exposure.. 
 
 What you'll take on 
 Put the Customer First: Help us deliver the sports betting experiences our customers love, ensuring we stay at the top of our game. 
 Adapt and Innovate: In this fast-moving industry, you'll work with your colleagues to build fresh, exciting betting options for over 1 million customers. 
 Solve Problems, Manage Risks: This role will teach you how to approach challenges strategically, improving the betting experience and learning risk management on the job. 
 Engage with Sports: Even if you're new to sports betting, we’ll provide full training to ensure you’re comfortable working with odds, pricing for multiple sports. 
 Build Technical Skills: You’ll gain exposure to ground breaking technical applications and analytics, helping you sharpen your analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 Grow Professionally: We support your development every step of the way, giving you the tools to expand your skill set and advance your career. 
 
 What you'll bring No prior Trading experience is required to succeed in this role, we’re looking for curious minds with a drive for continuous improvement. Our Trading Team are equipped to train you throughout your role. 
 Analytical Skills: Ability to think critically and solve problems using data. Excel experience is desired. 
 Attention to Detail: Precision is key to ensure accuracy in all trading tasks. 
 Organisation: Strong organisational skills to run multiple tasks and meet deadlines. 
 Communication & Teamwork: Collaboration across departments is crucial to improve customer experience. 
 Critical thinker: whether its analysing data or untangling a tricky situation, you always find the logic behind the madness. 
 
 What you'll get We are a flexible employer; whether you have personal commitments or a hobby that brings you joy, we want you to bring your best self to work. We also like to share our success; after all you make it happen. Our Benefits package includes; 
 Self-Development fund 
 Wellbeing fund 
 Uncapped holiday allowance 
 Enhanced pension scheme 
 Private Medical Insurance 
 Discretionary annual performance bonus 
 Invest via the Company Sharesave Scheme [Perm only] 
 Paid volunteering time per year 
 Enhanced parental leave 
 
 Flutter Entertainment ("Flutter") is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, ensuring every candidate can participate fully and fairly. We welcome requests for adjustments at any stage of the hiring journey and throughout employment. 
 If we are unable to meet a requested adjustment, we will work with you to explore suitable alternatives and ensure a fair and supportive process. Our goal is to enable all individuals to thrive, removing barriers, so they can reach their full potential. 
 
 Flutter Flutter is the world’s #1 online sports betting and gaming operator and home to some of the UK and Ireland’s most recognisable brands, including Paddy Power, Betfair and Sky Bet. We set the pace for our industry. And we’re always looking for what’s next. 
 Here, good ideas move fast. You’ll work with sharp people, solve problems at serious scale and be backed to challenge how things are done. Using our unmatched scale, we share ideas, tech and expertise across our brands and locations, turning great thinking into global impact.

title: 3D Fit Specialist
description:
3D Fit Specialist 
 Location: Dublin 
 Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way. 
 3D Fit at Primark 
 What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way

 What You’ll Do as a 3D Fit Specialist 
 You will lead the development, governance and continuous improvement of fit standards across Womenswear, Menswear and Childrenswear, ensuring consistent and customer-focused fit outcomes across all product categories. Working closely with Product, Technical, Sourcing and Supplier teams, you will drive the creation and application of standardised fit blocks, using customer insights and stakeholder feedback to refine fit standards and enhance product performance.
 You will champion the adoption of digital product development technologies, supporting the business strategy to reduce approval lead times, minimise physical fit sessions and increase efficiency across the development process. By leading the implementation of digital fitting solutions and embedding digital ways of working, you will help reduce sampling requirements, lower costs and improve speed to market. The role also holds responsibility for maintaining and governing technical documentation, digital assets and block libraries, ensuring information is accurate, accessible and aligned with business requirements.
  
 Contribute to the creation and implementation of a global block library, ensuring block details are delivered within critical path deadlines to support a fast-moving product strategy, enhance consistency, and improve right-first-time sample accuracy.
 Extensive understanding of apparel grading and its practical application to ensure accurate product fit and size progression.
 Work closely with QA Managers and QA teams to drive the implementation, compliance, and ongoing use of the Global Block Library within head office functions and the supplier base.
 Collaborate with QA and Buying teams to roll out and maintain Fit Expression, Length Guides, and fit standards and fit processes. Ensuring a consistent customer fit experience and adherence to agile ways of working.
 Lead the governance of apparel grading rules, points of measure standards, Fitting and Sealing processes, partnering with stakeholders and suppliers to ensure consistent application, fit integrity, and adherence to best practices.
 Partner with QA teams to lead fit-focused initiatives and the adoption of digital fitting solutions, providing training and technical support to ensure effective utilisation across the business.
 Work cross-functionally with Buying, Design, and the global supply base to drive the implementation of digital product development and fitting technologies, embedding new workflows and supporting the transformation of product development practices across the business.
 Ensure technical fit requirements are aligned to the needs of customers across all retail markets, including growth markets, and are consistently delivered across all product categories.
 Develop and maintain standards documentation and training resources, providing guidance and upskilling opportunities for stakeholders and suppliers as required.
 Champion digital innovation, keeping abreast of evolving technologies and advancements in virtual garment creation while building internal and external networks to drive opportunities across digital product development systems and workflows.
 

 What You’ll Bring   
 Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:
 Contribute to the creation and implementation of a global block library, ensuring block details are delivered within critical path deadlines to support a fast-moving product strategy, enhance consistency, and improve right-first-time sample accuracy.
 Extensive understanding of apparel grading and its practical application to ensure accurate product fit and size progression.
 Work closely with QA Managers and QA teams to drive the implementation, compliance, and ongoing use of the Global Block Library within head office functions and the supplier base.
 Collaborate with QA and Buying teams to roll out and maintain Fit Expression, Length Guides, and fit standards and fit processes. Ensuring a consistent customer fit experience and adherence to agile ways of working.
 Lead the governance of apparel grading rules, points of measure standards, Fitting and Sealing processes, partnering with stakeholders and suppliers to ensure consistent application, fit integrity, and adherence to best practices.
 Partner with QA teams to lead fit-focused initiatives and the adoption of digital fitting solutions, providing training and technical support to ensure effective utilisation across the business.
 Work cross-functionally with Buying, Design, and the global supply base to drive the implementation of digital product development and fitting technologies, embedding new workflows and supporting the transformation of product development practices across the business.
 Ensure technical fit requirements are aligned to the needs of customers across all retail markets, including growth markets, and are consistently delivered across all product categories.
 Develop and maintain standards documentation and training resources, providing guidance and upskilling opportunities for stakeholders and suppliers as required.
 Champion digital innovation, keeping abreast of evolving technologies and advancements in virtual garment creation while building internal and external networks to drive opportunities across digital product development systems and workflows.
 

 Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.
 About Primark  
 At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 19 countries today and growing.
 So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.
 You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Job Title:

Job Description:
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as KYC Remediation SME . Reporting to the KYC Remediation Lead , this full-time and permanent position is based in China, Foshan and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Client Acceptance and its’ growth.
Key responsibilities:
The KYC Remediation SME is responsible for leading and managing the implementation of customer due diligence (CDD) processes across the organization and being a subject matter expert for first line teams. This position ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, mitigates financial crime risks, and promotes the effective management of customer risk profiles. The role requires collaboration with various teams, including compliance, legal, risk management, and operations, to ensure the policies are consistently and effectively applied.
Develop, update, and implement CDD processes and operational guidance in line with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and the organization’s risk appetite.
Input into the creation and maintenance of CDD policies to ensure that they effectively identify, assess, and manage risks associated with customers, including anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), and other regulatory compliance requirements.
Lead the rollout of CDD processes across business units, ensuring consistency and alignment with the organization's overall risk management framework.
Stay up-to-date with local, national, and international regulatory changes (e.g., FATF recommendations, AML regulations) and adjust CDD processes as necessary.
Work closely with compliance teams to ensure that the CDD policies meet all regulatory requirements.
Develop and deliver training programs for staff on CDD processes and operational guidance, ensuring they are well-versed in how to identify and address potential risks.
Foster a culture of compliance, ensuring Onboarding and KYC teams understand the importance of due diligence and the risks of non-compliance.
Monitor the effectiveness of CDD processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and compliance.
Identify any gaps in the CDD process and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to close those gaps.
Liaise with business units, operations, and IT departments to ensure the design of CDD processes are practical for day-to-day operations.
Provide guidance and support to business units in implementing the CDD policies and processes and resolving any compliance issues that arise.
Prepare reports on the status of CDD policy implementation and compliance for senior management and regulatory bodies.
Be Accountable To:
Senior Management for supporting implementation of customer due diligence policies,
Relevant stakeholders for providing guidance and support in operationalising CDD.
Regulatory bodies for adhering to industry standards and regulations.
Peer and Stakeholder Relationship:
Provide regular communication between business resources, stakeholders & management
Facilitate workshops and other forums in the identification and resolution of complex issues or new opportunities
Contribute and participate in team activities, e.g., meetings, planning, goal setting
Provide support to other team members in both debriefing and assisting in delivery of outputs
Display behaviours such as flexibility to the changing needs of the business and communicating clearly and effectively to the various teams involved in initiatives
Others
Own your professional development
Support colleagues with transformational growth and compliance excellence as and when required
Any other duties that from time to time may be considered appropriate by your line manager
Key requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certifications (e.g., CAMS, ACAMS) is a plus.
Proven experience (5+ years) in compliance, risk management, or regulatory affairs, with a focus on customer due diligence, AML, or financial crime risk management.
Strong knowledge of global regulatory frameworks (e.g., FATF, OFAC, EU AML Directives).
Experience in process development, implementation, and monitoring.
Ability to communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly and effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent project management and organizational skills.
Proficient in compliance software and tools, as well as Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Expertise in CDD, AML, KYC (Know Your Customer), and other financial crime risk mitigation strategies.
Strong analytical and risk assessment skills.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

title: ES Operations & Project Specialist
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Employee Success 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 As a key member of Salesforce’s Employee Success – Global ES Operations team, this role shapes a world-class employee experience. Sitting within a dynamic and innovative HR organization, the Operations and Project Specialist leverages Salesforce technology and strong cross-functional partnerships to deliver scalable, employee-centric solutions across regions.
In this role, you will support Salesforce’s global Hire-to-Retire and Payroll transformation, driving process excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement while providing operational support to our Centers of Expertise. You will be a go-to specialist for complex Leave of Absence, Benefits, and other key aspects of the employee lifecycle, ensuring policies are applied with care, accuracy, and empathy.
Success in this position means thriving in a fast-paced environment, managing highly sensitive information with discretion, and acting as a proactive teammate who enjoys solving complex problems in an ambiguous environment. If you are highly organized, detail-focused, and excited by technologies like AI, you will have the opportunity to reimagine how HR operations work and help transform how every employee experiences their lifecycle at Salesforce.

 Project Management (Primary Focus) 
 Lead and support special projects and programs across the Hire-to-Retire lifecycle (e.g., Global Time & Attendance and Benefits), including reviewing BRDs, conducting UAT, driving change management, and managing stakeholder communications (including Workers Council updates). 
 Partner with the team to proactively identify and deliver operational and employee experience improvements using AI, automation, RPA, and data-driven insights. 
 Contribute to post-project hypercare and stabilization plans to ensure smooth transitions, timely issue resolution, and strong adoption of new solutions. 
 Train and enable People Services team members on new processes, procedures, and tools to embed changes effectively and build team capability. 
 Build trusted, consultative relationships with operational management and Employee Success partners at all levels to align on process, policy, and operational impacts. 
 Support development and maintenance of end-to-end SOPs and process maps in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders (Benefits/LOA, Payroll, Employee Relations, Legal/Compliance) to harmonize and standardize global operations. 
 2. Employee Support and Case Management 
 Deliver frontline support to prevent, resolve, and refer employee questions or concerns across Benefits, Compensation, Time Off, and Leave of Absence, acting as the trusted first point of contact for HR inquiries. 
 Serve as liaison between Benefits/LOA vendors and Salesforce employees, while functioning as the primary escalation point for LOA specialists, managers, Total Rewards COE, and other stakeholders. 
 Act as subject matter expert on leave policies and regulations, interpreting Salesforce practices to provide expert advice, guidance, coaching, and case management for complex individual leave scenarios. 
 Partner with global stakeholders as a thought leader to design seamless, end-to-end experiences for high-visibility LOA and Benefits programs that prioritize employee experience. 
 Develop, implement, and continuously improve internal team procedures, conducting regular audits to ensure full compliance with Salesforce policies, procedures, and current legislation. 
 Drive compliant, scalable processes for LOA, compensation, and benefits administration through proactive documentation, process harmonization, and opportunity identification. 
 Requirements and Qualifications 
 Education and Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) required. 
 Project Management experience is required. 
 Minimum 3 years’ experience in human resources, including leave management experience and LOA administration & vendor management. 
 Experience of benefits management across EMEA desirable. 
 Prior experience in HR operations, shared services organization, or a centralized HR function preferred. 
 Experience working in a high volume, fast-paced environment, preferably in a high growth technology company. 
 A strong track record in implementing or assessing technologies such as AI, RPA, chatbots or advanced analytics in HR/operations is highly desirable. 
 Technical Skills: 
 Advanced knowledge in Excel and/or other spreadsheet applications 
 Experience with case management systems and Workday is highly desirable. 
 Advanced knowledge and experience with Google Suite. 
 Fluency in English, both verbal and written; proficiency in other European languages is highly desirable. 
 Core Competencies: 
 Demonstrated ability to successfully navigate ambiguity, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a constantly changing environment. 
 Highly resilient and adaptable, with a proven ability to pivot and perform effectively in a rapidly changing environment. 
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills. 
 Outstanding time management and professional communication skills. 
 Exceptional verbal and written presentation skills, including the ability to craft materials for audiences at all levels of the organization. 
 Able to work both independently and collaboratively, effectively managing day-to-day work and deliverables with moderate guidance. 
 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 
 
 
 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

At AIB, we believe that great financial planning can make a real difference to our customers' lives.
Customer Financial Planning is a key strategic growth area for AIB, and we are seeking ambitious and customer-focused Financial Planning Specialists to help support our growing affluent customer base across the Dublin region. Build trusted relationships with affluent personal and business customers, delivering comprehensive financial planning solutions tailored to their individual needs and goals.

Support the achievement of regional and local Customer Financial Planning objectives, helping drive commercial performance and customer outcomes.
Operate to the highest standards of professionalism, governance, risk management and regulatory compliance.

Essential
Fully QFA qualified.

Excellent communication, relationship management, negotiation and influencing skills.
Desirable

Experience working in a target-driven, customer-focused environment.

Employee Assistance Programme
Family leave options

Graduate AI and Knowledge Validation Analyst - Boston Scientific 2027 Graduate Programme, Clonmel
Work mode:
Onsite
Onsite Location(s):
Clonmel, Ireland
Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance
At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.
Advancing possibilities for a brighter tomorrow
Boston Scientific is seeking a highly motivated Graduate AI and Knowledge Validation Analyst   on a defined-term (23months) basis to join our Clonmel team .
Job Purpose:
Start your career where your ideas, curiosity and technical skills can make a meaningful difference. As a Graduate Engineer/Analyst at Boston Scientific, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, contribute to innovative medical technologies and build hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.
Act as the quality control function for AI capabilities, ensuring AI-generated outputs are business-ready, accurate and trusted.
This is an opportunity to apply what you learned during your studies, develop your technical and problem-solving capabilities and gain valuable experience while contributing to technologies designed to improve patients' lives.
Key Responsibilities:
AI Testing and Validation
Test AI-generated process comparisons.
Validate solution recommendations.
Identify AI hallucinations or inaccuracies.
Support prompt optimization.
Deployment Copilot Development
Test business use cases.
Create a prompt library.
Support user adoption activities.
Document lessons learned.
Continuous Improvement
Gather user feedback.
Measure AI effectiveness.
Recommend enhancements.
Track adoption metrics.
Education & Experience:
Hons Bachelor Degree (Level 8) in computer science, information systems or engineering is essential.
Graduated within the past two years or currently in the final year of university.
Relevant work experience or completion of a co-op program, ideally with AI and machine learning coursework.
Eligibility to work in Ireland.
Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the initiative to contribute in a collaborative environment.
Strong systems aptitude and an interest in developing technical skills, interest in information systems.
Enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.
Interest in medical technology, manufacturing, product development or continuous improvement.
Strong analytics, data science and statistical skills.
What we can offer you
Competitive Benefits – we offer market leading benefits including performance-related bonus, pension contribution, onsite gym, onsite parking, subsidised canteen, organised social groups and healthcare.
A Career with Meaningful Purpose   – opportunity to transform the lives of patients worldwide.
Our Culture   - our work is guided by core values that define our culture and empower our employees.
Career Development   – our highly engaged leaders will empower you to grow and will invest in your potential. You can also broaden your skills through personal development courses.
Opportunity to Innovate   – we encourage you to fulfil your true creative potential by speaking up with your ideas and solutions to problems that matter.
Work-Life Balance   – we have created a culture that acknowledges, respects and supports your life and work choices.
Corporate Social Responsibility   – we are dedicated to progressing business practices in areas important to our communities. Our onsite charity events have raised over €1.5 million for worthy causes in the past ten years.
Boston Scientific Ireland Graduate Programme cosing date is 22nd November 2026.
As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.
So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!
To search and apply for open positions, visit: https://bostonscientific.eightfold.ai/careers
At Boston Scientific, we recognise that nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace helps us be more innovative. It is essential in advancing science for life and improving patient health. We stand for inclusion, equality, and opportunity for all. By embracing the richness of our unique backgrounds and perspectives, we create a better, more rewarding place for our employees to work and reflect the patients, customers, and communities we serve. Boston Scientific is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.  Boston Scientific is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with a disability. Should you require a reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please email TalentAcquisitionIre@bsci.com

title: Sr Accountant I - Indirect Tax
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
 Position-Specific Job Requirements 
 1. Develop strong relationships with GFS, Corporate Tax, Market Finance, external service providers, and business stakeholders.
 2. Support the centralized preparation and review of indirect tax compliance deliverables including VAT, Intrastat, EC Sales, and other indirect tax filings where applicable.
 3. Coordinate the collection, validation, and analysis of financial data required for indirect tax reporting and compliance activities.
 4. Ensure timely and accurate preparation of indirect tax, reconciliations, supporting schedules, and compliance submissions.
 5. Perform indirect tax account reconciliations and support resolution of tax-related balance sheet and P&L items.
 6. Partner with RTR, OTC, PTP, Supply Chain, and Tax teams to ensure transactions are correctly reflected for indirect tax purposes.
 7. Maintain compliance with company policies, internal controls, Worldwide Controller's Manual requirements, and local statutory obligations.
 8. Identify indirect tax risks, control gaps, and process inefficiencies and recommend appropriate remediation actions.
 9. Contribute to the development, documentation, and maintenance of indirect tax processes, controls, and standard operating procedures for the GFS Centralisation Model.
 10. Support indirect tax compliance reporting requirements under applicable local regulations and tax legislation.
 11. Drive continuous improvement initiatives through automation, standardization, and process optimization.
 12. Support tax technology and ERP initiatives, ensuring indirect tax requirements are appropriately incorporated into system enhancements and process changes.
 13. Act as a champion for the Global Financial Solutions operating model and support finance transformation initiatives.
 14. Build effective partnerships across global functions and diverse geographic locations.
 15. Quickly establish credibility with stakeholders and influence cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
 16. Ability to travel as required.
 17. Support broader RTR and finance initiatives where required.
 18. Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of Gilead's centralized indirect tax operating model and compliance framework.
 ________________________________________
 Education and Experience Requirements 
 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Business, or related discipline.
 • Professional tax qualification (CTA or equivalent) preferred and would be advantageous in supporting the technical requirements of the role.
 • Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent) preferred.
 • Experience operating within a Shared Service or Global Business Services environment is advantageous.
 • Experience within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or multinational corporate environment is desirable.
 ________________________________________
 Knowledge & Competencies 
 1. Experience managing indirect tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including VAT returns, Intrastat, and EC Sales List (ESL) reporting.
 2. A strong understanding of VAT processes and the ability to identify potential risks, inconsistencies, or gaps within existing filings.
 3. A proactive mindset with the initiative to investigate root causes, challenge existing processes, and drive improvements where opportunities are identified.
 4. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Tax, IT, market teams, and external providers to resolve issues and drive continuous process improvement.
 5. An interest in process optimization, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
 6. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of issues through to resolution.
 7. A technology-focused mindset, with a willingness to leverage digital tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
 8. Comfort working with AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot and an openness to incorporating emerging technologies into day-to-day activities.
 9. Experience with Excel, data analysis, reporting tools, Power Query, and automation solutions would be an advantage.
 10. Understanding of accounting principles and their interaction with indirect tax reporting requirements.
 11. Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP, and utilizing tax-sensitive financial data to support compliance processes.
 12. Strong analytical and reconciliation skills with attention to detail and a focus on data accuracy.

 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) It is the policy of Gilead Sciences, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively "Gilead" or the "Company") to recruit select and employ the most qualified persons available for positions throughout the Company.  Except if otherwise provided by applicable law, all  employment actions relating to issues such as compensation, benefits, transfers, layoffs, returns from layoffs, company-sponsored training, education assistance, social and recreational programs are administered on a non-discriminatory basis (i.e. without regard to protected characteristics or prohibited grounds, which may include an individual’s gender, race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, creed, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, medical condition, veteran status, and age, unless such protection is prohibited by federal, state, municipal, provincial, local or other applicable laws).  Gilead also prohibits discrimination based on any other characteristics protected by applicable laws.

description:

Careers
Resident Engineer (Project Opera)
24/04/2026
18 month Contract | Full- time
Location: Limerick
Reports to: Director of Civil Engineering
The Company
PUNCH Consulting Engineers is one of Ireland’s leading and most experienced Civil & Structural Engineering Consultancies. Since 1973, we have grown to be one of the largest Irish-owned consultancies, with vast experience in multi-disciplinary services including Civil, Environmental, Structural, Roads & Bridges, Marine & Energy and Conservation. We have offices in Dublin, Limerick, Cork, Galway and Glasgow and Macclesfield in the UK.
The Opportunity
PUNCH Consulting Engineers is seeking an experienced Resident Engineer (RE) to lead the on-site resident engineering team on Project Opera, a landmark €150m mixed-use development in Limerick city. This is a high-profile public project of regional and national significance, involving the redevelopment of a 3.7￼acre city￼centre site within Limerick’s Georgian Quarter. The successful candidate will take a key role in the oversight and delivery of multiple construction contracts, ensuring works are executed to the highest technical, safety, and quality standards. The role is offered on an initial 18 month full-time contract, commencing at the successful candidate’s earliest availability.
Project Overview
Client: Limerick Twenty Thirty (LTT)
Architects: Coady Architects; Henry J Lyons Architects
Engineering Services: PUNCH Consulting Engineers (Civil & Structural); C&S Engineering Services (M&E)
Project Value: c. €150m
Construction Contracts
Contract A: Demolition & Enabling Works (2022)
Contract B: 7‑Storey Office Building (2023)
Contract C : Library & Offices (2024)
Contract D: 14 Storey Office Building (2024)
Project Opera proposes the complete redevelopment of an existing city block, delivering new commercial, civic, and public‑realm infrastructure, including offices, a city library, an apart‑hotel, a public plaza, underground parking, and the refurbishment of protected heritage structures.
Key Responsibilities of the Role
Assist in liaising with the employer’s representative, contractor, client and all major stakeholders
Organise and maintain adequate site supervision at all times during construction works
Maintain a comprehensive site diary, recording detailed construction activities and significant site events
Ensure that accurate and complete site records are kept, including reports, diaries, correspondence, and photographic records (hard and soft copy), and made available for inspection by authorised personnel
Review and report on contractor payment applications against verified work completed
Ensure all contractor design submissions and variations to the Works Requirements are reviewed, approved, and fully documented prior to execution
Monitor construction progress against the approved programme and report any delays or risks
Ensure compliance with the conditions set out in all relevant permits, licences, and statutory approvals
Assess contractor submissions, including method statements, for compliance with the Works Requirements, and liaise closely with the Employer’s Representative
Verify that Temporary Traffic Management Plans and construction phasing are implemented as agreed with the Client and relevant stakeholders
Prepare draft responses and supporting information for the Employer’s Representative in relation to claims for additional payment or extensions of time
Provide regular reports on contractor payment requests and value engineering proposals
Carry out any functions or powers delegated by the Employer’s Representative under the construction contract
Liaise with and support the Employer’s Representative throughout the construction and defects periods, providing site data, surveys, and photographic records as required
Assist with the administration of the construction contract, including correspondence and contractual records
Maintain records relating to delays, industrial disputes, adverse ground conditions, and disputes involving subcontractors, landowners, pier users, or local businesses
Attend and contribute to Construction Stage Monitoring Meetings, including taking minutes where required and preparing reports in advance summarising progress, expenditure, resources, defects, and outstanding issues
Ensure effective communication with all site supervisory staff on matters affecting their work
Maintain continuous awareness of the duties and responsibilities of contractors and others under Safety, Health and Welfare at Work legislation
Liaise with statutory undertakers, stakeholders, and landowners as required
Provide information to support the Employer’s Representative in preparation for conciliation or arbitration proceedings, and participate in such hearings where necessary
Contribute to the development and ongoing review of the Construction Risk Register
Mandatory
Degree in Engineering or construction management
Experience in civil engineering works
What We Offer You
Competitive remuneration package, commensurate with experience, the salary band for this role is €50,000 to €65,000
Flexible and hybrid working conditions
Pension Scheme
24 days annual leave
A highly valued mentoring system in one of Ireland’s most experienced engineering consultancies
Training and continued professional development CPD
Active Sports and Social and annual summer outing
PUNCH Consulting Engineers hold IMS (Integrated Management Systems) Certification with NQA for the following standards:
ISO:9001-2015 Quality Management System
ISO:14001-2015 Environmental Management System
ISO45001-2018 Occupational Health and Safety
Equal opportunity employer

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

At PUNCH, we understand the value of education. That’s why we support our staff who wish to undertake further education and training. We encourage staff members to maintain their Continuous Professional Development (CPD) accreditations with Engineers Ireland. We also continue to offer training in sustainable design and construction through seminars, in-house lectures, and external training programmes. We promote the achievement of professional titles with institutions such as Engineers Ireland, the Association of Consulting Engineers of Ireland, the Institute of Structural Engineers, and the Institute of Civil Engineers.
Read More.
Goal 12
Policies that govern our processes are key to achieving our goals. As an ISO-accredited organisation, we are held to account for our Environmental Management and Waste Management standards. Our Environmental Management System ensures our policies are comprehensive and comply with our long-term goals. It encapsulates sustainable procurement, supply chain management, and material sourcing. As part of our commitment to Goal 12, we implement waste management policies, recycling programmes, and circular economy initiatives to help us achieve our goal.
Read More
Goal 9
Designing for the future begins in the now. Together with design teams, we work to provide designs that meet sustainable development standards. How we choose to build, the materials we select, and the carbon associated with them, all impact our design choices. At PUNCH, we have developed an R&D Group which investigates the benefits of adopting Modern Methods of Construction and lower embodied carbon materials from a sustainability perspective. Our design processes adopt sustainable technologies and evaluation processes. We encourage our teams to develop and use innovative techniques and methods in our portfolio of work, ensuring that staff have access to any information they might need in order to enhance their work. Our Pledge to Net Zero has given us insight into the thought leadership needed to achieve this goal.
Goal 6
Clean water and sanitation are basic human rights. Our work designing water and wastewater facilities is only part of our responsibility as engineers. We recognise that water usage is a right not everyone is afforded. Therefore, we have a duty to ensure that we do not excessively use or waste this valuable resource. As part of our commitment to net-zero, we monitor our water usage across our offices by checking the facilities in place, examining water meters and inspecting the efficiency of white goods in our canteens. On our projects, we implement water management plans, including water reuse potential for landscaping and rainwater utilisation. We fully embrace Sustainable Urban Drainage systems in our designs, which help with maintaining clean and reliable water sources.
Goal 4

BIM/Revit Technician

PUNCH Consulting Engineers have a vacancy for a structural  BIM Technician  at our Dublin (Dun Laoghaire) and Cork offices.
Job Description:
The work will be primarily office based with some site inspection duties.  Under the supervision of more senior technicians and engineers you will assist in the preparation of high-quality engineering BIM models and design drawings for a broad range of national and international structural engineering projects. You will assist in the preparation of planning, tender and construction documents.  All work will be carried out in accordance with the company ISO procedures.
Candidate specification:
A Higher Certificate (NFQ Level 6) in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
An excellent working knowledge of REVIT, together with a good working knowledge of AutoCAD and CADS-RC.
Significant experience in working on BIM projects in accordance with ISO 19650-1:2018 and ISO 19650-2:2018 standards .
Applicants must have a minimum  5 years  post-graduate experience in a design office assisting in the preparation of drawings for outline and detailed designs for structural engineering projects.
Draughting experience on building projects using concrete, steel, timber and masonry.
A thorough understanding of construction materials and construction methodology.
Civils experience of drainage, water, roads etc. an advantage.
Site experience gained in the inspection of on-site works.
A proactive approach to solving problems with an ability to adapt to changing scenarios
Excellent communication skills.
Proven commitment to CPD.
A comprehensive remuneration package is on offer for the successful candidate which includes competitive salary in line with experience, company pension and a commitment to ongoing training and development.

title: Safety Technician
description:
Keeping our people safe and well at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in making this happen. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop through a global company. You’ll work closely with our experts to monitor your site, which means you’ll get to see the difference that you make to people’s well-being every day. 

This role requires flexibility to work Night Shifts.

Key job responsibilities
- Carry out risk assessments and audits
- Monitor the site to make sure processes are in line with Amazon’s safety procedures
- Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues to review
- Work with colleagues in Operations and across the business on safety-related tasks and offer guidance on processes
- Support in putting new safety measures in place

A day in the life
You'll be based at one of our sites. This means that you can closely track what's happening and people can easily ask you any questions throughout their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential issues before they happen. You'll spend a lot of time checking the site and getting to know the way that people use equipment. By understanding how every task and machine works, you'll be able to think about the best way to keep processes safe. You'll also be one of the people to put safety changes into action, which means you'll get to work closely with lots of people. Alongside your daily and weekly tasks, you'll offer support to our Operations team on ad-hoc safety-related work. Safety is so important to Amazon, and you'll help us gather the vital data that keeps us on top of our processes and ahead of any issues. You'll also share that data with people across the business and work with other teams to make sure they're putting safety first.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.
- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent)
- Experience running metrics reports, analyzing data to identify problems and using data analysis to generate and explain metrics
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Knowledge of Irish Health and Safety legislation
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies
- Experience planning or managing environmentally conscious initiatives
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.
