title: Oracle E-Business P2P Functional Consultant (Contract)
description:
For over 30 years,  Version 1  has been a leading Oracle partner specialising in Enterprise Applications, delivering ERP, HCM and EPM solutions that enable organisations to transform and modernise their core systems.  
 Combining deep domain expertise with end-to-end delivery and managed services, we support some of the UK and Ireland’s largest organisations in driving business value through Oracle technology. 
 Top-tier Oracle partner across Database, Platform, ERP, and Managed Services 
 37 UKOUG awards  over the last 3 years 
 13 awards  - UK Oracle User Group (UKOUG) Community Awards 2026 (4 Gold, 5 Silver, 4 Bronze) 
 Certified Great Place to Work 
 Recognised as a  leader in AI & digital transformation consulting  with global delivery footprint 
 With  3,800+ people  and revenues exceeding  €347m/£302m , Version 1 is a market leader in Oracle, Microsoft, and AWS consulting services – and one of the fastest-growing digital consultancies in Europe.  

 Oracle E-Business P2P Functional Consultant (Contract) 
 YOU MUST BE ELIGIBLE FOR IRISH SECURITY CLEARANCE .
 Are you an experienced Oracle E-Business Suite Procure-to-Pay consultant who enjoys transforming business processes and delivering meaningful change?
 We're looking for a talented Oracle EBS P2P Functional Consultant to join a major ERP transformation programme, helping to redesign and optimise procurement operations within Oracle EBS 12.2.
 This is a fantastic opportunity to work at the heart of a large-scale business change initiative, partnering with stakeholders to modernise processes, enhance user experience and maximise the value of Oracle E-Business Suite.
 If you're passionate about procurement transformation, stakeholder engagement and delivering practical Oracle solutions that solve real business challenges, we'd love to hear from you.
 The Opportunity 
 As a key member of the ERP programme team, you'll work closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand current procurement processes and design future-state Oracle EBS solutions that improve efficiency, control and user adoption.
 You'll facilitate workshops, challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for improvement and help shape a modern, streamlined Procure-to-Pay landscape.
 What You'll Be Doing 
 You will: 
 Lead workshops with business users and stakeholders to understand current procurement and supply chain processes.
 Analyse existing Procure-to-Pay workflows and map requirements to Oracle EBS 12.2 functionality.
 Drive process mapping, process redesign and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Conduct gap analysis and identify opportunities to enhance procurement performance and user experience.
 Develop functional solutions across Oracle Procurement and P2P modules.
 Create and maintain process documentation, solution designs and ERP landscape artefacts.
 Support solution testing, user acceptance testing and defect resolution activities.
 Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions.
 Provide functional expertise during deployment, go-live and post-implementation support.
 Advise stakeholders on best practice, solution options, risks and dependencies.
 

 What We're Looking For 
 Essential Experience 
 You will have: 
 Strong Oracle EBS Procure-to-Pay functional consulting experience.
 Expertise across Oracle Purchasing, Procurement, Self-Service Procurement (iProcurement), Inventory and wider P2P processes.
 Proven experience delivering Oracle EBS implementations, upgrades or transformation programmes.
 Strong workshop facilitation, business analysis and requirements gathering skills.
 Experience producing process maps, solution designs and gap analysis documentation.
 Ability to engage confidently with business stakeholders at all levels.
 Experience supporting testing, training and business change activities.
 At least 7 years' Oracle consulting experience.
 Minimum of two Oracle EBS implementation, upgrade or migration projects.
 Desirable Experience 
 You will have: 
 Understanding of Oracle Financials modules and their integration with P2P processes.
 Experience using BI Publisher and OBIEE reporting solutions.
 Oracle certifications.
 PRINCE2, PMP or similar project delivery certifications.
 Previous experience within Local Government, Central Government or the wider Public Sector.
 Experience working within large, complex transformation programmes.
 Why Join? 
 This role offers the opportunity to have a genuine impact on how procurement services are delivered across a large organisation.
 You'll work alongside experienced Oracle professionals, business leaders and programme stakeholders, helping to shape future processes and drive tangible business improvements.
 You'll be joining a high-profile transformation programme where your expertise will influence solution design, operational efficiency and long-term business outcomes.
 If you're an Oracle EBS P2P Consultant looking for your next challenge and want to play a key role in a significant Oracle transformation programme, we'd love to hear from you.

 Why Join Version 1's Oracle Practice?  
 Join a global Oracle practice of  700+ specialists , supported by  500+ certified professionals  across the Oracle ecosystem. 
 Work on  large-scale, multi-pillar Oracle Cloud transformation programmes  for some of the UK's most recognised organisations. 
 Collaborate with a  high-performing, market-leading Oracle team  renowned for delivering complex enterprise transformation projects. 
 Be part of an organisation that provides  end-to-end Oracle services , including consulting and advisory, implementation, integration, cloud infrastructure, and managed services. 
 Leverage our deep  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)  expertise to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud solutions for enterprise clients. 
 Accelerate your career through our  Strength in Balance  and leadership development programmes, supported by quarterly  Pathways  career reviews. 
 Benefit from a substantial  training and certification budget , helping you stay at the forefront of Oracle technologies and industry best practices. 
 Enjoy meaningful recognition through our  Annual Excellence Awards , Call-Out recognition platform, and quarterly profit-share scheme. 
 Influence testing strategy, delivery quality, and business outcomes across some of the UK's most significant ERP transformation programmes. 
 Work with prestigious clients, including organisations such as the  Bank of England  and  Birmingham City Council . 
 Take advantage of our  flexible hybrid working model , combining remote delivery with occasional client or hub-based collaboration. 
 Access enhanced wellbeing and family support through our  maternity, paternity, and Moments that Matter  policies. 
 Be part of a purpose-driven culture with opportunities to contribute to  ESG, CSR, DEI, volunteering, and community initiatives  that create a positive social impact. 
 At Version 1, you'll combine industry-leading Oracle expertise, meaningful career progression, and the opportunity to deliver transformational outcomes for some of the world's most recognised organisations.  
 Benefits include:   
 Quarterly  performance-related profit share   
 Hybrid / Remote  working flexibility  
 Pension, private healthcare, life assurance  cover  
 Certified  Great Place to Work  for 10+ years running  
 This is hybrid based with occasional travel to your nearest base office.   
 Ashley Billington, Head of Talent Acquisition – Enterprise Applications (Oracle Cloud - ERP, HCM, EPM)   
 +447840839370   
 #LI-AB1       
 #LI-Hybrid     
 We are an equal opportunities employer. Please refer to our Diversity & Inclusion statement located at: Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging | Version 1 Careers  
 Please note: We have an internal recruitment team and do not accept agency candidates. If you want to join the team here at Version 1, get in touch with us directly!

Job Summary
Deliver high quality desktop support services in a hybrid work model ensuring stable and secure end user computing environments across a multinational organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to resolve incidents efficiently optimize device performance and uphold service level objectives for a diverse global workforce with rotational shift coverage.
Responsibilities
Provide advanced desktop support to resolve incidents and service requests for laptops and desktops while maintaining high end user satisfaction levels through timely resolution and clear communication
Perform detailed troubleshooting of operating systems applications and network connectivity issues to restore user productivity while minimizing business disruption across global teams
Implement standardized configuration and hardening of desktop environments to ensure compliance with organizational security policies and industry best practices for end user devices
Monitor and manage endpoint health using enterprise tools to proactively detect performance issues and apply corrective actions that sustain device stability and user experience
Coordinate with infrastructure application and security teams to escalate complex technical issues while ensuring accurate documentation and successful incident closure within agreed timelines
Execute software installation upgrades and patch deployments on user devices to maintain compatibility security posture and adherence to corporate software lifecycle standards
Document technical solutions known errors and standard operating procedures in a structured knowledge base to support faster issue resolution and consistent service delivery by the broader support team
Provide clear guidance to users on best practices for device usage collaboration tools and secure working habits in a hybrid model to enhance productivity and reduce preventable incidents
Analyze recurring incidents and problem trends to recommend improvements in tools processes or configurations that reduce ticket volumes and support efficient operations for the organization
Collaborate with asset management teams to support inventory accuracy device lifecycle tracking and replacement planning that optimize resource utilization and cost effectiveness for the company
Adhere to rotational shift schedules while maintaining reliable coverage for critical support windows ensuring continuous assistance to employees across multiple regions without compromising service quality
Maintain meticulous records of incidents changes and configurations in the service management platform to support audit readiness operational transparency and informed decision making by stakeholders
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives by sharing feedback insights and ideas that enhance support processes contributing to safer more efficient and more inclusive digital workplaces for society. Qualifications
Showcase strong experience in desktop support including troubleshooting of hardware operating systems collaboration tools and enterprise applications gained over two to five years in professional environments
Demonstrate proficiency with remote support tools endpoint management platforms and ticketing systems to handle requests efficiently and ensure consistent service quality
Apply solid understanding of networking fundamentals such as IP addressing DNS and VPN concepts to diagnose and resolve connectivity issues impacting user productivity
Exhibit familiarity with security practices such as antivirus management encryption and secure authentication methods to safeguard company information on end user devices
Bring experience working in rotational shifts and hybrid work models while maintaining high standards of responsiveness accountability and professional communication
Display effective communication and customer service skills to translate technical concepts into accessible language and build trust with diverse users across the organization
Pursue ongoing learning in modern desktop technologies automation and cloud integrated management solutions to align support capabilities with evolving enterprise strategies
Certifications Required
Preferred certifications include CompTIA A plus or Microsoft Modern Desktop Administrator Associate or equivalent industry desktop support certification

title: Sr. Associate Tax
description:
Career Category Finance Job Description If you feel like you're part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.
 
 Sr Associate Tax 
 
 What you will do 
 As the Sr Associate Tax, you will report to the Transfer Pricing Manager and collaborate closely with the rest of the team on Amgen’s transfer pricing, tax provision, and compliance work.
 The ideal candidate is a self-motivated team player who will assist in analyzing, implementing, and documenting Amgen’s transfer pricing planning, operations, reporting, and compliance processes.
 You will be part of Amgen’s tax planning and transfer pricing group, working within a world-class tax department that provides global tax planning, transfer pricing, tax reporting, and tax audit defense for the Company.
 
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. 
 
 In this role, you will: 
 Support transfer pricing and planning initiatives, including financial data gathering, analyzing and modeling, drawing preliminary conclusions, and maintaining appropriate internal documentation.
 Assist in maintaining and drafting intercompany agreements and managing the related SharePoint site.
 Prepare Amgen’s transfer pricing models and relevant supporting tax calculations for use in quarterly reviews, annual budgets, and year-end reporting.
 Support the preparation of transfer pricing documentation to meet US and international local transfer pricing requirements, including preparing segmented financial reports, reviewing financial data tables, and liaising with Amgen’s tax service providers.
 Assist with Irish corporation tax compliance and reporting, coordinating with tax service providers and in-house finance teams to complete necessary computations and filings.
 Assist with quarterly and annual tax provision calculations under US GAAP, FRS102, or other applicable local statutory requirements for Irish-based subsidiaries.
 Perform ad-hoc duties related to tax and transfer pricing as required.
 
 What we expect of you 
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek has these qualifications:
 Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
 2-5 years of experience in a Big Four firm or a corporate in-house tax department.
 Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
 Experience with financial data analysis and a solid understanding of economic, financial, and accounting concepts.
 Experience with SAP and Tableau is preferred.
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to organize files, project plans, and data.
 Ability to manage workstreams efficiently and maintain communication with the Transfer Pricing Manager and other stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met and objectives are achieved.
 A strong desire to develop and advance your career within the tax field.
 
 What you can expect of us 
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being. Therefore, Amgen is regularly recognized as a Best Place To Work ©.
 Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization.
 Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act.
 
 
 
 
.

AI is the most powerful technology IT departments have ever been asked to deploy. And ServiceNow is where powerful technology gets deployed, in the largest enterprises in the world. That’s where this position will sit, in the driver’s seat for the largest technology transformation Enterprises have ever seen.
Every enterprise is struggling to manage dozens of AI models, 100’s of app,1000’s of identities and services, and millions in token spend, to transform into AI-native organization.
They cannot do it with a dozen vendors each doing a piece. They need a platform. ServiceNow is that platform, and it is where our customers will deploy and manage AI from any vendor. We are looking for a leader to run our product marketing organization for this future. This is the moment where AI goes beyond parlor tricks and POCs and into the engine powering the of the world’s largest enterprises.
IT is where it starts and you will own that emergent category for AI-native and Autonomous IT across our market-leading portfolio, Autonomous Service Operations, IT Asset Management, and Portfolio and Enterprise Architecture, the vital backbone for the AI reinvention of companies worldwide.
Reporting to SVP, Product & Solutions Marketing, you will lead the category narrative, the AI-native innovation, and help our customers realize value from our Autonomous IT solutions. You will deliver cut through POVs and insights that fuel million-dollar campaigns. You will engage and activate a salesforce of 1000’s who will take our message to the market.
You're a product marketer at your core, sharp on positioning, messaging, launches and go-to-market strategy, but you operate at the altitude of a chief marketing officer. You think across business units, set the category agenda rather than react to it, and cut through a world that is way too noisy. You are credible in front of a CIO and a first-week intern in the same afternoon, and you move both to act. You inspire each.
You have AI curiosity and insight. You have already built new ways of working with AI in your own workflow and in your team's and you can show the work, not just talk about it.
You thrive on customer interaction, meeting with industry analysts, and the press. You galvanize talent around a common mission and build trusted bonds across the organization. You deeply understand technology and how it creates value for our customers. And you have a competitive streak you know your competition cold and you play to pull away from the pack, not to keep pace with it. You know how to build pipeline at scale in partnership with a broad and powerful marketing organization.
What you get to do in this role
Set the portfolio-level narrative and category strategy for Autonomous IT solutions
You drive the AI-native category play at an executive level: positioning, thought leadership, and external representation with customers, analysts, our customer advisory boards and the industry at large
Work with a tremendously deep bench of talent across marketing, sales and product on the most exciting innovations
Define integrated campaigns, GTM strategy alignment and activation at global scale
Partner with global marketing, product management, sales, solution consulting, and the partner ecosystem at an executive level
Build a portfolio-wide library of customer proof points spanning industries and use cases how customers realize value with Autonomous IT
Build, lead, and grow an organization of product and solutions marketing leaders who can execute at this altitude, including hiring and developing the next layer of category and narrative talent.
Qualifications
15+ years in product marketing, product management, or marketing leadership, including senior experience owning positioning and go-to-market strategy across multiple products or a portfolio, with demonstrated executive presence, not just a single product line.
Direct experience in IT operations, IT service management, IT operations management, security, or adjacent enterprise software, with the technical fluency to speak credibly with IT executive buyers and their teams.
A track record of building category or platform narratives at an executive level you can point to work where several product stories became one bigger story the market and analysts bought into.
Proven ability to lead and grow global product marketing teams
Fluency in AI-native product marketing.
Comfortable moving between board- and analyst-level narrative work and hands-on execution decks, talk tracks, and campaign briefs included.
Bachelor's degree required, MBA preferred.
Up to 25% travel to support customer, analyst, and industry events.

Who we are looking for 
 
 At State Street, our purpose is to help create better outcomes for the world's investors and the people they serve. We partner with many of the world's leading asset managers, owners, and financial institutions, providing investment servicing, data and analytics, investment research, and trading services.
 Join our exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) servicing team. ETFs are one of the fastest growing segments of the global investment industry, offering exposure to a diverse range of asset classes, investment strategies and markets. You will work in a collaborative, control-focused environment where accuracy, timeliness and continuous improvement are central to the service we provide.
 
 Why this role is important to us 
 
 Reporting to the team manager, you will be part of the ETF Servicing Team responsible for the creation, review, and release of order confirmation files to Authorised Participants for all primary market order activity across all Exchange Traded Funds administered by SSIIL as well as the settlement of all primary market orders through both local and international Centralised Securities Depositories in Europe and managing deliverables both internal and external.
 
 What you will be responsible for 
 
 As an Officer you will be responsible for the production of and coordination of
 Confirm production for primary market orders received on ETFs

 Instructing, review, and monitoring of settlement for all ETF orders

 Timely and accurate preparation of reporting  

 Investigation and resolution of internal queries

 Manage client queries to ensure the highest level of service  

 Build strong working relationships with clients and internal departments

 Identify any risks with processing and ensure that these are addressed

 Review of overall job process with a view to further efficiencies

 Manage own continued professional development, by engaging in the PPR process and attending relevant training per development pathways

 Engagement on project work within the team

 
 
 What we value 
 
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
 Ability to work in a virtual global team environment with emphasis on collaboration with both

 clients and other internal service teams

 Problem Solving & Decision Making - Develop solutions and provide counsel to ensure

 effective decisions are reached by employing timely, rigorous and logical analysis

 Strong interpersonal skills and ethical decision making

 Self-Motivated and reliant

 Enthusiastic

 Uses Initiative

 
 Education & Preferred Qualifications 
 Primary Degree or a Professional or Accounting qualification or equivalent

 Financial or business background

 Knowledge of ETF funds

 
 Work Requirement 
 In office presence, 4 days a week

 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
 
 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

Performing other duties as assigned from time to time.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.  
  
 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.  
  
 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com   
  
 YOUR FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES: 
  
  
 Taking an active part in the initial setup of any new funds take-on and liaising with independent tax specialists, lawyers, and notaries as part of the set up process; 
 Taking care of the day-to-day operations of the funds and following up with third parties, including investors and fund managers; 
 Handling the fund accounts and preparation of periodic reports and regulatory reports for the fund entities; 
 Preparing the funds’ periodic Net Asset Value calculation and year-end financial statements, management of the audit, and reviewing other fund related reports; 
 Reviewing tax returns and tax balances and maintaining relevant contacts with the tax authorities; 
 
 Accurately record all time spent dealing with client matters to ensure the clients are correctly invoiced; 
 Pro-actively take on additional responsibilities and administrational tasks as required by your managers or clients. 
  
  
 YOUR PROFILE: 
  
  
 You are degree level educated in a relevant area such Finance, Accounting or Economics; 
 You may have some existing relevant experience in the fields of fund administration, audit or fiduciary services; 
 You have knowledge of fund industry, valuation, and accounting; 
 A basic knowledge in accounting for investment products and experience of closed ended funds in the private assset space will be considered as an asset; 
 You are fluent in English; 
 You possess team spirit, a capacity to build strong client relationships and take initiative to act without waiting for direction (when appropriate).

 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.  
  
 Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

For us, this means taking action to ensure every colleague has equal opportunity, valuing every voice and experience across our organisation, maintaining an inclusive culture where you can bring your whole self to work, and making Alter Domus a workplace where everyone feels they belong.  
  
 We celebrate our differences, and understand that our success relies on diverse perspectives and experiences, working towards shared goals and a common purpose. We take pride in creating a workplace where all our people are empowered to be truly invested in the alternative and bring their whole selves to work. 
  
 We are committed to ensuring a welcoming recruiting and onboarding process for everyone. Please contact our hiring team if you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you.

title: Commercial Operations Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
   
 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

 Abbott Rapid Diagnostics is part of Abbott’s Diagnostics family of businesses, bringing together exceptional teams of experts and industry-leading technologies to support diagnostic testing which provides important information for the treatment and management of diseases and other conditions. 

 Purpose of the job 

 The Commercial Operations Specialist will primarily be responsible for support emerging markets. The role will be responsible for coordinating and executing critical commercial support processes that enable efficient sales execution and business operations. The role serves as a key link between Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Legal, and Commercial Excellence teams, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational effectiveness across order management, pricing, contracts, demand planning, stock allocation, opportunity management, and sales support activities The position reports directly to the Commercial Excellence Manager but will work closely with the Commercial Directors and Business Operation teams in International Markets. 

 Responsibilities : 

 Order Management 
 Coordinate end-to-end order management processes to ensure timely and accurate order processing. 
 Monitor order status, resolve order-related issues, and liaise with Customer Service, Commercial and Supply Chain teams. 
 Partner with Supply Chain and Demand Planning teams to manage stock allocation decisions. Communicate allocation decisions and inventory updates to relevant stakeholders.
 Support backlog management and ensure customer commitments are met.
 Identify and implement process improvements to enhance order fulfillment efficiency. 
 Pricing Management 
 Maintain customer pricing files and pricing master data within designated systems.
 Support price implementation, updates, and governance processes. 
 Ensure pricing accuracy and compliance with approved pricing policies. 
 Coordinate pricing approvals and maintain documentation of pricing exceptions. 
 Contract Management 
 Support the creation, review, execution, and renewal of customer contracts and commercial agreements. 
 Maintain contract repositories and ensure documentation is complete and current. 
 Track contract milestones, expirations, and renewal timelines within designated systems. 
 Collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Sales teams to ensure compliance with contractual obligations. 
 Ethics & Compliance 
 Ensure adherence to company policies, industry regulations, and ethical business practices. 
 Support compliance reviews related to customer engagements, contracts, pricing, and commercial activities. 
 Maintain required documentation and audit trails. 
 Assist in preparing documentation for internal and external audits.
 Opportunity Management 
 Maintain accurate opportunity data within CRM systems. 
 Support sales teams in managing sales pipelines and commercial opportunities. 
 Ensure timely updates of opportunity status, customer information, and revenue forecasts. 
 Generate pipeline and opportunity reports to support business decision-making. 
 Sales Support 
 Provide operational support to the sales organization, enabling effective customer engagement and execution.
 Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and business reviews. 
 Support sales incentive administration and tracking where applicable. 
 Coordinate internal approvals and documentation required for commercial activities. 
 Manage customer onboarding processes and related administrative requirements.
 
 Required/preferred educational background 
 3+ years of experience in Commercial Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial Excellence, or related business functions.
 Experience working with CRM and ERP systems.
 Experience supporting cross-functional commercial processes is preferred. 
 Personal Characteristics • 
 Excellent interpersonal skills with an ability to achieve results through influencing others and maintaining strong links with other departments, particularly Commercial Teams. 
 Positive attitude, team player with a high level of initiative, energy and enthusiasm. 
 Strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail and good business judgement. 
 A problem solver with great personal iniative and self-motivated 
 Strong desire to review activities in order to do things better. 
 Self-starter, possesses flexibility and ability to work under pressure in a fast-changing environment and ambiguous situations. 
 A proven record of delivering exceptional customer service. 
 Effective communicator, both articulate & verbally presentable with the ability to drive collaboration and performance of cross functional teams. 
 
 Minimum Requirements 
 Ideally experienced working with distributors in an international environment 
 CRM management (Salesforce, Dynamics, or equivalent)
 ERP systems experience (SAP preferred) 
 Strong Microsoft Excel 
 Experience working within a complex virtual team environmnent and leading project activities 
 Ability to travel and provide on-site support and training as needed
 
 Connect with us at www.abbott.com and on LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram , X and YouTube .
      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

 WORK SHIFT: Ie - 37.5Hst0 (Ireland)

title: Technical Specialist | Johnson & Johnson MedTech | EP | Ireland
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
MedTech Sales 
 
 Job Sub Function: 
Clinical Sales – Surgeons (Commission) 
 
 Job Category: 
Professional 
 
 All Job Posting Locations: 
Dublin, Ireland 
 
 Job Description: 
 Biosense Webster – Technical Specialist Ireland 
 Biosense Webster, Inc (BWI), a member of Johnson & Johnson's Family of Companies, is recruiting for a Technical Specialist role based in Ireland within the UK/IRL Team. 
 Biosense Webster, Inc., is recognized worldwide as an industry leader in endocardial diagnostics and therapy. Guided by the needs of Electrophysiologists, the company has pioneered innovative technological advancements ranging from the first deflectable tip catheter to today's most sophisticated three-dimensional cardiac mapping and navigation systems. Biosense Webster (BSW) is a key growth driver for the Global Surgery Group, operating in a fast growing and rapidly developing Electrophysiology marketplace.  As a business we have a close relationship and understanding with our customers and as a result, have a strong product portfolio today and a strong pipeline for the future. 

 Summary 
 We are seeking to recruit a highly talented, motivated and ambitious individual to take the role of Technical Specialist. This role is a full time role. The Technical Specialist (TS) will be responsible for executing specific customer development and training plans by providing full clinical support to all the Biosense Webster accounts within their territory. The TS will also work closely with the Sales Specialist to drive business plan for the territory in BSW UKIRL, in conjunction with the Regional Business Manager (RBM). Reporting to the Regional Business Manager, the TS will be expected to collaborate with other members of the Ireland and Northern UK Region team (Regional Business Manager, Technical Specialists, Clinical Training Leader and other Sales Specialists) in order to optimize customer experience and maximize sales and take share opportunities. 
 The key objective of this role will be to deliver the sales target within the identified geographic area, meeting all strategic and business objectives, delivering product and customer training plan and providing the highest level of clinical and customer support. 

 What to expect: 
 Meet and exceed sales targets for their geographic area 
 Increase catheter utilisation in Electrophysiology to gain market share and to achieve sales targets aligned with the Business Plan. 
 Provide Clinical Support for coverage for cases performed with the CARTO 3 Navigation System 
 Deliver customer training plan and effectively transfer knowledge to empower customers to use BSW kit effectively and independently. 
 Comply with mandatory training and attend local and abroad training programmes to maintain and develop knowledge required to fulfil job role effectively. 
 Collaborate with Regional Business Manager, Clinical Training Lead, Technical Specialists (TSs), and Sales Specialists (SS) to develop innovative activities to achieve sales targets and to allow the franchise to gain market share and differentiate from competition. 
 Execute on key marketing strategies to include the successful roll out of new products 
 Maintain and develop firm business relationships with KOLs and other strategically important clinical and economic stakeholders 
 Develop in depth understanding of the needs and objectives of customers on all levels- both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders, in order to develop tailored solutions which maximize sales and sales potential for Biosense Webster. 
 Maintain knowledge of competitor's products and strategies in the local market 
 Adopt Credo based principles in all interactions with internal and external customers. 
 
 Who are we looking for? 
 Cardiac Physiology experience of 3+ years, to include EP training and responsibility preferred 
 Fluent in English both verbal and written communication 
 Excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to build strong relationships quickly. 
 Have the capacity to gain in-depth product and procedure knowledge and the ability to communicate effectively with all key stakeholders within the EP lab setting. 
 Must be self-disciplined, organised, and be able to take ownership and responsibility for business objectives. 
 Must be highly motivated and have a strong desire to succeed in a demanding role. 
 A team player and independent thinker 
 Ability to positively influence thinking, behaviour and gain commitment 
 Trained to apply advanced Microsoft package skills: Word, Excel, Powerpoint, and Outlook 
 Full & clean driving license 
 
 What type of mark will YOU make?  
 By joining Johnson & Johnson you will find boundless opportunities to craft your path & amplify your impact inside & outside our walls. And with our commitment to be the world’s healthiest workforce you can strengthen your body as well as your mind.  When you work at Johnson & Johnson you can touch over a Billion lives worldwide every day.  And when you apply your talent to our collective purpose there’s no end to the lasting impact we can make together. And that changes everything.

 What’s in it for YOU?   
 It’s important to us that you feel you can bring your whole self to work; at Johnson & Johnson we provide an environment for you to fulfil your career aspirations as well as promoting your physical and mental wellbeing. As part of our offering, you will receive a competitive compensation and benefits package as well as benefits that can be tailored to what is valuable to you throughout different stages of your life. Examples of this include; online Digital GP, private healthcare, Retail Vouchers, Discounted & Subsidised Gym memberships and you can get to support community projects as part of our global Corporate Social Responsibility programme.
 Johnson & Johnson is a supporter of equal opportunities and is a proud member of Disability Confident . 
   
 We respectively request Government Officials to identify themselves as such on application; for the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act. If you decide to apply for the position, any personal data which you provide shall be processed by Johnson & Johnson. Your personal data shall be processed for the purposes of recruitment, recruitment policy and select. 

 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
Business Development, Communication, Customer Centricity, Customer Retentions, Execution Focus, Healthcare Trends, Market Knowledge, Market Research, Presentation Design, Problem Solving, Sales, Solutions Selling, Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Sales Planning, Sustainable Procurement, Team Management, Vendor Selection   
  
 The anticipated base pay range for this position is: 
€55,500.00 - €88,205.00  
  
 Benefits: 
 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers. 
  
 *This is for informative purposes only. Amounts and actual benefits may vary by location and are subject to change.

title: Motor Underwriter
description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you. 
 
 Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.
 
 The motor underwriter will report to the Motor Underwriting Manager.  The appointed person will take responsibility for selected countries; assist the Motor Underwriting Manager in the underwriting of motor fleet business from Group companies and will have significant focus on developing the company’s approach to pricing.  They will be responsible for the pricing, implementation and maintenance of our motor insurance programmes in a number of countries. Working with Actuarial, Legal and Business Development teams to develop insurance products for the clients of Ayvens. 
 Responsibilities will include but are not limited to: Managing various existing motor insurance programmes across multiple jurisdictions
 Main point of contact for dealing with day-to-day queries from Ayvens affiliates (business partners) and Fronter partners.
 In conjunction with the Underwriting Management, work on ensuring that pricing is appropriate and meets local entity requirements.
 Involvement in day-to-day discount and special acceptance requests.  Review and validate analysis prepared by the Data Analyst based on customer and country performance.  Check if discounts are within the Underwriter authority limits and make recommendations for approval.
 Define, develop and update policy wordings for new and existing programmes
 Co-ordinate the implementation of and the annual review of the Risk Selection & Pricing Procedures issued by Ayvens Insurance to Ayvens entities acting as policyholders and/or intermediaries of Ayvens Insurance
 Identifying and implementing corrective measures required to enhance the profitability of a motor portfolio
 Monitoring and administrating the Underwriting Key Performance and Key Risk Indicators
 Co-ordinate and administer reinsurance referrals and requests, in conjunction with in-house reinsurance team and external parties
 Participate in the review of programme structure, terms and conditions
 Participate in Business Control Reviews to ensure compliance with underwriting and regulatory guidelines
 Interact with our in-house Actuarial, Legal and Business Development teams and the insurance managers at the various Ayvens entities
 Involved in Ayvens affiliate (business partners) and Fronting partners meetings / calls.
 Any other tasks or projects as requested by Underwriting Management
 
 Character Profile 
 Requirements 
 A minimum 3 years’ experience in motor underwriting
 CIP Qualified and / or an Insurance Graduate
 Strong analytical skills and decision-making ability
 Knowledge of underwriting rating methods, procedures and reviews
 Excellent MS Office skills, in particular excel
 Attention to detail and accuracy essential
 A highly organized individual with the ability to prioritise and meet deadlines and act on own initiative
 Good communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal
 Team player who will play an important role as part of a specialized team
 Innovative and creative with willingness to bring new ideas to improve processes
 
 Desirable 
 5 years’ experience in motor underwriting
 Understanding of cross border insurance programmes (“Freedom of Services”, Solvency II, Insurance Distribution Directive, etc.)
 Experience in the design and construction of policy wordings for a range of motor insurance and ancillary covers
 MDI qualified or progression towards this
 Clear understanding or experience in the motor leasing industry
 
 This role is subject to the Central Bank of Ireland Fitness and Probity Standards (“Standards”) . The Standards provide that persons who are subject to the Standards must be competent and capable, act honestly, ethically and with integrity, and be financially sound. This role is subject to the Company satisfying itself (as required under the Standards) on reasonable grounds that a candidate complies with the Standards. 

 Why Ayvens?   

 With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.

 At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.

 Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

title: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Opportunities -  Limerick - Hybrid working
description:
About Northern Trust: 
 
 Northern Trust, a Fortune 500 company, is a globally recognized, award-winning financial institution that has been in continuous operation since 1889.
 
 Northern Trust is proud to provide innovative financial services and guidance to the world’s most successful individuals, families, and institutions by remaining true to our enduring principles of service, expertise, and integrity. With more than 130 years of financial experience and over 22,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
 
 
 Due to the build out of our AML centre of excellence in Limerick, we are seeking experienced AML professionals and leaders to join the teams in Limerick. 
 The teams 
 
 The Ireland Investor AML Onboarding team are responsible for completing AML verification on investors prior to opening an account in a fund under Northern Trust’s administration. All investors are risk assessed and initial due diligence documentation gathered to facilitate onboarding. The team also is also responsible for monitoring trigger events, whereby a refresh of documentation may be required due to a change in circumstance of an investor. 
 
 The Ireland Investor AML Ongoing Monitoring team are responsible for the continuous monitoring of investors throughout their Investment journey. This is done primarily through overnight screening of all investors and related parties, transaction monitoring of the investment activity as well as carrying out periodic reviews to ensure all due diligence documentation remains accurate and up to date.
 
 
 The roles 
 
 Our teams have opportunity to work on large scale ongoing monitoring projects, at an EMEA wide level and across multiple jurisdictions. AML partners will be involved in strategic roll out of such projects, and accountable for execution to the highest of AML standards. Success in our team requires partners to hold, build and maintain strong relationships with the Northern Trust Transfer Agency and Client Services Departments across EMEA, as well as other key stakeholders, to deliver a robust AML Ongoing Monitoring and AML Onboarding service to Northern Trust’s client and investor base.
 
 
 The skills 
 
 Successful candidates will demonstrate some of the following: 
 
 We are looking for people who are organised in their approach and can work to meet deadlines

 Collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders is key – so good verbal or written communication skills will be valuable

 Strong organisational and communication skills with experience in managing large projects.

 Skills gained in risk management, compliance, process improvement, or research are all transferable to this team so if you have experience in these areas, we encourage you to consider building a career in AML.

 Candidates with knowledge of the wider fund administration or investor services space will also be eligible to apply.

 Training is provided so that you can work on your own initiative

 For more senior roles, extensive knowledge of day-to-day AML and Transfer Agency operations and the wider funds administration business is required

 Experience in the AML industry with exposure to ongoing monitoring practices is ideal, especially if you hold knowledge of the EMEA AML regulatory landscape

 Successful candidates will demonstrate an ability to research issues and deliver solutions. A track record of driving operational improvement will be valuable.

 

 
 Working with Us: 
 As a Northern Trust partner, greater achievements await. You will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture in an organization where financial strength and stability is an asset that emboldens us to explore new ideas.
 
 Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to assisting the communities we serve! Join a workplace with a greater purpose.
 
 We’d love to learn more about how your interests and experience could be a fit with one of the world’s most admired and sustainable companies! Build your career with us and apply today. #MadeForGreater
 
 Reasonable accommodation 
 
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com .
 
 We hope you’re excited about the role and the opportunity to work with us. We value an inclusive workplace and understand flexibility means different things to different people.
 
 Apply today and talk to us about your flexible working requirements and together we can achieve greater.

 Sourcing at Primark  
 What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.  
 What You’ll Ge t  
 People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best
 Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.  

 What You’ll Do as Sourcing Specialist    
 In this role you will be responsible for supporting the delivery of sourcing strategies, supplier management activities and Sourcing best practices across the business. The role focuses on identifying value opportunities, managing supplier relationships, mitigating supply risks, and ensuring suppliers deliver against agreed commercial, operational, and service commitments.
 Duties & Responsibilities 
 Support the development and execution of category and sourcing strategies
 Support with the Supplier Communication process
 Own the Onboarding process for new factories to support Primark capacity growth
 Support supplier improvement plans where performance falls below expectations
 Maintain sourcing and supplier management documentation
 Assist in supplier due diligence and onboarding activities
 Maintain supplier records, contract databases, and sourcing documentation
 Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders
 Provide sourcing guidance and support to stakeholders
 Produce sourcing and supplier management reports
 Collaborate with regional sourcing teams to ensure adherent to sourcing process
 Working collaboratively with the Ethical, Finance and QA/Technical Teams to understand and mitigate any potential new supplier from ethical, financial and quality issues as part of their on-boarding process.
 Supporting the broader Sourcing team in preparing for key governance meetings, supplier conferences and supporting the delivery of the outputs from these meetings.
 

 What You’ll Bring    
 Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular: 
 The successful candidate needs to have a strong commercial and operational background, with a working knowledge of retail sourcing and buying practices.
 The successful candidate needs to have strong relationship and communication skills to liaise with Senior Stakeholders, Buying and Suppliers.
 The successful candidate must be resilient and motivated
 Supplier Relationship management
 Strong influencing skills
 Collaboration & Teamwork
 Creative & Strategic thinking
 Drive for continuous improvement
 

 Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.  
 About Primark  
 At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 19 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

Job title:           Responsible Sourcing Specialist (12 month FTC)
Function:        Sustainability
Reports to:     Head of ESG Programme Management
Location:         Dublin
_____________________________________________________________________
Ornua is a leading dairy co-operative which sells premium dairy products globally on behalf of its Member Co-operatives, Ireland’s dairy processors and, in turn, Irish dairy farmers.
Ornua has revenues of €3.4 billion and is supported by a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. The Group operates as a commercial organisation across 10 business units, including 12 production facilities located in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
The commercial organisation is responsible for the marketing and sales of Ornua’s consumer brands including Ireland’s most successful food export: Kerrygold. Consumer markets are served by production facilities in Ireland, Germany and the UK and by in-market Sales & Marketing Teams in Asia, Germany, Ireland, MEA, Poland, Spain, rest of Europe and North and Latin America.
It also manages the procurement of Irish and non-Irish dairy products, the sale of dairy ingredients to food manufacturing and foodservice customers globally, and the implementation of de-risking and trading strategies to manage market volatility. These activities are supported by production facilities and in-market teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
WHY THIS ROLE IS VALUABLE:
The Responsible Sourcing Specialist will own and continuously improve Ornua’s responsible sourcing programme across purchased goods and services. Working closely with Procurement, suppliers and relevant business functions, the role will apply a risk-based due diligence approach, embed requirements into procurement processes, strengthen supplier capability and support regulatory, customer and reporting obligations.
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:
Own and continuously improve Ornua's Responsible Sourcing Framework, policies, standards and supplier requirements.
Lead risk-based supply chain mapping, supplier segmentation, due diligence, assessments and assurance across priority commodities, materials and services.
Embed responsible sourcing requirements into supplier onboarding, tendering, contracting and supplier performance management processes.
Drive continuous improvement in the responsible sourcing, traceability and assurance performance of Ornua's priority commodities.
Support Procurement-led supplier engagement, capability building and remediation activities across environmental, human rights and ethical sourcing risks.
Manage responsible sourcing data, reporting, platforms and certification schemes, providing audit-ready information and performance insights.
Provide subject matter expertise on agricultural and farm sustainability, including farm research projects, customer farm visits, sustainability claims and stakeholder engagement.
KEY REQUIREMENTS:
Minimum 3 years’ experience in responsible sourcing, sustainable procurement, supplier ESG due diligence, ethical trade or a related sustainability role.
Good knowledge of food, agricultural or manufacturing supply chains, including environmental, human rights and ethical sourcing risks.
Experience conducting supplier assessments, due diligence, audits, corrective actions and risk remediation programmes.
Experience embedding sustainability or responsible sourcing requirements into procurement, contracting or supplier management processes.
Strong analytical and systems capability, including experience managing data, reporting, dashboards and supplier-related platforms.
Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and programme management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and suppliers.
Understanding of agricultural sustainability, farm-level environmental issues and sustainable sourcing practices would be advantageous.
Relevant graduate or postgraduate qualification desirable.
Knowledge of agricultural supply chains and the dairy industry is desirable.
Familiarity with Sedex/SMETA, RSPO, SAI Platform or comparable schemes is desirable.
Experience with Power BI, supply-chain traceability or international supplier capability-building is desirable.
Experience with project management and familiarity with CPD is desirable.
Closing date: 20 October 2026

Sustainable Agriculture, Agricultural, Agriculture

title: ITSM Service Excellence Leader
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Northern Trust is seeking a senior ITSM leader and ITIL expert to lead the automation, optimization, and maturation of IT Service Management function. This role is accountable for transforming how IT services are governed, executed, and continuously improved—shifting from manual, compliance-heavy processes to automated, data-driven, and resilient ITSM operations within a high-volume and time-critical environment .
 This is a highly visible leadership role balancing “run-the-bank” stability with “change-the-bank” transformation , operating within a dynamic, high-velocity operating model that requires strong ITIL judgment, deep automation expertise, and the ability to influence in a matrixed environment across global technology teams.

 What You’ll Do 
 ITSM Process Leadership & Optimization 
 Interface with senior executives across the organization to drive strategic outcomes and day-to-day service delivery priorities , delivering operational excellence while enabling risk reduction in a deadline-sensitive delivery model .
 Serve as the enterprise authority on ITIL-based processes , ensuring they are scalable, risk-aligned, and fit-for-purpose within a complex, high-throughput operational environment .
 Lead continuous optimization of ITSM processes, reducing friction, manual effort, and cycle time while improving quality, compliance, and delivery at pace and scale .
 Define and enforce clear process guardrails, decision frameworks, and risk-based controls , balancing speed with strong governance and control adherence .
 Manage priorities across a multi-threaded, high-demand environment , ensuring effective execution amid competing priorities and tight timelines.
 
 Automation & Intelligent Enablement 
 Drive an automation-first strategy for ITSM practices, leveraging AI, orchestration, and workflow automation to: Reduce human dependency and error
 Increase standardization and predictability
 Enable safe, fast, and repeatable execution in a continuous delivery and improvement environment 
 
 Partner with engineering, platform, and tooling teams to embed automation directly into ITSM workflows and deployment pipelines, supporting accelerated delivery cycles with appropriate governance controls .
 Identify and retire low-value manual controls, replacing them with preventative and detective automated controls aligned to high-volume change and release ecosystems .
 
 Metrics, Insights & Value Realization 
 Define and operationalize KPIs, KRIs, and experience metrics that measure effectiveness, risk reduction, and business value in a delivery-focused organization .
 Sponsor dashboard creation and automated reporting to provide real-time visibility into performance, compliance, and operational trends .
 Use data-driven insights to continuously refine process design while supporting rapidly evolving priorities and delivery demands .
 
 Collaboration & Influence 
 Act as a trusted advisor to technology, risk, audit, and business stakeholders within a dynamic and evolving workload environment .
 Facilitate global forums, workshops, and working groups to drive alignment, adoption, and continuous improvement .
 Mentor and develop ITSM practitioners, elevating process maturity, automation capability, and execution discipline across the organization.
 
 Who You Are: 
 You are a leader with a passion for ITSM modernization and ITIL practitioner with a drive for process excellence, intelligent automation, and scalable governance . You bring strong judgment, a systems-thinking mindset, and the ability to translate ITIL principles into modern, execution-oriented operating models .

 You thrive in high-performance, deadline-driven environments and are comfortable:
 Navigating rapidly shifting priorities and competing demands 
 Maintaining quality and control in time-sensitive, high-volume operations 
 Demonstrating agility in complex, evolving environments 
 Delivering measurable outcomes at pace and scale 
 
 Qualifications 
 10+ years of IT Service Management experience, ideally within Banking or Financial Services.
 Deep, hands-on expertise in ITIL/ITSM , including governance, risk-based decisioning, and continuous improvement.
 Proven experience leading automation and optimization initiatives within fast-moving ITSM and release cadences .
 Strong understanding of ITIL, COBIT, ISO/IEC 20000 , and regulated operating environments.
 Demonstrated ability to lead globally and influence outcomes without direct authority.
 Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
 
 Preferred Certifications 
 ITIL Certification (Intermediate or higher strongly preferred)
 Automation, AI/ML, or RPA-related certifications
 
 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Production Operator
description:
Production Operator – Evening Shift About Your New Employer Join a small, growing medical device company based in Galway.
 Work in a hands-on production environment where quality, safety and teamwork are key priorities.
 Gain valuable experience in the regulated medical device manufacturing sector.
 This is an evening shift position offering 20% shift allowance on top of salary. The working hours are Mon - Thurs: 4:00pm - 2:30am. 
 Initial 12 month contract. 
 About Your New Job As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for assembling medical device products safely, accurately and in line with company procedures. You will work as part of the production team to meet quality, delivery and product release targets.
 Assembling products in line with production requirements and approved procedures.
 Completing each step of the production process to the required quality standards.
 Inspecting and testing components and finished products where required.
 Identifying and reporting process issues, abnormalities or defects to the appropriate team lead.
 Completing all required production, quality, inventory and safety documentation.
 Following SOPs, cGMP requirements and all company health and safety procedures.
 Working with the Operations Line Lead to meet production schedules and product release targets.
 Supporting the coordination of materials and resources to maintain production.
 Monitoring work-in-progress and stock levels.
 Assisting with process and equipment validation activities when required.
 Working closely with colleagues across Production, Quality and Engineering.
 Supporting team members and completing additional production tasks as required.
 What Skills You Need Leaving Certificate or equivalent qualification.
 Previous experience in a production, manufacturing or regulated environment is preferred. Medical device experience would be an advantage.
 Ability to read, understand and follow written procedures and work instructions.
 Good attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality.
 Basic computer literacy and numeracy skills, including experience with applications such as Word and Excel.
 Good written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
 A proactive, reliable and self-motivated approach.
 Ability to organise tasks and work to production deadlines.
 Availability to work Monday to Thursday, from 4:00pm to 2:30am.
 What's on Offer A four-day working week, with evening shifts from Monday to Thursday.
 A 20% shift allowance plus 25 days holidays, bonus, health insurance and more.
 The opportunity to build experience in the medical device manufacturing industry.
 A supportive team environment with opportunities to develop your production and technical skills.
 What's Next Apply now to be considered for this Production Operator opportunity with a Galway-based medical device company. If this role is not quite right but you are interested in similar production, manufacturing or medical device positions, please get in touch.

title: Structural Engineer
description:
Location: Dublin, Cork or Galway (Hybrid Working Available) 
 Experience: 3-8 Years 
 Sector: Structural Engineering / Residential Development
 
 Your new company 
 Our client is a leading multidisciplinary engineering consultancy with a reputation for delivering sustainable engineering solutions across Ireland and internationally. With over three decades of experience, they work on a diverse portfolio of projects spanning residential, commercial, education, transport, infrastructure, civic and industrial developments. Their team is involved in shaping some of Ireland's most significant construction projects and developments. Due to a strong and growing pipeline of residential projects, they are seeking a talented Structural Design Engineer to join their expanding team in Dublin, Cork or Galway.
 

 Your new role 
 As a Structural Design Engineer, you will work as part of an experienced multidisciplinary team delivering structural design solutions across a range of residential developments and mixed use projects. You will be involved in the full project lifecycle, from concept design through to construction, working closely with architects, contractors, developers and fellow engineering professionals. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer looking to further develop their technical expertise while receiving mentorship and support towards Chartered Engineer status.

 Key Responsibilities
 Structural analysis and design of residential and commercial developments.
 Preparation of structural calculations, reports and design documentation.
 Production and review of engineering drawings and technical details.
 Design of concrete, steel, masonry and timber structures.
 Coordination with architects, contractors and project stakeholders.
 Carrying out site inspections and providing technical support during construction.
 Ensuring designs comply with Eurocodes, Building Regulations and industry standards.
 Contributing to project delivery within agreed budgets and timeframes.
 
 What you'll need to succeed 
 Degree in Structural Engineering.
 3-8 years' experience within a consulting engineering environment.
 Strong structural design experience across building projects.
 Experience working on residential developments.
 Good understanding of Eurocodes and Irish Building Regulations.
 Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team.
 Experience using software such as Tekla Tedds, Masterseries, Revit
 

 What you'll get in return 
 Competitive salary and benefits package.
 Hybrid working arrangement following successful completion of probation.
 Structured support towards Chartership.
 Dedicated mentorship and career development programmes.
 Ongoing CPD and technical training opportunities.
 Flexible start and finish times.
 Pension scheme.
 Death in Service benefit.
 Exposure to major residential and multidisciplinary engineering projects.
 Clear opportunities for career progression within a growing organisation.
 Collaborative and supportive team environment.
 

 What you need to do now 
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
