title: Account SE
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 Job Details 

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
 
 Overview of the role 
As an Account Solution Engineer (also known as a "Presales Consultant" or "Sales Engineer"), you are the visionary who transforms customer experiences. You aren’t just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner to Sales, owning the solutioning throughout the entire sales cycle. You will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, translating complex business objectives into enticing, practical recommendations that drive real change. 
Business Acumen & Strategic Impact Business Transformation Advocate: You are passionate about how technology solves real-world business puzzles. You enjoy digging into a company’s value chain to find where Salesforce can drive the most impact.

 The "Bottom Line" Mentality: You understand that technology is only as good as the business outcome it creates. You are excited by the challenge of connecting high-level business strategy to technical execution.

 
 Strategic Sales Partner: You thrive on the "win." You act as a co-pilot to the sales team, bringing a strategic lens to every deal to ensure we aren't just selling software, but building a long-term partnership.
 
The Ideal Profile: Passion & Mindset Demonstrated Passion for Technology & AI
 The "First to Know": You are a true technophile. You don't just wait for training; you are already experimenting with the latest in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows.

 AI Visionary: You have a clear passion for how AI is transforming the workforce. You are eager to show customers how Agentforce and autonomous agents can augment human productivity.

 Continuous Learner: You have a "Growth Mindset." Whether it’s passing a new Salesforce Certification or exploring a new API, you are driven by a natural curiosity to understand the how and why behind the tech.
 

 Responsibilities Strategic Sales Partnership: Act as the technical "North Star" for the sales team, aligning technical strategy with business outcomes to close complex deals. 
 Solution Innovation: Develop and deliver innovative custom solutions and demos (including Agentforce and Data Cloud) that address unique business challenges and prove tangible value.

 Lead the Cycle: Coordinate and lead the entire solution cycle through close collaboration with other high-performing teams (Product, Marketing, Professional Services).

 Value Communication: Articulate the benefits of Salesforce to audiences at every level—from IT Administrators to C-suite executives—using industry-specific insights.

 Continuous Growth: Maintain expert-level knowledge of Salesforce products and industry trends to remain effective in a performance-driven environment.
 

 Experience & Background 
 We are looking for a diverse range of backgrounds to join our high-performing South team. Whether you are a career SE or looking to pivot your technical and business acumen into a pre-sales career, we want to hear from you.
Core Experience (One or more of the following): Solution Excellence: A proven track record in Solution Engineering (Pre-sales), technical consulting, or professional services delivery within an enterprise software organization.

 Strategic Sales & Account Management: Experience in Account Management or Solution Selling, with a focus on navigating complex sales cycles and acting as a strategic partner to sales leadership.

 SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture.

 Consultative Mindset: A background in Business Consulting, with the ability to perform deep discovery, identify "pain points," and map them to high-value technology roadmaps.

 Technical Foundation: A strong Technical Background—this could be a degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience with APIs, data modeling, or software development.
 

 Required Skills & Qualifications The Foundations Professional Background: A track record in Solution Engineering, SaaS, Account Management, Management Consulting, or a deep Technical Background. We are open to a variety of backgrounds if you can demonstrate the core proficiencies of the role. 
 Strategic Partnering: Experience acting as a strategic partner to sales or business units, helping to steer the direction of a deal or project.

 Demonstrated Passion: A visible passion for Technology, Business, and AI. You are curious about the latest trends and eager to learn how they apply to customer success.

 Problem-Solving: Exceptional ability to find creative, pragmatic solutions to unique and complex business challenges.

 
 Key Professional Skills Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage and influence internal and external stakeholders, navigating different interests to reach a common goal. 
 Communication & Presence: Strong oral, written, and presentation skills. You are good at explaining complex ideas and finding ways to keep an audience’s attention.

 Prioritisation: Strong organizational and time-management skills to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 
 
 Experience & Adaptability Industry Insight: Ability to understand business requirements within multiple industries and translate them into a compelling vision and roadmap. 
 Agility: Comfortable working as part of a team to tackle problems in energizing environments and willing to travel occasionally.

 Language Requirements Fluency in English plus one or more additional languages is required from the following: Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Hebrew, Arabic, French or one of the main Eastern European languages (e.g., Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian). 
 
 Preferred Qualifications Salesforce Ecosystem: Existing Salesforce product knowledge and certifications (e.g., AI Associate, Administrator, or Cloud Consultant) are highly preferred. 
 SaaS Mastery: Experience or background in solution selling and the enterprise software landscape.

 Education: Degree or equivalent proven experience (including extracurricular leadership, military experience, or volunteer roles).

 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Job Title: Sr. Analyst, Sales Planning & Strategy

_____________________________________________________________________
Ornua (meaning “new gold”) is Ireland’s largest exporter of Irish dairy products, proudly bringing the unique taste of Irish dairy to the world since 1961.
Are you a Sr. Sales Planning & Strategy Analyst looking for the challenge of taking a mission-driven organization to its next level of success?
Ornua is actively seeking a Sr. Sales Planning & Strategy Analyst to join the Ornua Family as we continue our growth trajectory. This position will play a key role in driving transportation excellence, optimizing service performance, managing transportation costs, and ensuring the reliable delivery of products across our temperature-controlled supply chain.
WHY THIS ROLE IS VALUABLE
As our Sr. Analyst, Sales Planning & Strategy, you will serve as a strategic analytical partner to Sales leadership, helping shape customer strategies, portfolio decisions, and revenue growth initiatives. Your work will directly influence how Ornua identifies opportunities, mitigates risks, optimizes investments, and executes against commercial objectives.
This role goes beyond reporting and analysis. You will lead key analytical projects, generate actionable insights from complex data, and collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain to support strategic decision-making and long-term business growth.
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE ROLE
You are a highly analytical and commercially minded professional who excels at translating data into meaningful business recommendations. You enjoy solving complex problems, uncovering growth opportunities, and influencing decisions through compelling storytelling and insights.
You bring strong business acumen, advanced analytical capabilities, and the ability to work effectively across multiple functions.
EXPERIENCE AND REQUIREMENTS
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related field.
3-5+ years of experience in sales analysis, commercial analytics, category management, or a related field.
Deep experience working with syndicated data such as Nielsen and/or Circana (IRI).
Strong experience partnering directly with Sales teams and influencing business decisions.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong analytical, forecasting, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
Desired Qualifications
Costco IRI/Circana experience strongly preferred.
Experience with CRM systems and data visualization tools.
Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), food, dairy, or retail industry experience preferred.
Experience supporting category management, assortment optimization, promotional analytics, and forecasting initiatives.
Experience mentoring analysts or leading analytical projects across multiple stakeholders.
WHY ORNUA?
Ornua is a purpose-driven, values-led co-operative creating value for Irish dairy farming families through our global operations. With 10 business units, 16 production facilities, and in-market teams across the world, we operate through two divisions — Ornua Foods, which markets our iconic consumer brands including Kerrygold and Pilgrims Choice, and Ornua Ingredients, which provides innovative, customized dairy ingredient solutions to our customers.
Our Values lie at the core of everything we do. Our five values encourage us to Seek and Embrace New Ideas, Make It Happen, Be Our True Selves, Show You Care, and Achieve Great Things Together.
We invest in our people and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Career progression opportunities, including global mobility.
Comprehensive benefits with region-specific offerings.
Dynamic Working policy supporting flexible hours and hybrid work options.
PAY RANGE: $104,500 - $127,500
This range represents the overall market pay rate for candidates who meet the necessary qualifications and experience requirements for this role. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, education, and performance .
TOTAL REWARDS
Total Rewards at Ornua Foods North America will include a competitive salary and annual bonus scheme. The following are a list of other benefits you can avail of: low employee contribution for Medical, Vision and Dental benefits cover; 401k; Paid Time Off; Maternity Leave (20 weeks); Parental Leave; Flexible working; Fitness Reimbursement; Charity Donation; Complimentary Kerrygold products;

title: Utilities Technician
description:
Job Description : 
 Utilities   Technician   

 Littleconnell   Brewery,   Co.Kildare   

 Permanent Contract   

 Closing date   14/09/2026   

   

 Utilities   Technician   -   From   € 58,5 00   including   shift allowance   plus   competitive benefits package with pension, shares scheme and bonus.   

   

 Join our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team.   
 

 Our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team are problem-solvers, sourcing, producing, and delivering our much-loved brands to delight customers around the globe. Over half of Diageo’s 30,000+ people work   in Supply Chain and   Manufacturing .   It’s   an intricate and sophisticated operation   that’s   the product of logistical, manufacturing, and technical collaborations. We are proud to be a global leader in beverage alcohol with an exceptional portfolio of brands, including Guinness, Johnnie Walker, Baileys, Smirnoff, Tanqueray, and many more.   
 

 A forward-thinking €200 million investment has brought an innovative, carbon-neutral brewery to life in Newbridge, Co. Kildare .   This best-in-class facility   is   Ireland’s second-largest brewing operation and a powerhouse of sustainability, running entirely on renewable energy.   It’s   where iconic beers like   Rockshore , Harp, Smithwick’s, and Kilkenny   are   crafted for a new generation.   

 

 
 About the role   
 
 As a Utilities Technician, you will play a critical role in the safe, efficient, and sustainable operation of the Little Connell Utilities Section, including Water Treatment, Wastewater Treatment, Wastewater Recovery, Chemical Management, Boiler Operations, Hot Water Systems, Refrigeration, Heat Recovery, and Process Gases. Working within an operate-and-maintain model, you will use digital tools such as Zaptic, SCADA, MES, SAP, and ManEx to monitor performance, execute operational and maintenance tasks, and support continuous improvement. You will take ownership of utilities performance, ensuring the reliable supply of essential services to brewing operations while driving excellence in safety, quality, sustainability, and operational efficiency.
 
 Key accountabilities: 
 Champion a strong safety culture and support health, safety, environmental, hygiene, and compliance initiatives across the site.
 Operate, monitor, maintain, and optimise utilities systems, including water treatment, wastewater treatment, boilers, refrigeration, heat recovery, and process gas plants.
 Ensure premium quality, food safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to water discharge and ISO standards.
 Take ownership of plant performance through condition monitoring, autonomous maintenance, problem solving, and KPI management.
 Use digital systems and data insights to identify losses, improve efficiency, and support Manufacturing Excellence (ManEx) routines.
 Lead and participate in continuous improvement activities, including Kaizen events, root cause analysis, A3 problem solving, and sustainability initiatives.
 Support commissioning, start-up, validation, and steady-state operation of utilities systems while maintaining accurate SOPs, OPLs, and operational records.
 Work collaboratively across Utilities, Brewing, Engineering, and vendor partners to deliver production, sustainability, and performance goals.
 
 
 Experience/skills required:   
  
 We're looking for a proactive and technically capable Utilities Technician who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and enjoys taking ownership of plant performance. You'll combine strong operational knowledge with a continuous improvement mindset, using data, digital tools, and problem-solving skills to deliver safe, efficient, and sustainable utilities operations. Whether your background is in utilities, engineering, brewing, or process manufacturing, you'll be passionate about operational excellence, collaborative working, and driving performance improvements across the site.
 
 What you'll bring: 
 A technical qualification in Engineering, Brewing, Science, or a related discipline, with relevant manufacturing or utilities experience.
 Strong knowledge of utilities systems, including water treatment, wastewater treatment, steam generation, refrigeration, process gases, and energy management.
 A solid understanding of manufacturing, brewing, packaging, asset care, quality, safety, and environmental management systems.
 Proven diagnostic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, optimise performance, and deliver sustainable improvements.
 Experience using digital manufacturing and maintenance systems such as SCADA, MES, SAP, Zaptic, or similar platforms.
 Good understanding of health, safety, and environmental legislation, with a commitment to maintaining the highest safety standards.
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, and external partners.
 A passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and developing both personal capability and team performance.
 
   
 Working with Us   
 
 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.  
 
 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.  
 
 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.  
 
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity!
 
 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines.  Abbott in Ireland

In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened  a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems.
 
 This is how you can make a difference at Abbott: 
 
 In this role you will be in charge to apply subject matter knowledge in the area of Pharmaceutical/Biological Process. You will require capacity to apply skills/knowledge within the context of specific needs or requirements..

 Implement and maintain pharmaceutical/biological processes.

 Model processes and units operations.

 Ensure proper sequence of operation and prepares specifications and operating instructions for processing equipment.

 Growing business plus access to many more benefits.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.   
 At Davy, you are the difference.     
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.  
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.  
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity has opened up for a Salesforce Developer . In this role, the successful candidate will:
 Design, develop, configure, and maintain Salesforce solutions to support business objectives across various business units.
 Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
 Administer and support the Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) platform, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and user adoption.
 Configure Salesforce features including objects, fields, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards, profiles, permission sets, and security controls.
 Develop and support integrations between Salesforce and internal and external systems using APIs, middleware, and third-party solutions.
 Support system releases, deployments, testing activities, and change management processes. 
 Ensure Salesforce solutions comply with IT governance, security standards, data protection requirements, and financial services regulatory obligations. 
 Produce and maintain accurate technical documentation, solution designs, configuration documentation, and user guides.
 Identify opportunities to optimise business processes through automation, improved data management, and enhanced user experiences.
 Requirements 
 About You 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills:
 Minimum 5 years' experience working as a Salesforce Developer, including hands-on experience with Financial Services Cloud (FSC) or Service Cloud.
 Proven experience delivering Salesforce solutions in a regulated financial services environment.
 Strong capability in building Salesforce solutions using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex triggers, and Flow-based automation.
 Proven ability to develop scalable solutions for high-volume data processing using Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, and asynchronous processing patterns.
 Demonstrated success in supporting and enhancing business-critical production environments, including troubleshooting and resolution of complex technical issues.
 Understanding of Agile delivery frameworks and modern Salesforce DevOps practices, including Git-based source control, release management, automated deployments, and CI/CD processes.
 Strong stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Salesforce Certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator would be advantageous.
 Relevant third-level degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
 Benefits 
 What we offer   
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.   
 Health and Wellbeing   
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.  
 Reward and Recognition   
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.  
 Growth and Development   
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.  
 Positive Workplace   
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.  
 Values and Culture   
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.    
 Important Information   
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland.  
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role.  
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Abbott Ireland Nutrition Division Cootehill Cavan 
 Abbott Nutrition produces a range of infant formulae in all pack sizes under the brand name “Similac”. To complement the range of “Similac” infant formulae, the facility also manufactures a range of follow on formulae under the brand name of “Gain”. The essential ingredient is liquid skim milk and this is combined with carbohydrate, vegetable oils, vitamins and minerals. The product is blended, pasteurised, dried and packaged at the site and once packaged, is distributed to Europe, South East Asia, the Middle East, Latin America and Canada.
 
  Established in 1975, Abbott Nutrition in Ireland is the largest powder manufacturing facility for the production of infant formulae within the Abbott Corporation worldwide.  Approximately 1,000 dairy farms in Ireland and Northern Ireland supply quality milk to the Cootehill facility which processes 500,000 litres per day. This secure supply together with Ireland’s reputation as a green, clean environment is of significant strategic importance to Abbott Nutrition.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company. 
 
 We currently have a position for Compliance Specialist and this role will involve the following:
 
 Purpose of the role 
 The role is responsible for analysing quality standards for components, materials, and services. It includes applying measurement techniques, sampling methods, testing procedures, and other quality‑assurance practices to ensure all standards are consistently met.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Apply quality principles by reviewing quality records, preparing reports, and recommending improvements.
 Conduct inspections, verifications, and validations of components and materials used in development processes.
 Identify and resolve recurring issues related to product quality or testing reliability.
 Document quality issues and track performance metrics for management review.

The market reference point (midpoint) of the range typically represents the higher end of the initial offer and reflects a level at which an individual is considered fully proficient in the role. This structure also allows scope for ongoing salary progression as the employee continues to gain experience and develop in the position.
To apply, email your application, including your CV, to recruit@gasnetworks.ie , quoting the job title and reference number in the subject line.
The Role
Reporting to the Systems Integration and Asset Management Manager, the Project Delivery Engineer will have responsibility for supporting the end to end planning and delivery of the project, and managing, driving and delivering their respective workstream as issued by the System Integration Manager and PMO. The successful candidate will have the ability to work closely with other teams, supporting a wide range of technical engineering external suppliers and consultants , to drive the successful development and delivery of the project through design, procurement, construction and commissioning.
Duties and Responsibilities
Act as the primary point of contact for the delivery of specified workstreams as part of a cross functional team responsible for the design, planning and delivery of the project. Supports the management of project budget, schedule, quality and customer/stakeholder requirements, through various project phases and gates.
Responsible for planning and overseeing the end to end delivery of specified workstreams, in conjunction with PMO.
Responsible for developing and maintaining project schedules including tracking and reporting on progress against the agreed schedule. Updating project status on a weekly  basis through the GNI Project Reporting Portal.  Coordinating with Project Scheduler regarding provision of all project status information.
Responsible for developing, reviewing and collating key documentation as required to progress internal project budget approvals through relevant investment governance committees, in conjunction with PMO.
Coordinate the development of tender and contract documents for the project, with respect to procurement of 3rd party services and works contracts as necessary. (E.g. Site Investigations, Engineering Services and Construction Works). Review all project related contractor documentation to ensure compliance with legislation, standards and specifications.
Liaising with external stakeholders such as Local Authorities, ESB, Eir, NPWS, TII, regarding full project lifecycle activities/agreements. Includes managing applications where assigned projects require Statutory approvals or planning applications.
Input to contract management, risk mitigation and change control, per project/programme, to ensure delivery to time, scope and customer requirements. Development and tracking of project data in relation to risk, schedule, change management and preparing reports on same in coordination with PMO.
Ensure all project activities are completed in line with GNI Health, Safety, Quality, Environmental and Sustainability requirements.
Coordinate project team oversight of the role of Project Supervisor Design Process (PSDP) through the project lifecycle ensuring appropriate coordination of project designer, maintenance of temporary works & design change registers and ensuring the Project Supervisor Construction Stage (PSCS) adopts appropriate controls to mitigate identified particular risks.
Monitor contractors compliance with their requirements as PSCS requesting improvement, documenting and escalating where required.
Act as the project escalation point for the assigned workstream(s), mitigating project risks and resolving any issues that arise for specified project/programme of work.
Assist in relationship with Contractors at the project level, including review and approval of all contractor and project payments, as per relevant contract documentation.
Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders to progress project from high-level design to delivery as required.
Drive for high performance, setting the standard for continuous improvement in the delivery of projects/programmes.
Responsible for ensuring all project technical records.
Performing other duties as assigned from time to time.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
Relevant third level degree Engineering or other technical equivalent.
Minimum 3 - 5 years post qualification experience managing the delivery of projects and programmes, in the natural gas or similar utility/construction industries (e.g. water, gas, telecommunications, electrical, mission critical infrastructure)

 Job Category

 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 The Experience 

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we’re looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce’s core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Our Enterprise Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and c-suite decision makers within their patch, and become natural at helping customers realise value from their Salesforce investments.

You will use your skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.

Working within our Ireland team, this role requires extensive C-Suite engagement experience.

 What You'll Actually Be Doing 
 
 Develop key customer stakeholder relationships and drive customer satisfaction at assigned accounts 
 Develop and drive the overall long-term strategy for the account, aligned with customer business objectives 
 Lead the end-to-end sales process through the engagement of appropriate resources such as Sales Engineers, Professional Services, Executives, Partners, etc. 
 Territory identification and research, to formalise a go-to-market territory strategy and create a qualified target account list within 30 days. 
 Share Salesforce value proposition for existing and/or new customers 
 Drive growth within new and existing account 
 

 You're Our Person If... 
 
 Demonstrated Success of quota carrying, technology solution-based direct sales experience. 
 Account Planning Strategies: Create account plans to retain and grow ACV (Actual Contract Value) with existing and new accounts with a focus on upsell, and cross-sell. 
 Research and Discovery: Uncover customers’ current processes, business objectives, and strategic goals based on customer discovery, use cases, and value hypotheses. 
 Solutioning: Identifies compelling value propositions that address customer needs by demonstrating an understanding of technology solutions. 
 Customer Communication: Interacting with customers in a clear, concise, and timely manner using a variety of communication methods (writing, speech, presentation) and tools (whiteboarding, Slack, Google Slides, Zoom). 
 Resource Application: Continuously runs toward results using the full capabilities of available resources and tools. 
 Team Selling: Aligns with the full capacities of the account team and partners to support the deal and customer success. 
 

 Even Better If... 
 
 Excellent interpersonal and communications skills. 
 Sales Methodology education. 
 Ability to develop cases and service requirements, while crafting and leading strategic alliances. 
 Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. 
 Track record of consistently achieving or surpassing quota. 
 Ability to work with multiple internal teams, govern, inspire, and leverage resources to align with account objectives. 
 Experience will be evaluated based on alignment with the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, etc.). 
 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Archivist
description:
Job Description : 
 Archivist Location: Guinness Archive, Guinness Storehouse, Dublin Full-time 2 Years Fixed-Term Contract 
 Closing date: 25th September 2026 

 About us With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

 About the Function Heritage is one of Diageo's greatest assets, helping shape the future of our iconic brands through the stories of their past.
 The Guinness Archive, based at the Guinness Storehouse, is responsible for preserving, protecting and sharing the history of Guinness, Diageo's beer brands and Roe & Co Whiskey. As the only publicly accessible brand archive in Ireland, it supports brand teams, innovation, visitor experiences and cultural storytelling across the business.

 About the Team You'll join a small team of archive professionals and heritage specialists who work closely with Brand Homes, Learning & Development, Brewery Ambassadors and global brand teams to preserve our collections and bring our brands' rich history to life.

 About the Role As an Archivist, you'll help preserve one of Ireland's most important brand collections while making our heritage accessible to colleagues, visitors and stakeholders around the world. Combining archival expertise with storytelling, digital preservation and customer engagement, you'll help ensure our heritage continues to inspire future generations.

 Role Responsibilities Catalogue and preserve archive collections to recognised international archival standards, ensuring our collections remain accessible and protected.
 Support the management and preservation of digital archive collections and contribute to ongoing digitisation projects.
 Deliver engaging heritage inductions and presentations for employees, agencies and visitors, bringing the Guinness story to life.
 Provide archive expertise and support to internal stakeholders, helping colleagues access historical materials and brand heritage.
 Work collaboratively across the business to increase access to collections and support heritage projects that strengthen our brands.
 This is a unique opportunity to combine professional archive practice with one of the world's most iconic brands. You'll contribute to preserving Guinness' remarkable heritage while helping shape how our history informs future innovation, storytelling and visitor experiences.

 Experience / Skills Required This could be the right opportunity for you if you have:
 A qualification in Archives and Records Management (or are working towards one) together with knowledge of archive and cataloguing standards.
 Experience in an archive, museum, heritage or visitor-facing environment.
 Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage a range of audiences.
 A collaborative approach with excellent IT skills and experience using digital collections or archive management systems.
 Experience with Axiell Collections or similar archive management software would be advantageous but is not essential.

 Flexible Working Statement Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you're supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

 Rewards & Benefits Statement We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
 Competitive salary
 Annual bonus
 Product allowance
 Generous holiday allowance
 Contributory pension scheme
 Career development opportunities within a global organisation
 Diversity Statement Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. 
 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Work with VBU & VF-Group Product teams to identify best in class mobile services to range.
Work with VBU Product & Propositions teams to develop repeatable solutions incorporating mobile services.
Develop client relationships and work to strengthen industry partnerships in the mobile space.
Identify new customers by researching and creating networking opportunities.
Work with account teams to close business deals that promote sustained revenue.
Liaise with Sales, Marketing, Product and Management to align strategies right for VFIE and aimed at increasing mobile revenue.
Liaise with Vodafone Technology teams to ensure VBU are leveraging the full capabilities of our mobile network.
Work with partner managers to identify potential partners in the mobile technology space.
Who you are:
2-3 years + working in technical sales in mobile telecommunications or a related industry.
Experience in solution outcome selling
Experience in working with and through partners to deliver customer solutions
Ability to analyse market trends and competitor behavior.
Ability to maintain strong client relationships and establish industry partnerships.
Competency in negotiating and closing business deals.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Not a perfect fit?
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background.
If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply — you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
What’s in it for you?
The flexibility to work how you perform best, with hybrid ways of working and real focus on work-life balance
A competitive package including salary, bonus and a strong pension to support you now and long-term
‘’Generous’’ flexible benefits allowance, plus access to comprehensive health and wellbeing support
Access to our on-site wellness centre and gym, alongside a wider wellbeing programme
Free mobile plan, device offers and exclusive discounts for you, your family and friends
Market-leading family policies and flexibility to support you at every stage of life
Real opportunities for career growth through learning, development and internal progression
Who we are:
We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people’s lives and the world around us.
Through our technology, we empower people — connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live — and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.
Belonging at Vodafone isn’t a concept; it’s lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You’ll be part of a global and diverse community with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures.
We’re committed to increasing diversity, ensuring equal representation, and making Vodafone a place where everyone feels safe, valued and included.
Vodafone is committed to supporting candidates with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.
Together we can.
#LI-JB1
Vodafone is committed to attracting, developing and retaining the very best people by offering a motivating and inclusive workplace in which talent is truly recognised and rewarded. We are committed to promoting Inclusion for All with the belief that diversity plays an important role in the success of our business. We actively encourage everyone to consider becoming a part of our journey.

Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
What you get to do in this role:
We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated, and pragmatic problem solver to serve as Corporate Counsel, Public Sector supporting ServiceNow’s SaaS and professional services sales primarily to customers in Federal, State, and  Local government sectors. This is a great opportunity to work on cutting-edge issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment. This is is a full-time position with flexibility on location, but preference for location in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area. The position will report to the U.S. Public Sector lead counsel for Federal, State, Local, and Higher Education on our US Public Sector Legal team.
Review and negotiate master SaaS licensing agreements, professional services agreements, work orders, statements of work, and nondisclosure agreements that meet the company’s requirements under its policies, including those for risk tolerance, while working collaboratively with the business team, including various executives.
Serve as subject matter expert for channel partner issues and agreements, along with responses to requests for proposals (RFPs), enterprise licensing agreements, and other types of Federal, State, and Local contracting documents.
Collaborate with finance, sales operations, deal desk, product operations, support, security and other business units at all levels throughout the organization to ensure that agreements adequately protect the company’s interests.
Support the continuous improvement of standard forms of agreement and legal processes.
Be a trusted business partner, responding in a timely and productive manner to requests from internal customers.
Counsel and deliver training to internal customers regarding company policies, legal issues, and risk tolerance.
Qualifications
To be successful in this role you have:
Undergraduate degree and law degree from highly regarded schools
Active membership in at least one U.S. State bar
At least 5 years’ relevant experience practicing government contracts at the federal and/or state levels at a law firm, corporation, or government agency.
Extensive experience with Federal, State, and Local government procurement processes, and regulations, including the FAR and DFARS.
Experience negotiating agreements with government customers, including understanding of relevant regulations applicable to commercial item prime contractors and subcontractors
Strong understanding of GSA Schedule Cooperative Purchasing and State and Local Government procurement vehicles such as NASPO ValuePoint.
Familiarity with channel (distributors, resellers) and related practice issues.
Experience working cross-functionally with internal organizations to resolve questions.
Preferred:
Experience supporting due diligence for mergers and acquisitions of government contractors or commercial companies with robust government contracts business portfolios.
Deep understanding and experience supporting commercial contracting under FAR Part 12.
In order to be successful in this role, we need someone who has:
Excellent negotiating and influencing skills, and a talent for non-confrontational, win-win negotiations
Exceptional critical thinking abilities, who possesses strong business acumen and excellent business judgment; must be able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and pivot between responsibilities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to distill complex issues clearly and communicate well both one-on-one and in groups, and in internal and external contexts
Desire for close collaboration with sales and sales support to close deals efficiently, with a practical approach
Proficient drafting and legal technical skills, with keen attention to detail
For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $153,300 - $252,900 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.
Additional Information
Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
Accommodations
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact [email protected] for assistance.
Export Control Regulations
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Competitive with great benefits
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes

Career Grade: E
Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you will be required to undergo DV (Developed Vetting) level Security Clearance ( https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels) . An allowance of £5k per annum may be payable monthly while you hold this DV and continue to work in a role that requires that level of security clearance. The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.
Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses.   We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.
About the role
To manage, operate, and assure a large, complex, and highly secure Managed Service supporting critical UK national infrastructure and HM Government Defence operations.
The role operates under the direction of the Operational Service Manager (OSM) and Platform Technical Team and carries direct responsibility during shift for service resilience, security assurance, and operational stability, contributing to a brilliant customer and employee experience.
This role will be fully onsite and be based in the Swindon area. You will require DV clearance in order to work in this role.
What you’ll be doing
Whilst on shift, be responsible for ALL 1st and 2nd Line operational activities for a large, complex, highly secure Managed Service.
Operate strictly in accordance with all platform and building SYOPS, processes, procedures, and local work instructions, including any BT or Customer directed sub activities, as authorised and directed by the OSM.
Maintain full awareness of operational priorities, security posture, and live service risk throughout the shift
Core Networking and Routing Technologies Security and Boundary Technologies IT, Server, Virtualisation, and Infrastructure Technologies Voice and VoIP Technologies Environmental systems, including power, cooling, and intruder detection technologies
Ensure all technologies and infrastructure remain in an R0 Operational State (immediate readiness).
Support the platform team in regular testing, exercising, and development of service capability, as directed by the OSM.
Identify, escalate, and support resolution of incidents and service degradation in line with operational procedures.
Assist in attaining and maintaining the strictest government and MoD security assurance and accreditation for the Managed Service.
Essential Skills / Experience
Operational Experience: Proven experience supporting secure, highly available Managed Services within regulated or classified environments.
Technology Awareness: Working knowledge across networking, infrastructure, security, virtualisation, and environmental systems within secure operational estates.
Stakeholder Management: Ability to work collaboratively across virtual and on site teams, multiple BT Lines of Business, third party suppliers and contractors, and customer/user authorities.
Procedural Discipline: Demonstrated ability to operate strictly within SYOPS, processes, procedures, and local work instructions.
Teamworking: Commitment to inclusive behaviours, collaboration, and the One Team ethos.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Business Acumen: Awareness of business strategy and the drivers of organisational performance, including people performance and financial literacy.
Experience working within secure Network Operations Centres (NOCs).
Familiarity with incident, problem, and change processes within managed service environments.
Our Package
When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.
•    Competitive DV market aligned salaries
•    Tiered role based DV allowance
•    World-class training and development opportunities
•    10% on target bonus
•    Equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
•    Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
•    BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
•    New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
•    Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
•    On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
•    Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
•    24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
•    Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
•    25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
•    2 weeks paid carer’s leave
•    Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
•    Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary
Security is one of the fastest growing parts of our global organisation. We are protecting our networks from more than 6,500 cyber attacks each day, investing over £40m in research each year - and in employing nearly 3,000 people, we’re also the largest private cyber employer in the UK.  With incredible opportunities to learn, develop and grow your skills, we’ll invest in you, nurture your potential and shape your future – whatever your background or experience.
In today’s world, safe and secure digital connections have never been more vital. You’ll be joining a global company operating at the forefront of the information age: BT employs 90,000 people in 180 countries. With huge scale, we’re capable of achieving great things, striving to be personal, simple, and brilliant for our customers whilst creating an inclusive working environment where people from all backgrounds can succeed. Play your part. Make a difference. We are the Protectors.
A FEW POINTS TO NOTE:
Although these roles are listed as full-time, if you’re a job share partnership, work reduced hours, or any other way of working flexibly, please still get in touch.
We will also offer reasonable adjustments for the selection process if required, so please do not hesitate to inform us.
DON'T MEET EVERY SINGLE REQUIREMENT?
Studies have shown that women and people who are disabled, LGBTQ+, neurodiverse or from ethnic minority backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification and criteria. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone can be their best, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement on the Job Description, please apply anyway - you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles in our wider team.

title: Content Marketing Specialist (6 Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description:
About us  
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.  
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.  
 But we don’t stop there.  
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.   
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.  
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.  
 Overview of role 
 This is a fantastic opportunity to learn new skills and develop an exciting career in content marketing and communications. The Content Marketing Specialist will join a small team focused on owning Fenergo’s corporate voice and creating compelling, persuasive and informative content.
 You will be a highly motivated and enthusiastic individual, who can write across a myriad of mediums and channels, offering key messages to different buyer personas. You will be capable of translating complex technology-based content into compelling stories that fuel our lead lifecycle process.
 Your role will span support content marketing, PR and analyst relations, allowing you to expand your experience and skillset across these critical communications divisions.
 Please note this is a Fixed Term Contract for a period of 6 months.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Content Marketing 
 Manage content calendar to show forward plan of content and alignment to key priorities.
 Support Content and Comms Director with the development of whitepapers, blogs, case studies
 Support with writing landing page and web content (descriptions etc) of videos, case studies and awards.
 Leverage AI tools to summarise webinars and long-form content (research reports etc) for blogs.
 Support in writing and submitting speaking proposals for major events.
 Responsible for collating monthly reports including metrics for content pieces.
   Public Relations and Analyst Relations 
 Manage an annual global awards calendar including writing and submitting award entries, purchasing logos for award wins, publishing of award wins on website and all internal and external promotion.
 Coordinate effective promotion of analyst rankings internally and externally via various channels including social media, website, intranet etc. This includes writing relevant promo content for all channels.
 Support with logistics for annual events in key locations.
 Tracking and reporting of media coverage — partner with PR agency to report on impact of comms activity
 Requirements 
 Experience 
 1–2 years' experience in public relations or content marketing, gained in either an agency or in-house environment.
 B2B technology experience with strong media knowledge is essential.
 Proven experience planning, managing, and launching content and/or PR campaigns across earned and owned channels.
 Experience working with senior stakeholders and contributors.
 Skills 
 Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.
 Excellent time management and organisational skills.
 Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills.
 Outstanding writing ability that informs, educates, and persuades.
 Ability to combine creative thinking with commercial and product understanding.
 Skilled in writing across multiple formats (digital, social, print) and for a variety of audiences and personas.
 Strong attention to detail, with a passion for delivering high-quality, outcome-focused work.
 Nice to Have 
 A degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field.
 Benefits 
 Our promise to you   
 We are striving to become global leaders across all of the categories we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross functionally to accommodate our client’s needs.   
 Collaboration: Working together to achieve our best 
 Outcomes: Drive Success in every engagement  
 Respect: A collective feeling of inclusion and belonging 
 Excellence: Continuously raising the bar 
 What's in it for you? 
 Health insurance 
 25 days annual leave plus, 3 company days
 Work From Home set-up allowance
 Exposure to our local wide partner community 
 Opportunity to work with clients and colleagues on a global scale for a world leader in Client Lifecycle Management
 Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work-from-home policy, sports and social committee and much more
 Extensive training programs, through ‘Fenergo University' where you will be certified in all of the Fenergo products 
 Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest tools and technologies harnessing AI
 Defined training and role tracking to allow you to see and assess your own career development and progress
 
 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity
 Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
 Recruitment Safety  
 For information on our recruitment process and how to verify communications from Fenergo, please visit our Careers page.

title: RETAIL ASSISTANT
description:
Because you make the difference 
 Here at Primark, we love to do things our way. Because we help our customers keep up with high fashion at affordable prices. We do everything with passion, high standards and care around here. And if that sounds like you, join us as a Retail Assistant.

 Fully Flexible on weekends and public holidays, they need 2 evenings availability

during the week. Must be fully available for the month of December. 

 Because you matter 
 People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first:
 Salary: we offer a competitive salary €13.75 per hour plus premium Sunday rate
 Balance: Enjoy flexibility with accommodating shifts
 Pension: Secure your future with our generous pension scheme
 Discounts: Use your in-store employee discount across our fabulous range
 Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and employee assistance programme.
 Holiday: Enjoy generous holidays, based on your hours
 Opportunity to progress your career internationally
 

 What will I be doing? 
 As a Retail Assistant, you’ll be making our customer’s day, every day. Here’s what this looks like in action:
 Providing customers with an amazing experience as you help them with things like sizes or styles, purchases, or returns
 Setting up a good-looking shop floor with full shelves, tidy fitting rooms and all the latest fashions, as well as keeping a tidy and well-organised stockroom
 Delivering a fast, friendly, efficient experience at till points, processing queries, voids, and returns.
 Receiving, unpacking and checking off new deliveries. Getting our products on to the shop floor and ensuring they’re all correctly priced - all while making sure everything meets our high standards
 

 Who you are:
 We love to delight our customers with amazing in store experiences and that starts with you! Here’s what we need:
 You’re passionate about people and creating those amazing experiences
 You’re honest, a strong communicator who can also listen, share ideas and get involved where needed
 You’ve got good organisational skills and attention to detail
 You’re a team player with high levels of motivation, a positive attitude and willingness to learn
 You’re interested in fashion and the latest looks
 Ideally, you’ve got some experience working within a busy retail environment
 To join us, apply today! 
 
 Our fashion isn’t one-size-fits-all and neither is our culture. Primark promotes equal employment opportunity, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where people can be themselves, access opportunities and thrive together.
 #LI-DNI

description:
Jobs /
Backup and Disaster Recovery Consultant
Closing Date: 14/10/2026
Location: Dublin
Reference #: 2075
Role Title:
Business Area:
Consultancy & Delivery
About This Role:
eir Business is the B2B division of eir and one of Ireland's leading providers of telecommunications, technology, cloud, cybersecurity, managed IT and workplace solutions. Supporting organisations of all sizes, from SMEs to large enterprises and public sector bodies, eir Business delivers secure, end-to-end connectivity and digital transformation services that help customers operate more efficiently, securely and effectively. Leveraging Ireland's largest mobile network, extensive fixed-line infrastructure, cloud capabilities and 24/7 expert support, eir Business partners with customers to design, implement and manage technology solutions that enable innovation, productivity and business growth.
Why This Role:
The successful candidate will report directly to our Head of Infrastructure Practice. The Backup & Disaster Recovery Consultant will have solid technical capability, excellent verbal and written skills and a high focus on the quality of work.
Expectations From The
Role:
Installation, configuration and maintenance of backup & disaster recovery systems
Installation, configuration and maintenance of servers & storage area network
Integration of server infrastructure into SAN
Installation, configuration and maintenance of hypervisor platforms (VMware, Nutanix, HPE VME, OpenShift)
Installation, configuration and maintenance of Linux servers and associated services (RHEL, Ubuntu).
Proactive monitoring of infrastructure and identifying potential problems (bottlenecks, misconfigurations).
Compiling and producing technical documentation for all infrastructure layers.
Requirements For A
Successful Application:
More than 3 years of work experience in similar jobs
Proven experience with Windows and Linux based scripting (PowerShell, bash, Ansible, Terraform, Python)
Experience in working with automation, DevOps or containerization tools
Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Nutanix, HPE VME, OpenShift (Desirable)
Working experience with Linux CentOS (Rocky), RedHat, Ubuntu (Desirable)
Proven experience with Dell server, HPE Server or other relevant vendor servers.
Experience with TCP/IP Networking
Systematism and precision in work.
Proactive approach and providing solutions
Relevant vendor certification (VCP, NCP, RHSCA, VMCE, etc) (Desirable)
Organizational and mentoring skills
Others:
About eir
Our purpose is to connect for a better Ireland.
Our ambition is to be the number one choice for telecommunications and technology solutions, delivering for our customers today and into the future.
Our new values and behaviours reflect both who we are and who we strive to become.  They are the way that we bring our purpose to life in eir.
We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive work environment. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.
If successful in the interview process, eir reserves the right to conduct appropriate suitability checks in relation to prospective employees including but not limited to reference checking and/or other searches using publicly available information.
Apply Now!
