title: National KAM Role
description:
Salary Range: 
€54,096.00 - €100,464.00 
 
 Job Description Summary 
Are you passionate about improving patient outcomes and building trusted partnerships across healthcare systems? As a National Key Account Manager, you will play a critical role in driving the commercial success of Novartis' priority brands across Immunology, Neuroscience, and Cardiovascular therapeutic areas.

In this field-based role, you will engage strategically with key healthcare stakeholders, deliver impactful customer experiences, generate insights, and execute brand strategies that create value for patients, healthcare professionals, and healthcare organizations. You will work collaboratively across multiple functions while ensuring the highest standards of ethics, compliance, and customer focus. 
 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities Lead the national execution of commercial strategies for priority products across the Immunology, Neuroscience, and Cardiovascular therapeutic areas.
 Deliver high-quality, compliant customer engagements aligned with brand objectives and therapeutic area strategies.
 Build and maintain trusted partnerships with healthcare professionals, key decision-makers, and relevant stakeholders through meaningful scientific and commercial discussions.
 Communicate clinical evidence and product value propositions to support appropriate product use and improved patient outcomes.
 Implement the Novartis International Commercial Excellence (ICE) framework, including account planning, customer targeting, segmentation, and engagement planning.
 Leverage digital tools and data-driven insights, including Next Best Action recommendations, to optimize customer interactions and business impact.
 Gather and analyze customer, market, and competitive insights, translating findings into actionable opportunities and strategic recommendations.
 Participate in local meetings, educational activities, and promotional events in accordance with governance and compliance requirements.
 Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners across Marketing, Medical Affairs, Value & Access, and Execution Excellence teams to deliver integrated customer solutions.
 Operate in full compliance with Novartis policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards.

 What You'll Bring Essential Requirements
 Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Business, or a related field.
 Proven experience in pharmaceutical sales, key account management, or commercial roles within healthcare.
 Strong understanding of customer engagement principles and account management methodologies.
 Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and build long-term professional relationships.
 Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
 Experience working in a cross-functional environment and managing multiple priorities effectively.
 Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret market and customer insights.
 Proficiency in CRM systems and digital engagement tools.
 Willingness to travel nationally as required.

 Desirable Requirements
 Experience within Immunology, Neuroscience, Cardiovascular, or specialty care therapeutic areas.
 Knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and market access principles.
 Experience with omnichannel engagement approaches and data-driven customer planning.

 Why Novartis? Our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people's lives. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.
 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

 Key Success Measures Success in this role will be measured through:
 Achievement of sales objectives and business targets.
 Quality and effectiveness of customer engagement activities.
 Execution excellence across account planning, targeting, and segmentation.
 Delivery against omnichannel engagement and call plan objectives.
 Compliance with reporting, CRM, and governance standards.
 Quality and impact of field insights shared with cross-functional teams.
 Participation in capability-building and field effectiveness programs.
 Adherence to International Commercial Excellence standards and expectations.
 Successful completion of required product and disease area training and assessments.
 
 Benefits & Rewards  
 At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen. 
   
 Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:  54,096.00 - 77,280.00 - 100,464.00 EUR Annual 
   
 The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. 
   
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. 
   
 The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave. 
 You may be eligible for a company vehicle or a car allowance in accordance with the applicable local Novartis policies and guidelines. 
 Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics. 
   
 Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering: 
   
 https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf  
 
 
 Skills Desired 
Commercial Excellence, Conflict Management, Cross-Functional Coordination, Customer Insights, Influencing Skills, Key Account Management, Professional Ethics

title: Vendor Management & Contract/Commercial Governance
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Summary 
 Under general supervision, the Commercial Manager is responsible for commercial governance, contract oversight, and financial risk management for Human Resources vendor relationships within a regulated financial services environment. This role partners with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Risk to ensure commercial terms, pricing structures, and contractual obligations are appropriately managed throughout the vendor lifecycle and aligned with internal governance and Third‑Party Risk Management (TPRM) requirements. 
 The role provides commercial subject‑matter expertise to support informed decision‑making related to vendor selection, negotiations, renewals, amendments, and exits, with a focus on cost saving, value optimization, and risk mitigation. 
 
 Major Duties 
 • Provide commercial oversight for HR vendor contracts, including coordination of negotiations, renewals, amendments, and terminations in partnership with HR COEs, Procurement and Legal. 
 • Ensure commercial terms appropriately address financial, operational, regulatory, and data protection risk, in alignment with TPRM standards and internal policies. 
 • Review and maintain pricing models, fee structures, SLAs, incentives, and contractual remedies to ensure clarity, enforceability, and alignment with business objectives. 
 • Monitor vendor spend, contractual entitlements, and cost drivers, identifying cost optimization opportunities and potential financial risk exposure. 
 • Partner with HR COEs to support renewal strategy, back‑loaded risk assessment, and exit or transition planning for critical vendors. 
 • Provide clear escalation and reporting on commercial risks, issues, and key decision points to senior stakeholders. 
 • Support audits, reviews, and regulatory inquiries by providing commercial documentation, analysis, and risk assessments as required. 
 • Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of commercial governance practices, templates, and controls across the HR vendor portfolio. 
 
 Knowledge/Skills 
 · Strong knowledge and experience of commercial contracting, pricing models, and vendor financial management within a regulated environment. 
 · Working knowledge of Third‑Party Risk Management (TPRM) concepts and their intersection with contractual and commercial risk 
 · Ability to interpret and challenge complex contractual language, including financial, operational, and risk‑related provisions. 
 · Strong analytical skills with ability to assess financial exposure, renewal risk, and cost trends. 
 · Proven ability to partner effectively across HR, Legal, Procurement, Finance, Risk, and Compliance. 
 · Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present clear, concise commercial risk assessments to senior management. 
 · High attention to detail, sound judgment, and ability to operate independently in a highly controlled environment. 

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

 Role: IT CSD Support Associate

 Brief Summary: 
 The IT CSD Support Associate primarily answers hotline calls and responses to IT Incidents and Service Request Tasks from our end-user clients in EMEA and LATAM region.

 Please note the role will require hybrid attendance in the Dublin office (3 days a week) .

 CSD Vision:
 To deliver best in class employee workplace and collaboration experience, enriched by World Class support services and cloud solutions to boost SAP employee’s productivity. 

 CSD Mission: 
 Our workplace offers simple ways of working and collaborating for SAP employees and customers. Employee productivity is augmented by world-class support and high satisfaction. We provide vital IES solutions, rock-solid operations 7x24. 

 Expectations and Tasks 
 • Call handling for inbound IT support hotline.
 • Fully qualify and process all incoming IT support tickets in adherence to the agreed service, quality, and client satisfaction levels
 • Apply solutions, workarounds, patches and fixes as defined in our Knowledge Base.
 • Effective dispatch to the correct organization and resolver group.

 • Customer Focus 
 • Quality

title: Legal Analyst
description:
About Us 
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software - we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game. 
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management - we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries. 
 But we don’t stop there. 
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant - they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations - it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.  
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind. 
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future - together. 
 
 Who are you?  
 You are a high-achieving, recent Law graduate keen to launch a stellar career as a commercial lawyer. But, right now, your plans may be on hold because you are waiting to finish FE-1s or secure a traineeship. You wish there was a place where you could work now to put your degree to use and get real legal and business experience.  
 
 Why should you join us?  
 If that’s who you are, and you are hard-working, diligent, self-motivating and enjoy being part of an organisation with exciting revenue growth plans, we would like to speak to you. Fenergo is shaping the future of our industry, and you will be afforded an opportunity to significantly impact the revenue growth of a major target market for the company. 
 
 What you will do?  
 As a Fenergo Legal Analyst, you will be a member of our Legal Department reporting directly to our Head of Legal (Sales & Commercial). With training and oversight by our experienced team of lawyers, you will facilitate sales of Fenergo’s technology products to our customers. Many of whom are global financial institutions – names you will know! You will help review contracts, prepare for negotiations with our customers’ legal and procurement teams, and assist with advice to Fenergo’s business leaders. You will also have opportunities to learn how our business operates by liaising with Fenergo’s commercial, technical and financial teams.  
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Assist in all aspects of commercial contract review.
 Prepare for contract negotiations with customers by drafting responses to customer legal and commercial requests.

Die Ornua Deutschland GmbH mit Sitz in Neukirchen-Vluyn mit der Marke Kerrygold ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der irischen Ornua Cooperative Limited in Dublin, der genossenschaftlichen Organisation von irischen Milchbauern und deren Molkereien. Die nachhaltige Weidewirtschaft und unsere hervorragende Produktqualität hat uns mit der Marke  Kerrygold  zum  Marktführer  in den Kategorien Butter, Mischfette und Cheddar in  Deutschland  gemacht.
Rund 300 Mitarbeiter*Innen kümmern sich in der Abpackung, Logistik und in der Verwaltung um die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden*Innen. Mit hohem Engagement und Herzblut sorgen alle Mitarbeiter*Innen dafür, dass wir als Unternehmen nachhaltig wachsen und erfolgreich sind.
Auch für die Zukunft haben wir uns viel vorgenommen. Deshalb suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen
(Milchwirtschaftlichen) Laboranten / Laboratory Analyst (m/w/d) befristet für 12 Monate
Deine Aufgaben:
Beurteilung und Verwaltung aller Produkte und Proben inkl. Verpackungsmaterialien
Chemische und physikalische Laborkontrollen wie z.B. PH-Wert, Wasser- und Salzgehaltskontrollen
Mikrobiologische Untersuchung von Roh-, Fertig- und Zukaufwaren
Durchführung von Reinigungskontrollen
Organisation und Durchführung von sensorischen Kontrollen
Produktionsrundgänge und Produktkontrollen
Datenerfassung und -auswertung
Lagercheck externer Kühlhäuser
Zukaufwarenkontrolle (Entnahme bei Anlieferung)
Dein Profil:
Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als (milchwirtschaftliche/r) Laborant/-in oder vergleichbare Ausbildung

Gute Englischkenntnisse
Teamorientierung, Zuverlässigkeit und Engagement
Gute MS-Office Kenntnisse
Bereitschaft zum Schichtdienst (Drei-Schicht-Betrieb)
Teamgeist, Sorgfalt und Zuverlässigkeit runden Ihr Profil ab

Arbeiten bei Ornua bedeutet arbeiten in flachen Hierarchien. Voraussetzungen dafür sind ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Neugier, Begeisterung für das Kerrygold Sortiment und Teamfähigkeit. Ein ständiger Austausch mit den Kollegen (m/w/d) und eine offene Kommunikation sind ein wichtiger Bestandteil des täglichen Miteinanders.
Was Dich bei uns erwartet:
Eine attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Vermögenswirksame Leistungen
Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
Zuschuss zum Fitnessstudio (150€ p.a.)
Regelmäßige 1. Hilfe Auffrischung
Kostenfreie Getränke sowie täglich frisches Obst
Tolle Einkaufsrabatte bei über 700 Top-Markenanbietern
Sommerfeste und Teamdays
Firmeneigener Transporter zur privaten Nutzung möglich
Professionelle Unterstützung in Notlagen (Mitarbeiterhilfsprogramm)
uvm.

title: CAD Technician
description:
Technical Support CAD Specialist Our client, a leading provider of roofing, waterproofing and insulation solutions for the construction industry, is seeking a Technical Support CAD Specialist to join its technical team. This role offers a salary of €35,000–€40,000, depending on experience, and would suit someone with a background in AutoCAD, technical drawing and construction or engineering who is looking to develop their technical expertise within an established international business.
 About Your New Employer Join an established international business specialising in roofing, waterproofing, insulation and sustainable building solutions.

 Work with products and systems used across residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure developments.

 Become part of a technical team supporting customers and construction professionals with drawings and technical information.

 Gain exposure to a range of construction projects and building-envelope technologies.

 Develop your skills within a specialist technical environment with opportunities to build on your existing CAD experience.

 About Your New Job As a Technical Support CAD Specialist, you will support the preparation of technical drawings and provide CAD assistance to the wider technical team, helping ensure that building systems and product specifications are accurately represented.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Preparing and amending 2D technical drawings using AutoCAD.

 Producing detailed drawings and layouts in line with project requirements.

 Supporting the technical team with CAD documentation and drawing revisions.

 Reviewing technical information to ensure drawings are accurate and consistent with specifications.

 Assisting with technical queries relating to construction products and building systems.

 Liaising with internal teams and other stakeholders to ensure drawing requirements are met.

 Maintaining organised drawing records and technical documentation.

 What Skills You Need At least one year's relevant experience in a CAD, technical drawing or technical support role.

 Practical experience using 2D AutoCAD.

 Experience working in a construction, engineering or building-products environment.

 Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret technical information.

 Good organisational and communication skills.

 The ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

 A willingness to develop technical knowledge of construction products and building systems.

 What's on Offer Salary of €35,000–€40,000, depending on experience.

 Ongoing technical and product training.

 Career progression and professional development opportunities.

 Supportive and collaborative team environment.

 Exposure to a diverse range of construction projects and technical applications.

 Opportunity to develop your CAD and technical expertise within an established international organisation.

 Please note: This role does not offer sponsorship. Candidates must already have the right to work in Ireland.
 What's Next Apply now by clicking the “Apply Now” button or contact Shane Dunney at Sigmar Recruitment for more information.

title: Facilitation Officer
description:
Who are we looking for 
 This position is for an individual contributor in Talent Development & Learning’s – Global Facilitation team responsible for the Functional trainings for employees in India and several global offices as per the requirement.  This person is responsible for delivery and for monitoring the performance of New hire onboarding program for all new hires to the company and for the delivery of advanced skills training globally.  The role requires the person to be well versed in the financial services industry, departmental policies and company policies.  This position is designed to mitigate the risk of errors in fund administration operations (including accounting, transfer agency, trade processing, reconciliation and financial reporting).   Effectiveness as a trainer impacts the employees’ level of preparation for the job and the company’s level of protection against operational error and potential liability.  The person will report directly to a AVP Global facilitation team. 

 What will you be responsible for 
 The Functional Skills Trainer will be required to master and deliver the Functional onboarding, New Hire curriculums and other financial skills training
 Deliver both traditional classroom training and virtually instructed led training, hands on Functional and systems training, focused on Functional (job-specific) content training as needed.
 Crosstrain with other trainers and/or business unit staff to teach/learn training program material
 Liaise with subject-matter experts in the business lines when required to support the development of training materials.
 Attend staff development workshops/seminars to enhance presentation skills and industry knowledge.
 Actively participate in appraisal process by completing a self-evaluation and suggesting appropriate development.
 Take responsibility for Self-development in alignment to the teams goal.
  
 Required Qualifications and Skills 
 Solid understanding of the Financial Markets / Investment Management and Servicing industry is required, and intimate knowledge of State Street services, systems, processes and procedures is preferred.
 Support the development of new training and or evolve existing training offerings as well as delivering existing materials and add context/content/background to delivery of courses. 
 Ability to teach Functional information to employees of all experience levels. 
 Ability to work effectively with employees from other departments on training projects and various committees.
 Ability to work as part of a virtual training team spanning several locations/countries, sharing best practices.
 Bachelor’s degree with business, finance, accounting, or education major preferred. 
 10+ years’ experience in the Financial Services Industry. 
 Ability to develop business relationships, both within and outside of the organization.
 Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills.
 Strong Microsoft Office skills including Copilot and other AI tools.
 Communicate effectively at all levels within the organization, foster collaboration & teamwork.
  

 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: BIM Technician
description:
Your New Employer 
 An excellent opportunity has arisen to join one of Ireland’s leading M&E engineering contractors, delivering major projects across the data centre, commercial, pharmaceutical, healthcare and residential sectors.
 With a strong pipeline of projects in Dublin and continued investment in Digital Engineering, the company is looking to add a BIM Technician to its growing BIM team.
 
 Your New Role 
 As BIM Technician, you will work alongside BIM Coordinators, Engineers and Project Managers to support the production and coordination of high-quality mechanical and electrical models and drawings.
 The role offers excellent exposure to large-scale projects and is particularly suited to someone looking to develop their BIM career within an established M&E environment.
 
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Producing detailed mechanical and electrical models using Revit.
 Preparing coordinated construction drawings and layouts from BIM models.
 Supporting BIM Coordinators with multidisciplinary model coordination.
 Assisting with clash detection and issue resolution using Navisworks.
 Updating models throughout the design and construction stages.
 Working from engineering drawings, specifications and design information.
 Liaising with Engineers, BIM Coordinators and site teams to ensure models reflect construction requirements.
 Maintaining project documentation and models within Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)/BIM 360.
 Ensuring models and drawings comply with company and project BIM standards.
 Supporting the production of as-built models and handover documentation.
 Attending BIM and design coordination meetings where required.
 
 What You'll Need to Succeed 
 Qualification in BIM, Building Services Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Architectural Technology or a related discipline.
 Previous experience as a BIM Technician, Revit Technician or similar would be advantageous.
 Good working knowledge of Revit.
 Exposure to Navisworks, AutoCAD and ACC/BIM 360 would be beneficial.
 An understanding of mechanical and/or electrical building services.
 M&E contractor or building services consultancy experience would be particularly beneficial.
 Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical information.
 Strong attention to detail and willingness to develop technically.
 Good communication skills and ability to work within a multidisciplinary project team.
 
 What You'll Get in Return 
 Competitive salary and benefits package.
 Opportunity to work with a leading M&E contractor in Dublin.
 Exposure to major data centre, commercial and technically complex projects.
 Excellent opportunity to develop from BIM Technician into BIM Coordinator and BIM Lead positions.
 Hands-on experience with Revit, Navisworks, ACC and modern Digital Engineering workflows.
 Ongoing training and professional development.
 Support from an experienced BIM and engineering team.
 Strong long-term project pipeline and career progression opportunities.

title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Ops
description:
This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in the region.

A Data Center Technician will work as part of the Operations team whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. The candidate may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others). The position is full time and shift based, operating on a 24*7 rotation. The ideal candidate is someone with hands-on hardware experience.

Responsibilities:
· Work and meet SLA’s against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow
· First line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues
· Perform regular server hardware repairs(drives, motherboards etc)
· Carry out routine network, server hardware and OS related repairs
· Work with cross-functional teams on a regular basis to complete routine work
· Engage with Smart Hands in EU Regional POPs
· Adhere to security and safety best practices in the data center
· Participate in Data Center power & cooling events
· Participate in team meetings for metric analysis and daily/weekly goals achievement
· Identify and help create documentation for use globally
· Identify and help create process improvements relevant to the data center environment
· Perform server upgrades, rebuilds, scheduled works as required
· Interact with third party vendors & contractors
· Contribute to the development of other team members 

Key job responsibilities
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. 
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

· Work and meet SLA’s against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow
· First line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues
· Perform regular server hardware repairs(drives, motherboards etc)
· Carry out routine network, server hardware and OS related repairs
· Work with cross-functional teams on a regular basis to complete routine work
· Engage with Smart Hands in EU Regional POPs
· Adhere to security and safety best practices in the data center
· Participate in Data Center power & cooling events
· Participate in team meetings for metric analysis and daily/weekly goals achievement
· Identify and help create documentation for use globally
· Identify and help create process improvements relevant to the data center environment
· Perform server upgrades, rebuilds, scheduled works as required
· Interact with third party vendors & contractors
· Contribute to the development of other team members 
. Knowledge of Linux Operating Systems and Commands

About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. 

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair
- Experience in networking
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice ( https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page ) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: CSA Estimator
description:
Winthrop Technologies is Europe’s only dedicated data centre delivery partner, offering full turnkey solutions from design through to construction and commissioning. Headquartered in Dublin, we deliver projects across Europe and have become the most trusted name in our sector.
 
 We are pleased to announce that we are currently seeking a CSA Estimator to join our expanding team. This position will be based in our head office in Ballymount, Dublin 22 and reporting to the Estimating Director, offering the opportunity to work on cutting-edge data centre projects and contribute to our continued success.
 

 Responsibilities: 
 Complete & manage large tenders across long duration timeframes.
 Preparing estimates based on drawings and specifications.
 Manage quantities and prepare a pricing document.
 Obtain pricing for elements of the building from Irish and European subcontractors and suppliers.
 Utilise spreadsheets to compare subcontractor’s bids and quotations, and to demonstrate reasoning for selecting subcontractors.

 Understand the company’s high standards of safety.
 Able to identify potential risks on a project.
 Requirements 
 Minimum of 4 years’ relevant estimating experience. 
 Background in Civil, Structural & Architectural (CSA) engineering or proven previous trade experience. 
 Strong analytical and numerical skills with excellent attention to detail. 
 Ability to work collaboratively within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

 Benefits 
 Opportunity to work with a Market Leader in the Data centre Industry
 Supportive career development
 Competitive salary package
 Collaborative team environment
 Pipeline of project growth

title: Account Solution Engineer
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 
Job Description 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. We’re the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM . Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 Role Overview As an Account Solution Engineer (also known as a "Presales Consultant" or "Sales Engineer"), you are the visionary who transforms customer experiences. You aren’t just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner to Sales , owning the solutioning throughout the entire sales cycle. You will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, translating complex business objectives into enticing, practical recommendations that drive real change. 
 Business Acumen & Strategic Impact Business Transformation Advocate: You are passionate about how technology solves real-world business puzzles. You enjoy digging into a company’s value chain to find where Salesforce can drive the most impact. 
 The "Bottom Line" Mentality: You understand that technology is only as good as the business outcome it creates. You are excited by the challenge of connecting high-level business strategy to technical execution. 
 Strategic Sales Partner: You thrive on the "win." You act as a co-pilot to the sales team, bringing a strategic lens to every deal to ensure we aren't just selling software, but building a long-term partnership. 
 The Ideal Profile: Passion & Mindset Demonstrated Passion for Technology & AI 
 The "First to Know": You are a true technophile. You don't just wait for training; you are already experimenting with the latest in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows . 
 AI Visionary: You have a clear passion for how AI is transforming the workforce. You are eager to show customers how Agentforce and autonomous agents can augment human productivity. 
 Continuous Learner: You have a "Growth Mindset." Whether it’s passing a new Salesforce Certification or exploring a new API, you are driven by a natural curiosity to understand the how and why behind the tech. 
 Responsibilities Strategic Sales Partnership: Act as the technical "North Star" for the sales team, aligning technical strategy with business outcomes to close complex deals. 
 Solution Innovation: Develop and deliver innovative custom solutions and demos (including Agentforce and Data Cloud) that address unique business challenges and prove tangible value. 
 Lead the Cycle: Coordinate and lead the entire solution cycle through close collaboration with other high-performing teams (Product, Marketing, Professional Services). 
 Value Communication: Articulate the benefits of Salesforce to audiences at every level—from IT Administrators to C-suite executives—using industry-specific insights. 
 Continuous Growth: Maintain expert-level knowledge of Salesforce products and industry trends to remain effective in a performance-driven environment. 
 Experience & Background We are looking for a diverse range of backgrounds to join our high-performing UKI team. Whether you are a career SE or looking to pivot your technical and business acumen into a pre-sales career, we want to hear from you.
 Core Experience (One or more of the following): 
 Solution Excellence: A proven track record in Solution Engineering (Pre-sales) , technical consulting, or professional services delivery within an enterprise software organization. 
 Strategic Sales & Account Management: Experience in Account Management or Solution Selling , with a focus on navigating complex sales cycles and acting as a strategic partner to sales leadership. 
 SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture. 
 Consultative Mindset: A background in Business Consulting , with the ability to perform deep discovery, identify "pain points," and map them to high-value technology roadmaps. 
 Technical Foundation: A strong Technical Background —this could be a degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience with APIs, data modeling, or software development. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications The Foundations 
 Professional Background: A track record in Solution Engineering, SaaS, Account Management, Management Consulting, or a deep Technical Background . We are open to a variety of backgrounds if you can demonstrate the core proficiencies of the role. 
 Strategic Partnering: Experience acting as a strategic partner to sales or business units, helping to steer the direction of a deal or project. 
 Demonstrated Passion: A visible passion for Technology, Business, and AI . You are curious about the latest trends and eager to learn how they apply to customer success. 
 Problem-Solving: Exceptional ability to find creative, pragmatic solutions to unique and complex business challenges. 
 Key Professional Skills 
 Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage and influence internal and external stakeholders, navigating different interests to reach a common goal. 
 Communication & Presence: Strong oral, written, and presentation skills. You are good at explaining complex ideas and finding ways to keep an audience’s attention. 
 Prioritisation: Strong organizational and time-management skills to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously in a dynamic, fast-paced environment . 
 Experience & Adaptability 
 Industry Insight: Ability to understand business requirements within multiple industries and translate them into a compelling vision and roadmap. 
 Agility: Comfortable working as part of a team to tackle problems in energizing environments and willing to travel occasionally. 
 Preferred Qualifications Salesforce Ecosystem: Existing Salesforce product knowledge and certifications (e.g., AI Associate, Administrator, or Cloud Consultant) are highly preferred. 
 SaaS Mastery: Experience or background in solution selling and the enterprise software landscape. 
 Education: Degree or equivalent proven experience (including extracurricular leadership, military experience, or volunteer roles). 
 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 
 
 
 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: GOGB Brewing Technologist
description:
Job Description : 
 A Fixed-Term Contract (12 Months) 

 About the Function:  
    
 Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

 With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

 It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

 About the role   
      
 The Production Brewer is responsible for supporting the safe, efficient and compliant operation of the Pilot Brewery, delivering brewing and packaging activities that enable beer innovation, renovation and commercialisation programmes. Operating within a 10hl brewery with kegging, canning and bottling capability, the role is accountable for producing high-quality beer liquids and supporting the delivery of approximately 40 new beer developments annually.

 Working closely with the Pilot Plant Manager and Head Brewer, the role leads day-to-day brewing, fermentation and packaging operations while supporting pilot trials, liquid development and scale-up activities. The Production Brewer provides brewing expertise, maintains operational excellence and ensures all activities are performed to the highest standards of safety, quality and compliance.

 Key Accountabilities 

 1. Brewing & Production Operations 
 •Implement all brewing, fermentation, conditioning and filtration activities within the Pilot Brewery.
 •Deliver brewing plans and production schedules in support of innovation and commercialisation priorities.
 •Operate brewing equipment safely and efficiently.
 •Ensure all brewing activities align with quality, food safety and environmental standards.
 •Maintain accurate brewing, process and quality records.
 •Drive continuous improvement in brewing efficiency and operational performance.

 2. Packaging Operations 
 •Operate and oversee pilot packaging activities across keg, can and bottle formats.
 •Ensure packaging trials are completed safely and efficiently.
 •Maintain packaging quality standards and documentation.
 •Support new packaging formats and trial activities where required.
 •Ensure product quality is maintained throughout packaging operations.

 3. Innovation & Commercialisation Support 
 •Produce pilot-scale liquids supporting innovation and renovation programmes.
 •Implement brewing and packaging trials for new products and processes.
 •Support liquid validation and manufacturing readiness activities.
 •Work with Innovation, Quality and Supply teams to facilitate successful scale-up of new products.
 •Provide technical input and operational feedback during project development.

 4. Brewery Asset Care & Technical Support 
 •Support maintenance and care of brewery and packaging equipment.
 •Assist with preventative maintenance and calibration activities.
 •Troubleshoot brewing and packaging issues.
 •Support installation, commissioning and qualification of new equipment.
 •Maintain high housekeeping and GMP standards across the brewery.

 5. Brewing Expertise & Stakeholder Collaboration 
 •Provide brewing expertise and technical support to project teams.
 •Support recipe development, trial execution and process optimisation activities.
 •Build effective working relationships across Brewing, Innovation, Quality and Supply functions.
 •Support brewery tours, demonstrations and visits when required.
 •Maintain awareness of brewing trends, ingredients and technologies.

 Key Competencies 

 Brewing & Packaging Operations 
 Strong practical expertise in brewing processes, fermentation, cellar operations and packaging systems.

 Operational Excellence 
 Delivers brewing and packaging activities safely, efficiently and consistently to the highest quality standards.

 Teamwork & Collaboration 
 Works effectively across functions to support innovation delivery and solve operational challenges.
 Experience/skills required:   
   
 •Qualification in Brewing Science, Food Science, Biological Sciences or related technical field preferred.
 •IBD Certificate or Diploma in Brewing desirable.
 •HACCP and Food Safety training desirable.

 Experience 
 •Experience in brewing or beverage manufacturing operations.
 •Experience operating brewing and/or packaging equipment.
 •Experience working within quality-controlled manufacturing environments.
 •Experience supporting brewing trials, product development or innovation programmes desirable.
 •Knowledge of kegging, canning and bottling operations preferred.

 Functional Competencies 
 •Brewing Operations
 •Fermentation & Cellar Management
 •Packaging Operations
 •Beer Quality Management
 •Brewing Science
 •Product Scale-Up Support
 •Continuous Improvement
 •GMP & Food Safety
 •Asset Care
 •Operational Planning
 •Governance & Compliance
   
 Working with Us   
 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

 We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.     
  
 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.  

 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.  

 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.  
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity!

 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.  
  
    
 Recruitment Scam Warning   
 Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

 St James Gate

 Our client is a long-established multidisciplinary engineering consultancy with extensive experience delivering civil, structural and transportation projects across Ireland and internationally. With a strong reputation across major infrastructure and building projects, they provide design and project management services across a range of sectors, with a particular focus on delivering practical, sustainable and buildable engineering solutions.
 The company has a strong track record in urban infrastructure, active travel and public realm projects, alongside significant experience in data centre and major infrastructure design. They are committed to professional development and provide a collaborative environment where engineers are supported through mentoring, CPD and structured career progression.
 They are now seeking a Civil Engineer to join their team. This role would suit an engineer with a strong interest in urban infrastructure and active travel who enjoys technical problem-solving, working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and contributing to projects that shape the public realm.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Deliver civil engineering design across a range of projects, with a particular focus on active travel and urban infrastructure schemes.
 Work across all project stages, including feasibility, preliminary design, detailed design and construction.
 Design roads, junctions and streetscapes incorporating walking, cycling and public realm improvements.
 Prepare and review drawings, calculations and technical deliverables in accordance with relevant Irish standards and guidance, including DMURS, NTA, TII and TSM.
 Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, including landscape architects and structural engineers, to deliver integrated urban solutions.
 Provide guidance and support to technicians.
 Participate in client, stakeholder and project team meetings.
 Undertake site visits for surveys, inspections and construction support as required.
 Prepare technical reports, specifications and contract documentation.
 Support project planning and programming to ensure deadlines are met.
 Liaise with local authorities, utility providers and other stakeholders throughout the design and approval process.
 Contribute to design reviews, with a focus on safety, accessibility, sustainability and buildability.
 Support quality assurance processes and ensure compliance with internal procedures.
 Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
 Requirements 
 5+ years' experience working on civil engineering projects.
 Degree in Civil Engineering (Level 8 or equivalent).
 Experience delivering civil engineering projects through different design stages.
 Experience within urban infrastructure and/or active travel projects is highly desirable.
 Strong understanding of Irish civil engineering design standards and guidance.
 Proficiency in AutoCAD.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to manage workload effectively and work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
 Strong interest in urban infrastructure, active travel and public realm projects.
 Desirable 
 Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D.
 Progress towards Chartered Engineer status or an interest in pursuing professional accreditation.
 Experience working with local authorities, NTA, TII or other public-sector stakeholders.
 Experience across roads, junctions, active travel or public realm schemes.
 Benefits 
 Competitive salary.
 Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.
 Pension scheme.
 Ongoing CPD and professional development support.
 Mentoring and structured training programmes.
 Professional association membership fees covered.
 Educational assistance support.
 TaxSaver commuter ticket scheme.
 Cycle to Work scheme.
 Regular company events and social activities.
 Opportunity to work on high-profile infrastructure and building projects.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
Join us:
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers — we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world.

Ensure all activities are carried out in a safe and compliant manner
Manage logistics activities and be the point of contact for reverse logistics activities
Ensure all data and documents are accurate and up to date in our ERP
Assist with logistics and recycling providers queries
Ensure our inventory and savings targets are met through proactive initiatives

Experience in admin logistics, warehousing, or 3PL environment
Experience with SAP and/or WMS
Experience with Reverse logistics / Recycling
Experience with ESG compliance
Able to work in a fast paced, multitask environment

Real opportunities for career growth through learning, development and internal progression

We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people’s lives and the world around us.
Through our technology, we empower people — connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live — and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.
Belonging at Vodafone isn’t a concept; it’s lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You’ll be part of a global and diverse community with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures.
We’re committed to increasing diversity, ensuring equal representation, and making Vodafone a place where everyone feels safe, valued and included.

 You will have previous experience working within a busy finance or accounts department, ideally within the education, public or not-for-profit sector. You will have strong experience across transactional finance, reconciliations and general financial administration.

 An accounting technician qualification, finance-related qualification or relevant practical experience would be advantageous.

 What you'll get in return 

You will receive the opportunity to join a respected organisation within the education sector on a 6-month contract, gaining valuable experience in a varied Finance Officer position. The role will provide broad exposure across finance operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, reporting, budgeting and audit support. You will work as part of an experienced finance team in a professional and supportive environment.

 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

description:

Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Senior Payroll Specialist – EMEA & APAC

📍Location: Dublin, Ireland | Hybrid (3 days per week in office)

 

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist to join our Global Payroll team and help deliver accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll across our growing international footprint.This role will have  primary responsibility for UK & Ireland payroll, while supporting additional EMEA and APAC countries through our global partners. Beyond day-to-day payroll delivery, we're looking for someone who brings strong payroll expertise, takes ownership, proactively identifies risks, and enjoys finding better ways of working.

You'll work closely with our International Payroll Lead and cross-functional partners to strengthen payroll controls, standardize processes, and support automation initiatives as we continue to scale our global operations.

 

What You’ll Do

Payroll Operations & Compliance

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing for the UK and Ireland, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.
  • Support payroll review and coordination across additional countries, including France, Germany, Switzerland, Singapore, and Australia, as assigned.
  • Review payroll inputs, calculations, variances, and final outputs to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Partner with CloudPay and local payroll providers to resolve discrepancies and manage payroll-related issues.
  • Support statutory reporting, tax compliance, and month-end and year-end payroll requirements.

Controls & Operational Excellence

  • Perform payroll reconciliations, validation checks, and documented controls.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and audit-ready documentation.
  • Develop and maintain payroll SOPs, calendars, checklists, and country-specific process documentation.
  • Identify payroll risks, raise concerns proactively, and recommend solutions.
  • Support cross-training and backup coverage to ensure business continuity.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to simplify manual processes and improve payroll accuracy and efficiency.
  • Support automation initiatives using Workday, CloudPay, AI, and other available tools.
  • Help standardize payroll processes and controls across countries.
  • Participate in system enhancements, integrations, testing, and payroll-related projects.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with People Operations, Benefits, People Tech, Finance, and other internal partners.
  • Provide clear and timely communication on payroll matters, deadlines, risks, and resolutions.
  • Partner with the International Payroll Lead to support operational priorities and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing and process improvements.
  •  

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive payroll experience, ideally within a multinational organization.
  • Strong hands-on UK and Ireland payroll experience is essential.
  • Experience managing payroll across multiple countries and working with third-party payroll providers.
  • Strong understanding of payroll compliance, statutory reporting, reconciliations, and controls.
  • Experience with Workday and CloudPay or comparable HRIS and global payroll platforms.
  • Ability to independently manage payroll deadlines, investigate discrepancies, and resolve complex payroll issues.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance competing priorities.
  • Proactive mindset with a focus on process improvements and operational efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and regions.
  • Comfortable working in a changing environment and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Nice to Have

  • Payroll experience in France, Germany, Switzerland, Singapore, or Australia.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, integrations, or transformation projects.
  • Experience developing payroll SOPs, controls, and standardized processes.
  • Familiarity with automation, AI tools, or data analytics within payroll operations.
  • Experience supporting internal or external payroll audits.

Why Join

  • Be part of a growing Global Payroll team supporting an expanding international business.
  • Take ownership of key international payroll operations while working alongside experienced payroll professionals.
  • Help shape how we improve and scale our global payroll processes.
  • Work with modern payroll technology and contribute to automation and innovation.
  • Build your expertise across multiple countries and develop your career within a collaborative global team.

title: Red Team Engineer
description:
As a member of the Red Team within the Global Cyber Security group, the Red Team Engineer will serve as a core technical contributor for adversary‑emulation, threat‑informed security testing, and controlled offensive security operations. The engineer will execute activities in accordance with State Street’s standards and procedures, risk‑acceptance, and regulatory expectations, ensuring all work is conducted within approved environments, scopes, and authorization pathways.
 
 The Red Team Engineer will conduct comprehensive, intelligence‑driven assessments of enterprise applications, critical infrastructure components, and associated operational and technical security controls. These assessments evaluate not only the security posture of targeted systems but also the effectiveness of the organization’s detection, prevention, response, and governance capabilities.
 
 The Red Team Engineer will collaborate with technical experts across applications, platforms, and infrastructure, security leadership, and process stakeholders, threat intelligence and defensive analytics teams, security operations personnel, and business system owners to ensure testing scenarios reflect realistic adversary behaviors and enterprise risks. The role requires strong technical expertise and broad knowledge of core security control domains, including identity and access management, data protection, secure software development, cloud and infrastructure security, endpoint and detection technologies, network security, and enterprise vulnerability and threat management. Familiarity with security monitoring, detection engineering, and incident response processes further supports the evaluation of organizational defenses.
 
 What you will be responsible for
 Execute authorized adversary‑emulation activities to assess defenses, security controls, and organizational resilience.
 Perform targeted security assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and enterprise technologies.
 Collaborate with cybersecurity, technology, and risk stakeholders to develop realistic, threat‑informed testing scenarios.
 Evaluate detection and response capabilities and support improvement through coordinated purple‑team activities.
 Operate within defined approval processes, scopes, authorization boundaries, and safe‑testing protocols.
 Develop or adapt tools and techniques to support realistic testing, ensuring secure and compliant usage.
 Produce clear, audit‑ready reporting and support remediation to reduce identified risks and strengthen defenses.
 
 What we value
 Strong proficiency in offensive security techniques, including infrastructure, application, and cloud‑focused penetration testing.
 Deep understanding of adversary behaviors and attack frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK) to inform realistic testing scenarios.
 Familiarity with modern security tooling, assessment utilities, and red‑team‑oriented testing methodologies.
 Ability to develop or adapt scripts and tools using common scripting languages.
 Broad technical knowledge across networks, operating systems, identity systems, cloud services, and security controls.
 Demonstrated analytical ability to identify core issues, interpret risk, and propose practical, evidence‑driven solutions.
 Strong organizational, time‑management, and prioritization skills in dynamic and high‑pressure environments.
 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
 Commitment to maintaining awareness of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and offensive security trends.
 High attention to detail and consistent delivery of accurate, high‑quality work.
 Clear and professional communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
 Proven ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and operate with discretion and professionalism.
 
 Experience Desired
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent hands‑on security experience.
 2–4 years in penetration testing or red‑team activities.
 Broad experience with networks, operating systems, cloud, and security controls.
 Familiarity with threat‑informed testing and attack frameworks.
 Experience collaborating with defensive teams to validate detections.
 Ability to script or automate tasks using common languages.
 Strong reporting and communication skills across technical audiences.
 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
 
 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
 
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Some employers use assessment centres and recruitment assessments to select candidates beyond the application form and interview. They are designed to evaluate how you apply your skills, solve problems, communicate and work with others in situations similar to those you may encounter in the workplace. Assessment centres may take place in person or online and can last anywhere from a few hours to a full day. Assessment centres give employers multiple opportunities to see your skills in action and are often considered a fairer assessment method than an interview alone.
Remember, employers are usually assessing you across a range of activities, so one exercise is unlikely to determine the final outcome.
What Employers Are Looking For
Assessment centres are designed to evaluate a range of skills and competencies, including:
Communication
Teamwork
Problem-solving
Leadership potential
Decision-making
Analytical thinking
Organisation and time management
Commercial awareness
Adaptability and resilience
Employers are not looking for perfection. They want to see how you approach challenges, interact with others and demonstrate your potential.
Remember
You are usually being assessed against the employer's criteria, not against the other candidates. Focus on demonstrating your own skills and making a positive contribution.
Types of Activities
A typical assessment centre may include Introductions, group exercises, case studies, presentations, recruitment tests and interviews. The format varies between employers.
Group Exercises
Work with other candidates to solve a problem, discuss a case study or complete a task. Employers are assessing how you communicate, collaborate and contribute to achieving a shared objective.
Case Studies
You may be asked to analyse information, identify key issues and make recommendations. These exercises assess your analytical thinking, judgement and ability to work under pressure.
Presentations
You may be given a topic in advance or asked to prepare a short presentation on the day. Employers are often assessing your communication skills, confidence and ability to organise information clearly.
In-Tray or E-Tray Exercises
These activities simulate a busy workplace and require you to prioritise tasks, respond to emails and make decisions based on available information.
Many assessment centres include a further interview, which may focus on your skills, strengths, motivation and suitability for the role.
Recruitment Tests
Assessment centres often include aptitude, ability or personality tests as part of the overall selection process.
What Are Psychometric Tests?
Psychometric tests are widely used by employers to assess your abilities, behaviours and workplace preferences. They provide employers with additional information about your potential and suitability for a role.
Many graduate employers use psychometric testing as part of their recruitment process, often before an interview or assessment centre.
Aptitude Tests
These measure your ability to process information and solve problems under timed conditions.
Examples include:
Numerical reasoning
Verbal reasoning
Logical reasoning
Diagrammatic reasoning
Abstract reasoning
Data interpretation
Situational Judgement Tests (SJTs)
You are presented with workplace scenarios and asked how you would respond.
These tests assess areas such as:
Decision making
Professional judgement
Customer focus
There may not be one perfect answer. Employers are usually assessing how closely your judgement aligns with their workplace expectations.
Personality Questionnaires
These questionnaires explore your preferred ways of working, interacting and communicating.
There are no right or wrong answers.
Top tip: Answer honestly. Trying to guess the 'correct' response often creates inconsistent results.
Practice Resources
Many employers will share links to practice tests and assessment tools with you in advance, so make sure you use them. You can also use free practice assessments tools and tests on our Profiling for Success platform.
Preparation & Success Tips
Know your application, the role and the organisation.
Practise tests and assessment exercises.
Be professional, positive and authentic.
Listen, contribute and support others.
Manage your time and stay focused.
If one exercise does not go well, move on and focus on the next.
Assessment centres evaluate your skills across multiple activities, not just one task.

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid 
 
 The Regulatory Affairs Specialist works closely under direct supervision to learn and develop the regulatory skills required to bring medical devices to market and ensure ongoing compliance. Participate on cross-functional teams, develop global regulatory strategies, author regulatory submissions, interact with regulatory agencies/notified bodies, review labeling and marketing materials, and evaluate proposed device changes.
 
 General Responsibilities: 
• Work with supervision, conferring with more senior staff when indicated. Keep supervisor regularly apprised of project status.
• Participate in New Product Development Teams throughout all phases to ensure US, EU, and other international regulatory requirements are incorporated as part of the development process.
• Evaluate medical device regulations and develop strategies for bringing products to market.
• Contribute towards obtaining US and EU regulatory approvals by authoring, compiling, and submitting premarket regulatory applications.
• Partner with global regulatory affiliates and leverage Reconstructive product expertise to provide submission documentation for expedited international market access and sustaining support.
• Assess global impact of changes to launched products and support notifications/submissions as required.
• Review labeling and marketing literature for compliance with regulatory requirements.
 
 Additional tasks may include: 
• Determining and communicating submission and approval requirements
• Compiling, preparing, reviewing and submitting regulatory dossiers to authorities
 • Interfacing and coordinating directly with FDA, Notified Body reviewers, and other regulatory agencies on submissions, approvals or other issues.
• Reviewing and approving change documentation for regulatory impact on launched products.
• Providing regulatory input for and appropriate follow-up to inspections and audits
• Reviewing and approving labeling, advertising and promotional items for compliance before release
• Assisting in the development, implementation, and maintenance of regulatory procedures to ensure ongoing compliance of new and existing products.
• Providing regulatory input for NCs.
• Preparing and updating US product registrations and listings
• Assisting in the establishment and maintenance of regulatory information systems both electronically and hard copy.
• Participating in process improvement activities and projects.
• Assisting in complex projects and performing delegated tasks as required.
 • Assisting with product post-market or clearance requirements (progress reports, annual reports etc.)
• Assessing the acceptability of quality, preclinical and clinical documentation for submission to comply with regulatory requirements
• Identifying issues early in the submission preparation process that could impact product launch
• Communicating and negotiating with regulatory authorities and stakeholders under supervision of more experienced RA team-members.
• Ensuring project team(s) and RA management remain informed regarding all regulatory agency/Notified Body correspondence.
 
 Minimum Requirements: 
 Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering, Science, or equivalent field
 1-2 years in a Regulatory Affairs role
 
 #IJ
   
  
 Ireland Pay Ranges: Ireland : €42,000 - €71,000 EUR Annual
 
   
  
 At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.
  
 If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.

description:
Press & Media
Coverage
← Back
​Recruiter
May 1, 2013
View Original Article
Jobs Watch: Tech roles in Eire with Merchant Warehouse and Squarespace
Two technology firms – payment technology and merchant services provider Merchant Warehouse, and online publishing platform Squarespace – are to take on staff in their new international offices in Northern Ireland and the Irish Republic respectively.
Merchant Warehouse
A total of 70 staff in various development and support roles will be hired in the company’s new Belfast office over the next three years.
The US company’s other base is its Boston headquarters.
The base, known as Merchant Warehouse NI [Northern Ireland], was established with the help of investment agency Invest Northern Ireland.
Squarespace
All-in-one website publishing platform Squarespace is to create EMEA headquarters in Dublin with the creation of 100 jobs.
The new roles will be a variety of customer care jobs.
Supported by Irish government agency IDA Ireland, this is also Squarespace’s first office in addition to its headquarters, which are in New York.
Irish Taoiseach [prime minister] Enda Kenny says the move “is a signal of Ireland's growing reputation as the internet capital of Europe”.
