Job Title:
Associate Corporate Counsel - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract
Posting Start Date:
9/8/26
Job Description:
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business — to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional as Interim Associate Corporate Counsel on a 12 month fixed term contract reporting to a Senior Manager.
Your responsibilities include:
Client servicing through means of an in-depth knowledge of client files, client communication and internal procedures:
Draft/review of legal documentation in terms of incorporation of companies, day-to-day operations, liquidation
Monitor the various steps of the transactions, ensure adherence at all times with Luxembourg law as well as internal Vistra processes
Debt collection of outstanding Vistra invoices
Coordinate with central operations team to resolve issues concerning taxes, administration and banking of client companies
Detect possible corporate and tax issues
Handle client requests regarding transactions/statutory and outflow
Work in close collaboration with team members, law firms, auditors, tax advisors and other relevant parties
Organise the preparation shareholder and board meetings together with the Accountants and Corporate Secretarial Assistants
Maintain communication with clients, including the planning of the Corporate Calendar
Monitor completeness of client files
Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of Luxembourg market/regulations (legal, tax, accounting, reporting, market developments)
Take up directorship mandates in client's companies, if requested
Take up client payroll, if requested
Collect KYC documentation (as required)
Record the working hours/client in the time billing system according to the objectives set
Relevant experience:
Law, Economics and / or Tax degree
Strong knowledge of Luxembourg regulation
Minimum of 1 year of experience with a professional services firm
Strong communication skills
Ability to solve problems, work independently and as a member of a team
Company Benefits:
At our Vistra Luxembourg office, we believe in putting our employees' well-being first! We have a challenging position in an ambitious organization where no day is the same. A company with a view to the future where you can grow together with and, above all, put your own stamp on.
In addition, we offer:
Vistra Bonus Plan, based on Vistra Group performance and individual performance
232 hours of holidays (29 days), plus public holidays;
Lunch vouchers for the amount of 10.80 EUR (18 per month);
Remote and adaptive work arrangement (maximum 3 days per week work from home and minimum 2 days per week work from the office after the adaptation period)
Regular social events
Free coffee, tea and fresh fruits in our office
Vistra supports employees' charitable efforts by encouraging engagement in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives and projects to improve our impact as a company.
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

title: General Operative
description:
As an Abattoir General Operative in Kepak Kilbeggan , you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth running of daily operations to keep up with customer demand for our top - quality products. You will be a vital part of our team on the factory floor, working alongside other skilled operatives to achieve our goals.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Perform prestart, hygiene and safety checks as instructed
 Ensure product is of the highest standard, reporting any issues to the Line Supervisor
 Comply with Company's knife and Health and Safety rules, including hygiene requirements
 Operate knives and machinery with precision and care, ensuring all equipment is handled safely and efficiently. 
 Participate in Lean Manufacturing processes and embrace new methods of working
 
 What do we need from you? 
 As part of the factory's abattoir team, the successful candidate will produce cuts and trims of meat according to Kepak specifications, maintaining efficiency at the line speed.
 This role involves meeting production targets in a fast - paced environment while ensuring standards are met
 Requirements 
 Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
 Strong character: hardworking, self-motivated and dependable
 Consistently meet production targets while maintaining the required line speed
 Comfortable performing physical tasks, including lifting and standing for long periods
 Operate machinery safety once full training has been provided 
 Previous experience in an abattoir is an advantage but not required 
 Comfortable with the physical nature of the rol, including lifting and standing for extended periods
 Willingness to learn, take direction, and support additional tasks as required by the line supervisor
 Commitment to safety, following all site guidelines and procedures 
 Benefits 
 Company Pension
 Bike to Work Scheme
 Full training provided for all roles
 Long Service Awards
 Subsidised canteen onsite
 Free on-site parking

Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you will be required to undergo DV (Developed Vetting) level Security Clearance ( https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels) . An allowance of £5k per annum may be payable monthly while you hold this DV and continue to work in a role that requires that level of security clearance. The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.
Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses.   We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.
About the role
You'll be joining a specialist team within Business that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities.
Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities, and your contribution is always valued.
This role requires DV Clearance and will be onsite 5 days a week in London, Manchester, Ipswich or Cheltenham.
What you’ll be doing
Technically oversee Service Delivery Engineers, ensuring compliance with operational standards, electrical safety regulations, and customer service level agreements (SLAs).
Develop, maintain, and enhance the technical competency framework of the engineering team to support enterprise-scale power generation, distribution, HVAC, and critical infrastructure projects.
Deliver structured technical mentoring, competency assessments, and on-the-job training to engineers and apprentices, promoting continuous professional development and knowledge transfer.
Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of departmental policies, procedures, and engineering best practices in line with company and industry standards.
Ensure operational risks, safety incidents, compliance breaches, and technical errors are proactively managed, investigated, and reduced through robust governance and quality assurance processes.
Maintain accountability for the accurate planning, execution, documentation, and delivery of engineering activities, ensuring all work is completed to the required technical, commercial, and regulatory standards.
Champion a strong safety culture by implementing Health, Safety, Environmental, and Quality (HSEQ) policies, conducting risk assessments, reviewing Safe Systems of Work (SSoW), and driving corrective and preventive action plans.
Collaborate with Resource Management and Project Delivery teams to optimise workforce utilisation, ensuring engineering resources are allocated effectively and projects are delivered within agreed timescales, budgets, and performance targets.
Essential Skills / Experience
Ability to lead and develop a high-performing engineering team through coaching, support, and clear direction.
Builds strong relationships, fostering collaboration, accountability, and a positive team culture.
Uses technical knowledge and experience to guide decision-making and solve complex challenges.
Prioritises team development by identifying skills gaps and creating growth opportunities.
Communicates effectively with stakeholders while ensuring safe, efficient, and customer-focused delivery.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Recognised electrical or power engineering qualification (HNC/HND, NVQ Level 3, City & Guilds, or equivalent).
Current 18th Edition IET Wiring Regulations qualification (BS 7671).
Demonstrable experience in temporary power, power generation, electrical distribution systems and critical power infrastructure.
Strong understanding of electrical safety legislation, including Electricity at Work Regulations and safe isolation procedures.
Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams in a service delivery or operational environment.

Job Description – MCS Specialist (Management & Corporate Services Specialist)
Position Title: MCS Specialist
Department: Corporate Services / Legal & Corporate Secretarial

The MCS Specialist is responsible for providing corporate administration, governance, and company secretarial support to legal entities within the organization. Key Responsibilities
Corporate Governance & Company Secretarial

Organize and coordinate board meetings, shareholder meetings, and written resolutions.
Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and other corporate documentation.
Support directors, officers, and shareholders with governance-related requirements.

Entity Management

Coordinate filings and registrations with local authorities – trade license office, UBO, Commercial register, etc.

title: General Operative
description:
#INDATW 
 This position is based at our Athleague site, in Co. Roscommon. 
 Working as part of the operations team in the factory, undertaking all duties as directed by their manager/supervisor. Play a key role in production, storage, cleaning, Health & Safety and all other tasks as directed by management. This role will involve working to challenging production targets and therefore can be stressful. The role may also involve in working for extended periods of time in cold/chilled areas.
 Reports to:
Line Supervisor
 Key Responsibilities:
 Work in the production area conducting a wide variety of tasks, such as line operation, packing, cleaning, distribution etc. Lift weights of at least 15kgs, stand for 4+ hours and be able to move around the factory floor without assistance. Must be able to work for extended periods in a cold environment.
 Be familiar with the daily production plan and work as part of the team to set up the line, complete checks and ensuring materials are ready to use. Perform all pre start, hygiene and safety checks as directed.
 Report all breakages, damages or defaults of equipment to the Line Supervisor, ensuring all machinery is only used when it is safe to use. Record checks as and when directed.
 Ensure that the product is of the highest standard and report any issues to the Line supervisor immediately.
 Co-operate with all company training, asking questions and ensuring they feel satisfied in relation to all aspects of the area and role they are working in
 Reporting any accidents or near misses is expected and assistance with any investigation is a prerequisite of the Company’s safety policy.
 Participate fully in Lean Manufacturing processes and embrace new methods of working.
 Other duties will be part of the role from time to time – this will be specified by your direct line Supervisor.
 

 Requirements 
 Skills / Experience:
 Previous production experience highly beneficial
 Previous experience working in a manufacturing environment highly beneficial
 Each employee must be in a state of health such as would indicate a reasonable prospect of ability to render regular and efficient service.
 Each candidate must be of good character. Employment of the successful candidate shall be subject to satisfactory confidential reports.
 Benefits 
 €10.50 per hour start wage with possibility of production bonus after 1 month
 Training
 Subsidised canteen
 Access to Pension Scheme and Private Healthcare
 Free staff car parking
 Onsite health and wellness services
 Bike to work scheme
 Formal recognition initiatives and team awards in place
 A dedicated learning & development team

Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
ServiceNow is the fastest growing enterprise cloud software company in the world, and we believe it’s the great people we hire who will keep us there. We hire carefully, we hire the best, we celebrate our people. Come join our Sales A-team.
ServiceNow is currently seeking a highly driven Inside Sales Representative to join our expanding Inside Sales team. The Sr. Inside Sales Representative will be responsible for strategically prospecting into new accounts, expanding usage within existing customer base, and ensuring these customers continue to get value from the NOW Platform. The candidate will be an individual with a demonstrable track record in new business pipeline generation ideally over the telephone within an Enterprise capacity.  They will collaborate with their team of Sales Specialists, Solution Consultants, Renewal Sales and more to exceed quota and build the future of ServiceNow sales talent.
What you get to do in this role:
Meet or exceed Monthly, Quarterly and Annual sales objectives.
Manage sales opportunities and business relationships over the telephone with influential contacts within Small, Mid-Market, and Commercial  Accounts.

Job Description 
 
 An amazing opportunity has arisen for a Quality Operations Specialist , at our newest state-of-the-art, fully integrated vaccine facility in Dundalk.
 
 This role provides direct quality support and oversight to manufacturing operations as part of an integrated cross-functional team. With guidance from the Associate Director of Quality Operations, the Quality Specialist ensures the quality and compliance of products manufactured on site, adherence to Good Manufacturing and Documentation Practices, and represents quality directly on the shop floor across Drug Product and Drug Substance GMP manufacturing.
 
 What you will do: 
 Bring energy, knowledge, innovation, and leadership to carry out the following: 
 Responsible for the review and approval of new and updated Master Batch Records and Electronic Batch Records.
 Review and approve production documentation, such as executed electronic batch records and logbooks, to ensure accuracy and compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practice and company procedures.
 Maintain an active presence on the shop floor to support compliance, data integrity, and right-first-time manufacturing.
 Review and approve new and updated Standard Operating Procedures, work instructions, and controlled job aides.
 Actively participate in the site Tier process, using this forum to make quality matters visible and to partner with operational areas on swift resolution.
 Provide Quality Assurance support, review, and approval of Commissioning and Qualification lifecycle documents for capital projects and new equipment.
 Serve as the Quality Subject Matter Expert for Performance Qualification activities across the site, including equipment, clean utilities, facility qualification studies, Cleaning Validation, Sterilise-in-Place, and process validation.
 Participate as an active, collaborative quality partner on site cross-functional projects.
 Support sustaining activities such as change control management, deviation investigations, Corrective and Preventive Actions, equipment requalification, periodic reviews, and the site maintenance and calibration programme.
 Provide direct support to internal audits and external regulatory inspections, fostering ongoing inspection readiness.
 Collaborate with cross-functional team members in the identification and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives and action plans.
 Drive continuous improvement and utilise structured problem-solving tools to enhance operational efficiency, resolve issues, and promote a proactive quality culture.
 
 What skills you will need: 
 In order to excel in this role, you will more than likely have:
 Required 
 Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or engineering field (such as Biotechnology, Microbiology, or related Life Sciences).
 Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a regulated Good Manufacturing Practice manufacturing, Quality Assurance, or laboratory environment.
 Practical working knowledge in the biopharmaceutical or vaccine industry, specifically within Quality Assurance operations.
 Strong interpersonal skills, including flexibility, empathy, collaboration, and the proven ability to thrive in an inclusive team environment.
 
 Preferred 
 Experience with Quality Management Systems, pharmaceutical manufacturing or laboratory processes, and authoring and approving Good Manufacturing Practice documents. Advantage if participated to the implementation, deployment of QMS.  
 Demonstrated analytical aptitude, critical thinking skills, and practical problem-solving capabilities.
 Demonstrated leadership qualities with strong, constructive oral and written communication abilities.
 Bioprocessing knowledge, aseptic manufacturing experience, or technical transfer familiarity.
 
 As a cutting-edge, state-of-the-art vaccines facility spanning over 15,500 square metres across three stories, our Dundalk site will focus on qualification, continued product development and expanding its capabilities within our network. Featuring drug substance manufacturing, drug product manufacturing and quality control labs that will support the global supply of vaccine products - strengthening our ability to make an impact on people and patients worldwide by adding new capabilities to our already industry-leading network.   
 
 Our Companies in Ireland is one of the country’s leading healthcare companies, having first established here 50 years ago. The company has a dynamic and inclusive team of over 4,000 employees currently working across eight locations in Ballydine, Co. Tipperary, Brinny, Co. Cork, Dunboyne, Co. Meath, Dundalk, Co. Louth, Carlow and Dublin, and, in addition, operate substantial Human Health and Animal Health businesses. W e work at the forefront of science and technology to advance manufacturing excellence and R&D across our Irish sites and global company network.

title: PQV Combination Product Analyst IV
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
Quality 
 
 Job Sub Function: 
Quality Assurance 
 
 Job Category: 
Professional 
 
 All Job Posting Locations: 
Beerse, Antwerp, Belgium, Ringaskiddy, Cork, Ireland, Schaffhausen, Switzerland 
 
 Job Description: 
 The PQV Combination Product Analyst 4 will be responsible for handling high-volume E2E product quality complaint activities and adverse events, including performing Medical Device Reporting (MDR) assessments. Additionally, the Analyst IV Combination Products will provide instruction and feedback to the group as needed and ensure completeness and consistency of complaint and MDR documentation. The position manages and collaborates with business partners and stakeholders (Out Sourced Management Team, Clinical, PV, IT, Local Operating Companies, ESIQ, Call Centers, Brand Protection, External Manufacturing Sites, Internal/External Manufacturing Sites, QA, Business Quality, Medical Safety and R&D) to deliver effective change management, drive process improvements and identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency and timeliness of the complaint and MDR processes.

 This may include risk assessing the impact of proposed changes to the complaint handling/MDR process within and across functional/regional areas and supporting the global change management effectively. The Analyst IV must have the ability to lead projects and communicate effectively with all levels of management as part of stakeholder engagement and change management roll out.

 Position duties & responsibilities: Perform high-volume end-to-end complaint handling activities, including, but not limited to: Intake, triage and review of the event reported, determination of MDR reportability, recovery of field samples for evaluation, determination of Priority/Non-Priority, and QP notification to LOC. Additional activities include due diligence to be performed with the complainant/intake centers/LOC, trend analysis, defect coding, risk criticality assessment, ensuring accurate/holistic investigation, and review and closure.
 Evaluate complaints to determine if the QTL’s or ULC’s have been exceeded, assess the level of investigation required, and assign to the applicable site for investigation.
 Governance and oversight for daily thru put of complaints and MDR decisions to ensure prioritization and KPI are met.
 Perform MDR evaluations and document written justification to support reportable and non-reportable regulatory decisions.
 Monitor complaints for new malfunction events that may require inclusion in the malfunction description list (MDL).
 Serve as a PQV point person for post market and complaint handling regulatory/MDR questions and inquiries; provides guidance and direction to subordinate Analyst roles and other PQV functions.
 Evaluate information from a technical perspective to ensure appropriate analysis and investigations/ MDR’s are accurately assessed for risk prioritization and performed per procedures, standards, and regulations.
 Back-up Product Quality Vigilance Investigation Support (PQVIS) personnel to support increased volume of complaints.
 Strong collaboration with Global Medical Safety, manufacturing sites, and LOC/BQ for effective complaint handling/MDR assessments and adverse events with potential product quality issues.
 Use technical and product knowledge to provide accurate feedback for escalation/awareness of issues and for current product enhancements/future product development, if applicable.
 Ensure that uniform and timely management of complaint records and regulatory reporting occurs per procedures, standards, and regulations.
 Compile and analyze data, metrics, and trends associated with the complaint handling processes.
 Support internal and external audits and inspections; ability to communicate regulatory and process positions as an SME during regulatory inspections and provide follow-up support as required.
 May interact with regulatory authorities, other J&J operating companies, and J&J global councils to interpret and influence emerging quality systems regulatory trends.
 Provide product workflow leadership to PQV peers to ensure consistent and fully understood End-to-End complaint management process.
 Oversee the PQC complaint monitoring process and analyze the outcome of complaint monitoring.
 For compliance risk events, coordinate and lead the root cause identification, ensuring effective corrective actions for mitigations are captured within QMS documentation (eg CAPA/QI).
 Coordinate and lead the process mapping and change for the development, revision, and/or maintenance of applicable department SOP’s, job aids, and WI’s.
 Works independently, challenges the status quo, identifies gaps, and drives process improvements using Process Excellence tools. Participates and/or leads special projects.
 Executes statistical/data-driven processes and documentation to support controlled risk management and decision making. Exhibits strong ability to collaborate and influence Business Partners to ensure appropriate complaint handling and improved complaint management processes.
 Leads remediation activities and generates the write up and execution of protocols documenting results and report approvals.
 Participates and/or leads special projects. Develop and deliver appropriate training (i.e. process, complaint handling, regulatory reporting) to complaint management system end users.
 Facilitate, lead and collaborate with PQV Reporting and Surveillance on New Product Introduction Processes.
 Interaction with IT partners and application vendors as required.
 
 Professional experience requirements: 5+ years of related experience including Quality Assurance and/or Quality Control, including experience working in pharmaceutical and/or Medical Device or other related highly regulated industry
 Knowledge of medical safety environment and regulation
 Possesses strong organization skills supporting the ability to prioritize and manage workload and meet performance expectations.
 Strong knowledge of analytical, process mapping, investigation root cause and risk assessment tools
 Global mindset and demonstrated ability to lead change initiatives, project management and develop strong relationships
 Working knowledge of and experience with the following regulatory requirements: 21 CFR parts 4, 820, 803, 806, 210, 211, 314, ICH Q10, GDP, GMP, GVP, ISO 13485:2003, ISO 14971:2007/2012, MEDEV 2.12, CMDR and the Medical Device Directive 93/42/EEC
 
 Educational requirements: Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree (preferred) in technical, scientific, or engineering disciplines required. Biomedical Engineer, Registered Nurse, Physician Assistant or similar healthcare provider/science license/certification/degree preferred.
 Other requirements: Location of Role: EMEA
 Travel Requirements: This position may require up to 5-10% travel domestically and internationally.

 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
Business Alignment, Business Savvy, Coaching, Communication, Compliance Management, Continuous Improvement, Fact-Based Decision Making, Human-Centered Design, ISO 9001, Issue Escalation, Problem Solving, Quality Control (QC), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Quality Standards, Regulatory Environment, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)   
  
 The anticipated base pay range for this position is: 
€63’300.00 - €101’315.00  
  
 Benefits: 
 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers. 
  
 *This is for informative purposes only. Amounts and actual benefits may vary by location and are subject to change.

title: Platform Engineer II
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Platform Engineer II 
Platform Engineer II, Generative AI & Copilot Platforms

Overview
The Enterprise Operations team is seeking a Platform Engineer II to help scale and support Mastercard's Generative AI and Copilot platform capabilities. This role will contribute to the engineering, support, governance, and adoption of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and related AI platform services.
The successful candidate will combine technical engineering skills with a customer-focused mindset to support internal developers, maintain platform documentation, develop reusable solutions, and help drive enterprise AI adoption.

Key Responsibilities
AI Platform Engineering
• Build, test, and maintain solutions that support enterprise AI and Copilot initiatives.
• Contribute to platform integrations, automation, and reusable engineering components.
• Assist in the development of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, connectors, and proof-of-concept solutions.
• Follow engineering best practices for security, reliability, testing, and operational readiness. 12

Copilot Studio Support & Operations
• Support internal developers building solutions with Copilot Studio and related Microsoft technologies.
• Troubleshoot platform issues and assist users with technical questions and implementation guidance.
• Partner with engineering and product teams to improve the developer experience and platform reliability. 13

Knowledge Management
• Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, troubleshooting resources, and support content.
• Ensure platform knowledge repositories remain accurate, current, and easy to consume.
• Identify opportunities to improve self-service support and reduce repetitive support requests. 1

Developer Enablement
• Deliver training sessions, demonstrations, and technical enablement content.
• Create learning materials and reference assets that help developers successfully adopt platform capabilities.
• Support internal communities of practice and developer engagement activities. 13

Qualifications
Required
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
• 2-5 years of experience in platform engineering, software engineering, automation, or related technical roles.
• Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, automation, or application integrations.
• Experience troubleshooting technical issues and supporting users or development teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively in a collaborative environment.
Preferred
• Experience with Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio.
• Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI, or Generative AI technologies.
• Experience developing integrations, connectors, or automation solutions.
• Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
• Experience creating technical documentation, training content, or developer enablement resources. 12
Success Measures
Successful candidates will:
• Improve the experience of developers building on AI and Copilot platforms.
• Contribute reusable engineering solutions that accelerate platform adoption.
• Maintain high-quality documentation and support resources.
• Help scale AI capabilities through training, automation, and self-service experiences.
• Support secure and reliable operation of enterprise AI platforms. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: TIPM, Network Delivery, Data Center Capacity Delivery
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. 

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Brick and Network Deployment (BaND) team is searching for a passionate and talented Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to help bring next-generation network hardware to hundreds of AWS data centers worldwide. In this role, you will drive programs across partner teams to strategically plan, develop, and execute the deployment of new hardware technologies into the AWS Network at massive scale. You will work directly with Networking and Infrastructure leadership to define requirements, shape timelines, and drive alignment across organizations. A critical part of this role is the ability to take technically complex problems and distill them into clear, business-level narratives that enable leaders to make informed decisions. The Reserving Actuary will be a key member of the Non-Life Reserving Operations team, supporting the delivery, enhancement, and automation of reserving processes across the global Non-Life business.
The role combines traditional actuarial reserving responsibilities with a strong focus on operational excellence, data processes, platform management, and process automation. The successful candidate will contribute to reserving analyses, quarter-close activities, data validation, and the ongoing development of tools and workflows that support actuarial reserving.

title: Structural BIM Designer, Data Centre Design Services
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As part of this role you will be a part of highly creative and efficient CSA BIM team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in designing, constructing, and operating Amazon owned Data Center facilities globally.

Key job responsibilities
Daily responsibilities will include designing the Structural systems for our data centers, utilizing Revit to create and maintain BIM models. You must be able to work independently with occasional guidance, and work within a team environment to accomplish assigned tasks. This includes working with internal groups, as well as external suppliers, consultants, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Your duties will include:

Being self-motivated to work within the BIM Designer group and across other teams.
Preparing and developing detailed Structural Revit models.
Developing and publishing construction documentation for Structural building system designs in a fast-paced environment to meet scheduled deliverables.
Creating and maintaining regional and global libraries, including Revit Families, Details, and Detail Components.
Updating and modifying existing models, studies, and construction documents, as required.
Assisting the creation and maintenance of BIM templates and enforcing BIM standards.
Participating in design coordination meetings with other trades for clash detection and resolution.
Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographic locations.
Assisting information exchange processes between internal and external customers in a Common Data Environment (CDE).
Recording and reporting key metrics to management.
Traveling to data center sites for engineering evaluations and surveys, as required. On average: once or twice a year.
Being positive and always offering creative, out-of-the-box solutions.
Having fun and working hard!

A day in the life
Our BIM Designers create / maintain AWS ACS templates. They partner with consultants on projects, guiding and overseeing processes to produce CD deliverables. They ensure the ACS consultants adhere to AWS BIM standards. As part of this team you will carry out ACS documents reviews on in flight projects to ensure the highest standard is delivered and working with the wider AWS ACS teams to discuss process improvements, document standards, innovations and project obstacles. Our BIM Designers are capable of working with minimal oversight, have excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and maintain high working standards. Flexible to design changes, able to adapt to fast-paced drawing execution requirements, our BIM Designers define problems and dive deep on ambiguous design requests. The role will require you to work with a Global mindset as your work will cross between Global regions.

About the team
You will work with our internal BIM Design Services Team, Internal Design Engineering teams and external consultants to innovate and drive standards during the design stage of projects, leveraging all aspects of the Model capability to help consultants deliver efficient coordinated designs to IFC stage.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. 

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 
- Experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers
- Experience directly related to the design or construction of data centers or critical infrastructure or large-scale mechanical and electrical plants
- Experience using Revit for producing Structural engineering models and drawings.
- Experience using AutoCAD to produce architecture or engineering drawings
- Experience of working with multi discipline teams in an structural coordination role – shows strong ownership of projects.
- Experience working with Navisworks
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Structural Engineering
- Understanding of mechanical and electrical services in datacenters
- Proficient coordinating Structure with mission critical systems
- Experience directly related to Data Center design and construction
- Experience and knowledge applying Lean principals to design modelling and drawing production and experience with large scale designs

title: Mechanical Fitter
description:
Maintenance Fitter Required – Oranmore, Co. Galway 

 About Your New Employer 
Our client is a highly regarded and established business operating within the precast manufacturing sector. With a strong reputation for delivering high-performance, bespoke precast solutions, they provide a full-service offering from building design and manufacture through to installation. Their modern, highly automated facilities utilise state-of-the-art technology and BIM-orientated processes.
They are now seeking an experienced Maintenance Fitter to join their team on a long-term basis, working within a busy and modern manufacturing facility in Oranmore, Co. Galway.

 About Your New Job 
As a Maintenance Fitter, you will play a key role in ensuring the efficient and reliable operation of plant equipment and machinery. Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, you will be responsible for carrying out routine maintenance, servicing, fault-finding and repairs while helping to minimise downtime and maintain a safe working environment.

 Your main responsibilities will include: 
 Carrying out routine maintenance and servicing of plant equipment and machinery.
 Developing and implementing a plant-wide preventative maintenance programme.
 Diagnosing mechanical breakdowns and carrying out effective repairs.
 Identifying potential equipment issues and taking proactive measures to prevent breakdowns.
 Scheduling periodic testing of safety equipment and maintaining accurate records.
 Recycling and re-using parts and materials where possible.
 Maintaining accurate maintenance records and documentation.
 Working closely with production and maintenance teams to minimise plant downtime.
 Following all company Health & Safety policies, procedures, systems and rules.
 Reporting hazards, incidents and equipment defects promptly.
 Working safely and demonstrating a lead-by-example approach to Health & Safety at all times.
 
 What Skills You Need 
To be successful in this role, you should have:
 A time-served trade qualification in a mechanical discipline.
 A minimum of 2 years' relevant industry experience .
 Previous experience working within a manufacturing or production environment is preferred.
 Strong mechanical fault-finding and diagnostic skills.
 Experience carrying out preventative and routine maintenance.
 Good attention to detail and a precise, methodical approach to your work.
 The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to respond effectively to breakdowns.
 A strong understanding of Health & Safety practices within an industrial environment.
 Good communication skills and a reliable, professional approach to work.
 
 What’s on Offer 
 Competitive salary, depending on experience.
 Permanent position based in Oranmore, Co. Galway.
 Opportunity to work within a modern, highly automated manufacturing facility.
 Opportunity to work with state-of-the-art plant and machinery.
 Long-term career opportunity within an established business.
 Professional and supportive working environment.
 Opportunity to become an integral part of an experienced maintenance team.
 
 What’s Next 
If you're an experienced Maintenance Fitter looking for your next opportunity in Oranmore, Co. Galway, or the surrounding area, we’d love to hear from you.

Call or Whatsapp Michael on 086 771 8859 for more information.

Regional Communications Executive (Higher Executive Officer Grade)
Duration:         Fixed Term Contract (9 months Maternity Cover)
About the WDC:
The Western Development Commission (WDC) is a statutory body whose role is to promote the social and economic development of the western region of Ireland. The WDC works with a range of stakeholders to support sustainable and inclusive growth in the region and has a strong track record of delivering impactful initiatives and programmes.
Culture of the WDC:
At the WDC, we are committed to creating a positive and supportive work environment where employees can thrive and make a difference. Our culture is defined by teamwork, innovation, and a deep sense of purpose. We value diversity, respect for different perspectives, and a willingness to learn and grow. If you are passionate about making a difference in the western region of Ireland and want to be part of a dynamic and collaborative team, we encourage you to apply for this role.
Purpose of position:
The WDC is seeking to appoint a Regional Communications Executive at Higher Executive Officer (HEO) level on a 9-month fixed-term contract to provide maternity cover, with a view to possible extension.
This is a mid-senior role at the centre of the WDC's communications function. Working hand in hand with the Head of Communications and the wider Communications team, the post holder will help deliver the WDC's communications strategy across PR and media relations, content creation (with a particular focus on video), marketing and brand, events, and social and digital channels.
The successful candidate will bring 5+ years' communications experience, be comfortable leading projects end to end, managing external agencies and production teams, and be a significant part of how the WDC tells the story of the western region. They will be able to step in quickly, maintain momentum on live campaigns, and deliver from day one.
Key responsibilities:
The following are the main tasks to be undertaken:
PR and media relations
Secure high-quality regional and national media coverage that raises the profile of the WDC and its messaging.
Write and distribute press releases, media briefings, opinion pieces and speeches, and prepare spokespeople for interviews.
Proactively identify, develop and pitch news stories and features.
Manage media enquiries and support issues and reactive communications, escalating appropriately.
Content creation and video
Develop compelling content for all channels, including case studies, articles, reports, newsletters and web copy.
Lead the WDC's video content: developing concepts, writing briefs and scripts, and working with video production teams from pre-production through filming, editing and sign-off.
Commission and manage photography and other creative assets.
Ensure content is accessible, on-brand and tailored to each audience and platform.
Marketing and brand management
Act as a custodian of the WDC brand, ensuring consistent use of brand guidelines, tone of voice and visual identity.
Along with the Head of Communications, plan and deliver marketing campaigns for WDC programmes and initiatives, including paid and owned activity.
Oversee the production of marketing collateral, publications and promotional materials.
Website management and maintenance
Maintain and update content across the WDCs website, westerndevelopment.ie ensuring information is accurate, current and on-brand.
Upload and publish news, press releases, case studies, video and event content through the content management system.
Work with web developers and agencies on site updates, fixes, new pages and functionality.
Ensure website content meets accessibility standards (WCAG and the EU Web Accessibility Directive), GDPR and public sector requirements.
Monitor website analytics and use insights to improve content, user experience and search visibility (SEO).
Social media and digital marketing
Support the planning and delivery of social media content and campaigns across the WDC's channels.
Assist the Communications Officer with digital marketing, including paid social, email marketing and website content.
Use analytics to track performance and optimise campaigns.
Event management
Plan and deliver events, including launches, conferences, ministerial visits and media opportunities.
Coordinate logistics, speakers, stakeholders, suppliers and media attendance.
Maximise the communications value of events through promotion, content capture and follow-up.
Agency and supplier management
Brief, manage and evaluate external agencies and suppliers (PR, creative, digital, video production and events).
Manage budgets, timelines and deliverables, and support procurement in line with public sector requirements.
Stakeholder engagement
Work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, including government departments, local authorities, agencies and community groups.
Contribute to internal communications as needed.
Monitoring, evaluation and reporting
Monitor media coverage and channel performance, and provide regular analysis, insights and reports to the CEO and senior management.
Maintain media contact databases and ensure good governance, including GDPR, and record-keeping across communications activity.
The above is not, and does not purport to be, a comprehensive list of all duties involved and consequently, the post holder may be required to perform other duties as appropriate to the post which may be assigned to them from time to time and to contribute to the development of the post.
Eligibility Criteria and Experience:
Applicants must by the closing date of application have the following:
A minimum of 5 years' experience in communications, PR, media relations or marketing, including experience at a mid-senior level.
A third-level qualification in communications, journal

title: Specialist, Product Management – Client Data Onboarding, BE&O
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Specialist, Product Management – Client Data Onboarding, BE&O 
Specialist, Product Management – Client Data Onboarding, BE&O 

As a member of the Client Data Onboarding Product Management team, you will help deliver and improve our AI-led client data onboarding product. We are rapidly replacing manual ETL with agentic workflows, evolving how we onboard clients in the age of AI, and scaling onboarding across industries and pillars. We are looking for an AI-native Specialist, Product Management who applies practical product management knowledge and established team practices to support assigned features, from user problem through requirements, delivery readiness and performance tracking. 

This role reports to the Product Manager within BEO's Client Data Onboarding team. 

Position Responsibilities 

Support assigned features of our AI-led client data onboarding product, with specific focus on data pipelines, data quality and the onboarding user experience, within established product strategies and roadmaps. 

Work with Engineering and Data Science leads to document requirements for the agentic data onboarding workflows. Write feature specifications, acceptance criteria and functional and non-functional requirements for agents, automated data loading, data quality checks and the web app. 

Help keep users in control. Work with UX to gather feedback from Data Engineers and ACS users, and test how well they can review, edit and approve agent outputs and answer Client Data Requests (CDRs). 

Validate user problems and proposed solutions using user feedback, usage data, client data insights and structured testing. Define intended outcomes, success measures and key risks for assigned features. 

Maintain defined portions of the product backlog and support prioritization by gathering evidence on user value, business impact, delivery effort and risk, in line with the roadmap from the early adopter MVP to scale across R&C industries and FI clients. 

Support end-to-end delivery of assigned features. Support development and end-to-end testing, track onboarding time, approval effort, data quality and reduction in manual Data Delivery support, and recommend corrective actions or backlog adjustments. 

Track dependencies and delivery risks. Coordinate with the owners of client connectivity, the data ingestion pipeline, Databricks set-up, historical data migration from APT and Data Engineer capacity. Resolve defined issues and escalate material concerns when required. 

Support governance and launch readiness. Collect evidence for responsible AI, security, privacy, data, architecture and BizOps reviews, including the correct handling of PCI/PII data. 

Maintain accurate product documentation, including feature specifications, decision logs, user guidance and release notes. 

Work as a part of a cross-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Coordinate with Engineering, UX, Data Delivery, ACS, the R&C and FI pillars, and C&D to support client roll-out plans. 

 

All About You 

Relevant experience in product management or a related discipline, preferably supporting data, analytics, data engineering or platform products 

Practical understanding of product management processes and tools, including user discovery, requirements, backlogs, agile delivery, launch readiness and performance tracking 

Experience translating user or business problems into clear requirements, acceptance criteria and measurable success indicators 

Interest in, or experience of, building with AI, LLMs and agents, including human-in-the-loop workflows 

Awareness of data pipelines, ETL, data modelling, data contracts, semantic layers, data quality and platforms such as Databricks; hands-on data engineering is not required 

Ability to gather and interpret user feedback, usage data and operational measures to support product decisions 

Experience coordinating delivery or readiness activities across technology and business stakeholders, and tracking dependencies through to resolution 

Awareness of data privacy, security and responsible AI considerations, ideally in a regulated or financial-services environment 

A clear communicator who documents requirements, explains progress and raises risks or unclear decisions promptly 

Comfortable managing defined work independently while seeking guidance on complex, ambiguous or high-impact decisions 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The team is focused on excellence, reliability and innovation, delivering tightly controlled components to global customers who demand the highest standards.
 About Your New Job 
 Set up and operate CNC lathes to manufacture components accurately in line with technical drawings and work orders.
 Interpret engineering drawings, GD&T and specifications to ensure parts meet required standards.
 Carry out first-off inspections and regularly measure critical dimensions, recording quality checks as required.
 Complete production, quality and work-order documentation, ensuring completed batches are correctly prepared for the next operation.
 Maintain CNC equipment and a clean, safe working environment while following all health & safety procedures and PPE requirements.
 What Skills You Need 
 Previous experience setting up and operating CNC lathes in a manufacturing environment.
 Ability to read and interpret technical/engineering drawings and understand GD&T.
 Strong attention to detail with experience using measuring and inspection equipment.
 Commitment to health & safety, quality standards and maintaining a clean and organised work area.
 What’s Next 
 Apply now by clicking the “Apply Now” button or call me, Emma O'Connor , on 090 64 13972 for a confidential discussion.
 If this role isn’t quite right but you’re interested in similar opportunities, please get in touch.

title: Croatian Market Researcher
description:
Market Researcher - Croatian 

 Location - East Galway, Office based
 Type of contract - Permanent
 About Your New Employer: 
 This employer is a global company with 10+ offices worldwide.
 They offer competitive benefits including; 23 days annual leave, Pension, Health-cover for you and dependents, Life Assurance, Critical illness cover, Free Parking, Shower Facilities, Bike to Work scheme and more.
 About Your New Croatian Research Job: 
 This Research job is office based and collaborating with a large team (approx. 75+ ) of multi-lingual Market Researchers.
 Although you will be part of an experienced team, you will be working individually by researching the market through the use of the internet, trade magazines, other media and internal databases.
 To ensure that the data you gather is accurate, you will also speak to companies in your region (eg Balkan and English speaking countries) and ask them to qualify market intelligence.
 What Skills You Need: 
 Fluency in English and Croatian (written and spoken).
 Excellent office skills (including MS Office) and experience of working in a corporate office environment.
 A keen interest in conducting research via the internet and over the telephone. Prior Market Research experience is not essential as full training and development will be given.
 A genuine interest in working with people, you will be compiling and conducting research globally and working on a variety of interesting projects.
 A friendly and professional team player who enjoys working autonomously. 
 What’s on Offer with this Croatian Research Job: 
 Full time permanent position with a competitive salary package (OTE of 39k in your first year). This consists of a base salary of 28 - 30k (depending on level of experience) plus monthly uncapped bonuses.
 Office hours, 8am to 4.30pm Monday to Thursday and 8am to 3.30pm on a Friday.
 This company offers great training and development opportunities.
 Benefits including Laya healthcare for you and your family, 23 days annual leave, company pension, parking, Critical Illness cover, Shower Facilities and canteen. The offices are very close to shops and public transport.
  
 Please note that we are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Ireland without requiring sponsorship.

 A prestigious and well-established hotel in County Offaly is seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Wedding & Events Executive to support the continued growth of its busy weddings and events division. Known for exceptional guest experiences and premium events, the hotel offers an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic hospitality team.
 About Your New Job as a Wedding and Events Executive 
 Manage wedding and event enquiries from initial contact to final execution, converting leads into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer service.
 Conduct site visits, prepare proposals/contracts/function sheets, and guide clients through event planning including menus, décor, layouts, and timelines.
 Coordinate closely with hotel departments and external suppliers to ensure seamless delivery of weddings, conferences, and events.
 Track deposits, contracts, and payments while identifying upselling opportunities to enhance client experience and achieve revenue targets.
 Represent the hotel at wedding fairs, trade shows, and client meetings while maintaining awareness of competitor activity and local market trends.
 What Skills You Need 
 2+ years’ experience in weddings, events, or hospitality (preferably in a 4-star hotel) with strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a sales-driven, customer-focused approach.
 High attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to remain calm and proactive under pressure.
 Proficient in hotel/event management systems (e.g. Hotsoft or similar) with flexibility to work evenings and weekends.
 Professional, warm, and approachable personality; hospitality or event management qualification and knowledge of Irish wedding traditions/suppliers desirable.
 What’s Next

title: Mechanical Estimator
description:
Winthrop Technologies is Europe’s only dedicated data centre delivery partner, offering full turnkey solutions from design through to construction and commissioning. Headquartered in Dublin, we deliver projects across Europe and have become the most trusted name in our sector.
 We are pleased to announce that we are currently seeking a Mechanical Estimator due to our continued success within the Data Centre Industry. The position will be based in our Head Office in Ballymount, Dublin.

 Position: Mechanical Estimator 
 Location: Ballymount, Dublin 22
 Reporting to: Lead Mechanical Estimator
 
 Responsibilities 
 Produce reports for management for bids and monthly meetings 
 Prepare estimates based on drawings and specifications 
 Manage quantities and prepare pricing document 
 Oversea pricing for elements of the building from the Irish and European subcontractors and suppliers 
 Utilise spreadsheets to compare subcontractors bids and quotations, and to demonstrate reasoning for selecting subcontractors 
 Assist in the maintenance of the cost data base 
 Present the estimate to the Estimating Director, and to the Board of Directors, where and when required 
 Build relationships with key vendors (subcontractors, suppliers, engineers etc) 
 Keep informed with developments in the construction industry 
 Participate in the development of procedures to ensure a high standard of quality control in the documents produced by the Estimating Department 
 Co-operate with the application of quality assurance procedures 
 Mentor and train junior members of the team
 Co-ordinate and collaborate with the CSA & Electrical Estimators 
 Requirements 
 4+ years experience within a Mechanical capacity 
 Estimating or Quantity Surveying background 
 Knowledge of FIDIC contracts is desirable
 Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and in at least one of the more widely used QS BQ production software packages – e.g. Buildsoft or CostX
 Understand the requirement to achieve a high level of quality in the production of subcontractor tender documentation and Winthrop’s tender submission
 Be able to identify potential risks on a project
 Be aware of the company’s high standards of safety
 Benefits 
 Opportunity to work with a Market Leader in the Data centre Industry 
 Supportive career development 
 Competitive salary package 
 Collaborative team environment 
 Pipeline of project growth 
 
 Winthrop Technologies Ltd is an equal opportunities employer

title: Carpenter
description:
Carpenter – Oranmore, Galway 

 About Your New Employer 
Our client is a well-established construction and precast business with a major operation in Oranmore, Co. Galway. Due to ongoing project requirements, they are now seeking a skilled and experienced Carpenter to join their team.
This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified Carpenter looking for consistent, long-term work within a professional construction environment. The successful candidate will initially join on a long-term contract, with a genuine opportunity to secure a permanent position based on performance, reliability, and ongoing business requirements.

 About Your New Job 
As a Carpenter, you will play an important role on a busy construction site, carrying out carpentry, installation, and repair work to a high standard. You will work as part of an experienced team and will be responsible for constructing, installing, and repairing structures and fixtures using timber, plywood, and other materials.
 Your main responsibilities will include: 
 Reading and interpreting construction drawings, blueprints, and specifications to determine project requirements.
 Constructing, installing, and repairing structures and fixtures using a range of materials.
 Identifying and resolving issues that may arise during construction or installation and adapting plans where necessary.
 Working effectively both independently and as part of a wider construction team.
 Maintaining a safe and professional working environment while following all site safety procedures and PPE requirements.
 
 What Skills You Need 
 To be successful in this role, you should have: 
 Relevant certification or qualification in Carpentry with previous experience in a construction environment.
 Strong carpentry and woodworking skills, with excellent attention to detail and pride in your workmanship.
 Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and blueprints.
 Competent and safe use of a range of hand and power tools.
 Reliable, safety-conscious, and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
 
 What's on Offer 
 Competitive hourly rate, depending on experience.
 Full-time hours with consistent, long-term work.
 Long-term contract based in Oranmore, Co. Galway.
 Genuine opportunity to secure a permanent position following the initial contract period.
 Opportunity to work within a professional and well-managed construction environment.
 Ongoing work with an established construction business.
 Excellent opportunity for an experienced Carpenter looking for long-term career prospects.
 
 What's Next 
If you're a qualified and experienced Carpenter looking for your next opportunity in Galway, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply now for more information and to discuss the role. Alternatively, you can call or Whatsapp Michael on 086 771 8859 for details.

title: Defect/Integration Engineer
description:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
           
 The Limerick Defect/Integration team are seeking an motivated, enthusiastic engineer to join their group. The candidate must be curious, agile and flexible, with excellent problem solving and data analysis skills. A sense of urgency and the ability to manage multiple tasks & projects simultaneously is also a must. The Defect Integration role is exciting and dynamic with huge potential for learning across all fab areas and functions. This is an exciting time for the Limerick Fab as we are expanding our Wafer Fab by 2X and will increase output by 3X by 2026.
 
 Job Description: 
 Layer (Module) Ownership: 
 Drive defect reduction/yield improvement projects for your layers Identify top pareto items impacting defect density
 Identify improvements and collaborate with the workcentres to drive to completion
 
 Use SPC (Statistical Process Control) to monitor and control inline defects throughout the product lifecycle Maintain appropriate control limits to be able to flag genuine issues, while preventing false OOCs.
 
 Excursion detection, fast response and containment, and prevention
 Inspection recipe maintenance and improvement to ensure low nuisance detection and high capture rate of defects of interest
 
 Required Skills: 
 Root Cause Analysis :
 Investigate complex technical challenges to identify the underlying causes of defects or yield loss
 Requires strong analytical skills and the ability to apply creative problem solving and critical thinking to a problem
 Excellent data analysis skills are a must: use of Klarity Defect, SAS, jmp, and ACE to datamine large data sets with complex interactions
 Design of Experiment to facilitate problem solving
 Use of Python a bonus
 
 Statistical Process Control 
 Requires a deep understanding of the fundamentals of SPC to maintain inline defect charts with correct control and spec limits, and identify and respond quickly to shifts in the population
 Good understanding of Statistics in general
 
 Process Integration and improvement: 
 Strong knowledge or a willingness to learn about the different process flows
 Understand how different layers and process tools interact with each other – the importance of establishing good process window
 An ability to read and interpret wafer cross sections: FIB, SEM, TEM, EDX
 Ability to perform SEM & FIB analysis a bonus
 
 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with process engineering, equipment engineering, product engineering,  manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure defect issues are resolved quickly with robust fixes in place to prevent reoccurrence
 Requires excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to bring people along
 Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain a complex problem clearly and concisely are a must
 
 Defect Reduction/Yield Improvement 
 Use of ACE for Defect-Yield correlation
 Identify top pareto items impacting yield, and creative solutions to improve
 Project management is a key skill to be able to drive Defect Reduction projects to completion in timely manner
 Ability to scope out a project and set realistic timelines
 Bring the right people on board and work with them to achieve project goals
 Strong self-starter with ability to drive a project and keep it moving
 Overcome obstacles by thinking creatively
 
 For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export  licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.  As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process. 
 
 Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group. 
 
Job Req Type: Experienced           
Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time           
Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

title: Engineer, Reliability Engineering
description:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
           
 The Team: 
 The Intrinsic Reliability ( i Rel) Group is responsible for ensuring Product/Process Lifetime Robustness at ADI. This is achieved by investigating the intrinsic reliability of devices/circuits and sensors. The i Rel Group employs a range of engineering disciplines including electronics, physics and materials experts. The group is split across two locations namely, ADLK (Limerick, Ireland) and ADSV (San Jose, CA). The successful candidate will reside in ADLK.
 
 The Position: 
 The position to be filled is for a P2 Intrinsic Reliability Engineer. The engineer will be responsible for characterizing novel technologies such as electrochemical biosensors and magnetoresistive sensors through device reliability testing.
 
 Main responsibilities: 
 Early engagement in new technology developments to understand technical risks with regards to device design and manufacturing process risks as well as customer expectations.
 De-risking of novel electrochemical and semiconductor devices through reliability testing utilizing industry standard testing but also through the development of bespoke stress tests and lifetime acceleration techniques.
 Development of statistical lifetime models to evaluate technology robustness.
 Collaboration with failure analysis and process/product development teams to localize and understand root cause of failures.
 Attendance at industry leading device/circuit reliability conferences and adoption of industry State-of-the-Art best practices.
 
 Required skills: 
 Bachelor’s degree in chemistry/physics/material science or related field at a minimum. Master’s degree or relevant early career work experience is an advantage.
 Ability to multitask and pivot between multiple priorities is essential.
 Strong teamwork, interpersonal and communication skills are essential, coupled with a demonstrated ability to work at a high level of performance independently and as part of a team.
 Knowledge of reliability engineering is an advantage.
 Experience with Python/JMP for modelling of lifetime data is an advantage.
