 Take full responsibility for the maintenance, servicing and repair of CNC, manual machinery, automation systems, compressors, forklifts and vehicles.
 Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic and electronic faults, while managing preventative maintenance schedules and machine downtime.
 Support the introduction and development of automation, robotics and Industry 4.0 solutions, including automated cells and coolant management systems.
 Oversee facilities, infrastructure and utilities, including compressed air and power systems, ensuring equipment remains safe and operational.
 Manage spares, maintenance records, suppliers and external contractors, while ensuring all equipment meets health & safety requirements.
 What Skills You Need 
 Minimum 3+ years' experience in a maintenance role within a manufacturing environment.
 Experience maintaining CNC machines is highly desirable.

 Excellent organisational, fault-finding, and preventative maintenance planning skills.
 Experience with automation, robotics, or Industry 4.0 technologies is advantageous.

title: Electrician (QC Qualified) – Munster
description:
About Your New Employer Join an established Irish company specialising in electrical installation, servicing and maintenance within the fuel industry.

 Work on a variety of technical projects across petrol forecourts, fuel installations and oil depots throughout Ireland.

 Become part of an experienced engineering team offering hands-on technical work, ongoing training and a company vehicle.

 About Your New Job As a Qualified Electrician with a current Safe Electric QC qualification , you will join a field-based engineering team covering the Munster region, reporting directly to the Head Engineer.
 Carry out electrical installation, commissioning, servicing, testing and maintenance at customer sites.

 Diagnose electrical faults, troubleshoot equipment and complete repairs to the required technical and safety standards.

 Test, inspect and certify electrical works, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and client specifications.

 Work on electrical systems and equipment within petrol forecourts, fuel installations and oil depots.

 Plan and coordinate daily site activities, working independently and alongside other engineers and contractors.

 Complete service reports, testing documentation, risk assessments and method statements.

 Provide technical support and guidance to customers and colleagues when required.

 Participate in an occasional weekend on-call rota, approximately once per month.

 What Skills You Need Fully qualified Electrician with SOLAS/FÁS certification.

 Current Safe Electric QC (Qualified Certifier) qualification – essential. 

 Experience in electrical installation, maintenance, testing, certification and fault-finding.

 Full, clean Irish driving licence.

 Valid Safe Pass and Manual Handling certification.

 Willingness to travel to customer sites throughout the designated region and work occasional weekends or outside normal hours.

 Previous experience with MV/HV contractors, industrial electrical systems or fuel installations would be an advantage.
 What's on Offer Competitive salary – negotiable depending on experience. 

 Company vehicle and mobile phone provided. 

 Permanent, full-time position with normal working hours of 8:00 am–5:00 pm, Monday to Friday , plus occasional on-call duties.

 Company-arranged travel and accommodation when required for site work.

 Training courses and opportunities to develop your technical experience.

 A varied, field-based role working on specialist electrical installations across Ireland.

title: Sr Clin Data Mgmt Assoc
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 

 Clinical Data Management (CDM) supports drug discovery, development and marketed products across Gilead by ensuring the accurate and timely acquisition, analysis and reporting of diverse clinical data through CRF / eCRF design, editing specifications and query resolution processes. CDM also manages data transfers from vendors, such as central labs and others.  

 You will act as the CDM lead on one or more clinical studies. You will lead the preparation of CRF/eCRF design. You will review study protocols and assist in the planning and implementation of CDM portions of clinical studies. You may act as lead in the oversight of vendors to ensure high quality processes for data review, data transfers and reporting. You will use standard / routine and non-routine reports to track study progress and ensure timelines and quality expectations are met. You will provide guidance and training to contract research organizations (CROs), vendors, investigators and study coordinators on CDM requirements.  You will also support regulatory submissions of assigned projects. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES:   
 Serves as lead for one or more studies or projects of increasing complexity, including participating in or leading cross-functional working groups.  
 Reviews study protocols and assists site coordinators, investigators, and field clinical staff in collecting routine data to meet protocol requirements in a timely manner. 
 Identifies, tracks, and resolves CDM queries and issues. 
 Acts as a point of contact for study management teams and for Clinical Development regarding data management issues. 
 Works collaboratively with other colleagues to meet project deliverables and timelines for clinical data acquisition, quality checking and reporting.   
 Ensures completeness, accuracy and consistency of routine clinical data and data structure. 
 Ensures adherence to standard business processes within CDM systems to assure compliance with regulatory requirements.  
 May lead the design and implementation of the CDM process with vendors, including data entry, data quality checking, data transfer, reporting, backup and recovery.  
 Educates study teams and vendors on CDM processes and deliverables, including deviations from established processes.  
 Leads the preparation of CRF/eCRF design.    
 Utilizes reports to track study progress and ensures timeliness and quality expectations are met. 
 Provides technical and business process expertise on new and emerging technologies / vendors for clinical trial execution.  
 Leads or otherwise participates in the development, review and implementation of continuous improvements, processes, policies, SOPs and other guidance / process documents for CDM.  
 Trains and mentors less experienced in colleagues in CDM processes, projects, programs and tools.  
 Ensures assigned work complies with established practices, policies and processes and any regulatory or other requirements.  
  
  
 REQUIREMENTS:   
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Please see the following for the qualifications and skills we seek for this role.  

 Minimum Education & Experience   
 PhD in life sciences or related discipline with relevant CDM or other data analytics / data management experience is preferred.  
 MA / MS in life sciences or related discipline with relevant CDM or other data analytics / data management experience.  
 BA / BS in life sciences or related discipline with relevant CDM or other data analytics / data management experience.  
 Extensive CDM or other data analytics / data management experience is preferred.  
 Extensive vendor oversight experience. 
 
 Knowledge & Other Requirements   
 Demonstrated proficiency in leading CDM or related deliverables, including understanding of project timelines and metrics to ensure databases are delivered as needed and in accordance with established timelines.  
 Demonstrates sound knowledge of FDA / EMA regulations, NDA and other regulatory requirements, and web-based EDC and CDM systems.  
 Demonstrated ability and effectiveness identifying, communicating and escalating project-level issues, such as processes, timelines, resourcing, performance, etc.  
 Demonstrates strong facilitation / presentation skills and ability to appropriately delegate tasks to others.  
 Demonstrated ability to be a fast learner.  
 Demonstrated ability to be flexible and adaptable to change, to move between projects easily and provide support/expertise where needed.  
 Strong communication and organizational skills.  
 When needed, ability to travel.  
 
 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) It is the policy of Gilead Sciences, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively "Gilead" or the "Company") to recruit select and employ the most qualified persons available for positions throughout the Company.  Except if otherwise provided by applicable law, all  employment actions relating to issues such as compensation, benefits, transfers, layoffs, returns from layoffs, company-sponsored training, education assistance, social and recreational programs are administered on a non-discriminatory basis (i.e. without regard to protected characteristics or prohibited grounds, which may include an individual’s gender, race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, creed, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, medical condition, veteran status, and age, unless such protection is prohibited by federal, state, municipal, provincial, local or other applicable laws).  Gilead also prohibits discrimination based on any other characteristics protected by applicable laws.
 
 
 For Current Gilead Employees and Contractors: Please apply via the Internal Career Opportunities portal in Workday.

title: Reality Capture Specialist
description:
Reality Capture Specialist
Location: Dublin, County Dublin, Ireland
« back to All Jobs
At John Paul Construction, we believe every project is an opportunity to improve on what has come before. To foster that mindset, we hire the brightest and best in the industry, encourage collaboration, and embrace innovative thinking and new technology.
Due to continued expansion, we are hiring a Reality Capture Specialist for our various projects and Head Office.
The Reality Capture Specialist will support the development, implementation and adoption of John Paul Construction’s Reality Capture capability across projects.
The role is focused on improving the use of laser scanning, model-to-site verification and digital construction technologies to support earlier identification of installation deviations, reduce rework and improve installation quality.
Acting as the dedicated point of ownership for Reality Capture within JPC, the Reality Capture Specialist will support project teams, drive adoption of company standards and procedures, increase utilisation of captured information and promote consistent delivery of Reality Capture workflows across the business.
The role will work closely with the BIM team, Engineering and project teams to help ensure Reality Capture is used as a proactive construction verification process rather than solely an as-built or handover activity.
Requirements
The role is primarily focused on construction verification, scan control, captured data review, standards implementation and project support. Innovation and future technology development remain part of the remit alongside the previous.
Key Responsibilities
Reality Capture & Construction Verification
Support implementation of Reality Capture workflows across JPC projects.
Promote earlier model-to-site verification during construction.
Support project teams in identifying and managing installation deviations from coordinated BIM models.
Increase utilisation of Reality Capture and related verification workflows.
Support development of practical construction verification reporting and best practice.
Project Support & Standards
Provide technical guidance to project teams undertaking Reality Capture activities.
Support implementation of Reality Capture standards, procedures and workflows.
Assist with project mobilisation and planning of Reality Capture activities.
Promote consistency of delivery across projects and regional offices.
Capture lessons learned and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Scan Control & Quality Assurance
Support implementation of JPC’s Point Cloud Scanning Control procedures.
Act as the interface between BIM and Engineering teams for scan control activities.
Promote improved quality assurance, validation and data confidence.
Assist project teams in resolving Reality Capture related issues.
Drone & 360° Capture
Drive adoption of Drone and 360° capture technologies across projects.
Support project teams in the use and review of captured information.
Promote effective use of digital project records for quality, progress and verification purposes.
Innovation & Development
Support continuous improvement of Reality Capture workflows and reporting.
Monitor developments in Reality Capture and digital construction technologies.
Assist in the evaluation of emerging technologies including AI-assisted workflows, automation and robotic capture solutions.
Skills & Experience
Essential
Experience working within BIM, or Digital Construction environments.
Strong understanding of construction processes and project delivery.
Experience with Reality Capture technologies and point cloud workflows.
Experience using Leica Reality Capture software platforms.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across BIM, Engineering and project teams.
Desirable
Experience with Cyclone Register 360 and Cyclone 3DR.
Experience with DroneDeploy, Revizto or similar platforms.
Knowledge of survey control principles.
Experience supporting quality assurance or construction verification processes.
Interest in emerging digital construction technologies and innovation.
Key Attributes
Proactive and solutions focused.
Strong attention to detail.
Effective communicator and collaborator.
Continuous improvement mindset.
Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
Ability to influence adoption of new processes and technologies.
Benefits
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe in fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and are given the opportunity to reach their full potential.
Apply for this Position

title: Account Executive (Nordics) - Sales Solutions
description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Dublin.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

LinkedIn’s Sales Solutions team is dedicated to changing the world of sales. We are supporting customers in developing a Deep Sales approach focusing their sales efforts where they will have the most impact.  We do this through LinkedIn Sales Navigator, which helps connect, engage and build mutually beneficial relationships between buyers and sellers at the right time. As Account Executive, you will develop and manage a strong pipeline of new prospects, manage the acquisition process from end to end, and demonstrate strong revenue attainment and forecasting skills.

As an Account Executive, you will use your strategic selling skills to educate prospective customers in the Nordic market on the benefits and value of LinkedIn Sales Navigator. You will serve as a trusted adviser, share insights and continually seek opportunities for growth to make your customers as strong and successful as possible. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive revenue by connecting with customers and building opportunities that will make all parties more successful 
  • Demonstrate sales leadership through strong planning, forecasting, revenue reporting and pipeline management
  • Be a best-in-class Sales Navigator user and leader on top performing sales habits
  • Leverage your skills and your customers’ experience to continually evolve our solution offerings and the sales process 
  • Act as an owner on your book-of-business and revenue goals
  • Consistently meet and exceed the business and revenue objectives set forth in your plan 
  • Adapt but also work to develop, apply, and circulate a set of best practices that will be the foundation of this growing team
  • Champion LinkedIn’s Diversity and Inclusion values and culture

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 2+ years of applicable sales experience
  • Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Fluency in a Nordic language; Swedish, Danish, Finnish or Norwegian
  • Sales experience selling into Nordic market(s)
  • Track record selling SaaS solutions, CRM platforms or software platform solutions  
  • Proven ability to work to a quota and achieve results  
  • Demonstrated ability to find, manage and close high-level business sales  
  • Ability to assess business opportunities and read prospective buyers  
  • Ability to predictably forecast and execute on business goals  
  • Ability to use insights and data-driven decisions in the sales process  
  • Ability to effectively build trust-based relationships with senior-level sales professionals  
  • Ability to bring together multiple buyers in the same company to build groundswell while 
  • Leveraging partners within LinkedIn to effectively evangelize the solution  

Suggested skills:

  • Prospecting 
  • Negotiation 
  • Analytics & Forecasting 
  • Relationship Building 
  • Multithreading

Additional Information

title: Manufacturing Team Member (12 month Contract)
description:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
           
 Position: Manufacturing Team Member(s) - 12-month Contract 
 Location: Limerick Ireland 

 Are you interested in a career working at one of the longest established high tech, high end manufacturing facilities in Ireland? Analog Devices International is a world-leading semiconductor company specializing in high-performance analogue, mixed signal and digital signal processing (DSP) integrated circuits (ICs). One of Limerick’s major employers for over 40 years, we are currently looking for a number of Manufacturing Team members to support the business. At our Limerick Operations site, we currently employ 1200 people. Here we manufacture Integrated Circuits in our clean room fabrications that are used in all forms of the electronics spectrum from industrial to consumer devices.

 Responsibilities include but not limited to :
 Process wafers through equipment in clean room fabrications accordance with specifications and procedures to meet daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly production targets.
 Promote and maintain a high level of safety and housekeeping.
 Must follow safety, wafer handling. Tool operation, chemical handling, housekeeping and clean room protocols.
 Handling of wafer cassettes and boxes, loading and unloading of tools, selecting of programs either manually or through automation process
 Performing measurements as required, entering data as necessary.
 Be responsible for updating manufacturing systems to optimise performance of work area.
 Perform equipment checks procedures as required.
 Liaise with manufacturing / equipment / engineering groups
 Training of new employees as required.
 Participate and support continuous improvement programmes through groups and on an individual basis.
 
 Education requirement: 
 Minimum - Leaving Certificate or Equivalent
 
 Skills and Competencies: 
 Strong ability to follow written instructions/specifications.
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to multi-task.
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work on own initiative
 Demonstrated ability to operate computer interfaces to ensure data accuracy and integrity and analysis of production information.
 An MTM must possess a flexible, innovative and committed approach to their work and have an ability to learn and apply new concepts.
 A demonstrated ability to participate in teams is essential.
 Demonstrated ability to follow detailed instructions and procedures to complete tasks and required documentation
 Demonstrated work performance in an environment requiring high level of attention to detail and ability to deliver to output targets at a tool level.
 Demonstrated ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and priorities activities.
  Open to working a 5-cycle shift pattern.

title: Proposition Specialist
description:
Contract Type:    Fixed Term Contract (24 months) 
 Job Title:  Proposition Specialist 
 Benefits:  €52,000 – 65,000 base salary, 10% Non-Contributory Pension (matched up to a further 2%), Funded Industry Qualifications, Lunch Allowance, Hybrid working . 
 We offer salaries within the stated pay range. Typically, new hires start at the lower end of the range, though recognition of relevant experience and prior service may result in a higher starting salary. 
 Who are we?  
 We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures. 
 Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day. 
 The role- 
 We're looking for Product Specialists on a 2 year Fixed term Contract (FTC) basis to join our Proposition Operations team. This is a delivery-focused role supporting the effective management and development of the Standard Life International product portfolio, while also providing product expertise to our strategic migration programme. 
 Working as part of the wider Proposition Operations team, you will take ownership of a range of product activities and product-related deliverables. You will apply your knowledge and judgement to assess product and customer impacts, develop recommendations and support the successful delivery of change. You will work across Proposition, Operations, Digital, Technology, Change and other business areas, managing agreed activities with appropriate independence and escalating material risks or decisions where required.   
 Key Responsibilities 
 Taking ownership of BAU product activities across the Standard Life International portfolio, including product maintenance, periodic reviews, customer literature and product-related queries. 
 •   Coordinating product changes from initial assessment through to implementation, ensuring requirements, decisions, actions and supporting evidence are clearly documented and progressed. 
 •   Providing product expertise to the strategic migration programme, including product analysis, information gathering, requirements development, impact assessments, testing and issue resolution. 
 •   Assessing the impact of product and platform changes on customers, advisers, operational processes and existing product terms, escalating material concerns and recommending appropriate actions. 
 •   Working closely with Proposition, Operations, Digital, Technology and Change colleagues to translate product requirements into practical delivery outcomes. 
 •   Reviewing product and customer information for accuracy, consistency and alignment with product terms, regulatory requirements and agreed customer outcomes. 
 •   Preparing clear papers, updates and recommendations for working groups and governance forums, and presenting product matters where appropriate. 
 •   Maintaining effective product records, trackers, processes and governance evidence to support oversight, decision-making and audit readiness. 
 •   Identifying and managing risks, issues and dependencies across BAU and migration activity, using judgement to resolve matters or escalate where necessary. 
 •   Supporting test planning, execution, defect assessment, implementation and post-delivery review for product and migration changes. 
 •   Building strong stakeholder relationships and acting as a reliable product contact across BAU and programme activity. 
 •   Sharing product knowledge with colleagues and contributing to continuous improvement across product processes and ways of working. 
 •   Ensuring customer outcomes, regulatory obligations and internal governance standards remain central to all activity. 
   Key Skills: 
 Experience working in a product, proposition, operations or change role within financial services. 
 •   Knowledge of life and pensions products, customer journeys and associated operational processes is desirable. 
 •   Knowledge of Standard Life products and propositions is desirable. 
 •   Ability to take ownership of defined activities and deliver work with a good level of independence, while recognising when guidance or escalation is required. 
 •   Experience assessing product or customer impacts and translating detailed information into clear requirements, recommendations or actions. 
 •   Ability to manage competing priorities across BAU and project activity, with strong organisation and attention to detail. 
 •   Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear governance material and explain product matters to different audiences. 
 •   A collaborative approach and confidence working with stakeholders across business and technical teams. 
 •   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgement and a practical approach to resolving issues. 
 •   A customer-focused mindset and a good understanding of the importance of regulatory, risk and governance requirements. 
 •   A willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues and continue developing broader product expertise. 
 We want to hire the whole version of you. 
 We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we’ve advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we’d love to hear from you.  
   If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best.  
 We’re reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out. 
 Find out more about working at Standard Life 
 Guide for Candidates:  standardlifeplc.pagetiger.com/guideforcandidates 
 Find or get answers from our colleagues:  www.standardlifeplc.com/careers/talk-to-us 
   
 We value diversity in our workforce and welcome enquiries from everyone.

description:
Reception Officer – Resident Support Location: County Limerick
 Contract: Temporary, with potential for permanency
 Working hours: Initially 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase to full-time hours quickly
 Work pattern: On-site
 We are recruiting a Reception Officer to join a residential accommodation service in County Limerick. This is a temporary position initially offering 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase to full-time hours relatively quickly. There is also the possibility of the role becoming permanent.
 This is not a traditional administrative reception role. It is a people-focused position supporting residents with their day-to-day needs, accessing essential services and integrating into the wider community.
 We are looking for someone with a relevant Level 7 qualification, strong communication skills and a genuine interest in supporting vulnerable individuals.
 About Your New Employer You will join a resident-focused accommodation service committed to providing a safe, welcoming and supportive environment.
 Working alongside an experienced welfare team, you will help residents access healthcare, education, counselling, community services and other essential supports.
 This is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference to people's lives while gaining valuable experience in a varied and rewarding support role.
 About Your New Job As a Reception Officer, you will provide practical assistance to residents, identify individual support needs and work closely with internal teams and external organisations to ensure residents receive appropriate support.
 Your main responsibilities will include: 
 Supporting residents in accessing healthcare, education, counselling, family support and community services.
 Identifying vulnerable residents and recognising emerging or previously unidentified support needs.
 Assisting with the development and implementation of individual integration and support plans.
 Building relationships with local healthcare providers, schools, charities, community groups and voluntary organisations.
 Liaising with external agencies and national support organisations to coordinate services and referrals.
 Responding to residents' questions, concerns and complaints in a professional, compassionate and respectful manner.
 Working closely with the internal welfare team and escalating safeguarding concerns or emerging support needs appropriately.
 Promoting residents' wellbeing, dignity, safety, independence and integration into the local community.
 Maintaining confidentiality and following relevant policies, procedures and professional standards.
 What You Need Essential: 
 A Level 7 qualification in Social Care or an equivalent relevant discipline.
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage respectfully with people from diverse backgrounds.
 A compassionate, patient and proactive approach to supporting vulnerable individuals.
 The ability to recognise individual support needs, provide appropriate information and make effective referrals.
 Strong professional boundaries and a commitment to confidentiality, dignity and equal treatment.
 Willingness to undergo Garda vetting.
 Full permission to work in Ireland.
 Nice to Have: 
 Previous experience in social care, resident support, mental health, community services or care planning.
 Experience working in a regulated care or support environment.
 Experience supporting individuals from diverse cultural and social backgrounds.
 Knowledge of local healthcare, community and voluntary support services.
 What's on Offer 20 hours per week initially, with the potential to increase to full-time hours quickly. 
 Temporary contract with the possibility of becoming permanent. 
 Opportunity to gain valuable experience in a rewarding, people-focused environment.
 Staff meals.
 VHI and pension scheme, subject to eligibility.
 Ongoing training and professional development.
 Opportunity to work collaboratively with healthcare professionals, welfare teams and community organisations.
 Right to Work Applicants must have full permission to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
 What's Next? If you hold a relevant Level 7 qualification and are interested in a rewarding resident-support role with the potential for increased hours and long-term employment, we would love to hear from you.
 Apply now or contact Niall Holmes at Sigmar Recruitment on 021 484 5132 for a confidential discussion.
 If this position isn't quite right for you, please get in touch to discuss other permanent and temporary opportunities.

The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.
Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses.   We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.
Why this job matters
The Cloud Engineering Specialist independently implements core infrastructure and security services in Amazon Web Services to deliver highly available and scalable services, automating time intensive processes whilst and meeting security and compliance objectives in all aspects of the secure cloud ecosystem.
This job role can be based in London, Cheltenham or Ipswich. Onsite (5 days office based). Monday-Friday 9am-5pm. DV Security Clearance is required. Must have lived in UK for 10+ years to obtain clearance.
What you’ll be doing
Be hands on in the build and development of world class secure cloud-based solutions as part of an agile delivery team.
Lead the design of cloud solutions.
Work directly with our customers to understand their requirements.
Working with support teams to enable management and monitoring of cloud-based systems, and their ongoing support.
Provide some third line support to deployed cloud-based solutions.
Line manage several more junior members of the team, assisting them in their professional development.

Cloud Architecture/Design
Cloud Migration
Cloud Deployment
Software Development for Cloud
Agile Methodologies

Have experience utilising AWS cloud services, both compute and appropriate managed services.
Have expertise in developing for cloud, with experience in iterative full-stack development in appropriate languages (for example node.js or Python).
Have experience in delivering Kubernetes or AWS EKS solutions.
Have experience managing infrastructure-as-code, for example using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
Have experience managing or mentoring more junior colleagues.
You might even
Have some experience with CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Jenkins.
Have experience automating specific management and maintenance activities, to support BAU tasks in complex systems environments. (e.g. new cloud account creation, bulk user management, environment housekeeping, monitoring and compliance).
Have familiarity with micro-service and container based deployment strategies, and a zero trust authorization model.
Some experience in the migration of on-prem solution to AWS.
Have experience with other cloud platforms such as Azure and GCP.

10% on target bonus (Depending on country based)
BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
Huge range of flexible benefits including cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan
World-class training and development opportunities

Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.​
24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues​
2 weeks paid carer’s leave ​
World-class training and development opportunities​
Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes.

Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
#LI-Onsite
Security is one of the fastest growing parts of our global organisation. We are protecting our networks from more than 6,500 cyber attacks each day, investing over £40m in research each year - and in employing nearly 3,000 people, we’re also the largest private cyber employer in the UK.  With incredible opportunities to learn, develop and grow your skills, we’ll invest in you, nurture your potential and shape your future – whatever your background or experience.
In today’s world, safe and secure digital connections have never been more vital. You’ll be joining a global company operating at the forefront of the information age: BT employs 90,000 people in 180 countries. With huge scale, we’re capable of achieving great things, striving to be personal, simple, and brilliant for our customers whilst creating an inclusive working environment where people from all backgrounds can succeed. title: AI Engineer
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 What can you expect? 
 Marsh is a global leader in insurance broking and risk management, serving clients in over 130 countries. The AI Center of Excellence is a newly formed team with a singular mission: get emerging AI capabilities into the hands of Marsh engineers and business teams as fast as the technology landscape moves.
 
 We're looking for an AI Engineer who wants to live on the cutting edge of AI. You'll be the person who picks up preview-stage technologies — new LLM approaches, memory systems, agentic deployment frameworks, guardrails, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling — runs rapid proofs-of-concept and turns the successful ones into production-ready capabilities that the rest of Marsh can adopt.
 
 This is an individual contributor role, but you'll become the recognised subject-matter expert in one or more AI technology areas. That means coaching your peers in the AI CoE, presenting internally, and — critically — ensuring that both human engineers and autonomous AI coding agents across the enterprise are configured to use these technologies correctly and select them ahead of alternatives.
 
 We will count on you to: 
 Run focused proofs-of-concept — typically one or two at a time — to evaluate emerging AI technologies against real Marsh use cases, moving from experiment to recommendation at speed
 Select and recommend technologies for adoption, producing clear guidance on when and why to use them
 Productionise chosen capabilities with repeatable, infrastructure-as-code deployment patterns using Crossplane across AWS, Azure, and other hyperscaler clouds, then hand operational ownership to the appropriate platform teams
 Direct AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and others) — ensuring they are technically configured to leverage new technologies, select them appropriately, and follow Marsh standards
 Become a subject-matter expert in one or more AI technology domains (e.g. memory and retrieval, agent orchestration, guardrails and safety, MCP tooling) and coach peers across Marsh on those topics
 Engage with business units across Marsh through architecture forums, dev councils, and other channels to understand needs and feed requirements back into the PoC pipeline
 Share knowledge internally through blog posts, demos, and presentations — keeping the wider engineering community informed about what's coming and what's ready
 
 What you need to have: Strong software engineering experience in Python and/or TypeScript , with a track record of shipping production systems — not just prototypes
 Hands-on experience with AI engineering : integrating, deploying, instrumenting, and operating LLM-based systems (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, agent frameworks, evaluation, observability)
 Experience writing infrastructure-as-code for cloud deployments (Crossplane preferred; Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK experience transfers well)
 Comfort working across multiple cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) rather than deep specialism in one
 Strong intellectual curiosity and high standards — you actively track emerging technology, learn quickly, and care about doing excellent work
 The ability to evaluate a new technology quickly and form a clear recommendation
 Excellent communication skills, able to explain a complex technical decision to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
 
 What makes you stand out: Breadth of programming language experience beyond Python/TypeScript — Rust, Go , or others that demonstrate curiosity and range
 Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — building or consuming MCP servers and tools
 Experience with Crossplane or Kubernetes-based infrastructure management
 Exposure to AI safety and guardrails frameworks (content filtering, prompt injection defence, output validation)
 Experience configuring or extending AI coding assistants (custom instructions, tool integration, workspace configuration)
 Background in fine-tuning or adapting foundation models
 
 What makes this role different: You'll use things before anyone else. Preview APIs, beta frameworks, technologies that don't have Stack Overflow answers yet.
 You'll shape technical direction. Your PoC outcomes and recommendations directly influence which technologies Marsh adopts across the enterprise.
 You'll onboard humans and machines. You'll ensure that AI coding agents across the organisation are configured to use the right tools in the right way.
 You'll be one of the first members of the AI CoE. You'll help shape ways of working, team culture, and technical standards as the team grows.
 You'll have the tools you need. Access to AI models, tools, tokens, and broader professional development opportunities.
 
 Why join our team: We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.
 #MMCIC
 
 
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit corporate.marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Design Assurance Engineer, Device Technical Operations ( 18 Months FTC )
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Design Assurance Engineer, Device Technical Operations role will make an impact:
 
 Key responsibilities for this role include:
 Provide Design Assurance oversight and support to the creation and maintenance of Technical Documentation supporting development and on-market combination products / medical devices.

 Provide Design Assurance oversight for the transfer of manufacturing of Devices and Combination Products from the Global Device Development (GDD) Group in R&D to commercial manufacturing sites as per the GDD design control process in compliance with ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820.

 Manage, review, and approve change controls issued from the commercial site or from GDD which are deemed to impact the device/combination product.

 Provide Design Assurance support on site as required at suppliers or manufacturing sites for device-related complaints, support device-related investigations to root cause and the establishment of appropriate corrective actions.

 
 The minimum qualifications for this role are:  
 
 Degree in Engineering/Science 

 Previous experience of Design Assurance in device development or high volume GMP manufacturing environment for devices and/or combination products.

 Experience authoring technical reports and producing high quality documentation within a regulatory controlled GMP environment.

 Experience in quality management, ideally in the medical device industry or another regulated environment

 A working knowledge of MDR 2017/745, ISO 14971, ISO 13485 & FDA 21 CFR Part 820 Design Control requirements,  would be an advantage.

 It is essential that the candidate will be both highly innovative and well organized, having excellent planning and communication skills and able to operate across all site teams.

 The candidate must be able to work under pressure and have a proven track record of problem solving and effective time management.

 Willingness to travel as necessary between the Global Device Development Teams, Affiliates & suppliers.

 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits, and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives, and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.

title: Quality System Specialist
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Our global portfolio includes best-in-class, iconic brand-name products as well as global key brands; generics, including branded and complex generics; and other offerings across a wide range of therapeutic areas. We are committed to helping create healthier communities worldwide through education, outreach and better access to treatment. 
 
 For those driven to live their lives with purpose, Viatris helps employees realise their full potential by creating a collaborative culture that fosters courage and resilience. Viatris is more than just a place to work. This is a place to make a difference in the world. 
 
 The Role & What You Will Be Doing 
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Quality System Specialist role will make an impact: 
 
 Review of third party GxP documentation to support batch disposition of respiratory products.

 Management and review of product complaints

 To manage and develop the change control system in accordance with the relevant SOPs and to coordinate the follow up and closure of all open items.

 To manage the Pre-Market Supply Incident (PMSI) and deviation systems, including, but not limited to, the raising of PMSI/deviation records in the Trackwise system, assisting in investigations to determine root causes and the review of third-party investigation reports to ensure that root causes are determined and CAPAs (where applicable) have been implemented.

 To ensure Quality Technical Agreements (QTAs) are in place with affiliate and third party suppliers/service providers as appropriate.

 To manage product returns as per current GDP guidelines.

 To manage and coordinate the approval of new vendors and customers as per GDP guidelines.

 To carry out annual Bona Fide checks on suppliers and customers as per GDP guidelines.

 Carry out annual reviews/assessments on vendors and service providers to ensure appropriate performance of third party suppliers/service providers.

 To maintain and coordinate the MAH systems (e.g. Product Lists, QTAs, PQRs).

 To carry out annual reviews of manufacturing/packaging/release PQRs as part of the company’s responsibilities as QP release site and Marketing Authorisation Holder.

 To maintain and update the department’s training and Learning Management systems.

 Coordinate the distribution of wholesale related SOPs to relevant non-QA staff through the Learning Management System.

 The administration and conducting of risk assessments.

 To maintain and develop the SOP system in relation to the update, logging and distribution of SOPs.

 To support the self-inspection system.

 Actively support the development and implementation of the Quality Management System at Mylan Regional EU.

 Provide weekly and/or monthly KPIs for relevant systems to management.

 Compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Distribution Practices (GDP) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure an audit ready facility.

 To adhere to all company and legislative health, safety and environmental requirements.

 Any other duties as assigned by the Quality Systems Manager/Quality Director.

 About Your Skills & Experience 
 For this role, we’re looking for a candidate who has an effective combination of the following qualifications, skills and experiences:
 
 Degree in a scientific, pharmaceutical or related discipline.

 Experience working in a Quality Assurance, Quality Systems or Quality Compliance role within the pharmaceutical industry.

 Strong knowledge and practical experience of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and Quality Management Systems (QMS).

 Experience managing deviations, investigations, root cause analysis and CAPAs.

 Experience managing and coordinating Change Controls through to timely closure.

 Experience reviewing GxP documentation and working with third-party manufacturing sites, suppliers or service providers.

 Experience using an electronic Quality Management System, ideally TrackWise.

 Experience with supplier/vendor qualification, quality oversight and performance management.

 
 
 
 
 Benefits at Viatris 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. Some of our benefits include the following on top of a competitive salary:
 
 Excellent career progression opportunities

 Work-life balance initiatives

 Bonus scheme

 Health insurance

 Pension

 
 
 Diversity & Inclusion at Viatris 
 At Viatris, diversity and inclusion are essential to our mission. The diversity we foster in all aspects of our business can be one of our greatest strengths in redefining healthcare not as it is, but as it should be. If you would like to know more about what diversity, equity and inclusion means to us, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/Careers/Diversity-and-Inclusion 
 
 
 
 Sustainability at Viatris 
 Corporate social responsibility is fundamental to the Viatris mission. We work to advance responsible and sustainable operations and leverage our collective expertise to empower people to live healthier at every stage of life, recognizing that our actions affect the stakeholders and communities we serve. To learn more about our efforts, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/about-us/corporate-responsibility

The commercial organisation is responsible for the marketing and sales of Ornua’s consumer brands including Ireland’s most successful food export: Kerrygold. It also manages the procurement of Irish and non-Irish dairy products, the sale of dairy ingredients to food manufacturing and foodservice customers globally, and the implementation of de-risking and trading strategies to manage market volatility. HMI & SCADA systems.

description: Stakeholder/ Client Engagement Uses data to educate and influence hiring managers on talent acquisition strategy and linking this data to filling the roles. Interprets client's business and the industry landscape and/or university talent pools to influence the client to adopt optimal staffing solutions. Identifies opportunities to optimize policies, systems, and processes. Develops sourcing strategy using market and channel insights. Develops multi-channel strategies to contribute to differentiated talent in emerging roles or highly competitive talent pools to meet long-term business needs (e.g., industry, technical recruiting). Executes initial screening and assessing of candidates. Bachelor's Degree AND relevant talent acquisition experience (e.g recruiting, sourcing, campus hiring) OR equivalent experience. Strong critical thinking, judgment capability and communications skills, with the ability to engage and consult in strategic hiring discussions. Proficient with a data-driven approach to recruiting, using talent insights, hiring data & competitor analysis to drive impactful hiring outcomes. Full-cycle experience in engineering or technical recruitment, with deep understanding on different technology stacks. Experience in university recruiting or volume hiring for early-in-career talents. Strong planning, program and event management skills is a plus. Experience in leveraging technology/AI, in process improvements and/or scaling hiring programs.

What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.
How do you connect with other members of the Armed Forces Community at Expleo?
I participate in careers  transition workshops supporting recruiters. When Ex-Forces  are looking for a new career, I attend the workshops chatting  to the Armed Forces community sharing my experience and  what I have learned.
What advice would you give to other members of the Armed Forces Community who are planning to join Expleo?
Expleo has many different opportunities, whether it be leadership management, various jobs in engineering, project management etc. Don’t think that you don’t have the skill set to join Expleo. It is within you; you do have those skills and Expleo can bring out these skills in people.

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Global Product Lifecycle Engineer, you will provide electrical infrastructure support to AWS data centers. You will collaborate with the product development team to gain a deep understanding of all facets of each product as they are being developed and tested, then take engineering ownership of the product through its operational life. You will be a global subject matter expert for electrical products deployed in data centers.

We are looking for engineers with hands-on design, manufacturing, and installation experience. The right candidate will have led product design efforts, have an understanding of electronics, and know how products should be manufactured to ensure quality. They should be capable of understanding detailed equipment specifications and evaluating the merit and risks of design changes.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but is not expected to exceed 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be required. Contributions could include leading international projects and developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary.

Key job responsibilities
- Review, update, and approve equipment submittals
- Work with global electrical equipment suppliers and manufacturers
- Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g. reliability, operations, design, compliance)
- Work on concurrent projects, in multiple geographic zones
- Understand and explain complex systems in clear and concise language
- Provide support to Field Engineering for root cause analysis, with collaboration with quality team for component-level investigations, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for both mechanical and electrical issues.
- Listen to the voice of the customer to understand if there are improvements that can be made to increase product reliability or availability.
- Work with global supplier and manufacturers to design product improvements, and to oversee root cause analysis.
- Contribute to our global body of knowledge and drive a cycle of continuous improvement at a global scale

In this role, you'll focus on the electrical products that form the backbone of AWS data centers worldwide. You might start your day reviewing equipment submittals and specifications, then transition into a collaborative session with our product development team to understand how new electrical systems are being designed and tested. You'll work across multiple geographic zones simultaneously, sometimes supporting field engineering teams through root cause analysis investigations, other times partnering with global suppliers to explore design improvements. Your work includes translating complex electrical systems into clear documentation and guidance for operations teams, while staying connected to how your decisions impact customer reliability and availability. You'll also contribute to our collective knowledge base, sharing insights that help drive continuous improvement across our global infrastructure.

About the team
The Electrical Products and Services team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, we are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. We drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to Senior Leadership. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
- Traveling to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
- Being a leader within the global group as well as within internal and external teams that support Amazon’s data centers.
- Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

A day in the life
As an Electrical Engineer on our team, you'll focus on designing robust electrical distribution systems that keep our data centers running at world-class uptime. Your day might include developing design specifications, reviewing and marking up technical drawings, collaborating with cross-functional teams on equipment qualifications, conducting site inspections, responding to design inquiries, and presenting your work to stakeholders. You'll move fluidly between desk-based design work and on-site activities, ensuring designs translate seamlessly from concept to construction. You'll also have opportunities to explore new technologies and construction methods that could improve how we build and operate our facilities.

About the team
The team consists of Electrical Engineers with Design Engineering backgrounds (typically having worked as Consulting Engineers with wide ranging experience), many ex-electricians with a practical knowledge of the systems they are designing. 

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:
Join us, be part of more.  
 
 We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that's energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels, whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion, and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently - we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it, and mend it.  
  
 About your team:  
 
 At Centrica Business Solutions, we’re proud to partner with over 7,000 organisations globally – helping them to balance planet, with profit. We build, operate and maintain onsite, large-scale energy assets like Solar PV and Combined Heat and Power – to help businesses to save the planet and save money. We’re also transforming the UK’s energy landscape by partnering with landowners and developers to build a 900MW portfolio of new grid-scale solar farms and battery storage assets.
 
 We have a great opportunity for a Shift Operations Electrical AP for a key role in our Data Centre Operations, which provides best in class operation and maintenance for our customers critical power generation sites.
 
 The role focuses on system monitoring, implementation of procedures and SSOW, equipment checks and system maintenance and repairs for the client equipment.
 
 The role would suit a candidate who possesses the skills necessary to effectively interpret data from multiple sources, react promptly to event notifications and follow established procedures to rectify and escalate issues, in line with contractual obligations.
 
 About the role: 
 Monitoring customer assets to maximise efficiency in line with contractual terms
 Managing and prioritising incoming event notifications to comply with relevant contractual obligations
 Providing professional, concise communications to a variety of internal and external customers and stakeholders
 Maintain accurate records of all tasks undertaken on the monitoring tool and asset management system.
 Ensuring a comprehensive and thorough handover takes place between shift teams to maintain continuity of safe operations and ensure ongoing knowledge of work activities.
 Working efficiently in an SLA (Service Level Agreement) driven team environment
 Daily site inspections of mechanical & electrical engineering systems and technical equipment.
 Ensure the site's environmental conditions provide a safe work environment.
 React to Building Management System alarms, and complete emergency actions as set out in the agreed procedures.
 Issue permits and oversight of third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with company-developed processes, procedures, and all applicable laws and regulations.
 Producing reports detailing asset availability and performance patterns
 Adhering to all applicable company policies, procedures and business ethics codes
 Provide support to the maintenance team during maintenance activities.
 
 Here's what we're looking for: 
 Previous experience working in a mission critical and/or power generation environment.
 Good IT literacy, ability to write and develop documents, SOPs/EOPs. 
 A good understanding of CMMS (Maintenance Management Systems) is desirable but not essential.
 Familiar with UPS & battery systems.
 Experience in carrying out electrical switching activities & testing (LV).
 Good understanding of LOTO (Lock Out/Tag Out) practices, hazardous energy and permit systems 
 NFQ L6 (Tradesperson) or equivalent in an electrical discipline, or other technical fields will be considered.
 Engineering Degree is desirable but not essential. 
 
 
 
 Why should you apply?   
  
We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.  
  
 https://www.morethanacareer.energy/cbs  
   
 If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.    
   
Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

 Job Title: Software Engineer (Backend)
   
 Department & Team: JM & EDP — Journey Data Team
   
 Location: Galway (Flexible, 2–3 office days per week)
   
 Summary 
 We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to join the Journey Data team at Genesys.
 You will be responsible for helping to build out the Genesys Cloud’s Event Data Platform, a key pillar for Agentic Orchestration in Genesys.
 You will work closely with a team of engineers and product managers to ideate, build, operate, and scale customer-facing features across the full software development lifecycle.
 You will get the opportunity to work with exciting technologies like Amazon Web Services (cloud computing), Jenkins (CI/CD), New Relic & Sumo Logic (monitoring/telemetry), and a wide array of proprietary Genesys software. 
 You will be part of our transition into an AI-assisted world, helping us adopt and develop new AI tooling like Skills, Agents, and MCPs to redefine the way we work, deliver software, and bring intelligence into our products.
 About Our Team 
 Our team is key contributor to the Event Data Platform, mainly centred around Customer Journey.
 Some of our key focus areas include Customer Segmentation – grouping customers by shared attributes and behaviours to provide context and enrichment for personalisation across both traditional and agentic orchestration, and Predictive Engagement – proactively engaging with web and mobile visitors to provide assistance at critical points in their customer journey.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Data Centre Engineering
description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer who can perform design engineering activities for new build projects. You will become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print across the EMEA region.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective mechanical services systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to senior management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. You will have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on. Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. 

We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

If you can design a mechanical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data centre and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
