title: Client Side - Construction Coordinator - West Dublin
description:
In-depth Job Spec 
 Client Side Construction Coordinator – Strong Financials – West Dublin – Long Term Opportunities 

 The Opportunity 
 We are working with a leading international engineering, construction management and project delivery consultancy to appoint a Functional Area Construction Coordinator to support the delivery of a major manufacturing project in West Dublin.
 This is a highly site-focused position, suited to an experienced Construction Coordinator, General Foreman, Trade Foreman, Tool Install Coordinator or Construction Supervisor who has previously worked within a clean room or similarly controlled high-tech construction environment.

 You will act as the focal point for construction and trade activities within your assigned Functional Area (FA) / Tool Install area, reporting to the Project Manager and taking responsibility for implementing the agreed construction plan on the ground.
 The role will involve significant time in the field, coordinating trades, removing constraints, driving safety and quality, and ensuring individual tools, systems and areas are delivered through the required construction milestones.

 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Take ownership of construction coordination within your assigned Functional Area / Tool Install area.
 Coordinate all relevant trade activities and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently and in the correct sequence.
 Develop detailed project and installation plans for individual tools, systems and work areas.
 Work closely with trade foremen to establish daily work plans, crew requirements, start dates, completion dates and priorities.
 Maintain a strong site presence, with the majority of the working day spent in the field coordinating contractors and monitoring progress.
 Lead Area Whiteboard meetings and attend daily huddles, weekly team meetings, toolbox talks and construction coordination meetings.
 Track mobilisation of trades and ensure the correct crews are available when required.
 Use task lists, constraint logs and short-term planning tools to improve coordination between trades.
 Participate in the six-week lookahead planning process, identifying potential blockers before they impact the programme.
 Identify and remove constraints affecting trade productivity, escalating issues promptly where required.
 Coordinate construction activities between Tool Install, supporting systems, other Functional Areas and wider projects on site.
 Coordinate field issue resolution and bring in the appropriate technical specialists when required.
 Drive punch lists towards zero outstanding items at the appropriate construction milestone.
 Coordinate demolition works associated with conversion activities where applicable.
 Maintain and update daily progress records and construction reporting.
 
 Safety & Site Leadership Safety will be a major part of this position. You will:
 Drive an Incident and Injury-Free culture throughout your Functional Area.
 Review Pre-Task Plans and participate in toolbox meetings, kick-off meetings and risk assessments.
 Ensure contractors and trade personnel operate in accordance with their approved safety plans.
 Participate in safety audits and required operating procedures.
 Maintain high housekeeping standards throughout construction areas.
 Address and report safety events in line with site requirements.
 
 Quality & Controlled Environment 
 You will take responsibility for ensuring works are delivered to the required standard, including:
 Working closely with relevant teams to implement QA/QC and quality programmes.
 Walking tools and systems ahead of key milestones to verify installation quality.
 Driving 100% design-to-field implementation.
 Ensuring contractor compliance with site protocols and controlled-environment requirements.
 Coordinating clean-as-you-go requirements and appropriate material storage.a.
 Driving the required final clean standard at construction completion.
 
 What We’re Looking For 
 This position requires someone who is comfortable being out on site, owning an area and coordinating multiple trades simultaneously.

 Having previous on-site management experience and stakeholder engagement (client, multiple subcontractors, architects, local authorities etc). 

 Clean room environment experience, data centre / semiconductor / pharmaceutical etc, is preferred.
 Ability to coordinate multiple trades within a live, fast-moving construction environment.
 Excellent safety awareness and a proactive approach to site safety.
 Strong understanding of QA/QC, punch-list management and construction close-out.
 Comfortable working within a highly controlled and process-driven construction environment.
 Good general IT skills and ability to maintain construction trackers, reports, task lists and project documentation.
 The overall requirement is for an experienced construction professional with 5+ years' relevant education / industry experience, depending on qualification and background .

 
 What You’ll Get in Return 
 This is an opportunity to work in one of Ireland's most significant high-tech construction environments, joining an established international engineering and project management organisation with extensive experience delivering complex semiconductor, pharmaceutical, biotech and advanced manufacturing facilities .

 You will benefit from: 
 A brilliant working environment, flexibility on hours and very good financials. 
 Hourly paid up to €45.00 per hour – 40–45 hours per week. 
 Exposure to a major clean room construction programme.
 A highly responsible position where you will have genuine ownership of your Functional Area.
 The opportunity to work alongside experienced construction, engineering and project management professionals.
 Exposure to complex tool installation, clean room and advanced manufacturing construction.
 Excellent experience for anyone looking to build a long-term career within the high-tech construction sector.
 A technically challenging project environment with significant coordination responsibility.
 The opportunity to work with specialist contractors and multidisciplinary construction teams.
 

 All applications and enquiries will be treated with the strictest confidenc e. Apply within for more information, or details on similar roles. 

#LI-DNI

At ADI we strive to be Ahead of What’s Possible .

Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure.  As ADI continues to grow its software capability, we’re also focussed on building expertise in Machine Learning and AI.  We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real.
 
 One Company, Unlimited Opportunity; The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities.  From our Graduate Rotation Program to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success.
 
 What's the secret to our success? It's very simple – we treat our employees as our greatest asset.

 Good communication skills, both written and verbal.

 Must be open to work a 5-cycle shift pattern

title: Technician 2, Facilities Technician
description:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
           
 ADI’s products play a fundamental role in converting real-world phenomena such as temperature, motion, pressure, light and sound into electrical signals to be used in a wide array of applications ranging from industrial process control, factory automation, radar systems and CAT scanners to cellular base stations and telephones, broadband networking, computers, cars and digital cameras.

 Here at ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. A career with ADI means taking part in innovation and being challenged to achieve, as well as the opportunity to work with other talented people, using state-of-the art processes and equipment.

 The Role: 

 An opportunity has arisen on-shift within the Plant Facilities group for a Technician in support of the following key Operational and Business goals of the Plant: 
 Facilities Plant Maintenance & Operation
 Key Project Implementation
 Troubleshooting all areas of the plant as required.
 
 The Facilities Maintenance Technician will use their knowledge of engineering principles to provide frontline support to the operation of equipment issues as they arise.  They will carry out the following:
 Planned and Unplanned Maintenance activities
 Work to Operating Specifications
 Participate in Training and Development
 Work in full EHS compliance at all times
 Implement BKM’s for PM`s and engineering practices
 Troubleshooting / Root cause Analysis
 Installations, procurement, upgrades, and modifications
 
 Key Responsibilities: 

 The performance of electrical and mechanical troubleshooting and the resolution of issues with electro‑mechanical equipment across the plant.
 Dismantling, adjustment, repair, and assembly of equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, sketches or drawings. 
 The use of test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts.
 May perform equipment modifications as directed by facilities engineers.
 Facilities plant includes the DI water and effluent treatment plants, chilled water systems, MTHW boilers, air handing systems, acid scrubbers, gas and chemical delivery systems, central vacuum, compressed air, BMS, gas detection systems etc.
 The role of the support technician is to maintain the supply of services to, and the operating conditions within the cleanrooms to strict specification with regards to temperature, humidity, and particle counts. This requires the maintenance of pressure profiles across areas, regular validations and responding to out of control and stop work notifications.
 
 The suitable candidate will have the following: 

 A minimum level 7 degree or have a level 6 qualification in a relevant trade discipline with experience. 
 A strong engineering knowledge.
 A thorough understanding of equipment hardware – electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum, etc.
 Good decision-making skills and a logical approach to problem solving
 Good interpersonal and communication skills.
 Will be Quality/Safety mindset.
 
 
 For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export  licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.  As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

Experience with Active Directory.

This role is a full-time position, and a full-clean driving license is required.

Strong stakeholder management skills.
Professional and customer-focused approach.
Personal Attributes

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Telecom Operations Engineer, Amazon Connect, Amazon Connect
description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, our vision is to provide business applications leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' success through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions which solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect Customer is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect Customer has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

The Amazon Connect Customer Telecom Engineering team is responsible for provisioning and maintaining connectivity to global telecom carriers, managing the backend telecom infrastructure, and troubleshooting customer issues related to telephony. The SBC (Session Border Controller) service is owned by the team and is used to route calls between Amazon Connect Customer and telecom carriers. 

We are seeking Systems Engineers who are experts in SIP/VoIP to join our team to help us support and expand the Amazon Connect Customer's telecom infrastructure. Amazon Connect Customer supports thousands of concurrent customer calls and tens of thousands of agents using an internally developed SIP based Call Center Platform. Our technology is compelling, as it solves a common problem in a novel way — and it is unique in the industry. We are looking for engineers to help us expand our infrastructure to new global regions, support existing implementations, and innovate telecom network operations through tooling and processes to improve customer productivity. Be part of the team that handles large amount of phone calls, among the largest in contact center platforms globally. 

About the team
Diverse Experiences 
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS 
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance 
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. 
Inclusive Team Culture 
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
- Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
- Experience working with Linux
- Experience in systems engineering
- Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent

- Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
- Experience working in 24/7 production environment
- Experience with service-oriented architecture and web services
- Experience solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry
- Experience with open-source VoIP systems like Asterisk, Free-Switch, SIPp, SER

Job Title:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Regional (Global Support)
Posting Start Date:
10/23/26
Job Description:
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that. We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Sales Development Representative. Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this full-time and permanent position is based in Kuala Lumpur and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our team and its’ growth.
This role is responsible for managing both inbound and outbound lead engagement, working closely with Marketing and Sales to convert interest into qualified opportunities.
As part of a global SDR team, you will operate within a coordinated “all bound” approach — combining marketing-generated leads, proactive outreach, and account-based engagement to drive consistent pipeline growth.
Key Responsibilities
Lead Generation & Prospect Engagement
Manage and respond promptly to marketing-generated inbound leads, conducting initial outreach and qualification to assess business needs, fit, and potential opportunities.
Identify, research, and proactively engage target accounts and decision-makers through outbound prospecting activities, including email campaigns, phone outreach, and social selling channels such as LinkedIn.
Build and nurture relationships with prospects to generate qualified sales opportunities and maintain a healthy pipeline.
Pipeline Development & Sales Alignment
Drive consistent pipeline growth through a combination of inbound and outbound lead generation strategies.
Collaborate closely with Marketing to leverage campaigns, content, and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives in support of prospect engagement and opportunity creation.
Partner with Sales teams to align on target accounts, strategic priorities, and opportunity development plans.
Lead Qualification & Opportunity Handoff
Qualify prospects against defined criteria, including ideal customer profile (ICP), business needs, decision-making process, budget, and timeline.
Arrange discovery meetings and ensure a seamless transition of qualified opportunities to Account Executives for further sales engagement.
Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders to support effective opportunity progression and conversion.
Regional Coverage & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Take ownership of Sales Development Representative (SDR) activities and performance within the assigned region, ensuring timely engagement with prospects and leads.
Provide support across additional regions when required to maintain global responsiveness and coverage.
Collaborate with global SDR teams to share market insights, best practices, and effective prospecting strategies.
CRM Management & Sales Enablement
Utilise CRM and sales engagement platforms, including HubSpot and Salesforce, to manage prospecting activities, track engagement, and maintain pipeline visibility.
Leverage automation tools, outreach sequences, and sales playbooks to optimise productivity and prospect engagement efforts.
Ensure accurate, complete, and up-to-date customer and prospect records within all systems.
Performance & Reporting
Meet or exceed established performance targets, including meetings booked, qualified opportunities generated, and pipeline contribution.
Monitor, analyse, and report on key activity and performance metrics to identify trends, improve effectiveness, and support business objectives.
Maintain high standards of data quality, activity tracking, and reporting accuracy.
Key Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
1 to 3 years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, Lead Generation, Inside Sales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and build rapport with prospects across various channels.
Experience using CRM and sales engagement platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar tools is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritise both inbound lead follow-up and outbound prospecting activities effectively.
Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and a disciplined approach to maintaining accurate CRM data.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Comfortable collaborating within a remote and globally distributed team environment.
Self-motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve or exceed performance targets.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently generates qualified sales opportunities and contributes to a healthy and growing sales pipeline.
Responds promptly and effectively to inbound leads, ensuring a positive prospect experience and timely qualification.
Successfully executes outbound prospecting and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives to engage target accounts and decision-makers.
Maintains strong alignment and collaboration with Sales and Marketing teams to maximise pipeline generation and conversion outcomes.
Demonstrates a high level of CRM discipline through accurate data management, activity tracking, and reporting.
Achieves or exceeds key performance indicators, including meetings booked, qualified opportunities created, and pipeline contribution.
Adapts effectively to changing business priorities and supports cross-regional activities to ensure global coverage when required.
Working Style
Proactive and self-driven, taking ownership of goals and outcomes.
Resilient and persistent when engaging prospects and navigating objections.
Results-focused, with a strong commitment to achieving performance targets.
Collaborative and team-oriented, working effectively across functions, regions, and cultures.
Curious and growth-minded, continuously seeking opportunities to learn, improve, and adopt best practices.
Adaptable and agile, demonstrating flexibility in a dynamic and evolving business environment.
Company Benefits
At our Malaysia office, we believe in putting our employees’ well-being first! We offer a flexible hybrid working arrangement and birthday leave. Additionally, we provide comprehensive medical insurance and dental coverage, wellness allowance and competitive annual leave entitlement to support your well-being and time to recharge or explore your passions out of work. As advocates of continuous learning and professional development, we provide.an internal mentorship program and reimburse professional membership fees for certifications like ICSA, ensuring you stay ahead in your field.
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey.

Job Market Hanging in There
Recent jobless claims data point to a resilient U.S. labor market, with both initial and continuing claims remaining low and signaling that unemployment is still contained.
Chart is for illustrative purposes only. Past performance is not necessarily an indication of future results.
Over the last three months, average weekly initial jobless claims have stood at 212,000, near their lowest level in three years. Because initial jobless claims are also a leading economic indicator, these low levels suggest an economy where economic growth can remain positive.
Continuing jobless claims, which track the number of Americans already receiving unemployment benefits, are also at the lower end of their two-year range. Taken together with initial claims, these figures reinforce our view that the labor market remains resilient or good enough to continue to support positive economic growth.

Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
As a Sales Coach, you will work one on one with sellers to lift pipeline generation, deal quality, and forecast accuracy. This is a hands-on field coaching role. You will spend most of your week with sellers and in live deal work, and the rest building the programs that scale what works. You report to the manager of the department and partner closely with frontline sales managers, enablement, product marketing, and the teams integrating newly acquired sellers.
What you get to do in this role:
Coach sellers one on one - This is the center of the role. You will spend most of your week with individual sellers, working on whatever stands between them and their number.
● Run a recurring one-on-one coaching cadence with each assigned seller against a written individual development plan
● Coach the full seller motion—prospecting and outbound rigor, territory and account management, deal management and qualification, executive presence, time and calendar management, CRM accuracy and forecast hygiene, and personal change management through reorgs and portfolio shifts
● Facilitate role plays and certification checkpoints across discovery, executive conversations, pricing, objection handling, and competitive positioning, so mastery is demonstrated rather than assumed
● Observe live customer calls and give same-day feedback that names the specific behavior to change
Build coaching programs with your manager
● Partner with your manager to design programs that answer real business needs—segment ramp paths, focused skill sprints, manager coaching enablement, and remediation tracks
● Build segment-appropriate variants where Enterprise and Commercial need different treatment of the same skill—multi-stakeholder pursuit strategy and executive alignment on one side, call volume, cycle discipline, and portfolio juggling on the other
● Design coaching that scales across a large Commercial population without losing the personal quality that makes coaching work
● Contribute reusable assets back to the global library: playbooks, call frameworks, role play scenarios, and certification rubrics
● Pilot, measure, and retire—keep what moves the number and cut what does not
Support large-scale training events
● Help design and deliver org-wide moments: sales kickoff, bootcamps, mid-year kickoffs, product launch enablement, and field readiness days
● Own assigned tracks end to end—content, facilitators, breakout design, certification, and the reinforcement plan that follows
● Build the follow-through so event content shows up in seller behavior 30 and 60 days later
Document and report progress
● Build and maintain the documentation layer that makes coaching visible and auditable—rep scorecards, skill matrices, certification records, development plans, and progress over time
● Report coaching impact to sales and enablement leadership on a set cadence, tied to business results rather than activity counts
● Keep records consistent enough that another coach could pick up any rep and know exactly where they stand
Shorten time to productivity for new hires, transfers, and acquired teams
● Own the coaching side of ramp for new hires, internal transfers, and sellers joining through acquisition, with an explicit goal of moving time to productivity from roughly six months to three
● Build and run acquisition-specific enablement: cross-portfolio positioning, joint account mapping, tooling and process conversion, and the cultural onboarding that makes acquired sellers feel like part of the team quickly
● Track ramp milestones by cohort and flag an at-risk ramp early enough to fix it
● Give hiring managers a clear read on where each new seller stands and what they need next
Validate readiness on new products, releases, and acquisitions
● Assess whether sellers are genuinely equipped to sell new products, new releases, and newly acquired portfolios—measured through certification, call review, and pipeline evidence, not attendance
● Report readiness gaps to product, marketing, and enablement partners with a recommended fix and a date
● Re-test after remediation and close the loop
Qualifications
To be successful in this role you have:
● Seven or more years in enterprise or commercial software sales, sales management, or sales coaching and enablement
● Direct experience with both a large-deal Enterprise motion and a higher-velocity Commercial or mid-market motion, and a clear point of view on how coaching differs between them
● A track record of coaching adults to behavior change—specific sellers or teams who improved on a measurable metric because of your work
● Fluency in at least one recognized sales methodology, such as MEDDICC, Challenger, Strategic Selling, or Command of the Message, and the ability to coach to it rather than just describe it
● Strong CRM discipline—you can inspect a pipeline and tell the difference between a data problem and a deal problem
● Comfort with the enablement stack: CRM, conversation intelligence, sales content management, and a learning management system
● Credibility with senior sellers and frontline managers—this role carries influence, not authority
● Excellent facilitation and written communication skills, and the judgment to know when to teach and when to ask
Nice to Have:
● Prior quota-carrying experience at both Enterprise and Commercial
● Experience coaching across a multi-product or platform portfolio
● Formal coaching certification, such as ICF or equivalent
● Experience integrating an acquired sales team

title: Microbiology Analyst
description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. 
 Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies. 
 Eurofins PSS Insourcing Solutions® is a global, award-winning insourcing solution. We place our skilled team directly at the client site, managing operations seamlessly and eliminating complexities. We ensure a strategic, long-term service commitment that delivers value directly at the client’ site, utilising their facilities, equipment, and methodologies, while maintaining the same service, expertise, and cGMP compliance available at the Eurofins facility. If you're an employee seeking an exceptional career journey, Eurofins PSS Insourcing Solutions® is your gateway to a future where innovation, collaboration, and success converge. Join us in a world where excellence knows no boundaries! 
 We’re proud to be an armed forces-friendly place to work and welcome applications from reservists, armed forces veterans (including the wounded, injured and sick), as well as cadet instructors, and military spouses and partners. 
 If you want to continue to help make our world a safer and healthier place, then apply for the role below and become a part of the extraordinary Eurofins network. 

 Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. 
 This is a full time, 8 Month Fixed Term Contract, working 4 days on 4 days off, 07:00 - 19:00. 
 As a Microbiology Analyst you will work in a cross functional team to support the Microbiology Quality Control testing function, ensuring compliance with cGMP.
 Job Responsibilities 
 You will carry out environmental monitoring activities within GMP cleanroom and manufacturing environments, including viable and non-viable particulate monitoring, water and gas system monitoring, and pharmaceutical water system sampling and management.
 You will perform a range of microbiological analyses including bioburden, endotoxin, microbial identification, Biological Indicator, BacT/ALERT, sterility, growth promotion, and other laboratory sampling and testing activities to support client and regulatory requirements.
 You will review, trend, and interpret microbiological and analytical data, ensuring all results, documentation, and laboratory records are completed accurately, compliantly, and in line with GMP standards and client procedures.
 You will support investigations relating to deviations, provide technical expertise to identify root causes and solutions, contribute to protocol and report preparation, and assist in the continuous improvement of quality, service, and laboratory processes.
 You will collaborate closely with clients and colleagues, providing regular project updates, delivering exceptional customer service, maintaining strong working relationships, and ensuring all activities are conducted with integrity, quality, and regulatory compliance in mind.
 You will maintain a safe, organised, and audit-ready laboratory environment, keep training and documentation up to date, support the development of team members through training and knowledge sharing, and provide flexible operational support across the wider Eurofins team as required.
 

 What skills, qualifications and experiences you will hold as an Microbiology Analyst 
 You will hold a degree in Microbiology or a related scientific discipline and possess at least one year of experience within a pharmaceutical, GMP-regulated, or similarly controlled laboratory environment.
 You will have academic and/or practical environmental monitoring (EM) experience, along with a strong understanding of cGMP principles and the requirements for working effectively within a regulated laboratory setting.
 You will have the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, meet established timelines, and remain adaptable when responding to changing business and customer requirements.
 You will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships, collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients, and communicate technical information clearly and accurately.
 You will have strong organisational, documentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure, quickly learn new processes, and contribute to solutions as part of a collaborative team environment.
 You will have a customer-focused mindset, a passion for quality and continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering accurate, high-quality results while supporting the goals of a dynamic and growing Eurofins operation.
 

 At Eurofins we are growing, innovating and always learning. We celebrate the achievements of our employees through annual long service awards, recognise our colleagues special life events.
 As a Eurofins employee you will benefit from: 
 We offer exceptional opportunities for career growth, within a friendly and supportive team. As well as a competitive salary, pension and associated benefits you will enjoy an unrivalled working environment, including an active social calendar and subsidised canteen, all while working in a start of the art client facility- a leading biotechnology company
 Fantastic developmental opportunities and career progression pathways such as leadership, training, compliance and Subject Media Expert.
 Full Benefits Package including:- Pension
 Private Medical Insurance
 Income protection and life assurance
 Annual discretionary bonus
 Birthday Holiday entitlement
 
 Exciting Eurofins Incentives: Employee Activity Committee (EAC), Equality Driving Excellence (EDE), significant Reward and Recognition programme Opportunity to benefit from Eurofins Operational Development training platform, plus potential support for part-time training (relevant to the position)
 Full use of the canteen facilities and barista on the client site
 Free parking onsite and onsite electric charging
 Additional annual leave days with continued service
 The opportunity to work on life saving products
 What Happens Next 
 Our people are the backbone of what we do, so it's incredibly important we find the right individuals to join us. As a potential new recruit you'll be invited to meet the team in the form of an assessment centre or a staged interview process dependent on the role and it's requirements, this will give you the opportunity to see what working for Eurofins is really like and enable us to get you know your key skills and strengths.
 Your data 
 As part of any recruitment process, the company collects and processes personal data relating to job applicants. The company is committed to being transparent about how it collects and uses that data and to meeting its data protection obligations.
 We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.
 For more information about Eurofins PSS® please visit our website and watch a message below from our Global Head, Beth Di Paolo.

title: Medical device manufacturer streamlines clinical trial using Accelerant ClinPASSTM
description:
The Customer A medical device company with global presence with innovative solutions in multiple therapies. The Challenge An efficient clinical trial design with regulatory constraints is part science and part data science. Customer was challenged to complete enrollment in defined timeframe and within a certain budget. The customer had challenges providing overall study data to sites in real time and communicating future enrollment priorities to research sites.   The Solution In order to run the clinical trial, customer partnered with Accelerant to manage end to end clinical trial. Customer enabled Accelerant ClinPASS­­TM, intelligent clinical trial platform to bring sponsor, researchers on single data science platform. Accelerant ClinPASS­­TM enabled key performance indices (KPIs) kept all parties on same page. Clinical department was able to leverage sophisticated insights generated by ??? to get deep insight into operational as well as financial metrics of the trial. By tracking spend vs budget, clinical department was able to keep check on costs. Site scorecards facilitated enabled customer to encourage most efficient sites for quicker enrollment. Research sites felt empowered to get real time data, and transparency into billing. Milestone based payment metrics provided visibility and transparency into payment processes, thus improving sponsor-site relationship. Result Standard and compliant revenue recognition process throughout the organization. Improved accuracy in revenue recognition with significant reduction in manual work. Quick drill down capability to deep dive from balance sheet to transaction details. Standard and secure reporting access, as defined in finance system. How can we assist you? Competitive + Benefits!
Location
This role is based out of our New Bailey, Manchester office. We have a hybrid working model of 3 days together and 2 days wherever.
Due to the nature of the work, you will need to be elegible for security clearance+.
About the role
The purpose of this role is to help create, implement and support technical solutions that impact internally and/or externally. It supports the execution of the software engineering strategy and roadmap that supports BT’s commercial strategy through cross functional project and technical delivery and the participation of a team that pursues innovation as well as engineering excellence.
The role is to work with other engineers build and support network and computing components of the secure platform, working closely with internal teams, Openreach engineering people and external customers. It is key to providing outstanding service to our customers by maintaining and improving the products we supply them with.
What you’ll be doing
Manages the implementation of high-level designs for stable network and infrastructure environments that meet the needs of BT, are shared with partners, and are compliant with current security, privacy, and audit requirements
Leads the maintenance of IT Infrastructure components, tools or locations and executes the designs on services (e.g., network, security, storage, compute), which are to be produced in line with design standards
Provides advanced technical knowledge and expertise where needed to support managers, principals or technical experts to resolve complex issues
Leads the collaboration with stakeholders across application development, enterprise architecture, infrastructure and cyber security teams to implement an effective product roadmap
Leads the day-to-day support for internal tools and system health, as well as infrastructure implemented for all projects and managing customer support contracts
Leads the collaboration with technical architects, using advanced technical knowledge and past experience to translate architectural designs into operations
Writes documentation and builds tooling that makes the infrastructure easier to use and manage
Drives the documentation of the processes, measurements, and assessments required for both individual work and projects
Leads the activities and collaborates with team members in the installation, configuration, maintenance, support, and optimisation for all network and infrastructure hardware, software and communication links
Audits and reports on the performance and the overall health of the network and infrastructure and recommends or initiates corrective action or enhancements
Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in infrastructure engineering best practices and industry standards
Mentors other infrastructure engineers, helping to improve the team’s abilities by acting as a technical resource
Essential Skills / Experience
Advanced IP Networking, including Cisco Firewalls and Load Balancing (nginx exposure advantageous)
Advanced Windows (AD, DNS, GPOs, WSUS, server management) & Linux (RHEL/OEL) Administration with strong scripting and automation capabilities (at least two of PowerShell, Bash, Perl, Ansible) including system updates and reporting. Familiarity with open-source software/infrastructure solutions
Comprehensive IT Security Expertise, including security management, monitoring, compliance, and infrastructure security. Superior Troubleshooting Skills over a wide range of different technologies
Desirable Skills / Experience
Advanced monitoring and alerting using SNMP, WMI including bespoke scripting (PRTG or equivalent)
Database administration, SQL, and data extraction
Cloud computing platforms and services, including VMware and enterprise storage technologies
Microservices and service-oriented architectures, including containerisation using Docker
VoIP/sip telephony devices and technology (Asterisk exposure advantageous)
Experience with Cisco ACI (not essential)
Excellent Communication Skills
IT Security Management
Continuous upskilling and ability to quickly learn new technologies
Agile delivery methodologies
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life.
You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle.
Your core benefits include:
• 10% on target annual bonus
• Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
• Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
• Equalized maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
• Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
• Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
• Holiday purchase scheme
You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready.
Ready to connect for good and help shape the future? Apply now.
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good.  Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country.   Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 Job Description

 Intro 
 We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.
 
 About the Role 
 Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
 Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
 
 The Builder Experience 
 AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

 Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

 Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

 Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

 
 What You'll Actually Be Building 
 Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

 Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform  and current LLM techniques.

 Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

 Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

 Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

 Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

 Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

 Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the  product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

 Partner with the Deployment Strategist  in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

 
 You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If… 
 You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

 You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

 You are fluent in English + another EMEA language

 You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

 You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

 You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

 You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

 You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

 You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.

 You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

 You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.

 You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

 
 Nice-to-Haves 
 Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

 Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns

 Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

 Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

 
 *LI-Y

 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 
 
 
 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has been operating in Ireland since 1946 and serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.
 
 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened  a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems.
 
 This is how you can make a difference at Abbott: 
 As a Controls Engineer, you will apply your expertise in pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes to support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated control systems. Working within a regulated environment, you will leverage your technical knowledge to ensure process reliability, compliance, and operational excellence. You will play a key role in developing and maintaining solutions that enhance manufacturing efficiency, productivity, and performance while supporting business and customer requirements.

 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Apply technical expertise in pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes to support operational and project objectives.

 Implement, monitor, and maintain process systems to ensure efficient, reliable, and compliant manufacturing operations.

 Develop, calculate, and organise data for complex process flow diagrams, including instrumentation and control requirements.

 Create and evaluate process and unit operation models to optimise performance and productivity.

 Define process sequences and prepare detailed equipment specifications, operating procedures, and work instructions.

 Conduct process testing, monitoring, and analysis throughout production, evaluating variables such as temperature, pressure, density, and viscosity.

 Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve process and equipment issues, providing effective engineering solutions to minimise downtime.

 Ensure all processes, procedures, and documentation comply with applicable regulatory, quality, and safety standards.

 Support root cause investigations, deviation management, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives and enhance operational performance.

 
 Education & Experience 
 Associate Degree, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Process Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related technical discipline.

 Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, biologics, or regulated manufacturing environment.

 Experience supporting manufacturing processes, process improvements, or production operations is desirable.

 Knowledge of process control, instrumentation, troubleshooting, and compliance requirements within a regulated industry would be an advantage.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

 
 What we Offer 
 Attractive compensation package that includes competitive pay, as well as benefits such as
 Family health insurance,

 Excellent pension scheme

 Life assurance

 Career Development

Key skills and prior experience that align well with this position Ideally suited to a solicitor interested in pursuing a career in tax Studying towards being a Chartered Tax Adviser or is already a Chartered Tax Adviser. They value integrity, collaboration and continuous development, leading by example with a supportive and inclusive leadership style. They encourage innovation and empower their teams to take ownership of their work while fostering strong client relationships and cross-border collaboration. Where is this role based? Deloitte is the number one professional services firm in the world, and the leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, sustainability, tax, and related services. We have offices across Ireland in Dublin, Belfast, Cork, Limerick and Galway. It means we trust our people with the flexibility and control to make the right choices in where, when, and how they work. Deloitte is looking for people that have a leadership mindset, are curious, enjoy solving challenges and are eager to grow their careers.

About the role
The role will be Brisbane based and it is a 24- month fixed term role.
The LTE RAN RF Planning Engineer is responsible for monitoring, optimising, and maintaining the RF performance of a private LTE network and associated wireless technologies used to support mission‑critical mining operations. This includes ensuring consistent coverage, mobility, and capacity for autonomous haulage, fleet communications, IoT sensors, control systems, CCTV, rail operations, and Cambium point‑to‑multipoint (PTMP) / point‑to‑point (PTP) wireless links distributed across the mine.
The role focuses on operational RF optimisation, performance troubleshooting, and supporting deployment or relocation of LTE cells and Cambium nodes in dynamic mining environments.
What you’ll be doing
Manage incidents and requests while maintaining high ticket quality and hygiene.
Develop RF propagation and coverage models for open-pit mine environments using tools such as HTZ, Atoll, Mentum, or similar.
Perform advanced root cause analysis for LTE outages.
Maintain and manage LTE macro/small cell hardware (FDD) suitable for dynamic mining operations.
Perform frequency optimization, PCI/RSI planning, link budgets, interference analysis, and EARFCN/channel allocation.
Create RAN capacity plans aligned with AHS (Autonomous Haulage System), telemetry, CCTV, and IoT demands.
Provide remote guidance to field teams performing RF surveys, antenna alignment, and LTE trailer moves.
Use TEMS Pocket / TEMS Discovery for drive‑test data analysis (onsite teams), RSRP/SINR profiling, Layer‑3 message decoding, handover investigations, and KPI trend analysis.
Analyse LTE RAN performance KPIs including throughput, PRB utilisation, accessibility, retainability, and mobility metrics.
Identify and resolve issues such as overshooting, coverage holes, interference, and imbalance.
Produce optimisation recommendations such as power adjustments, tilt optimisations, parameter changes, and azimuth
Conduct remote troubleshooting sessions with onsite teams, providing step‑by‑step diagnostic guidance.
Manage and optimise Cambium PTP/PTMP backhaul links using tools such as Cambium  HTZ/ LINKPlanner.
Perform path profile studies, Fresnel zone checks, and availability modelling.
Provide remote alignment assistance and configuration guidance to site teams.
Work with Mining Technology, AHS, Fleet Management, and OT Automation teams to understand coverage/performance needs, adjust designs for pit progression and mine expansion, and ensure stable connectivity for trucks, drills, shovels, LV, and IoT devices
Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes
Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes.
Prepare RF design documents, coverage heatmaps, network design packs, BOMs, and commissioning documentation.
Support acceptance and integration testing remotely.
Maintain version-controlled RF documents and change logs.
Design LTE and wireless systems for high reliability in remote industrial environments.
Ensure designs comply with mining standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational safety guidelines.
Consider resilience, redundancy, and harsh environmental factors when developing plans.
Manage and upkeep of NetAct server and software.
Essential Skills / Experience
Minimum 3–5+ years of LTE RAN planning, RF engineering, or optimisation experience.
Experience with Private LTE / 5G SA networks in industrial deployments.
Experience with common GIS applications eg: Global mapper,ArcGIS
Knowledge of mining technologies (AHS, fleet management, dispatch systems).
Networking knowledge: VLANs, routing, backhaul design, QoS.
Scripting or automation (Python, SQL) for performance reporting is advantageous.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Preferred :
LTE/RAN certification (nokia,Ericsson,Cisco)
Cambium certification desirable
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Strong understanding of LTE RAN concepts (EPC/E-UTRAN architecture, PCI planning, SINR/RSRP/TA, VoLTE, CA, etc.).
Hands‑on experience analysing drive test data using TEMS Investigation or TEMS Discovery.
Experience with RF planning tools (Atoll, HTZ, Planet, Mentum, iBwave).
Experience with Cambium Networks (PTP 670/700, PMP 450i/450m,CnMaestro, cnWave, etc.).
Strong analytical background in interpreting logs, KPIs, layer‑3 messages, and RF statistics.
Experience in ticketing-tools like Service Now, and exposure to ITIL processes in context of service operations is a plus.
Experience supporting remote sites (mining/oil & gas/utilities) is preferred.
Ability to work effectively with field teams from a remote location.

You’ll be part of the team supporting Flipdish’s mission to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple. This role is a generalist role with an emphasis on two core regulatory mindset areas - employment law and data protection - alongside an interesting and varied mix of other legal work spanning corporate, M&A, IP and equity. .

You’ll partner closely with our People, Finance, Commercial, Product and Engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to provide pragmatic, risk-aware guidance, help shape internal processes, and ensure the business stays compliant.

What you’ll own

  • Lead employment law support across the business
  • Lead data protection compliance key data-protection processes.
  • Steward privacy policy and marketing compliance: maintain privacy policy updates and ensure direct marketing practices (including SMS compliance) are handled lawfully.
  • Maintain training and standards for key teams (People, Support, and others) so compliance is practical and repeatable.
  • Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility - prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.

What success looks like

  • You are involved partner to the business who isn’t confined to their legal swim lane
  • You take a proactive approach to employment-law and handle issues consistently, with timely and well-documented advice.
  • You ensure data subject  requests are handled with clear legal triage, governance, and defensible timelines.
  • You strengthen our compliance culture through targeted training and practical guidance that teams can apply.
  • You own Companies Act compliance for our Irish entities alongside third party company secretarial support.
  • You scan for relevant legal changes that will impact our business and take a proactive approach to getting ahead of these.
  • You are a key part of the team managing our employee equity structure.
  • You are well known in the Commercial team for transacting partner contracts and triaging some novel customer queries.

About You

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 3+ years PQE (qualified as a solicitor in Ireland).
  • Can demonstrate strong experience across employment law and practical risk management.
  • Have credible GDPR / data protection experience, including comfort engaging with regulators and leading privacy assessments.
  • Communicate clearly with non-lawyers, translate legal risk into actionable next steps, and manage sensitive situations with discretion.
  • Take high ownership: you don’t wait to be told what to do.
  • Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working.
  • Embrace technology to augment your work and build efficient processes

The following would help you stand out.

  • In-house experience in a tech / data-driven environment.
  • Experience with privacy policy governance, marketing compliance, and operational DSAR oversight.
  • Exposure to other EU regulatory areas (e.g., digital or accessibility-related compliance) where privacy intersects.

What You Get

We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!

  • Hub model (hybrid): a healthy blend of hub + home working (2 days per week from our Sandyford office)
  • Time off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays
  • Private healthcare
  • Pension: Retirement savings support (Ireland)
  • Team connection: regular team meet-ups and company events
  • Commuter supports: TaxSaver / travel schemes (where available)

Our Culture

At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.

Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.

Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, and create the space for people to grow (with balance, not burnout). We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.

If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.
Location/Division Specific Information


Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic guides. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations.


Discover Impactful Work:
The role of Group Leader is to provide support to our Biopharma department by providing management and direction to a group of laboratory staff and resources for project activities and needs, overseeing daily operations to monitor quality and project timeliness, and assist in preparation and implementation of company policies, quality systems and training programs.


A day in the Life
•Management of a team of analysts
•Allocation, scheduling and managing laboratory resources for group's project activities and updates LIMS for project status. Reviews timesheet reports for billing accuracy.

•Designing experimental study and participates in technical troubleshooting.
•Reviewing data for technical quality and compliance to protocols, methods and SOPs. Review and approve laboratory investigations, deviations, QA facility and data audits. Assists in client and regulatory authority audits.
•Responding to client questions and needs; leads client technical meetings.
•Assisting in preparation of proposals, project definition and pricing.
•Coordinating and prioritizing project activities with internal functional groups (physical testing, analytical development, etc.) and support functions (QA, sample management, etc.)
•Assisting senior group leaders and/or managers in their responsibilities.
•Preparation and implementing SOPs and company operational policies. Ensuring adherence and making recommendations for quality system improvements.

•Educated to a bachelor's degree level in a relevant area, ie chemistry, biochemistry. In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.
•Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years) or equivalent and relevant combination of education, training, & experience.
•1+ year of leadership responsibility

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
•Management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech or analytical contract laboratory industries
•Stability/QC/analytical R&D/project and program management.
•Direct supervision of technical staff.
•Full understanding of GMP requirements, client SOPs, ICH guidelines, EP and USP requirements, EMA and FDA guidance's.

title: Packaging & Sustainability Advisor
description:
Your new role 
 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Packaging & Sustainability Advisor to join a leading Not for Profit organisation focused on sustainability, packaging innovation, and regulatory compliance.
 Reporting to the Packaging Technology Manager, you will provide expert guidance on packaging design, recyclability, waste reduction, and evolving packaging legislation. You will work closely with member organisations and industry stakeholders, delivering technical consultancy, training, and support to help businesses achieve their sustainability goals.
 

 Your responsibilities 
 Partner with organisations to review and assess their packaging portfolios, identifying opportunities to reduce packaging waste and improve recyclability. 
 Conduct technical packaging audits and provide practical recommendations on plastic reduction, lightweight, and the transition to more sustainable packaging materials. 
 Advise stakeholders on Design for Recycling (DfR) principles, helping businesses improve packaging performance within a circular economy framework.
 Provide guidance on packaging regulations, including the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), eco-modulated fees, and plastic levy requirements. 
 Develop and deliver technical workshops, webinars, and best-practice resources to support member engagement and knowledge sharing.
 Keep abreast of industry developments, emerging technologies, and sustainability trends to provide informed technical advice to members. 
 Build strong relationships with stakeholders across industry, supporting organisations on their journey towards more sustainable packaging solutions.
 

 What you'll need to succeed 

 This role would suit an experienced packaging professional passionate about sustainability, circular economy initiatives, and helping organisations make meaningful improvements to their environmental impact.
 
 A degree in Packaging Technology, Materials Science, Sustainable Development, or a related technical discipline.
 At least 3 years' experience in a packaging, sustainability, materials, manufacturing, or related technical role.
 Strong working knowledge of plastic packaging, polymers, recycling technologies, and circular economy principles– not in a laboratory or from a research point of view – but from a commercially working environment. (I.e.in a Manufacturing or an FMCG environment). 
 Knowledge of packaging legislation and regulatory frameworks, including PPWR and wider sustainability initiatives.
 A full clean driving licence and willingness to travel when required. 
 

 What you'll get in return 
 The opportunity to work at the forefront of packaging sustainability and environmental innovation.
 Exposure to industry-leading sustainability projects and initiatives.
 A collaborative and supportive working environment.
 Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
 The chance to influence packaging sustainability practices across a diverse range of organisations and sectors.
 
 What you need to do now 
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.
